In this case we'd have to see, once more, whether this kind of year were either one with or distinct from the twelve months.

gru.acip: GCIG TU GRUB NA ZLA BA BCU GNYIS YOD PA BZHIN DU LO YANG BCU GNYIS SU 'GYUR LA,
gru.wylie: gcig tu grub na zla ba bcu gnyis yod pa bzhin du lo yang bcu gnyis su 'gyur la
gru.english: Suppose it were one with them.  In this case, the year would have to be twelve years--given that there are twelve months.

gru.acip: THA DAD DU GRUB NA ZLA BA BCU GNYIS PO RE RE NAS BSAL BA'I RJES SU, LO DE 'DI'O ZHES BSTAN RGYU DGOS PA LAS, DE LTAR MI 'DUG PAS, DE LTA BU'I LO GTAN MI 'DUG SNYAM DU NGES SHES DRANGS NAS SNGAR LTAR BSKYANG BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: tha dad du grub na zla ba bcu gnyis po re re nas bsal ba'i rjes su, lo de 'di'o zhes bstan rgyu dgos pa las, de ltar mi 'dug pas, de lta bu'i lo gtan mi 'dug snyam du nges shes drangs nas sngar ltar bskyang bar bya'o
gru.english: And what if it were distinct from them?  In that case you'd have to be able to separate out each of the twelve years individually, point to each one of them, and say "this is the one that's the year. "  But once more that's not the way it is, and so once more we have to decide to ourselves that there simply doesn't exist any such year--and then maintain this as a meditation.

gru.acip: DE YANG NAM MKHA' LTA BU LA MTSON NA PHYOGS DANG PHYOGS MTSAMS KYI NAM MKHA'I CHA DU MA ZHIG YOD PAS, DE RNAMS DANG GCIG TU GRUB BAM THA DAD DU GRUB DPYAD DE BDEN MED KYI NGES SHES DRANGS NAS SNGAR LTAR SGOM PAR BYED DO,,
gru.wylie: de yang nam mkha' lta bu la mtshon na phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi nam mkha'i cha du ma zhig yod pas, de rnams dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub dpyad de bden med kyi nges shes drangs nas sngar ltar sgom par byed do
gru.english: We'll take empty space as our representative example of uncaused things.  There are many different parts to empty space: the cardinal directions and the ordinal directions.  Again you look into whether that empty space were either one with, or distinct from, these directions.  You come to a state of certainty about how this space could never be real, and then you meditate upon it.

gru.acip: MDOR NA NGA DANG PHUNG PO DANG RI RAB KHANG KHYIM LA SOGS PA 'KHOR 'DAS KYI CHOS THAMS CAD RTOG PAS BTAGS PA TZAM MA YIN PAR, RANG NGOS NAS GRUB PA RDUL TZAM YANG MED PAR NGES PA'I NGES SHES DE NYID RTZE GCIG TU SKYONG BA MNYAM GZHAG NAM MKHA' LTA BU DANG ,
gru.wylie: mdor na nga dang phung po dang ri rab khang khyim la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin par, rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med par nges pa'i nges shes de nyid rtse gcig tu skyong ba mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang
gru.english: To sum, there doesn't exist even a single atom of anything that exists from its own side--there is not a single thing in the world of pain, and not a single thing beyond this world of pain, which is anything more than a simple projection: whether your talking about you, or your parts, or the great mountain at the center of the world, or just the house you live in.  Come to a state of certainty about this fact, and then maintain a meditation where you stay single-pointed upon it.  This is what we call "the yoga of the empty sky. "

gru.acip: ,CHOS KUN BYANG DBYE BA THA DAD RNAMS, ,DBYINGS DON DAM NGANG DU DBYER MED 'DRES, ,LAM DGAG BSGRUB BRAL YANG MDZANGS PA'I BLOS, ,LAS DGE SDIG BLANG DOR BYA RU BYUNG ,
gru.wylie: chos kun byang dbye ba tha dad rnams, ,dbyings don dam ngang du dbyer med 'dres, ,lam dgag bsgrub bral yang mdzangs pa'i blos, ,las dge sdig blang dor bya ru byung
gru.english: Every single Thing there is--the two separate sides, The source Of pain, and total enlightenment-- Was mixed together Inseparably, in that highest realm there is. It was the path Where there was nothing to prove or disprove, But still That oh-so-wise mind of mine Saw how right The laws of karma are: what to do, and what not.

gru.acip: ,PHAN BDE'I 'BYUNG GNAS RGYAL BSTAN YONGS 'DU'I LJON, ,RAB RGYAS 'GRO KUN THAR MCHOG 'BRAS BZANG LA, ,SPYOD PHYIR BKRA SHIS LHUN GRUB CHOS GRVA CHER, ,CHOS SBYIN 'DZAD MED DAL 'GRO'I RGYUN 'DI SPEL, ,SARBA DZA GA Tm,,
gru.wylie: phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan yongs 'du'i ljon, ,rab rgyas 'gro kun thar mchog 'bras bzang la, ,spyod phyir bkra shis lhun grub chos grva cher, ,chos sbyin 'dzad med dal 'gro'i rgyun 'di spel, ,sarba dza ga tM
gru.english: The teachings of the Victorious Ones Are a great tree where living beings assemble, A source of help and happiness. It spreads its mighty branches and then Every living creature comes To pluck that finest fruit Of the highest form of freedom. May the tree be fed by the gentle waters Of an inexhaustible stream of the gift Of the Dharma, evermore increasing Here within the walls of the abbey Where joyful fortune appears of its own. Sarva Dzagatam: For the sake of every living being. [Translator's note: The expression "joyful fortune that appears of its own " includes all the words that make up the name of Trashi Hlunpo Monastery, seat of His Holiness the Panchen Lama.] * * * How it Came to Be The last thing we hear from Yongdzin Yeshe Gyeltsen's biography is the story of how our text was written:

gru.acip: BDE MCHOG RGYUD 'GREL SBAS DON KUN GSAL GYI GZABS BSHAD RNAMS YANG YANG STZAL ZHING , SGRUB PA SNYING POR MDZAD PA MANG PO LA LAM RIM DANG BSKYED RDZOGS RNAMS 'DZIN CHOS SU YANG LAN MANG DU STZAL,
gru.wylie: bde mchog rgyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal gyi gzabs bshad rnams yang yang stsal zhing , sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa mang po la lam rim dang bskyed rdzogs rnams 'dzin chos su yang lan mang du stsal
gru.english: He granted as well, over and over again, meticulous explanations upon The Revelation of Every Secret, a commentary upon the secret teachings of Highest Bliss.  So too did he grant, time and again, teachings upon the steps of the path, and upon the stages of creation and completion, to a great many people who had made their spiritual practice the entire core of their life--all meant as instructions to be committed to memory.

gru.acip: LHAG PAR BKRA SHIS LHUN POR SRAS KYI THU BO GRUB CHEN MANG PO DANG 'DUS TSOGS BCAS LA RJE RIN PO CHE'I SNYAN RGYUD LAM RIM GYI KHRID ZLA SBREL GYI BAR LA 'DZIN CHOS SU STZAL BA THUGS SRAS THU BO RNAMS KYIS ZIN DRIS SU BTAB PA BYANG CHUB LAM GYI RIM PA'I DMAR KHRID THAMS CAD MKHYEN PAR BGROD PA'I BDE LAM ZHES YONGS SU GRAGS PA 'DI BZHIN DANG ,
gru.wylie: lhag par bkra shis lhun por sras kyi thu bo grub chen mang po dang 'dus tshogs bcas la rje rin po che'i snyan rgyud lam rim gyi khrid zla sbrel gyi bar la 'dzin chos su stsal ba thugs sras thu bo rnams kyis zin dris su btab pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar khrid thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i bde lam zhes yongs su grags pa 'di bzhin dang
gru.english: Most especially, he granted--again as instruction to be memorized--teachings upon the steps of the path (all the way up to the inseparable pair) from the oral lineage of the Precious Lord, Tsongkapa.  These he gave to many great adepts of Trashi Hlunpo--to his leading spiritual sons; as well as to the assembled monks. The greatest of his heart-sons then compiled these teachings into a series of lecture notes, which became what we all know now as The Path to Bliss, a Dissection Text on the Steps of the Path to Enlightenment, to be used for Traveling to Omniscience.

gru.acip: RJE THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA'I PHYAG BZHES LTAR BDE GSANG 'JIGS GSUM GYI BDAG BSKYED, MDUN BSKYED, BUM SGRUB, DBANG CHOG DANG BCAS PA NGAG 'DON CHOG BSGRIGS SU MDZAD PA, RJE RIN PO CHE'I RING LUGS 'DZIN PA MTHA' DAG LA YONGS SU GRAGS PA LTAR YIN ZHING ,
gru.wylie: rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag bskyed, mdun bskyed, bum sgrub, dbang chog dang bcas pa ngag 'don chog bsgrigs su mdzad pa, rje rin po che'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag la yongs su grags pa ltar yin zhing
gru.english: He also compiled texts for the oral recitation of rituals in the same three secret practices: rituals for becoming the Angel; for bringing the Angel before us; for creating the sacred vase; and for granting the empowerment--all in keeping with the sacred tradition of the Lord, the omniscient Je Tsongkapa.  These works are used among all those who uphold the tradition of this precious Lord.

gru.acip: ,SGO GSUM NYES SPYOD KUN BRAL SKU BZHI YI, ,SA BON LEGS BZHAG BSKYED RDZOGS ZAB MO'I LAM, ,SGOM PA'I SNOD DU GYUR PA SGRUB PA'I THABS, ,BDAG 'JUG RIM PA NAG 'GROS TSUL DU DGOD,,
gru.wylie: sgo gsum nyes spyod kun bral sku bzhi yi, ,sa bon legs bzhag bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam, ,sgom pa'i snod du gyur pa sgrub pa'i thabs, ,bdag 'jug rim pa nag 'gros tshul du dgod
gru.english: Here now I shall set forth, In running prose, the steps By which you bring yourself Into the secret world. It is the means by which You reach the goal Of becoming a worthy vessel For practicing that deepest path Of creation and completion. It is a rite which perfectly Plants within you the seeds For each of the four perfect forms, Free of every single fault In act or word or thought.

gru.acip: DE LA 'DIR DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED DPA' BO GCIG PA'I RAS BRIS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR DU DBANG BLANG PA'I RIM PA NAG PO 'GROS SHES SU DGOD PA LA, DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB PA, MCHOD BSTOD SOGS BYA BA, DKYIL 'KHOR DU ZHUGS NAS DBANG BLANG BA, MJUG GI CHOG DANG BCAS PA LAS,
gru.wylie: de la 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang blang pa'i rim pa nag po 'gros shes su dgod pa la, dkyil 'khor sgrub pa, mchod bstod sogs bya ba, dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang blang ba, mjug gi chog dang bcas pa las
gru.english: (And so now here we will present a ritual, written in running prose, for taking empowerment into the secret teaching of the glorious Diamond Lord of Terror, in the form of a solitary warrior; while utilizing a painted form of his secret world to do so.  We proceed in four broad steps:  bringing the secret world into being; making offerings, singing praises, and the like; entering the secret world and taking empowerment; and concluding the ceremony.) 1) Bring the Secret World into being

gru.acip: RAS BRIS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR BDAG MDUN THA MI DAD DU 'JUG PA GCIG PAS SGRUB PA LA, RANG GI MDUN NGOS SU STEGS JI LTAR 'TSAMS PAR RTEN KHEBS SOGS KYIS LEGS PAR G-YOGS PA'I STENG DU RAS BRIS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR LEB MOR BKRAM PA'I MTHAR GTZO BO'I G-YAS PHYOGS NAS 'GO BRTZAMS TE G-YAS BSKOR DU DRI CHAB SNGON DU 'GRO BA'I MCHOD PA LEGS PAR BSHAMS,
gru.wylie: ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bdag mdun tha mi dad du 'jug pa gcig pas sgrub pa la, rang gi mdun ngos su stegs ji ltar 'tshams par rten khebs sogs kyis legs par g-yogs pa'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor leb mor bkram pa'i mthar gtso bo'i g-yas phyogs nas 'go brtsams te g-yas bskor du dri chab sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa legs par bshams
gru.english: (As for the first, the secret world is brought into being with a painted representation of it.  This particular mandala goes the same whether we are approaching it as the Angel ourselves, or whether the Angel is a separate being in front of us.  And so before us we place a table or stand of an appropriate size and height, and cover it first with a fine cloth. Atop the table we set the painted mandala, down flat on its back.  Around the outside of the frame, starting from the central Angels own right, we arrange a lovely array of bowls containing scented water.  These bowls are preliminary offerings; work around clockwise as you set them down.)

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS KYI MCHOG RNAMS LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG NI SKYABS SU MCHI, ,BDAG GIS SBYIN SOGS BGYIS PA 'DI DAG GIS, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG LAN GSUM BRJOD,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la, ,byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi, ,bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lan gsum brjod
gru.english: (Repeat the following three times:) I go for refuge to the Buddha, The Dharma, and the Sangha, Until I achieve enlightenment. By the power of the goodness that I do In giving and the rest May I reach Buddhahood For the sake of every living being. 3) Meditate upon the Four Infinite Thoughts

gru.acip: ,KHYAB BDAG 'JAM PA'I RDO RJE GSHIN RJE'I GSHED, ,MGON DE'I DGYES PA KUN BSKYED MKHA' 'GRO'I GTZO, ,ZUNG 'JUG GO 'PHANG MNGON GYUR L'A LI TA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: khyab bdag 'jam pa'i rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed, ,mgon de'i dgyes pa kun bskyed mkha' 'gro'i gtso, ,zung 'jug go 'phang mngon gyur lA li ta, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To the one who rules over the secret world: To the Gentle Diamond Who butchers the Lord of Death; To the Queen of Angels Flying across the sky, The one who pleased this Protector In every way there is; And to Lalita, Who was able to achieve That matchless state Of the Union of the Two. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,GRUB MCHOG DON YOD RDO RJE YE SHES SBAS, ,RLUNG SEMS DBANG BSGYUR PAD+MA BADZ+RA DANG , ,MDO RGYUD MNGA' BDAG MAR ME MDZAD PA'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: grub mchog don yod rdo rje ye shes sbas, ,rlung sems dbang bsgyur pad+ma badz+ra dang , ,mdo rgyud mnga' bdag mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To those highest saints: To Amogha Vajra And Jnyana Gupta; To Padma Vajra, Absolute lord Over inner winds and thoughts; And to Dipamkara, Absolute master Of the open and secret teachings. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,MTHU STOBS DBANG PHYUG RVA LO RDO RJE GRAGS, ,'JIG RTEN MIG GYUR CHOS RAB DE SRAS MCHOG ,DPAL LDAN YE SHES SENG GE 'BUM SENG ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: mthu stobs dbang phyug rva lo rdo rje grags, ,'jig rten mig gyur chos rab de sras mchog ,dpal ldan ye shes seng ge 'bum seng zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Ralo Dorje Drak, Lord of power Of mystic power; To His highest son, Churab, Eyes to see with For an entire world; To the glorious Yeshe Senge And the the Lord, Senge Bum. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,BDUD BZHI'I G-YUL BZLOG RJE BTZUN RGVA LO DANG , ,KUN MKHYEN SHES RAB SENG GE YE SHES DPAL, ,DON GNYIS LHUN GYIS GRUB PA RIN PO CHE, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: bdud bzhi'i g-yul bzlog rje btsun rgva lo dang , ,kun mkhyen shes rab seng ge ye shes dpal, ,don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa rin po che, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Jetsun Galo, Who on the field of battle Sent the Four Demons fleeing; To the omniscient Sherab Senge, And Yeshe Pel; And to the Rinpoche Who achieved both goals Spontaneously. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,RGYAL BA GNYIS PA BLO BZANG GRAGS PA'I DPAL, ,MKHAS GRUB DAM PA SHES RAB SENG GE DANG , ,ZUNG 'JUG MCHOG BRNYES DPAL LDAN BZANG PO'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal, ,mkhas grub dam pa shes rab seng ge dang , ,zung 'jug mchog brnyes dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To the Buddha come again: To the glorious Lobsang Drakpa; To Kedrup Je, Highest master and sage; To Sherab Senge; And to Lord Pelden Sangpo, Who won the highest Union of the Two. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,MDO RGYUD BSTAN PA'I MNGA' BDAG DGE 'DUN 'PHEL, ,RGYUD DON JI BZHIN GZIGS PA BKRA SHIS 'PHAGS, ,DON GNYIS LHUN GRUB BSAM 'GRUB RGYA MTSO'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: mdo rgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dge 'dun 'phel, ,rgyud don ji bzhin gzigs pa bkra shis 'phags, ,don gnyis lhun grub bsam 'grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Gendun Pel, Absolute master Of the open and secret word; To Trashi Pak, Who saw the meaning Of the secret way, Exactly as it is; And to Samdrup Gyatso, Who without effort reached Both the ultimate goals. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,YONGS RDZOGS BSTAN PA'I MNGA' BDAG BRTZON 'GRUS 'PHAGS, ,LEGS BSHAD 'BYOR PA'I MDZOD 'DZIN RDO RJE BZANG , ,GDAMS PA'I GTER MDZOD SANGS RGYAS RGYA MTSO'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brtson 'grus 'phags, ,legs bshad 'byor pa'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje bzang , ,gdams pa'i gter mdzod sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Tsundru Pak, Absolute master Over all the teachings; To Dorje Sang, Keeper of the treasure, A wealth of perfect words; And to Sangye Gyatso, Himself a hidden treasure Of excellent advices. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG BLO BZANG CHOS RGYAN DANG , ,RDO RJE 'DZIN PA DKON MCHOG RGYAL MTSAN ZHABS, ,SNANG MTHA'I ZLOS GAR BLO BZANG YE SHES LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang chos rgyan dang , ,rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs, ,snang mtha'i zlos gar blo bzang ye shes la, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Lobsang Chu Gyen, Absolute lord Of enlightened masters; To the lord Konchok Gyeltsen, Keeper of the Diamond; And to Lobsang Yeshe, The Angel of Infinite Forms Dancing His role for us. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,RGYAL BA'I DBANG PO BSKAL BZANG RGYA MTSO DANG , ,RGYUD DON 'DZIN PA ROL PA'I RDO RJE'I ZHABS, ,BSTAN PA'I MNGA' BDAG NGAG DBANG TSUL KHRIMS LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: rgyal ba'i dbang po bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang , ,rgyud don 'dzin pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs, ,bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang tshul khrims la, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To the lord of every Victor: Kelsang Gyatso; To Rolpay Dorje, The one who kept The meaning of the secrets; And to Ngawang Tsultrim, Absolute master Of the Buddhas holy word. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,MDO SNGAGS YONGS RDZOGS BYANG CHUB CHOS 'PHEL DANG , ,BKA' DRIN MNYAM MED BRAG RI RDO RJE 'CHANG , ,BLO BZANG CHOS 'BYOR RGYA MTSO DPAL BZANG PO, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: mdo sngags yongs rdzogs byang chub chos 'phel dang , ,bka' drin mnyam med brag ri rdo rje 'chang , ,blo bzang chos 'byor rgya mtsho dpal bzang po, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Janchub Chupel, Who possessed the entirety Of the open and secret teachings; And to the Holder of the Diamond From Drakri, The good and glorious one, Lobsang Chujor Gyatso, Whose kindness was unmatched. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,YONGS 'DZIN CHEN PO GLING SPRUL RDO RJE 'CHANG , ,BLO BZANG LUNG RTOGS BSTAN 'DZIN 'PHRIN LAS ZHABS, ,MKHAN CHEN BSTAN PA CHOS 'PHEL DPAL BZANG PO, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: yongs 'dzin chen po gling sprul rdo rje 'chang , ,blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las zhabs, ,mkhan chen bstan pa chos 'phel dpal bzang po, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To the Lord and Holder of the Diamond, The master Tutor, Lingtrul, Lobsang Lungtok Tendzin Trinley; And to the great and glorious Kenchen Tenpa Chumpel. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,RAB 'BYAMS RGYAL BA KUN GYI YE SHES NI, ,'JIGS MDZAD KHRO BOR MNGON BZHENGS MI YI GAR, ,BKA' DRIN MNYAM MED BDE CHEN SNYING PO LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni, ,'jigs mdzad khro bor mngon bzhengs mi yi gar, ,bka' drin mnyam med bde chen snying po la, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication To Dechen Nyingpo, The one of matchless kindness, Who is the wisdom Of all the infinite Victors, Embodied in the One of Wrath, The Lord of Terror, Posing as a human. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: ,DE LTAR BSTOD PAS TSE RABS KUN TU BDAG ,THEG MCHOG DGE BA'I BSHES KYIS RJES BZUNG NAS, ,ZAB RGYAS CHOS KYI DGA' STON GYIS 'TSO ZHING , ,MA RNAMS DON DU BYANG CHUB BSGRUB PA LA, ,'GAL RKYEN BDUD BZHI'I G-YUL LAS RNAM RGYAL TE, ,ZHI RGYAS DBANG DRAG GRUB CHEN BRGYAD LA SOGS, ,DNGOS GRUB KUN GYI 'BYOR PA RAB RGYAS SHING , ,THUB BSTAN SNYING PO 'DZIN PA'I MCHOG GYUR CIG
gru.wylie: de ltar bstod pas tshe rabs kun tu bdag ,theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas, ,zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston gyis 'tsho zhing , ,ma rnams don du byang chub bsgrub pa la, ,'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i g-yul las rnam rgyal te, ,zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad la sogs, ,dngos grub kun gyi 'byor pa rab rgyas shing , ,thub bstan snying po 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur cig
gru.english: By the power of These words of praise, May we in the string Of all our lives Be taken under the care Of Spiritual Guides Of the greater way. May They raise us up From childhood, Feeding us the feast Of the Dharma, vast and deep. For the sake of all our mothers May we reach our final enlightenment, Emerging victorious in the war With everything that could stop us: The four different Demon Lords. May we become rich in a wealth Of spiritual attainments: Those that include the modes Of peace and generosity, Power and ferocity, And the eight high spiritual powers. In short may we become The highest among all Who hold the very heart Of the word of the Able Ones. 5) Bless the inner offering

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS LAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR SNGON PO GZHU'I DBYIBS LTA BU BA DAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM PA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las laM las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire.

gru.acip: RDOR SEMS BSGOM BZLAS BYED NA SGRUB THABS LTAR BYA STE, ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA SKYABS SU 'GRO, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GIS SGROL, ,BYANG CHUB GNAS LA 'GOD PAR BGYI, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI YANG DAG BSKYED, ,LAN GSUM,
gru.wylie: rdor sems bsgom bzlas byed na sgrub thabs ltar bya ste, ,dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro, ,sems can thams cad bdag gis sgrol, ,byang chub gnas la 'god par bgyi, ,byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed, ,lan gsum
gru.english: (Next, do the meditation and recitation upon the Warrior of Diamond, as found in the ritual for reaching the Angel.  To begin, repeat the following words, three times:) I go for shelter To the three Rare and supreme Jewels; And I give birth Purely, to the Wish For enlightenment: I myself Will liberate Every living being; I myself Will guide them Home to enlightenment.

gru.acip: 'JUG PA BDE BA'I PHYIR BUM SGRUB KYANG MTSAMS 'DIR BYED PAS, LHA BUM LAS BUM GNYIS RANG RANG GI MTSAN MA CHOS 'BYUNG GI DBUS SU SA BON RNAMS, GRI GUG GAM, RDO RJE GANG RUNG BRIS BRKOS BYAS PA BTAGS, MGUL TSINGS BROG GSUM PA, KHA RGYAN 'BRAS BU CAN GYI SHING NGAM KU SHA GANG RIGS, CHU GTZANG SUM GNYIS BKANG BA DRI BZANG , BLA MED BUM RDZAS NYER LNGA SOGS GZHUG
gru.wylie: 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bum sgrub kyang mtshams 'dir byed pas, lha bum las bum gnyis rang rang gi mtshan ma chos 'byung gi dbus su sa bon rnams, gri gug gam, rdo rje gang rung bris brkos byas pa btags, mgul tshings brog gsum pa, kha rgyan 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam ku sha gang rigs, chu gtsang sum gnyis bkang ba dri bzang , bla med bum rdzas nyer lnga sogs gzhug
gru.english: (Since this is a convenient place to do so, you should at this point begin the process of bringing the Divine Vase into being. Take a ritual chopknife, or else a diamond, and mark the Vase of Ritual with the sacred sign, the root syllable, in the middle of a dharma star.  The vases should have a three-piece ornament around the neck, and to adorn the opening at the top either small branch of wood with fresh leaves or berries still attached, or else a piece of sacred kusha grass. Fill the vases about two-thirds of the way with pure water, and then add fragrant saffron; the 25 sacred materials for a vase of the Unsurpassed Way; or any other appropriate substance.)

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS YAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR DU BA'I MDOG CAN GZHU LTA BU RGYAL MTSAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM 'BAR BA'I 'PHRENG BAS 'KHRIGS PA'I RDO RJE'I RGYAN GYIS BRGYAN PA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las yaM las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas 'khrigs pa'i rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa
gru.english: (Go through the following visualization:) Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, YAm And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, RAm Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire. Upon the disk is a lovely diamond, Wrapped in a rosary Blazing in flame.

whole_word_matches.context: han pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas 'khrigs pa'i rdo rje'i rgya

gru.acip: DE'I STENG DU PAm LAS CHU'I DKYIL 'KHOR DKAR PO ZLUM PO BUM PAS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU LAm LAS SA'I DKYIL 'KHOR SER PO GRUB ZHIR RDO RJES MTSAN PA'I STENG DU H'Um LAS SNA TSOGS RDO RJE LTE BA LA H'Um GIS MTSAN PA,
gru.wylie: de'i steng du paM las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa, de'i steng du laM las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po grub zhir rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du hUM las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hUM gis mtshan pa
gru.english: Above this disk Appears a letter pam, PAm And from if a disk of water, White in color. It is circular, and marked With a sacred vase. Above this disk in turn Appears a letter lam, LAm And from it a disk of earth. It is yellow, and square in shape, Marked with a diamond. Atop all this comes a letter hung H'Um And from it comes a crossed diamond Marked at the center with another hung. H'Um

gru.acip: DE LAS 'OD ZER 'OG TU 'PHROS PAS RDO RJE'I SA GZHI, LOGS SU 'PHROS PAS RDO RJE'I RVA BA, STENG DU 'PHROS PAS RDO RJE'I GRU, GUR GYI 'OG RVA BA'I STENG DU RDO RJE'I BLA BRE STE,
gru.wylie: de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi, logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rva ba, steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gru, gur gyi 'og rva ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla bre ste
gru.english: From the letter come rays of light; The light descends to make a diamond ground, Travels to the sides to make diamond walls, And then ascends to make a diamond roof. Below the roof and above the walls Is a diamond canopy.

gru.wylie: chos rje don grub rin chen gyi zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of Chuje Dundrup Rinchen. Om ah hung. 16)

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB BSTAN PA'I NYI MA DGE LEGS DPAL BZANG PO'I ZHAL DU AOm AA: HUm,
gru.wylie: mkhas grub bstan pa'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po'i zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of Kedrup Je, Tenpay Nyima Gelek Pel Sangpo. Om ah hung. 18)

gru.acip: RGYUD CHEN BSAM 'GRUB RGYA MTSO'I ZHAL DU AOm AA: HUm,
gru.wylie: rgyud chen bsam 'grub rgya mtsho'i zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of Gyuchen Samdrup Gyatso. Om ah hung. 23)

gru.acip: RGYUD CHEN BRTZON 'GRUS 'PHAGS PA'I ZHAL DU AOm AA: HUm,
gru.wylie: rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags pa'i zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of Gyuchen Tsundru Pakpa. Om ah hung. 24)

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG ROL PA'I RDO RJE'I ZHAL DU AOm AA: HUm,
gru.wylie: grub pa'i dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of Rolpay Dorje, Lord of Spiritual Adepts. Om ah hung. 31)

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG SNGON SANGS RGYAS MTHONG BA, DAM PA'I CHOS THOS BA, 'PHAGS PA'I DGE 'DUN LA BRTEN PA, BSTAN PA DANG 'KHOR RNAM BZHI SKYONG BAR ZHAL GYIS BZHES PA BLA MA GONG MA RNAMS KYIS BSTEN CING BSGRUBS PA'I SRUNG MA DAM TSIG CAN RNAMS KYI ZHAL DU AOm AA: HUm,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba, dam pa'i chos thos ba, 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa, bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du aoM aa: huM
gru.english: I raise this offering To the holy lips Of the Protectors bound by pledge: Those on whom the Lamas of the past relied; Those whom They reached; Those who swore to protect All who ever saw the Buddhas, And all who ever heard the Dharma, And all who ever took themselves To the Community of beings Who have seen emptiness. I offer it to These, Who swore to protect the teachings, And the four groups of followers. Om ah hung.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS YAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR SNGON PO GZHU'I DBYIBS LTA BU BA DAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM PA,

gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire.

gru.acip: ,BDAG LA DNGOS GRUB MCHOG STZOL LA, ,TING 'DZIN KUN GYI 'BRAS BU STZOL, ,SEMS CAN KUN LA CI 'DOD PA'I, ,DNGOS GRUB BLA NA MED PA STZOL,
gru.wylie: bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol la, ,ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol, ,sems can kun la ci 'dod pa'i, ,dngos grub bla na med pa stsol
gru.english: Grant me supreme attainments Grant me the result of all meditations Grant to every living being Every unsurpassable Attainment that they dream of.

gru.acip: BDAG DANG SEMS CAN THAMS CAD LA DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD KYI BKA' DRIN STZOL ZHIG (,CES GSOL BA GDAB PO, ,DBANG LHA SOGS LA 'BUL RGYU'I MCHOD PA BYIN RLABS BYAS NA 'BREL CHAGS MOD DENG DUS BYED MKHAN NYUNG BSAM BYAS KYANG RUNG,)
gru.wylie: bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol zhig (,ces gsol ba gdab po, ,dbang lha sogs la 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa byin rlabs byas na 'brel chags mod deng dus byed mkhan nyung bsam byas kyang rung,)
gru.english: (Now make this supplication:) I beg that you grant me And every other living being The kindness Of every attainmnent Of the spirit there is. (It would admittedly seem logical at this point to perform a blessing over the offerings to be made to the Angels of the Empowerment and so on, but it seems that nowadays there are only a few people who do it.  At any rate, you may also do it here if you wish:) [254]
