gru.acip: (RGYAL MCHOG BDUN PA'I DKYIL CHOG PAR MA RGYA DBUS BCAS SU MI SNANG MOD, MKHAS GRUB GZHAN RNAMS KYI DKYIL CHOG RNAMS SU 'BYUNG BAS NA BTON NA MI 'GAL SNYAM,)
gru.wylie: (rgyal mchog bdun pa'i dkyil chog par ma rgya dbus bcas su mi snang mod, mkhas grub gzhan rnams kyi dkyil chog rnams su 'byung bas na bton na mi 'gal snyam,)
gru.english: (Its admittedly the case that this particular wording is not to be found within the copies of the ceremony for the secret world written by that supreme Victor, His Holiness the Seventh Dalai Lama.  We find it in neither the editions in China nor in those from the state of U, in central Tibet.  Nonetheless, these lines do appear in the ceremonies for this mandala composed by other wise and accomplished Masters; and so it would not seem inappropriate to recite them here.)

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,'GRO BA'I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS BZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB SGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANG CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYIS NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GIS MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: I go for refuge to the Three Jewels, And confess one by one all the wrong I have done. I rejoice in the good of every being. I hold the enlightenment Of the Buddha in my mind. I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind into my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, Let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: DENG KHYOD DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA THAMS CAD KYI RIGS SU ZHUGS KYI, DES NA NGAS KHYOD LA RDO RJE YE SHES BSKYED PAR BYA STE, YE SHES GANG GIS KHYOD DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA THAMS CAD KYI DNGOS GRUB RNAMS KYANG THOB PAR 'GYUR NA, DNGOS GRUB GZHAN RNAMS LTA SMOS KYANG CI DGOS, KHYOD KYIS KYANG 'DI DKYIL 'KHOR MA MTHONG BA RNAMS KYI MDUN DU SMRA BAR MI BYA STE, KHYOD DAM TSIG NYAMS PAR GYUR TA RE,
gru.wylie: deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi, des na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste, ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na, dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos, khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste, khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re
gru.english: Today you have entered the high family of all those who have Gone That Way.  As such, I will now trigger within you the wisdom of the diamond.  This is the wisdom with which you will be able to reach all the high attainments of those who have Gone That Way; and so needless to say it will bring you all other goals you desire.  On your part, you must agree now never to speak of the things of this secret world to those who have yet to lay their eyes upon it.  Know that, if you do, then your commitments will be broken.

gru.acip: ,'DI NI KHYOD KYI DMYAL BA'I CHU, ,DAM TSIG 'DAS NA SREG PAR BYED, ,DAM TSIG BSRUNGS NA DNGOS GRUB STER, ,RDO RJE BDUD RTZI'I CHU 'THUNG ZHIG ,
gru.wylie: 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu, ,dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed, ,dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster, ,rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig
gru.english: Drink-- This is the water That will send you to hell, The water that will burn you If you break your commitments. And this water too Is the diamond nectar of deathlessness That will bring you every attainment If you keep your commitments.

gru.acip: SPYI BOR BAm LAS BYUNG BA'I CHU'I DKYIL 'KHOR DKAR PO ZLUM PO BUM PAS MTSAN PA LA HA:, SNYING GAR LAm LAS BYUNG BA'I SA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GRUB BZHI BA SER PO ZUR DU RDO RJE RTZE GSUM PAS MTSAN PA LA H'Um, LTE BAR RAm LAS BYUNG BA'I ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR ZUR GSUM PA DMAR PO RNO ZHING 'BAR PA LA A'A: ,
gru.wylie: spyi bor baM las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la ha:, snying gar laM las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor grub bzhi ba ser po zur du rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa la hUM, lte bar raM las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa dmar po rno zhing 'bar pa la a'a:
gru.english: At the tip of His head Appears a letter vam, BAm And from it comes a mandala of water, White and circular. It is marked by a vase, And here is a letter ha. HA At His precious heart Comes a letter lam, LAm And from it a mandala of earth, Square in shape, and yellow. This is marked at its corners By diamonds of three points, And here appears a letter hung. At His navel comes A letter ram, RAm And from it appears a mandala of fire, Triangular, and red. Its tips are sharp, And it blazes in fire. Here there appears a letter ah.

gru.acip: ,'DI YI DNGOS GRUB JI LTAR 'GYUR, ,RIGS NI GANG GI SNOD DU 'GYUR, ,BSOD NAMS MTHU YANG JI LTA BA, ,DE 'DRA DKYIL 'KHOR DU GYUR CIG ,
gru.wylie: 'di yi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur, ,rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur, ,bsod nams mthu yang ji lta ba, ,de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig
gru.english: Which attainments Will my disciple reach? Which family Are they fit to join? Let my disciple's good deeds answer; Let this world now transform According to these dictates.

gru.acip: (ZHES BRJOD DE ME TOG 'KHYIL 'KHOR DU DOR, GZHAN LA DBANG BSKUR BA'I TSE GTZO BO'I SKU LA PHOG NA MYUR DU 'GRUB CING, LHA'I SKU BKOD PA'I MDZOD SPU LA SOGS PA LA PHOG NA PHYAG CHEN LA SOGS PA'I DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB, SKU LAS HA CANG RING NA YUN RING BAS 'GRUB LA NYE NA MYUR RO,  ,RTZIG PA'I PHYIR LHUNG NA LAN GSUM BSKYAR, YANG PHYIR LHUNG NA DNGOS GRUB PHRA MO 'GRUB, 'DI LVA BA PAS MI BZUNG BAR BSHAD,)
gru.wylie: (zhes brjod de me tog 'khyil 'khor du dor, gzhan la dbang bskur ba'i tshe gtso bo'i sku la phog na myur du 'grub cing, lha'i sku bkod pa'i mdzod spu la sogs pa la phog na phyag chen la sogs pa'i dngos grub 'grub, sku las ha cang ring na yun ring bas 'grub la nye na myur ro, ,rtsig pa'i phyir lhung na lan gsum bskyar, yang phyir lhung na dngos grub phra mo 'grub, 'di lva ba pas mi bzung bar bshad,)
gru.english: (Now stand and drop the flower onto the drawing of the mandala.  When you are granting the empowerment to someone else and they are dropping the flower, it indicates that they will reach their spiritual goals with speed if the flower falls upon the image of the central Angel.  If you have placed a larger image of the Angel there and the flower falls upon an important place like the spot between the eyebrows, then this indicates that the disciple will reach attainments such as the Great Seal. If the flower drops some distance from this Angel's holy body, then the attainments will take longer; the closer it drops, the faster.  If the flower falls outside the walls of the mandala, then have the disciple try three more times.  If still it falls outide the walls, then the attainments will lesser.  Master Kambalapada even advises that this particular kind of disciple should not be led further into the empowerment at this time.)

gru.acip: RDO RA'I NANG LHUNG NA TSEGS CHEN POS 'GRUB LA, DE'I PHYIR LHUNG NAS DNGOS GRUB MED CING, DKYIL 'KHOR YANG RE ZHIG MI BSTAN PAR SNGAGS BZLAS PA LA SOGS PAS SKAL BA DANG LDAN PAR BYAS NAS PHYIS GZHUGS PAR GSUNG BA, GSANG BA SPYI RGYUD NAS DE DANG RTZIG PA LA ME TOG LHUNG BA LA YANG ZHI BA'I SBYIN SREG BYAS NAS GZHUGS PAR BSHAD,
gru.wylie: rdo ra'i nang lhung na tshegs chen pos 'grub la, de'i phyir lhung nas dngos grub med cing, dkyil 'khor yang re zhig mi bstan par sngags bzlas pa la sogs pas skal ba dang ldan par byas nas phyis gzhugs par gsung ba, gsang ba spyi rgyud nas de dang rtsig pa la me tog lhung ba la yang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas gzhugs par bshad
gru.english: (If the flower falls inside the fence of diamonds, then the disciple will develop attainments, but only with great effort.  If it falls outside even the fence, then they will not develop attainments at this time.  It is said that, for the time being, the Master should not reveal the secret world to this type of disciple, but rather give them spiritual tasks such as reciting a certain number of mantras, in order to bring them up to a higher level of goodness.  After these tasks are completed then they are brought into the mandala.  The scriptures of the secret way in general though say that, in this and the case where the flower falls outside the walls, the disciple can still be granted entrance if they first complete a peaceful fire offering.) 49) Deliver the initiate to their Angel

gru.acip: ,DA NI DAD PA'I SHUGS KYIS SU, ,DKYIL 'KHOR 'DI DE NYID LA LTOS, ,KHYOD NI SANGS RGYAS RIGS SU SKYES, ,PHYAG RGYA SNGAGS KYIS BYIN GYIS BRLABS, ,DNGOS GRUB KUN NI PHUN SUM TSOGS, ,DAM TSIG MCHOG TU KHYOD 'GYUR GYIS, ,RDO RJE PADMA RTZE ROL BAS, ,GSANG SNGAGS RNAMS LA SGRUB PA GYIS,
gru.wylie: da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su, ,dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos, ,khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes, ,phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs, ,dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs, ,dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis, ,rdo rje padma rtse rol bas, ,gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis
gru.english: Look now Upon the secret world, Through the power of your faith. Today you have taken birth Into the family of the Buddhas; And you have been blessed With mudra and mantras. You possess now The highest of commitments For every most perfect form Of spiritual attainment. Go now and accomplish The secret word; Let the diamond And the lotus play.

gru.acip: DE YANG PHYI ROL DU DUR KHROD CHEN PO BRGYAD KYIS YONGS SU BSKOR BA'I BSRUNG BA'I 'KHOR LO ME RI DANG BCAS PA'I NANG DU GZHAL YAS KHANG GRU BZHI SGO BZHI MTSAN NYID THAMS CAD DANG LDAN PA'I DBUS SU DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED ZHAL PHYAG YONGS SU RDZOGS PA STE DE LTAR RTEN DANG BRTEN PAR BCAS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR MNGON SUM DU MTHONG BAR GYUR (PAR MOS NAS,)
gru.wylie: de yang phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa ste de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur (par mos nas,)
gru.english: You look now With your own eyes Upon a complete secret world, The place and all its beings. There is a crystal palace, And around it a circle of protection Formed by a mountain of fire. This circle itself is surrounded By the eight great burial grounds. The palace has four sides, And four doors, And is replete in every respect. In its center stands the shining Diamond Lord of Terror, Perfect in all His arms and heads. (Speak then the following:)

whole_word_matches.context: 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbu

gru.acip: (DE NAS SLOB MA LA DBANG BSKUR BA LA BSGRUBS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA LA DGONGS PA GTAD PA TZAM LAS DNGOS SU DBANG BSKUR PA'I BYA BA MI MDZAD CING, DBANG RE RE BZHIN DNGOS SU DBANG BSKUR BA'I DBANG LHA GSAR PA SPYAN 'DREN DGOS PAS NA,)
gru.wylie: (de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba la bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba la dgongs pa gtad pa tsam las dngos su dbang bskur pa'i bya ba mi mdzad cing, dbang re re bzhin dngos su dbang bskur ba'i dbang lha gsar pa spyan 'dren dgos pas na,)
gru.english: (From here on, whenever the intiate is given a new empowerment, the Angels of the secret world who have already been brought into existence merely give Their assent that the power be given; it is not They who actually grant the empowerment.  Rather, we must in each case invite new Angels of Empowerment who directly give the empowerment.)

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR BA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NAM MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUBS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs, bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: (Picture then the following:) From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: (MI BSKYOD PA'I BSGOM BZLAS BSGRUBS PA SOGS LA DBANG BAR BYAS BYUNG SNYAM PA DANG, MA MTHA' 'ANG CHU DBANG BSKUR BA LA BRTEN NAS BDE STONG GI YE SHES SKYES BYUNG SNYAM PA BYED,)
gru.wylie: (mi bskyod pa'i bsgom bzlas bsgrubs pa sogs la dbang bar byas byung snyam pa dang, ma mtha' 'ang chu dbang bskur ba la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes skyes byung snyam pa byed,)
gru.english: (Reflect then on the fact that you are now empowered to engage in practices such as the meditation and recitation of the Angel named Unshakable.  At the very least, you must remember to think to yourself that, because of this Empowerment of Sacred Water, you have now undergone an experience of ecstasy and emptiness.)

gru.acip: (CHU DBANG GI DAG PA NI,) DE LTAR MI BSKYOD PA'I CHU'I DBANG THOB, ZHE SDANG GI DRI MA SBYANGS, RNAM SHES KYI PHUNG PO GNAS BSGYUR, CHOS KYI DBYINGS KYI YE SHES MNGON DU BYAS, ,MI BSKYOD PA DANG DE'I RIGS KYI DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS SO, (,ZHES BRJOD DO,)
gru.wylie: (chu dbang gi dag pa ni,) de ltar mi bskyod pa'i chu'i dbang thob, zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs, rnam shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur, chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas, ,mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so, (,zhes brjod do,)
gru.english: (The Master now gives the initiate a description of the purity which has been granted to them during the Empowerment of Sacred Water:) With this, you have attained the Empowerment of the Unshakable One: the Empowerment of Sacred Water.  The impurity of anger within you is forever cleaned away.  The heap of consciousness within you is forever transformed.  You have reached now the Wisdom of the Realm of All Things.  And you are empowered to practice and attain the Angel Unshakable, with all His family. 56) Begin the second Initiation of the Vase: The Empowerment of the Crown

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR BA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NAM MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUBS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs, bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: (Picture then the following:) From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: DE LTAR RIN CHEN 'BYUNG LDAN COD PAN GYIS DBANG THOB, NGA RGYAL DANG SER SNA'I DRI MA SBYANGS, TSOR BA'I PHUNG PO GNAS BSGYUR, MNYAM PA NYID KYI YE SHES MNGON DU BYAS, RIN CHEN 'BYUNG LDAN DANG DE'I RIGS KYI DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS SO, (ZHES DAG PA BRJOD DO,)
gru.wylie: de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyis dbang thob, nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs, tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur, mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas, rin chen 'byung ldan dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so, (zhes dag pa brjod do,)
gru.english: (Now the Master gives the initiate a description of the purity which has been granted to them during the Empowerment of the Crown:) With this, you have attained the Empowerment of the Source of Jewels: the Empowerment of the Crown.  The impurities of pride and stinginess within you are forever cleaned away.  The heap of feelings within you is forever transformed.  You have reached now the Wisdom of Equality.  And you are empowered to practice and attain the Angel called Source of Jewels, with all His family. 61) Begin the third Initiation of the Vase: The Empowerment of the Diamond

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR BA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NA MA MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUB PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR PA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams na ma mkhar bzhugs, bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: (Picture then the following:) From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS KUN GYI RDO RJE YI, ,DBANG GIS DE RING KHYOD DBANG BSKUR, ,'DI DE SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD NYID, ,RDO RJE RAB TU GRUB PHYIR BZUNG,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi, ,dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur, ,'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid, ,rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung
gru.english: I grant you today empowerment With the Empowerment of the Diamond Of every Enlightened Being there is. The diamond you see here is nothing less Than each and every Buddha; Take it now in order to reach The diamond which is Them.

gru.acip: ,DE LTAR 'OD DPAG MED RDO RJE DBANG THOB, ,'DOD CHAGS KYI DRI MA SBYANGS, 'DU SHES KYI PHUNG PO GNAS BSGYUR, SO SOR RTOGS PA'I YE SHES MNGON DU BYAS, 'OD DPAG MED DANG DE'I RIGS KYI DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS SO,, (ZHES BRJOD,)
gru.wylie: de ltar 'od dpag med rdo rje dbang thob, ,'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs, 'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur, so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas, 'od dpag med dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so,, (zhes brjod,)
gru.english: With this, you have attained the Empowerment of Limitless Light: the Empowerment of the Diamond.  The impurity of ignorant desire within you is forever cleaned away.  The heap of discrimination within you is forever transformed.  You have reached now the Wisdom of Discrimination.  And you are empowered to practice and attain the Angel of Limitless Light, with all His family. 66) Begin the fourth Initiation of the Vase: The Empowerment of the Bell

gru.acip: BDAG DANG DBANG RDZAS DRIL BU STONG PA NYID DU GYUR, STONG PA'I NGANG LAS KHAm DANG RAL GRI LAS DON GRUB LJANG GU ZHAL GCIG PHYAG GNYIS KYIS RAL GRI DANG DRIL BU 'DZIN PAS YUM DAM TSIG SGROL MA LJANG GU GRI GUG DANG THOD PA 'DZIN PA LA 'KHYUD PA,
gru.wylie: bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa nyid du gyur, stong pa'i ngang las khaM dang ral gri las don grub ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa
gru.english: (Picture then the following:) I and the substance of initiation And the bell Transform into emptiness. Out of a state of emptiness Comes a letter kham, KHAm And from it a sword. From this comes the Angel, Attainment. His precious body is green; He has one head, and two arms. In His hands He holds a sword and a bell, And He holds to Him His holy Wife, The Lady of Liberation with Vows. She too is made of emerald light, And She holds a chopknife And a cup of skull.

gru.acip: ZHES GSOL BA BTAB PAS, NAM MKHA'I RGYAL BA YUB YUM SNYOMS BAR ZHUGS, 'DOD CHAGS CHEN PO'I MES ZHU BA'I BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS KYIS RANG NYID DON GRUB TU BYAS PA LA DBANG BSKUR,
gru.wylie: zhes gsol ba btab pas, nam mkha'i rgyal ba yub yum snyoms bar zhugs, 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid don grub tu byas pa la dbang bskur
gru.english: Because of my request, The Victors in the sky before me, The holy Man and Wife, Join together in meditation. The fire of passion blazes, And They melt down into The Wish for enlightenment. Now I am the Angel, Attainment-- It grants me the empowerment.

gru.acip: DBANG GI LHA RNAMS KYIS DBANG RDZAS KYI LHA LA DBANG BSKUR, DON YOD GRUB PAS DBU BRGYAN PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur, don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur
gru.english: The Angels of Empowerment Now grant empowerment To the Angels of The substance of empowerment. The tips of Their heads Are now adorned With the Angel, Attainment.

gru.acip: DON GRUB YAB YUM ZHU BA LAS BYUNG BA'I DBANG RDZAS DRIL BUR GYUR (PAR BSAM,)
gru.wylie: don grub yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur (par bsam,)
gru.english: (Think then that:) The substance of empowerment That appeared when the Man and Wife Of the Angel, Attainment, melted down Becomes now here a bell.

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR PA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NAM MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUBS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur pa'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs, bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: (Picture then the following:) From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: DE LTAR BDUD RTZI'I CHUS DBANG BSKUR, LUS THAMS CAD GANG, BDE BA CHEN PO MYONG, DRI MA THAMS CAD DAG ,CHU'I LHAG MA SPYI GTZUG TU 'KHYIL PA YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS DON YOD GRUB PAS DBU BRGYAN PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur, lus thams cad gang, bde ba chen po myong, dri ma thams cad dag ,chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil pa yongs su gyur pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur
gru.english: With this, I have received the empowerment Of the water of deathlessness. It fills my body, And I come to ecstasy. All my impurities Are washed away. The water spills over The top of my head, Swirling there in a circle, And becoming the Angel Attainment, Who I wear as a crowning jewel. [497]

gru.acip: DE LTAR DON YOD GRUB PA DRIL BU'I DBANG THOB, PHRAG DOG GI DRI MA SBYANGS, 'DU BYED KYI PHUNG PO GNAS BSGYUR, BYA BA SGRUB PA'I YE SHES MNGON DU BYAS, DON YOD GRUB PA DANG DE'I RIGS KYI DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS SO, (,ZHES BRJOD DO,)
gru.wylie: de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob, phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs, 'du byed kyi phung po gnas bsgyur, bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas, don yod grub pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so, (,zhes brjod do,)
gru.english: With this, you have attained the Empowerment of Attainment: the Empowerment of the Bell.  The impurity of jealousy within you is forever cleaned away.  The heap of other factors within you is forever transformed.  You have reached now the Wisdom of Accomplishment.  And you are empowered to practice and attain the Angel of Attainment, with all His family. 71) Begin the fifth Initiation of the Vase: The Empowerment of the Name

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR BA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NAM MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUBS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs, bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: DE LTAR RNAM PAR SNANG MDZAD MING GI DBANG THOB, GTI MUG GI DRI MA SPYANGS, GZUGS KYI PHUNG PO GNAS BSGYUR, ME LONG LTA BU'I YE SHES MNGON DU BYAS, RNAM PAR SNANG MDZAD DANG DE'I RIGS KYI DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS SO,
gru.wylie: de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob, gti mug gi dri ma spyangs, gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur, me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas, rnam par snang mdzad dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so
gru.english: With this, you have attained the Empowerment of Appearances: the Empowerment of the Name.  The impurity of ignorance within you is forever cleaned away.  The heap of form within you is forever transformed.  You have now reached Mirror-Like Wisdom.  And you are empowered to practice and attain the Angel of Appearances, with all His family.

gru.acip: ,SHES RAB THABS KYI RANG BZHIN NYID, ,RDO RJE DRIL BU RAB GRUB PHYIR, ,BU YIS YANG DAG GUS PAS BZUNG, ,KHYOD KYIS SLOB MA BSDU BAR GYIS,
gru.wylie: shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid, ,rdo rje dril bu rab grub phyir, ,bu yis yang dag gus pas bzung, ,khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis
gru.english: (The Master says--) Take this bell now, child, Take it well, so that you can attain The diamond and the bell Which are of the nature Of wisdom along with method. Then go and gather Disciples of your own.

gru.acip: RANG RDO RJE 'CHANG DU GSAL BAS YE SHES KYI PHYAG RGYA 'DU BYAS NAS 'DOD YON LA LONGS SPYOD BA'I TSUL GYIS DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD BSGRUB PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: rang rdo rje 'chang du gsal bas ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'du byas nas 'dod yon la longs spyod ba'i tshul gyis dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya'o
gru.english: (Grant the initiate then this understanding:) You must picture yourself As the Holder of the Diamond, And then go into union With your partner of wisdom. With this you will attain Each and every spiritual goal, Using the way Of enjoying the objects Of the senses.

gru.acip: BLA MA DANG GTZO BO THA MI DAD PA'I THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER GYIS RGYAL BA 'KHOR BCAS THAMS CAD RANG LA DBANG BSKUR PA'I PHYIR DU BSKUL TE SPYAN DRANGS PA RNAMS NAM MKHAR BZHUGS, BSGRUB PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BSKUR BA'I DGONGS PA MDZAD,
gru.wylie: bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur pa'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs, bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad
gru.english: From the precious heart Of the inseparable pair-- My Lama and the central Angel-- Comes a letter hung, H'Um Whose light then flies And invites to me Every victorious Buddha there is, Along with each of Their retinues, Urging Them To grant the empowerment. They appear then in The sky before me, And the Angels of the mandala Who've already been brought into being Give Their consent That the power be given.

gru.acip: DE LA SANGS RGYAS DANG SANGS RGYAS MA YIN PA GNYIS DE KHO NA NYID DU MI MNYAM PA MED PAS GRU BZHI PA,
gru.wylie: de la sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas ma yin pa gnyis de kho na nyid du mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa
gru.english: (This first part involves saying the following to the initiate:) Now the fact that the mandala is a perfect square represents that, with reference to suchness, beings who are already enlightened and those who are not are in no way less than perfectly equal to one another.

whole_word_matches.context: ma yin pa gnyis de kho na nyid du mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa

gru.acip: BSRUNG BA'I DAM TSIG DANG, BZA' BA'I DAM TSIG DANG, GTOR MA'I CHO GA DANG, BSRUNG BA DANG, PHYIR BZLOG PA DANG, DKYIL 'KHOR BSGRUB PA DANG, DER SLOB MA BZHUGS PA'I MTSAN NYID NI SLOB DPON GYI LAS SU BYA BA'I RIM PA YIN NO,
gru.wylie: bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang, bza' ba'i dam tshig dang, gtor ma'i cho ga dang, bsrung ba dang, phyir bzlog pa dang, dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang, der slob ma bzhugs pa'i mtshan nyid ni slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa yin no
gru.english: Here are the various works of a Diamond Master, which you must perform; these are your qualification: the Pledge to Protect; the Pledge to Partake; the Offering of Tormas; the Rites of Protection; the Rites of Defense; Building a Secret World; and Bringing Disiples into the Secret World.

gru.acip: ,BDE CHEN THEG PA 'DI YIS NI, ,PHYIN CHAD 'CHI BA KHYOD LA MED, ,SRID PA SHIN TU GRUB BYA'I PHYIR, ,SRID PA'I SDUG BSNGAL LAS KHYOD 'DAS,
gru.wylie: bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni, ,phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med, ,srid pa shin tu grub bya'i phyir, ,srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das
gru.english: Now there will never be death for you; It is stopped now, Through the power Of the way of ecstasy. You've perfected the cycle of suffering And thus gone beyond its pain.

gru.acip: ,SEMS CAN RNAMS LA RJES BRTZE BAS, ,KHYOD KYIS DKYIL 'KHOR CHO GA BZHIN, ,RAB TU 'BAD DE BRI BAR BYA, ,SGRUB PA PO RNAMS RGYUD LA SBYOR, (ZHES BRJOD DE DBUGS DBYUNG BA'O,)
gru.wylie: sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas, ,khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin, ,rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya, ,sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor, (zhes brjod de dbugs dbyung ba'o,)
gru.english: Love all beings. And out of this love, Go and labor to create This secret world, As the ritual here prescribes it. Go and marry Every serious disciple To these secret teachings. 91) The purity which is granted

gru.acip: ,BTUNG BA RIN CHEN 'DI YIS NI, ,RDO RJE YI NI LUS SGRUB PAR, ,BU KHYOD KYIS NI SHES GYIS LA, ,YID LAS BYUNG BA'I CHU 'THUNG ZHIG ,
gru.wylie: btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni, ,rdo rje yi ni lus sgrub par, ,bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la, ,yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig
gru.english: Know, my child, That when you drink This jewel elixir It brings the body of diamond Into being. Come, drink, Of the dew that comes From the Mind.

gru.acip: ,BTUNG BA RIN CHEN 'DI YIS NI, ,RDO RJE YI NI LUS SGRUB PAR, ,BU KHYOD KYIS NI SHES GYIS LA, ,YID LAS BYUNG BA'I CHU 'THUNG ZHIG ,
gru.wylie: btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni, ,rdo rje yi ni lus sgrub par, ,bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la, ,yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig
gru.english: (And then she says:) Know, my child, That when you drink This jewel elixir It brings the body of diamond Into being. Come, drink, Of the dew that comes From the Mind.

gru.acip: ,BTUNG BA RIN CHEN 'DI YIS NI, ,RDO RJE YI NI LUS SGRUB BAR, ,BU KHYOD KYIS NI SHES GYIS LA, ,YID LAS BYUNG BA'I CHU 'THUNG ZHIG ,
gru.wylie: btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni, ,rdo rje yi ni lus sgrub bar, ,bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la, ,yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig
gru.english: (Then continue as before with:) Know, my child, That when you drink This jewel elixir It brings the body of diamond Into being. Come, drink, Of the dew that comes From the Mind.

gru.acip: KUN RDZOB SGYU MA'I SKU'I RANG BZHIN CAN GYI RDO RJE'I SKU BDAG BYIN GYIS BRLAB PA BSGOM PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS, 'BRAS BU LONGS SPYOD RDZOGS PA'I SKU 'GRUB PA'I NUS PA KHYAD PAR CAN BZHAG GO ,
gru.wylie: kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje'i sku bdag byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang bar byas, 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag go
gru.english: You are, moreover, now empowered to engage in the practice of blessing the body of diamond yourself--the body which possesses, as its nature, the deceptive form of the body of illusion.  And an extraordinary seed has been planted within you which gives you now the power to to attain the Paradise Body: the body complete in all enjoyments. 97) Begin the third initiation: The Initiation of Infinite Wisdom

gru.acip: ,'DI DE SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI, ,RIG MA'I BRTUL ZHUGS BLA NA MED, ,RMONGS PA GANG ZHIG 'DA' BYED PA, ,DE LA MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB MED,
gru.wylie: 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi, ,rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med, ,rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa, ,de la mchog gi dngos grub med
gru.english: This then is the burden Of the Woman of Knowledge, The Woman of every Buddha. Any fool who transgresses this Will never reach the highest goal.

gru.acip: ,DNGOS GRUB KUN GYI GTER GYUR PA'I, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI LHUNG GYUR NA, ,PHUNG PO RNAM SHES RGYAL BA LA, ,MA SMAD DNGOS GRUB GA LA YOD,
gru.wylie: dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa'i, ,byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na, ,phung po rnam shes rgyal ba la, ,ma smad dngos grub ga la yod
gru.english: This Wish for the enlightenment Is a goldmine of spiritual attainment. How could the attainments of the Maiden Ever come to a person Who allowed the body To conquer the mind?

gru.acip: DON DE GOMS PAR BYAS PA LAS MTHAR RLUNG SEMS TZAM LAS GRUB PA'I LONGS SPYOD RDZOGS PA'I SKU RANG SNANG GI RIG MA DANG KHA SBYOR BA'I LUS CAN DANG,
gru.wylie: don de goms par byas pa las mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang snang gi rig ma dang kha sbyor ba'i lus can dang
gru.english: Suppose now that you continue to acquaint yourself with this same object.  In the end, you will come to have a special body, a holy Paradise Body, complete in all enjoyments and made purely of inner winds and the mind itself--and this body will be in union with a Woman of Knowledge, who appears automatically.

gru.acip: ,SRID PA SHIN TU ZHI BYA'I PHYIR, ,SRID PA'I NGAN 'GRO LAS KHYOD 'DAS, ,SRID PA SHIN TU GRUB PA'I PHYIR, ,STON PA'I MCHOG TU YANG DAG 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir, ,srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das, ,srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir, ,ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur
gru.english: The cycle For you is put to a stop. You have passed forever beyond The cycle of the lower realms. Now you will create A different cycle, Now you will surely become yourself The highest Teacher of all.

gru.acip: ,DNGOS GRUB DAM TSIG SDOM PA 'DI, ,KHYOD KYIS RTAG TU BSGRUB BYA STE, ,SANGS RGYAS KUN GYIS MTHUN PAR GSUNGS, ,MCHOG TU RTAG PA'I BKA' YIN NO,
gru.wylie: dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di, ,khyod kyis rtag tu bsgrub bya ste, ,sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs, ,mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no
gru.english: Now you must go and forever Reach the goals, And keep your commitments And vows. All the Buddhas have said This same one thing, In a single voice-- It is Their never-ending And highest command of all.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS YAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR SNGON PO GZHU'I DBYIBS LTA BU BA DAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM PA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las yaM las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire.

whole_word_matches.context: han pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa

gru.acip: (BSTAN PA RGYAS ZHING 'GRO BA BDE BA, RANG GZHAN GYI CHOS SGRUB PA'I 'GAL RKYEN ZHI ZHING, MTHUN RKYEN 'PHEL BA SOGS GNAS SKABS DANG MTHAR THUG GI 'DOD PA'I DON RNAMS 'GRUB PAR GSOL BA BTAB,)
gru.wylie: (bstan pa rgyas zhing 'gro ba bde ba, rang gzhan gyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi zhing, mthun rkyen 'phel ba sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par gsol ba btab,)
gru.english: (Make supplications now, so that all the goals you hope for--whether they be immediate, or ultimate--may be accomplished: so that the teachings spread in the world; and that all beings reach happiness; and that all the obstacles to both your own and all other people's spiritual practice are put to an end; and that all the things we need for our practice come to us; and all the like:)

gru.acip: ,BDAG LA DNGOS GRUB MCHOG STZOL LEGS, ,TING 'DZIN KUN GYI 'BRAS BU STZOL, ,SEMS CAN KUN LA CI 'DOD PAR, ,DNGOS GRUB BLA NA MED PA STZOL, ,SLAR YANG GSHEGS PAR MDZAD PA'I PHYIR, ,RANG GI GNAS GSHEGS BADZRA MU:
gru.wylie: bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol legs, ,ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol, ,sems can kun la ci 'dod par, ,dngos grub bla na med pa stsol, ,slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir, ,rang gi gnas gshegs badzra mu:
gru.english: It is good That you have granted me The highest of attainments. Grant me as well The final result Of every meditation. Grant to every living creature All they hope for-- Grant them the goal Of the unsurpassed. And now, So that You may return to us, Travel now please to Your homes: Vajra mu.

gru.acip: ,PHYOGS BCU'I ZHING NA RGYUD 'DI'I PHYOGS TZAM ZHIG , ,'DZIN DANG GRUB PA MCHOG BRNYES DPA' BO DANG, ,RNAL 'BYOR MA TSOGS 'DUS PA DE DAG LA, ,LEGS TSOGS JI SNYED MCHIS PA'I BKRA SHIS DES, ,KHYED CAG LAM MCHOG BSGRUB BYED MTHUN PA'I RKYEN, ,THUGS GSUNG SKU YI LHAN SKYES SNGAGS SKYES DANG, ,ZHING SKYES PHO NYA'I GROGS DANG 'DUS PA LAS, ,BDE BA'I DGA' STON 'BAR BA'I BKRA SHIS SHOG ,
gru.wylie: phyogs bcu'i zhing na rgyud 'di'i phyogs tsam zhig , ,'dzin dang grub pa mchog brnyes dpa' bo dang, ,rnal 'byor ma tshogs 'dus pa de dag la, ,legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des, ,khyed cag lam mchog bsgrub byed mthun pa'i rkyen, ,thugs gsung sku yi lhan skyes sngags skyes dang, ,zhing skyes pho nya'i grogs dang 'dus pa las, ,bde ba'i dga' ston 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog
gru.english: May all of you then find the joyful fortune Of the festival of fire and bliss That comes when you gather together With your messenger mate, For They are a vital aid in reaching The goals of the highest path. May you find then the partner Who is born of the inborn union Of holy mind and body and speech; And the one who is born of mantra; And the one who is born of the sacred realms. Concluding words by the author of the ceremony

gru.acip: (MKHAS GRUB DAM PA DU MA'I ZHABS RDUL SPYI BOR THOB BA, KHYAD PAR RDO RJE 'CHANG YAB SRAS RNAMS KYI ZHAL GYI BDUD RTZIS NYE BAR 'TSO BA'I BAN RGAN 'DU GSUM PA CHOS KYI RDO RJES,)
gru.wylie: (mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor thob ba, khyad par rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsis nye bar 'tsho ba'i ban rgan 'du gsum pa chos kyi rdo rjes,)
gru.english: (And so the work was completed by myself, Chukyi Dorje [Cheshu Rinpoche Lobsang Jangchub Tenpay Drunme], a decrepit old monk with only three thoughts on his mind, who has received this teaching from a great many high masters, accomplished saints all, who deigned to place the soles of their feet upon the top of my head.  Most especially, I have been nourished in these practices with the nectar that fell from the holy lips of the Keeper of the Diamond--both the Father and His spiritual sons.)

gru.acip: (DAM PA RNAMS KYI PHYAG BZHES MDZAD RGYUN DANG DKYIL CHOG GI NGAG 'DON NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA SGRUB THABS KYI KHYAD PAR PHYOGS BSGRIGS SU BKOD PA'I DGE BAS MKHA' MNYAM SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDUD BZHI'I GA-YUL LAS RGYAL BA'I ZUNG 'JUG RDO RJE 'CHANG GI GO 'PHANG MYUR DU THOB PA'I RGYUR GYUR CIG , ,,)
gru.wylie: (dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes mdzad rgyun dang dkyil chog gi ngag 'don nag 'gros su bkod pa sgrub thabs kyi khyad par phyogs bsgrigs su bkod pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad bdud bzhi'i ga-yul las rgyal ba'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig , ,,)
gru.english: (And it has been a virtuous act, availing myself of the actual practices of the Holy Ones of our lineage, taking the recitation of this ceremony of the secret world and putting it into running prose, arranging it into a method for reaching the Angel.  By the power of this goodness, may all living beings--beings who cover the universe, vast as space itself--speedily attain the state of the Keeper of the Diamond, the Union of the Two, Victory in the War against the Four Demons.) [The translation into English has been completed by Geshe Michael Roach and Lady Christie McNally on the occasion of the first tantric initiation held at Diamond Mountain, in Arizona, United States.  Lady Ora Maimes assisted greatly with editing and layout. There were numerous sections in the original Tibetan text where the author simply stated "At this point, such-and-such a prayer should be recited," without including the actual prayer.  All these sections have been filled in to allow the ceremony to be read all the way through without stopping or skipping back to previous sections. We also corrected, to the best of our ability, doubtful spellings and such--especially with the Sanskrit mantras--by checking older Tibetan texts (primarily the matchless Je Tsongkapa), as well as several original Sanskrit manuscripts for this practice.  Finally, the lineage tree was brought up to date through our Root Lama, the Slayer of Death Himself, Sera Mey Khensur Rinpoche Geshe Lobsang Tharchin.]

gru.acip: DES NGAG GI DRI MA DAG ,GSANG BA'I DBANG THOB, 'BRAS BU LONGS SPYOD RDZOGS PA'I SKU GRUB PA'I BAG CHAGS BZHAG GO ,
gru.wylie: des ngag gi dri ma dag ,gsang ba'i dbang thob, 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku grub pa'i bag chags bzhag go
gru.english: Reciting the mantra purifies your speech of the slightest fault and bestows upon you the secret initiation.  It also plants within you the seeds to achieve the final result of the holy body which is complete in all enjoyments: the paradise body. 2 The Root Mantra of the Lord of Terror Mantra Commitment: 21 (Sadhana) The Mantra

gru.acip: YO SKYE GNAS, NI RA YA GTAN NAS, KshE YA ZAD PAR BYED PA, YA KshE GNOD SBYIN MO, YATZTSA GANG YANG, NI R'A MA YA NI 'GRUL PAR MDZOD CIG PA STE, 'DI'I NGES DON GYI BSHAD PA DE DANG CUNG MI 'DRA'O,
gru.wylie: yo skye gnas, ni ra ya gtan nas, kShe ya zad par byed pa, ya kShe gnod sbyin mo, yatstsha gang yang, ni rA ma ya ni 'grul par mdzod cig pa ste, 'di'i nges don gyi bshad pa de dang cung mi 'dra'o
gru.english: Yo means birth-place, or womb.  Niraya means at all, or completely.  Ksheya means to put an end to, while yakshe means female demon.  Yacha is any one, and niramaya means please be a haven for wanderers.  This separate breakdown of the words of the mantra, however, differs somewhat from the actual meaning of the mantra. From The Harvest of Attainments: A Work on the Stage of Creation in the Practice of the Shining Diamond Lord of Terrror (ACIP digital text S5906), by His Holiness the First Panchen Lama, Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen (1570-1662):

gru.acip: AA NU RAKTO ME BHA BA NI BDAG LA RJES SU CHAGS PA'I DNGOS POR MDZOD, SARBA SIDDHI MME PRA YATZTSA DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD BDAG LA RAB TU STZOL CIG ,
gru.wylie: aa nu rakto me bha ba ni bdag la rjes su chags pa'i dngos por mdzod, sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsol cig
gru.english: Anurakto me bhava means please be someone who loves me.  Sarva siddhim me prayacha means please grant me freely every attainment.

gru.acip: SU PO shYO ME BHA WA NI BDAG LA SHIN TU RGYAS PA'I RANG BZHIN DU MDZOD, SARBA SIDDHI ME PRA YATZTSA NI DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD BDAG LA STZAL TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: su po Shyo me bha wa ni bdag la shin tu rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du mdzod, sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha ni dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsal tu gsol
gru.english: Suposhyo me bhava means please be someone who is very generous with me.  Sarva siddhi me prayacha means please grant me every attainment.

gru.acip: ,SBYANG BA NI, NANG MCHOD KYI SGRUB GZHI STONG SBYANG BYED PA YIN, DE'ANG RANG DGAR STONG PA YIN SNYAM PAS MI CHOG PAR DE'I DGAG BYA RANG BZHIN DE SBYONG DGOS SHING,
gru.wylie: sbyang ba ni, nang mchod kyi sgrub gzhi stong sbyang byed pa yin, de'ang rang dgar stong pa yin snyam pas mi chog par de'i dgag bya rang bzhin de sbyong dgos shing
gru.english: Next we go on to the purification step; this is where you "purify" the substances that we will turn into the inner offering by sending them into emptiness.  It's not enough here that you just get some vague notion that everything has become empy; rather, you have to work to purify or clean away the nature that things seem to have: the thing that we deny when we say that something is "empty."

gru.acip: DE LA SBYANG BYA MA DAG PA THA MAL GYI SNANG ZHEN DANG, BDEN GRUB TU SNANG BA'I SNANG ZHEN GNYIS YOD PAS DE GNYIS KA SBYANG,
gru.wylie: de la sbyang bya ma dag pa tha mal gyi snang zhen dang, bden grub tu snang ba'i snang zhen gnyis yod pas de gnyis ka sbyang
gru.english: There are two things that we need to purify or clean away during this process: two kinds of impurity, and both must be cleaned away.  One is our tendency to see things as normal.  The other is our tendency to believe it when things appear to us to exist in and of themselves.

gru.acip: 'DI'I SKABS NGA RGYAL 'JOG LUGS SNANG NGOR NANG MCHOD KYI SGRUB GZHI SNOD DANG BCAS PA STONG PAR SBYANGS,
gru.wylie: 'di'i skabs nga rgyal 'jog lugs snang ngor nang mchod kyi sgrub gzhi snod dang bcas pa stong par sbyangs
gru.english: Here is what "identification with the divine" refers to exactly here.  The substances that we use to make the inner offering, along with the vessel in which they are contained, appear to our mind as emptiness: we have sent them into emptiness.

gru.acip: NGES NGOR CHOS THAMS CAD RANG BZHIN MED PA'I STONG NYID KYI LTA BA DRAN PAR BYAS NAS RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PAS STONG PA'I YUL STONG SANG DE DANG, YUL STONG PA NYID RTOGS PA'I BLO YUL CAN BDE BA CHEN PO GNYIS LA NGA RGYAL BZHAG PA YIN,
gru.wylie: nges ngor chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba dran par byas nas rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i yul stong sang de dang, yul stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i blo yul can bde ba chen po gnyis la nga rgyal bzhag pa yin
gru.english: From our side, we reflect on the fact that every object in the universe is void of any nature of its own.  As such the object which our mind is holding is sheer emptiness: the fact that nothing occurs through any nature of its own.  And the subject state of mind which perceives this object is realizing emptiness and also experiencing great bliss.  We then identify ourselves with the divine by identifying ourselves with both this object and this state of mind.

gru.acip: SNANG NGOR STONG SANG BSGOM PA TZAM GYIS THA MAL GYI SNANG ZHEN SBYONG NUS KYANG BDEN ZHEN SBYONG MI NUS, SGRUB GZHI NANG MCHOD SOGS CHOS THAMS CAD NGES NGOR RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA RDUL TZAM YANG MED PA'I STONG NYID KYI LTA BA DRAN PAR BYAS NA BDEN ZHEN YANG SBYONG NUS,
gru.wylie: snang ngor stong sang bsgom pa tsam gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyong nus kyang bden zhen sbyong mi nus, sgrub gzhi nang mchod sogs chos thams cad nges ngor rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba dran par byas na bden zhen yang sbyong nus
gru.english: Restricting our meditation to the fact that everything which appears to our mind is sheer emptiness has the power to clean us of our tendency to believe that things are normal, but doesn't have the power to purify us of our belief that things exist in and of themselves.  But then we go further and reflect upon the view of emptiness in the sense that, from our side, we actively understand that the substances which we'll turn into the inner offering, the inner offering itself, and so on are all void of even a single atom of anything which exists in and of itself.  This then does have the power to clean us of our tendency to believe that things exist in and of themselves.

gru.acip: AOm DAndA DHRiK GIS DBYUG PA GSHIN RJE GSHED PHYUNGS NYON MONGS PA'I BDUD BCOM BRTZON 'GRUS KYI STOBS LA BKOD NAS LHO SGOR 'KHOD,
gru.wylie: aoM daNDa dhrik gis dbyug pa gshin rje gshed phyungs nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod nas lho sgor 'khod
gru.english: When you say om danda dhirk, then the Slayer of the Lord of Death who carries a battle-club emerges.  He destroys the Demon of the Mental Afflictions within every living being, guiding them to the power of joyful effort, and bringing them to the southern door of the mandala.

gru.acip: P'UR BA NI G'A NAm, SHAR NA SPYOD PA NANG SGRUB KYI 'KHOR LAS BZHI'I GSHIN RJE LA,
gru.wylie: pUr ba ni gA naM, shar na spyod pa nang sgrub kyi 'khor las bzhi'i gshin rje la
gru.english: Purva niganam means the one who acts to the east, a reference to the Lord of Death of the Four Modes in the retinue of [the King of All Things] known as Inner Attainment.

gru.acip: DE LTAR BZLAS PA BYAS PA LA DGOS PA YOD DE, RANG LA LHAG PA'I LHA NYE BA'I SGO NAS LAS RAB 'BYAMS MYUR DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR BA DANG, RDZOGS RIM GYI SKABS SU RDOR BZLAS KYI RTOGS PA SKYE BA'I DGE RTZA SMIN BYED PA 'GYUR BA DANG,
gru.wylie: de ltar bzlas pa byas pa la dgos pa yod de, rang la lhag pa'i lha nye ba'i sgo nas las rab 'byams myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba dang, rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rdor bzlas kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i dge rtsa smin byed pa 'gyur ba dang
gru.english: Now there is a specific purpose for doing the visualization this way.  Your own special Angel will stay near to you, and suddenly you will find yourself able to complete trillions of sacred deeds with speed.  It also ripens the core of good karma in your being so that, when you undertake the practices of the completion stage, you quickly give birth to the realizations that come with the practice of recitation in the Warrior of Diamond.

gru.acip: DE LTAR BSKYED RIM PHRA RAGS LA BSLABS SHING, BSNYEN PA SOGS MTHAR PHYIN PA'I RNAL 'BYOR PAS, RDZAS SNGAGS 'PHRUL 'KHOR SOGS KYI LAS RAB 'BYAMS BSGRUB PA NI LAS RGYAL MCHOG DNGOS YIN NO,
gru.wylie: de ltar bskyed rim phra rags la bslabs shing, bsnyen pa sogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pas, rdzas sngags 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi las rab 'byams bsgrub pa ni las rgyal mchog dngos yin no
gru.english: Work this way through the steps of the stage of completion, going ever more subtle.  Then undertake your retreats and so on.  At the end of this process, a yogi or yogini is ready to undertake the higher practices of secret substances, secret words, the machine of the body, and so on.  This is the real form of what they call The Deeds of the Ultimate Victors. The following instructions are from Chone Lama's Crystal Mirror:

gru.acip: MTHAR YIG BRGYA BZLA, GRUB NA THUN THAMS CAD DANG, MA GRUB NA THUN THA MA'I MTHAR GTOR MA 'BUL ZHING,
gru.wylie: mthar yig brgya bzla, grub na thun thams cad dang, ma grub na thun tha ma'i mthar gtor ma 'bul zhing
gru.english: When you finish, then recite the 100-syllable mantra.  If you can, then offer a torma during every session; if not, then at least offer one during the final session.

gru.acip: 'DIR ZHI KHRO SBRAG SGRUB KYI MAN NGAG LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR BZLAS PA BYA BAR 'DOD NA,
gru.wylie: 'dir zhi khro sbrag sgrub kyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na
gru.english: If, at this point, you wish to practice recitation according to the instructions for reaching both the peaceful and wrathful modes of the Angel combined, then proceed as follows.

gru.acip: ,KHYAB BDAG 'JAM PA'I RDO RJE GSHIN RJE'I GSHED, ,RGYAL BA KUN DNGOS RJE BTZUN TZONG KHA PA, ,YAB SRAS BRGYUD PAR BCAS PA THAMS CAD LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: khyab bdag 'jam pa'i rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed, ,rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa, ,yab sras brgyud par bcas pa thams cad la, ,gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol
gru.english: I make supplication to the All-Pervading Master, Gentle Diamond, He Who Butchers Death; To glorious Tsongkapa, Who in truth is every one of the Victors; And to all those who have descended From the Father and his Spiritual Sons. Grant us please Both of the attainments.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS YAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR SNGON PO GZHU'I DBYIBS LTA BU BA DAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM PA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las yaM las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire.

whole_word_matches.context: han pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa

gru.acip: CHOS 'BYUNG DKAR PO GRU GSUM PA GYEN DU 'GRENG BA, 'OG TU PHRA ZHING STOD YANGS PA, 'OG ZUR NAS BAm LAS BYUNG BA'I SNA TSOGS PADMA'I LTE BAR H'Um LAS SNA TSOGS RDO RJE SHAR GYI RVA DKAR, LHO'I RVA SER, NUB KYI RVA DMAR, BYANG GI RVA LJANG, DBUS KYI LTE BA SNGON POS BRGYAN PA,
gru.wylie: chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa gyen du 'greng ba, 'og tu phra zhing stod yangs pa, 'og zur nas baM las byung ba'i sna tshogs padma'i lte bar hUM las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rva dkar, lho'i rva ser, nub kyi rva dmar, byang gi rva ljang, dbus kyi lte ba sngon pos brgyan pa
gru.english: They become a dharma star With three sides, and facing upwards. The bottom point is sharp, And the upper part is vast. From the lower corner comes a letter vam And from it a multicolored lotus. In its center is hung And from it comes a crossed diamond Decorating the dharma star. The eastern spoke is white, The southern spoke is yellow, The western spoke is red, The northern spoke is green, And the center is blue.

whole_word_matches.context: chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa gyen du 'greng ba, 'og tu phra zhing stod yang

gru.acip: LTE BA'I DBUS SU BHR'Um LAS 'KHOR LO BH'Um GYIS MTSAN PA LAS BYUNG BA'I RNAM SNANG DKAR PO DKAR MTHING DMAR PA'I ZHAL GSUM PHYAG DRUG PA YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS GZHAL YAS KHANG GRU BZHI PA, SGO BZHI PA, RTA BABS BZHI DANG BCAS PA MTSAN NYID THAMS CAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PA RDO RJE'I RVA BA ME RI DANG BCAS PA'I PHYI ROL TU GTUM DRAG LA SOGS PA'I DUR KHROD BRGYAD KYIS YONGS SU BSKOR BA,
gru.wylie: lte ba'i dbus su bhrUM las 'khor lo bhUM gyis mtshan pa las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po dkar mthing dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa, sgo bzhi pa, rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje'i rva ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba
gru.english: In the middle of the diamond Is a letter bhrum And from it comes A disk marked with bhrum. From the disk comes the Buddha named Appearances. He is white with six arms and three faces Of white, blue and red. He then transforms into a four-sided crystal palace. It has four doors, four raised entrances, And is complete in every way. It is surrounded by diamond walls And a mountain of flame. Outside it is encircled by the great burial grounds Of Savage Wrath and the other seven.

whole_word_matches.context: sum phyag drug pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa, sgo bzhi pa, rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa mtsha

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG SNGON SANGS RGYAS MTHONG BA, DAM PA'I CHOS THOS PA, 'PHAGS PA'I DGE 'DUN LA BRTEN PA, BSTAN PA DANG 'KHOR RNAM BZHI SKYONG BAR ZHAL GYIS BZHES PA BLA MA GONG MA RNAMS KYIS BSTEN CING BSGRUBS PA'I SRUNG MA DAM TSIG CAN RNAMS KYI ZHAL DU AOm A'A:H'Um,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba, dam pa'i chos thos pa, 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa, bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du aoM a'a:hUM
gru.english: And I raise this offering To the holy lips Of the Protectors bound by pledge: Those on whom the Lamas of the past relied; Those whom They reached; Those who swore to protect All who ever saw the Buddhas, And all who ever heard the Dharma, And all who ever took themselves To the Community of beings Who have seen emptiness. I offer it to These, Who swore to protect the teachings, And the four groups of followers. Om ah hung.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS YAm LAS RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR SNGON PO GZHU'I DBYIBS LTA BU BA DAN GYIS MTSAN PA, DE'I STENG DU RAm LAS ME'I DKYIL 'KHOR DMAR PO GRU GSUM PA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las yaM las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa, de'i steng du raM las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes the letter yam, And from it a blue disk of wind. It is shaped like a bow And ornamented with with a banner of victory. Atop it appears a letter ram, Which transforms into a three-sided Crimson disk of fire.

gru.acip: PHYOGS SKYONG 'KHOR DANG BCAS PA RNAMS KYIS BDAG GIS DAM PA'I CHOS SGRUB PA'I BAR CHAD THAMS CAD ZHI BA'I 'PHRIN LAS MDZOD CIG ,
gru.wylie: phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gis dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig
gru.english: Do now Your mighty deeds, Guardians of the Directions, And all You in Their company. Put an end to every obstacle That could ever come in the way Of our practice of the holy Dharma.

gru.acip: ,BDAG LA DNGOS GRUB MCHOG STZOL LA, ,TING 'DZIN KUN GYI 'BRAS BU STZOL, ,SEMS CAN KUN LA CI 'DOD PA'I, ,DNGOS GRUB BLA NA MED PA STZOL,
gru.wylie: bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol la, ,ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol, ,sems can kun la ci 'dod pa'i, ,dngos grub bla na med pa stsol
gru.english: Grant me supreme attainments Grant me the result of all meditations Grant to every living being Every unsurpassable Attainment that they dream of.

gru.acip: (,CES BRJOD PAR BYA'O, ,ZHES PA 'DI YANG DKON RDOR ZHABS GRAS DGE SLONG LHUN GRUB BKRA SHIS NAS NAN GYIS BSKUL NGOR PHA BONG KHA'I SPRUL MING PAS DKON RDOR BLA BRANG NYID DU SUG BRIS SU BGYIS PA 'GRO DON 'PHEL,,)
gru.wylie: (,ces brjod par bya'o, ,zhes pa 'di yang dkon rdor zhabs gras dge slong lhun grub bkra shis nas nan gyis bskul ngor pha bong kha'i sprul ming pas dkon rdor bla brang nyid du sug bris su bgyis pa 'gro don 'phel,,)
gru.english: (This piece has been set down into words by the one they call "The Reincarnation of the Stone," Pabongka, in response to repeated requests by Gelong Hlundrup Trashi, one of the monks of the Lamasery of Kondor; the writing was accomplished in fact at Kondor itself.  May this deed help accomplish the goals of all living kind.)

gru.acip: ,GSANG CHEN RGYUD SDE'I RGYA MTSO BSRUBS PA'I BCUD, ,DUS GSUM DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO GSHEGS PA'I LAM, ,DNGOS GRUB MA LUS 'GUGS PA'I LCAGS KYU CHE, ,TSOGS 'KHOR CHO GA'I RIM PA MDOR BSDUS BRI,
gru.wylie: gsang chen rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i bcud, ,dus gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs pa'i lam, ,dngos grub ma lus 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu che, ,tshogs 'khor cho ga'i rim pa mdor bsdus bri
gru.english: Here then now I will write for you The briefest steps in the ritual For the Circle of Gathering. It is the cream of the cream Churned from vast seas Of the groups of the secret way; It is the very path Along which Warriors and their Lady Angels Have made, and make, and always will make, Their way to Enlightenment. It is a massive iron hook and chain To draw irresistibly to yourself Every high attainment there is.

gru.acip: GRU BZHI SGO BZHI RTA BABS BZHI DANG LDAN PA MTSAN NYID THAMS CAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PA DANG
gru.wylie: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang
gru.english: It has four sides, and four gates, With raised portals on the outside: All the lovely features Of a true palace of the gods.

whole_word_matches.context: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid t

gru.acip: ,RGYUD SDE CHEN PO BZHI DANG YONGS 'BREL BA'I, ,YI DAM DKYIL 'KHOR LHA TSOGS 'KHOR BCAS DANG, ,KHYAD PAR KHRO BO CHEN PO GSHIN RJE'I GSHED, ,'KHOR BCAS DNGOS GRUB STZOL PHYIR GNAS 'DIR GSHEGS,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang yongs 'brel ba'i, ,yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas dang, ,khyad par khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed, ,'khor bcas dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs
gru.english: And we ask You to come as well, All Close Angels who make their home In the secret worlds connected to All four groups of the secret teachings. Come, with the mass of Angels Who attend You. We ask especially that the Angry One, The mighty Slayer of the Lord of Death, Come here to us, with all Your circle, To grant us our spiritual goals.

gru.acip: ,DUS GSUM BDE GSHEGS MA LUS SRAS DANG BCAS, ,GNAS GSUM DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO JI SNYED DANG, ,BAR CHAD KUN SEL CHOS SKYONG BSRUNG MA'I TSOGS, ,RNAL 'BYOR 'PHRIN LAS BSGRUB PHYIR GSHEGS SU GSOL,
gru.wylie: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus sras dang bcas, ,gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ji snyed dang, ,bar chad kun sel chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs, ,rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol
gru.english: Come, we beg You, Every Buddha Gone to Bliss, Or going, or ever to go; Come with Your daughters and sons, And come with all the Warriors And their Angels flying through the sky, As many as there may be of them In all three of the realms. Come too great assembly of Protectors, Those who keep the holy Dharma, And stop all obstacles. Come all, help us achieve the sacred deeds Of this deepest practice of all.

gru.acip: ,PHYI NANG GSANG BA'I MCHOD SPRIN RGYA MTSO'I DBUS, ,RIN CHEN LAS GRUB MDZES PA'I GDAN KHRI LA, ,ZHABS SEN 'OD CHAGS BRTAN PAR BZHUGS NAS KYANG, ,SGRUB MCHOG BDAG LA 'DOD DGU'I DNGOS GRUB STZOL,
gru.wylie: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus, ,rin chen las grub mdzes pa'i gdan khri la, ,zhabs sen 'od chags brtan par bzhugs nas kyang, ,sgrub mchog bdag la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol
gru.english: Come, come, deign to place Your precious feet of light Here upon this throne of jewel Floating in the midst of a sea, A galaxy of offerings Outer, inner, and secret. Stay here everlasting, Grant to all of us Who try to keep this highest practice The countless high attainments We've set our hearts upon.

gru.acip: ,H'Um ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,BDE BA CHEN PO'I TSOGS KYI MCHOD PA 'DI, ,RDO RJE 'CHANG DBANG BLO BZANG GRAGS PA DANG, ,DBYER MED RIGS KYI COD PAN DRIN CAN RJE, ,RTZA BA BRGYUD PA'I BLA MA RNAMS LA 'BUL, ,DGYES SHING BZHES NAS SGRUB MCHOG BDAG CAG LA, ,'PHRIN LAS RNAM BZHI GRUB PA CHEN PO BRGYAD, ,BLA MED MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: hUM zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i, ,bde ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di, ,rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa dang, ,dbyer med rigs kyi cod pan drin can rje, ,rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul, ,dgyes shing bzhes nas sgrub mchog bdag cag la, ,'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad, ,bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: Hung! Here is the Offering of the Gathering, Ecstasy itself, Blessed and become the nectar of deathlessness, Immaculate understanding. And we offer it to To our root and lineage Lamas: To You of greatest kindness, Crowning jewels of Enlightened Kind, Completely indivisible From the Keeper of the Diamond-- Lobsang Drakpa himself. Be pleased, we beg You, With our gift, and accept it from us. For we are high practitioners, And we ask that You grant us The power of the four mighty deeds, The eight great attainments, And the highest spiritual goal of all-- The unsurpassable.

gru.acip: ,H'Um ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,BDE BA CHEN PO'I TSOGS KYI MCHOD PA 'DI, ,DPAL LDAN RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED GSHID RJE'I GSHED, ,DUS 'KHOR GSANG BDE DGYES PA RDO RJE SOGS, ,YI DAM ZHI KHRO RAB 'BYAMS RNAMS LA 'BUL, ,DGYES SHING BZHES NAS SGRUB MCHOG BDAG CAG LA, ,'PHRIN LAS RNAM BZHI GRUB PA CHEN PO BRGYAD, ,BLA MED MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: hUM zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i, ,bde ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di, ,dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed gshid rje'i gshed, ,dus 'khor gsang bde dgyes pa rdo rje sogs, ,yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams rnams la 'bul, ,dgyes shing bzhes nas sgrub mchog bdag cag la, ,'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad, ,bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: Hung! Here is the Offering of the Gathering, Ecstasy itself, Blessed and become the nectar of deathlessness, Immaculate understanding. And we offer it To the glorious Diamond Lord of Terror, To the Slayer of the Lord of Death; And to all the millions of Close Angels, Peaceful ones and wrathful too: To those who count among Their number The Wheel of Time; the Secret Collection; Highest Bliss and the Diamond of Pleasure. Be pleased, we beg You, With our gift, and accept it from us. For we are high practitioners, And we ask that You grant us The power of the four mighty deeds, The eight great attainments, And the highest spiritual goal of all-- The unsurpassable.

gru.acip: ,H'Um ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,BDE BA CHEN PO'I TSOGS KYI MCHOD PA 'DI, ,DUS GSUM BDE GSHEGS DAM CHOS 'PHAGS TSOGS BCAS, ,BSLU MED DKON MCHOG RIN CHEN MA LUS DANG, ,KHYAD PAR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO'I TSOGS LA 'BUL, ,DGYES SHING BZHES NAS SGRUB MCHOG BDAG CAG LA, ,'PHRIN LAS RNAM BZHI GRUB PA CHEN PO BRGYAD, ,BLA MED MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: hUM zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i, ,bde ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di, ,dus gsum bde gshegs dam chos 'phags tshogs bcas, ,bslu med dkon mchog rin chen ma lus dang, ,khyad par dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul, ,dgyes shing bzhes nas sgrub mchog bdag cag la, ,'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad, ,bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: Hung! Here is the Offering of the Gathering, Ecstasy itself, Blessed and become the nectar of deathlessness, Immaculate understanding. And we offer it To Those Who Have Gone to Bliss Before, or now, or in time to come; And to the highest Dharma, And the Community of beings Who have already seen the void; We offer it to all of You Jewels, Precious and supreme, Who cannot ever fail us. And most especially we offer this To the crowds of Warriors And Ladies who travel the sky. Be pleased, we beg You, With our gift, and accept it from us. For we are high practitioners, And we ask that You grant us The power of the four mighty deeds, The eight great attainments, And the highest spiritual goal of all-- The unsurpassable.

gru.acip: ,H'Um ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,BDE BA CHEN PO'I TSOGS KYI MCHOD PA 'DI, ,PHYAG DRUG CHOS RGYAL 'DOD KHAMS DBANG PHYUG MA, ,ZHAL BZHI RGYAL CHEN DREGS PA LCAM SRING SOGS, ,MA LUS CHOS SKYONG BSRUNG MA'I TSOGS LA 'BUL, ,DGYES SHING BZHES NAS SGRUB MCHOG BDAG CAG LA, ,'PHRIN LAS RNAM BZHI GRUB PA CHEN PO BRGYAD, ,BLA MED MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: hUM zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i, ,bde ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di, ,phyag drug chos rgyal 'dod khams dbang phyug ma, ,zhal bzhi rgyal chen dregs pa lcam sring sogs, ,ma lus chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs la 'bul, ,dgyes shing bzhes nas sgrub mchog bdag cag la, ,'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad, ,bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: Hung! Here is the Offering of the Gathering, Ecstasy itself, Blessed and become the nectar of deathlessness, Immaculate understanding. And we offer it To the Six-Armed One, To the King of All Things, To the Empress of the Desire Realm, To the Four-Faced One, the Great King, The Arrogant One, and the Queen of Witches; To all the Guardians of the Dharma, To all the Ladies who keep it safe. Be pleased, we beg You, With our gift, and accept it from us. For we are high practitioners, And we ask that You grant us The power of the four mighty deeds, The eight great attainments, And the highest spiritual goal of all-- The unsurpassable.

gru.acip: ,H'Um ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,BDE BA CHEN PO'I TSOGS KYI MCHOD PA 'DI, ,PHYOGS SKYONG ZHING SKYONG DREGS PA SDE BRGYAD DANG, ,TSE RING MCHED LNGA BSTAN MA BCU GNYIS SOGS, ,YUL LHA GZHI BDAG 'KHOR DANG BCAS LA 'BUL, ,DGYES SHING BZHES NAS SGRUB MCHOG BDAG CAG LA, ,SPYOD LAM RNAM BZHI BYA BA CI BYED KYANG, ,KUN SLONG RU NGA PHRAG DOG MA BYED PAR, ,'GAL RKYEN KUN GSOL MTHUN RKYEN MA LUS SGRUBS,
gru.wylie: hUM zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i, ,bde ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di, ,phyogs skyong zhing skyong dregs pa sde brgyad dang, ,tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs, ,yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul, ,dgyes shing bzhes nas sgrub mchog bdag cag la, ,spyod lam rnam bzhi bya ba ci byed kyang, ,kun slong ru nga phrag dog ma byed par, ,'gal rkyen kun gsol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs
gru.english: Hung! Here is the Offering of the Gathering, Ecstasy itself, Blessed and become the nectar of deathlessness, Immaculate understanding. And we offer it To the Guardians of the Ten Directions, The Protectors of the Holy Lands, The Eight Great Forces of Arroganze, The Five Mighty Sisters who grant long life, The Band of the Twelve Protectors, And to all their like. We offier to the spirits of power Who live in our land, And to the lord of all the spirits Who make this very place their home. Be pleased, we beg You, With our gift, and accept it from us. For we are high practitioners, And regardless of how we seem to act, In each of the four different modes, You need not think of us With thoughts of envy or possessiveness. Come instead and work with us: Help to clear away Anything that could hinder us; Help us gather together All the things we need to succeed.

gru.acip: ,DGYES SHING BZHES TE RNAL 'BYOR BDAG CAG LA, ,RTAG TU GA-YEL BA MED PA'I GROGS MDZAD NAS, ,'GAL RKYEN KUN GSOL MTHUN RKYEN MA LUS SGRUBS, (ZHES BRJOD CING,)
gru.wylie: dgyes shing bzhes te rnal 'byor bdag cag la, ,rtag tu ga-yel ba med pa'i grogs mdzad nas, ,'gal rkyen kun gsol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs, (zhes brjod cing,)
gru.english: Be pleased with our gifts, And kindly accept them, For we are high practitioners; Come then now and work with us, Never failing in this charge-- Help to clear away Anything that could hinder us; Help us gather together All the things we need to succeed.

gru.acip: ,PHYOGS BCU'I ZHING NA RGYUD 'DI'I PHYOGS TZAM ZHIG , ,'DZIN DANG GRUB PA MCHOG BRNYES DPA' BO DANG, ,RNAL 'BYOR MA TSOGS 'DUS PA DE DAG LA, ,LEGS TSOGS JI SNYED MCHIS PA'I BKRA SHIS DES,
gru.wylie: phyogs bcu'i zhing na rgyud 'di'i phyogs tsam zhig , ,'dzin dang grub pa mchog brnyes dpa' bo dang, ,rnal 'byor ma tshogs 'dus pa de dag la, ,legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des
gru.english: And so we have gained great joyful fortune, We have gathered goodness, from this Gathering. And we dedicate it to the spiritual Warriors And their Angel mates in every corner Of the entire universe: To all of those who have gained the highest goal, And to those as well who are trying to follow Even the tiniest part of this secret practice.

gru.acip: ,KHYED CAG LAM MCHOG BSGRUB BYED MTHUN PA'I RKYEN, ,THUGS GSUNG SKU YI LHAN SKYES SNGAGS SKYES DANG, ,ZHING SKYES PHO NYA'I GROGS DANG 'DUS PA LAS, ,BDE BA'I DGA' STON 'BAR BA'I BKRA SHIS SHOG ,
gru.wylie: khyed cag lam mchog bsgrub byed mthun pa'i rkyen, ,thugs gsung sku yi lhan skyes sngags skyes dang, ,zhing skyes pho nya'i grogs dang 'dus pa las, ,bde ba'i dga' ston 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog
gru.english: May all of you then find the joyful fortune Of the festival of fire and bliss That comes when you gather together With your messenger mate, For They are a vital aid in reaching The goals of the highest path. May you find then the partner Who is born of the inborn union Of holy mind and body and speech; And the one who is born of mantra; And the one who is born of the sacred realms.

gru.acip: ,SKU GSUM LHUN GRUB THUGS RJE MTHAR PHYIN YANG, ,SRID GSUM GDUG PA 'DUL PHYIR KHROS PA'I SKU, ,DUS GSUM RGYAL BA'I BSTAN BSRUNGS CHEN MO LA, ,SGO GSUM GUS PA CHEN POS PHYAG 'TSAL BSTOD,
gru.wylie: sku gsum lhun grub thugs rje mthar phyin yang, ,srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku, ,dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan bsrungs chen mo la, ,sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod
gru.english: I bow to the Lady who preserves The teachings of the Victors of all three times. You have reached the ultimate end Of compassion that acts without a thought: The state of all three Bodies. Yet still You take this violent form In order to subdue The evil ones of all three realms. And so I bow to You, And sing Your praises Through all three gates: In my thoughts and words and deeds

gru.acip: ('DIR DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED KYI RGYAS PA'I SBYIN SREG BYED TSUL DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSOR GSUNGS PA'I CHOG BSGRIGS GO BDE BAR BRJOD PA NI,)
gru.wylie: ('dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed tshul dngos grub rgya mtshor gsungs pa'i chog bsgrigs go bde bar brjod pa ni,)
gru.english: Here now I will impart to you a simplified version of the ceremony described in the Ocean of Attainments for performing an extensive offering of fire in the secret practice of the shining Diamond Lord of Terror.

gru.acip: ZHU BA LAS BYUNG BA'I YE SHES KYI THAB KHA DOG SER ZHING DBYIBS GRU BZHI PA, MU RAN DANG KHA KHYER DANG BCAS PA, KHA KHYER LA RIN PO CHE'I PHRENG BAS BSKOR BA, GRVA BZHIR ZLA PHYED RDO RJES MTSAN PA,
gru.wylie: zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab kha dog ser zhing dbyibs gru bzhi pa, mu ran dang kha khyer dang bcas pa, kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba, grva bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa
gru.english: He melts down And becomes a fire platform Made of wisdom. Its color is gold, Its shape is square, And the inner and outer circles Are inscribed upon it. Along the outer circle Runs a string of diamonds, And the four corners are marked With crescents and diamonds.

whole_word_matches.context: s byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab kha dog ser zhing dbyibs gru bzhi pa, mu ran dang kha khyer dang bcas pa, kha khyer

gru.acip: DVANGS SHING THOGS PA MED PA'I NANG DU, RAm LAS SKYES PA'I ME GRU GSUM PA'I DBUS SU SNA TSOGS PADMA'I LTE BAR RAm LAS BGRANG PHRENG,
gru.wylie: dvangs shing thogs pa med pa'i nang du, raM las skyes pa'i me gru gsum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar raM las bgrang phreng
gru.english: The platform is clear, like crystal, And totally ineffable. In its center comes the letter ram, And from it a triangle of fire. In the center of this Comes a multicolored lotus, And then in its center Another letter ram, Which becomes a rosary.

whole_word_matches.context: shing thogs pa med pa'i nang du, raM las skyes pa'i me gru gsum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar raM las b

gru.acip: GA-YON BRKYANGS PA'I STABS KYIS BZHUGS PA, KHRO BO'I RGYAN THAMS CAD KYIS BRGYAN PA'I THUGS KAR ME GRU GSUM PA RAm GYIS MTSAN PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: ga-yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa, khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar me gru gsum pa raM gyis mtshan par gyur
gru.english: He stands With his left leg extended, And he wears upon Him All the ornaments of an Angry One. Within His holy heart Is a triangle of fire Marked with a letter ram.

whole_word_matches.context: hro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar me gru gsum pa raM gyis mtshan par gyur

gru.acip: ,KHYAD PAR SDE SNOD GSUM DANG RGYUD SDE BZHI'I, ,BSHAD SGRUB BSLAB GSUM RIM GNYIS RNAL 'BYOR SOGS, LEGS TSOGS THAMS CAD PUshtIm KU RU AOm,
gru.wylie: khyad par sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i, ,bshad sgrub bslab gsum rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs, legs tshogs thams cad puShTiM ku ru aoM
gru.english: Most especially may we attain Every success in teaching and practicing The three collections of scripture And all four of the groups Within the secret word. May we accomplish every good In all three of the trainings; In the high practice Of both the secret stages; And every other holy deed. Pushtim kuru om.

gru.acip: ,YAM SHING MAR KHU TIL DANG DUR, ,MA GRUGS ZHO ZAN KU SHA DANG, ,YUNGS KAR SO BA NAS SRAN GRO, ,MJUG TU ZHAL BSIL BSANG GTOR PHUL,
gru.wylie: yam shing mar khu til dang dur, ,ma grugs zho zan ku sha dang, ,yungs kar so ba nas sran gro, ,mjug tu zhal bsil bsang gtor phul
gru.english: Offer first the yamshing sticks, And then the ghee and sesame, The reeds, rice, the yogurt mixture, The kusha grass and mustard seeds, The rye and next the barley, The soybeans, and then the sheat. In conclusion, present the feast of rice And the torma cake of purity.

gru.acip: ,DE NAS 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I, ,MCHOD RDZAS SNGON BZHIN BSANGS SBYANGS BSKYED, ,YE SHES ME LHA SGRUB MCHOD DANG, ,'BREL DANG MA 'BREL DBYE BA YIS,
gru.wylie: de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i, ,mchod rdzas sngon bzhin bsangs sbyangs bskyed, ,ye shes me lha sgrub mchod dang, ,'brel dang ma 'brel dbye ba yis
gru.english: After this, go through the steps Of clearing, purifying, and creating The substances to be offered As you did before, Except now for the Holy Beings Who've already gone beyond The world of suffering. Bring the Wisdom Angel of Fire Into being, and then Make offerings to Him. Creating Him is done In two separate steps, With and without a connection.

gru.acip: (TSIG GIS DNGOS SU MA THON PA RNAMS DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSO LTAR SHES PAR BYA'O,)
gru.wylie: (tshig gis dngos su ma thon pa rnams dngos grub rgya mtsho ltar shes par bya'o,)
gru.english: For any sections here where you require the actual wording of the ritual, consult the Ocean of Attainments.

gru.acip: (ZHES PA 'DI YANG BTZUN PA BLO BZANG CHOS KYI RGYAL MTSAN GYIS GRUB PA'I GNAS MCHOG DBEN DGON DU SBYAR BA'O,,)
gru.wylie: (zhes pa 'di yang btsun pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog dben dgon du sbyar ba'o,,)
gru.english: This work has been composed by myself, the monk Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen [His Holiness the First Panchen Lama], at the abbey of Wengun, that highest of places for spiritual attainment. The Tibetan text has been translated into English by Ven. Thupten Pelma, Debra Ballier, along with Geshe Michael Roach.

gru.acip: BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA' GSANG SNGAGS KYI SGO NAS BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA'I SPYAD PA SPYOD PA RNAMS KYI TSUL KHRIMS KYI BSLAB PA YONGS SU DAG PAR BYA BA'I TSUL RNAM PAR BSHAD PA DNGOS GRUB KYI SNYE MA ZHES BYA BA,
gru.wylie: byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul rnam par bshad pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba
gru.english: This text, called The Golden Harvest of Attainments, is intended to explain how we can make perfectly pure our practice of the guidelines of an ethical life, while we as bodhisattvas practice the deeds of the bodhisattva in a tantric way.

gru.acip: DRI MA MED PA'I DBANG BSKUR BAS RDO RJE THEG PA'I LAM GYI SNOD DU BYAS PA'I SGRUB PA PO RDO RJE THEG PA'I LAM NAS 'GRO BAR 'DOD PA RNAMS KYIS NI, THOG MAR DNGOS GRUB GNYIS KYI RTZA BA DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA RNAM PAR DAG PAR BYA BA LA 'BAD DGOS,
