gru.english: And so the left stands for wisdom, and wisdom is that thing which brings about each and every attainment.  This then leads to why we act to the left: we are--from the present moment--setting up all the conditions which will bring us extraordinary realizations of this path.

gru.acip: GSANG BA GRUB PA LAS, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA MNYAM LDAN PAS, ,RDO RJE PAD+MA MNYAM SBYOR BAS, ,BDEN PA GSUNG BAS MNGON SUM DU, ,'DI 'DRA'I SGOM PA GANG GSUNGS PA, ,DANG PO'I LAS CAN SEMS CAN LA, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA GANG SPANGS NAS, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI RAB STON PA, ,GZHAN GYI MTSON PAS MI MTHONG STE, ,DANG PO'I LAS PAS RIG PAR BYA, ,THOG MA BAR MTHA' DRI MED PA, ,RIG STE GZHAN DU NUS MA YIN, ZHES GSUNGS PAS SO,,
gru.wylie: gsang ba grub pa las, ,las kyi phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas, ,rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas, ,bden pa gsung bas mngon sum du, ,'di 'dra'i sgom pa gang gsungs pa, ,dang po'i las can sems can la, ,las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas, ,byang chub sems ni rab ston pa, ,gzhan gyi mtshon pas mi mthong ste, ,dang po'i las pas rig par bya, ,thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa, ,rig ste gzhan du nus ma yin, zhes gsungs pas so
gru.english: This fact is expressed in the text called Practicing in Secret: Have an actual consort And stay with them; Let the diamond rod And the lotus join; Come to the truth. Thus it is said, But suppose a person Who is just a beginner Gives up the practice Of an actual consort, And fails to meditate As it's described here. They will never be able To see that element Of enlightenment as It's taught so well, Trying to bring An approximation Through some other way. Those who are new To the practice should come To understand this fact, And come to knowledge In this way instead, With an immaculate Beginning, and middle, And end; there is No other way.

gru.acip: ,PHYAG RGYA DANG BRAL GSANG SNGAGS NI, ,LUS CAN RNAMS LA 'GRUB MI 'GYUR, ZHES DANG ,
gru.wylie: phyag rgya dang bral gsang sngags ni, ,lus can rnams la 'grub mi 'gyur, zhes dang
gru.english: Anyone here in a body who tries To practice the secret word Without a consort can never Achieve the goals they seek.

gru.acip: ,DE BZHIN PHO NYA LEGS 'GROGS PAS, ,SGRUB PA PO YIS DNGOS GRUB 'THOB, ,BZLAS BRJOD BSAM GTAN MCHOD MED PAR, ,MYUR BA NYID DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ,SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS SGRUB PA POS, ,MCHOD PA NYID LA RAB TU 'JUG ,'DI LAS GZHAN PA'I MCHOD MED DE, ,DE LTAR BSTAN BCOS NGES PA YIN, ,PHO NYA'I LAM LA DGA' RNAMS KYI, ,SGRUB PA PO NI DNGOS GRUB 'GYUR, ,ZHES GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: de bzhin pho nya legs 'grogs pas, ,sgrub pa po yis dngos grub 'thob, ,bzlas brjod bsam gtan mchod med par, ,myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur, ,sngags dang phyag rgyas sgrub pa pos, ,mchod pa nyid la rab tu 'jug ,'di las gzhan pa'i mchod med de, ,de ltar bstan bcos nges pa yin, ,pho nya'i lam la dga' rnams kyi, ,sgrub pa po ni dngos grub 'gyur, ,zhes gsungs te
gru.english: It further says that, And just so a practitioner reaches their goals By finding a messenger to be their companion. When you do, then you will reach your attainments With ultimate speed, even without Following any of the practices Of reciting, meditation, or offering. It's with the secret words and their consort That a practitioner engages in The very highest of offerings. There is no other offering, And on this the classical commentaries Are completely definite. And so it is those practitioners Who are attracted to the path Of the Messenger who reach the goals.

gru.acip: HE RU KA MNGON 'BYUNG LAS KYANG , ,DPA' BO GANG ZHIG PHYAG RGYA DMAN, ,SGRUB BO MCHOD PAR BYED PA NI, ,PHUB MA RDUNG DANG MTSUNGS PA STE, ZHES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: he ru ka mngon 'byung las kyang , ,dpa' bo gang zhig phyag rgya dman, ,sgrub bo mchod par byed pa ni, ,phub ma rdung dang mtshungs pa ste, zhes gsungs so
gru.english: The Excerpt from the Source for Heruka also says, Any warrior who attempt to practice And to make the offering With a lesser kind of consort Is like someone thrashing chaff.

gru.acip: YANG DE NYID LAS, ,RTAG TU G-YON PA YIS NI BYA, ,BUD MED RNAMS LA MTHUN PAR BYA, ,DE YIS NGES PAR RTAG PAR 'BYUNG , ,RKANG PA G-YON PA'I MTHE BONG GIS, ,SA YANG RKO ZHING RI MO 'DRI, ,LAG PA G-YON PAS RANG PHYOGS KYI, ,SPYI BO LA NI 'PHRUG PAR BYED, ,RANG LUS LAG PA G-YON PAS STON, ,DE YIS RANG GI RIGS NI DRAN, ,SGRUB PO'I LUS LA GNAS PA YIN,
gru.wylie: yang de nyid las, ,rtag tu g-yon pa yis ni bya, ,bud med rnams la mthun par bya, ,de yis nges par rtag par 'byung , ,rkang pa g-yon pa'i mthe bong gis, ,sa yang rko zhing ri mo 'dri, ,lag pa g-yon pas rang phyogs kyi, ,spyi bo la ni 'phrug par byed, ,rang lus lag pa g-yon pas ston, ,de yis rang gi rigs ni dran, ,sgrub po'i lus la gnas pa yin
gru.english: This same text says, Always perform every act Using the left-hand one; Act in harmony With all of womankind; By doing so you'll always Achieve your goals, with certainty. Use the big toe of your left foot To dig or draw upon the earth; Use your left hand too To shake the center tip of your head. Point to your own body Using the left one of your hands. These will help you to recall The family you belong to; You will be living then In the body of a practitioner.

gru.acip: ,BRDA NI LNGA PO BSTAN PA DAG ,SGRUB PA PO YIS LAG G-YON GYIS, ,'DI NI DPA' BO'I GNAS YIN TE, ,BRDA RNAMS LA NI RAB 'JUG PA'O, ZHES DANG ,
gru.wylie: brda ni lnga po bstan pa dag ,sgrub pa po yis lag g-yon gyis, ,'di ni dpa' bo'i gnas yin te, ,brda rnams la ni rab 'jug pa'o, zhes dang
gru.english: For making the sign, For showing the five, Practitioners always use The left of their two hands. This is the way Of those who are great warriors; Always then follow the practice Of making these special signs.

gru.acip: SDOM 'BYUNG LAS KYANG , DE NAS LAG G-YON GYI NI BRDA, ,MDOR BSDUS 'DI LA BSHAD PAR BYA, ,ZHES GSUNGS PAS DE 'DRA BA'I 'DU BA BSGRUB PA'I PHYIR DU DA LTA NAS LAG PA G-YON PA LA MCHOD PAR BYED DE DGOS PA GZHAN YANG YOD DO,,
gru.wylie: sdom 'byung las kyang , de nas lag g-yon gyi ni brda, ,mdor bsdus 'di la bshad par bya, ,zhes gsungs pas de 'dra ba'i 'du ba bsgrub pa'i phyir du da lta nas lag pa g-yon pa la mchod par byed de dgos pa gzhan yang yod do
gru.english: The Source of Vows too says, Now next I will explain In prief the practice of making The sign here in this teaching, With the left of your hands. Given all this, one should learn to make offerings with their left hand from now, in order  to undertake this type of union later.  There are other reasons as well why you should make the offering of the hand.

gru.acip: SPYIR GNAS GANG DU LHA GANG BSGOMS NAS MCHOD KYANG PHAN YON CHE MOD KYI, KHYAD PAR LAG PA G-YON PA'I RTZA KHAMS LA 'KHOR LO BDE MCHOG GI LHA TSOGS DGYES PAS BYON TE MCHOD PA LEN PAR MDZAD PA'I GNAD KHYAD PAR CAN YOD PAS, PHYI ROL MCHOD PA'AM, LUS DKYIL LAM, PHYI DKYIL YONGS RDZOGS MCHOD PA TZAM GYI PHAN YON ZHIG LAG MCHOD 'BA' ZHIG LA YANG YOD DE, 'DI RNAMS KYI RGYU MTSAN NI HE RU KA'I BKA' NYID KYIS GRUB PA YIN NO,, ZHES KYANG DAM PA 'GA' ZHIG GSUNG ,
gru.wylie: spyir gnas gang du lha gang bsgoms nas mchod kyang phan yon che mod kyi, khyad par lag pa g-yon pa'i rtsa khams la 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs dgyes pas byon te mchod pa len par mdzad pa'i gnad khyad par can yod pas, phyi rol mchod pa'am, lus dkyil lam, phyi dkyil yongs rdzogs mchod pa tsam gyi phan yon zhig lag mchod 'ba' zhig la yang yod de, 'di rnams kyi rgyu mtshan ni he ru ka'i bka' nyid kyis grub pa yin no,, zhes kyang dam pa 'ga' zhig gsung
gru.english: A number of holy ones of the past have said as well that: One must admit that, generally speaking, it is of great benefit to visualize Angels anywhere, and then make offerings to them.  There is though a very special point to the practice where the entire assembly of the Angels of the secret teachings of the Sphere of Great Bliss come, with great pleasure, into the channels and elements of your left hand and take your offerings. As such, the benefits of a number of different forms of offering are all complete within the one practice of the offering of the hand: the benefits of making outer offerings; those of the secret world of the body; and those of the outer secret world.  The reasons why this is true are established in the word of none other than Heruka himself.

gru.acip: LAG MCHOD JI LTAR BYA TSUL GYI CHO GA'I RIM PA LA, PHYI ROL MCHOD PAR GRAGS PA THUN BZHI'I RNAL 'BYOR LA GNAS PA'I THUN MTSAMS SOGS SU LAG PA G-YON PA DAG PAR BYAS TE BYIN GYIS BRLABS NAS MAn+dALA BCAS PA'I GNAS SU MDUN BSKYED BSGRUB CING MCHOD PA LAG PAS MCHOD PA DANG , TSOGS 'KHOR GYI SKABS SAM TSES BCU SOGS DUS KHYAD PAR CAN DANG , RGYUN GYI BZA' GTUNG GI DUS SU YANG LAG PA G-YON PA SBYANGS SHING LHAR BYIN GYIS BRLABS TE MCHOD PA LAG PA LA MCHOD PA DANG ,
gru.wylie: lag mchod ji ltar bya tshul gyi cho ga'i rim pa la, phyi rol mchod par grags pa thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i thun mtshams sogs su lag pa g-yon pa dag par byas te byin gyis brlabs nas maN+Dala bcas pa'i gnas su mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa lag pas mchod pa dang , tshogs 'khor gyi skabs sam tshes bcu sogs dus khyad par can dang , rgyun gyi bza' gtung gi dus su yang lag pa g-yon pa sbyangs shing lhar byin gyis brlabs te mchod pa lag pa la mchod pa dang
gru.english: Here is a bit on the subject of the various steps in the ritual; that is, on how to perform the offering of the hand.  First there is what is known as the "outer offering," which is presented at times such as the interval between meditation sessions when one is following the practice of deep meditation during four extended periods of the day. Here you "make your hand pure," meaning perform the ceremony of blessing upon it, and also make an offering of a secret world.  Then in the place before you bring forth an Angel, and make an offering to them, making this gift with your left hand.  You can perform this offering on any special occasion--such as when you are having a secret feast, or holding the ceremony of the tenth.  So too you can do it any time that you are taking your normal food or drink: purify the left hand; perform the ceremony of blessing it so that it becomes the Angels, and then make the offering, the offering of the hand.

gru.acip: LAG MCHOD MA 'GRUB PA'I TSE LAG PA BYIN GYIS BRLABS TE CHOS 'BYUNG GRU GSUM GYI DBUS SU DKYIL 'KHOR GYI 'KHOR LO SPYAN DRANGS TE MCHOD PA'I TSUL RNAMS GSUNGS PA'I CHO GA RNAMS GRAGS CHE BAS GZHAN DU BYUNG BA LAS SHES PAR BYA LA,
gru.wylie: lag mchod ma 'grub pa'i tshe lag pa byin gyis brlabs te chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te mchod pa'i tshul rnams gsungs pa'i cho ga rnams grags che bas gzhan du byung ba las shes par bya la
gru.english: Even when you can't undertake the offering of the hand, you can still make the blessing upon your hand, visualizing the triangular dharma star and asking the community of the secret world to enter its center, where you make offerings to them.  Descriptions for how to perform offerings this way, the required ceremonies, are well known, and you can study them from other sources.

whole_word_matches.context: 'grub pa'i tshe lag pa byin gyis brlabs te chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG LAM 'DI'I BSGRUB PA PO RNAMS LA SHIN TU NYE BAR MKHO BA GZHON NU MA MCHOD PA DANG , RIGS LDAN MA MCHOD PA DANG , 'BYUNG PO THAMS CAD PA'I GTOR CHOG DANG , ZHING SKYONG BZHI BCU RTZA BRGYAD DAM BDUN CU RTZA GNYIS KYI GTOR CHOG DANG , PHYOGS SKYONG BA'I GTOR CHOG RGYAS PA DANG , MKHA' 'GRO SPYI GTOR RGYAS PA DANG , BYA ROG DANG CE SPYANG GI GTOR CHOG LA SOGS PA'ANG YOD DO,,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang lam 'di'i bsgrub pa po rnams la shin tu nye bar mkho ba gzhon nu ma mchod pa dang , rigs ldan ma mchod pa dang , 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog dang , zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dam bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtor chog dang , phyogs skyong ba'i gtor chog rgyas pa dang , mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rgyas pa dang , bya rog dang ce spyang gi gtor chog la sogs pa'ang yod do
gru.english: There are other practices which are of vital necessity for one who is following this particular path.  These include the offering to maidens; the offering to women of knowledge; the ritual for presenting the offering cake to every kind of spirit; the ritual for presenting the offering cake to the 48 protectors of the paradise, or else the 72; the extensive ritual for presenting the offering cake to the protectors of the directions; the extensive ritual for presenting the offering cake to the Angels in general; the rituals for presenting the offering cakes of the crow and the wolf; and all the rest.

gru.acip: DE DAG LA RDUL TSON DANG RAS BRIS SOGS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR BSGRUB MCHOD RGYAS PA DANG , TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO'I MCHOD PA LA SOGS PA DANG , GONG GI MCHOD TSUL GSUM PO DE DAG GIS BCOM LDAN 'DAS HE RU KA'I DKYIL 'KHOR PA MCHOD PA LA BRTZON PAR BYAS NA SKYE BA THAMS CAD DU DPAL HE RU KA DANG RJE BTZUN MAS RJES SU BZUNG NAS GNAS SKABS DANG MTHAR THUG GI 'DOD DON THAMS CAD BDE BLAG TU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR BA YIN GSUNG NGA O,,
gru.wylie: de dag la rdul tshon dang ras bris sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod rgyas pa dang , tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa la sogs pa dang , gong gi mchod tshul gsum po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa la brtson par byas na skye ba thams cad du dpal he ru ka dang rje btsun mas rjes su bzung nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin gsung nga o
gru.english: On these days you should do an extensive ceremony of creating the secret world, either with colored sand or drawn on cloth, and then make the various offerings that are done with it.  Make also the offering of the secret feast, and the like.  If you are able to make efforts in the practice of offerings to the beings in the secret world of the Conqueror, Heruka, by means of the three types of offering just mentioned, then in all of your future lives you will be taken under their care both by the glorious Heruka and by the Angel.  And then you will come to achieve all your wishes--both the temporal ones and the ultimate ones--with the greatest of ease.  Thus is it spoken.

gru.acip: GAL SRID BLA MA MTSAN NYID TSANG BA THAG RING BA SOGS KYIS MA 'GRUB TSE RANG GI BDAG 'JUG BLANGS PA'I SGO NAS GSOR CHUD PAR BYA ZHING , 'DIS RTZA LTUNG GZHAN RNAMS PHYIR BCOS TSUL YANG SHES PAR BYA LA,
gru.wylie: gal srid bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba thag ring ba sogs kyis ma 'grub tshe rang gi bdag 'jug blangs pa'i sgo nas gsor chud par bya zhing , 'dis rtsa ltung gzhan rnams phyir bcos tshul yang shes par bya la
gru.english: Now suppose there is some reason why we cannot do al this; suppose, for example, that we happen to be very far away from a Lama who possesses all the required qualifications to grant us such an empowerment.  In this case, we can perform the ritual of bringing our selves into the secret world, and there restore the commitment. Understand that this same procedure is to be followed for restoring our commitment in the case of any other root downfall as well.

gru.acip: BDAG RIG PA 'DZIN PA MING 'DI ZHES BGYI BA LA, JI SKAD YONGS SU BRJOD PA'I PHAM PA'I GZHI LAS, RDO RJE THEG PA'I 'DUL BA DANG 'GAL BA'I NONGS PA, GANG PHYIR RDO RJE 'DZIN PA YIS, ,DNGOS GRUB SLOB DPON RJES 'BRANGS GSUNGS, ,DE BAS DE LA BRNYAS PA NI, ,RTZA BA'I LTUNG BA DANG POR BSHAD,
gru.wylie: bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la, ji skad yongs su brjod pa'i pham pa'i gzhi las, rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nongs pa, gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis, ,dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs, ,de bas de la brnyas pa ni, ,rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad
gru.english: "I am the Holder of Knowledge whose name is (you say your name), and I have made a grave error, for I have acted against the discipline of the diamond way, as expressed in the foundation teachings upon the defeats, where it says: The One Who Holds the Diamond Has said that every attainment there is Follows from our Master. As such, it is taught That the very first Among all the root downfalls Is to criticize our master.

gru.acip: BZHI PA BSRUNG BA'I PHAN YON NI, SNGAGS SDOM DANG LDAN PA'I GANG ZAG GIS RTZA LTUNG DANG , SBOM PO'I LTUNG BA RNAMS SPONG BA'I RIGS LNGA SPYI DANG , SO SO'I DAM TSIG RNAMS BSRUNG NA GNAS SKABS DANG MTHAR THUG GI DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA THOB PAR 'GYUR ZHING , KHYAD PAR SKYE BA BCU DRUG TSUN LA 'TSANG RGYA BAR GSUNGS PA'O,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa bsrung ba'i phan yon ni, sngags sdom dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis rtsa ltung dang , sbom po'i ltung ba rnams spong ba'i rigs lnga spyi dang , so so'i dam tshig rnams bsrung na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par 'gyur zhing , khyad par skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa'o
gru.english: Here is the fourth and final section in our presentation: an explanation of the benefits which we derive from keeping our commitments.  Suppose now that a person who possesses the commitments of the way of the secret word continues to honor the various overall and individual pledges of the Five Families, through which we give up committing the different root downfalls, as well as the downfalls of the serious offenses. This person will then gain each and every immediate and ultimate attainment there is.  And more especially, they will--within the space of sixteen lifetimes or less--achieve enlightenment itself. *** Some final helpful comments from Je Tsongkapa's Golden Harvest of Attainments:

gru.acip: LTUNG BA 'DI RNAMS GSUNGS PA NI KHA NA MA THO BA CHEN PO RNAMS DGAG PA'I PHYIR DU BCAS PA YIN LA, GANG LA BRTEN NAS NYES PA RNAMS 'BYUNG BA'I YUL GYI GTZO BO NI GSUM STE, 'DI LTAR RANG LA CHOS STON PA PO DANG , CHOS SGRUB PA'I GROGS DANG , NYAMS SU BLANG BYA'I CHOS SO,
gru.wylie: ltung ba 'di rnams gsungs pa ni kha na ma tho ba chen po rnams dgag pa'i phyir du bcas pa yin la, gang la brten nas nyes pa rnams 'byung ba'i yul gyi gtso bo ni gsum ste, 'di ltar rang la chos ston pa po dang , chos sgrub pa'i grogs dang , nyams su blang bya'i chos so
gru.english: The various downfalls that we've described in this text are rules that were set down for the purpose of keeping us from committing the most serious of negative deeds.  It's good to remember that the principle objects towards which we commit these mistakes are three: the One who teaches us the Dharma; the friends who help us practice this Dharma; and the Dharma which we seek to practice, itself. ***

gru.acip: 'DIR 'BAD PA CHEN POS MA BSGOMS KYANG SKYE BA BDUN NA DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA DANG DE YANG RNAL 'BYOR CUNG ZAD SGOM PA DANG DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAS 'GRUB KYI DAM TSIG NYAMS NA DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA LTA ZHOG NGAN 'GROR 'GRO BAS BDE 'GRO YANG RNYED DKA'O ZHES GSUNGS SO,
gru.wylie: 'dir 'bad pa chen pos ma bsgoms kyang skye ba bdun na dngos grub 'grub pa dang de yang rnal 'byor cung zad sgom pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa dag pas 'grub kyi dam tshig nyams na dngos grub 'grub pa lta zhog ngan 'gror 'gro bas bde 'gro yang rnyed dka'o zhes gsungs so
gru.english: With these vows, one will achieve the final goal within seven lifetimes--even if you make no great efforts in the other practices.  When the scriptures say this though what they mean is that a person will reach the final goal if they keep up a minimum level of deep practice, and if they keep their pledges and vows pure.  But if we fail in this pledges, the scriptures are also saying, then not only is there no question of achieving the final goal; we will instead pass to the realms of misery, and just staying in a higher birth then would be highly unlikely.

gru.acip: ,DAM TSIG LNGA PA LAS, ,GAL TE LTUNG BA MED GYUR NA, ,SKYE BA BCU DRUG DAG LA 'GRUB, ,CES DANG ,
gru.wylie: dam tshig lnga pa las, ,gal te ltung ba med gyur na, ,skye ba bcu drug dag la 'grub, ,ces dang
gru.english: The Book of the Five Pledges says as well, If one is free of downfalls, Then they achieve the goal In sixteen lives.

gru.acip: BI BH'U T'I TZAN+D+RASA KYANG , ,MA BSGOMS GYUR KYANG LTUNG MED NA, ,SKYE BA BCU DRUG DAG NA 'GRUB, ,CES GSUNGS PAS RTZA BA DANG YAN LAG GI NYES PAS MA GOS PA'AM GOS KYANG PHYIR BCOS TSUL BZHIN DU BYAS NAS DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAR BSRUNG NA SKYE BA BCU DRUG TSUN LA MCHOG 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS SO,
gru.wylie: bi bhU tI tsan+d+rasa kyang , ,ma bsgoms gyur kyang ltung med na, ,skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub, ,ces gsungs pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas ma gos pa'am gos kyang phyir bcos tshul bzhin du byas nas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par bsrung na skye ba bcu drug tshun la mchog 'grub par gsungs so
gru.english: Vibhuti Chandra states that If we can remain free of downfalls, Then we achieve the goal in sixteen lives-- Even without the other practices. What this is saying is that, if we can keep ourselves from being sullied by any of the root or secondary misdeeds--or, even if we are sullied by any of them, we act to restore our commitments in the proper way--then we achieve the highest goal in sixteen lifetimes or less, for we are keeping our pledges and vows pure.

gru.acip: ,ZLA GSANG THIG LE LAS KYANG , ,SNGAGS KYI DNGOS GRUB DON 'DOD PAS, ,DAM TSIG SRUNG LA BRTZON PAR BYA, ,GZHAN DU BYAS NA SNGAGS MKHAN GYIS, ,SNGAGS LA SOGS PA'I DON MI 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: zla gsang thig le las kyang , ,sngags kyi dngos grub don 'dod pas, ,dam tshig srung la brtson par bya, ,gzhan du byas na sngags mkhan gyis, ,sngags la sogs pa'i don mi 'grub
gru.english: This same sentiment is expressed in the Drop of the Secret Moon, when it says-- Those who hope for the goal, The attainments of the way Of the secret way, Must devote themselves To keeping their commitments. A tantrika who behaves otherwise Will never achieve the goals Of tantra and their other practices.

gru.acip: GAL TE RIG SNGAGS BZUNG BA NYID DU NGES PAS NI, SDOM PA DANG DAM TSIG TSUL BZHIN MA BSRUNGS NA 'PHAGS PA RNAMS BSLUS PA BDAG NYID LA 'KHU BAR BYED PA DNGOS GRUB LA RGYAB KYIS PHYOGS PA DE NI G-YO CAN SHING RUL PA LTA BU YIN NO,
gru.wylie: gal te rig sngags bzung ba nyid du nges pas ni, sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsrungs na 'phags pa rnams bslus pa bdag nyid la 'khu bar byed pa dngos grub la rgyab kyis phyogs pa de ni g-yo can shing rul pa lta bu yin no
gru.english: Suppose someone has committed themselves totally to follow the way of the secret word, but then they fail to keep their vows and pledges in the proper way.  A person like this has deceived all the realized beings of the universe, and hurt themselves more than anyone.  They are a liar, they are rotten, they are headed full speed away from spiritual attainments.

gru.acip: DE LTAR NA RDO RJE RTZE MO LAS, ,DAM TSIG NYID NI NYAMS GYUR NA, ,'BRAS BU 'DI NI THOB MI 'GYUR, ,'DI NI KHYOD KYI DMYAL BA'I CHU, ,DAM TSIG 'DAS NA SREG PAR BYED, ,DAM TSIG BSRUNGS PAS 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ,'THUNGS SHIG RDO RJE BDUD RTZI 'THUNG , ,RDO RJE SEMS DPA'I MNA' YI NI, ,SNYING PO 'DI YIS MNA' BSGAG GO
gru.wylie: de ltar na rdo rje rtse mo las, ,dam tshig nyid ni nyams gyur na, ,'bras bu 'di ni thob mi 'gyur, ,'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu, ,dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed, ,dam tshig bsrungs pas 'grub par 'gyur, ,'thungs shig rdo rje bdud rtsi 'thung , ,rdo rje sems dpa'i mna' yi ni, ,snying po 'di yis mna' bsgag go
gru.english: Thus it is that the Tip of Diamond says, If you fail in these very pledges You will never reach the goal. Drink-- This is the water That will send you to hell, The water that will burn you If you break your commitments. And this water too Is the diamond nectar of deathlessness That will bring you every attainment If you keep your commitments. Commit yourself now To this core of the pledge Of the diamond bodhisattvas. ***

gru.acip: SDOM 'BYUNG NAS GSUNGS PA LTAR BYA STE, JI SKAD DU, ,CI STE DNGOS GRUB MCHOG 'DOD NA, ,SROG NI YONGS SU GTONG YANG BLA, ,'CHI BA'I DUS LA BAB KYANG BLA'I, ,RTAG TU DAM TSIG BSRUNG BAR BYA,
gru.wylie: sdom 'byung nas gsungs pa ltar bya ste, ji skad du, ,ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na, ,srog ni yongs su gtong yang bla, ,'chi ba'i dus la bab kyang bla'i, ,rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya
gru.english: It's just as The Source of Vows puts it-- Giving up your life for them Is nothing. Watching yourself die for them Is nothing. But if you've any hope Of the highest goal You must maintain your pledges. ***

gru.acip: ,GRUB MCHOG KLU SGRUB YAB SRAS DANG , ,ZLA BA'I ZHABS DANG BLO BZANG GRAGS, ,RTZA BA'I BLA MA MCHOG RNAMS KYIS, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYONGS SHIG
gru.wylie: grub mchog klu sgrub yab sras dang , ,zla ba'i zhabs dang blo bzang grags, ,rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog rnams kyis, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyongs shig
gru.english: Protect me, I beg you, Highest of saints-- Nagarjuna and his spiritual son; High master, Chandrakirti; Lobsang Drakpa; And my own Root Lama. Keep me until the moment That I reach enlightenment.

gru.acip: DANG PO LA BZHI, LAM SGOM PA'I SNOD RUNG DU BYA BA, SNOD DU GYUR NAS DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAR BYA BA, DAM TSIG LA GNAS NAS SNGON DU BSNYEN PA JI LTAR BYA BA, BSNYEN PA LAS SU RUNG NAS DNGOS GRUB JI LTAR SGRUB PA'O,
gru.wylie: dang po la bzhi, lam sgom pa'i snod rung du bya ba, snod du gyur nas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par bya ba, dam tshig la gnas nas sngon du bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba, bsnyen pa las su rung nas dngos grub ji ltar sgrub pa'o
gru.english: There are four sections to the path of the action class of teachings: (1) how we are made into a worthy vessel for practicing this path; (2) keeping our pledges and commitments purely, once we have been made into a worthy vessel; (3) how we actually do our practice, once we are established in our commitments; and (4) how we reach high spiritual attainments, once our practice has made us fit for them.

gru.acip: 'ON KYANG SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I DAM TSIG BSRUNG BAR BYA BA MANG PO YOD PA RNAMS SNGAGS RIM CHEN MOR LEGS GRUB KYI RGYUD DRANGS PA LAS SHES PAR BYA ZHING , RTZA LTUNG RNAMS BYANG CHUB GZHUNG LAM DU BLTA BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: 'on kyang sngags kyi thun mong min pa'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya ba mang po yod pa rnams sngags rim chen mor legs grub kyi rgyud drangs pa las shes par bya zhing , rtsa ltung rnams byang chub gzhung lam du blta bar bya'o
gru.english: There are however a great many unique pledges to be kept in the way of the secret word, and for these you can refer to the citations of the Tantra of Perfect Practice found in the Great Book on the Way of the Secret Word.  For the root downfalls here you can simply refer to the Highway for Bodhisattvas.

gru.acip: DE YANG SGRA GNAS KYI BSAM GTAN MAN CHAD DU ZHI GNAS SGRUB LA, SGRA MTHA' NAS LHAG MTHONG SGOM ZHING DER YANG SO SOR RTOG PA'I SHES RAB KYIS DPYAD PA MANG DRAG NA SNGAR GYI GNAS CHA 'JIG PAS, DPYAD 'JOG SPEL MAR BYAS LA STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I ZHI LHAG ZUNG 'BREL SGRUB BO,,
gru.wylie: de yang sgra gnas kyi bsam gtan man chad du zhi gnas sgrub la, sgra mtha' nas lhag mthong sgom zhing der yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa mang drag na sngar gyi gnas cha 'jig pas, dpyad 'jog spel mar byas la stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel sgrub bo
gru.english: The meditations from being fixed on the sound on down are practiced for attaining meditative stillness.  From the meditation on the end of the sound and beyond, we are meditating upon special insight.  Here too, it breaks the quality of fixation upon the object which we have achieved up to this point if we engage in too much analytical wisdom at this stage.  And so we alternate between analytical meditation and fixed meditation, thus reaching the combination of stillness and insight wherein we perceive emptiness itself.

gru.acip: DNGOS GRUB KHYAD PAR CAN GYI LAS TSOGS MTHA' YAS PA BSGRUB PAR BYA SPYOD LAS GSUNGS PA RNAMS JI LTA BA BZHIN DU 'GRUB PA LA, BZLAS BRJOD YAN LAG BZHI DANG DE NYID GSUM GYI BSAM GTAN SNGON DU 'GRO DGOS LA, DNGOS GRUB PHRAN TSEGS MANG PO 'GRUB PA LA DE LTAR DGOS PA'I NGES PA MED DO ZHES SNGAGS RIM CHEN MO LAS GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: dngos grub khyad par can gyi las tshogs mtha' yas pa bsgrub par bya spyod las gsungs pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub pa la, bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi dang de nyid gsum gyi bsam gtan sngon du 'gro dgos la, dngos grub phran tshegs mang po 'grub pa la de ltar dgos pa'i nges pa med do zhes sngags rim chen mo las gsungs so
gru.english: The Great Book on the Steps of the Way of the Secret Word says, A veritably limitless mass of extraordinary spiritual attainments is attained by undertaking, in the proper way, the practices described in the action and activity classes.  And to succeed in these practices, we must first engage in the four components of recitation and the meditation of the three kinds of suchness.  If all we want though is to reach a great number of miscellaneous attainments, it's not necessarily the case that we would need this kind of preparation.

gru.acip: BZHI PA NI, DNGOS GRUB RAB 'BRING THA GSUM STE, GSUM DU 'BYED LUGS LA SGO MANG PO YOD PA LAS NGO BO'I SGO NAS NI,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa ni, dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum ste, gsum du 'byed lugs la sgo mang po yod pa las ngo bo'i sgo nas ni
gru.english: This brings us to our fourth point, the high attainments we reach through our practice.  The attainments here are divided into the highest; the medium; and the lowest.  There are many ways to execute this division, but here is how it is done according to the essential nature of the thing.

gru.acip: GZHI'I SGO NAS NI LUS KYI DANG RDZAS KYI DANG LONGS SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB BO, GSUNG BA PO'I SGO NAS NI 'PHAGS PA DANG LHA DANG SA BLA'I SNGAGS SO,,
gru.wylie: gzhi'i sgo nas ni lus kyi dang rdzas kyi dang longs spyod kyi dngos grub bo, gsung ba po'i sgo nas ni 'phags pa dang lha dang sa bla'i sngags so
gru.english: The same division--into highest, medium, and lowest--with respect to the basis of the attainments would be attainments in the body, those in substances, and those in our possessions.  With respect to those who speak, this division would be represented the mantras of realized beings, angels, and those who live in the realm above the earth.

gru.acip: RIGS KYI SGO NAS NI SNGAGS RIM LAS, ZHI BA DANG RGYAS PA DANG DRAG PO'I LAS NI RIM PA BZHIN DU DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA'I RIGS DANG , PAD+MA'I RIGS DANG , RDO RJE'I RIGS KYIS BSGRUB STE, DNGOS GRUB MCHOG DANG 'BRING DANG THA MA YANG DE LTAR BSGRUB BO,,ZHES DANG ,
gru.wylie: rigs kyi sgo nas ni sngags rim las, zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang drag po'i las ni rim pa bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang , pad+ma'i rigs dang , rdo rje'i rigs kyis bsgrub ste, dngos grub mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yang de ltar bsgrub bo,,zhes dang
gru.english: Making this same division by family is described in the Steps on the Way of the Secret Word as follows: The modes of peace, generosity, and ferocity are achieved--respectively--through the family of Those Gone That Way; the family of the lotus; and the family of the diamond.  The highest, medium, and lowest attainments are achieved in this same way.

gru.acip: RIGS RE RE LA YANG DNGOS GRUB GSUM GSUM DANG , ZHI RGYAS DANG DRAG PO GSUM GSUM YOD PA LAS RANG RANG GI RIGS KYI BDAG PO DANG , RIGS KYI YUM DANG , RIGS KYI KHRO BOS ZHI SOGS GSUM BYA'O, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA TZAM LAS MI GSAL ZHING , RJES 'JUG RNAMS KYIS KYANG GSAL BAR BSHAD PA MA MTHONG NGO ,,
gru.wylie: rigs re re la yang dngos grub gsum gsum dang , zhi rgyas dang drag po gsum gsum yod pa las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po dang , rigs kyi yum dang , rigs kyi khro bos zhi sogs gsum bya'o, ,zhes gsungs pa tsam las mi gsal zhing , rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong ngo
gru.english: The same text says: There are also all three levels of attainments for each one of the families; and there are three modes--that is, peaceful, generous, and ferocious--for each as well.  These three modes, peace and the rest, come through the principal Angel of the family; the consort of the family; and the wrathful being of the family. The point is clarified no further than this; nor is there any clarification by subsequent generations of authors.

gru.acip: MKHAS PA KHA CIG GIS, BYA RGYUD KYI GDUL BYA DBANG RNON GYIS BSKAL PA MANG PO THUB PA'I TSE'I RIG 'DZIN BSGRUBS NAS TSE GCIG LA 'TSANG RGYA BA YOD PAR GSUNGS KYANG , SNGAGS RIM LAS DE LTAR GSAL BAR MA GSUNGS SHING , RGYUD SDE SPYI RNAM LAS, BYA SPYOD GNYIS LA PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA'I LUGS KYI 'TSANG RGYA TSUL LAS LOGS PA MED, CES GSUNGS PA LTAR 'DOD NA, 'OG MIN STUG PO BKOD PA'I RTEN LA 'TSANG RGYA BAR 'DOD DGOS PAS DPYAD PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: mkhas pa kha cig gis, bya rgyud kyi gdul bya dbang rnon gyis bskal pa mang po thub pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin bsgrubs nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba yod par gsungs kyang , sngags rim las de ltar gsal bar ma gsungs shing , rgyud sde spyi rnam las, bya spyod gnyis la pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi 'tshang rgya tshul las logs pa med, ces gsungs pa ltar 'dod na, 'og min stug po bkod pa'i rten la 'tshang rgya bar 'dod dgos pas dpyad par bya'o
gru.english: Some sages have stated that disciples of the action class of secret teachings can reach the attainment of knowledge which relates to life, meaning that they are then able to live for many eons.  Within one life thus they can reach enlightenment. The Steps on the Way of the Secret Word though makes no such statement in any clear way; while the General Structure of the Different Classes of the Secret Teaching says that "There is no actual process of enlightenment described in the action and activity classes which is any different than that described in the open teachings." If we accept this last statement as correct, then we would have to accept that a person becomes enlightened in a body and mind within the paradise known as Below None, the Mass of Clouds.  As such, this is something that must be looked into further.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA SPYOD RGYUD KYI LAM BGROD TSUL LA BZHI, SNOD RUNG DU BYA BA DANG , DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAR BYA BA DANG , BSNYEN PA JI LTAR BYA BA DANG , DNGOS GRUB JI LTAR SGRUB PA'O,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi lam bgrod tshul la bzhi, snod rung du bya ba dang , dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par bya ba dang , bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba dang , dngos grub ji ltar sgrub pa'o
gru.english: Here next is our second point from above: how we travel the path of secret teachings of the activity class.  Here in this explanation we repeat the same four divisions of (1) how we are made into a worthy vessel; (2) keeping our pledges and commitments purely; (3) how we do our actual practice; and (4) how we reach high spiritual attainments.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, LHA'I SKU LA SOGS PA LA DMIGS PA'I ZHI GNAS RNYED PA NA, LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR DANG 'BREL BA'I SGO NAS STONG NYID SGOM STE, DPYAD 'JOG SPEL MAR BYAS LA STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I ZHI LHAG ZUNG 'BREL SGRUB BO,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, lha'i sku la sogs pa la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas rnyed pa na, lha'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas stong nyid sgom ste, dpyad 'jog spel mar byas la stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel sgrub bo
gru.english: As for the second, we perform a practice of meditation upon emptiness through working with deep practice centered on an Angel, once we have reached meditative stillness focused upon an object such as the precious body of an Angel.  We alternate between analytical and fixed meditation, thus attaining a combination of meditative stillness and special insight, with which we perceive emptiness.

gru.acip: MTSAN MA MED PA'I RNAL 'BYOR NI, CHOS THAMS CAD RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PAS STONG PAR GCIG DU BRAL SOGS KYI RIGS PAS NGES PAR BYAS PA'I NGES SHES KYI RGYUN GOMS PAR BYED PA YIN LA, ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor ni, chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong par gcig du bral sogs kyi rigs pas nges par byas pa'i nges shes kyi rgyun goms par byed pa yin la, zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: And it says as well that-- What does it mean when we say "deep practice where there are no longer any signs?"  This refers to habituating ourselves, over and over, to the understanding that we gain through logical arguments such as that known as "neither one nor many": proofs that there is nothing in the world which exists in and of itself.

gru.acip: BZHI PA NI, RAL GRI LA SOGS PA'I PHYI'I RDZAS LA BRTEN NAS RAL GRI'I RIG PA 'DZIN PA SOGS SGRUB PA DANG , NANG GI LUS KYI GNAS RNAMS SU SA CHU ME RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR BSGOMS NAS ZHI RGYAS LA SOGS PA'I LAS SGRUB PA DANG ,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa ni, ral gri la sogs pa'i phyi'i rdzas la brten nas ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin pa sogs sgrub pa dang , nang gi lus kyi gnas rnams su sa chu me rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las sgrub pa dang
gru.english: Here then is the fourth point, on how we reach our spiritual attainments in this class of the secret teachings.  The texts of this class describe the following types of attainments.  We can first reach attainments such as the holder of the knowledge of the sword by utilizing outer objects such as a sword.  Meditating on disks of earth, water, fire, and wind at specific places on the inside--within our own body--enables us to attain the various modes of peace, generosity, and the rest.

gru.acip: 'JAM DPAL SOGS PA'I SGRUB PA BYAS NAS BYANG SEMS DE DAG GIS MGO LA NYUG PA'AM LEGS SO ZHES PA BYUNG BYUNG DU BZLAS BRJOD BYAS PA'I MTHAR DE DAG BYUNG BA NA, BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS MI BRJED PA'I TING NGE 'DZIN THOB PAR RGYUD 'DI LAS GSUNGS TE, DE LA SOGS PA'I DNGOS GRUB SGRUB PA'I TSUL DU MA ZHIG GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: 'jam dpal sogs pa'i sgrub pa byas nas byang sems de dag gis mgo la nyug pa'am legs so zhes pa byung byung du bzlas brjod byas pa'i mthar de dag byung ba na, byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par rgyud 'di las gsungs te, de la sogs pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul du ma zhig gsungs so
gru.english: Undertaking practices to reach Gentle Voice and similar Angels, we recite our mantras until we reach the point where we feel as though these bodhisattvas are just about to touch us upon the head, or tell us, "You are doing well."  If at the end of the recitation something like this actually happens, then we have attained what is known as "the meditative concentration beyond ever forgetting the Wish for enlightenment."  In this class of secret teachings as well, there are a great number of different methods described for reaching these and similar attainments.

gru.acip: GSUM PA RNAL 'BYOR RGYUD KYI LAM BGROD TSUL LA BZHI, SNOD RUNG DU BYA BA DANG , DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAR BYA BA DANG , BSNYEN PA JI LTAR BYA BA DANG , DNGOS GRUB JI LTAR SGRUB PA'O,,
gru.wylie: gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam bgrod tshul la bzhi, snod rung du bya ba dang , dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par bya ba dang , bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba dang , dngos grub ji ltar sgrub pa'o
gru.english: This brings us to our third point from above, which is a description of how we travel the path of secret teachings of the class of deep practice.  Here again we repeat the same four divisions of (1) how we are made into a worthy vessel; (2) keeping our pledges and commitments purely; (3) how we do our actual practice; and (4) how we reach high spiritual attainments.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, SO THAR GYI RTEN DU RUNG NA SDOM PA GSUM LDAN DU BYAS NAS SGRUB DGOS PAS, SDOM PA GSUM KA'I BCAS PA DANG , DPAL MCHOG DANG PO DANG RTZE MO NAS GSUNGS PA'I DAM TSIG RNAMS SRUNG DGOS SO,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, so thar gyi rten du rung na sdom pa gsum ldan du byas nas sgrub dgos pas, sdom pa gsum ka'i bcas pa dang , dpal mchog dang po dang rtse mo nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams srung dgos so
gru.english: Here next are the commitments.  Assuming that we are qualified to take on vows of individual liberation, then we should be practicing this class of secret teachings as a person who possesses all three types of vows.  We are required to observe the rules of all three of these sets of vows, and to honor the commitments described in the First of Highest Glory and the Tip of Diamond.

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, SLOB MA'I DBANG TZAM THOB PAS ME TOG GANG LA PHOG PA'I LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR GCIG LDAN BYA BA DANG , SLOB DPON GYI DBANG THOB PAS SLOB MA LA DBANG BSKUR BA DANG RANG GIS LHA SGRUB PA LA BDAG RDZOGS RNAL 'BYOR CHEN PO DANG BCAS PA'I TING NGE 'DZIN GSUM PHRI BA MED PAR SGOM PA'I BSNYEN PA RGYAS PA DANG , DKYIL 'KHOR RGYAL MCHOG GI BSKYED CHOG LA SOGS PA BSDUS PA'I BSNYEN PA 'BRING DANG , RNAL 'BYOR CHEN PO LHA RE RE'I BZLAS BRJOD 'BUM DANG BCAS PA'I BSNYEN PA BSDUS PA GANG RUNG BYA BA'O,,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, slob ma'i dbang tsam thob pas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gcig ldan bya ba dang , slob dpon gyi dbang thob pas slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang rang gis lha sgrub pa la bdag rdzogs rnal 'byor chen po dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum phri ba med par sgom pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang , dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi bskyed chog la sogs pa bsdus pa'i bsnyen pa 'bring dang , rnal 'byor chen po lha re re'i bzlas brjod 'bum dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa bsdus pa gang rung bya ba'o
gru.english: Here is what the first of these involves.  If we have received no more than the empowerments of the disciple, then we undertake the type of practice for someone who has but a single deep practice for an Angel--depending upon which Angel was selected when we dropped the flower petal. If we have received the empowerment of the master, then we can empower disciples of our own, and bring the Angel on our own.  And we undertake some one or more of three different kinds of practice.   In the extensive practice, we engage in three different types of meditation, without ever shortening them--and during this we do what is called "the great deep practice of the self complete." For the medium form of the abbreviated practice, we are performing practices like the ritual of creation ritual for the Supreme Victor secret world.  For the abbreviated practice we are performing the "great deep practice," which involves reciting 100,000 mantras for each of the Angels.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, BDAG MDUN GYI LHA SNGAGS KYI YI GE DANG BCAS PA RANG BZHIN MED PAR GTAN LA PHAB CING , DE LA NGES PA RNYED PA NA NGES SHES DE'I RGYUN DPYAD 'JOG SPEL MAR BYAS TE STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I ZHI LHAG ZUNG 'BREL SGRUB PA'O, ,DE'I LHAG MTHONG THOB TSE SBYOR LAM DU 'PHO BA SOGS NI SNGAR DANG 'DRA'O,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, bdag mdun gyi lha sngags kyi yi ge dang bcas pa rang bzhin med par gtan la phab cing , de la nges pa rnyed pa na nges shes de'i rgyun dpyad 'jog spel mar byas te stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel sgrub pa'o, ,de'i lhag mthong thob tshe sbyor lam du 'pho ba sogs ni sngar dang 'dra'o
gru.english: As for the deep practice where there are no longer any signs, we work on establishing the fact that things lack any nature of their own with regard to ourselves as the Angel, and to the Angel as someone out there--exploring as well this fact with reference to the sounds of the mantra. Once we have reached some understanding of the way these lack any nature then we maintain this understanding in a steady stream, alternating between both analytical and fixed forms of meditation.  In this way then we attain the combination of meditative stillness and extraordinary insight. When we attain this type of insight in the context of this particular class of secret teachings, then we have graduated to the path of preparation in this class, and so on--as we mentioned before.

gru.acip: BZHI PA NI, BSAM GTAN DANG , BZLAS BRJOD DANG , SBYIN SREG GSUM GYIS DNGOS GRUB MANG PO SGRUB PAR GSUNGS PA RNAMS SO, ,DE DAG LAS RDZOGS PA'I SANGS RGYAS KYI GZUGS 'DZIN PA'I BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA'I RIG SNGAGS 'CHANG DU 'GYUR BA DANG , RANG GI LHA'I SKU PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO'I GZUGS KYI DNGOS GRUB 'THOB PA GNYIS NI RNAL 'BYOR RGYUD KYI GDUL BYA MCHOG RNAMS KYIS THOG MAR GRUB PA'I DNGOS GRUB BZANG SHOS YIN PA DANG , BYA SPYOD LA NI RIG 'DZIN GYI DNGOS GRUB GRUB PA LUS KYI DNGOS GRUB CHEN PO YIN PAR SNGAGS RIM LAS GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa ni, bsam gtan dang , bzlas brjod dang , sbyin sreg gsum gyis dngos grub mang po sgrub par gsungs pa rnams so, ,de dag las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rig sngags 'chang du 'gyur ba dang , rang gi lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs kyi dngos grub 'thob pa gnyis ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gdul bya mchog rnams kyis thog mar grub pa'i dngos grub bzang shos yin pa dang , bya spyod la ni rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub grub pa lus kyi dngos grub chen po yin par sngags rim las gsungs so
gru.english: Here then are the attainments for this class.  Many of these attainments are described, and they are said to come from the three practices of meditation, the recitation of mantras, and from fire offerings. The Steps on the Way of the Secret Word says that--of all these attainments--the very best that the best of the disciples who follow the secret teachings of the deep practice class can attain are (1) coming to hold the knowledge mantra of bodhisattvas who take the form of an enlightened Buddha, and (2) achieving the attainment of the physical form of the great seal, with our own Angel's body. This text also says that--in the action and activity classes of secret teachings--reaching the attainment of a holder of knowledge is the "great attainment of the body."

gru.acip: RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM GYIS MCHOG 'GRUB PA NI SNGON DU 'JIG RTEN PA'I DNGOS GRUB GRUB PA LA RAG LAS PA YIN LA, BLA MED LTAR NA DE LA RAG MA LAS PAR BSKYED RDZOGS BAR MA CHAD PAR BSGOM PAS MCHOG 'GRUB TU RUNG BAR DUS 'KHOR t'IKA CHEN LAS GSUNGS SHING ,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyis mchog 'grub pa ni sngon du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub grub pa la rag las pa yin la, bla med ltar na de la rag ma las par bskyed rdzogs bar ma chad par bsgom pas mchog 'grub tu rung bar dus 'khor TIka chen las gsungs shing
gru.english: The Great Commentary on the Wheel of Time says that--according to the three lower classes of the secret teachings--reaching the highest attainment of all depends upon first reaching the attainments which are shared; whereas according to the teachings of the unsurpassed class we can reach this highest attainment without having to rely on the shared ones, simply by practicing, in an uninterrupted stream, the stages of creation and completion.

gru.acip: SNGAGS RIM LAS KYANG , DANG POR DNGOS GRUB KYI 'BYUNG GNAS DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA DAG PAR BYAS NAS, DE NAS THUN BZHIR MTSAN MA YOD MED KYI RNAL 'BYOR LA 'BAD DE NUS PA RNYED PA DANG ,
gru.wylie: sngags rim las kyang , dang por dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byas nas, de nas thun bzhir mtshan ma yod med kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad de nus pa rnyed pa dang
gru.english: The Steps on the Way of the Secret Word too says-- The very first thing we must do is to strive to keep our pledges and vows pure, for this is the very source of all attainments.   Then we exert ourselves in the deep practice of the four sessions, both in the practice where there are still signs and the one where there are no longer any signs.  In this way we gain sufficient power.

gru.acip: DE NAS THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DNGOS GRUB RNAMS BSGRUBS NAS LAM GYIS SA GCOD PA'I TSUL 'DI RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM LA SHES DGOS KYI, RLUNG DANG BZLAS PA DANG STONG PA DANG LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR RNAMS LA GCIG DRIL BYAS PAS LAM BGROD PAR 'DOD NA MI RUNG NGO, ,ZHES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: de nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrubs nas lam gyis sa gcod pa'i tshul 'di rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la shes dgos kyi, rlung dang bzlas pa dang stong pa dang lha'i rnal 'byor rnams la gcig dril byas pas lam bgrod par 'dod na mi rung ngo, ,zhes gsungs so
gru.english: With this then we reach both the shared and the unique attainments.  One should understand this particular method of working up through the path in the lower three classes of the secret teachings.  It is incorrect though to think that we travel the path in these classes by just lumping together all these different deep practices of the inner winds; the recitation of mantras; emptiness; and the Angel.

gru.acip: RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM GYI LAM GYIS MCHOG 'GRUB PA LA SNGON DU THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB GRUB DGOS PA'I RGYU MTSAN YOD DE, SPYOD 'JUG LAS, YAN LAG 'DI DAG THAMS CAD NI, THUB PAS SHES RAB DON DU GSUNGS, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR THABS KYI CHA RNAMS KYIS STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I SHES RAB KHYAD ZHUGS PAR BYED PA NI THEG PA CHEN PO GNYIS KA'I LUGS YIN LA,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyis mchog 'grub pa la sngon du thun mong gi dngos grub grub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de, spyod 'jug las, yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni, thub pas shes rab don du gsungs, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs kyi cha rnams kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad zhugs par byed pa ni theg pa chen po gnyis ka'i lugs yin la
gru.english: Now there is a reason why, in the three lower classes of the secret teachings, we must first reach the shared attainments before we can come to the highest attainment.  As the Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life says, All these branches then were stated By the Able Ones to be Something for the purpose of wisdom. The point made here is that the practices which relate to method take the wisdom which perceives emptiness to a new level--and this idea is shared by both sections of the greater way.

gru.acip: RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM LAS NI PHAR PHYIN THEG PA LTAR SBYIN SOGS KYI GSAL BA'I DBYE BA MTHA' YAS PA LA DUS MTHA' YAS PAR SLOB PAR YANG MA GSUNGS SHING , SNGAGS BLA MED LTAR STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I YUL CAN KHYAD PAR CAN SKYED TSUL YANG MA GSUNGS PAS, THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB MANG PO DANG SANGS RGYAS DANG BYANG SEMS GONG MA RNAMS KYIS DNGOS SU RJES SU BZUNG NAS BYIN GYIS RLOB PA LA SOGS PA'I THABS MKHAS KYIS STONG NYID RTOGS PA KHYAD ZHUGS PAR 'GYUR DGOS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde 'og ma gsum las ni phar phyin theg pa ltar sbyin sogs kyi gsal ba'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa la dus mtha' yas par slob par yang ma gsungs shing , sngags bla med ltar stong nyid rtogs pa'i yul can khyad par can skyed tshul yang ma gsungs pas, thun mong gi dngos grub mang po dang sangs rgyas dang byang sems gong ma rnams kyis dngos su rjes su bzung nas byin gyis rlob pa la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis stong nyid rtogs pa khyad zhugs par 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: Here in the teachings of the lower three classes of the secret way though, we see neither the explanation of the open teachings of the greater way--where we train ourselves in that veritably limitless number of different types of giving and the rest, for a veritably limitless length of time; nor do we see the explanation of unsurpassed teachings of the secret word--the description of how we can give rise to a quite extraordinary state of mind which does the perceiving of emptiness. What we do see in these three lower classes is a way in which we must use unexpected methods--such as the shared attainments, and the blessing which we receive when the Buddhas and great bodhisattvas have taken us into their care--in order to take our perception of emptiness to a new level.

gru.acip: RTAGS PHYI MA MA GRUB STE, STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I YUL CAN KHYAD PAR CAN SKYED PA'I DON DU CHAGS PA LAM DU BYED PA NI BLA MED KHO NA'I KHYAD CHOS YIN PA'I PHYIR TE, GSAL SGRON LAS, STONG NYID SGOM PA'I YUL CAN KHYAD PAR CAN SKYED PA'I DON DU 'DOD YON LA CHAGS PA LAM DU BYED PA NI BLA MED LAS GZHAN DU YOD PA MA YIN NO, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: rtags phyi ma ma grub ste, stong nyid rtogs pa'i yul can khyad par can skyed pa'i don du chags pa lam du byed pa ni bla med kho na'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir te, gsal sgron las, stong nyid sgom pa'i yul can khyad par can skyed pa'i don du 'dod yon la chags pa lam du byed pa ni bla med las gzhan du yod pa ma yin no, ,zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: The second of the two reasons you give here to prove your point though is incorrect, for using desire as a path to give rise to an extraordinary state of mind which perceives emptiness is a feature of practice which is found only in the unsurpassed class.  As The Lantern says-- The practice of using desire for the objects of sense as a path for giving rise to the extraordinary state of mind which meditates upon emptiness is found in the unsurpassed class, and not in any of the others.

gru.acip: SNGAGS RIM LAS, RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM DANG PHAR PHYIN THEG PA'I MYUR KHYAD NI LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR DANG BZLAS PA'I MTHU LA BRTEN NAS THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB MANG PO DANG , SANGS RGYAS DANG BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA' CHEN PO RNAMS KYIS DNGOS SU RJES SU BZUNG NAS BYIN GYIS RLOB PA LA SOGS PA'I THABS MKHAS MANG POS BYANG CHUB KYI SPYOD PA RDZOGS PAR BYED PA YIN LA,
gru.wylie: sngags rim las, rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang phar phyin theg pa'i myur khyad ni lha'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa'i mthu la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub mang po dang , sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dngos su rjes su bzung nas byin gyis rlob pa la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas mang pos byang chub kyi spyod pa rdzogs par byed pa yin la
gru.english: And this is true because of the following statement from the Steps of the Secret Word: Here are the features of the lower three classes of the secret teachings which make them faster than the open teachings of the greater way.  In these classes, we utilize the deep practice of an Angel, and the recitation of mantras, to reach a great many of the shared attainments.  We also enjoy the blessings of the Buddhas and great bodhisattvas who have taken us in their care.  We use these and many other unexpected methods to bring our practice of the activities of a bodhisattva to its final perfection.

gru.acip: ZHES THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB SOGS KYI SGO NAS LAM MYUR BAR GSUNGS KYI, CHAGS PA LAM DU BYAS PA'I SGO NAS STONG NYID RTOGS PA'I BLO STOBS CHE BAS LAM MYUR BAR ZUR TZAM YANG MA GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: zhes thun mong gi dngos grub sogs kyi sgo nas lam myur bar gsungs kyi, chags pa lam du byas pa'i sgo nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo stobs che bas lam myur bar zur tsam yang ma gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: This citation is relating how the path here in the three lower classes is quicker because it utilizes the shared attainments and so on; there is not a single word here that says anything about this path being quicker because of some very powerful state of mind which perceives emptiness.

gru.acip: RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM GYI LAM TZAM GYIS TSE 'DIR SANGS RGYAS MI 'GRUB STE, DE DAG LA SNGAGS KYI THU MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM BLA MED KYI BSKYED RIM LAS LHAG PA MED PA'I PHYIR, ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam tsam gyis tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi 'grub ste, de dag la sngags kyi thu mong ma yin pa'i lam bla med kyi bskyed rim las lhag pa med pa'i phyir, zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: The same text says as well, We cannot reach enlightenment in this present life only by using the paths of the three lower classes of the secret teachings.  This is because there is nothing in these paths which exceeds the creation stage of the unique teachings of the secret word: the unsurpassed class.

gru.acip: CHUNG NGU'I PHRA BA'I DNGOS GNYEN NI RGYUN MTHA'I YE SHES SU 'JOG PA SOGS MDO LUGS THAL 'GYUR BA'I LUGS LTAR 'DOD DGOS TE, RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM GYI SGRIB GNYIS SPONG TSUL PHAR PHYIN THEG PA DANG MI 'DRA BAR GZHUNG KHUNGS THUB GANG NAS KYANG MA BSHAD LA, RIGS PAS KYANG MI GRUB PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: chung ngu'i phra ba'i dngos gnyen ni rgyun mtha'i ye shes su 'jog pa sogs mdo lugs thal 'gyur ba'i lugs ltar 'dod dgos te, rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi sgrib gnyis spong tshul phar phyin theg pa dang mi 'dra bar gzhung khungs thub gang nas kyang ma bshad la, rigs pas kyang mi grub pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: We define it as the wisdom of the very end of the process when we reach the direct antidote for the more subtle version of the lesser form of these obstacles to omniscience.  One would have to accept then that these descriptions of the paths and levels, and similar details at this point, follow the system of the Consequence School within the open teachings.  There is in fact no authoritative scripture which states that the description found in the three lower classes of the secret teachings for how we eliminate the two different kinds of obstacles differs from that found in the open teachings of the greater way.  Neither is there any logic which would indicate any such difference.

gru.acip: RNAL 'BYOR RGYUD LTAR NA, SLOB DPON SH'AKYA BSHES GNYEN DANG SANGS RGYAS GSANG BA GNYIS KYIS RGYAL PO GZHON NU DON GRUB CHU BO NI RANY+DZA NA'I 'GRAM DU RAB MTHA'I BSAM GTAN BZHI PA LA SNYOMS PAR ZHUGS PA'I TSE, PHYOGS BCU'I SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYIS SE GOL GYI SGRAS BSLANGS TE BSKUL NAS 'OG MIN DU KHRID DE,
gru.wylie: rnal 'byor rgyud ltar na, slob dpon shAkya bshes gnyen dang sangs rgyas gsang ba gnyis kyis rgyal po gzhon nu don grub chu bo ni rany+dza na'i 'gram du rab mtha'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe, phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis se gol gyi sgras bslangs te bskul nas 'og min du khrid de
gru.english: How does the class of deep practice explain this point?  The masters Shakyamitra and Buddhaguhya both say that Prince Siddhartha went into deep meditation on the fourth concentration level, at the very limit, sitting on the banks of the Ranjana River.  All the Buddhas in every corner of the universe then snapped Their fingers; and the sound brought him up out of this meditation and urged him higher.

gru.acip: GSAL SGRON LAS, DE NYID BSDUS PAR BYANG SEMS DON GRUB BYANG CHUB KYI SHING DRUNG DU BZHUGS PA LA DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA RNAMS KYIS BSKUL ZHES PA MA GTOGS PA 'OG MIN DANG 'DOD KHAMS GANG YIN MI GSAL BA LA, RDO RJE RTZE MO LAS 'OG MIN STUG PO BKOD PA YIN PAR BSHAD DO, ,ZHES GSUNGS SO,
gru.wylie: gsal sgron las, de nyid bsdus par byang sems don grub byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskul zhes pa ma gtogs pa 'og min dang 'dod khams gang yin mi gsal ba la, rdo rje rtse mo las 'og min stug po bkod pa yin par bshad do, ,zhes gsungs so
gru.english: As The Lantern puts it, The text known as Suchness Abbreviated says only that the bodhisattva Siddhartha was seated at the foot of the Bodhi Tree, and that Those Who Had Gone That Way urged him on higher.  Whether this was in the Heaven Below None, or in the desire realm, isn't specified.  The Tip of Diamond says that it took place in the Heaven Below None, the Mass of Clouds.

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, RGYUD SDE KHUNGS MA NAS BSHAD CING GRUB CHEN TSAD LDAN GYIS BKRAL PA'I BLA MED KYI DKYIL 'KHOR GANG YANG RUNG BA ZHIG TU 'JUG CING DBANG BSKUR PA THOB PAS LAM SGOM PA'I SNOD DU BYED PA STE,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, rgyud sde khungs ma nas bshad cing grub chen tshad ldan gyis bkral pa'i bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba zhig tu 'jug cing dbang bskur pa thob pas lam sgom pa'i snod du byed pa ste
gru.english: Here is the first.  We are made into a worthy vessel for the practice of this path through being granted entrance and initiation into some one or more of the secret worlds of the unsurpassed class, as these have been presented in an authentic scripture of the secret way, and commented upon by high practitioners: by people who are fully qualified to do so.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, DBANG GI DUS SU KHAS BLANGS PA'I DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA SRUNG PA LA BRTZON PAR BYAS NAS LAM BSGOMS NA DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB KYI SRUNG SDOM YAL BAR BZHAG NAS BSKAL BA MANG POR 'BAD KYANG DNGOS GRUB MI 'GRUB PAR MA ZAD BDE 'GRO TZAM YANG RNYED DKA' BAR GSUNGS PAS,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, dbang gi dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung pa la brtson par byas nas lam bsgoms na dngos grub 'grub kyi srung sdom yal bar bzhag nas bskal ba mang por 'bad kyang dngos grub mi 'grub par ma zad bde 'gro tsam yang rnyed dka' bar gsungs pas
gru.english: Here next are the pledges and vows.  It is stated in scripture that if we practice the path while working hard to keep all the pledges and vows which we committed ourselves to during our empowerment, then we will attain our spiritual goals; but that if we simply ignore the vows which we have pledged to keep then there is no way that we can reach any attainments at all, even if we exert ourselves for a great many eons--much less, for in this case we will find it difficult even to reach a rebirth in one of the higher realms.

gru.acip: DBANG YONGS RDZOGS THOB NAS LTUNG BAS MA GOS PAR BSRUNG NA LAM SGOM PA CHER MA BYAS KYANG SKYE BA BDUN NAM BCU DRUG TSUN CHAD DU MCHOG 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS SHING , SRUNG SDOM YAL BAR BZHAG NAS GZHAN LA JI TZAM 'BAD KYANG NGAN 'GROR LTUNG BAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO, ,'DI DAG RGYAS PAR BLA MA LNGA BCU PA'I RNAM BSHAD DANG RTZA LTUNG GI RNAM BSHAD DNGOS GRUB SNYE MA LAS SHES PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: dbang yongs rdzogs thob nas ltung bas ma gos par bsrung na lam sgom pa cher ma byas kyang skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du mchog 'grub par gsungs shing , srung sdom yal bar bzhag nas gzhan la ji tsam 'bad kyang ngan 'gror ltung bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro, ,'di dag rgyas par bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad dang rtsa ltung gi rnam bshad dngos grub snye ma las shes par bya'o
gru.english: And this is so because it is stated that--if we do receive the empowerment in its totality, and if we keep our commitments without being sullied by a downfall--then even if we fail to undertake any great practice of the rest of the path we will attain the highest goal within the length of seven or sixteen lifetimes.  But it is stated as well that--if we simply ignore the vows we have pledged to keep--then we will drop to a birth in the realms of misery, regardless of how hard we practice.  You should refer to the Commentary to the "Fifty Verses on Lamas" and to the commentary upon the root downfalls--the Golden Harvest of Attainments--for the more expanded explanation on these points found there.

gru.acip: DANG PO GRUB STE, RNAM GZHAG RIM PA'I RNAM BSHAD LAS, RIG MA 'DU BYA BA MAN CHAD RNAMS NI SANGS RGYAS PA'I SKABS KYI MDZAD PA DANG SBYAR GYI SRID PA'I RIM PA DANG MI SBYAR TE, ZHES SOGS RGYAS PAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: dang po grub ste, rnam gzhag rim pa'i rnam bshad las, rig ma 'du bya ba man chad rnams ni sangs rgyas pa'i skabs kyi mdzad pa dang sbyar gyi srid pa'i rim pa dang mi sbyar te, zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: The former point is true because of extensive statements from the Explanation of the Proper Steps of the Presentation such as the following: The practices up to and including joining with a Woman of Knowledge are activities performed at the point where we are enlightened beings, and not something which should be connected to any stages of suffering life.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA GRUB STE, DE NYID LAS, BSRUNG 'KHOR NI SRID PAR SKYE BA'I RIM PA LTAR SGOM PA'I BSKYED RIM DNGOS GZHI'I YAN LAG GAM SNGON 'GRO TZAM YIN PAS DE DAG LA SRID PA'I RIM PA DANG CHOS MTHUN SBYAR MI DGOS SO, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa grub ste, de nyid las, bsrung 'khor ni srid par skye ba'i rim pa ltar sgom pa'i bskyed rim dngos gzhi'i yan lag gam sngon 'gro tsam yin pas de dag la srid pa'i rim pa dang chos mthun sbyar mi dgos so, ,zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: And the latter point above is true because of the following statement from the same work: The circles of protection are only an auxiliary or preliminary step to the main part of the stage of creation, where our meditation follows the steps of a rebirth into the cycle of pain.  As such, there is no need to practice them as a reflection of the steps of this cycle.

gru.acip: RTAGS GRUB STE, DE'I RGYUD LA PHAR PHYIN THEG PA DANG RGYUD SDE 'OG MA DANG THUN MONG BA'I LAM DU MA YOD PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: rtags grub ste, de'i rgyud la phar phyin theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i lam du ma yod pa'i phyir
gru.english: And it is true that the last statement is true, because there do exist in the minds of such people a great many paths which are shared with the open teachings of the greater way, and with the lower classes of the secret teachings.

gru.acip: 'DOD MI NUS TE, BSKYED RIM SDUD PAR BYED PA'I SPYI'I CHINGS KYI DBYE BAR BSNYEN SGRUB YAN LAG BZHI DANG , RNAL 'BYOR BZHI DANG YAN LAG DRUG DANG , TING NGE 'DZIN GSUM GYI CHINGS BSHAD PA DANG 'GAL BA'I PHYIR, 'DI DAG RGYAS PAR SNGAGS RIM LAS SHES PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: 'dod mi nus te, bskyed rim sdud par byed pa'i spyi'i chings kyi dbye bar bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang , rnal 'byor bzhi dang yan lag drug dang , ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir, 'di dag rgyas par sngags rim las shes par bya'o
gru.english: And you can't agree to the statement before that, because it contradicts the explanation that the general structure which embodies the entire stage of creation can be divided into the categories of the four components of practice; the four deep practices and six components; and the three types of single-pointed concentration. You can find more detail on these points in the Steps of the Way of the Secret Word.

gru.acip: 'O NA BSKYED RIM LA SLOB PA DES RDZOGS RIM BZHIN DU DMIGS SKOR SNGA MA BSGOMS PAS BRTAN PA THOB PA NA PHYI MA LA 'PHO BA YIN NAM, 'ON TE SGRUB THABS KYI MGO MJUG THAMS CAD THUN GCIG LA SGOM PA YIN SNYAM NA,
gru.wylie: 'o na bskyed rim la slob pa des rdzogs rim bzhin du dmigs skor snga ma bsgoms pas brtan pa thob pa na phyi ma la 'pho ba yin nam, 'on te sgrub thabs kyi mgo mjug thams cad thun gcig la sgom pa yin snyam na
gru.english: The following question might come up in your mind: When you talk about training oneself in the stage of creation, is it similar to the same process in the stage of completion, where we move up to each successive practice once we have established ourselves firmly in the previous one?  Or is it rather that, in a single session, we go from the beginning to the end of our practice to reach the Angel?

gru.acip: DE LA DANG PO'I SKABS SU RANG GI SGRUB THABS NAS BYUNG BA'I BSKYED RIM GYI CHO GA THAMS CAD RDZOGS PAR BSGOM DGOS LA, DE YANG BSKYED RIM DANG POR SGOM PA NAS BZUNG STE RAGS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR YUD TZAM GYIS THAMS CAD GSAL BAR 'CHAR MI NUS PA'I BAR THAMS CAD LAS DANG PO BAR GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: de la dang po'i skabs su rang gi sgrub thabs nas byung ba'i bskyed rim gyi cho ga thams cad rdzogs par bsgom dgos la, de yang bskyed rim dang por sgom pa nas bzung ste rags pa'i dkyil 'khor yud tsam gyis thams cad gsal bar 'char mi nus pa'i bar thams cad las dang po bar gsungs so
gru.english: In the first instance here we must practice, in its entirety, the whole ritual for the stage of creation found in our particular text for reaching the Angel.  It is stated that one is considered a "beginner" from the point that we first begin practicing the stage of creation up to the point where we are able, in a single swoop, to visualize the entire secret world in a rough way.

gru.acip: DES NA KHYAD PAR CAN GYI SNANG BAS YID SHES KYI NGOR THA MAL BA'I SNANG BA 'GOG PA'I NUS PA THOB NA DES DGOS PA 'GRUB LA, DNGOS PO LA LHAR MA SONG YANG LHA'I BCOS MIN GYI NGA RGYAL SKYES NA'ANG DES DGOS PA 'GRUB PO ZHES SNGAGS RIM LAS GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: des na khyad par can gyi snang bas yid shes kyi ngor tha mal ba'i snang ba 'gog pa'i nus pa thob na des dgos pa 'grub la, dngos po la lhar ma song yang lha'i bcos min gyi nga rgyal skyes na'ang des dgos pa 'grub po zhes sngags rim las gsungs so
gru.english: As the Steps on the Way of the Secret Word puts it, As such, the purpose of this practice is achieved if we can use an extraordinary scene in the mind to prevent an ordinary perception of things from appearing in our mental consciousness.  And this purpose is achieved even if all we can do is give rise to a genuine sense of identification with the divine--even if we are not yet able, in reality, to become the divine itself.

gru.acip: GSAL SNANG SKYE BA LA SNGON DU DE LA DMIGS PA'I ZHI GNAS SGRUB DGOS PA YANG MIN LA, LHA RE RE NAS RIM GYIS MA GOMS NA MI SKYE BA YANG MIN ZHING , YANG DAG PA'I DON GOMS PA YANG MI DGOS PAR GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: gsal snang skye ba la sngon du de la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas sgrub dgos pa yang min la, lha re re nas rim gyis ma goms na mi skye ba yang min zhing , yang dag pa'i don goms pa yang mi dgos par gsungs so
gru.english: It is stated that, for us to give birth to clarity of the vision, we need not first reach meditative stillness focused on this particular object.  Neither is it the case that we cannot give birth to this clarity if we fail to build up a familiarity with each one of the Angels, moving through Them one by one.  Nor finally is it the case, it is stated, that we must build up a familiarity at this point with the one pure object.

gru.acip: RNAM PA YANG DANG YANG DU YID LA BYED PA GOMS NA DE TZAM GYIS GSAL SNANG SKYE MOD KYANG BRTAN POR GNAS PA DES MI RNYED LA, BRTAN CHAGS PAR GNAS PA MED NA NI THA MAL BA'I SNANG ZHEN 'GOG MI NUS PAS, BSKYED RIM GYI SKABS SU NGES PAR ZHI GNAS BSGRUB DGOS LA DE YANG PHRA THIG GI RNAL 'BYOR GYIS BYA DGOS SO,,
gru.wylie: rnam pa yang dang yang du yid la byed pa goms na de tsam gyis gsal snang skye mod kyang brtan por gnas pa des mi rnyed la, brtan chags par gnas pa med na ni tha mal ba'i snang zhen 'gog mi nus pas, bskyed rim gyi skabs su nges par zhi gnas bsgrub dgos la de yang phra thig gi rnal 'byor gyis bya dgos so
gru.english: Now we can admittedly gain clarity in our vision of ourselves by relying only upon the practice of bringing this form to mind, over and over again.  This though cannot lead us to a point where the clarity stays very firmly.  And unless we can maintain this clarity in a very stable way, it will not be able to block our tendency to believe it when things appear to us as ordinary.  As such, we must during the stage of creation reach a state of meditative stillness.  This in turn must be accomplished through the deep practice of the subtle drop.

gru.acip: DE YANG DANG PO GNYIS KYI SKABS SU PHRA THIG SGOM PA NI GTZO CHER MNGON RTOGS SGOM PA LA BYING RGOD GCOD PA'I CHED YIN LA, PHRA THIG LA DRIL NAS SEMS BRTAN PAR BYED PA'I GNAS PA SGRUB PA NI GNAS SKABS GSUM PA NAS BYED PAR GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: de yang dang po gnyis kyi skabs su phra thig sgom pa ni gtso cher mngon rtogs sgom pa la bying rgod gcod pa'i ched yin la, phra thig la dril nas sems brtan par byed pa'i gnas pa sgrub pa ni gnas skabs gsum pa nas byed par gsungs so
gru.english: At these first two levels, moreover, the reason that we meditate primarily upon the subtle drop for our visualization practice is in order to put a stop to mental dullness and agitation.  It is stated then that practicing fixation where the mind is brought to stability through wrapping everything up into a tiny drop is something that we do starting from the third level.

gru.acip: LAS DANG PO BA'I SKABS SU ZHI GNAS SGRUB PA MIN KYANG , STENG 'OG GI SNA SGO GNYIS SAM LTE BA'AM SNYING GA SOGS SU YI GE'AM THIG LE PHRA MO SOGS LA SEMS BTZAN THABS SU BZUNG NA SGOM PA'I GNAS DANG DMIGS RTEN GYI GNAD KYIS RIM GYIS RLUNG NANG DU GNAS PA'I RKYEN BYED PAS,
gru.wylie: las dang po ba'i skabs su zhi gnas sgrub pa min kyang , steng 'og gi sna sgo gnyis sam lte ba'am snying ga sogs su yi ge'am thig le phra mo sogs la sems btsan thabs su bzung na sgom pa'i gnas dang dmigs rten gyi gnad kyis rim gyis rlung nang du gnas pa'i rkyen byed pas
gru.english: Now even though it's true that while we are at the beginner's level we do not reach meditative stillness, we do hold the mind--through drastic means--upon objects such as sacred syllables or tiny drops positioned in certain places like the upper and lower channel openings, or the navel and the heart.  Due to this state of meditation, and due as well to the critical importance of the particular meditative object, we do bring the inner winds, gradually, to a point where they remain within.

gru.acip: DPYAD SGOM GYI DMIGS PA MANG PO DANG BSRES KYANG , RLUNG RIM GYIS 'DUL BA'I MTHUS DKYIL 'KHOR RGYAL MCHOG SOGS SGOM PA LA SEMS RGOD PA MYUR DU DGAG NUS PAS, PHAR PHYIN THEG PA DANG RGYUD SDE 'OG MA NAS BSHAD PA'I TING NGE 'DZIN SGRUB LUGS DANG MI 'DRA STE,
gru.wylie: dpyad sgom gyi dmigs pa mang po dang bsres kyang , rlung rim gyis 'dul ba'i mthus dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sogs sgom pa la sems rgod pa myur du dgag nus pas, phar phyin theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma nas bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgrub lugs dang mi 'dra ste
gru.english: Even though our meditation at this point is interspersed with a great many objects upon which we are performing an analytical form of meditation, nonetheless the above process helps us, in time, to bring the inner winds under our control.  This then has the power to stop, quickly, any agitation in the mind as we meditate upon something like the secret world of the Supreme Victor.  As such, the way in which we attain single-pointed meditation here is unlike that which is described in the open teachings of the greater way, and in the lower classes of the secret teachings.

gru.acip: BRTAN PA THOB PA DANG MTHAR PHYIN PA'I TSAD SO SOR BSHAD PA DE NI MKHAS GRUB RIN PO CHE'I DGONGS PA PAnA CHEN CHOS RGYAN GYIS GSAL BAR GSUNGS PA LTAR BKOD PA YIN LA, 'ON KYANG DPYAD GZHI CUNG ZAD YOD DE,
gru.wylie: brtan pa thob pa dang mthar phyin pa'i tshad so sor bshad pa de ni mkhas grub rin po che'i dgongs pa paNa chen chos rgyan gyis gsal bar gsungs pa ltar bkod pa yin la, 'on kyang dpyad gzhi cung zad yod de
gru.english: My description here of separate points at which we attain stability in a form and at which we take this form to its final development is based upon clear references to these in the works of His Holiness the First Panchen Lama, Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen, as He interprets the true intent of Kedrup Rinpoche.  Nonetheless, there appears to be some point of discussion here.

gru.acip: BSKYED RIM DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSO LAS, DKYIL 'KHOR GYI 'KHOR LO LA DMIGS NAS RNAM PA RANG BZHIN MED PAR BSGOM PA'I BLO DE NI, DKYIL 'KHOR GYI 'KHOR LO LA DMIGS PA'I CHA NAS BSOD NAMS KYI TSOGS DANG , RANG BZHIN MED PA'I 'DZIN STANGS CAN DU SKYES PA'I CHA NAS YE SHES KYI TSOGS GNYIS KA'I NGO BOR SKYES PA YIN ZHING , ZHES DANG ,
gru.wylie: bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho las, dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la dmigs nas rnam pa rang bzhin med par bsgom pa'i blo de ni, dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la dmigs pa'i cha nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang , rang bzhin med pa'i 'dzin stangs can du skyes pa'i cha nas ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ka'i ngo bor skyes pa yin zhing , zhes dang
gru.english: As the text on the stage of creation entitled The Ocean of Attainments puts it, Consider this state of mind, in which we are focusing upon the circle of Angels within the secret world, but doing so in a way where we are meditating upon the fact that they have no nature of their own.  This mind comes up as a combination of both of the collections: there is the collection of merit, in that our visualization is focused upon the circle of Angels in the secret world; and there is the collection of wisdom, in that the way this visualizing state of mind holds its object is to see it as lacking any nature of its own.

gru.acip: BSKYED RIM GYI SGRA BSHAD DANG DE JI LTAR SGOM TSUL DANG LHA SO SO'I MI 'DRA BA'I KHYAD PAR DANG , GRUB CHEN SO SO'I BSHAD TSUL MI 'DRA BA RNAMS NI GZHUNG GZHAN DU GSAL PAR BSHAD PA MI SNANG BAS SNGAGS RIM KHO NA LAS SHES PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: bskyed rim gyi sgra bshad dang de ji ltar sgom tshul dang lha so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang , grub chen so so'i bshad tshul mi 'dra ba rnams ni gzhung gzhan du gsal par bshad pa mi snang bas sngags rim kho na las shes par bya'o
gru.english: The literal meaning of the name "stage of creation"; exactly how we practice this stage; the exact differences between the various Angels; and the different explanations given on this stage by the accomplished masters are all points that you can learn only from the Steps on the Way of the Secret Word, for they are explained clearly in no other work. * * * * * The following brief summary of Je Tsongkapa's explanation in the Steps on the Way of the Secret Word is from Chone Drakpa Shedrup's commentary on this work, entitled The Light of Fine Explanation (ACIP digital text S0215).

gru.acip: RDZOGS RIM NI, BLOS BTAGS PA LA MA BLTOS PAR GRUB PA'I RTZA RLUNG THIG LA DMIGS NAS DBU MA'I NANG DU RLUNG ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM SOGS BYA BA'I PHYIR BSGOM PAR BYA BA'I RIM PA YIN PAS NA RDZOGS RIM ZHES BYA STE DON BSDUS PA'O,
gru.wylie: rdzogs rim ni, blos btags pa la ma bltos par grub pa'i rtsa rlung thig la dmigs nas dbu ma'i nang du rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum sogs bya ba'i phyir bsgom par bya ba'i rim pa yin pas na rdzogs rim zhes bya ste don bsdus pa'o
gru.english: Here's then what the name "stage of completion" refers to.  This is given its name because it is a stage where we undertake practices such as getting the winds to go through the three-fold process of entering, staying, and dissolving within the central channel, due to our focus upon the channels, winds, and drops--things which come complete without depending on our imagining them.

gru.acip: RTAGS GRUB STE, GSAL SGRON LAS, GAL TE GANG ZAG KHA CIG GIS BSKYED RIM PHRA MO MTHAR PHYIN PA NA RLUNG DH'U T'IR TSUD PA'ANG SRID PA DANG , PHYI'I PHYAG RGYA DANG SBYOR BA SROG RTZOL DU 'GRO BA'I GNAD SHES PAS, DE LA BRTEN NAS KYANG RLUNG DH'U T'IR THIM PA'I DGA' BA BZHI BSKYED PAR NUS NA NI,
gru.wylie: rtags grub ste, gsal sgron las, gal te gang zag kha cig gis bskyed rim phra mo mthar phyin pa na rlung dhU tIr tshud pa'ang srid pa dang , phyi'i phyag rgya dang sbyor ba srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gnad shes pas, de la brten nas kyang rlung dhU tIr thim pa'i dga' ba bzhi bskyed par nus na ni
gru.english: Now the fact that the last statement above is true is established by the following quotation from The Lantern: Now it is true that certain individuals can reach the final end of the subtle form of the stage of creation, and bring the inner winds to enter the channel of dance.  And those who understand how joining with an outer partner can be used as a crucial practice for mastering the life-wind may then able to use this practice to bring on an experience of the four kinds of bliss, as the inner winds enter the channel of dance.

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, BSGRUB BYA MTHAR THUG SGRUB PA LA THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MIN PA'I LAM 'DI RNAMS DGOS LA, 'DIR MI 'DU BA'I LAM GZHAN MI DGOS TE,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, bsgrub bya mthar thug sgrub pa la thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i lam 'di rnams dgos la, 'dir mi 'du ba'i lam gzhan mi dgos te
gru.english: Here is the first.  In order to reach the ultimate goal, what we need are these two paths: the one which is shared, and the one which is unique.  We do not need though any other type of path--one which is not subsumed by one of these two.

gru.acip: BLA MED SPYI NAS BSHAD PA'I MI SLOB PA'I ZUNG 'JUG 'GRUB PA LA NI, DON GYI 'OD GSAL DANG DAG PA'I SGYU MA'I SKU GNYIS TSOGS PA'I SLOB PA'I ZUNG 'JUG SNGON DU 'GRO DGOS SHING , DE LA NI DAG PA'I SGYU MA'I SKU SNGON DU 'GRO DGOS TE, DAG PA'I SGYU MA'I SKU SNGON DU MA SONG BAR DE 'DRA BA'I ZUNG 'JUG THOB MI RUNG BA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: bla med spyi nas bshad pa'i mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub pa la ni, don gyi 'od gsal dang dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku gnyis tshogs pa'i slob pa'i zung 'jug sngon du 'gro dgos shing , de la ni dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku sngon du 'gro dgos te, dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku sngon du ma song bar de 'dra ba'i zung 'jug thob mi rung ba'i phyir
gru.english: This is true because--if one hopes to reach the combination of the two where there is no more learning--then they must first reach the combination of the two for one who is still learning; that is, the combination of the actual clear light and the pure body of illusion.  This is because it would be incorrect to say that one could reach this higher combination of the two without first attaining the pure body of illusion.

gru.acip: YANG KHA CIG ,MA DAG PA'I SGYU LUS THOB PA LA SEMS DBEN SNGON DU SONG BAS KHYAB PAR THAL, GSAL SGRON LAS, DE 'DRA BA'I SGYU MA'I SKU GANG LAS SGRUB PA'I GZHI'I RLUNG DANG SEMS NI, ZHES PA NAS, SEMS DBEN GYI YE SHES GSUM BSKYED PA'I SEMS DANG , DE'I BZHON PA'I RLUNG YIN PAS SGYU LUS KYI SNGON DU SEMS DBEN 'GRO DGOS SO, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR NA MA KHYAB STE,
