In the crook of His left elbow, He wields a khatvanga staff; His legs are crossed In the diamond posture, And he wears the six Adornments of bone. He embodies every shelter there is.

whole_word_matches.context: g g-yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa, gru mo g-yon na kha T+vAM ga bsnams pa, zhabs rdo rje'i sk

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANG CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer
gru.english: I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind in my care;

gru.acip: ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,ZHES SOGS KYIS RGYUN BSHAGS BYA,
gru.wylie: byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ,zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya
gru.english: I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: RANG SEMS RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I THUGS KA NAS KA P'A LA THOGS PA'I MKHA' 'GRO MA DPAG TU MED PA SPROS PAS BDUD RTZI NAS BCUS TE, AOm A'A: H'Um, GANG 'GRUB BRJOD CING ,
gru.wylie: rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas ka pA la thogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spros pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te, aoM a'a: hUM, gang 'grub brjod cing
gru.english: My own mind Flies forth from the precious heart Of the Angel of Diamond, In the form of infinite Angels of the Sky, Each one bearing A cup of skull. They scoop up the nectar From the cup. (Repeat then this mantra, as many times as you can:)

gru.acip: MAn+dALA GANG 'GRUB 'BUL, GSUNGS PA NI,
gru.wylie: maN+Dala gang 'grub 'bul, gsungs pa ni
gru.english: (Offer then the mandala, as many times as you can, as it has been spoken we should:)

gru.acip: ,GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG NA BZA' BRAG PHUG PA, ,GRUB MCHOG MKHAS PA'I DED DPON CHOS KYI RJE, ,GRUB RIGS SNYAN RGYUD MNGA' BDAG YAR LUNG PAR, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: grub pa'i dbang phyug na bza' brag phug pa, ,grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje, ,grub rigs snyan rgyud mnga' bdag yar lung par, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Drakpukpa, Of the land of Nasa, Lord of saints; At the feet Of Chukyi Je, Captain of masters And highest saints; And at the feet Of Yarlungpa, Owner of the spoken tradition Of the line of saints; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: ,BKA' DRIN MNYAM MED RJE BTZUN RDO RING BA, ,BKA' BZHAN SGRUB PA'I BSTAN 'DZIN BLO GSAL DBANG , ,BKA' RGYUD GSANG CHEN SMRA BA MKHYEN BRTZE'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo ring ba, ,bka' bzhan sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang , ,bka' rgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Doringwa, The Venered One, Kind beyond all words; At the feet Of Losel Wang, Keeper of the Teachings And of his Lama's word; And at the feet Of Kyentse, Proclaiming the Great Secret In the Lineage of the Word; Grant me simultaneous wisdom

gru.acip: ,RDO RJE GO 'PHANG 'GRUBS PA'I NYE LAM MCHOG ,RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I SMIN SGROL DAM PA'I MDZOD, ,RDO RJE 'DZIN PA BLO BZANG YE SHES LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: rdo rje go 'phang 'grubs pa'i nye lam mchog ,rdo rje btsun mo'i smin sgrol dam pa'i mdzod, ,rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang ye shes la, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Lobsang Yeshe, The Holder of the Diamond; Supreme short path To reach The state of the Diamond; Treasure house Of holy instructions That make us ripe, And make us free, The Word of the Angel of Diamond; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: ,RDO RJE 'CHANG CHEN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA, ,GRUB CHEN N'A RO TA PA PHAM 'THING PA, ,SHES RAB BRTZEGS DANG MAL GYO SA SKYA BA, ,RJE BTZUN SKU MCHED RNAMS LA GSOL BA 'DEBS,
gru.wylie: rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma, ,grub chen nA ro ta pa pham 'thing pa, ,shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya ba, ,rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of the great Keeper of the Diamond, The Angel of Diamond, The master yogi Naropa, The Pamtingpa brothers, Sherab Tsek, Melgyo, Sakyawa, And the two holy brothers.

gru.acip: ,BSOD NAMS MCHOG LDAN BSOD NAMS MCHOG GRUB DANG , ,MKHYEN RAB CHOS RJE RMOR CHEN RDO RJE 'CHANG , ,KUN DGA' LEGS 'BYUNG BLO GSAL PHUN TSOGS ZHABS, ,BSTAN 'DZIN 'PHRIN LAS RNAMS LA GSOL BA 'DEBS,
gru.wylie: bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang , ,mkhyen rab chos rje rmor chen rdo rje 'chang , ,kun dga' legs 'byung blo gsal phun tshogs zhabs, ,bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rnams la gsol ba 'debs
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Sunam Chokden, Sunam Chokdrup, Kyenrab Chuje, Morchen Dorje Chang, Kunga Lekjung, Losel Puntsok, And Tendzin Trinley. [The following is modified to include Lamas after the author:]

gru.acip: ,DGA' LDAN BSTAN 'DZIN DGA' LDAN DAR RGYAS MTSAN, ,DHARMA BHADRA DBYANGS CAN GRUB PA'I RJE, ,BLO BZANG 'JIGS MED KHRI BYANG RIN CHEN ZHABS, ,BKA' DRIN GSUM LDAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA MCHOG ,DBANG BSKUR RGYUD BSHAD MAN NGAG STZOL RNAMS LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: dga' ldan bstan 'dzin dga' ldan dar rgyas mtshan, ,dharma bhadra dbyangs can grub pa'i rje, ,blo bzang 'jigs med khri byang rin chen zhabs, ,bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog ,dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag stsol rnams la, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Ganden Tendzin, Ganden Dargye, Dharma Bhadra, Yangchen Druppay Dorje, Lobsang Jikme, Trijang Rinpoche, And of my supreme Root Lama, The one who has granted me The three different forms Of kindness. Thus do I make my supplication At the feet of all the Lamas Who have granted us empowerment, Explained to us the secret teachings, And given us private instructions on them. Grant us we beg Simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU A LAS ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DKAR LA DMAR BA'I MDANGS CAN GYI STENG DU,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi steng du
gru.english: From a state of emptiness Come the letters eh and eh, And from them a dharma star. The star is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together. Inside is a disk, The moon, Come from the letter ah. It is colored a mix Of red and white, And upon it rest These secret words, Circling to the left:

whole_word_matches.context: stong pa'i ngang las ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'kh

gru.acip: DE YANG RDO RJE'I SA GZHI RVA BA GUR BLA RE DANG BCAS PA'I PHYI ROL TU KHA DOG SNA LNGA PA'I ME DPUNG G-YON SKOR DU 'KHYIL ZHING 'BAR BA, DE'I NANG DU GTUM DRAG LA SOGS PA'I DUR KHROD CHEN PO BRGYAD KYIS BSKOR BA'I DBUS SU CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI GDENGS KA CHE BA GYEN DU PHYOGS SHING , RTZE MO PHRA BA THUR DU ZUG PA,
gru.wylie: de yang rdo rje'i sa gzhi rva ba gur bla re dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu kha dog sna lnga pa'i me dpung g-yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba, de'i nang du gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing , rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa
gru.english: This world Has a diamond ground, Circled by walls, With a great canopy roof And ceiling. Outside the walls Is a great mass of fire; It has five different colors, And swirls around to the left, Burning fiercely. Inside the walls Are Savage Wrath and the rest Of the eight great burial grounds. They surround a dharma star, Set in the center; It is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together. The wide part of the star Faces upward, And its sharp point Is stuck down in the ground.

whole_word_matches.context: po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs

gru.acip: BDUN PA 'GRO BA DAG PA'I RNAL 'BYOR NI, RANG GI SNYING GAR CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU BAm YIG LA SNGAGS 'PHRENG GIS BSKOR BA LAS 'OD ZER 'PHROS TE, BA SPU'I BU GA NAS PHAR SONG , RIGS DRUG GI SEMS CAN THAMS CAD LA PHOG PAS SDIG SGRIB BAG CHAGS DANG BCAS PA SBYANGS, DE THAMS CAD RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SKUR GYUR PAR BSAM,
gru.wylie: bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni, rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su baM yig la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros te, ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song , rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs, de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam
gru.english: (Now begin number seven, the Practice of Making All Beings Pure:) In my heart is a dharma star, It is red, made of two Triangular parts stacked together. Inside the star is a moondisk, And in the center of the disk Is a letter vam, surrounded by A string of secret words. Light goes forth from them And leaves from the pores of my skin; It flies and strikes Every living being Of all of the six kinds. The light cleans them Of their wrong deeds and obstacles, Along with the seeds for these. They all turn into The Angel of the Diamond.

whole_word_matches.context: rnal 'byor ni, rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi

gru.acip: RANG GI SNYING GAR CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU VAm YIG LA SNGAGS 'PHRENG KHA DOG DMAR POS G-YON SKOR DU BSKOR BA LAS 'OD ZER DMAR PO DPAG MED 'PHROS,
gru.wylie: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su vaM yig la sngags 'phreng kha dog dmar pos g-yon skor du bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po dpag med 'phros
gru.english: (See now the following:) At my heart Is a dharma star; It is red, with two Triangular sections Stacked together. Inside the star Is a moon disk, And at the center of the disk Is a letter vam, Surrounded by the secret words; They are red, And they circle to the left. From them all shine forth Red rays of light, Too many to count.

whole_word_matches.context: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi

gru.acip: ,,GSUM PA BUM PA BSGRUB PA NI, BUM PA LAS SNGAGS KYIS BSANGS, SVA BH'A WAS SBYANGS,
gru.wylie: gsum pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni, bum pa las sngags kyis bsangs, sva bhA was sbyangs
gru.english: (This brings us to the third major section of the ceremony: bringing the sacred vase into being.  First clear the vase with the Mantra of Ritual, and then purify it with the Svabhava Mantra:)

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS PAm LAS PAD+MA DANG ,A LAS ZLA BA'I STENG DU B+H+R'Um LAS RIN PO CHE'I BUM PA MTSAN NYID THAMS CAD DANG LDAN PA'I NANG DU AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las paM las pad+ma dang ,a las zla ba'i steng du b+h+rUM las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi
gru.english: From a state of emptiness Comes the letter pam, And from it a lotus. From it comes a letter ah, And from it a moon. Atop it stands a letter bhrum, And from it forms a jeweled vase With every fine quality. Inside the vase Appear the letters eh and eh, And from them comes A dharma star. It is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together.

whole_word_matches.context: d dang ldan pa'i nang du ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi

gru.acip: ,,BZHI PA MDUN BSKYED BSGRUB MCHOD NI,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa mdun bskyed bsgrub mchod ni
gru.english: (This brings us to the fourth of the six sections of the ceremony: Reaching the Angel who is outside of us, and making offerings to Her.)

gru.acip: DE'I NANG DU GTUM DRAG LA SOGS PA'I DUR KHROD CHEN PO BRGYAD KYIS BSKOR BA'I DBUS SU AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU
gru.wylie: de'i nang du gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du
gru.english: Inside the walls Are Savage Wrath and the rest Of the eight great burial ground. At the center Appear the letters eh and eh, And from them comes A dharma star. It is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together.

whole_word_matches.context: kyis bskor ba'i dbus su ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du

gru.acip: ,PHUL BYUNG KUN TU BZANG PO'I MCHOD PA'I SPRIN, ,DNGOS BSHAMS YID KYIS RNAM PAR RAB SPRUL NAS, ,BLA MA YI DAM CHOS SKYONG SRUNG MA LA, ,GUS PAS 'BUL LO BZHES NAS DNGOS GRUB STZOL,
gru.wylie: phul byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin, ,dngos bshams yid kyis rnam par rab sprul nas, ,bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma la, ,gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub stsol
gru.english: It is a cloud of offerings, which fills the sky, The gift of Excellence: Things weve set out here before You, And things we can only imagine to give. We beg You to accept these offerings, Lamas, Close Angels, the Keepers And Protectors of the Dharma; Accept and grant us every attainment.

gru.acip: ,YID 'PHROG GZUGS SGYUR SNYAN PA'I ROL MO SGROG ,DRI ZHIM NGAD 'THUL RO MCHOG PHYUR BUR SPUNGS, ,'JAM MNYEN REG BYA'I TSOGS KUN 'BUL BYED NA, ,NYE BAR BZHES LA DNGOS GRUB STZAL TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: yid 'phrog gzugs sgyur snyan pa'i rol mo sgrog ,dri zhim ngad 'thul ro mchog phyur bur spungs, ,'jam mnyen reg bya'i tshogs kun 'bul byed na, ,nye bar bzhes la dngos grub stsal tu gsol
gru.english: We offer You sights that steal Your heart away; We send to You the sounds of lovely song; Clouds of fragrance; feasts piled high With the highest taste of all; And things both soft and pleasing to touch. Accept these please our gifts, And grant us all attainments.

gru.acip: ,RGYAL SRID BDUN DANG BKRA SHIS RTAGS BRGYAD RDZAS, ,YID 'PHROG PHYI NANG GSANG BA'I MCHOD PA'I TSOGS, ,SLU MED MCHOG GSUM DAM PA'I TSOGS LA 'BUL, ,MCHOG DANG MTHUN MONG DNGOS GRUB STZAL TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas, ,yid 'phrog phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs, ,slu med mchog gsum dam pa'i tshogs la 'bul, ,mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub stsal tu gsol
gru.english: We present these gifts To the highest assembly: To the Triple Gem Which cannot ever fail us; We present You here With a mass of offerings Outer, inner, and secret too These seven jewels of royalty, The eight sings of auspiciousness, And all the rest as well. Grant us then we beg You, Every attainment of the spirit: The highest, and those of the world.

gru.acip: ,BDEN GNYIS RNAM DAG RDZOGS RIM DBU MA'I LAM, ,SGRIB GNYIS SBYANG PHYIR BRTZON PAS LEGS BSGOMS PAS, ,DON GNYIS LHUN GRUB 'GYUR MED BDE BA'I THUGS, ,MKHA' SPYOD THUGS KYIS BYIN GYIS BRLAB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam, ,sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas, ,don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs, ,mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol
gru.english: Let me practice, perfectly, With endless efforts the central path: The stage of completion, perfection of Each of the two kinds of truth, The state where I have cleaned myself Of both the obstacles. Let me attain then the sacred mind, Immutable, acting without thought To help both others and myself. Grant me this too, Do I beg, Heaven of the Angel, With Your holy mind.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi
gru.english: I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood,

gru.acip: ,BYANG CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYIS NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,CES LAN GSUM GYIS BYANG SDOM GZUNG ,
gru.wylie: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ,ces lan gsum gyis byang sdom gzung
gru.english: And take all living kind in my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU, A LAS ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DKAR LA DMAR BA'I MDANGS CAN GYI STENG DU, AOm AOm AOm SARBA BUDDHA d'A KI N'I YE BADZRA WARnA n'I YE BADZRA BEE RO TZA N'I YE H'Um H'Um H'Um PHAt PHAt PHAt SV'A H'A, ZHES PA'I SNGAGS 'PHRENG G-YON SKOR DU 'KHOD PAR GYUR,

gru.wylie: de'i nang du gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing , rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa

gru.acip: YE SHES KYI ME 'BAR BA'I DBUS NA BZHUGS PA'I LTE BAR AE AE SA CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU A LAS ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU VAm YIG DMAR PO, MDUN RGYAB GNYIS SPANGS PA'I GRVA BZHIR DGA' 'KHYIL DMAR SKYA G-YON SKOR DU 'KHOR BA RE RES MTSAN PAR GYUR PAR BSAM LA,
gru.wylie: ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar ae ae sa chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su vaM yig dmar po, mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grva bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar skya g-yon skor du 'khor ba re res mtshan par gyur par bsam la
gru.english: (See now the following:) I stand in the midst Of a blazing fire of knowledge. At my navel appear The letters eh and eh, Which transform into A dharma star. It is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together. Within it appears A letter ah, Which transforms into A disc of the moon. At the center of this moon Stands a crimson Letter vam. The four corners of the star, Not counting the front and back, Each are marked With a pink-red swirl of bliss, Spinning to the left.

whole_word_matches.context: us na bzhugs pa'i lte bar ae ae sa chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'kh

gru.acip: SLOB DPON RIN PO CHES BDAG LA, DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA THAMS CAD KYI SKU GSUNG THUGS YON TAN 'PHRIN LAS THAMS CAD KYI DNGOS GRUB DANG , 'JIG RTEN DANG 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA STZAL ZHING BRTAN PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, ZHES LAN GSUM GSOL BA BTAB,
gru.wylie: slob dpon rin po ches bdag la, de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang , 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol, zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab
gru.english: (The initiate then makes the following supplication, three times over:) O my precious Master, I beg that You bestow upon me All the attainments, All the high spiritual qualities, And all the sacred deeds Of the holy acts And words and thoughts Of every Enlightened Being Who has already passed that way. Grant me I beg You, And make firm within me, Every kind of attainment there is: Those of the world, And those beyond the world.

gru.acip: BLA MA RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR PA BDAG LA DGONGS SU GSOL, BDAG MING 'DI ZHES BGYI BAS DUS 'DI NAS BZUNG STE JI SRID BYANG CHUB SNYING PO LA MCHIS KYI BAR DU RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB PA'I YI DAM GYI LHAR BZUNG NAS GZUNG SNGAGS AOm GSUM MA NYIN RE LA 'DI SNYED RE BZLA BAR BGYI'O, ,LAN GSUM BRJOD PA DAM BCA' BA'I LUNG ,
gru.wylie: bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor pa bdag la dgongs su gsol, bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas gzung sngags aoM gsum ma nyin re la 'di snyed re bzla bar bgyi'o, ,lan gsum brjod pa dam bca' ba'i lung
gru.english: (The Lama next grants the oral transmission of the commitment, by having the initiate repeat the following three times:) O my Lama, O Angel of Diamond, I beg You to hear me now. My name is (give your tantric name), And I swear to You now The following oath. From this day forth, Until I reach The Heart of Enlightenment, I take the Lady of Holiness, The Angel of Diamond, As my personal Angel, In my journey to reach The Heaven of Purity; And I promise that I will Recite Her secret words, The Mantra of the Triple Om, (State a number) times each day from now.

gru.acip: DES SKU TSOM BU'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU BUM PA'I DBANG THOB, LUS KYI DRI MA DAG ,LAM BSKYED RIM RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG BSGOM PA LA DBANG ZHING , 'BRAS BU SPRUL SKU 'GRUB PA'I SKAL BA CAN DU BYAS SO, ,ZHES DAG PA BRJOD,
gru.wylie: des sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob, lus kyi dri ma dag ,lam bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom pa la dbang zhing , 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so, ,zhes dag pa brjod
gru.english: (Grant now the disciple an explanation of the purity gained:) With this, You have received The empowerment of the vase In the secret world Of Her holy body, The mandala of the pile of powder. Every impurity Of your body Is cleaned from you. You are empowered now To undertake the practice Of the eleven yogas Of the path Of the stage of creation. You have been changed Into a person Who possesses the goodness To attain the final goal In the form of The body of emanation.

gru.acip: DES GSUNG BDUD RTZI'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU GSANG BA'I DBANG THOB, NGAG GI DRI MA DAG ,LAM RDZOGS RIM RTZA DBU MA BSGOM PA LA DBANG ZHING , 'BRAS BU LONGS SKU 'GRUB PA'I SKAL BA CAN DU BYAS SO, ,ZHES DAG PA BRJOD,
gru.wylie: des gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob, ngag gi dri ma dag ,lam rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma bsgom pa la dbang zhing , 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so, ,zhes dag pa brjod
gru.english: (Grant the disciple again an explanation of the purity they have gained:) With this, You have received The empowerment of the secret In the secret world Of Her holy words, The mandala of The nectar of deathlessness. Every impurity In how you speak Is cleaned from you. You are empowered now To undertake the practice Of the central channel: The path of the stage Of completion. You have been changed Into a person Who possesses the goodness To attain the final goal In the form of The body in paradise.

gru.acip: DES THUGS SIN+D+HU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU SHES RAB YE SHES KYI DBANG THOB, YID KYI DRI MA DAG ,LAM PHO NYA BSTEN PA LA DBANG ZHING , 'BRAS BU CHOS SKU 'GRUB PA'I SKAL BA CAN DU BYAS SO, ,ZHES DAG PA BRJOD,
gru.wylie: des thugs sin+d+hu ra'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob, yid kyi dri ma dag ,lam pho nya bsten pa la dbang zhing , 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so, ,zhes dag pa brjod
gru.english: (Grant the disciple once more an explanation of the purity bestowed upon them:) With this, You have received The empowerment of the wisdom Of the Woman of knowledge Within the secret world Of Her holy mind, The mandala of The powder of sindhura. Every impurity In how you think Is cleaned from you. You are empowered now To undertake the practice Of the path Of working with A Messenger. You have been changed Into a person Who possesses the goodness To attain the final goal In the form of The Dharma body.

gru.acip: DE NAS, DBANG GSUM PA'I DUS SU LUS 'DOD LHA YAB YUM DANG SEMS BDE STONG DBYER MED DU MOS PA'I RGYUN JE BZANG DU SONG STE MTHAR SKU RLUNG SEMS LAS GRUB PA'I YAB YUM ZHAL SBYOR GYI RNAM PA CAN DANG THUGS LHAN SKYES KYI BDE STONG DBYER MED PA'I ZUNG 'JUG DNGOS GNAS SU 'GRUB PA YIN NO,
gru.wylie: de nas, dbang gsum pa'i dus su lus 'dod lha yab yum dang sems bde stong dbyer med du mos pa'i rgyun je bzang du song ste mthar sku rlung sems las grub pa'i yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can dang thugs lhan skyes kyi bde stong dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug dngos gnas su 'grub pa yin no
gru.english: (Continue by saying:) When you gained The third of the empowerments, You imagined That your body was that Of the Angels of passion, Man and Woman; And that your mind Was bliss and emptiness, Indivisible. This thought Will stream on now Into the future, Into reality, Growing ever more pure Until the final end, When your holy body Will be that of an Angel Man and Woman, Joined in union: A creation of your own Inner winds and thoughts. Your holy mind too then Will be that of bliss And emptiness, simultaneous; And so you shall dwell In the actual state Of the Union of the Two.

gru.acip: NGES DON DAM BYANG SEMS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR DU TSIG DBANG RIN PO CHE THOB, SGO GSUM GYI DRI MA DAG ,LAM BSAM MI KHYAB BSGOM PA LA DBANG ZHING , 'BRAS BU NGO BO NYID SKU 'GRUB PA'I SKAL BA CAN DU BYAS SO, ,ZHES DAG PA BRJOD,
gru.wylie: nges don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin po che thob, sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ,lam bsam mi khyab bsgom pa la dbang zhing , 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so, ,zhes dag pa brjod
gru.english: (Grant the disciple this final explanation of the purity given to them:) With this, You have received The precious empowerment Of the word Within the secret world Of Her ultimate Wish For Enlightenment. Every impurity In how you act, Speak, and think Is cleaned from you. You are empowered now To undertake the practice Of the path Of the inconceivable. You have been changed Into a person Who possesses the goodness To attain the final goal In the form of The body of suchness.

gru.acip: ,BDAG GIS JI LTAR BTZAL YANG 'PHAGS MA KHYOD, ,BDEN PAR GRUB PA'I NGES PA MA RNYED NAS, ,SPROS PAS DUB PA'I SEMS KYI GZHON NU DE, ,BRJOD BRAL NAGS KYI KHANG BUR NGAL GSO BSTEN,
gru.wylie: bdag gis ji ltar btsal yang 'phags ma khyod, ,bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas, ,spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon nu de, ,brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso bsten
gru.english: No matter how I seek, My Lady of Realization, I cannot find in You Anything that is truly real; So take this Child's mind of mine, Exhausted by Projections, And let it rest In the quiet forest home Of the thing that words Cannot express.

gru.acip: ,AE MA DA NI d'A KI DBYINGS NAS BZHENGS, ,HE RU KA DPAL RGYUD KYI RGYAL PO LAS, ,RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I NYE BA'I SNYING PO MCHOG ,BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB CES GSUNGS PA'I BDEN PAS SKYONGS,
gru.wylie: ae ma da ni DA ki dbyings nas bzhengs, ,he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las, ,rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog ,bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs
gru.english: Eh-ma, Rise now from The Realm of Dakis, Save me, for I swear By the might of Truth; By the words Spoken in The King of Secret Tomes, The Book of the Glorious Heruka: "Those will reach Who only say The highest Secret Words, The Words of Closest Essence, The Words of the Diamond Queen."

gru.acip: ,AO dI BI SHA'I BAS MTHA'I NAGS KHROD DU, ,GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG RDO RJE DRIL BU PA, ,'KHYUD DANG TZUM BHA'I BDE BAS RJES BSKYANGS TE, ,KHA SBYOR MCHOG GIS ROL BZHIN BDAG KYANG SKYONGS,
gru.wylie: ao Di bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du, ,grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa, ,'khyud dang tsum bha'i bde bas rjes bskyangs te, ,kha sbyor mchog gis rol bzhin bdag kyang skyongs
gru.english: Within the forest wilds Of Oddivisha, There lived Ghanta Pada, Lord of all the Saints; And You saved him With the bliss Of Your embrace and chumba, With the play Of the ultimate Kiss; I ask, save me the same.

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS, BDAG DANG SEMS CAN THAMS CAD DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'KHRID PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, 'JIG RTEN DANG 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA STZAL TU GSOL, ZHES 'DOD DON LA GSOL BA GDAB CING TSOGS 'KHOR BYED NA 'DIR BYED DO,,
gru.wylie: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas, bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol, 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol, zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing tshogs 'khor byed na 'dir byed do
gru.english: (Say then:) Holy Angel of Diamond, I ask that You take me And every other living being To the Heaven of Purity. Grant us every one of our goals; Those of the world, And those Beyond the World. (Request thus all that you may wish.  If you will be performing the Circle of Gathering, do so at this point.) [151]

gru.acip: ,YONGS 'DU'I TSAL DANG GSHIN RJE'I PHO BRANG DANG , ,'DZAM GLING DE WI KO tI'I GNAS MCHOG NAS, ,'DOD KHAMS GTZO BO NAM GRU RE MA T'I, ,DPAL LDAN LHA MO 'DIR BYON MCHOD GTOR BZHES,
gru.wylie: yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang , ,'dzam gling de wi ko Ti'i gnas mchog nas, ,'dod khams gtso bo nam gru re ma tI, ,dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes
gru.english: Come, Queen of the desire realm, Ship in the Sky, Remati, From the sacred places: The Garden of The Meeting Tree, The Palace of the Lord of Death, And Devikoti Of the Jambu Continent; Angel of Glory, Come, partake Of the torma offerings.

whole_word_matches.context: de wi ko Ti'i gnas mchog nas, ,'dod khams gtso bo nam gru re ma tI, ,dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes

gru.acip: ,GSOL LO MCHOD DO RGYAL BA'I BSTAN SRUNG TSOGS, ,BSGRUBS SO BSTEN NO BLA MA'I BKA' SRUNG CHE, ,'BOD DO BSKUL LO RNAL 'BYOR DGRA LHA'I TSOGS, ,RINGS PA'I TSUL GYIS 'DIR BYON MCHOD GTOR BZHES,
gru.wylie: gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs, ,bsgrubs so bsten no bla ma'i bka' srung che, ,'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha'i tshogs, ,rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes
gru.english: I ask I offer Gathering of Protectors Of Teachings of the Victors; I reach I come Great Protectors Of the Lama's Word; I call I urge The Angels against enemies Of those who try to practice; Make haste, Come, partake, Of the torma offerings.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS BSTAN PA GNYAN PO KHYED KYIS SRUNGS, ,DKON MCHOG DBU 'PHANG GNYAN PO KHYED KYIS STOD, ,DPAL LDAN BLA MA'I 'PHRIN LAS KHYED KYIS SPEL, ,RNAL 'BYOR BCOL BA'I 'DOD DON KHYED KYIS SGRUBS, ,ZHES GTOR RDZONG BYA'O,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po khyed kyis srungs, ,dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po khyed kyis stod, ,dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las khyed kyis spel, ,rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'dod don khyed kyis sgrubs, ,zhes gtor rdzong bya'o
gru.english: Protect The uncompromising Teaching of the Buddhas; Praise The uncompromising Eminence of the Jewels; Spread The great works Of the glorious Lamas; Accomplish The goals that we practitioners Have entrusted to You. F. The Conclusion of the Ritual F. The Conclusion of the Ritual

gru.acip: DRUG PA MJUG BSDU BA NI, CHU GNYIS NYER SPYOD ROL MO DANG BCAS PA BYIN GYIS BRLAB STE, RANG GI THUGS KA NAS ZHES SOGS BUM SGRUB LTAR PHYI NANG GI MCHOD PA PHUL LA,
gru.wylie: drug pa mjug bsdu ba ni, chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa byin gyis brlab ste, rang gi thugs ka nas zhes sogs bum sgrub ltar phyi nang gi mchod pa phul la
gru.english: (This brings us to the sixth and final section of this ceremony: the conclusion of the ritual.  First present the outer and inner offerings as we did when bringing the vase into being:)

gru.acip: ,AOm KHYED KYIS SEMS CAN DON KUN MDZAD, ,RJES SU MTHUN PA'I DNGOS GRUB STZOL, ,SANGS RGYAS YUL DU GSHEGS NAS KYANG , ,SLAR YANG 'BYON PAR MDZAD DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: aoM khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad, ,rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol, ,sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang , ,slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol
gru.english: Om. You do For every living creature What it is They need. You grant them The attainments They deserve. And though You May return now To your paradise, We beg that In the future You come back to us.

gru.acip: DE NAS ,DGE BA 'DI YIS MYUR DU BDAG ,MKHA' SPYOD MA DNGOS 'GRUB GYUR NAS, ,'GRO BA GCIG KYANG MA LUS PA, ,DE YIS SA LA 'GOD PAR SHOG
gru.wylie: de nas ,dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ,mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas, ,'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa, ,de yis sa la 'god par shog
gru.english: (Continue with:) By this good deed May I quickly attain The Angel of Paradise; May I lead beings To Her place, Leaving behind not even one.

gru.acip: ,RMAD BYUNG SRAS BCAS RGYAL BA'I BYIN RLABS DANG , ,RTEN 'BREL BSLU BA MED PA'I BDEN PA DANG , ,BDAG GI LHAG BSAM DAG PA'I MTHU STOBS KYIS, ,RNAM DAG SMON PA'I GNAS 'DI 'GRUB PAR SHOG MDOR BSDUS SAM,
gru.wylie: rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang , ,rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang , ,bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis, ,rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par shog mdor bsdus sam
gru.english: (The final prayer may be done briefly as follows:) By the blessings of The wondrous Victors and Their daughters and Their sons; By the truth of the fact That dependant origination Cannot ever fail; And by the mystic power Of our pure willingness To free all beings ourselves, May all that we have Prayed here for So purely come to pass.

gru.acip: SPRO NA, ,DAL 'BYOR GRU CHEN MI RTAG DRAN PA YI, ,BA DAN DKAR PO BSKYOD PA LAS 'BRAS KYI, ,BLANG DOR MTHUN PA'I RLUNG GIS RAB BSKUL NAS, ,'JIGS RUNG 'KHOR BA'I MTSO LAS SGROL BAR SHOG
gru.wylie: spro na, ,dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las 'bras kyi, ,blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas, ,'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog
gru.english: (Or, if you like, you may recite the following more extensive version:) And by the power Of this deed May we board the good ship Of spiritual leisure and fortune; May we set the white sails Of constantly remembering Our own impermanence, And thus see the ship stir forth; May the fair winds Of our careful observation Of the laws of karma And its consequences Then fill the sails And drive us all Across the terror of this sea, The cycle of pain we live in.

whole_word_matches.context: spro na, ,dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las

gru.acip: ,SIN+D+HURA LANG+GA LI YI SDONG BUR BCAS, ,RO LDAN GNAS SU BSGRUBS SHING YUL KUN TU, ,MYUL BAS GANG GI MDZOD SPUR 'KHYIL RIS CAN, ,'PHOS PA'I MDZES MAS MKHA' SPYOD 'KHRID PAR SHOG
gru.wylie: sin+d+hura lang+ga li yi sdong bur bcas, ,ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu, ,myul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can, ,'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog
gru.english: And by this power May we use the sindhura And the trunk of langali To practice in The home of the dead And then go wandering off To places far and near; And when we meet the One Where the drawing of the swirl Moves off to the spot In between Her brows, May the Lovely One Lead us off To the Heaven of the Angel

gru.acip: ,RMAD BYUNG SRAS BCAS RGYAL BA'I BYIN RLABS DANG , ,RTEN 'BREL BSLU BA MED PA'I BDEN PA DANG , ,BDAG GI LHAG BSAM DAG PA'I MTHU STOBS KYIS, ,RNAM DAG SMON PA'I GNAS 'DI 'GRUB PAR SHOG
gru.wylie: rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang , ,rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang , ,bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis, ,rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par shog
gru.english: By the blessings of The wondrous Victors and Their daughters and their sons; By the truth of the fact That dependent origination Cannot ever fail; And by the mystic power Of our pure willingness To free all beings ourselves, May all that we have Prayed here for So purely come to pass.

gru.acip: ,SNA TSOGS ZHING DU SNA TSOGS GZUGS SKU YIS, ,SNA TSOGS THABS KYIS SNA TSOGS GDUL BYA'I DON, ,SNA TSOGS BSAM PA JI BZHIN SGRUB MDZAD MA, ,ZHING SKYES SPRUL PA'I SKU YI BKRA SHIS SHOG
gru.wylie: sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis, ,sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don, ,sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma, ,zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog
gru.english: May we have the joyful fortune Of the Emanation Body Born of the holy places; The One who goes To different places In different physical bodies And uses different Skilful means In order to fulfill The different wishes In the heart Of every different disciple.

gru.acip: ,GANG GI RNAM SPRUL GRANGS MED BYE BA PHRAG ,STONG PHRAG BDUN CU RTZA GNYIS TSOGS RNAMS KYIS, ,SGRUB PA PO YI BAR CHAD KUN SEL ZHING , ,'DOD DON DNGOS GRUB STZOL BA'I BKRA SHIS SHOG
gru.wylie: gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag ,stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis, ,sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing , ,'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog
gru.english: May we have the joyful fortune Of Her granting us All wishes and attainments, Coming in two And seventy thousand Groups of emanations, Bodies of Her Sent from Her In millions without count; Sent to clear The obstacles Of all who try to reach Her.

gru.acip: ,DE PHYIR SGRUB DKYIL BDE BA CHEN PO'I LAM, ,MA LUS GSAL BAR LTA BA'I SGRON ME 'DI, ,GZUR GNAS BLO GSAL DON GNYER CAN RNAMS KYIS, ,LONGS LA MKHA' SPYOD ZHING DE BGROD PAR MDZOD,
gru.wylie: de phyir sgrub dkyil bde ba chen po'i lam, ,ma lus gsal bar lta ba'i sgron me 'di, ,gzur gnas blo gsal don gnyer can rnams kyis, ,longs la mkha' spyod zhing de bgrod par mdzod
gru.english: (As such Ive been able To compose These instructions for reaching Her, For entering Her secret realm: They are indeed a light Which illuminates Every part of the path For coming to highest bliss. I pray that those disciples Who are free of any bias, Whose minds are bright And hearts so yearn, May utilize these instructions To make their way to paradise, The Heaven of the Angel.)

gru.acip: CES RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD KYI SIN+D+HU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD DANG DBANG GI CHO GA BDE CHEN GSAL SGRON ZHES BYA BA 'DI NI, RANG NYID LA RTZOM 'DUN NAR MAR YOD PA'I THOG ,NYE CHAR DGE TSUL MA SKAL BZANG CHOS SKYID NAS TSES BCU RNAM GNYIS LA NYAMS SU BLANGS CHOG PA'I SGRUB DKYIL TSIG NYUNG ZHING DON 'DUS PA ZHIG DGOS ZHES YANG DANG YANG DU BSKUL BA LTAR,
gru.wylie: ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+d+hu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang dbang gi cho ga bde chen gsal sgron zhes bya ba 'di ni, rang nyid la rtsom 'dun nar mar yod pa'i thog ,nye char dge tshul ma skal bzang chos skyid nas tshes bcu rnam gnyis la nyams su blangs chog pa'i sgrub dkyil tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes yang dang yang du bskul ba ltar
gru.english: (This ends the Light for Finding Ecstasy, a ritual for reaching, making offerings to, and then taking empowerment into the secret world of sindhura: the practice of the Heaven of the Angel, granted to Naropa for reaching the holy Angel of Diamond.  I had for quite some time been thinking constantly of composing such a work, and then recently I was approached by the novice nun Kelsang Chukyi, who urged me repeatedly to undertake this work, saying that people were in great need of a concise, abbreviated ceremony which could be used during the two tenth-day rituals of the month, as a practice for reaching Her, and entering into Her secret world.)

gru.acip: LAM 'DI LA LHAG PAR MOS PA'I SH'AKYA'I DGE SLONG DHARMA BHA DRAS, TSAR CHEN BLO GSAL RGYA MTSO DANG LCANG SKYA ROL PA'I RDO RJE SOGS SA DGE'I MKHAS GRUB RGYA MTSO LTA BU'I GZHUNG LA BRTEN NAS, MYOS LDAN GYI LO'I CHU STOD ZLA BA'I MAR DO'I TSE BCU'I NYIN BZHAD DNGUL CHU'I RI PHUG TU SBYAR BA'O,,
gru.wylie: lam 'di la lhag par mos pa'i shAkya'i dge slong dharma bha dras, tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje sogs sa dge'i mkhas grub rgya mtsho lta bu'i gzhung la brten nas, myos ldan gyi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i mar do'i tshe bcu'i nyin bzhad dngul chu'i ri phug tu sbyar ba'o
gru.english: (As such, this piece has been completed by myself, the monk of the Shakya by the name of Dharma Bhadraa person who has a special devotion to this particular practice.  In composing the text, I availed myself of a veritable ocean of spiritual classics by Masters of both the Sakya and Gelukpa traditions: sages like Tsarchen Losel Gyatso and Changkya Rolpay Dorje.  The writing was finished at Quicksilver Hermitage of Shey on the tenth of the waning moon, in the sixth Mongul month of the Earth Rabbit Year [1819].) G. The Circle of Gathering, to Accompany the Empowerment G. The Circle of Gathering, to Accompany the Empowerment

gru.acip: ,BDE SKYONG STONG GSUM LTAR YANGS KA P'A LAR, ,DAM RDZAS 'DUD RTZI RAB 'KHYIL TSOGS MCHOD 'DI, ,YI DAM DKYIL 'KHOR LHA TSOGS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,BZHES NAS MCHOG MTHUN DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pA lar, ,dam rdzas 'dud rtsi rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di, ,yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul, ,bzhes nas mchog mthun dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: The cauldron of the kapala Is vast as all three realms, And sustains us with its bliss. Inside it is the sacred substance, The circle of gathering, Waves of swirling nectar. We offer it forth To the gathering Of Close Angels, And Angels of the Mandala; May You be pleased. Deign to partake of it, We beg, And grant us both Our worldly goals And the attainment of The ultimate.

gru.acip: ,BDE SKYONG STONG GSUM LTAR YANGS KA P'A LAR, ,DAM RDZAS BDUD RTZI RAB 'KHYIL TSOGS MCHOD 'DI, ,MKHA' 'GRO CHOS SKYONG TSOGS RNAMS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,BZHES NAS RNAL 'BYOR 'PHRIN LAS BSGRUB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pA lar, ,dam rdzas bdud rtsi rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di, ,mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul, ,bzhes nas rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub tu gsol
gru.english: The cauldron of the kapala Is vast as all three realms, And sustains us with its bliss. Inside it is the sacred substance, The circle of gathering, Waves of swirling nectar. We offer it forth To the gathering Of Angels of the Sky And Protectors of the Dharma; May You be pleased. Deign to partake of it, We beg, And bring to success The sacred deeds Of the yogis of this practice.

gru.acip: H'Um, ,BDE SKYONG STONG GSUM LTAR YANGS KA P'A LAR, ,DAM RDZAS BDUD RTZI RAB 'KHYIL TSOGS LHAG 'DI, ,DAM CAN ZHING SKYONG TSOGS RNAMS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,BZHES NAS 'GAL RKYEN SOL LA MTHUN RKYEN SGRUBS,
gru.wylie: hUM, ,bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pA lar, ,dam rdzas bdud rtsi rab 'khyil tshogs lhag 'di, ,dam can zhing skyong tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul, ,bzhes nas 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs
gru.english: Hung! The cauldron of the kapala Is vast as all three realms, And sustains us with its bliss. Inside it is the sacred substance, The circle of gathering, Waves of swirling nectar. We offer it forth To the gathering Of the Protectors of Holy Lands Bound by vows to serve; May You be pleased. Deign to partake of it, We beg; Remove from our lives All that would obstruct our path, And bring for us All that would open our path.

gru.acip: ,CHAGS BRAL RLUNG SEMS DBU MAR BSDU BSGOM ZUNG , ,BSGOM PAR BDE BA DANG NI STONG PA SGRUB, ,GSUM PA 'BRAS BU YAN LAG BDUN LDAN THOB, ,BSAM MI KHYAB BYA MJUG SDUD TSAR CHOS STON,
gru.wylie: chags bral rlung sems dbu mar bsdu bsgom zung , ,bsgom par bde ba dang ni stong pa sgrub, ,gsum pa 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan thob, ,bsam mi khyab bya mjug sdud tshar chos ston
gru.english: That free of desire Is a pair, to gather wind and mind Into the central one, and meditate. For the meditation Attain bliss And voidness. The third is to achieve The result that has Seven parts. Do the Inconceivable, And present as a summary The teaching of Tsar.

gru.acip: ZHES PA 'DI NI RJE BTZUN BLA MA DE NYID KYIS RNAL 'BYOR MA'I CHO GA 'DI PAR DU 'KHOD ZIN PA MA GTOGS, DA LTA'I LAG LEN LTAR BSGRIGS NA BLO RMONGS LA PHAN CHE BAR 'DUG ,CES GSUNGS PA'I DGONGS PA BSGRUB PHYIR ME 'BRUG LO PAR GSAR RKO BYED SKABS DBYANGS CAN GRUB PA'I RDO RJES BSGRIGS PA'O,,
gru.wylie: zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyis rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga 'di par du 'khod zin pa ma gtogs, da lta'i lag len ltar bsgrigs na blo rmongs la phan che bar 'dug ,ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bsgrub phyir me 'brug lo par gsar rko byed skabs dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes bsgrigs pa'o
gru.english: (The Holy One, our Very Lama who composed it, said of His ritual text for the Angel of Diamond, "But for the fact that it's already been carved into blocks, it would have been a great benefit to the dull-witted if we had arranged it more in keeping with current custom."  And so to fulfill the wishes so stated by our Lama, the above has been compiled by myself, Yangchen Druppay Dorje, on the occasion of the carving of new blocks, in the Fire Dragon Year [1856].) [34]

gru.acip: ,SDE DGE'I PAR RKOS SHES RAB BZANG POS PAR DU BSGRUBS PA DGE'O, ,ZHAL GRO,
gru.wylie: sde dge'i par rkos shes rab bzang pos par du bsgrubs pa dge'o, ,zhal gro
gru.english: (The carving of the Derge blocks has been carried out by Sherab Sangpo--May Goodness Prevail.  Sheldro.)

gru.acip: LUGS DE'I LEN PA PO NI GRUB THOB KHYUNG PO RNAL 'BYOR TE, DE NI GDUNG RUS KHYUNG PO, YAB STAG SKYES, YUM BKRA SHIS SKYID GNYIS KYI SRAS SU STAG GI LO LA SNYE MO RA MANGS SU 'KHRUNGS,
gru.wylie: lugs de'i len pa po ni grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor te, de ni gdung rus khyung po, yab stag skyes, yum bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su stag gi lo la snye mo ra mangs su 'khrungs
gru.english: The one who first received this method of practice was the accomplished yogi Kyungpo Neljor.  He was born among the Kyungpo people, Born of the Tiger, and His holy mother was Trashi Kyi, Joy of Goodness.  Their excellent son came into this world in the Year of the Tiger [probably the one in 1014 AD or close to it], at Ramang in the province of Nyemo.

gru.acip: BTZAS MA THAG TU RGYA GAR GRUB THOB A MO GHA BYON TE LUNG LEGS PAR BSTAN, LO BCU LON PA'I TSE KLOG DANG RGYA BOD KYI YI GE MKHYEN, DUS KYI 'KHOR LO LA MKHAS, LO BCU GSUM PA LA SLOB DPON G-YUNG DRUNG RGYAL BA LA BON MKHAS PAR BSLABS NAS GZHAN LA BSHAD PAS DPE 'GREMS BDUN BRGYA TZAM BYUNG ,
gru.wylie: btsas ma thag tu rgya gar grub thob a mo gha byon te lung legs par bstan, lo bcu lon pa'i tshe klog dang rgya bod kyi yi ge mkhyen, dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas, lo bcu gsum pa la slob dpon g-yung drung rgyal ba la bon mkhas par bslabs nas gzhan la bshad pas dpe 'grems bdun brgya tsam byung
gru.english: Just after the birth, the great Indian yogi named Amogha came to see the child, and made a prophecy of His greatness.  By the age of ten, He had already learned to read, and become a master of writing the languages of both India and Tibet. In His thirteenth year, He studied with the sage Yungdrung Gyalwa, and Himself mastered the teachings of the Bon tradition.  He began to teach others, and soon had some 700 adherents.

gru.acip: DE NAS GSER MANG PO BSNAMS NAS BAL POR BYON NAS PAn+dI TA BA SU MA TI LA LO TZ'A BSLABS, KRi YOG GI DBANG DANG RGYUD SGRUB THABS LNGA BCU TZAM ZHUS, A TU LA BADZ+RA GYIS GROGS MDZAD NAS RDO RJE GDAN PA DANG MJAL, DGE TSUL MDZAD CHOS MANG DU GSAN,
gru.wylie: de nas gser mang po bsnams nas bal por byon nas paN+Di ta ba su ma ti la lo tsA bslabs, kri yog gi dbang dang rgyud sgrub thabs lnga bcu tsam zhus, a tu la badz+ra gyis grogs mdzad nas rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal, dge tshul mdzad chos mang du gsan
gru.english: Taking along with him a great quantity of gold, Kyungpo Neljor journeyed then to Nepal, where He studied the art of translation under the pandita Vasumati.  He was also granted empowerment into the system of kriya yoga, and no less than fifty different secret methods for reaching the Angels. With the assistance of Atulya Vajra, He was able to meet the sage Vajrasana, from whom He received ordination as a novice monk, and took a great many Dharma teachings.

gru.acip: RDO RJE GDAN PA LA GSER SRANG BRGYA PHUL, N'A LAN+D+RARA N'A RO PA'I SLOB MA D'A CHEN PO, SU MA TI K'IRTI, RA MA P'A LA, NA TE KA RA, KAm KA TA'I RJE BTZUN MA RIN CHEN LHA MO, KU KU RI PA'I SLOB MA GRUB THOB NYI MA'I SNYING PO RNAMS LA CHOS MANG DU ZHUS,
gru.wylie: rdo rje gdan pa la gser srang brgya phul, nA lan+d+rara nA ro pa'i slob ma dA chen po, su ma ti kIrti, ra ma pA la, na te ka ra, kaM ka ta'i rje btsun ma rin chen lha mo, ku ku ri pa'i slob ma grub thob nyi ma'i snying po rnams la chos mang du zhus
gru.english: Once more He met the sage Vajrasana, and made him a gift of a hundred measures of gold.  He came to Nalendra, where He was able to receive a great many Dharma teachings from the "Great Da" [said to be Danashila], disciple of Naropa himself; as well as from Sumati Kirti: Rama Pala, Natekara, the holy woman of Kankata named Ratna Devi, and from the master yogi Surya Garbha--a disciple of Kukuripa.

gru.acip: MEE TRI PA DANG MJAL NAS RGYUD MANG PO'ANG ZHUS, GSER SRANG BDUN PHUL, BOD LONGS SPYOD CHUNG BAS NOR SGRUB LHA BTZAN CHE BA CIG ZHUS PAS, YID BZHIN GYI MGON PO PHYAG DRUG GNANG GA
gru.wylie: mee tri pa dang mjal nas rgyud mang po'ang zhus, gser srang bdun phul, bod longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub lha btsan che ba cig zhus pas, yid bzhin gyi mgon po phyag drug gnang ga
gru.english: Kyungpo Neljor was then able to meet Maitripa himself, who granted Him instruction in many different secret teachings.  He offered this Lama seven measures of gold, and said to Him: "We Tibetans are people of limited material means; would You be willing to grant me instruction into a particular Angel for achieving great wealth?"  And so Maitripa bestowed on Him the secret practice of the Six-Armed Protector, Grantor of Wishes.

gru.acip: MKHA' 'GRO MAS DPAG TSAD GSUM DU KHYER NAS GSER GYI RI'I KHAR BZHAG DER RMI LAM DU RDO RJE BTZUN MOS CHOS DRUG TSAR GCIG DNGOS SU TSAR GSUM, RDO RJE TSIG RKANG , SGYU MA LAM RIM GNANG , GZHAN YANG RGYUD DANG SGRUB THABS SHIN TU MANG PO GSUNGS NAS,
gru.wylie: mkha' 'gro mas dpag tshad gsum du khyer nas gser gyi ri'i khar bzhag der rmi lam du rdo rje btsun mos chos drug tshar gcig dngos su tshar gsum, rdo rje tshig rkang , sgyu ma lam rim gnang , gzhan yang rgyud dang sgrub thabs shin tu mang po gsungs nas
gru.english: The Angel then carries Kyungpo Neljor through the sky, to a distance of three miles, and sets Him down on the top of a mountain made of gold.  He falls into a dream; the Queen of Diamond comes to Him, and teaches Him the Six Practices, one time through.  And then awake too She grants it to Him thrice. She teaches Him too the Lines of Diamond, and the Steps of the Path of the Illusion.  And She imparts to Him a great many other secret teachings, and methods of reaching the Angels.

gru.acip: LO GSUM GYI NANG DU ZHONG ZHONG LA SOGS PA'I DGON GNAS BRGYA RTZA BRGYAD BTAB, CHOS MANG DU BSHAD PAS GRVA PA RNAMS BSHAD PA LA CUNG ZAD 'BYAMS, SGRUB PA LA G-YEL BAR GYUR PAS DE RNAMS KYIS MTHONG BAR RES LHA MO'I GZUGS MANG PO BSTAN, RES GSHIN RJE'I SKYES BU 'JIGS SU RUNG BA MANG PO BSTAN PAS SLAR SGRUB PA LA TSUD,
gru.wylie: lo gsum gyi nang du zhong zhong la sogs pa'i dgon gnas brgya rtsa brgyad btab, chos mang du bshad pas grva pa rnams bshad pa la cung zad 'byams, sgrub pa la g-yel bar gyur pas de rnams kyis mthong bar res lha mo'i gzugs mang po bstan, res gshin rje'i skyes bu 'jigs su rung ba mang po bstan pas slar sgrub pa la tshud
gru.english: Here, over a period of three years, Kyungpo Neljor was able to found 108 different monasteries, among them Shongshong.  He also gave a great many teachings of the Dharma. At some points, the monks would become complacent about their studies, and distracted form their practices.  Then Kyungpo Neljor would push them back in, by showing them different divine beings.  Some needed to see the exquisite forms of many different goddesses, while others required a whole variety of terrifying Angels: forms of the Slayer of Death.

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I SKYES BU RNAMS KYI DGONGS PA CAN GYI GSUNG LA RDZUN DU BLTA BAR MI BYA LA, PHYIS 'DI LAS GRUB THOB MANG DU BRGYUD MAR BYUNG BA'I GTAN TSIGS KYIS GRUB PA'I SKYES BU KHO NAR LTA BAR BYA STE, DU BA LAS ME RTOGS PA BZHIN NO,,
gru.wylie: grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi dgongs pa can gyi gsung la rdzun du blta bar mi bya la, phyis 'di las grub thob mang du brgyud mar byung ba'i gtan tshigs kyis grub pa'i skyes bu kho nar lta bar bya ste, du ba las me rtogs pa bzhin no
gru.english: Holy beings that tell us things like this are communicating to us something special; we shouldn't view these things as less than absolute truth.  We must look at the great number of highly accomplished yogis who have appeared since then in the lineage descended from Kyungpo Neljor, and take this as logical proof, in effect, for the fact that He was none other than a highly attained being himself.  Where there is smoke, there must indeed be fire.

gru.acip: ,MI 'JIGS SENG KHRI PAD MA NYI ZLA'I GDAN STENGS NA, ,DRI MED NAM MKHA'I SNYING PO NOR BU RTZA BSHAD PA, SNYAN GRAGS BZANG PO MCHOG GIS YE SHES DNGOS GRUB BSNYES, ,KUN TU BZANG PO CHOS KYIS BRGYAL MTSAN BSTAN PA 'DZIN, ,SANGS RGYAS RNAM SPRUL N'A RO'I ZHABS LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO,
gru.wylie: mi 'jigs seng khri pad ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs na, ,dri med nam mkha'i snying po nor bu rtsa bshad pa, snyan grags bzang po mchog gis ye shes dngos grub bsnyes, ,kun tu bzang po chos kyis brgyal mtshan bstan pa 'dzin, ,sangs rgyas rnam sprul nA ro'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo
gru.english: Fearless You took your seat Upon the lion throne Of lotus, sun, and moon. Immaculate You revealed the core Of the jewels Of the heart of the sky. Renowned You came and gained The highest wisdom And attainments. Total goodness, Upholder of the Victory banner Of the holy Dharma. I bow to you, Naropa, Sent forth From the Buddhas themselves.* *[Translator's note: As we shall see, the various names by which Master Naropa was known during his life are woven into the verse with the italicized words.]

gru.acip: ,RTZIBS STONG RGYAN MDZES SKABS GSUM DBANG PO PAD+MO'I GNYEN, ,DBANG PO'I DGRA DANG DRI ZA GDENGS CAN TSOGS KYI BDAG, ,DBANG PHYUG 'JUG DGU MI DANG MI MIN RNAMS KYI NI, ,DGU MCHOD CI GSUNG BKA' BSGRUB 'GRO BA'I SKYABS MCHOG RJE, ,RIGS SANG LHA'I BRTZUN PA'I SPYI GTZUG RGYAN BZHUGS CIG
gru.wylie: rtsibs stong rgyan mdzes skabs gsum dbang po pad+mo'i gnyen, ,dbang po'i dgra dang dri za gdengs can tshogs kyi bdag, ,dbang phyug 'jug dgu mi dang mi min rnams kyi ni, ,dgu mchod ci gsung bka' bsgrub 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog rje, ,rigs sang lha'i brtsun pa'i spyi gtsug rgyan bzhugs cig
gru.english: Come now worldly gods of power: You with the Crown of a Thousand Spokes; Lord of Those Who Know Three Times; Friend of the Lotus; Foe of Power; Divine Musician; King of the Gathering; Lord of Power; Nine-Fork Lightning; Human spirits, and inhuman spirits as well-- A thousand offerings have been made, Come now and carry out All the commands that you've been given; Come now and seat yourselves as a crown Around the purest of the gods, That child of perfect family, The Lord, the Highest Protector Of every living being.

gru.acip: AE MA HO, KHAMS GSUM GYI BLA MA DUS GSUM GYI SANGS RGYAS 'GRO BA'I DPAL MGON DAM PA, DPAL N'A RO PA CHEN PO'I RNAM THAR DANG , YON TAN GYI MDZAD PA MTHA' DAG NI BRJOD PAR GA LA NUS, 'ON KYANG SKU TSE 'DI LA PHYI THOS BSAM GYI ’O NAS BSTAN PA DAR RGYAS SU MDZAD CING , NANG GSANG SNGAGS KYIS LAM DANG SNYING PO'I DON LA DKA' SPYAD BRTZON 'GRUS DRAG POS BLA MA MNYES PAR BYAS STE,
gru.wylie: ae ma ho, khams gsum gyi bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa, dpal nA ro pa chen po'i rnam thar dang , yon tan gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag ni brjod par ga la nus, 'on kyang sku tshe 'di la phyi thos bsam gyi ’o nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad cing , nang gsang sngags kyis lam dang snying po'i don la dka' spyad brtson 'grus drag pos bla ma mnyes par byas ste
gru.english: Eh-ma-ho!  And so we begin. Now of course it would be entirely impossible for one such as myself to describe, in their entirety, the high qualities and sacred deeds--the holy life--of the great and glorious Naropa, that shining protector of every living creature, himself every Buddha of the past and present and future, in all three realms of existence.  Nonetheless I shall attempt this task, in order to please my Lamas, putting forth every ounce of effort that I possess. In the outer world, I hope that by doing so I may contribute to the spread of the teachings--to see people learn them, and contemplate their meaning.  In the world within myself, I undertake this daunting work as part of my practice of the way of the secret word, to reach that essential heart. [18]

gru.acip: TSE 'DIR MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB BRNYED PA'I RNAM THAR LA GSUM, SKU BLTAMS TE NGO MTSAR MTSAN DPE DANG LDAN TSUL, 'KHOR BA LA YID PHYUNG STE BSTAN PA SPYI LA ZHUGS TSUL, KHYAD PAR SNGAGS KYI ’O RU ZHUGS NAS DKA' BA SPYAD TSUL LO,
gru.wylie: tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub brnyed pa'i rnam thar la gsum, sku bltams te ngo mtshar mtshan dpe dang ldan tshul, 'khor ba la yid phyung ste bstan pa spyi la zhugs tshul, khyad par sngags kyi ’o ru zhugs nas dka' ba spyad tshul lo
gru.english: Now there are three parts to the story of this holy being--of how He reached the highest goal of the spirit within a single life.  The first is the account of how he deigned to take His birth, an event accompanied by miraculous signs in the outer world, and special marks upon His own body. The second part covers how He gained despair over this life of suffering, and thus entered the teachings of the Buddha in general.  The third and final part relates the way in which, more especially, He gained the doorway of the secret way, and the hardships He underwent upon this path. The Land of His Birth [19]

gru.acip: DE YANG SNGON BSKAL PA 'DI CHAGS PA'I DUS NA, MANG POS BKUR BA'I RGYAL PO BYA BA BYON, DE'I SRAS RGYAL PO 'OD MDZES| ,DE'I SRAS DGE BA, DE'I SRAS DGE MCHOG ,DE'I SRAS GSO SBYONG 'PHAGS, DE'I SRAS SPYI BO SKYES, DE'I SRAS MDZES PA CAN, DE'I SRAS NYI MDZES 'OD, DE'I SRAS MDZES LDAN PA, DE'I SRAS LEGS SKYES, DE'I SRAS GO'U TA MA, DE'I SRAS BU RAM SHING PA, DE'I SRAS BSOD NAMS SKYES, DE'I SRAS DBANG PHYUG GRAGS PA, DE'I SRAS BSOD NAMS RTZE MO, DE'I SRAS YE SHES RGYAL MTSAN, DE'I SRAS BSOD NAMS GRUB, DE'I SRAS BSOD NAMS BKRA SHIS, DE'I SRAS BSOD NAMS GRAGS PA, DE'I SRAS ZHI BA'I GO CHA'O,,
gru.wylie: de yang sngon bskal pa 'di chags pa'i dus na, mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po bya ba byon, de'i sras rgyal po 'od mdzes| ,de'i sras dge ba, de'i sras dge mchog ,de'i sras gso sbyong 'phags, de'i sras spyi bo skyes, de'i sras mdzes pa can, de'i sras nyi mdzes 'od, de'i sras mdzes ldan pa, de'i sras legs skyes, de'i sras go'u ta ma, de'i sras bu ram shing pa, de'i sras bsod nams skyes, de'i sras dbang phyug grags pa, de'i sras bsod nams rtse mo, de'i sras ye shes rgyal mtshan, de'i sras bsod nams grub, de'i sras bsod nams bkra shis, de'i sras bsod nams grags pa, de'i sras zhi ba'i go cha'o
gru.english: Now in the ancient days, when this present eon was first beginning, there came into this world a king by the name of Respected by the Multitudes.  His son was the King Lovely Light.  His son was Supreme Goodness, and his son was Higher Perfection.  His son was named Magnificent, and his son was Beauty of the Sunlight.  His son was Exquisite, and his in turn was Wellborn. His son then was Gautama, and his was Leader of the People of the Sugarcane.  His son was Born of Virtue, and he was Lord of Power and Fame.  His son was Height of Merit, and his son was Banner of Wisdom.  His son was Attainment of Merit, whose son was Fortune of Merit.  His son was Fame of Merit, and his son, lastly, Armor of Peace. His Holy Parents

gru.acip: RTEN 'BREL CI BYAS KYANG MA 'BYUNG BA'I TSE, DBEN GNAS CIG NAS, DGE BA'I SHES GNYEN GRAGS PA'I BLO GROS ZHES BYA BA MNGON SHES DANG LDAN PA CIG YOD PA DE NYID GDAN DRANGS, DE LA MNGON SHES KYIS BRTAG PA ZHUS PAS, SKYABS BLO BTANG BYAS PA'I MI SLU BA DKON MCHOG YIN PAS, BSAM PA BZANG PO DANG LDAN PA JI BZHIN PA'I NGANG NAS, BYANG CHUB KYI MCHOG TU THUGS BSKYED LA, BLA MA DKON MCHOG YI DAM MKHA' 'GRO LA MCHOD PA GYA NOM PA BSHAMS TE, MOS GUS BCOS MA MA YIN PA'I ’O NAS GSOL BA RGYUN DU THOB DANG , KHYED RANG JI LTAR 'DOD PA'I DON 'GRUB PA GDA' YIS GSUNG NAS, LUNG BSTAN TE RANG GNAS SU GSHEGS SO,
gru.wylie: rten 'brel ci byas kyang ma 'byung ba'i tshe, dben gnas cig nas, dge ba'i shes gnyen grags pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba mngon shes dang ldan pa cig yod pa de nyid gdan drangs, de la mngon shes kyis brtag pa zhus pas, skyabs blo btang byas pa'i mi slu ba dkon mchog yin pas, bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pa ji bzhin pa'i ngang nas, byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed la, bla ma dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro la mchod pa gya nom pa bshams te, mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i ’o nas gsol ba rgyun du thob dang , khyed rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa gda' yis gsung nas, lung bstan te rang gnas su gshegs so
gru.english: No good thing that they could do to achieve this goal seemed to work.  And so they invited to the palace a certain spiritual guide named Renowned Intelligence--a sage who had been living in the wild and who possessed the gift of clairvoyance. They asked this wise one, "Can you use your powers of inner sight to see what we must do?" He replied, "The Three Jewels are the one thing that--if you truly put your hopes in them--will never fail you.  And so first you must give birth within your hearts to the Wish for highest enlightenment, keeping the very most pure motivation that you can. "Then set forth exquisite offering to the Lamas, the Three Jewels, the Close Angels, and the Angels of the Sky.  Ask Them for Their help, with genuine faith and devotion; and do so again and again.  All your wishes will be fulfilled." This prophecy did the sage give to them, and then returned to the wild. [26]

gru.acip: ,AE MA NGO MTSAR SKYES BU'I MCHOG, ,'DI NI ZAS GTZANG SRAS BZHIN DU, ,RAB TU MA BYUNG SA BDAG BYED, ,RAB TU 'BYUNG NA RGYAL BA'I SRAS, ,RGYAL BU DON 'GRUB JI BZHIN NO, ,ZHES LUNG BSTAN NAS BKRA SHIS PA MANG PO BRJOD DO, ,MTSAN KUN TU BZANG POR GSOL,
gru.wylie: ae ma ngo mtshar skyes bu'i mchog, ,'di ni zas gtsang sras bzhin du, ,rab tu ma byung sa bdag byed, ,rab tu 'byung na rgyal ba'i sras, ,rgyal bu don 'grub ji bzhin no, ,zhes lung bstan nas bkra shis pa mang po brjod do, ,mtshan kun tu bzang por gsol
gru.english: Eh-ma, ! Wondrous it is! He is the highest of beings.* He is like the prince Of Finest Feast,** For if he does not leave the home life, He will become the lord of the land; And if he does take the robes, Then he will become a bodhisattva, A child of the Victors. He is just the same As the prince, Siddhartha. *[Translator's note:  Again, a play on the literal name of Master Naropa's name in Sanskrit.] **[Finest Feast: Shuddhodana, the name of the king who was the Father of Lord Buddha.] Thus did he give his prophecy, and continued on with many songs of salutation.  And then he granted the child the name of Samanta Bhadra: Total Goodness.

gru.acip: ,,RTZA BA'I GNYIS PA, BSTAN PA SPYI LA ZHUGS TSUL LA BZHI, DGE BSNYEN GYI SDOM PA BZHES TE RIGS PA'I GNAS LNGA LA SBYANGS PA'I MDZAD PA, YAB YUM GYI BKA' SGRUB PHYIR DRI MED MA KHAB TU BZHES PA'I MDZAD PA, SLAR YANG RAB TU BYUNG ZHING BSNYEN PAR BRDZOGS TE RGYAL BA'I BSTAN PA NYIN MOR MDZAD PA, RDO RJE GDAN GYI MKHAN PO MDZAD DE MU STEGS TSAR BCAD NAS NANG PA'I BSTAN PA DAR RGYAS SU MDZAD PA'O,,
gru.wylie: rtsa ba'i gnyis pa, bstan pa spyi la zhugs tshul la bzhi, dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te rigs pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa'i mdzad pa, yab yum gyi bka' sgrub phyir dri med ma khab tu bzhes pa'i mdzad pa, slar yang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par brdzogs te rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor mdzad pa, rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po mdzad de mu stegs tshar bcad nas nang pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'o
gru.english: With this we come to the second major section of the biography: a description of how Master Naropa entered the teachings in general.  Here we proceed in four more parts: The story of how Master Naropa took lifetime layperson's vows and then went on to train in the five great divisions of classical knowledge; How, as an act of obedience for the wishes of His parents, He took the lady Immaculate as His bride; How once again He left the home life, and took full ordination, illuminating the teachings of the victorious Buddhas as if He were the Sun itself; And finally how He assumed the position of abbot at the Seat of the Diamond, vanquishing teachers of other schools and helping spread the ideas of the Buddha.

gru.acip: TSAD MA KUN LAS BTUS, DE'I DGONGS 'GREL GTZO BO LTA BU'I STAN BCOS GSUM, 'PHROS PA YAN LAG LTA BU'I BZHI STE SDE BDUN, KLU GRUB GYIS MDZAD PA'I TSAD MA SNANG BA, 'PHAGS PA LHAS MDZAD PA'I MNGON GSUM RJES DBANG SOGS KYI TSAD MA LA SBYANGS SHING THUGS SU CHUD,
gru.wylie: tshad ma kun las btus, de'i dgongs 'grel gtso bo lta bu'i stan bcos gsum, 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bzhi ste sde bdun, klu grub gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma snang ba, 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i mngon gsum rjes dbang sogs kyi tshad ma la sbyangs shing thugs su chud
gru.english: For the art of reasoning, Naropa studied the Compendium on Valid Perception, as well as the classical commentaries which clarify its true intent.  These included the Seven Classics, with the three great commentaries which are like the core, and the four which are like the limbs, as they are derived from the core works.  He further learned, among other such treatises, the Light on Valid Perception, written by Arya Nagarjuna--as well as Direct and Inferential Perception, by Master Aryadeva.  He grasped all these teachings as well.

gru.acip: SNYAN NGAG DON RGYAN SOGS GNYIS KYI MDO, KLU GRUB YAB SRAS MDZAD PA'I MU TIG PHRENG BA, NOR BU'I RGYAN, SLOB DPON DPA' BOS MDZAD PAS SNYAN NGAG ME LONG SOGS LA SBYANGS SHING THUGS SU CHUD,
gru.wylie: snyan ngag don rgyan sogs gnyis kyi mdo, klu grub yab sras mdzad pa'i mu tig phreng ba, nor bu'i rgyan, slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pas snyan ngag me long sogs la sbyangs shing thugs su chud
gru.english: For classical poetry, Naropa studied sutras of both [?], such as the Ornament of the Meaning.  He covered too the String of Pearls and the Jewel Ornament of Arya Nagarjuna and his spiritual son.  He learned as well the Mirror of Poetics by Master Shura, and other such works.  These teachings did He grasp completely too.

gru.acip: ,LHA DKON MCHOG GSUM LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO, ,DKON MCHOG GSUM GYIS THUGS RJES BZUNG , ,'GRO DRUG PHA MA'I RANG BZHIN LA, ,GCIG GNYIS PHA MAR MA SHES KYANG , ,BKA' BZHIN SGRUB PO 'DI 'DRA 'TSAL, ,RTOG MED GTZANG SBRA LA GNAS SHING , ,MU STEGS DRI MED THEG CHEN RIGS, ,RNYED NA BDAG LA BKA' STZOL GCIG, ,CES BUD MED 'DI LTA BU ZHIG BYUNG NA YAB YUM GYI BKA' MI BCAG GSUNG ,
gru.wylie: lha dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo, ,dkon mchog gsum gyis thugs rjes bzung , ,'gro drug pha ma'i rang bzhin la, ,gcig gnyis pha mar ma shes kyang , ,bka' bzhin sgrub po 'di 'dra 'tshal, ,rtog med gtsang sbra la gnas shing , ,mu stegs dri med theg chen rigs, ,rnyed na bdag la bka' stsol gcig, ,ces bud med 'di lta bu zhig byung na yab yum gyi bka' mi bcag gsung
gru.english: I bow down to my Angel, and to the Jewels. In kindness the Triple Gem Has taken me into Their care; And although every single being Of the six realms of existence Is by their very nature Our father and our mother, We do not know one another. Nonetheless, I agree to honor The wishes you've expressed; But to do so you must seek for me A maiden who's like this. She must be free of imagining That things come from their side, And she must be a person Of absolute cleanliness. She must be a pure Hindu, And at the same time must belong To a family of the greater way. If you can find this maiden, Your wish is my command. "That is," he concluded, "I will be able to avoid breaking your command, Father and Mother, if you can find me a maiden like this."

gru.acip: RIGS BRAM ZE YIN, GRUB MTHA' PHYI ROL PA YIN ZER NAS, RE ZHIG BU MO DE MIG CES RE LTA 'DUG, BLON PO'I BSAM PA LA 'DI NYID KYI MING DANG RIGS DANG MDZAD SPYOD LA BRTAGS PAS, RGYAL PO JI LTAR GSUNG BA'I YON TAN RNAMS BU MO 'DI LA 'TSANG 'DUG PA, SPRO MI SPRO LTA DGOS SNYAM NAS, KHYED KYIS RGYAL PO ZHI BA'I GO CHA'I SRAS KUN TU BZANG PO BYA BA, PAn+dI TA CHEN PO'I MTSAN THOS SAM,
gru.wylie: rigs bram ze yin, grub mtha' phyi rol pa yin zer nas, re zhig bu mo de mig ces re lta 'dug, blon po'i bsam pa la 'di nyid kyi ming dang rigs dang mdzad spyod la brtags pas, rgyal po ji ltar gsung ba'i yon tan rnams bu mo 'di la 'tshang 'dug pa, spro mi spro lta dgos snyam nas, khyed kyis rgyal po zhi ba'i go cha'i sras kun tu bzang po bya ba, paN+Di ta chen po'i mtshan thos sam
gru.english: And the Maiden simply stands there, silent, gazing steadily into the minister's eyes.  The minister thinks to himself, "Judging from her name, and her family, and the way she acts, this maid possesses all the qualities which the King has described.  Now we have to see whether she will like the plan." And so he says to Her, "Have you by any chance ever heard mention of the name of Total Goodness, who is the son of the king Armor of Peace, and is furthermore a great and learned man?"

gru.acip: MKHAN PO SOGS LA DPAL DUS KYI 'KHOR LO'I RGYUD 'GREL DRI MED LA SOGS PA DANG , MA H'A M'A Y'A, GDAN GZHI LA SOGS PA GSAN, DE NAS GNAS MCHOG PHUL LA HA RIR PHEBS TE BSHAD SGRUB GNYIS KYI BSTAN PA DAR RGYAS SU MDZAD CING , 'KHOR YANG DGE SLONG GI DGE 'DUN DANG BCAS PA DPAG TU MED PA TSOGS,
gru.wylie: mkhan po sogs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dri med la sogs pa dang , ma hA mA yA, gdan gzhi la sogs pa gsan, de nas gnas mchog phul la ha rir phebs te bshad sgrub gnyis kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad cing , 'khor yang dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa tshogs
gru.english: During this time, he continued His studies, going through various works with His vowmaster and others.  These texts included classics on the secret teachings of the Wheel of Time--the commentary known as The Immaculate, for example--as well as other tantric systems such as the Mahamaya and the Four Seats. Master Naropa then traveled on to the holy city of Pulahari, where He did much to spread the teachings, both by explaining them to others and by practicing them himself.  At this time too He began to gather a circle of disciples--an infinite number of monks who sought to follow Him.

gru.acip: ,,DANG PO DKA' PHRAN BCU GNYIS SPYAD TSUL NI, RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB LA SBYOR BA DANG , SNYING PO DON GYIS BSTAN PA SPEL PHYIR T'I LO'I SAR BSKUL BA NI, DPAL 'JIGS MED GRAGS PA SKU RGYAB NYI MA STAN NAS, SGRA TSAD LUNG RIGS KYI PHYAG DPE RNAMS LA GZIGS RTOGS MDZAD PA LAS, DUS NAM ZHIG TSE, PHYAG DPE'I STENGS SU GRIB MA 'JIGS SU RUNG BA CIG BYUNG NAS PHYIR GZIGS PAS,
gru.wylie: dang po dka' phran bcu gnyis spyad tshul ni, rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor ba dang , snying po don gyis bstan pa spel phyir tI lo'i sar bskul ba ni, dpal 'jigs med grags pa sku rgyab nyi ma stan nas, sgra tshad lung rigs kyi phyag dpe rnams la gzigs rtogs mdzad pa las, dus nam zhig tshe, phyag dpe'i stengs su grib ma 'jigs su rung ba cig byung nas phyir gzigs pas
gru.english: Here then is the first of these three:  The way in which Naropa underwent the twelve lesser tests.  We will see how the holy Angel of Diamond herself undertook to urge Naropa on to the place where He would meet Tilopa.  She did so in order to help Him attain the highest spiritual goal of all, surely; but even more importantly, She sought to achieve the higher purpose of helping these very teachings spread throughout our world. And so one day the glorious one, Fearless One of Fame, is sitting outside with His back to the sun, poring over some treatises on classical languages and the art of reasoning--in the form of both scriptural authority and pure logic.  Suddenly a dark and threatening shadow falls over the pages of His book; He whirls around and looks up, to see what it could be.

gru.acip: 'O NA DON SHES PA SU YOD GSUNGS PAS, DON NGA'I MING PO SHES ZER, KHYOD KYI MING PO GANG NAS YOD DE DANG NGA SPROD GSUNGS PA, KHYOD RANG SGRUB PA BGYIS LA GSOL BA THOB DANG MJAL DE 'ONG GIS 'JA' LTAR YAL SONG NGO ,,
gru.wylie: 'o na don shes pa su yod gsungs pas, don nga'i ming po shes zer, khyod kyi ming po gang nas yod de dang nga sprod gsungs pa, khyod rang sgrub pa bgyis la gsol ba thob dang mjal de 'ong gis 'ja' ltar yal song ngo
gru.english: "Well then," He sputters.  "If I don't understand their meaning, who does?" "My older brother knows their meaning," She answers. "Well where is this brother of yours?" He asks.  "I'd like to meet him." "You need to do a little bit of spiritual practice," She replies, "and make some proper prayers of supplication to him.  Then you'll be able to meet him."  With that, She simply disappears, like a rainbow melting into the sky.

gru.acip: DGOS THAMS CAD SDUG BSNGAL DU GYUR PA'I TSE, SHAR SGO'I PAn+dI TAS GSOL BA BTAB PA, MNYAM MED DPAL LDAN 'JIGS MED GRAGS, BSTAN RTZA DGE 'DUN SDE YIN PAS, SDE SPANGS CHOS MED BZHUGS SU GSOL, BDAG GIS 'DOD DON SGRUB TU GSO, ZHES ZHUS PAS, BKAS MA GNANG ,
gru.wylie: dgos thams cad sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i tshe, shar sgo'i paN+Di tas gsol ba btab pa, mnyam med dpal ldan 'jigs med grags, bstan rtsa dge 'dun sde yin pas, sde spangs chos med bzhugs su gsol, bdag gis 'dod don sgrub tu gso, zhes zhus pas, bkas ma gnang
gru.english: When it reaches a particular point where everyone is thrown into despair, the Sage of the East Gate addresses the following supplication to Master Naropa: The community of monks Is the very root Of the Buddhist teachings. Leave them, And you leave The Dharma itself. I call on you to remain; I call on you to gain your goals— Here. But Naropa refuses him.

gru.acip: ,RGYUD SDE RGYA MTSO LTA BU YI, ,SNYING PO'I BYIN BRLABS BDUD RTZI'I RGYUN, ,BLA MA'I BYIN BRLABS DNGOS GRUB KYIS, ,RANG RGYUD TSOGS PAR MA BYAS NA, ,RDZU 'PHRUL YON TAN MNGON SHES SOGS, ,DU MA YOD KYANG DON MI MTHONG ,
gru.wylie: rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu yi, ,snying po'i byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun, ,bla ma'i byin brlabs dngos grub kyis, ,rang rgyud tshogs par ma byas na, ,rdzu 'phrul yon tan mngon shes sogs, ,du ma yod kyang don mi mthong
gru.english: The blessing of the Lama Is the stream of deathless nectar, The blessed core of the ocean Of every secret teaching. If we cannot find this blessing To fill us with attainments Then perhaps we might achieve The strength to do some miracles; Some higher spiritual powers; The ability to read people's minds, Perceive past or future or such; But truthfully I can see No point in any of it.

gru.acip: ,NAM MKHA' NA SGRA GCIG NA RE, ,BDE MCHOG 'KHOR LO LA RTEN NA, ,BLA MA SANGS RGYAS LUNG BSTAN BYUNG , ZER BA DANG , N'A RO PAS, ,DENG NAS RTZAMS TE BDAG GNYID KYIS, ,BDE MCHOG LA RTEN CIS MI SGRUB, CES GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: nam mkha' na sgra gcig na re, ,bde mchog 'khor lo la rten na, ,bla ma sangs rgyas lung bstan byung , zer ba dang , nA ro pas, ,deng nas rtsams te bdag gnyid kyis, ,bde mchog la rten cis mi sgrub, ces gsungs te
gru.english: A voice then comes from the sky-- Surrender yourself To Highest Bliss, The Angel of Spheres; The Lama Buddha Foretold for you Will come then. Naropa raises His head to the sky and proclaims, From this moment on I surrender myself To the Angel of Highest Bliss; Now I can attain Anything.

gru.acip: SNGAR LTAR GDAMS NGAG ZHUS PA, NOR BU DE LA SPYAN G-YO MGUL MED PAR GZIGS SHING 'DUG PA, DE TSE 'DIR CHOS NYID KYI DON MTHONG BA PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB THOB PA LA, MOS GUS 'GYUR MED KYI MIG GIS, BLA MA'I MDZAD SPYOD THAMS CAD YON TAN DU SHES DGOS PAR GO ,T'I LO PA CI YANG MI GSUNG BA LA,
gru.wylie: sngar ltar gdams ngag zhus pa, nor bu de la spyan g-yo mgul med par gzigs shing 'dug pa, de tshe 'dir chos nyid kyi don mthong ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la, mos gus 'gyur med kyi mig gis, bla ma'i mdzad spyod thams cad yon tan du shes dgos par go ,tI lo pa ci yang mi gsung ba la
gru.english: They meet again, and Naropa once again requests the instructions.  Tilopa holds up the same jewel, and simply sits there, staring at it, His eyes moving not the slightest.  From this, Naropa understands that there is one thing that we must do if we have any hope of seeing ultimate reality in this very lifetime: if we want to attain the highest form of the Great Seal.  It is that we must--with eyes of unshakable faith and devotion--look upon every holy activity that our Lama ever undertakes, and see it as something infinitely good. Tilopa remains perfectly silent. 7] The Empowerment of Pure Water

gru.acip: GDAMS NGAG ZHUS PA, SHING THOG GCIG BSTAN BYUNG BAS, 'BRAS BU 'DUL BYA DUS LA BAB PA, RANG GZHAN GYI DON 'GRUB PA BRDA' RU GO ,BU LA BRDA DE RNAMS RE RES BZHIN GO 'Am GSUNG , GO LUGS RNAMS ZHUS STE,
gru.wylie: gdams ngag zhus pa, shing thog gcig bstan byung bas, 'bras bu 'dul bya dus la bab pa, rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa brda' ru go ,bu la brda de rnams re res bzhin go 'aM gsung , go lugs rnams zhus ste
gru.english: He returns and begs instruction.  Tilopa holds up a piece of fruit.  Naropa understands this as a message that--when the time comes that the disciple reaches the final fruit or goal--this allows both themselves and others to enjoy the taste of spiritual attainment. And then Tilopa says, "Have you, my child, understood each of these different silent messages?"  And then Naropa respectfully describes that He has understood. The Revelation of the Empowerments

gru.acip: N'A RO PAS GSOL BA, ,RANG SEMS NOR BU RIN PO CHE, ,BLA MA GRU GZINGS LA RTEN NAS, ,KHAMS GSUM 'KHOR BA'I RGYA MTSO LAS, ,DA LTA NYID DU GROL BA'I GDENG , ,SMIN LAM DON MTHONG RNAL 'BYOR BDE, ZHUS PAS,
gru.wylie: nA ro pas gsol ba, ,rang sems nor bu rin po che, ,bla ma gru gzings la rten nas, ,khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las, ,da lta nyid du grol ba'i gdeng , ,smin lam don mthong rnal 'byor bde, zhus pas
gru.english: And then He says to His Teacher, The precious jewel Of my own mind Boarded the ship-- My Lama-- And in this very moment I received guarantee That I would one day sail To the very end, To that far shore, Of the sea of the cycle of pain, These three realms of suffering. Ah, the bliss of the yoga Of seeing the meaning Of the path that ripens us!

gru.acip: CES MKHA' SPYOD ZHAL BZANG LTA BA'I SMON LAM DANG , RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS, BDAG DANG SEMS CAN THAMS CAD DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'KHRID PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, 'JIG RTEN DANG 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA STZAL TU GSOL, ZHES 'DOD DON LA GSOL BA GDAB CING TSOGS 'KHOR BYED NA 'DIR BYED DO,,
gru.wylie: ces mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam dang , rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas, bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol, 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol, zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing tshogs 'khor byed na 'dir byed do
gru.english: (Say then:) Holy Angel of Diamond, I ask that You take me And every other living being To the Heaven of Purity. Grant us every one of our goals; Those of the world, And those Beyond the World. (Request thus all that you may wish.  If you will be performing the Circle of Gathering, do so at this point.)

gru.acip: ZHES GSUNGS SO,, ZHES PA 'DI NI RJE BTZUN BLA MA DE NYID KYIS RNAL 'BYOR MA'I CHO GA 'DI PAR DU 'KHOD ZIN PA MA GTOGS, DA LTA'I LAG LEN LTAR BSGRIGS NA BLO RMONGS LA PHAN CHE BAR 'DUG ,CES GSUNGS PA'I DGONGS PA BSGRUB PHYIR ME 'BRUG LO PAR GSAR RKO BYED SKABS DBYANGS CAN GRUB PA'I RDO RJES BSGRIGS PA'O,,
