gru.english: (The Holy One, our Very Lama who composed it, said of His ritual text for the Angel of Diamond, "But for the fact that it's already been carved into blocks, it would have been a great benefit to the dull-witted if we had arranged it more in keeping with current custom."  And so to fulfill the wishes so stated by our Lama, the above has been compiled by myself, Yangchen Druppay Dorje, on the occasion of the carving of new blocks, in the Fire Dragon Year [1856].)

gru.acip: AE MA HO, KHAMS GSUM GYI BLA MA DUS GSUM GYI SANGS RGYAS 'GRO BA'I DPAL MGON DAM PA, DPAL N'A RO PA CHEN PO'I RNAM THAR DANG , YON TAN GYI MDZAD PA MTHA' DAG NI BRJOD PAR GA LA NUS, 'ON KYANG SKU TSE 'DI LA PHYI THOS BSAM GYI 'O NAS BSTAN PA DAR RGYAS SU MDZAD CING , NANG GSANG SNGAGS KYIS LAM DANG SNYING PO'I DON LA DKA' SPYAD BRTZON 'GRUS DRAG POS BLA MA MNYES PAR BYAS STE,
gru.wylie: ae ma ho, khams gsum gyi bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa, dpal nA ro pa chen po'i rnam thar dang , yon tan gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag ni brjod par ga la nus, 'on kyang sku tshe 'di la phyi thos bsam gyi 'o nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad cing , nang gsang sngags kyis lam dang snying po'i don la dka' spyad brtson 'grus drag pos bla ma mnyes par byas ste
gru.english: Eh-ma-ho!  And so we begin. Now of course it would be entirely impossible for one such as myself to describe, in their entirety, the high qualities and sacred deeds--the holy life--of the great and glorious Naropa, that shining protector of every living creature, himself every Buddha of the past and present and future, in all three realms of existence.  Nonetheless I shall attempt this task, in order to please my Lamas, putting forth every ounce of effort that I possess. In the outer world, I hope that by doing so I may contribute to the spread of the teachings--to see people learn them, and contemplate their meaning.  In the world within myself, I undertake this daunting work as part of my practice of the way of the secret word, to reach that essential heart.

gru.acip: TSE 'DIR MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB BRNYED PA'I RNAM THAR LA GSUM, SKU BLTAMS TE NGO MTSAR MTSAN DPE DANG LDAN TSUL, 'KHOR BA LA YID PHYUNG STE BSTAN PA SPYI LA ZHUGS TSUL, KHYAD PAR SNGAGS KYI 'O RU ZHUGS NAS DKA' BA SPYAD TSUL LO,
gru.wylie: tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub brnyed pa'i rnam thar la gsum, sku bltams te ngo mtshar mtshan dpe dang ldan tshul, 'khor ba la yid phyung ste bstan pa spyi la zhugs tshul, khyad par sngags kyi 'o ru zhugs nas dka' ba spyad tshul lo
gru.english: Now there are three parts to the story of this holy being--of how He reached the highest goal of the spirit within a single life.  The first is the account of how he deigned to take His birth, an event accompanied by miraculous signs in the outer world, and special marks upon His own body. The second part covers how He gained despair over this life of suffering, and thus entered the teachings of the Buddha in general.  The third and final part relates the way in which, more especially, He gained the doorway of the secret way, and the hardships He underwent upon this path. The Land of His Birth

gru.acip: RTEN 'BREL CI BYAS KYANG MA 'BYUNG BA'I TSE, DBEN GNAS CIG NAS, DGE BA'I SHES GNYEN GRAGS PA'I BLO GROS ZHES BYA BA MNGON SHES DANG LDAN PA CIG YOD PA DE NYID GDAN DRANGS, DE LA MNGON SHES KYIS BRTAG PA ZHUS PAS, SKYABS BLO BTANG BYAS PA'I MI SLU BA DKON MCHOG YIN PAS, BSAM PA BZANG PO DANG LDAN PA JI BZHIN PA'I NGANG NAS, BYANG CHUB KYI MCHOG TU THUGS BSKYED LA, BLA MA DKON MCHOG YI DAM MKHA' 'GRO LA MCHOD PA GYA NOM PA BSHAMS TE, MOS GUS BCOS MA MA YIN PA'I 'O NAS GSOL BA RGYUN DU THOB DANG , KHYED RANG JI LTAR 'DOD PA'I DON 'GRUB PA GDA' YIS GSUNG NAS, LUNG BSTAN TE RANG GNAS SU GSHEGS SO,
gru.wylie: rten 'brel ci byas kyang ma 'byung ba'i tshe, dben gnas cig nas, dge ba'i shes gnyen grags pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba mngon shes dang ldan pa cig yod pa de nyid gdan drangs, de la mngon shes kyis brtag pa zhus pas, skyabs blo btang byas pa'i mi slu ba dkon mchog yin pas, bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pa ji bzhin pa'i ngang nas, byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed la, bla ma dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro la mchod pa gya nom pa bshams te, mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i 'o nas gsol ba rgyun du thob dang , khyed rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa gda' yis gsung nas, lung bstan te rang gnas su gshegs so
gru.english: No good thing that they could do to achieve this goal seemed to work.  And so they invited to the palace a certain spiritual guide named Renowned Intelligence--a sage who had been living in the wild and who possessed the gift of clairvoyance. They asked this wise one, "Can you use your powers of inner sight to see what we must do?" He replied, "The Three Jewels are the one thing that--if you truly put your hopes in them--will never fail you.  And so first you must give birth within your hearts to the Wish for highest enlightenment, keeping the very most pure motivation that you can. "Then set forth exquisite offering to the Lamas, the Three Jewels, the Close Angels, and the Angels of the Sky.  Ask Them for Their help, with genuine faith and devotion; and do so again and again.  All your wishes will be fulfilled." This prophecy did the sage give to them, and then returned to the wild.

gru.english: dak sok nam kyang kyu kyi leksung dun mije nying gi chu du tak ten ne tsulshin druppay dresang ngungyur te kamsum druppay lama chokdrup shok And may I and othersNever forgetThe meaning of Your excellent words;May we ever followAnd keep them inThe heart inside our hearts;And may our practiceAs You've taughtLead us to those finest fruits;May we become in the endA Lama supreme, for beingsOf all of the three realms.

gru.english: lume gyalwa seche jinlab dang nangtong gelme chuying tendrel top dakchak tsechik mupay dentu yi jitar munpay dun di hlundrup shok By the blessingsOf the Victors and their Sons,Which cannot ever fail;By the power of DependenceWith the Sphere of Reality:That Appearances and EmptinessCannot be incompatible;And by the might of truth,Of the single-pointed wishThat we all make,May what we pray forIn these wordsCome instantly to pass.

gru.acip: BOD SKAD DU, RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SGRUB THABS,
gru.wylie: bod skad du, rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs
gru.english: In the language of Tibet, it is known as Dorje Neljormay Druptap: A Practice for Reaching the Angel of Diamond.

gru.acip: GSUNG NAS PHYAG GIS BYIL MDZAD PAS, LUS SNGA MA LTAR SOS PA DANG , KHO BOS AU RGYAN DU YE SHES MKHA' 'GRO LA DNGOS SU THOB PA'I GDAMS PA THUN MONG YID BZHIN NOR BU 'DI DAG YIN GSUNG , YUM LHAN CIG SKYES MA'I SGRUB THABS LA SOGS STE, RGYAL PO CHOS NYID MI 'GYUR BA, BLON PO RIGS GSUM LAS BYED, DMANGS 'PHRIN LAS MTHUN SBYOR GYI GDAMS NGAG RNAMS TSANG BAR GNANG NGO ,
gru.wylie: gsung nas phyag gis byil mdzad pas, lus snga ma ltar sos pa dang , kho bos au rgyan du ye shes mkha' 'gro la dngos su thob pa'i gdams pa thun mong yid bzhin nor bu 'di dag yin gsung , yum lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thabs la sogs ste, rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba, blon po rigs gsum las byed, dmangs 'phrin las mthun sbyor gyi gdams ngag rnams tshang bar gnang ngo
gru.english: Tilopa gently caresses His disciple's broken body, healing it back to the way it was before.  And then He says to him, "This then is the wishing jewel which is shared: the instructions for you to actually travel to the paradise of Uddiyana, and reach there the Angels of Wisdom." And so He grants Naropa, in their entirety, secret teachings such as the practice for reaching the enlightened partner named the Lady of the Simultaneous.  These He gives in three parts: the Teaching on the Immutable Reality, which is like the king; the Rites of the Three Families, which is like the minister; and the Advices on the Holy Deeds of Joining, which is like the people of the kingdom. The Second Trial: The Test of Fire, to Equanimity

gru.acip: , ,RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD KYI SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM ZHES BYA BA BZHUGS SO,,
gru.wylie: ,rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so
gru.english: Herein Contained is the Short Path to Great Bliss, a Unique Method for Becoming The Holy Angel of Diamond, and for Reaching The Heaven of Naropa

gru.acip: ,NYER BZHI'I YUL NA SKAL LDAN RJES GZUNG PHYIR, ,MA NGES RNAM 'GYUR DU MA'I MIG 'PHRUL MKHAN, ,ZHING SNGAGS LHAN CIG SKYES PA'I MKHA' 'GROS KYANG, ,BRTZE BAS RJES GZUNG 'DOD PA'I DNGOS GRUB STZOL,
gru.wylie: nyer bzhi'i yul na skal ldan rjes gzung phyir, ,ma nges rnam 'gyur du ma'i mig 'phrul mkhan, ,zhing sngags lhan cig skyes pa'i mkha' 'gros kyang, ,brtse bas rjes gzung 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol
gru.english: Angels of the holy places, Of the secret word, Of the simultaneous, Masters of the holy mirage, Taking a thousand Unexpected forms To lead the good and fortunate To the twenty-four sacred lands, You too I pray In your love, Take me after You, Grant me the attainments I desire.

gru.acip: 'PHAGS PA'I YUL DU PAn GRUB KUN GYI GTZUG GI NOR BUR GYUR PA JO BO N'A RO TA PAS, RJE BTZUN MA'I ZHAL MNGON SUM DU GZIGS TE GDAMS PA RNAMS MA NOS NAS LEGS PAR BKRAL ZHING,
gru.wylie: 'phags pa'i yul du paN grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa jo bo nA ro ta pas, rje btsun ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs te gdams pa rnams ma nos nas legs par bkral zhing
gru.english: The instruction was elucidated by Lord Naropa, a crowning jewel who stood above all the sages and saints of India, the Land of the Realized.  He himself received it as a personal teaching from the Holy One, when he met Her face to face.

gru.acip: N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DU GRAGS PA RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA LTAR NYAMS SU LEN PA'I TSUL LAG TU BLANG BDE BAR 'GOD PA LA,
gru.wylie: nA ro mkha' spyod du grags pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul lag tu blang bde bar 'god pa la
gru.english: Here I will set forth a practice which follows this unique method for becoming the Holy Angel of Diamond, and which is easily carried out.

gru.acip: MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR DAG GSAL GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES KYI RANG SNANG LAS GRUB PA'I GZHAL YAS KHANG GRU BZHI SGO BZHI RGYAN RTA BABS DANG BCAS PA MTSAN NYID THAMS CAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PA'I DBUS SU SENG+GE CHEN PO BRGYAD KYIS BTEG PA'I RIN PO CHE'I KHRI SNA TSOGS PADMA ZLA BA NYI MA'I GDAN GYI STENG DU DRIN CAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA DE NYID SANGS RGYAS RDO RJE CHOS KYI RNAM PA CAN SKU MDOG DMAR PO ZHAL GCIG PHYAG GNYIS KYIS RDO RJE DANG DRIL BU THUGS KAR BSNOL NAS 'DZIN PA,
gru.wylie: mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng+ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa
gru.english: dun gyi namkar dak sel nyisu-mepay yeshe kyi rang nang le druppay shel ye gang dru shi go shi gyen ta bap dang chepa tsennyi tamche yong su dzokpay usu sengge chenpo gye kyi tekpay rinpochey tri natsok pedma dawa nyimay den gyi teng du drinchen tsaway lama denyi sanggye dorje chu kyi nampa chen kundok marpo shel chik chak nyi dorje dang drilbu tukkar nul ne dzinpa In the air in front of me Appears a palace, An expression of the wisdom Of pureness and clarity Become one. It is four-sided And fully replete With four different gates, Adornments and stepways. At its center Is a jeweled throne On the backs of Eight great lions. On the throne are cushions Of the multicolor lotus, A moon and sun. Upon these sit My kind root Lama, the One, In the form of Dharma of Diamond. His holy body is red, He has one head And two arms; In His hands He holds The diamond and bell, Crossed before His breast.

whole_word_matches.context: i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid

gru.english: drumo yun na kadamga, shab dorjey kyiltrung gi shukpa, rupay gyen druk gi gyen ching, shunnu langtso dar la bepa In the crook of their left arm They carry a khatvanga staff, And They sit cross-legged In the posture of diamond. They wear the six Adornments of bone, And their age is that Of a young adult.

gru.acip: ,SGRIB BRAL LHAN SKYES BDE BA'I YE SHES CHE, ,CHOS KUN RANG BZHIN SPROS DANG BRAL BA'I DBYINGS, ,DBYER MED LHUN GRUB SMRA BSAM BRJOD, LAS 'DAS, ,DON DAM BYANG CHUB SEMS MCHOG KHYOD LA 'BUL,
gru.wylie: sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes che, ,chos kun rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i dbyings, ,dbyer med lhun grub smra bsam brjod, las 'das, ,don dam byang chub sems mchog khyod la 'bul
gru.english: dripdrel hlenkye dewar yeshe che chukun rangshin trudang drelway ying yerme hlundrup masam julen de dundam jangchub semchok kyula bul I offer to You The highest form of mind, The ultimate Wish for Enlightenment: Great wisdom Of simultaneous bliss, Free of every obstacle; The Sphere Of every single thing Free of any Projection of truth; The Indivisible, The Spontaneous, That which is Beyond All thoughts to imagine, All words to describe.

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,‘GRO BA’I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS GZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG BSHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID ‘ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,’DRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS ‘GRUB PAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,‘gro ba’i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang bshan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid ‘ong spyad par bgyi, ,’dro la phan phyir sangs rgyas ‘grub par shog
gru.english: sanggye chudang tsokchok la jangchub bardu dakkyap chi rangshen dunni rabdrup chir jangchub semni kyepar gyi kunchok sumla dakkyap chi drikpa tamche sosor shak droway gela jeyi rang sanggye jangchub yikyi sung jangchub chokgi semni kyegyi ne semchen tamche dakgi drundu nyer jangchub chuchok yi-ong chepar gyi drola penchir sanggye druppar shok

gru.acip: ,DNGOS GRUB 'BYUNG GNAS BRGYUD PA'I BLA MA LA, ,DAM RDZAS BDUD RTZI 'BUL LO MNYES GYUR CIG ,AOm A'A:H'Um,
gru.wylie: dngos grub 'byung gnas brgyud pa'i bla ma la, ,dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bul lo mnyes gyur cig ,aoM a'a:hUM
gru.english: ngudrup jungne lama la damdze dutsi bullo nyegyur chik om ah hung (Continue with:) I offer this nectar of holy substance To my lineage Lamas: You are the source from which Every attainment comes. I pray that You are pleased. Om ah hung.

gru.acip: ,GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG NA BZA' BRAG PHUG PA, ,GRUB MCHOG MKHAS PA'I DED DPON CHOS KYI RJE, ,GRUB RIGS SNYAN RGYUD MNGA' BDAG YAR LUNG PAR, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: grub pa'i dbang phyug na bza' brag phug pa, ,grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje, ,grub rigs snyan rgyud mnga' bdag yar lung par, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: druppay wangchuk nasa drakpukpa drup chok kepay depun chukyi je druprik nyengyu ngadak yarlungpar sulwan debso hlenkye yeshe tsul I make supplication At the feet Of Drakpukpa, Of the land of Nasa, Lord of saints; At the feet Of Chukyi Je, Captain of masters And highest saints; And at the feet Of Yarlungpa, Owner of the spoken tradition Of the line of saints; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: ,BKA' DRIN MNYAM MED RJE BTZUN RDO RING BA, ,BKA' BZHAN SGRUB PA'I BSTAN 'DZIN BLO GSAL DBANG, ,BKA' RGYUD GSANG CHEN SMRA BA MKHYEN BRTZE'I ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo ring ba, ,bka' bzhan sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang, ,bka' rgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: kadrin nyamme jetsun doringpa kashin druppay tendzin losel wang kagyu sangchen mawa kyentsey shab sulwan debso hlenkye yeshe tsul I make supplication At the feet Of Doringwa, The Venered One, Kind beyond all words; At the feet Of Losel Wang, Keeper of the Teachings And of his Lama's word; And at the feet Of Kyentse, Proclaiming the Great Secret In the Lineage of the Word; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: ,RDO RJE GO ‘PHANG ‘GRUBS PA’I NYE LAM MCHOG, ,RDO RJE BTZUN MO’I SMIN SGRON DAM PA’I MDZOD, ,RDO RJE ‘DZIN PA BLO BZANG YE SHE LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: rdo rje go ‘phang ‘grubs pa’i nye lam mchog, ,rdo rje btsun mo’i smin sgron dam pa’i mdzod, ,rdo rje ‘dzin pa blo bzang ye she la, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: dorje gopang druppay nyelam chok dorje tsunmoy mindrul dampay dzu dorje dzinpa lobsang yeshe la sulwan debso hlenkye yeshe tsul I make supplication At the feet Of Lobsang Yeshe, The Holder of the Diamond; Supreme short path To reach The state of the Diamond; Treasure house Of holy instructions That make us ripe, And make us free, The Word of the Angel of Diamond; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU AA LAS ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DKAR LA DMAR BA'I MDANGS CAN GYI STENG DU,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las ae ae las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du aa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi steng du
gru.english: tongpay nang le eh eh le chunjung marpo dru sum nyi tsek kyi nang du ah le daway kyilnkor kar la marway dang chen gyi teng du From a state of emptiness Come the letters eh and eh, And from them a dharma star. The star is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together. Inside is a disk, The moon, Come from the letter ah. It is colored a mix Of red and white, And upon it rest These secret words, Circling to the left:

gru.acip: DE'I NANG DU GTUM DRAG LA SOGS PA'I DUR KHROD CHEN PO BRGYAD KYIS BSKOR BA'I DBUS SU CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI GDENGS KA CHE BA GYEN DU PHYOGS SHING, RTZE MO PHRA BA THUR DU ZUG PA,
gru.wylie: de'i nang du gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing, rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa
gru.english: dey nang du tum drak la sokpay dur tru chenpo gye kyi korway u-su chunjung marpo dru sum nyi tsek kyi deng ka chewa gyen du chok shing, tsemo trawa trawa tur du sukpa Inside the walls Are Savage Wrath and the rest Of the eight great burial grounds. They surround a dharma star, Set in the center; It is red, and made Of two triangular sections Stacked together. The wide part of the star Faces upward, And its sharp point Is stuck down in the ground.

gru.acip: RANG GI SNYING GAR CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU BAm YIG LA SNGAGS PHRENG GIS BSKOR BA LAS 'OD ZER 'PHROS TE, BA SBU'I BU GNAS PHAR SONG, RIGS DRUG GI SEMS CAN THAMS CAD LA PHOG PAS SDIG SGRIB BAG CHAGS DANG BCAS PA SBYANGS, DE THAMS CAD RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SKUR GYUR,
gru.wylie: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su baM yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros te, ba sbu'i bu gnas phar song, rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs, de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur
gru.english: rang gi nyingkar chunjung marpo dru sum nyi tsek kyi nang du daway kyilnkor gyi u-su yik la ngaktreng gi korwa le u-ser tru te, babuy bu ka ne par song, rik druk gi semchen tamche la pokpe, dikdrip bakchak dang cheap jung, de tamche dorje nelnjormay kur gyur In my heart is a dharma star, It is red, made of two Triangular parts stacked together. Inside the star is a moondisk, And in the center of the disk Is a letter bam, surrounded by A string of secret words. Light goes forth from them And leaves from the pores of my skin; It flies and strikes Every living being Of all of the six kinds. The light cleans them Of their wrong deeds and obstacles, Along with the seeds for these. They all turn into The Angel of the Diamond.

whole_word_matches.context: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi

gru.acip: 'KHOR LO'I SHUGS CAN MA, DU MA SKYES MA, CHANG TSONG MA, 'KHOR LO'I GO CHA MA, SHIN TU DPA' MO, STOBS CHEN MA, 'KHOR LOS SGYUR MA, BRTZON 'GRUS CHEN MO STE SKU'I RIGS KYI DPA' MO BRGYAD RNAMS SU GYUR PA,
gru.wylie: 'khor lo'i shugs can ma, du ma skyes ma, chang tshong ma, 'khor lo'i go cha ma, shin tu dpa' mo, stobs chen ma, 'khor los sgyur ma, brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i rigs kyi dpa' mo brgyad rnams su gyur pa
gru.english: korloy shukchenma, dumkyema, changtsongma, korloy gochama, shintu pamo, topchenma, korlu gyurma, tsundru chenmo te kuy rik kyi pamo gye nam su gyurpa Eight are the ones Related to body: The Lady with Strength of Wheel, The Lady of The Night, The Lady of the Tavern, The Lady with Armor of Wheel, The Lady of Valor, The Lady of Might, The Empress of the Wheel, The Lady of Effort.

gru.acip: RANG GI SNYING GAR CHOS 'BYUNG DMAR PO GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS KYI NANG DU ZLA BA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU BAm YIG LA SNGAGS PHRER KHA DOG DMAR POS GA-YON SKOR DU BSKOR BA LAS 'OD ZER DMAR PO DPAG MED 'PHROS, SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI SDIG SGRIB SBYANGS, SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD MCHOD,
gru.wylie: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su baM yig la sngags phrer kha dog dmar pos ga-yon skor du bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po dpag med 'phros, sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs, sangs rgyas thams cad mchod
gru.english: At my heart Is a dharma star; It is red, with two Triangular sections Stacked together. Inside the star Is a moondisk, And at the center of the disk Is a letter bam, Surrounded by the secret words; They are red, And they circle to the left. From them all shine forth Red rays of light, Too many to count. The rays clean away The wrong deeds and obstacles Of every living being, And make offerings To every Buddha there is.

whole_word_matches.context: rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi

gru.acip: BDAG GIS JI LTAR BTZAL YANG 'PHAGS MA KHYOD, , BDEN PAR GRUB PA'I NGES PA MA RNYED NAS, , SPROS PAS DUB PA'I SEMS KYI GZHON NU DE, , BRJOD BRAL NAGS KYI KHANG BUR NGAL GSO BSTEN, ,
gru.wylie: bdag gis ji ltar btsal yang 'phags ma khyod, , bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas, , spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon nu de, , brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso bsten,
gru.english: No matter how I seek, My Lady of Realization, I cannot find in You Anything that is truly real; So take this Child's mind of mine, Exhausted by Projections, And let it rest In the quiet forest home Of the thing that words Cannot express.

gru.acip: AE MA DA NI d'A KI DBYINGS NAS BZHENGS, , HE RU KA DPAL RGYUD KYI RGYAL PO LAS, , RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I NYE BA'I SNYING PO MCHOG , BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB CES GSUNGS PA'I BDEN PAS SKYONGS, ,
gru.wylie: ae ma da ni DA ki dbyings nas bzhengs, , he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las, , rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog , bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs,
gru.english: Eh-Ma, Rise now from The Realm of Dakis, Save me, for I swear By the might of Truth; By the words Spoken in The King of Secret Tomes, The Book of the Glorious Heruka: "Those will reach Who only say The highest Secret Words, The Words of Closest Essence, The Words of the Diamond Queen."

gru.acip: AOO dI BI SHA'I BAS MTHA'I NAGS KHROD DU, , GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG RDO RJE DRIL BU PA, , 'KHYUD DANG TZUM BHA'I BDE BAS RJES BSKYANGS TE, , KHA SBYOR MCHOG GIS ROL BZHIN BDAG KYANG SKYONGS,
gru.wylie: aoo Di bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du, , grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa, , 'khyud dang tsum bha'i bde bas rjes bskyangs te, , kha sbyor mchog gis rol bzhin bdag kyang skyongs
gru.english: Within the forest Whose end is Otibishu, There lived Drilbupa, Lord of all the Saints; And You saved him With the bliss Of Your embrace and tzumba, With the play Of the ultimate Kiss; I ask, save me the same.

gru.acip: (CES MKHA' SPYOD ZHAL BZANG LTA BA'I SMON LAM DANG,) RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS, BDAG DANG SEMS CAN THAMS CAD DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'KHRID PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, 'JIG RTEN DANG 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA STZAL DU GSOL, (ZHES 'DOD DON LA GSOL BA GDAB CING TSOGS 'KHOR BYED NA 'DIR BYED DO, ,DE NAS,)
gru.wylie: (ces mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam dang,) rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas, bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol, 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol, (zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing tshogs 'khor byed na 'dir byed do, ,de nas,)
gru.english: (Say then:) Holy Angel of Diamond, I ask that You take me And every other living being To the Heaven of Purity. Grant us every one of our goals; Those of the world, And those Beyond the World. (Request thus all that you may wish.  If you will be performing the Circle of Gathering, do so at this point.  Then continue with:)

gru.acip: YONGS 'DU'I TSAL DANG GSHIN RJE'I PHO BRANG DANG, , 'DZAM GLING DE W'I KO tI'I GNAS MCHOG NAS, , 'DOD KHAMS GTZO MO NAM GRU RE MA T'I, , DPAL LDAN LHA MO 'DIR BYON MCHOD GTOR BZHES, ,
gru.wylie: yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang, , 'dzam gling de wI ko Ti'i gnas mchog nas, , 'dod khams gtso mo nam gru re ma tI, , dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes,
gru.english: Come, Queen of the desire realm, Ship in the Sky, Remati, From the sacred places: The Garden of The Meeting Tree, The Palace of the Lord of Death, And Dewikoti Of the Dzambu Continent; Angel of Glory, Come, partake Of the torma offerings.

whole_word_matches.context: de wI ko Ti'i gnas mchog nas, , 'dod khams gtso mo nam gru re ma tI, , dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhe

gru.acip: GSOL LO MCHOD DO RGYAL BA'I BSTAN SRUNG TSOGS, , BSGRUBS SO BSTEN NO BLA MA'I BKA' SRUNG CHE, , 'BOD DO BSKUL LO RNAL 'BYOR DGRA LHA'I TSOGS, , RINGS PA'I TSUL GYIS 'DIR BYON MCHOD GTOR BZHES, ,
gru.wylie: gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs, , bsgrubs so bsten no bla ma'i bka' srung che, , 'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha'i tshogs, , rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes,
gru.english: I ask I offer Gathering of Protectors Of Teachings of the Victors; I reach I come Great Protectors Of the Lama's Word; I call I urge The Angels against enemies Of those who try to practice; Make haste, Come, partake, Of the torma offerings.

gru.acip: SANGS RGYAS BSTAN PA GNYAN PO KHYED KYIS SRUNGS, , DKON MCHOG DBU 'PHANG GNYAN PO KHYED KYIS STOD, , DPAL LDAN BLA MA'I 'PHRIN LAS KHYED KYIS SPEL, , RNAL 'BYOR BCOL BA'I 'DOD DON KHYED KYIS SGRUBS, ,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po khyed kyis srungs, , dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po khyed kyis stod, , dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las khyed kyis spel, , rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'dod don khyed kyis sgrubs,
gru.english: Protect The uncompromising Teaching of the Buddhas; Praise The uncompromising Eminence of the Jewels; Spread The great works Of the glorious Lamas; Accomplish The goals that we practitioners Have entrusted to You.

gru.acip: (SMON LAM NI,) DGE BA 'DI YIS MYUR DU BDAG , MKHA' SPYOD MA DNGOS 'GRUB GYUR NAS; ; 'GRO BA GCIG KYANG MA LUS PA, , DE YI SA LA 'GOD PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: (smon lam ni,) dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag , mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas; ; 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa, , de yi sa la 'god par shog
gru.english: (Next is the Concluding Prayer:) By this good deed May I quickly attain The Angel of Paradise; May I lead beings To Her place, Leaving behind not even one.

gru.acip: ,DE LTAR RGYAL YUM MKHA' SPYOD DBANG MO YI, ,SMIN GROL LAM BZANG TSUL BZHIN BSGOM PA 'I MTHUS, ,DNGOS GRUB 'BYUNG GNAS MTSAN LDAN BLA MA YIS, ,DGYES BZHIN 'BRAL MED RJES SU 'DZIN PAR SHOG
gru.wylie: de ltar rgyal yum mkha' spyod dbang mo yi, ,smin grol lam bzang tshul bzhin bsgom pa 'i mthus, ,dngos grub 'byung gnas mtshan ldan bla ma yis, ,dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog
gru.english: (When there is time you can, if you like, recite the following prayer, which was composed by the Holder of the Diamond from Tsarpa:) Thus have I practiced And properly, The good paths of ripening And liberation Taught us by the Queen Of the Angel's Heaven, Woman of all the Victors; And I pray that by The power of this deed May I be taken Under the care Of a Lama who possesses Every qualification, for these Are the true source Of every spiritual goal. And may I always please My Lama And never be apart From Him or Her.

gru.acip: ,DAL 'BYOR GRU CHEN MI RTAG DRAN PA YI, ,BA DAN DKAR PO BSKYOD PA LAS 'BRAS KYI, ,BLANG DOR MTHUN PA'I RLUNG GIS RAB BSKUL NAS, ,'JIGS RUNG 'KHOR BA'I MTSO LAS SGROL BAR SHOG
gru.wylie: dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las 'bras kyi, ,blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas, ,'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog
gru.english: And by the power Of this deed May I board the good ship Of spiritual leisure and fortune; May I set the white sails Of constantly remembering My own impermanence, And thus see the ship stir forth; May the fair winds Of my careful observation Of the laws of karma And its consequences Then fill the sails And drive us all Across the terror of this sea, The cycle of pain we live in.

whole_word_matches.context: dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las

gru.acip: ,SINDHUR LANG+GA LI YI SDONG BUR BCAS, , ,RO LDAN GNAS SU BSGRUBS SHING YUL KUN TU, , ,MYUL BAS GANG GI MDZOD SPUR 'KHYIL RIS CAN, , ,'PHOS PA'I MDZES MAS MKHA' SPYOD 'KHRID PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: sindhur lang+ga li yi sdong bur bcas, , ,ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu, , ,myul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can, , ,'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog
gru.english: And by this power May I use the sindhura And the trunk of langali To practice in The home of the dead And then go wandering off To places far and near; And when I meet the One Where the drawing of the swirl Moves off to the spot In between Her brows, May the Lovely One Lead me off To the Heaven of the Angel

gru.acip: ,RMAD BYUNG SRAS BCAS RGYAL BA'I BYIN RLABS DANG, , ,RTEN 'BREL BSLU BA MED PA'I BDEN PA DANG, , ,BDAG GI LHAG BSAM DAG PA'I MTHU STOBS KYIS, , ,RNAM DAG SMON PA'I GNAS KUN 'GRUB PAR SHOG , (CES TSAR PA RDO RJE 'CHANG GIS MDZAD PA'I SMON LAM 'DON,)
gru.wylie: rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang, , ,rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang, , ,bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis, , ,rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub par shog , (ces tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i smon lam 'don,)
gru.english: By the blessings of The wondrous Victors and Their daughters and their sons; By the truth of the fact That dependent origination Cannot ever fail; And by the mystic power Of my pure willingness To free all beings myself, May all that I have Prayed here for So purely come to pass.

gru.acip: SNA TSOGS ZHING DU SNA TSOGS GZUGS SKU YIS, , SNA TSOGS THABS KYIS SNA TSOGS GDUL BYA'I DON, , SNA TSOGS BSAM PA JI BZHIN SGRUB MDZAD MA,, ZHING SKYES SPRUL PA'I SKU YI BKRA SHIS SHOG ,
gru.wylie: sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis, , sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don, , sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma,, zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog
gru.english: May we have the joyful fortune Of the Emanation Body Born of the holy places; The One who goes To different places In different physical Bodies And uses different Skilful means In order to fulfil The different wishes In the heart Of every different disciple.

gru.acip: GANG GI RNAM SPRUL GRANGS MED BYE BA PHRAG , STONG PHRAG BDUN CU RTZA GNYIS TSOGS RNAMS KYIS, , SGRUB PA PO YI BAR CHAD KUN SEL CING, , 'DOD DON DNGOS GRUB STZOL BA'I BKRA SHIS SHOG
gru.wylie: gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag , stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis, , sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel cing, , 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog
gru.english: May we have the joyful fortune Of Her granting us All wishes and attainments, Coming in two And seventy thousand Groups of emanations, Bodies of Her Sent from Her In millions without count; Sent to clear The obstacles Of all who try to reach Her.

gru.acip: NYI ZLA'I LAM DU RNAM PAR GA-YO BA'I KHAMS, , SGRA GCAN MAL DU SAD PA'I GNYUG MA'I DBYINGS, , BDE CHEN ROL PAR SHAR BA'I DGA' STON LA, , SPYOD PA'I GDAMS ZANG BDUD RTZI'I GTER DU BSGRUBS,
gru.wylie: nyi zla'i lam du rnam par ga-yo ba'i khams, , sgra gcan mal du sad pa'i gnyug ma'i dbyings, , bde chen rol par shar ba'i dga' ston la, , spyod pa'i gdams zang bdud rtsi'i gter du bsgrubs
gru.english: Find in here A treasure of nectar, Profound advices on flying To the Place That travels on the paths Of the sun and moon; To the Sphere Of the Is that awakens In the path of the planet Rahula; And to the Party, Where Greatest Bliss Appears to you, and plays.

gru.acip: (DE LTAR RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD KYI SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM ZHES BYA BA 'DI NI LAM 'DI NYAMS SU LEN PA'I RNAL 'BYOR BA DAG GI RGYUN GYI RNAL 'BYOR DANG, MTSAMS BSNYEN SOGS KYI SKABS NYAMS SU LEN BDE BA'I RIM PA KHO NAR SGRIGS KYI, DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD DANG 'BREL BA'I SKABS DKYIL CHOG DANG SBRAGS NAS NYAMS SU LEN TSUL GYI KHYAD PAR PHYED PAR BYA'O, ,)
gru.wylie: (de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam zhes bya ba 'di ni lam 'di nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor ba dag gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang, mtshams bsnyen sogs kyi skabs nyams su len bde ba'i rim pa kho nar sgrigs kyi, dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i skabs dkyil chog dang sbrags nas nyams su len tshul gyi khyad par phyed par bya'o, ,)
gru.english: (This then is the Short Path to Great Bliss, a Unique Method for Becoming the Holy Angel of the Diamond, and Reaching the Heaven of Naropa.  I have written it only to provide some steps that are easy to carry out during those occasions when persons who usually follow this path perform their regular practice, or when they do a retreat or similar activity.  You should however draw a distinction between this and the method of practice connected to the Ritual for the Secret World, which is to be carried out on occasions that relate to the Offering to Reach the Secret World.)

gru.acip: CHAGS BRAL RLUNG SEMS DBU MAR BSDU BSGOM ZUNG, , BSGOM PAR BDE BA DANG NI STONG PA SGRUB, , GSUM PA 'BRAS BU YAN LAG BDUN LDAN THOB, , BSAM MI KHYAB BYA MJUG SDUD TSAR CHOS STON,,
gru.wylie: chags bral rlung sems dbu mar bsdu bsgom zung, , bsgom par bde ba dang ni stong pa sgrub, , gsum pa 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan thob, , bsam mi khyab bya mjug sdud tshar chos ston
gru.english: That free of desire Is a pair, to gather wind and mind Into the central one, and meditate. For the meditation Attain bliss And voidness. The third is to achieve The result that has Seven parts. Do the Inconceivable, Present a summary, And then the final teaching.

gru.acip: ,DMAN PA'I YUL LAS RAB 'DAS SHING, ,RGYAL BA KUN GYI DAM TSIG MCHOG ,DNGOS GRUB KUN GYI GZHIR GYUR PA, ,BDUD RTZI MCHOG GIS MCHOD PAR BGYIS,
gru.wylie: dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing, ,rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog ,dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa, ,bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyis
gru.english: We make offering With this highest nectar; It is far beyond Any normal substance; It is the supreme Pledge of all the Victors; It is the foundation Of every accomplishment.

gru.acip: ,HO, ,TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,ZAG MED BDUD RTZI'I TSOGS MCHOD RGYA MTSO 'DI, ,RNAL 'BYOR DBANG MO'I LHA TSOGS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,AOm A'A: H'Um, 'DOD DGU'I DPAL LA ROL PAS TSIMS MDZAD NAS, ,AE MA HO, ,MKHA' SPYOD DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: ho, ,ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i, ,zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di, ,rnal 'byor dbang mo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul, ,aoM a'a: hUM, 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol pas tshims mdzad nas, ,ae ma ho, ,mkha' spyod dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: Ho! We offer this ocean Of gifts of the Gathering, Immaculate nectar Blessed by our concentration, By our secret words, And by our secret signs, To the gathering Of Angels and their Queen; May You be pleased. Om ah hung, Take Your fill, Revel in these thousand Objects of the senses; Eh ma ho, Grant us all the goals Of the Heaven of the Angel.

gru.acip: ,HO, ,TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,ZAG MED BDUD RTZI'I TSOGS MCHOD RGYA MTSO 'DI, ,YI DAM LHA TSOGS 'KHOR BCAS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,AOm A'A: H'Um, ,'DOD DGU'I DPAL LA ROL PAS TSIMS MDZAD NAS, ,AE MA HO, ,DNGOS GRUB CHAR CHEN DBAB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: ho, ,ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i, ,zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di, ,yi dam lha tshogs 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul, ,aoM a'a: hUM, ,'dod dgu'i dpal la rol pas tshims mdzad nas, ,ae ma ho, ,dngos grub char chen dbab tu gsol
gru.english: Ho! We offer this ocean Of gifts of the Gathering, Immaculate nectar Blessed by our concentration, By our secret words, And by our secret signs, To the gathering Of Angels and Close Angels; May You be pleased. Om ah hung, Take Your fill, Revel in these thousand Objects of the senses; Eh ma ho, Send down on us A great rain of attainments.

gru.acip: ,HO, ,TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,ZAG MED BDUD RTZI'I TSOGS MCHOD RGYA MTSO 'DI, ,YI DAM LHA TSOGS 'KHOR BCAS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,AOm A'A: H'Um, ,'DOD DGU'I DPAL LA ROL PAS TSIMS MDZAD NAS, ,AE MA HO, ,DNGOS GRUB CHAR CHEN DBAB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: ho, ,ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i, ,zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di, ,yi dam lha tshogs 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul, ,aoM a'a: hUM, ,'dod dgu'i dpal la rol pas tshims mdzad nas, ,ae ma ho, ,dngos grub char chen dbab tu gsol
gru.english: Ho! We offer this ocean Of gifts of the Gathering, Immaculate nectar Blessed by our concentration, By our secret words, And by our secret signs, To the gathering Of rare and precious Jewels; May You be pleased. Om ah hung, Take Your fill, Revel in these thousand Objects of the senses; Eh ma ho, Send down on us A great rain of the Holy Dharma.

gru.acip: (CES BRJOD, DE NAS LAS KYI RDO RJES LAG PA GNYIS PADMA'I PHYAG RGYA LAS SRIN LAG GA-YAS KYIS STENG GI BA LA 'DZIN PAS RDO RJE SLOB DPON NAS MAS RIM BZHIN MA DA NA BRIMS TSAR BA DANG, TSOGS KYI RDZAS NAS MA TSANG BA MED PA SLOB DPON LA NYIS 'GYUR SOGS DPON SLOB THAMS CAD LA LAG PA GNYIS KAS 'BUL ZHING, LEN PA POS KYANG, AA HO MA H'A SU KHA HO: ZHES BRJOD CING, LAG PA GNYIS PAD KOR GYIS BLANGS, 'DI DAG GI SKABS SNOD MIN GYIS DBEN PAR BYAS, SGRUB PA PO RNAMS KYIS KYANG GTZANG RME'I RNAM RTOG MI BYA BAR SNYING GA'I BAm YIG SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD 'DUS PA'I NGO BO MCHOD PAR BSAMS LA RDZAS THAMS CAD TSIM PAR LONGS SPYOD, KHYAD PAR DGE SLONG RDO RJE 'DZIN PA LTA BUS, MA DA NA DANG TSOGS RDZAS KHYAD DU BSAD NA RTZA LTUNG BCU GSUM PAR 'GYUR BAR GSUNGS PAS LCE LA NANG MCHOD REG TZAM BYAS NAS BDUD RTZI MYONG BA NGES PAR BYA YI, BAG MED DU BTUNG BA NI KHYIM PA LA'ANG BKAG NA RAB TU BYUNG BA LA LTA CI SMOD PA'I PHYIR RO,
gru.wylie: (ces brjod, de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis padma'i phyag rgya las srin lag ga-yas kyis steng gi ba la 'dzin pas rdo rje slob dpon nas mas rim bzhin ma da na brims tshar ba dang, tshogs kyi rdzas nas ma tshang ba med pa slob dpon la nyis 'gyur sogs dpon slob thams cad la lag pa gnyis kas 'bul zhing, len pa pos kyang, aa ho ma hA su kha ho: zhes brjod cing, lag pa gnyis pad kor gyis blangs, 'di dag gi skabs snod min gyis dben par byas, sgrub pa po rnams kyis kyang gtsang rme'i rnam rtog mi bya bar snying ga'i baM yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchod par bsams la rdzas thams cad tshim par longs spyod, khyad par dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bus, ma da na dang tshogs rdzas khyad du bsad na rtsa ltung bcu gsum par 'gyur bar gsungs pas lce la nang mchod reg tsam byas nas bdud rtsi myong ba nges par bya yi, bag med du btung ba ni khyim pa la'ang bkag na rab tu byung ba la lta ci smod pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: (Then the Diamond Attendant puts his hands in the Sign of the Lotus, using the ring finger of his right hand to hold up the bala.  He distributes the bala to the Master and disciples, in order of seniority.  Then the madana is distributed, and then the offerings of the Gathering, with nothing left incomplete, following such customs as presenting the Master with a double portion. The Attendants offer these things to the Master and all the disciples using both their hands, and upon accepting the things they also say, ah ho maha suka ho, and pick them up with both hands, using the Sign of the Circling Lotus. During these performances, all those who are not proper vessels should be excluded.  The practitioners should avoid any wrong notions that the substances might be something unclean; instead they should partake of them all, heartily, and think that they are making an offering to the letter bam in their heart, a letter which is, in reality, a combination of all the Buddhas there are. This applies especially to ordained persons who are keeping the practice of the Diamond: it is spoken that, if someone rejects the madana and offerings of the Gathering, then he has committed the thirteenth root downfall.  Therefore the ordained must be sure to touch a drop of the madana to their tongues, and thereby perform the partaking of nectar.  But drinking these things carelessly is prohibited even for laymen, much less for those who have left the home life.)

gru.acip: ,HO, ,TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS BYIN BRLABS PA'I, ,ZAG MED BDUD RTZI'I TSOGS LHAG RGYA MTSO 'DI, ,DAM CAN ZHING SKYONG TSOGS RNAMS MNYES PHYIR 'BUL, ,AOm A'A: H'Um, 'DOD DGU'I DPAL LA ROL PAS TSIM MDZAD NAS, ,AE MA HO, ,RNAL 'BYOR 'PHRIN LAS TSUL BZHIN SGRUBS,
gru.wylie: ho, ,ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i, ,zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs lhag rgya mtsho 'di, ,dam can zhing skyong tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul, ,aoM a'a: hUM, 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol pas tshim mdzad nas, ,ae ma ho, ,rnal 'byor 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs
gru.english: Ho! We offer this ocean Of gifts of the Gathering, Immaculate nectar Blessed by our concentration, By our secret words, And by our secret signs, To the gathering Of those who are pledged to defend, And those who protect this place; May You be pleased. Om ah hung, Take Your fill, Revel in these thousand Objects of the senses; Eh ma ho, Accomplish well The mighty deeds Of practitioners.

gru.acip: ,ZHI DANG RGYAS LA SOGS PA YI, ,LAS KYI DNGOS GRUB BDAG LA STZOL, ,DAM TSIG CAN GYIS BDAG LA SRUNGS, ,DNGOS GRUB KUN GYI STONG GROGS MDZOD,
gru.wylie: zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi, ,las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol, ,dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs, ,dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod
gru.english: Grant us The ability To act in the Various ways Of peace, prosperity, And all the rest as well. May those With the pledge Protect us, And assist us In attaining All the goals;

gru.acip: ,'JIG RTEN BDE ZHING LO LEGS DANG, ,'BRU RNAMS 'PHEL ZHING CHOS 'PHEL DANG, ,BDE LEGS PHUN SUM TSOGS PA DANG, ,YID LA 'DOD PA KUN 'GRUB SHOG
gru.wylie: 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang, ,'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang, ,bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang, ,yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog
gru.english: May the whole world Be happy; May their crops grow high; May the harvests Be plentiful; May the Dharma spread; May every good And virtuous thing Come to pass; May every one Upon the earth Get all he wishes for.

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,'GRO BA'I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS GZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG BSHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'DRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang bshan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'dro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: sanggye chudang tsokchok la jangchub bardu dakkyap chi rangshen dunni rabdrup chir jangchub semni kyepar gyi kunchok sumla dakkyap chi drikpa tamche sosor shak droway gela jeyi rang sanggye jangchub yikyi sung jangchub chokgi semni kyegyi ne semchen tamche dakgi drundu nyer jangchub chuchok yi-ong chepar gyi drola penchir sanggye druppar shok

gru.acip: ,RDO RJE GO 'PHANG 'GRUBS PA'I NYE LAM MCHOG, ,RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I SMIN SGRON DAM PA'I MDZOD, ,RDO RJE 'DZIN PA BLO BZANG YE SHE LA, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
gru.wylie: rdo rje go 'phang 'grubs pa'i nye lam mchog, ,rdo rje btsun mo'i smin sgron dam pa'i mdzod, ,rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang ye she la, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
gru.english: dorje gopang druppay nyelam chok dorje tsunmoy mindrul dampay dzu dorje dzinpa lobsang yeshe la sulwan debso hlenkye yeshe tsul I make supplication At the feet Of Lobsang Yeshe, The Holder of the Diamond; Supreme short path To reach The state of the Diamond; Treasure house Of holy instructions That make us ripe, And make us free, The Word of the Angel of Diamond; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

gru.acip: ,NGES PA BRTAN PO RNYED NAS NYES PA'I TSOGS, ,PHRA ZHING PHRA BA RNAMS KYANG SPONG BA DANG, ,DGE TSOGS MTHA' DAG SGRUB PAR BYED PA LA, ,RTAG TU BAG DANG LDAN PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: nges pa brtan po rnyed nas nyes pa'i tshogs, ,phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang spong ba dang, ,dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la, ,rtag tu bag dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: ngepa tenpo nyene nyepay tsok trashing trawa namkyang pongwa dang getsok tadak druppar jepa la taktu bakdang denpar jingyi lop Grant me then Ever to be careful, To stop the slightest Wrongs of many wrongs we do, And try to carry out instead Each and every good Of the many that we may.

gru.acip: ,RNAM DAG BSAM PA DE YIS DRANGS PA YI, ,DRAN DANG SHES BZHIN BAG YOD CHEN PO YIS, ,BSTAN PA'I RTZA BA SO SOR THAR PA LA, ,SGRUB PA SNYING POR BYED PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: rnam dag bsam pa de yis drangs pa yi, ,dran dang shes bzhin bag yod chen po yis, ,bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la, ,sgrub pa snying por byed par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: namdak sampa deyi drangpa yi drendang sheshin bakyu chenpo yi tenpay tsawa sosor tarpa la druppa nyingpor jepar jingyi lop Grant that these pure thoughts May lead me to be watchful And to recall What I should be doing, Grant me to give The greatest care To make the vows of morality The essence of my practice; They are The root of the Buddha's teaching.

gru.acip: ,SEMS TZAM BSKYED KYANG TSUL KHRIMS RNAM GSUM LA, ,GOMS PA MED NA BYANG CHUB MI 'GRUB PAR, ,LEGS PAR MTHONG NAS RGYAL SRAS SDOM PA LA, ,RTZON PA DRAG POS SLOB PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la, ,goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub par, ,legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la, ,rtson pa drag pos slob par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: semtsam kyekyang tsultrim namsum la gompa mena jangchub mindrup par lekpar tongne gyelse dompa la tsunpa drakpu loppar jingyi lop Bless me to see clearly That the Wish itself Is not enough, For if I'm not well trained In the three moralities, I cannot become a Buddha. Grant me then A fierce resolve To master the vows For children of the Victors.

gru.acip: ,DE TSE DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS GRUB PA'I GZHI, ,RNAM DAG DAM TSIG SDOM PAR BSRUNG BA LA, ,BCOS MA MIN PA'I NGES PA RNYED GYUR NAS, ,SROG DANG BSDOS TE BSRUNG BAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis grub pa'i gzhi, ,rnam dag dam tshig sdom par bsrung ba la, ,bcos ma min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas, ,srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: detse ngudrup namnyi druppay shi namdak damtsik dompar sungwa la chuma minpay ngepa nyegyur ne sokdang dute sungwar jingyi lop Bless me to know With genuine certainty That when I've entered thus, The cause that gives me Both the attainments Is keeping my pledges And vows most pure. Grant me then To always keep them Even if it costs my life.

gru.acip: ,DE NAS RGYUD SDE'I SNYING PO RIM GNYIS KYI, ,GNAD RNAMS JI BZHIN RTOGS NAS BRTZON PA YIS, ,THUN BZHI'I RNAL 'BYOR MCHOG LAS MI G-YEL BAR, ,DAM PA'I GSUNG BZHIN SGRUB PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: de nas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis kyi, ,gnad rnams ji bzhin rtogs nas brtson pa yis, ,thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog las mi g-yel bar, ,dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: dene gyudey nyingpo rimnyi kyi nenam jishin tokne tsunpa yi tunshiy nelnjor chokle miyel war dampay sungshin druppar jingyi lop Bless me next To realize precisely The crucial points Of both the stages, The essence of The secret ways. Grant me then To practice as The Holy One has spoken, Putting all my effort in And never leaving off The Practice of the Four Times, Highest that there is.

gru.acip: ,DE LTAR LAM BZANG STON PA'I BSHES GNYEN DANG, ,TSUL BZHIN SGRUB PA'I GROGS RNAMS ZHABS BRTAN CING, ,PHYI DANG NANG GI BAR DU GCOD PA'I TSOGS, ,NYE BAR ZHI BAR BYIN GYIS BRLAB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: de ltar lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang, ,tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs rnams zhabs brtan cing, ,phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa'i tshogs, ,nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol
gru.english: detar lamsang tunpay shenyen dang tsulshin druppay droknam shapten ching chidang nanggi bardu chupay tsok nyeway shiwar jingyi laptu sul Bless me, grant me that The spiritual Guide Who shows me this good road, And all my true Companions in this quest Live long and fruitful lives. Bless and grant me that The rain of obstacles, Things within me Or outside me That could stop me now, Stop and end forever.

gru.acip: ,SNYIGS MA'I DUS 'DIR MANG THOS SGRUB LA BRTZON, ,CHOS BRGYAD SPANGS PAS DAL 'BYOR DON YOD BYED, ,MGON PO KHYOD KYI RLABS CHEN MDZAD PA LA, ,BDAG CAG BSAM PA THAG PAS YI RANG NGO,
gru.wylie: snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang thos sgrub la brtson, ,chos brgyad spangs pas dal 'byor don yod byed, ,mgon po khyod kyi rlabs chen mdzad pa la, ,bdag cag bsam pa thag pas yi rang ngo
gru.english: nyikmay dundir mangtu drupla tsun chugye pangpe delnjor dunyu je gunpo kyu kyi labchen dzepa la dakchak sampa takpe yirang ngo Here in the age Of degeneration You made every effort To gain great learning; You threw away The eight worldly thoughts And so made use Of Your leisure and fortune. Savior, we rejoice� We are glad, happy deep inside, For what you have done, So good and powerful.

gru.acip: ,THOS BSAM SGOM PA'I SHES RAB 'PHEL DU GSOL, ,'CHAD RTZOD RTZOM PA'I BLO GROS RGYAS SU GSOL, ,MCHOG DANG THUN MONG DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL, ,MYUR DU KHYED RANG LTA BUR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab 'phel du gsol, ,'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros rgyas su gsol, ,mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol, ,myur du khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: tusam gompay sherab peldu sul che-tsu tsompay lodru gyesu sul chok dang tunmong ngudrup tseldu sul nyurdu kyerang tabur jingyi lop Grant I pray That the wisdom which comes From learning, And the wisdom which comes From contemplation, And the wisdom which comes From meditation, Grow forever more in me. Grant me Ever more inspiration In explaining the teachings to others, In debating their meaning, In writing their commentary. Grant that I achieve the highest of goals, And worldly goals as well. Bless me, that I May quickly become Like You.

gru.acip: ,DNGOS GRUB KUN 'BYUNG THUB DBANG RDO RJE 'CHANG ,
gru.wylie: dngos grub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang
gru.english: ngudrup kunjung tubwang dorje chang I pray to the One who Holds the Diamond The source from where Every goal is found;

gru.acip: ,DPAL LDAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA RIN PO CHE, ,BDAG GI SNYING GAR PAD+MO'I STENG BZHUGS LA, ,BKA' DRIN CHEN PO'I SGO NAS RJES BZUNG STE, ,SKU GSUNG THUGS KYI DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che, ,bdag gi snying gar pad+mo'i steng bzhugs la, ,bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste, ,sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: pelnden tsaway lama rinpoche dak gi nyingkar pemuy tengshuk la kadrin chenpoy gone jesung te kusung tukkyi ngudrup tseldu sol Come I pray and sit My root Lama Shining and precious Upon the lotus In my heart; Take me after You In great kindness, Grant that I attain Your body, speech and mind.

gru.acip: ,DPAL LDAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA RIN PO CHE, ,BDAG GI SNYING GAR PAD+MO'I STENG BZHUGS LA, ,BKA' DRIN CHEN PO'I SGO NAS RJES BZUNG STE, ,MCHOG DANG THUN MONG DNGOS GRUB STZAL DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che, ,bdag gi snying gar pad+mo'i steng bzhugs la, ,bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste, ,mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol
gru.english: pelnden tsaway lama rinpoche dakgi nyingkar pemuy tengshuk la kadrin chenpoy go-ne jesung te chokdang tunmong ngudrup tseldu sol Come I pray and sit My root Lama Shining and precious Upon the lotus In my heart; Take me after You In great kindness, Grant that I attain Both common and highest goals.

gru.acip: BRTZE BA CHEN POS RJES SU BZUNG STE GDAMS PA 'DI NYID YI GER 'BRIR RUNG BA'I GNANG BSTZAL BA DANG, MKHA' MNYAM 'GRO BA'I DON DU PHYI NANG MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB GEGS MED BDE BLAG TU STZOL BAR MDZAD DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste gdams pa 'di nyid yi ger 'brir rung ba'i gnang bstsal ba dang, mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du phyi nang mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub gegs med bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad du gsol
gru.english: In Your great love, Take me after You: Grant me Your consent To put these advices Down in writing; And grant that I may, Easily and without hindrance, Attain the inner and outer Heaven of the Angel, For the sake of living beings, Who stretch as far As space itself.

gru.acip: ,LAM 'DI'I SGRUBo POS CHE BRJOD TZAM MIN PAR, ,DON GNYIS SGRUBo BYED MYUR LAM MTHAR THUG 'DIR, ,MKHA' SPYOD SGRUBo PA'I SNGON BYON RNAM THAR BZHIN, ,BRTZON PAS SGRUBo 'BRAS MNGON DU 'GYUR BYIN RLOBS,
gru.wylie: lam 'di'i sgrubo pos che brjod tsam min par, ,don gnyis sgrubo byed myur lam mthar thug 'dir, ,mkha' spyod sgrubo pa'i sngon byon rnam thar bzhin, ,brtson pas sgrubo 'bras mngon du 'gyur byin rlobs
gru.english: {LO: a round circle under each syllable here with a lower-case "o" after it} Bless us, that those of us Trying to follow and achieve This path might win The fruits of final achievement By making efforts Like those described In the stories of the lives Of those in the past Who've achieved the Angel's heaven, Efforts in this quick and Ultimate path, which in but a few words Can help us achieve both goals.

gru.acip: DA RES RNYED DKA'I RTEN DANG SANGS RGYAS KYI BSTAN PA MDO SNGAGS ZUNG 'BREL DANG MJAL, THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA SGRUB PA'I SKABS LAN CIG TZAM RNYED PA 'DIR SNYING PO MA BLANGS NA NOR BU 'BUM PHRAG MANG PO CHUD ZOS SU BTANG BA LAS KYANG CHOS PHANGS TE, THOG MED NAS 'DI LTA BU MA BYUNG ZHING, PHYIN CHAD KYANG 'DI 'DRA 'BYUNG BAR DKA',
gru.wylie: da res rnyed dka'i rten dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo sngags zung 'brel dang mjal, thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i skabs lan cig tsam rnyed pa 'dir snying po ma blangs na nor bu 'bum phrag mang po chud zos su btang ba las kyang chos phangs te, thog med nas 'di lta bu ma byung zhing, phyin chad kyang 'di 'dra 'byung bar dka'
gru.english: This time we have the kind of life that is so hard to find; and this time in this life we have been fortunate enough to meet with the teachings of the Buddha, in the combination of both the open and the secret Word.  This is the one and only chance we will ever have to achieve the state of omniscience. If now, while we have such a chance, we fail to take ultimate advantage of it, then we have done something infinitely more wasteful than throwing away many hundreds of thousands of precious jewels; for we have never had a chance like this in all of time with no beginning, and it will be difficult for such a chance to occur again in the future.

gru.acip: DES NA DA RES GTAN GYI 'DUN MA SGRUB PA'I DUS YIN PAS SNYING PO KHYAD PAR CAN LEN RAN, GZHAN DU NA BTZON PA BTZON KHANG LAS THAR KYANG BSKYAR DU DER 'DZUL BA LTAR YIN PAS DE LTAR MA SONG BA DGOS,
gru.wylie: des na da res gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa'i dus yin pas snying po khyad par can len ran, gzhan du na btson pa btson khang las thar kyang bskyar du der 'dzul ba ltar yin pas de ltar ma song ba dgos
gru.english: Therefore this time is the time to achieve our ultimate wishes; the time has come, to take that very extraordinary advantage of our life.  Otherwise we would be like a prisoner who broke out of prison, and then turned around and stepped back in.  We must not let this happen to us.

gru.acip: DA LAM 'DI'I RIM GNYIS KYI KHRID MDOR BSDUS TZAM 'BUL BA SKABS SU BABS PA YIN PAS, 'DI LA SA BCAD BZHI, GDAMS PA 'DI NYID GANG LAS BYUNG BA'I RGYUD KYI KHUNGS BSHAD PA DANG, KHUNGS DE LDAN GYI GDAMS PA'I PHAN YON BSHAD PA, PHAN YON DE LDAN GYI GDAMS PA NYAMS SU BLANGS PAS DAM PA RNAMS KYIS DNGOS GRUB BRNYES PA'I TSUL, GDAMS PA DNGOS NYAMS SU LEN PA'I RIM PA'O,
gru.wylie: da lam 'di'i rim gnyis kyi khrid mdor bsdus tsam 'bul ba skabs su babs pa yin pas, 'di la sa bcad bzhi, gdams pa 'di nyid gang las byung ba'i rgyud kyi khungs bshad pa dang, khungs de ldan gyi gdams pa'i phan yon bshad pa, phan yon de ldan gyi gdams pa nyams su blangs pas dam pa rnams kyis dngos grub brnyes pa'i tshul, gdams pa dngos nyams su len pa'i rim pa'o
gru.english: We have now reached the point, said our Lama, where I can begin delivering to you my brief teaching on the two stages of this path.  We will proceed in four sections: 1) An explanation of which secret teachings provide the authoritative source for this instruction; 2) An explanation of the benefits of the instruction which we have established does possess such a source; 3) A description of how holy beings of the past have attained their goals by carrying out the instruction which we have established to have such benefits; and 4) The steps one must take to actually carry out the instruction. The Authoritative Source

gru.acip: MDOR NA RGYA BOD GNYIS NA MTSAN NYI ZLA LTAR GRAGS PA GRUB MCHOG N'A RO TA PA LA RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS ZHAL DNGOS SU BSTAN NAS RJE BTZUN MA NYID KYI LAM GYI RIM PA RNAMS RTZA RGYUD KYI DGONGS DON LTAR BKRAL NAS BSTAN PA'I GDAMS PA DNGOS SU GSAN,
gru.wylie: mdor na rgya bod gnyis na mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa grub mchog nA ro ta pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas zhal dngos su bstan nas rje btsun ma nyid kyi lam gyi rim pa rnams rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar bkral nas bstan pa'i gdams pa dngos su gsan
gru.english: To summarize what He said, Narotapa was a supreme accomplished saint, whose name covered both India and Tibet like the light of the sun and moon.  The Angel of Diamond showed Herself to him directly, and he heard from this Holy Angel directly the instructions on the stages to Her own path.  He then commented upon these instructions himself, in exact accordance with the true intent of the root tantras.

gru.acip: ZHVA LU RIN CHEN BSOD NAMS MCHOG GRUB NAS BRGYUD PA YANG RNYING MA'I BLA CHEN 'OD GSAL THEG MCHOG RDO RJE DANG, SA SKYA'I CHOS BRGYUD MAN NGAG 'DZIN PA ZHIG BCAS NAS DBANG LUNG KHRID MAN NGAG DANG BCAS PA LEGS PAR THOB,
gru.wylie: zhva lu rin chen bsod nams mchog grub nas brgyud pa yang rnying ma'i bla chen 'od gsal theg mchog rdo rje dang, sa skya'i chos brgyud man ngag 'dzin pa zhig bcas nas dbang lung khrid man ngag dang bcas pa legs par thob
gru.english: I have also received the practice in the lineage descended through Zhalu Rinchen Sunam Chokdrup, from the Grand Lama of the Nyingma tradition, Usel Tekchok Dorje.  Finally I have received it in the lineage of the Sakya Dharmas, from a holder of the advices of this tradition.

gru.acip: KHO BOS MAN NGAG 'DI SKOR SA DGE'I BLA MA GNYIS KYI NA BZA' GNYIS MNYAM DU BSRES TE BTZEMS NA LEGS BO 'ONG ZHES PA'I MTSAN MA GSAL BAR BYUNG BA SOGS LA BRTEN NAS LAM 'DI'I SA DGE'I ZAB GNAD MANG PO BSDUS PA SGRUB THABS BDE CHEN NYE LAM SOGS GSAR DU BRTZAMS TE MAN NGAG RNAMS CHA TSANG BA BKOD PA YIN GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: kho bos man ngag 'di skor sa dge'i bla ma gnyis kyi na bza' gnyis mnyam du bsres te btsems na legs bo 'ong zhes pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar byung ba sogs la brten nas lam 'di'i sa dge'i zab gnad mang po bsdus pa sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam sogs gsar du brtsams te man ngag rnams cha tshang ba bkod pa yin gsungs
gru.english: I had a clear vision, in which I was told that "As for the instructions of this practice, it would be good if you were to place the holy robes of the Lamas of the Sakya and the Geluk together, and sew them into one piece."  Based on this and other experiences, I have written a number of original works, such as a ritual for becoming the Angel entitled Short Path to Great Bliss, in which I include many profound and crucial points on this path from both the Sakya and the Geluk traditions.  In these texts I have put down the complete instructions, said our Lama. Benefits of the Instruction

gru.acip: SNGAR RGYA GAR DU GRUB CHEN NAG PO PAS PHYI ROL PA'I RGYAL PO'I MNGA' 'BANGS MI ZHIG LA BDE MCHOG GI GDAMS PA GNANG, KHOS LKOG TU BDE MCHOG GI SKU THANG BRIS PA GSANG ZHING SBAS KYANG SKABS SHIG TU RGYAL POS TSOR NAS,
gru.wylie: sngar rgya gar du grub chen nag po pas phyi rol pa'i rgyal po'i mnga' 'bangs mi zhig la bde mchog gi gdams pa gnang, khos lkog tu bde mchog gi sku thang bris pa gsang zhing sbas kyang skabs shig tu rgyal pos tshor nas
gru.english: In India, in days gone by, the great saint Kirshna Pada granted instruction in the secret teaching of Highest Bliss to a certain subject of a non-Buddhist king.  This subject then surreptitiously kept a painting of the Angel; and although he tried to keep it secret and hidden from sight, it came to pass that one day the King found it out.

gru.acip: YUL NYER BZHIR YANG 'DUL BYED KYI LHA DPA' BO DPA' MO GRANGS MED BZHUGS PA RANG CAG DANG GNAS GCIG PAS 'GRUB THAG NYE ZHING, DE DAG GIS BDE MCHOG YAB YUM GYI RNAL 'BYOR PA RJES SU BZUNG STE RTZA KHAMS BYIN GYIS BRLAB PA KHYAD CHOS GNYIS PA,
gru.wylie: yul nyer bzhir yang 'dul byed kyi lha dpa' bo dpa' mo grangs med bzhugs pa rang cag dang gnas gcig pas 'grub thag nye zhing, de dag gis bde mchog yab yum gyi rnal 'byor pa rjes su bzung ste rtsa khams byin gyis brlab pa khyad chos gnyis pa
gru.english: The second special phenomenon is this.  The countless man and woman Warriors who defeated the evil beings in the 24 sacred places are also still there; and since we both live in the same level, They are close by for us to reach.  They take under their care those who are trying to follow the practice of the Man and Wife of Highest Bliss; and they do so by giving Their blessing to the channels and substances of our bodies.

gru.acip: DES NA BDE MCHOG YAB YUM GNYIS NI SNYIGS DUS 'GRUB THAG NYE ZHING, BYIN RLABS KYI TSAN KHA YI DAM GYI LHA GZHAN DANG GZHAN LAS KHYAD PAR DU 'PHAGS ,
gru.wylie: des na bde mchog yab yum gnyis ni snyigs dus 'grub thag nye zhing, byin rlabs kyi tshan kha yi dam gyi lha gzhan dang gzhan las khyad par du 'phags
gru.english: And so these two, the Man and Wife of Highest Bliss, are closer to reach in the dark days of the world, and the efficacy of Their blessing is far beyond that of any other Close Angel you may choose.

gru.acip: YAB BKA' BDE MCHOG LA RTZA BSHAD SBYAR NAS BSHAD PA'I GRUB CHEN GYI LUGS MI 'DRA BA MANG YANG GTZO CHE ZHING DAR KHYAB CHE BA NI KUN SPYOD L'U AI'I SKOR, RTZA RGYUD NAG PO'I SKOR, ZAB DON DRIL BU'I SKOR TE L'U NAG DRIL GSUM GYIS BKRAL BA RNAMS YIN, DRIL BU'I SKOR NI, GRUB CHEN DRIL BU PA'I LUGS KYI BDE MCHOG LUS DKYIL DANG BCAS PA STE SNGA MA GNYIS LAS 'DI ZA BA,
gru.wylie: yab bka' bde mchog la rtsa bshad sbyar nas bshad pa'i grub chen gyi lugs mi 'dra ba mang yang gtso che zhing dar khyab che ba ni kun spyod lU ai'i skor, rtsa rgyud nag po'i skor, zab don dril bu'i skor te lU nag dril gsum gyis bkral ba rnams yin, dril bu'i skor ni, grub chen dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog lus dkyil dang bcas pa ste snga ma gnyis las 'di za ba
gru.english: There are a great number of different systems by which accomplished saints of the past have given explanations of the Word of the Man in the secret teachings of Highest Bliss, using both the root texts and their commentaries.  But those that are the chief ones, and which have found the most widespread following, are the explanations by the Three: by Luyipa, Kirshnapada, and Ghantapada.  These explanations are known by the names of The Activities--the Collection of Luyipa; The Secret Root Text--the Collection of Kirshnapada; and The Profound Meaning--the Collection of Ghantapada.  The Collection of Ghantapada consists of the practice of Highest Bliss, along with its Secret World of the Body, according to the system of the great saint Ghantapada.  This collection is even deeper than the other two mentioned.

gru.acip: DE LA'ANG LUGS MANG DU YOD PA LAS GTZO BOR GYUR PA AINDRA MKHA' SPYOD DANG, MEE TRI MKHA' SPYOD, N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD GSUM, DE DAG GI ZAB DON MTHAR THUG SNYING POR DRIL BA, SA SKYA'I GSER CHOS BCU GSUM MAM KLU BA'I GSER CHOS BCU BZHIR YANG GRAGS PA'I NANG TSAN DMAR MO SKOR GSUM GYI GTZO BO LTA BU, MCHOG SGRUB PAS THUN MONG ZHAR LA 'GRUB CING, SKAL LDAN GYI SKYES BU LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD PAR BYED PA'I GDAMS PA ZAB MO, YANG ZAB N'A RO'I SKOR ZHES YONGS SU GRAGS PA NI YUM BKA' N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD MA 'DI YIN,
gru.wylie: de la'ang lugs mang du yod pa las gtso bor gyur pa aindra mkha' spyod dang, mee tri mkha' spyod, nA ro mkha' spyod gsum, de dag gi zab don mthar thug snying por dril ba, sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum mam klu ba'i gser chos bcu bzhir yang grags pa'i nang tshan dmar mo skor gsum gyi gtso bo lta bu, mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'grub cing, skal ldan gyi skyes bu lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bgrod par byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo, yang zab nA ro'i skor zhes yongs su grags pa ni yum bka' nA ro mkha' spyod ma 'di yin
gru.english: There are as well many systems for this teaching; the main ones are the three of the Heaven in the tradition of Indra, the Heaven of Maitri, and the Heaven of Naropa.  But the one which is-- The ultimate meaning of all of them, rolled up into one essential ball; The Chief, in effect, of the Three Teachings on the Lady of Red, which themselves form a part of the Thirteen Dharmas of Gold of the Sakyas, otherwise known as the Fourteen Dharmas of Gold of Luwa; The practice that gives you all worldly attainments along the way with the Supreme Attainment; The profound instruction that lets good and fortunate persons travel to the Heaven of the Angel without leaving this very body; The teaching, deeper than deeper, known everywhere as the Collection of Naro; --is none other than this Word of the Wife, the Heaven of Naro.

gru.acip: DE YANG LNGA PA CHEN POS, ,DBANG PO RAB 'BRING LUS 'DIS MKHA' SPYOD BGROD, ,THA MA BAR DOR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GROS BSU, ,YANG MTHA' SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS DNGOS GRUB 'THOB, ,CES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: de yang lnga pa chen pos, ,dbang po rab 'bring lus 'dis mkha' spyod bgrod, ,tha ma bar dor dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu, ,yang mtha' skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub 'thob, ,ces gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: Now the Great Fifth spoke the following: Those with high and medium abilities Travel in this body to the Angel's Heaven; Those with the lowest are welcomed By Warriors and their Angels in between; Those with abilities lower than low Attain the goal over a number of lives.

gru.acip: 'BRING GIS DE LTAR NYAMS SU BLANGS KYANG RTAGS SOGS MA BYUNG NA GZHI BSNYEN 'BUM BRGYA KHA SKONG BSNYEN SGRUB SBRAGS MA, LANGGA LI YA'I SHING LA BRTEN NAS SGRUB PA LAS SBYOR BCAS BYAS PAS MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD,
gru.wylie: 'bring gis de ltar nyams su blangs kyang rtags sogs ma byung na gzhi bsnyen 'bum brgya kha skong bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma, langga li ya'i shing la brten nas sgrub pa las sbyor bcas byas pas mkha' spyod du bgrod
gru.english: Those of medium abilities will travel to the Heaven of the Angel if they do the same; but it they fail to see a sign of the success of their practice, or something else like a sign, then they must do what we call the "foundation" retreat for getting close to the Angel, completing 100 sets of 100,000 recitations; and then in fulfillment they must combine the retreat with special practice for reaching the Angel.  This is the practice of the Tree of Langaliya; which combined with practices of the four modes enables them to travel to this Heaven.

gru.acip: RAB 'BRING GNYIS KA TSE 'DIR MKHA' SPYOD DU 'GRO, DBANG PO THA ,MAS DE LTAR BSGRUBS PAS TSE 'DIR MA 'GRUB KYANG BAR DOR 'DI'I BZLAS SGOM BYED PA'I SNANG BA SOGS BYUNG STE DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO'I BSU BA DANG BCAS MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD,
gru.wylie: rab 'bring gnyis ka tshe 'dir mkha' spyod du 'gro, dbang po tha ,mas de ltar bsgrubs pas tshe 'dir ma 'grub kyang bar dor 'di'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba sogs byung ste dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba dang bcas mkha' spyod du bgrod
gru.english: Both those of high and medium abilities will travel to the Heaven of the Angel in this life.  Persons of low ability who complete the same activities will not reach the ultimate goal in this life, but in the state between death and birth they will travel to the Heaven: since in their life they kept the practices such as recitation and meditation, they see Warriors and their Angels coming to greet them, leading them on to the Heaven of the Angel.

gru.acip: DBANG PO SHIN TU MA MTHA' YIN YANG SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS CHOS 'DI STON PA'I BLA MA DANG MJAL ZHING, LAM 'DIR THOS BSAM SGOM GSUM BYAS TE MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB NGES PAR 'THOB PA 'ONG GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: dbang po shin tu ma mtha' yin yang skye ba brgyud nas chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma dang mjal zhing, lam 'dir thos bsam sgom gsum byas te mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub nges par 'thob pa 'ong gsungs
gru.english: Even those of the very lowest abilities will, over a number of lives, meet Lamas who will teach them this Dharma; they will study, contemplate, and meditate upon this path, and then it is spoken they will definitely reach the goal. How Those in the Past Have Attained the Goal

gru.acip: GSUM PA NI, LAM 'DI LA BRTEN NAS SKU LUS MA SPANGS PAR DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU GSHEGS PA RANG CAG GIS RNAM THAR DNGOS SU MTHONG BA DANG MA MTHONG BA GRANGS LAS 'DAS, 'PHAGS YUL DU GRUB CHEN L'U AI PA DANG, SLOB DPON RDO RJE DRIL BU BA, GRUB CHEN DZ'A LANDHA RA PA, RGYAL PO D'A RI KA PA, BLON PO dEm GI PA, SLOB DPON AA BHY'A KA RA, DGE TSUL TSEM BU BA, PHAM MTHING PA MCHED GNYIS SOGS KYANG BDE MCHOG YAB YUM GYI LAM GYIS SKU LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU PHEBS PA DANG, RJES SU BZUNG BA MANG,
gru.wylie: gsum pa ni, lam 'di la brten nas sku lus ma spangs par dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa rang cag gis rnam thar dngos su mthong ba dang ma mthong ba grangs las 'das, 'phags yul du grub chen lU ai pa dang, slob dpon rdo rje dril bu ba, grub chen dzA landha ra pa, rgyal po dA ri ka pa, blon po DeM gi pa, slob dpon aa bhyA ka ra, dge tshul tshem bu ba, pham mthing pa mched gnyis sogs kyang bde mchog yab yum gyi lam gyis sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du phebs pa dang, rjes su bzung ba mang
gru.english: The third section of the teaching is a description of how holy beings of the past have attained their goals by carrying out the instruction possessing the benefits just described. There are countless accounts, some we have witnessed ourselves, and others not, of persons who have followed this path and then gone to the Heaven of Purity without leaving this very body.  In India, the Land of the Realized, there were the great saint Luyipa, the master Vajra Ghantapada, the great saint Jalandhara, King Darikapa, the minister Dhengipa, Master Abhyakara, the novice Tunnavaya, the two Pamtingpa brothers, and many others as well who used the path of the Man and Wife of Highest Bliss to go themselves to the Heaven of the Angel, or else who were taken there by Her.

gru.acip: BOD NAS KYANG MAL GYO LO TZ'A BA SKU LA RUS PA'I RGYAN DRUG GSOL, RDOR DRIL PHYAG TU BZHES TE DA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'GRO ZHES DNGOS SU PHEBS, GZHAN YANG NA BZA' BRAG PHUG BA, BU RANGS LO CHUNG, SNGAGS 'CHANG GZUNGS KYI DPAL BA SOGS KYANG SKU LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU GSHEGS, NA BZA' BRAG PHUG PA'I SGRUB KHANG PHUG PA DE'I NANG GCIG PU NAS KYANG SLOB MA BDUN MKHA' SPYOD DU PHEBS,
gru.wylie: bod nas kyang mal gyo lo tsA ba sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol, rdor dril phyag tu bzhes te da mkha' spyod du 'gro zhes dngos su phebs, gzhan yang na bza' brag phug ba, bu rangs lo chung, sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba sogs kyang sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs, na bza' brag phug pa'i sgrub khang phug pa de'i nang gcig pu nas kyang slob ma bdun mkha' spyod du phebs
gru.english: In Tibet too there was Mel the Translator, who one day dressed himself in the six ornaments of bone, took up the diamond and bell in his hands, and said "Now I'm going to the Heaven of the Angel"--and then really did.  There were also Nasa Drakpukpa, Purang Lochung, and Ngakchang Sungkyi Pelwa, among others, who went to the Heaven without leaving their body.  In the place where Nasa Drakpukpa did his practice, from this one cave alone, seven of his students went to the Angel's Heaven.

gru.acip: GONG DU ZHUS PA LTAR MKHA' SPYOD 'GRUB PA'I THABS KYI GTZO BO BDE MCHOG YAB YUM, DE'I NANG NAS YUM BKA', DE'I NANG NAS N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD MCHOG YIN, MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB PA'I YI DAM LA 'DI DANG 'DRA BA MED TSUL,
gru.wylie: gong du zhus pa ltar mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo bde mchog yab yum, de'i nang nas yum bka', de'i nang nas nA ro mkha' spyod mchog yin, mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam la 'di dang 'dra ba med tshul
gru.english: As he had explained above, our Lama spoke about how the main method for reaching the Heaven of the Angel is the teaching of the Man and Wife of Highest Bliss.  The highest instructions within this teaching are those of the Word of the Wife, and the very highest practice within these instructions is the Heaven of Naropa.  And there is no Close Angel like this one, for reaching the Heaven.

gru.acip: LHA GZHAN LA NI BSGOM RGYU, TING NGE 'DZIN, BZLAS DMIGS SOGS CHA THAMS CAD NAS LEGS PO MA BYUNG NA JI BZHIN MI 'GRUB KYANG, 'DI LA NI DAD PAS BZLAS BSGOM DANG BKLAGS PA TZAM GYIS 'GRUB STE,
gru.wylie: lha gzhan la ni bsgom rgyu, ting nge 'dzin, bzlas dmigs sogs cha thams cad nas legs po ma byung na ji bzhin mi 'grub kyang, 'di la ni dad pas bzlas bsgom dang bklags pa tsam gyis 'grub ste
gru.english: With other Angels, you cannot achieve the goals you seek if what you are supposed to meditate on; and your concentration; your practice of recitation and meditation, and so on, don't all come out very well.  But this Angel you can reach only by doing recitation and meditation, and by saying Her secret words, with faith.

gru.acip: RTZA RGYUD LE'U ZHE BRGYAD PA LAS, ,DE NAS GZHAN YANG BSHAD PAR BYA, ,MKHA' 'GRO KUN GYI DGE BA GANG, ZHES PA NAS, ,SNGAGS 'DI BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB PA STE, ,LAS RNAMS KUN BYED DGE BA YIN, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR YIN,
gru.wylie: rtsa rgyud le'u zhe brgyad pa las, ,de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya, ,mkha' 'gro kun gyi dge ba gang, zhes pa nas, ,sngags 'di bklags pas 'grub pa ste, ,las rnams kun byed dge ba yin, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar yin
gru.english: This is true because of the lines stated in the 48th chapter of the secret root text, beginning with the words "I will also explain others; that which is the virtue of all the Angels..." and continuing on up to "...you will reach it by saying these secret words; this is virtue that can do all things."

gru.acip: DES NA DENG SANG GI DUS LTA BUR GZHAN CI YANG MI SHES PAS KYANG 'DI BZLAS PA DANG DAD PA KHO NAS DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB, BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS PA 'DI TZAM LAS MED, SGRUB THABS BDE CHEN NYE LAM DANG, 'BRING PO SOGS SGRUB THABS MA BSDUS TZAM ZHIG DANG, DAM BCA'I SNGAGS KYI STENG LHAG PO GANG 'GRUB DANG, LAS RUNG GI BSNYEN PA KHA SKONG GI SPYIN SREG DANG BCAS PA, YAR MAR GYI TSES BCU SOGS LA BRTZON PAS NGES PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD PAR THE TSOM MED,
gru.wylie: des na deng sang gi dus lta bur gzhan ci yang mi shes pas kyang 'di bzlas pa dang dad pa kho nas dngos grub 'grub, bklags pas 'grub par gsungs pa 'di tsam las med, sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam dang, 'bring po sogs sgrub thabs ma bsdus tsam zhig dang, dam bca'i sngags kyi steng lhag po gang 'grub dang, las rung gi bsnyen pa kha skong gi spyin sreg dang bcas pa, yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs la brtson pas nges par mkha' spyod du bgrod par the tshom med
gru.english: Therefore even people like those of us nowadays, who don't know anything else at all, can reach the goal just by reciting Her words, and by having faith in Her.  There is no other practice at all where it has been spoken that you can reach the goal just by reciting the secret words.  Just try to follow the ritual for reaching the Angel, the one called the Short Path to Great Bliss, or the medium-length one, or any other ritual for reaching Her which is not too brief; and then do as many extra rounds of Her secret words as you can, above and beyond the number you have pledged to do; do the retreats that will make you ready and bring you close to Her, along with the fire offerings that fulfill them; and keep your other practices, such as the ceremonies on the tenth day of the waxing and waning of the moon--then there is no doubt, it is certain, that you will travel to the Angel's Heaven.

gru.acip: 'DI'I MTSAN LA'ANG MKHA' SPYOD MA DANG, ZHAL YANG MKHA' SPYOD DU GZIGS TE SGRUB PA PO LA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'GRO ZHES PA'I TSUL DU BZHUGS PA SOGS BCAS GDAMS PA'I CHE BA MDO TZAM ZIN NAS,
gru.wylie: 'di'i mtshan la'ang mkha' spyod ma dang, zhal yang mkha' spyod du gzigs te sgrub pa po la mkha' spyod du 'gro zhes pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa sogs bcas gdams pa'i che ba mdo tsam zin nas
gru.english: And there is the fact that She is called the Angel of Heaven, and that She always stands with Her eyes looking up to Her Heaven, as if to say to us who are following Her path: "Let us go now, to My Heaven."

gru.acip: DE 'DRA ZHIG NGES CAN DU MA BYUNG NA GROL LAM BSGOM RUNG DU MI 'GRO STE, GROL LAM BSGOM RUNG LA PHAG MO'I BYIN RLABS TZAM GYIS GO MI CHOD PAR, BSKYED RIM LA BUM DBANG DANG, RDZOGS RIM LA DBANG GONG MA GSUM GYIS SNOD RUNG DU BSGRUB DGOS PAS, THOG MAR SMIN BYED RGYU'I DBANG BZHI MA THOB PAR BYIN RLABS DANG RJES GNANG SOGS KYI SNOD DU MI RUNG BA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: de 'dra zhig nges can du ma byung na grol lam bsgom rung du mi 'gro ste, grol lam bsgom rung la phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis go mi chod par, bskyed rim la bum dbang dang, rdzogs rim la dbang gong ma gsum gyis snod rung du bsgrub dgos pas, thog mar smin byed rgyu'i dbang bzhi ma thob par byin rlabs dang rjes gnang sogs kyi snod du mi rung ba'i phyir
gru.english: If the person has not received one of the empowerments specified as a prerequisite, then they do not qualify as someone fit to practice the path which liberates us.
