As the lines say, If you make offerings and show respect, You will gain ability and great power; And if you keep your practice secret, The obstacles you experience will be few.

gru.acip: SPYIR GSANG STE SPYOD PAS 'GRUB PAS NA GSANG SNGAGS ZHES GSUNGS ZHING, KHYAD PAR LUS DKYIL SOGS GSANG BA CHE RIGS BSHAD NA RANG GI DNGOS GRUB NYAMS PA'I RGYU MTHAR THUG YIN LA, NGAG 'DON LUS DKYIL BKOD STABS DPE 'DI YANG SU RUNG RUNG LA MI STON PAR BKA' BRGYA DAM PAR BYED PA NI GNAD SHIN TU CHE'O,
gru.wylie: spyir gsang ste spyod pas 'grub pas na gsang sngags zhes gsungs zhing, khyad par lus dkyil sogs gsang ba che rigs bshad na rang gi dngos grub nyams pa'i rgyu mthar thug yin la, ngag 'don lus dkyil bkod stabs dpe 'di yang su rung rung la mi ston par bka' brgya dam par byed pa ni gnad shin tu che'o
gru.english: Now as a general note, the meaning of the Tibetan word sang-ngak, or way of the secret word, is "that which is performed or attained by acting in secret."  This is especially true for the more secret practices such as the secret world of the body. Speaking of these things to other people is the ultimate cause for the degeneration of your own attainments.  Insofar as I have set down a description of the secret world of the body in this recitation text, you should not show it to just anyone; but rather you should keep it under tight lock and key.  This point is extremely important.

gru.acip: LUS SKYIL GYI YIG CHUNG GZHUNG BZHIN LA, RANG RNAL 'BYOR MAR GSAL BA'I ZHABS MTHIL NAS DBU GTZUG GI BAR THAMS CAD 'JA' 'OD LTA BUR BSGOMS TE KHOG GRUM DANG RTZA SOGS GANG YANG MED PAR STONG SANG NGE BA BSAM ZHING,
gru.wylie: lus skyil gyi yig chung gzhung bzhin la, rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhabs mthil nas dbu gtsug gi bar thams cad 'ja' 'od lta bur bsgoms te khog grum dang rtsa sogs gang yang med par stong sang nge ba bsam zhing
gru.english: According to the small treatise on the secret world of the body, you should visualize yourself as the Angel of Diamond, and meditate that Your entire body--from the bottom of the soles of your feet up the very tip of your head--is made of rainbow light. Your body is totally free of all its normal internal cavities, channels, and so on, and is perfectly ineffable.

gru.acip: 'DI'I SGRUB GZHI MA LAS THOB PA'I KHAMS DMAR PO YIN PAS, RAS BRIS DANG RDUL TSON GYI SGRUB GZHI'I DKYIL 'KHOR BSKAL PAR BSGOM PA LAS PHAN YON CHE BA DANG, GZHUNG DU LUS DKYIL SHIN TU ZAB PAR GSUNGS KYANG ZAB PA'I RGYU MTSAN RJE BDAG NYID CHEN PO MA BYON GONG NGOS 'DZIN LUGS SNA TSOGS BYUNG BA LAS, RJE YAB SRAS KYIS MI 'THAD PA DE DAG LUNG RIG GIS BKAG NAS,
gru.wylie: 'di'i sgrub gzhi ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po yin pas, ras bris dang rdul tshon gyi sgrub gzhi'i dkyil 'khor bskal par bsgom pa las phan yon che ba dang, gzhung du lus dkyil shin tu zab par gsungs kyang zab pa'i rgyu mtshan rje bdag nyid chen po ma byon gong ngos 'dzin lugs sna tshogs byung ba las, rje yab sras kyis mi 'thad pa de dag lung rig gis bkag nas
gru.english: Because this secret world is made from the red element you received from your mother, meditating on it is more useful than meditating for hundreds of millions of years on the secret worlds made from canvas or colored sand. In the great texts it is stated that the practice of the secret world of the body is extremely profound; but the reason for its being so was misunderstood in a great variety of ways prior to the coming of that great being, Lord Tsongkapa, into the world.  The Lord Father and His spiritual sons disproved these theories with scriptural authority and reasoning.

gru.acip: 'O NA JI LTAR YIN ZHE NA, RANG RDO RJE 'CHANG DU GNAS PA DE LAS THA MAL PA'I LUS KYI CHA SHAS RE CHAD NAS THIM PAS GZHAL YAS KHANG SKAD CIG GI SNGA MA DES NYE BAR LEN PA'I RGYU DANG, SKAD CIG PHYI MA RANG GI LUS DES LHAN CIG BYED PA'I RKYEN BYAS NAS GRUB PA LTAR RO,
gru.wylie: 'o na ji ltar yin zhe na, rang rdo rje 'chang du gnas pa de las tha mal pa'i lus kyi cha shas re chad nas thim pas gzhal yas khang skad cig gi snga ma des nye bar len pa'i rgyu dang, skad cig phyi ma rang gi lus des lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas grub pa ltar ro
gru.english: How then are we supposed to do this practice?  Hold your visualization of yourself as the Keeper of the Diamond, and then imagine that pieces from the channels of your normal body break off and then sink into the crystal palace at your heart.  The first instant of the palace provides the material cause, and in the next instant comes a piece of your body that provides the contributing factor, for the mandala.

gru.acip: DES NA NANG GI DMAR CHA TI LA KA ZHES PA LTE BA'I RTZA MDUD GRU GSUM GYI DBUS SU MA LAS THOB PA'I KHAMS DMAR PO RAKTA, DPYID CES PA SNYING GA'I BYANG SEMS KYI NGO BO'I BAm YIG LA THIM PA 'DI LA DUS 'KHOR LTAR AE WAm SGRA SGRUB DANG GZUGS SGRUB GNYIS KYI BSHAD PA BYAS NA YI GE BZHI YOD TSUL SOGS LA GO BA STER RGYU YOD PAS,
gru.wylie: des na nang gi dmar cha ti la ka zhes pa lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi dbus su ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po rakta, dpyid ces pa snying ga'i byang sems kyi ngo bo'i baM yig la thim pa 'di la dus 'khor ltar ae waM sgra sgrub dang gzugs sgrub gnyis kyi bshad pa byas na yi ge bzhi yod tshul sogs la go ba ster rgyu yod pas
gru.english: Your inner red part, which we call the tilaka (small seed), stays in the middle of the triangular knot at your navel chakra.  This is the red element which you received from your mother--what we call rakta (blood). The red element dissolves into the vam syllable, whose essence is of the mind of enlightenment at the indestructible drop of spring at your heart.  In the teachings on the Wheel of Time, we can see how to deconstruct both the component parts and the shape of evam.  If I were to give you an explanation of these two it would give you an understanding of where the four letters come from.

whole_word_matches.context: a nang gi dmar cha ti la ka zhes pa lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi dbus su ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po rakta,

gru.acip: 'BRI DANG BGRANG BA GA-YAS NAS BTZAM, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA DE SGRUB TSUL NI LO CHEN GYIS AA YIG GI BAR DU AU'O, AU'I YI GE WA'O, ,GSAL BYED DBYANGS nA PA PHA ROL GYI YI GE DRANG NGO, ,'JIG RTEN PA'I NYE BAR SPYOD PA LAS THIG LE NGA ROR SONG, BRTEN PA'I CHED DU, GZHI LA 'DUN PA NYOS,
gru.wylie: 'bri dang bgrang ba ga-yas nas btsam, ,zhes gsungs pa de sgrub tshul ni lo chen gyis aa yig gi bar du au'o, au'i yi ge wa'o, ,gsal byed dbyangs Na pa pha rol gyi yi ge drang ngo, ,'jig rten pa'i nye bar spyod pa las thig le nga ror song, brten pa'i ched du, gzhi la 'dun pa nyos
gru.english: "Writing and counting should start from the right," indicating how to construct the evam [presumably by starting from the wam].  Lochen explains the deconstruction as follows: Suppose an a sound meets a u syllable. The u then becomes a va.  When there is a consonant with no vowel sound, it is pulled into the far syllable. In keeping with the habit of the everyday world, it turns into a nasal sound with the dot.  In order to make it firm, add the locative, which indicates location at some base. ["Lochen" or "Great Translator" here refers to the great Tibetan grammarian Shalu Lochen Chukyong Sangpa (1441-1527); this is not by the way the "Shaluwa" who wrote the commentary upon the Vajra Yogini practice--this is Shalu Risur Rinchen Lobsang Kyenrab. This latter Shaluwa was a teacher of the teacher of Pabonka Rinpoche Dechen Nyingpo, and dates for the late 1800's. The correction of the line that had the error {nA PA} in it is taken from " The Essence of the Great Bliss of the Body of Emptiness," being a Brief Presentation on the Method for of the Secret Syllables called "Power of Ten Types," along with the Significance of Each Syllable (S6297), a commentary on the Wheel of Time (Kalachakra).  The translation here is tentative and should be improved upon later; the Tibetan texts on Sanskrit are sometimes quite corrupted.]

gru.acip: GNYIS PA GZUGS SGRUB NI, LO CHEN GYIS, DBUS SU AA YIG GRI GUG GI RNAM PA CAN GSUNGS PAS GRI GUG GI SO'I DBYIBS CAN TE GZUGS SGRUB 'DI NI DHA RI'I YI GE STE LAN TSA'I MGO THUR DU BKUG PA LTA BU YOD GSUNG,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa gzugs sgrub ni, lo chen gyis, dbus su aa yig gri gug gi rnam pa can gsungs pas gri gug gi so'i dbyibs can te gzugs sgrub 'di ni dha ri'i yi ge ste lan tsha'i mgo thur du bkug pa lta bu yod gsung
gru.english: This brings us to our second step, where we deconstruct the shape.  The Great Translator has said that in the center is an a letter in the shape of a chopknife, meaning shaped like a blade.  This deconstruction of the shape of the letter refers to a letter in dhari script, which looks like the letter in lancha script with its head bent down.

gru.acip: THABS SHES KYI DON NI RI MO'I RNAM PA RNAMS GANG YANG MIN GYI PHYOGS RE RER NYIS SDEBS BYED PA YIN ZHING, RANG PHYOGS LA SHAR DU BYAS PAS LHO'AM GA-YON PHYOGS SU STONG SANG YOD CING, YI GE'I DBYIBS GRU GSUM GYI TSUL DU 'ONG BAS RNAL 'BYOR MA LA MTSON NA SHAR NUB GNYIS DANG STENG BCAS LA CHOS 'BYUNG GCIG ,LHO BYANG GNYIS DANG, 'OG BCAS LA CHOS 'BYUNG GCIG BYAS NAS SBYOR RO,
gru.wylie: thabs shes kyi don ni ri mo'i rnam pa rnams gang yang min gyi phyogs re rer nyis sdebs byed pa yin zhing, rang phyogs la shar du byas pas lho'am ga-yon phyogs su stong sang yod cing, yi ge'i dbyibs gru gsum gyi tshul du 'ong bas rnal 'byor ma la mtshon na shar nub gnyis dang steng bcas la chos 'byung gcig ,lho byang gnyis dang, 'og bcas la chos 'byung gcig byas nas sbyor ro
gru.english: The expression "wisdom and method" here does not refer at all to the shapes of the syllables, but rather to the fact that in each direction there is a pair.  Taking the direction which is facing you as east, the area to the south or to the left is empty.  The shape of the letters comes out like a triangle.  In the practice of the Angel of Diamond for example this represents the two dharma stars.  If you draw a line connecting the east, west, and above you get one dharma star, and if you draw another connecting the north, south and below, you get another.

gru.acip: LUS DKYIL BSGOM PA 'DI DPAL LDAN SA SKYA PAS SNYAN BRGYUD KHO NA ZUR DU MDZAD KYANG , NGED KYIS SGRUB THABS NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA 'DI 'JAM DBYANGS BDE RDOR GYI GSUNG RGYUN STAG PHU'I THEM SKAS LAS GSUNGS PA LTAR TE, 'DON CHA THU'U 0,,-GYI GSUNG LTAR YIN,
gru.wylie: lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di dpal ldan sa skya pas snyan brgyud kho na zur du mdzad kyang , nged kyis sgrub thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di 'jam dbyangs bde rdor gyi gsung rgyun stag phu'i them skas las gsungs pa ltar te, 'don cha thu'u 0,,-gyi gsung ltar yin
gru.english: The meditation on the secret world of your body is a practice which the glorious Sakyas kept separately, passed along only by oral tradition.  Here in the ritual though I have written it down, in running prose, following the tradition of Jamyang Dedor described in the Staircase of Takpu.  The recitation itself keeps to the explanation of Tuken.

gru.acip: LUS DKYIL BSGOM PA 'DI DPAL LDAN SA SKYA PAS SNYAN BRGYUD KHO NA ZUR DU MDZAD KYANG , NGED KYIS SGRUB THABS NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA 'DI 'JAM DBYANGS BDE RDOR GYI GSUNG RGYUN STAG PHU'I THEM SKAS LAS GSUNGS PA LTAR TE, 'DON CHA THU'U 0,,-GYI GSUNG LTAR YIN,
gru.wylie: lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di dpal ldan sa skya pas snyan brgyud kho na zur du mdzad kyang , nged kyis sgrub thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di 'jam dbyangs bde rdor gyi gsung rgyun stag phu'i them skas las gsungs pa ltar te, 'don cha thu'u 0,,-gyi gsung ltar yin
gru.english: When we speak of the "secret world of your body," one should realize that placing angels around in the body is not itself enough to say a practice is this kind of secret world.  If this were all that were required, a number of problems would follow.  In the practice of the Frightener, there is a meditation where angels are positioned at the gateways of the senses; at the eye, for example, we make Diamond Eye appear.  This and other visualizations, such as the stack of three Warriors, would then have to be secret worlds of the body, whereas they are not.

gru.acip: 'O NA LUS DKYIL DE JI 'DRA ZHIG YIN SNYAM NA, DPER NA SGRUB GZHI'I RGYU RAS LA BRIS PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR LA RAS BRIS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR DANG , RDUL TSON GYIS BZHENGS PA LA RDUL TSON GYI DKYIL 'KHOR ZER BA DANG , DNGUL LAS BSKRUN PA'I SKU LA DNGUL SKU DANG , GSER LAS BSKRUN PA'I SKU LA GSER SKU ZER BA LTAR
gru.wylie: 'o na lus dkyil de ji 'dra zhig yin snyam na, dper na sgrub gzhi'i rgyu ras la bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang , rdul tshon gyis bzhengs pa la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zer ba dang , dngul las bskrun pa'i sku la dngul sku dang , gser las bskrun pa'i sku la gser sku zer ba ltar
gru.english: What is it, then, that does make a practice one of the secret world of the body?  There are secret worlds that we call "secret worlds of the canvas," for the basic material they are made of is canvas, with a secret world drawn upon it.  There are others that we call "secret worlds of the sand," for they are built using sand of different colors.  A holy statue fashioned from silver is called a "statue of silver," and one from gold we call a "statue of gold."

gru.acip: SGRUB GZHI RANG GI LUS KYI CHA SHAS LAS GRUB PA'AM, LUS KYI CHA SHAS LA BRTEN NAS BSKYED PA'I DKYIL 'KHOR LA LUS DKYIL ZHES BYA,
gru.wylie: sgrub gzhi rang gi lus kyi cha shas las grub pa'am, lus kyi cha shas la brten nas bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la lus dkyil zhes bya
gru.english: Here the basic material is our body: the secret world is made of parts of our body, or you can say created using the various parts of the body.  And so we call it the "secret world of the body."

gru.acip: DE YANG RDO RJE DRIL BU PAS, ,BCOS MA GNYIS KYI NGO BO GANG , ,DE NI GDUL BYA'I DBANG LAS 'DOD, ,MKHAS PA'I BSGRUB BYA DE MIN TE, ,YANG DAG DON MTHONG GROL PHYIR RO,
gru.wylie: de yang rdo rje dril bu pas, ,bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang , ,de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod, ,mkhas pa'i bsgrub bya de min te, ,yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro
gru.english: Now Vajra Ghanta has said: The essence of the artificial two Comes we say from the level of the student; This is not the material that wise men use, Since seeing pure reality Is what brings liberation.

gru.acip: SKU GSUNG THUGS KYI LHA NYER BZHI'I SGRUB GZHI NI YUL NYER BZHI'I RTZA KHAMS NYER BZHI STE, SNYING GA'I BYANG SEMS DKAR CHA GTZO BOR 'BAB PA'I RTZA BRGYAD LAS SKU 'KHOR, DMAR CHA GTZO BOR 'BAB PA'I RTZA BRGYAD LAS GSUNG 'KHOR, RLUNG GTZO BOR 'BAB PA'I RTZA BRGYAD LAS THUGS 'KHOR GYI DPA' MO BRGYAD DE NYER BZHI BSKYED,
gru.wylie: sku gsung thugs kyi lha nyer bzhi'i sgrub gzhi ni yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams nyer bzhi ste, snying ga'i byang sems dkar cha gtso bor 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad las sku 'khor, dmar cha gtso bor 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad las gsung 'khor, rlung gtso bor 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad las thugs 'khor gyi dpa' mo brgyad de nyer bzhi bskyed
gru.english: The materials we use here to make the twenty-four Angels of holy body, speech, and mind are the twenty-four channels and substances of the twenty-four sacred places.  There are eight channels at the heart that carry chiefly the white element of enlightenment, and from these we bring forth the eight Woman warriors that relate to the holy body.  From the eight channels that carry principally the red element of enlightenment, we bring forth the eight Woman warriors that relate to holy speech.  From the eight channels that carry mainly inner wind, we produce the eight Woman warriors that relate to holy mind.  This gives us a total then of twenty-four Women.

gru.acip: SNYING PO'I RNAL 'BYOR MA BZHI BSKYED TSUL LA LUGS GNYIS LAS, SGRUB THABS BDE CHEN NYE LAM DU BKOD PA 'DI LA GZHAN DANG MI 'DRA BA'I ZAB GNAD YOD DE, GRUB MCHOG 'JAM DBYANGS BDE BA'I RDO RJE'I GSUNG RGYUN BEE d'URA ZHUN MA'I THEM SKAS LAS GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bskyed tshul la lugs gnyis las, sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam du bkod pa 'di la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i zab gnad yod de, grub mchog 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun bee DUra zhun ma'i them skas las gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: There are two different ways of bringing forth the four heart Angels.  The way given here in the ritual for reaching the Holy Angel of Diamond, the Short Path to Great Bliss, has a very profound feature that distinguishes it from other presentations.  The Staircase of Lapis Made Pure, taking after the oral tradition of that highest of accomplished saints, Jamyang Deway Dorje, describes it as follows.

gru.acip: SNYING GAR GZHI DUS SU PHA LAS THOB PA'I BYANG SEMS DKAR PO YAB KYI SGRUB GZHI STE DPYID KYANG ZER, LTE BAR GZHI DUS SU MA LAS THOB PA'I BYANG SEMS DMAR PO YUM GYI SGRUB GZHI STE THIG LE TI LA KA YANG ZER BA DE GNYIS NGO BO DBYER MED LAS GTZO MO BSKYED, DPYID THIG LA 'BYUNG BZHI'I RDUL BZHI YOD PA LAS SNYING PO'I RNAL 'BYOR MA BZHI BSKYED PA YIN,
gru.wylie: snying gar gzhi dus su pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po yab kyi sgrub gzhi ste dpyid kyang zer, lte bar gzhi dus su ma las thob pa'i byang sems dmar po yum gyi sgrub gzhi ste thig le ti la ka yang zer ba de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med las gtso mo bskyed, dpyid thig la 'byung bzhi'i rdul bzhi yod pa las snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bskyed pa yin
gru.english: At our heart is the white element of enlightenment that comes from our father, in its original condition; it is what the Man comes from, and is otherwise known as the "inner core."  At our navel is the red element of enlightenment our mother gives us, in its original condition; this is what the Wife comes from, and is otherwise known as the "drop," or the "tilaka."  From the indivisible combination of these two we bring forth the central Angel.  The inner-core drop contains four minute particles of the four elements; and it is from these that we bring forth the four heart Angels.

gru.acip: MKHAS MCHOG DNGUL CHU BAS AE Wm GZUGS SGRUB LTAR BSHAD NA NGES SHES STER BAR GSUNGS PA MAN NGAG KHYAD PAR CAN YIN,
gru.wylie: mkhas mchog dngul chu bas ae wM gzugs sgrub ltar bshad na nges shes ster bar gsungs pa man ngag khyad par can yin
gru.english: The ultimate master, Ngulchu, has described the composition of the word evam, and it is said that if we use the same method here, it can provide us with a solid understanding; this saying itself is a very special piece of advice for us.

gru.acip: DES NA Bm YIG GZUGS SGRUB LAS NGES DGOS PAS, MTSAN BRJOD LAS, STONG PA CHEN PO YI GE LNGA, ,ZHES PA LTAR AA AI AU Ri Li LNGAR GNAS PA LAS PHAN TSUN MTSAMS SBYAR SKABS AU WA'O, ,ZHES PAS AU WA RU BSGYUR, DE BZHIN DU AI YA, Ri RA, Li LA RU BSGYUR BAS AA THUNG YA RA LA WA BZHIR GNAS PA Bm YIG TU BSGYUR BA STE,
gru.wylie: des na bM yig gzugs sgrub las nges dgos pas, mtshan brjod las, stong pa chen po yi ge lnga, ,zhes pa ltar aa ai au ri li lngar gnas pa las phan tshun mtshams sbyar skabs au wa'o, ,zhes pas au wa ru bsgyur, de bzhin du ai ya, ri ra, li la ru bsgyur bas aa thung ya ra la wa bzhir gnas pa bM yig tu bsgyur ba ste
gru.english: This we need to do by grasping the composition of the letter vam itself.  Reciting the Names speaks of "Great emptiness, the five letters."  This is referring to the five separate letters a, i, u, ir, and il.  When they are joined together, then �u to va,� which means that the uh changes into a va letter.  In like manner the i changes to ya, the ir becomes ra, and the il becomes la.  The short a residing in these four letters ya, ra, la, and va turns into the letter vam.

gru.acip: AA THUNG GRI GUG GI SO LTA BU, BYANG DU YA DBYUG PA LTA BU, SHAR DU WA THIG LE'I RNAM PA, LHOR LA ZLA TSES KYI RNAM PA, NUB TU RA THONG GSHOL GYI RNAM PA CAN, DE RNAMS 'DUS PA LAS RGYA YIG GI Bm GZUGS GRUB PA YIN,
gru.wylie: aa thung gri gug gi so lta bu, byang du ya dbyug pa lta bu, shar du wa thig le'i rnam pa, lhor la zla tshes kyi rnam pa, nub tu ra thong gshol gyi rnam pa can, de rnams 'dus pa las rgya yig gi bM gzugs grub pa yin
gru.english: The short a has a shape like the blade of a chopknife; the ya is to the north and looks like a stick; the va in the east takes the form of a small circle; the la to the south is like a crescent; and the ra on the west resembles a plowshare.  When all these are come in together, the composite form is that of the Sanskrit letter vam.

gru.acip: H'Um NAS H'A BAR YI GE BRGYAD LA SGRUB GZHI RANG GI DBANG PO'I SGO BRGYAD KYI RTZA KHAMS LAS RIGS 'DRA GNYIS PA RE CHAD DE THIM PA YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS KHVA GDONG MA SOGS SGO MTSAMS MA BRGYAD BSKYED PA'AM,
gru.wylie: hUM nas hA bar yi ge brgyad la sgrub gzhi rang gi dbang po'i sgo brgyad kyi rtsa khams las rigs 'dra gnyis pa re chad de thim pa yongs su gyur pa las khva gdong ma sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed pa'am
gru.english: Next there are the eight channels, complete with their substances, which belong to the eight gateways of our senses; the building blocks of the secret world.  A copy of each splits off, and melts into one of the eight letters from hung up to ha.  The letters are transformed, and from them arise the eight Ladies of the gates and corners: Crowface and the rest.

gru.acip: GZHAN SO GNYIS PO RNAMS SKU MDOG RGYAN CHA LUGS PHYAG MTSAN SOGS PHYI'I RNAM PA RNAL 'BYOR MA GTZO MO LTA BU DMAR PO SHA STAG LA, NGO BO RAB GTUM MA NAS BRTZON 'GRUS CHEN MO'I BAR GYI THUGS GSUNG SKU 'KHOR GYI DPA' MO NYER BZHI DANG , KHVA GDONG MA SOGS SGO MTSAMS MA BRGYAD BCAS YIN,
gru.wylie: gzhan so gnyis po rnams sku mdog rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan sogs phyi'i rnam pa rnal 'byor ma gtso mo lta bu dmar po sha stag la, ngo bo rab gtum ma nas brtson 'grus chen mo'i bar gyi thugs gsung sku 'khor gyi dpa' mo nyer bzhi dang , khva gdong ma sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas yin
gru.english: The outer appearance of the remaining thirty-two Angels that is, their color, ornaments, dress, ritual instruments, and so on is in every case like the central Angel: red and the rest.  Their actual nature though is that of the twenty-four woman Warriors associated with holy body, speech, and mind the Angels from the Lady of Horrible Wrath up to the Lady of Effort along with the eight Ladies of the gates and corners: Crowface Lady and the others.

gru.acip: LUS DKYIL BSGOM SKABS BLO'I PHYOGS GCIG NAS RNAL 'BYOR MA SO BDUN PO RNAMS SGRUB GZHI RANG GI LUS KYI CHA SHAS RTZA KHAMS RNAMS LAS GRUB PAS RTZA KHAMS DE DANG DE DNGOS YIN SNYAM PA DGOS, DE MED NA LUS DKYIL DU MI 'GRO,
gru.wylie: lus dkyil bsgom skabs blo'i phyogs gcig nas rnal 'byor ma so bdun po rnams sgrub gzhi rang gi lus kyi cha shas rtsa khams rnams las grub pas rtsa khams de dang de dngos yin snyam pa dgos, de med na lus dkyil du mi 'gro
gru.english: While you are actually performing the meditation of the secret world of your body, part of your mind has to focus on the thirty- seven Angels and think how they are in reality this or that channel and substance, since they are made of different parts of your body, having come forth from the various channels and substances.  If this step is missing, then the practice is not one of the secret world of the body.

gru.acip: 'KHOR RNAMS LA'ANGx ZHABS GNONx YOD, 'DI'I SGRUB THABS SU ZLA GDAN 'DUG KYANG 'DI NYI GDAN BYAS NA CHOG ,BZHUGS GDAN DU PAD+MA MED,
gru.wylie: 'khor rnams la'angx zhabs gnonx yod, 'di'i sgrub thabs su zla gdan 'dug kyang 'di nyi gdan byas na chog ,bzhugs gdan du pad+ma med
gru.english: Now each of the Angels around the central figure is also smashing down with Her feet a pair of the two demons.*  The ritual text for this section says that they are all on a cushion of the moon, but it is also allowable to make it a sun cushion.  There is no lotus cushion on which they are seated here. * Translator's note: The Tibetan editor notes a possible error here.

gru.acip: NI PHYI'I RNAL 'BYOR MA SNGAGS SKYES LA BRTEN NA 'GRUB DKA' ZHING , ZHING SKYES LA BRTEN PA 'BRING , LHAN SKYES LA BRTEN NA MYUR BAR 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: ni phyi'i rnal 'byor ma sngags skyes la brten na 'grub dka' zhing , zhing skyes la brten pa 'bring , lhan skyes la brten na myur bar 'grub
gru.english: Suppose our practice is carried out with one of the different types of outer Angels.  When performed with an Angel born of the secret word, it is difficult to succeed in.  When carried out with an Angel of the sacred places, it is only moderately difficult; and when carried out with an Angel of the simultaneous is succeeded with speed.

gru.acip: YANG NA, CHOS NYID DANG CHOS CAN RO GCIG PAS CHOS THAMS CAD KYI STENG GI GNAS LUGS RANG BZHIN GYIS MA GRUB PA'I STONG PA DANG , BDE BA CHEN PO'I YE SHES GNYIS NGO BO DBYER MED DU SONG BA'I DPA' BO DPA' MO'I BDAG NYID DE NGA'O SNYAM DU BSAM PA GSUNGS TSUL GCIG STE,
gru.wylie: yang na, chos nyid dang chos can ro gcig pas chos thams cad kyi steng gi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa dang , bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du song ba'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bdag nyid de nga'o snyam du bsam pa gsungs tshul gcig ste
gru.english: Another tradition is also taught, which reads the line as follows.  The very nature that things have, and the things that have this nature, are of a single feeling; therefore the way of being that all things have their emptiness in being free of any natural existence and the wisdom of great bliss blend inseparably, and the man and woman Warriors are this, and then I think of how I am all of them, joined into one.

gru.acip: GO CHA BGO SKABS GO CHA'I LHA LA GSHIN RJE MA SOGS MTSAN MI 'DRA BA BTAGS PA LAS, DON LA GO CHA'I DPA' BO'AM LHA YAB DRUG NI, NGO BO RNAM SNANG , RIN 'BYUNG , 'OD DPAG MED, DON GRUB, MI BSKYOD PA, RDO RJE 'CHANG STE DRUG ,DPA' MO DRUG NI DE DRUG GI YUM DRUG STE, SPYAN MA, M'A MA K'I, GOS DKAR MO, SGROL MA, RDO RJE PHAG MO, RDO RJE DBYINGS KYI DBANG PHYUG MA BCAS YIN,
gru.wylie: go cha bgo skabs go cha'i lha la gshin rje ma sogs mtshan mi 'dra ba btags pa las, don la go cha'i dpa' bo'am lha yab drug ni, ngo bo rnam snang , rin 'byung , 'od dpag med, don grub, mi bskyod pa, rdo rje 'chang ste drug ,dpa' mo drug ni de drug gi yum drug ste, spyan ma, mA ma kI, gos dkar mo, sgrol ma, rdo rje phag mo, rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma bcas yin
gru.english: As we don the armor we mention each of the Angels of armor by a different names such as the "Lady of Death" or the like.  In actual fact though They are the six man Warriors or Angels and Their woman Warrior mates.  The six males are the Buddhas known as Appearances, Jewels, Limitless Light, Attaining, Unmoving, and Keeper of the Diamond.  Their six female mates are the Buddhas named Lady of the Eyes, Mamaki, the Lady in White, the Lady of Freedom, the Diamond Sow, and Queen of the Diamond Sphere.

gru.acip: JI LTAR BLTAMS PA'I TSIG RKANG GNYIS PA LA CHO GA GZHAN DU, LHA RNAMS KYIS NI ZHES PA RGYAL BU GZHON NU DON GRUB SKU BLTAMS MA THAG THUN MONG BA LTAR NA, LHA TSANGS PA DANG BRGYA BYIN SOGS KYIS KHRUS GSOL BA LTAR LHA'I CHUS DBANG BSKUR BA'I THA SNYAD BYAS PA DANG ,
gru.wylie: ji ltar bltams pa'i tshig rkang gnyis pa la cho ga gzhan du, lha rnams kyis ni zhes pa rgyal bu gzhon nu don grub sku bltams ma thag thun mong ba ltar na, lha tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs kyis khrus gsol ba ltar lha'i chus dbang bskur ba'i tha snyad byas pa dang
gru.english: Now the lines from "Just as all" down to "His birth" read differently in other rituals.  There instead of "all Who've Gone That Way" they say "the gods."  This refers to an event that occurred just after the young prince Siddhartha took His holy birth.  In the path which is shared by the open and secret teachings, the phrase would go, "We grant you the empowerment with this water of the gods," just as the gods named Pure One and Hundred Gift made offering to the Prince by bathing Him.

gru.acip: GTOR MA 'BUL BA NI DNGOS GRUB ZHU BA'I PHYIR YIN PAS BDAG BSKYED KYI LHA LA 'BUL MI DGOS,
gru.wylie: gtor ma 'bul ba ni dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir yin pas bdag bskyed kyi lha la 'bul mi dgos
gru.english: Offering a torma cake, on the other hand, is done for the purpose of requesting that one be granted attainments, and so there is no need to present one to the Angel as you have become Her.

gru.acip: BDAG MED MA'I RNAM PA CAN GYIS BYA DGOS PA SNGAR BDAG MED MA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYIS 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS PAS SHES SHING , 'ON KYANG LHA PHO'I RNAM PA CAN DU BSGOMS PA LA HE RU KA ZHES THA SNYAD BYAS PA'O, ,BH'A WA'I 'GREL PAR SKYES BUR 'GYUR GYI DOD LA 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ZHES 'BYUNG BA LEGS TE, PHO'I RNAM PAR BSGYUR BA NI SKYES BU NYID KYIS BSTAN ZIN PA'I PHYIR RO, ,ZHES MKHAS GRUB RJE'I BRTAG GNYIS PHYI MA'I LE'U GNYIS PA'I RNAM BSHAD LAS GSUNGS PA LTAR 'DIR SBYOR SHES PA DGOS TSUL,
gru.wylie: bdag med ma'i rnam pa can gyis bya dgos pa sngar bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor gyis 'grub par gsungs pas shes shing , 'on kyang lha pho'i rnam pa can du bsgoms pa la he ru ka zhes tha snyad byas pa'o, ,bhA wa'i 'grel par skyes bur 'gyur gyi dod la 'grub par 'gyur, zhes 'byung ba legs te, pho'i rnam par bsgyur ba ni skyes bu nyid kyis bstan zin pa'i phyir ro, ,zhes mkhas grub rje'i brtag gnyis phyi ma'i le'u gnyis pa'i rnam bshad las gsungs pa ltar 'dir sbyor shes pa dgos tshul
gru.english: Our Lama noted that we had to understood how to apply these lines in keeping with the following statement from Kedrup Je's explanation of the second chapter of the latter Text of Two Sections: The fact that you must do it with the form of the Lady of No-Self-Nature can be understood from the earlier statement that you  "attain the goal through the practice of the Lady of No-Self-Nature."  You do though just call yourself  "Heruka," and meditate on yourself as having the form of a male Angel.  	The statement in Bhatva's commentary that  "You attain the goal as the surrogate, as one who's become a man" is quite good, because transforming oneself into the form of a male has already been indicated in the phrase  "only a man."

gru.acip: DE LA PHO NYA ZHES PA NI BANG CHEN LTA BU 'DOD DON SGRUB MI LA ZER BA BZHIN, RANG GI LAM MYUR DU BGROD PAR BYED PAS NA, RANG PHO YIN NA DPA' BO DANG MO YIN NA DPA' MO RNAMS PHO NYA YIN,
gru.wylie: de la pho nya zhes pa ni bang chen lta bu 'dod don sgrub mi la zer ba bzhin, rang gi lam myur du bgrod par byed pas na, rang pho yin na dpa' bo dang mo yin na dpa' mo rnams pho nya yin
gru.english: Now the word  "Messenger" here is meant in the sense of an emissary: someone who goes and gets something done that you wish accomplished.  And since They help you complete your journey of the path with speed, then the male Warriors (if you are yourself a female) or female Warriors (if you are a male) are in this case your Messengers.

gru.acip: LTE BA'I AOm Bm LAS 'OD ZER DMAR PO SPROS PAS SKED PA NAS LTE BA'I BAR GYI SHA LPAGS KYI NANG THAMS CAD KHYAB, DE BZHIN DU RANG RANG GI YI GE'I MDOG DANG MTSUNGS PA'I 'OD ZER SPROS PAS LTE BA NAS SNYING GA DANG , SNYING GA NAS MGRIN PA DANG , MGRIN PA NAS SKRA MTSAMS DANG , SKRA MTSAMS NAS SPYI GTZUG GI BAR DANG , DPUNG PA GNYIS NAS GRU MO'I KHUG DANG DE NAS SOR RTZE'I BAR DANG , DPYI GNYIS NAS PUS MO'I BAR DANG , DE NAS RKANG RTZE'I BAR THAMS CAD 'OD ZER GYIS KHYAB CING ,
gru.wylie: lte ba'i aoM bM las 'od zer dmar po spros pas sked pa nas lte ba'i bar gyi sha lpags kyi nang thams cad khyab, de bzhin du rang rang gi yi ge'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer spros pas lte ba nas snying ga dang , snying ga nas mgrin pa dang , mgrin pa nas skra mtshams dang , skra mtshams nas spyi gtsug gi bar dang , dpung pa gnyis nas gru mo'i khug dang de nas sor rtse'i bar dang , dpyi gnyis nas pus mo'i bar dang , de nas rkang rtse'i bar thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab cing
gru.english: Red rays of light come forth from the om and the vam at our navel and spread between the flesh and skin, covering the entire area from the hips to the navel.  Similar rays of light, each with its corresponding color, spread out to cover the area from the navel to the heart; from the heart to the throat; the throat to the hairline; and hairline to tip of head. Light also spreads from the two shoulders down to the crook of the elbows, and from these down to the tips of the fingers.  The same thing happens from the two hip joints down to the knees, and then further down to the tips of the toes-- --until every single place of our body is enveloped in the crimson light.

whole_word_matches.context: tshams nas spyi gtsug gi bar dang , dpung pa gnyis nas gru mo'i khug dang de nas sor rtse'i bar dang , dpyi gnyis

gru.acip: LTE BA'I AOm Bm LAS 'OD ZER DMAR PO SPROS PAS SKED PA NAS LTE BA'I BAR GYI SHA LPAGS KYI NANG THAMS CAD KHYAB, DE BZHIN DU RANG RANG GI YI GE'I MDOG DANG MTSUNGS PA'I 'OD ZER SPROS PAS LTE BA NAS SNYING GA DANG , SNYING GA NAS MGRIN PA DANG , MGRIN PA NAS SKRA MTSAMS DANG , SKRA MTSAMS NAS SPYI GTZUG GI BAR DANG , DPUNG PA GNYIS NAS GRU MO'I KHUG DANG DE NAS SOR RTZE'I BAR DANG , DPYI GNYIS NAS PUS MO'I BAR DANG , DE NAS RKANG RTZE'I BAR THAMS CAD 'OD ZER GYIS KHYAB CING ,
gru.wylie: lte ba'i aoM bM las 'od zer dmar po spros pas sked pa nas lte ba'i bar gyi sha lpags kyi nang thams cad khyab, de bzhin du rang rang gi yi ge'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer spros pas lte ba nas snying ga dang , snying ga nas mgrin pa dang , mgrin pa nas skra mtshams dang , skra mtshams nas spyi gtsug gi bar dang , dpung pa gnyis nas gru mo'i khug dang de nas sor rtse'i bar dang , dpyi gnyis nas pus mo'i bar dang , de nas rkang rtse'i bar thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab cing
gru.english: We have to think that our set of armor is just like the Armor of the Obliterator: that is, if we look closely at the light in which we are covered, we can see that in reality it is made of this or that seed syllable.  This is how the accomplished saint Kambala intended for us to don the armor, and it is a crucial hidden points.

gru.acip: DBANG PHYUG PHUN TSOGS NI SGRIB GNYIS BAG CHAGS DANG BCAS PA SPANGS SHING GZHAN DBANG DU MA GYUR PA'O, ,GZUGS BZANG NI GONG NA MED PA'I MTSAN DPE'O, ,GRAGS PA NI PHYOGS DUS KUN TU SNYAN PAS KHYAB PA'O, ,DPAL NI 'JIG RTEN LAS 'DAS PA'I PHUN TSOGS 'DOD PA THAMS CAD KYIS BRTAN PAR BYAS PA'O, ,YE SHES NI SHES BYA THAMS CAD LA CHAGS THOGS MED PAR 'JUG PA'O, ,BRTZON 'GRUS NI LHUN GYIS GRUB PA DANG RGYUN MI CHAD PAR GSUNG GIS 'DOMS PA'O,
gru.wylie: dbang phyug phun tshogs ni sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs shing gzhan dbang du ma gyur pa'o, ,gzugs bzang ni gong na med pa'i mtshan dpe'o, ,grags pa ni phyogs dus kun tu snyan pas khyab pa'o, ,dpal ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs 'dod pa thams cad kyis brtan par byas pa'o, ,ye shes ni shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'o, ,brtson 'grus ni lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi chad par gsung gis 'doms pa'o
gru.english: The phrase "total lord of power" refers to having eliminated both the obstacles, together with all their seeds, and to the fact that one will never again come under their domination. The words "excellent form" refer to the marks and signs on the body of a Buddha, for no higher form exists. "Renown" means that one's fame has reached to every place, and every time that there is. "Glory" refers to the total excellence of having transcended the world, reinforced by achieving all ones' wishes. "Wisdom" is the ability of the mind to engage in every knowable thing that exists, without the slightest obstruction. "Effort" means to give instruction, with words that are totally spontaneous, in an unbroken flow.

gru.acip: NYON MONGS, PHUNG PO, LHA'I BU, 'CHI BDAG GI BDUD BZHI BCOM ZHING, BCOM LDAN GYI SKAD DOD BHA GA W'AN ZHES PA'I BHA GA SKAL BA DANG, W'A NA NI LDAN PA'I DON TE, DBANG PHYUG PHUN TSOGS NAS BRTZON 'GRUS PHUN TSOGS KYI BAR GYI SKAL BA DRUG DANG LDAN PA DANG,
gru.wylie: nyon mongs, phung po, lha'i bu, 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi bcom zhing, bcom ldan gyi skad dod bha ga wAn zhes pa'i bha ga skal ba dang, wA na ni ldan pa'i don te, dbang phyug phun tshogs nas brtson 'grus phun tshogs kyi bar gyi skal ba drug dang ldan pa dang
gru.english: One has conquered the four different demons: the mental afflictions, the heaps, the so-called "Son of the Pleasure Being of Power," and the Lord of Death. Remember that the Sanskrit original for the term "One who Has the Conquest" is Bhagavan.  The word bhaga refers to a "share," or a good quality that one is fortunate enough to share.  The word van means to "have."  The quotation of Lord Tsongkapa above lists the six qualities traditionally referred to in this way, starting with being a "total lord of power" and continuing on to "effort."  And so the Angel is Bhagavan, for She has all these qualities.

gru.acip: DGA' RAB DBANG PHYUG SOGS NAG PO SDE DANG BCAS PA PHYI'I BDUD, CHAGS SOGS NAS SNANG MCHED THOB GSUM GYI GNYIS SNANG PHRA MO MAN CHAD NANG GI BDUD, BYANG CHUB SGRUB LA MI DGA' ZHING BAR DU GCOD PA'I NAG PHYOGS MI DANG MI MIN 'BYUNG PO THAMS CAD GSANG BA'I BDUD DE,
gru.wylie: dga' rab dbang phyug sogs nag po sde dang bcas pa phyi'i bdud, chags sogs nas snang mched thob gsum gyi gnyis snang phra mo man chad nang gi bdud, byang chub sgrub la mi dga' zhing bar du gcod pa'i nag phyogs mi dang mi min 'byung po thams cad gsang ba'i bdud de
gru.english: Now there are three kinds of demons.  The first are the outer demons, beings like the powerful worldly creature named "Eminent Lord," and all their evil followers.  Then there are the inner demons, everything from desire and the rest on up to very subtle forms of the appearance of duality: those known as the appearance, the spread, and the attainment.  Finally come the secret demons: each and every evil being, human or inhuman, that belongs to the side of darkness: anyone who despises seeing us reach enlightenment, and who works to hinder us.

gru.acip: RDO RJE PHAG MO NI SNGAR LTAR DANG, SBYOR CHEN NI RNAL 'BYOR MA CHEN MO ZHES PA'O, ,BSHES GNYEN BSTEN TSUL NAS MI SLOB PA'I ZUNG 'JUG BAR GYI 'DOD PA'I DNGOS GRUB GNYIS CI DGAR STZOL BA LA DBANG BA'AM, RANG NYID LAM DE DAG LA MNGA' DBANG 'BYOR BAS NA 'DOD DBANG MA,
gru.wylie: rdo rje phag mo ni sngar ltar dang, sbyor chen ni rnal 'byor ma chen mo zhes pa'o, ,bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug bar gyi 'dod pa'i dngos grub gnyis ci dgar stsol ba la dbang ba'am, rang nyid lam de dag la mnga' dbang 'byor bas na 'dod dbang ma
gru.english: The words "Diamond Sow" are the same as before.  "Mighty Angel" refers to the Mighty One, the Lady, the Holy Angel of Diamond.  She is a Queen who has it in Her power to grant us whichever os the two kinds of attainments we might hope for: everything from finding a spiritual Guide and serving Him or Her properly, on up to the state of secret Union where there is nothing more to learn.  You can also say She's called the "Queen of Hopes" because She has gained total and absolute mastery over the entire range of these spiritual paths.

gru.acip: RTZA RGYUD LE'U SO BRGYAD PA LAS, ,SLOB DPON DPA' BO MTHONG GYUR NA, ,SGRUB PA POS NI SNGAGS 'DI DAG ,MTHONG ZHING MTHONG ZHING KUN TU DGA', ,DPA' BO'I RTZA BA'I GSANG SNGAGS MCHOG ,LAN BDUN DU NI BRJOD PAR BYA, ,RAB SNGAGS H'Um LA SOGS PAS PHYE,
gru.wylie: rtsa rgyud le'u so brgyad pa las, ,slob dpon dpa' bo mthong gyur na, ,sgrub pa pos ni sngags 'di dag ,mthong zhing mthong zhing kun tu dga', ,dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i gsang sngags mchog ,lan bdun du ni brjod par bya, ,rab sngags hUM la sogs pas phye
gru.english: Chapter 38 of the secret root text states, Whenever the one who follows this practice Happens to see the Master, the Warrior, Then he or she should recite seven times The praises here, for they are the highest Root secret words of all the Warriors; Space each praise with hung and the rest Look, look again, and sing with joy.

gru.acip: DE LTA RANG RE RNAMS HE RU KA YAB YUM SOGS DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO RNAMS DANG DNGOS SU MJAL BA'I SKAL BA NI MED, BSGRUB NA 'GRUB BAM MI 'GRUB SNYAM PA DANG, SPYAN DRANGS NA 'BYON NAM MI 'BYON SNYAM DU THE TSOM BYED MOD,
gru.wylie: de lta rang re rnams he ru ka yab yum sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba ni med, bsgrub na 'grub bam mi 'grub snyam pa dang, spyan drangs na 'byon nam mi 'byon snyam du the tshom byed mod
gru.english: I have to admit you could have your doubts about all this.  After all, you and I have never had the virtue and fortune it would take to meet all these beings face-to-face, to actually see all these Warriors and their Angels Heruka Man and Wife, and the rest.  You might wonder whether, if you actually tried, you would be able to make this happen or not.  You might wonder whether, if you asked Them all to come, they would actually show up or not.

gru.acip: DKA' TSEGS CHEN PO'I RIM GRO RTEN 'BREL BYED PA DANG MI 'DRA BAR BYA SLA LA TSEGS CHUNG BA'I SGO NAS TSOGS GSOG SGRIB SBYONG RKYEN SEL RLABS PO CHE THAMS CAD SKAD CIG TU 'GRUB PA'I 'PHRUL GSANG SHIN TU CHE BA YIN PAS,
gru.wylie: dka' tshegs chen po'i rim gro rten 'brel byed pa dang mi 'dra bar bya sla la tshegs chung ba'i sgo nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong rkyen sel rlabs po che thams cad skad cig tu 'grub pa'i 'phrul gsang shin tu che ba yin pas
gru.english: But reciting the Eight Verses is way that's totally different from all these different hardships you undertake to honor the Holy Ones, or to assure some state of auspiciousness.  It is a great and powerful, secret machine that accomplishes in a single moment, in one broad sweep, everything you need: the massing together of virtue, the elimination of obstacles, and the clearing away of problems.  Besides, it's easy to do no trouble at all!

gru.acip: 'DI PHYIR BAR DO GSUM GYI DON GANG BSGRUB KYANG SHIN TU GCES PAS SHI GSON GANG GI DON BSGRUB KYANG 'DI NYID LA 'BAD DGOS,
gru.wylie: 'di phyir bar do gsum gyi don gang bsgrub kyang shin tu gces pas shi gson gang gi don bsgrub kyang 'di nyid la 'bad dgos
gru.english: This practice then is one you should hold dear to your heart, for with it you can achieve the goals of all three stages of your life: the life you have now, the lives you will live, and the times you will spend between them.  So no matter what you are working for, for living or for dying, this is the practice for you.

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG RKANG BRGYAD KYI BSTOD PA 'DON PA'I RNAL 'BYOR PA DE CHU BO, RGYA MTSO, RDZING BU LA SOGS PA CHU'I NANG DU GNAS PA'AM, RI BO'I RTZE DANG, LAM GYI BZHI MDO DANG, KHANG STONG DANG, LAM SRANG DANG, KHYIM LA SOGS PA PHYOGS GANG DU GNAS KYANG MKHA' 'GRO MA THAMS CAD SHIN TU CHAGS SHING DGYES PA'I SGO NAS DE LA GZIGS SHING 'GAL RKYEN SEL BA DANG, MTHUN RKYEN SGRUB PA'I GROGS NGES PAR MDZAD PA YIN TE,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa 'don pa'i rnal 'byor pa de chu bo, rgya mtsho, rdzing bu la sogs pa chu'i nang du gnas pa'am, ri bo'i rtse dang, lam gyi bzhi mdo dang, khang stong dang, lam srang dang, khyim la sogs pa phyogs gang du gnas kyang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad shin tu chags shing dgyes pa'i sgo nas de la gzigs shing 'gal rkyen sel ba dang, mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs nges par mdzad pa yin te
gru.english: It also doesn't matter where a practitioner who is reciting these Eight Verses may happen to find themselves: on the water somewhere on a river, an ocean, a pond, or the like; or else on top a mountain, or at some crossroads, in an abandoned house, on the road, in their home, anywhere.  No matter where he or she is, all of the Holy Angels will feel affection and joy over them; They will most certainly be his or her constant companion, and watch over them, and prevent any problems that may hinder them, and assure that he or she has whatever they needs to succeed in their spiritual practice.

gru.acip: CHED GNYER GYIS NGA RGYAL DANG GSAL SNANG SGRUB DGOS, DE MA BYUNG NA BSKYED RIM DNGOS GZHI CHAD 'GRO BAS BDAG BSKYED BSGOMS PA'I DGOS BSTOR BA YIN,
gru.wylie: ched gnyer gyis nga rgyal dang gsal snang sgrub dgos, de ma byung na bskyed rim dngos gzhi chad 'gro bas bdag bskyed bsgoms pa'i dgos bstor ba yin
gru.english: Therefore you must make a conscious effort at this point to achieve the states of supreme confidence and clear vision.  If you fail to do so, then the main event in the stage of creation will start to get lost, and the whole point of turning yourself into the Angel will be lost to the wind.

gru.acip: SGRUB THABS 'DON DUS TSIG DON SNGA MA SNGA MA MA BRJED PA'I STENG DU PHYI MA PHYI MA BSNON GYIN TSIG BSHAR DU MA SONG BAR BSGOMS DON RNAMS YID LA NGES PAR BYED,
gru.wylie: sgrub thabs 'don dus tshig don snga ma snga ma ma brjed pa'i steng du phyi ma phyi ma bsnon gyin tshig bshar du ma song bar bsgoms don rnams yid la nges par byed
gru.english: As you recite the ritual for becoming Her here, try to retain in your mind the meaning of each part that is finished and try to build on that with each part yet to come.  Don't get caught up in the flow of the words; try rather to take each point in the meditation and learn to grasp its importance fully.

gru.acip: 'DI'I MTSAMS SU GSAL SNANG CHED GNYER GYIS SGRUB PA LA, DBANG PO RAB KYIS GTZO BO NAS ME RI'I BAR LTA BU RNAM PA SPYI LA SEMS 'DZIN PA STOBS CHE ZHING,
gru.wylie: 'di'i mtshams su gsal snang ched gnyer gyis sgrub pa la, dbang po rab kyis gtso bo nas me ri'i bar lta bu rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa stobs che zhing
gru.english: At this juncture then you must make a conscious effort to develop the clear vision.  For those of strong intellect, it is extremely powerful if you can hold the mind on the entire scene, on something like the whole picture from the central Angel out to the mountain of fire.

gru.acip: NYES PA LNGA SPONG TSUL, 'DU BYED BRGYAD BSTEN TSUL, STOBS DRUG GIS BSGRUB LUGS, YID BYED BZHI YOD TSUL, BYING RGOD SPONG BA'I THABS, DRAN SHES KYIS SKYONG TSUL SOGS LA
gru.wylie: nyes pa lnga spong tshul, 'du byed brgyad bsten tshul, stobs drug gis bsgrub lugs, yid byed bzhi yod tshul, bying rgod spong ba'i thabs, dran shes kyis skyong tshul sogs la
gru.english: These sections present how to eliminate the five problems that prevent reaching quietude; how to employ eight types of solutions to them; the way in which to gain one's goals with six different forces; how there are four mental modes during this process; methods for stopping mental sinking and agitation; how to carry on recollection and watchfulness; and so on.

gru.acip: MKHAS PAR BYAS NAS BSKYANG NA, ZLA BA DRUG GIS ZHI GNAS 'GRUB PA DANG, LO GCIG GIS BSKYED RIM RAGS PA LA BRTAN PA THOB PA 'ONG BAR GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: mkhas par byas nas bskyang na, zla ba drug gis zhi gnas 'grub pa dang, lo gcig gis bskyed rim rags pa la brtan pa thob pa 'ong bar gsungs
gru.english: If you master all these subjects and then actually carry out all the instructions, said our Lama, you can attain the state of quietude within six months.  Within the span of a year too you can reach a very stable version of the stage of creation, in its grosser form.

gru.acip: ZHI GNAS BSGRUB PA LA GTZO BOR DRAN PAS SKYONG TSUL LA MKHAS PA GAL CHE, SHES BZHIN GYIS BYING RGOD 'ONG MI 'ONG LTA RTOG BYED PA LAS BYING RGOD KYI GNYEN PO MIN,
gru.wylie: zhi gnas bsgrub pa la gtso bor dran pas skyong tshul la mkhas pa gal che, shes bzhin gyis bying rgod 'ong mi 'ong lta rtog byed pa las bying rgod kyi gnyen po min
gru.english: As you strive to achieve this state of quietude, the main thing is to learn how to use recollection it is very important that you master this point.  Watchfulness only watches to see whether or not mental sinking and agitation are approaching; it is not in itself a counteragent that could stop these two.

gru.acip: DANG POR GSAL SNANG DANG GNAS CHA GNYIS SO SO NAS BSGRUB, DE YANG DPYAD SGOM LA BRTEN NAS GSAL CHA DANG, 'JOG SGOM LA BRTEN NAS GNAS CHA BSGRUB PA YIN,
gru.wylie: dang por gsal snang dang gnas cha gnyis so so nas bsgrub, de yang dpyad sgom la brten nas gsal cha dang, 'jog sgom la brten nas gnas cha bsgrub pa yin
gru.english: Nevertheless, at the beginning you reach these two clarity of the vision, and fixation independent of each other.  Clarity in your meditation is achieved by using the analytical form of meditation; fixation is attained by using the fixed form of meditation.  You must try to reach a state where two conditions are present in combination: the clarity should have intensity, and the fixation should be very firm, single-pointed.

gru.acip: DE YANG DANG POR SNGAR ZHUS PA LTAR GSAL SNANG DANG GNAS CHA GNYIS SO SOR SGRUB DGOS, BDE GSANG SKABS NAS BYUNG BA LTAR DPYAD SGOM LA BRTEN NAS GSAL CHA'I NGAR YOD PA DANG, 'JOG SGOM LA BRTEN NAS GNAS CHA BRTAN PO RTZE GCIG PA GNYIS TSOGS LA GONG BZHIN 'BAD PAS NGES PAR 'GRUB PA'ONG GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: de yang dang por sngar zhus pa ltar gsal snang dang gnas cha gnyis so sor sgrub dgos, bde gsang skabs nas byung ba ltar dpyad sgom la brten nas gsal cha'i ngar yod pa dang, 'jog sgom la brten nas gnas cha brtan po rtse gcig pa gnyis tshogs la gong bzhin 'bad pas nges par 'grub pa'ong gsungs
gru.english: Our Lama then asked us to remember though that, as He had already mentioned, we would in the beginning have to develop these two qualities clearness and fixation one by one, independently of one another.  He spoke of how, in the teachings of Highest Bliss and the Secret Collection, one uses analytical meditation to reach intensity in the picture's clarity, and fixed meditation to attain firm, single-pointed fixation.  If we could make good effort in achieving a combination of these two, then we would with certainty succeed in this practice.

gru.acip: DE LTAR GSAL SNANG SGRUB PA NI THA MAL GYI SNANG BA'I GNYEN PO DANG, NGA RGYAL SGRUB PA NI THA MAL GYI ZHEN PA'I GNYEN PO YIN PAS NGA RGYAL LA'ANG SLOB DGOS,
gru.wylie: de ltar gsal snang sgrub pa ni tha mal gyi snang ba'i gnyen po dang, nga rgyal sgrub pa ni tha mal gyi zhen pa'i gnyen po yin pas nga rgyal la'ang slob dgos
gru.english: Practicing to achieve the clarity of the vision described above serves as an antidote against things appearing as normal, everyday.  Practicing to reach the supreme level of confidence provides the antidote to believing that things are normal, just everyday.  Therefore we must train ourselves in supreme confidence as well.

gru.acip: 'DI LA KHA CIG GIS, DE LTAR BSKYED PA'I SKU DE GZHAN GYI YIN PAS DE LA NGA RGYAL BYED PA MI RIGS SNYAM NA, SKYON MED DE, DPER NA DA LTA'I RANG GI LUS 'DI YANG SKYE BA SNGA MA NAS RANG GIS KHYER TE 'ONGS PA MIN PAR PHA MA'I KHU KHRAG LAS GRUB PAS GZHAN GYI YIN YANG NGA'I LUS SO SNYAM DU 'DZIN PA DANG,
gru.wylie: 'di la kha cig gis, de ltar bskyed pa'i sku de gzhan gyi yin pas de la nga rgyal byed pa mi rigs snyam na, skyon med de, dper na da lta'i rang gi lus 'di yang skye ba snga ma nas rang gis khyer te 'ongs pa min par pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pas gzhan gyi yin yang nga'i lus so snyam du 'dzin pa dang
gru.english: Now some people might think to themselves, "The holy body that you are creating this way is somebody else's; it doesn't make sense to feel supreme confidence that is you."  But there's no such problem.  Consider for example the body you have right now; it didn't get here because you packed it up and brought it with you from your previous life.  It's made from the sperm and blood of your father and mother, so it's somebody else's too.  But you still consider it yours, don't you?

gru.acip: DGON PA'I DGE SKOS SOGS KYANG DANG PO NAS DER MA GRUB PA LA GDAGS GZHI 'DOGS BYED KYI RKYEN TSOGS TE MING BRDAS PHAR BTAGS PA NA DGE SKOS SOGS BSNYON MED DU GRUB PA LTAR YIN,
gru.wylie: dgon pa'i dge skos sogs kyang dang po nas der ma grub pa la gdags gzhi 'dogs byed kyi rkyen tshogs te ming brdas phar btags pa na dge skos sogs bsnyon med du grub pa ltar yin
gru.english: People like the master of discipline in some monastery aren't that way from the beginning either.  All the right conditions get together a reasonable basis to call the "master of discipline," and someone to call him "master of discipline" and then he is labelled with the name and the concept, "master of discipline."  When that happens he really is the master of discipline, and undeniably so.  Here it's just the same.

gru.acip: BSKYED RIM BSGOM TSE YI DAM GYI NGA RGYAL BRTAN PO 'GRUB MI 'GRUB THOG MA'I STONG SBYANGS LEGS NYES LA RAG LAS, DE MA LEGS NA THA MAL SNANG ZHEN GYI KHA YA MI CHOD PAR KLONG RDOL BLA MAS GSUNGS TSUL,
gru.wylie: bskyed rim bsgom tshe yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan po 'grub mi 'grub thog ma'i stong sbyangs legs nyes la rag las, de ma legs na tha mal snang zhen gyi kha ya mi chod par klong rdol bla mas gsungs tshul
gru.english: As you meditate upon the stage of creation, the question of whether you can achieve a very firm level of this supreme confidence all depends on how well you carry out the initial purification of things into emptiness.  If this does not go well then, as Longdol Lama used to say, "Lip service doesn't cut it with grasping to things as normal."

gru.acip: GSUM PA NI, DRIL BU PAS, ,MYUR DU DNGOS GRUB BYED 'DOD PAS, ,PHYAG RGYA'I MCHOD 'DIS THE TSHOM MED, ,CES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: gsum pa ni, dril bu pas, ,myur du dngos grub byed 'dod pas, ,phyag rgya'i mchod 'dis the tshhom med, ,ces gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: Then the third offering: the secret one.  As Ghantapada himself has said -- If you want to reach Your spiritual goals with speed, It can be done with this offering Of a holy partner; of this There is no doubt.

gru.acip: BZHI PA NI, DE LA BRTEN NAS CHOS THAMS CAD RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA RDUL TZAM YANG MED PA'I STONG NYID RTOGS PA NI TSIG DBANG GI DNGOS GZHI YIN NO, ,DE NAS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA KHAtV'Am GAR SNGAR LTAR GYUR PAR BSAM,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa ni, de la brten nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa ni tshig dbang gi dngos gzhi yin no, ,de nas 'khor lo sdom pa khaTvAM gar sngar ltar gyur par bsam
gru.english: Last is the fourth offering: that of suchness.  Due to the previous empowerment, we now go into the perception of emptiness, which is where no object in the entire universe possesses even a single atom of existing through some nature of its own.  This is the actual event of the empowerment of the word.

gru.acip: GZHAN LUGS LA SNGAGS 'DRA MIN SNA TSOGS 'JUG KYANG, 'DIR BKOD PA DGE LUGS RANG GI 'DON RGYUN LTAR BYINGS DAG PAR YOD CING, KA ME SHVA RI KHA GE ZHES PA'I KHA GE'I SNGAGS DON CHAD PA 'DRA BAS MKHA' 'GROR BSGYUR TE, 'DOD DBANG MKHA' 'GROR 'DUD CES BRJOD DO, ,BOD SKAD KYI DON RGYA CHEN POR 'GYUR BAS MA SPROS SHING BSTOD PA GRUB NAS LHA MO BAm YIG LA BSDU BA'O,,
gru.wylie: gzhan lugs la sngags 'dra min sna tshogs 'jug kyang, 'dir bkod pa dge lugs rang gi 'don rgyun ltar byings dag par yod cing, ka me shva ri kha ge zhes pa'i kha ge'i sngags don chad pa 'dra bas mkha' 'gror bsgyur te, 'dod dbang mkha' 'gror 'dud ces brjod do, ,bod skad kyi don rgya chen por 'gyur bas ma spros shing bstod pa grub nas lha mo baM yig la bsdu ba'o
gru.english: Other traditions have this mantra in a whole variety of different forms, but the version I've set forth here is that of our own Gelukpa tradition of recitation, and is of authoritative source.  As for the one line with kameshvari khage, it seems in certain cases that the Tibetan words correlating to the khage have been mistakenly dropped.  This khage is to be translated as Angel, and so the line would be adjusted to "I bow to You, Angel of Conquest" and so on.  Since it would go on at quite some length if I were to translate all the pieces of the mantra for you here, I will not be elaborating on that.  Once the praise has been completed, withdraw the Goddesses back to the vam letter.

gru.acip: 'DI DAG GI SKABS SU ZAB GSAL GNYIS SU MED PA'I RNAL 'BYOR BSKYED RIM GYI SMIN BYED KHYAD PAR CAN DU 'GYUR TE, RNAM PA LHA LA DMIGS PA NI GSAL BA GZUGS SKU SGRUB BYED DANG, 'DZIN STANGS RANG BZHIN MED PAR ZAB PA CHOS SKU SGRUB BYED DANG, DE LTA BU'I NGA RGYAL GSAL SNANG YOD PA NI THABS SHES GNYIS MED KYI RNAL 'BYOR PA YIN LA, DE MIN RDZUN TE SNGAGS KYI SBOM PO 'BYUNG NGO,,
gru.wylie: 'di dag gi skabs su zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor bskyed rim gyi smin byed khyad par can du 'gyur te, rnam pa lha la dmigs pa ni gsal ba gzugs sku sgrub byed dang, 'dzin stangs rang bzhin med par zab pa chos sku sgrub byed dang, de lta bu'i nga rgyal gsal snang yod pa ni thabs shes gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor pa yin la, de min rdzun te sngags kyi sbom po 'byung ngo
gru.english: Maintaining what we call the "yoga of indivisible depth and clarity" at points like this acts as a powerful force for bringing your practice of the stage of creation to its final ripening.  Seeing yourself in the form of the Goddess functions to bring you the Form Body of a Buddha: which is what the "clarity" in the name of the yoga refers to.  Maintaining a certain perception as you do so -- that is, holding that nothing here has any nature of its own -- functions to bring you the Dharma Body of a Buddha: the "depth" in the name of the yoga.

gru.acip: DGU PA BZLAS BA BYA BA LA, BZLAS PA'I DGOS PA NI, YI DAM GYI LHA NYE BAR BYED PA DANG, SDIG PA ZAD PA DANG, NGAG NUS PA DANG LDAN PA, LAS 'GRUB PA, GSUNG RDO RJE 'GRUB PA'I NUS PA 'JOG PA, RDOR BZLAS KYI SMIN BYED DU 'GYUR BA, SNGAGS BZLAS PAS LHA'I THUGS RGYUD BSKUL TE DNGOS GRUB MYUR DU STZOL BA SOGS KYI CHED DU YIN,
gru.wylie: dgu pa bzlas ba bya ba la, bzlas pa'i dgos pa ni, yi dam gyi lha nye bar byed pa dang, sdig pa zad pa dang, ngag nus pa dang ldan pa, las 'grub pa, gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa 'jog pa, rdor bzlas kyi smin byed du 'gyur ba, sngags bzlas pas lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te dngos grub myur du stsol ba sogs kyi ched du yin
gru.english: We have now reached the ninth of the eleven practices: the practice of recitation.  What is the purpose of this recitation?  It has many functions, among them the following: it brings the Close Angels closer to us; wears out the power of our bad deeds; gives our speech power; helps us accomplish our spiritual work; plants in us the ability to achieve the diamond of enlightened speech; ripens the power of our practice of the recitation of the Warrior of Diamond; and, as we recite the secret words, it calls in the holy minds of the Angels, asking that They quickly bestow upon us all our spiritual aims.

gru.acip: SPYIR YANG SNGAGS 'DI SHIN TU GSANG DGOS PA 'JAM BZHAD LA RGYAL PO ZHIG GIS CHOS 'BREL ZHUS PAR 'JAM BZHAD KYIS ZHABS 'BRING PA THAMS CAD PHYIR BSKRAD DE SHIN TU GSANG BA'I TSUL DU, BADZRA P'A nI'I LUNG GNANG BAS DE LA GZHAN PAS 'GRUB SLA ZHING PHAN CHE BA BYUNG TSUL,
gru.wylie: spyir yang sngags 'di shin tu gsang dgos pa 'jam bzhad la rgyal po zhig gis chos 'brel zhus par 'jam bzhad kyis zhabs 'bring pa thams cad phyir bskrad de shin tu gsang ba'i tshul du, badzra pA Ni'i lung gnang bas de la gzhan pas 'grub sla zhing phan che ba byung tshul
gru.english: In general this thing called the "secret word" must absolutely be kept secret.  There is an account of how a certain king asked Jamshe to grant him the relationship that comes from teaching and learning the Dharma together.  Jamshe first took all the attendants to the king and chased them out of the room, and then in the strictest secrecy bestowed upon the king the oral transmission of Vajrapani.  This made it much easier for the other person to attain his spiritual goals, and proved a great benefit.

gru.acip: AOm GSUM MA 'DI LA SNYING PO DANG NYE SNYING LAS RTZA SNGAGS MED, 'ON KYANG 'DIS DE GSUM GA'I GO CHOD, SGRUB THABS RIN 'BYUNG GI PHAG MO DBU BCAD MA'I SKABS SU,
gru.wylie: aoM gsum ma 'di la snying po dang nye snying las rtsa sngags med, 'on kyang 'dis de gsum ga'i go chod, sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi phag mo dbu bcad ma'i skabs su
gru.english: The formula of the triple om has only an essence version and a close essence version; there is no root version.  It does however suffice completely for all three.  The Source of Jewels, a ritual for reaching an Angel, describes the secret words in the section on the Sow whose name is Headless.

gru.acip: 'DI'I KHUNGS AOm GSUM MA'I SNGAGS DON 'JAM MGON TZONG KHA PAS BDE MCHOG SGRUB THABS 'DOD 'JO LAS,
gru.wylie: 'di'i khungs aoM gsum ma'i sngags don 'jam mgon tsong kha pas bde mchog sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo las
gru.english: The basis for this explication is an explanation of the secret words of the triple om made by our Gentle Savior, Tsongkapa, in His work called The Cow which Gives the Milk of Whatever You Wish, a treatise on the ritual for reaching the Angel of Highest Bliss:

gru.acip: SARBA BUDDHA d'A KI N'I YE NI SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI MKHA' 'GRO MA STE, d'A KI ZHES PA MKHA' 'GRO LA 'JUG PA dI 'GRO BA LA'O, ,ZHES PA'I BYINGS BZHAG STE BSGRUB TSUL,
gru.wylie: sarba buddha DA ki nI ye ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma ste, DA ki zhes pa mkha' 'gro la 'jug pa Di 'gro ba la'o, ,zhes pa'i byings bzhag ste bsgrub tshul
gru.english: Our Lama then described how the original Sanskrit roots can help us establish that the words sarva Buddha Dakiniye indicate "every Woman Angel Buddha."  He referred us to the line that states, "Daki refers to 'Angel', the one who flies through the sky, the one who flies through the di."

gru.acip: DE LTAR 'BYUNG BA'I RGYU MTSAN YANG THU'U BKVAN RIN PO CHE SOGS DAM PA SNGA MA RNAMS KYIS GSUNGS BA LTAR BSGRUB BYA'I YUL DU GYUR PA'I MKHA' 'GRO MA GRANGS MED RNAMS BSDU NA YUL NYER BZHI DUR KHROD BRGYAD GLING BZHI RI RAB BCAS SO BDUN DU BZHUGS PA'I DPA' BO DANG RNAL 'BYOR MA RNAMS SU 'DU ZHING, DE KUN KYANG GTZO MO RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAR 'DU,
gru.wylie: de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang thu'u bkvan rin po che sogs dam pa snga ma rnams kyis gsungs ba ltar bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma grangs med rnams bsdu na yul nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad gling bzhi ri rab bcas so bdun du bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams su 'du zhing, de kun kyang gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar 'du
gru.english: The reason why this is true can be found in the sacred words of Tuken Rinpoche, and other Holy Ones of days gone by.  The infinite number of Holy Woman Angels whom you could ever hope to reach are all present in the Warriors and Holy Angels who reside in the thirty seven lands: in the twenty four sacred places, the eight burial grounds, and the four continents--together with Mount Supreme.  All of them are present as well in the central figure, the Holy Angel of Diamond herself.

gru.acip: YES 'KHOR LO'I SHUGS CAN MA, BAS DUM SKYES MA, DZRA YIS CHANG TSONG MA, BEES 'KHOR LO'I GO CHA MA, ROS SHIN TU DPA' MO, TZAS STOBS CHEN MA, N'IS 'KHOR LOS SGYUR MA, YES BRTZON 'GRUS CHEN MO STE SKU'I BRGYAD,
gru.wylie: yes 'khor lo'i shugs can ma, bas dum skyes ma, dzra yis chang tshong ma, bees 'khor lo'i go cha ma, ros shin tu dpa' mo, tsas stobs chen ma, nIs 'khor los sgyur ma, yes brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i brgyad
gru.english: The ye stands for the Lady with Strength of Wheel, the va for the Lady of Pieces, the jra for the Lady of the Tavern, the vai for the Lady with Armor of Wheel, the ro for the Lady of Valor, the cha for the Lady of Might, the ni for the Empress of the Wheel, and the ye for the Lady of Effort.  These are the eight which relate to holy Body.

gru.acip: ,GAL TE DNGOS GRUB MCHOG 'DOD NA, ,SNGAGS DANG LHA LA THA DAD MED, ,CES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na, ,sngags dang lha la tha dad med, ,ces gsungs so
gru.english: If you hope to reach the highest attainment, The Angels and secret words are no different.* *Translator's note: The Tibetan editor has placed a "sic" mark under the "secret words" here.

gru.acip: DE'I PHYIR GSANG SNGAGS AOm GSUM MA BZLAS PAS GONG GI LHA THAMS CAD 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR LA, SNGON GYI LAS 'PHRO YOD PAS NI BSNYEN SOGS LA MA LTOS PAR 'DI BZLAS PA TZAM GYIS LAS THAMS CAD 'GRUB STE, RJE TSAR CHEN GYIS,
gru.wylie: de'i phyir gsang sngags aoM gsum ma bzlas pas gong gi lha thams cad 'grub par 'gyur la, sngon gyi las 'phro yod pas ni bsnyen sogs la ma ltos par 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis las thams cad 'grub ste, rje tshar chen gyis
gru.english: This then explains why, if you recite the secret words of the triple om over and over, you can reach all the Angels mentioned.  Those with sufficient virtue left over from their previous lives can accomplish all their spiritual aims just by reciting these words, without having to rely on practices such as a close retreat.  Remember the words of the Lord, Tsarchen:

gru.acip: ,HE RU KA DPAL RGYUD KYI RGYAL PO LAS, ,RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I NYE BA'I SNYING PO MCHOG ,BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB CES GSUNGS PA'I BDEN PAS SKYONGS, ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las, ,rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog ,bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs, ,zhes dang
gru.english: Save me, for I swear By the might of Truth; By the words Spoken in The King of Secret Tomes, The Book of the Glorious Heruka: "Those will reach Who only say The highest secret words, The Words of Closest Essence, The Words of the Diamond Queen."

gru.acip: RTZA RGYUD LE'U ZHE BRGYAD PAR, ,SNGAGS 'DI BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB PA STE, ,LAS RNAMS KUN BYED DGE BA YIN, ,ZHES GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: rtsa rgyud le'u zhe brgyad par, ,sngags 'di bklags pas 'grub pa ste, ,las rnams kun byed dge ba yin, ,zhes gsungs
gru.english: Chapter Forty-Eight of the secret root text says as well: You will reach it by saying these secret words; This is virtue that can do all things.

gru.acip: BDE MCHOG GI DBANG BSKUR BA LEGS PAR THOB PA'I GANG ZAG DE, RGYUD SDE BZHI'I DBANG GZHAN MA THOB KYANG THOB PA DANG 'DRA BA'I NUS PA DANG LDAN ZHING LHA ZHI KHRO KUN GYI SGRUB POR 'GYUR BAS GZHAN RNAMS ZIL GYIS GNON PAS NA DAM PA'AM MCHOG TU GSUNGS TE, RTZA RGYUD LAS,
gru.wylie: bde mchog gi dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i gang zag de, rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gzhan ma thob kyang thob pa dang 'dra ba'i nus pa dang ldan zhing lha zhi khro kun gyi sgrub por 'gyur bas gzhan rnams zil gyis gnon pas na dam pa'am mchog tu gsungs te, rtsa rgyud las
gru.english: Any person who has received properly an empowerment into the practice of Highest Bliss acquires an ability which is the same as if they had received all the other empowerments of the four groups of the secret teachings, even if they haven't actually done so.  They also become then a practitioner of all the Angels, whether peaceful or fierce ones.  Because they then outshine all others, this teaching is spoken to be the "ultimate," or "highest."  This fact is stated in the secret root text:

gru.acip: ,RGYUD 'DI RU NI DBANG BSKUR BA, ,THAMS CAD KYI NI SGRUB POR GSUNGS, ,RGOD DANG LTA DANG LAG BCANGS DANG, ,GNYIS GNYIS 'KHYUD PA LA SOGS LA, ,DBANG BSKUR BAR NI 'GYUR BA YIN, ,RGYUD RNAMS KUN GYI DAM PA YIN, ,'DI NI LHA MI ZIL GNON 'GRO, ,ZHES PA DANG,
gru.wylie: rgyud 'di ru ni dbang bskur ba, ,thams cad kyi ni sgrub por gsungs, ,rgod dang lta dang lag bcangs dang, ,gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa la sogs la, ,dbang bskur bar ni 'gyur ba yin, ,rgyud rnams kun gyi dam pa yin, ,'di ni lha mi zil gnon 'gro, ,zhes pa dang
gru.english: The one empowered for this secret teaching Becomes a practitioner of all, it is spoken. They become empowered for all the acts Of flirting and looking and holding hands, Of embracing, one with the other, and such. This one's the ultimate secret teaching, For they then outshine all gods and men.

gru.acip: ,ZHES DE NYID BSDUS PA, SGYU MA BDE MCHOG ,GSANG 'DUS, 'JIGS BYED SOGS KYI RGYUD SNGAR GSUNGS PA DANG, SLAD NAS GSUNG BAR 'GYUR BA KUN LAS KYANG 'DI LAS LHAG PA'I BSHAD PA SNGAR YANG MA BYUNG, DA DUNG MI 'BYUNG ZHING, RGYUD SDE GZHAN NAS BSHAD PA'I MCHOG THUN GYI DNGOS GRUB KUN 'DIR GNAS PA STE 'THOB PAR GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: zhes de nyid bsdus pa, sgyu ma bde mchog ,gsang 'dus, 'jigs byed sogs kyi rgyud sngar gsungs pa dang, slad nas gsung bar 'gyur ba kun las kyang 'di las lhag pa'i bshad pa sngar yang ma byung, da dung mi 'byung zhing, rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i mchog thun gyi dngos grub kun 'dir gnas pa ste 'thob par gsungs
gru.english: The verse means this.  You can take all the secret teachings that have ever come in the past: the ones called Short Suchness, and the Illusion of Highest Bliss, and the Secret Collection, and Frightener, or any others.  You can take as well all the secret teachings that may ever come in future times.  But no greater teaching than this has ever been spoken, and none ever will be.  The attainments spoken of in all the other secret teachings--both the highest kinds of attainments and the common ones--all stay here; that is, are attained with this practice.

gru.acip: YANG RTZA RGYUD LAS, ,RIG PA'I RGYAL PO'I GSANG SNGAGS TE, ,BYA BA THAMS CAD 'GRUB PA PO, ,'DI LAS SHIN TU MCHOG GYUR PA, ,'JIG RTEN GSUM NA YOD MIN TE, ,HE RU KA DPAL SNGAGS SHES NA, ,ME STE GZHAN DAG SOG MA MTSUNGS,
gru.wylie: yang rtsa rgyud las, ,rig pa'i rgyal po'i gsang sngags te, ,bya ba thams cad 'grub pa po, ,'di las shin tu mchog gyur pa, ,'jig rten gsum na yod min te, ,he ru ka dpal sngags shes na, ,me ste gzhan dag sog ma mtshungs
gru.english: Again the secret root text reads: These are secret words of the King Of enlightened kind, and accomplish all deeds. These are the highest of highest; there are In all three worlds no higher than them. If you know these words, of shining Heruka, The rest seem the same as hay against fire.

gru.acip: LE'U ZHE BDUN PAR SANGS RGYAS MKHA' 'GRO MA'I SNGAGS 'DI'I PHAN YON GSUNGS PA LAS, ,MKHA' 'GRO KUN GYI SNYING PO STE, ,'DI NI DRAN PA TZAM GYIS KYANG, ,DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD SKYED BYED YIN, ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: le'u zhe bdun par sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags 'di'i phan yon gsungs pa las, ,mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying po ste, ,'di ni dran pa tsam gyis kyang, ,dngos grub thams cad skyed byed yin, ,zhes dang
gru.english: The benefits of these secret words are described in the forty seventh chapter; among them it is said-- They are the essence of every Angel: Just the act of thinking of them Is enough to bring on every attainment.

gru.acip: LE'U ZHE BRGYAD PA LAS, ,MKHA' 'GRO KUN GYI DGE BA GANG, ,SNYING PO RNAL 'BYOR MA KUN GYIS, ,'DOD DON THAMS CAD SGRUB BYED PA'O,
gru.wylie: le'u zhe brgyad pa las, ,mkha' 'gro kun gyi dge ba gang, ,snying po rnal 'byor ma kun gyis, ,'dod don thams cad sgrub byed pa'o
gru.english: The forty-eighth chapter too adds: They are the essence of every good Of every Angel, and every Holy Woman Brings every wish to come about.

gru.acip: ,ZHES RDO RJE PHAG MO SOGS RNAL 'BYOR MA KUN GYIS SGRUB PA PO'I DON THAMS CAD SGRUB PAR BYED PA'I SNGAGS MKHA' 'GRO KUN 'DUS KYI SNYING PO 'DI YIN PAR GSUNGS SHING,
gru.wylie: zhes rdo rje phag mo sogs rnal 'byor ma kun gyis sgrub pa po'i don thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i sngags mkha' 'gro kun 'dus kyi snying po 'di yin par gsungs shing
gru.english: This verse is saying that here are secret words through which every Holy Woman--the Diamond Sow and all the rest--will bring about every wish that a practitioner could ever have; secret words which are the essence for gathering in every Angel there is.

gru.acip: YANG LE'U DE NYID LAS, ,SA 'OG YANG NA MTHO RIS SAM, ,DE BZHIN MI YUL DAG TU YANG, ,'JIG RTEN GSUM NA YOD PA YI, ,LAS NI GANG DAG YOD PA RNAMS, ,SNGAGS KYIS DE DAG THAMS CAD 'GRUB, ,DNGOS GRUB KUN BYED DGE BA YIN, ,DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD RAB STZOL BA, ,'DI LAS SHIN TU MCHOG GYUR MED, ,GANG PHYIR 'DI NI BLA MED DE, ,THABS BZANG PO NI BSTAN PA YIN, ,MKHA' 'GRO MA NI KUN GYI GNAS, ,MDOR BSHAD RGYAS PAR MA YIN NO,
gru.wylie: yang le'u de nyid las, ,sa 'og yang na mtho ris sam, ,de bzhin mi yul dag tu yang, ,'jig rten gsum na yod pa yi, ,las ni gang dag yod pa rnams, ,sngags kyis de dag thams cad 'grub, ,dngos grub kun byed dge ba yin, ,dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ba, ,'di las shin tu mchog gyur med, ,gang phyir 'di ni bla med de, ,thabs bzang po ni bstan pa yin, ,mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas, ,mdor bshad rgyas par ma yin no
gru.english: From the very same chapter we hear: These words accomplish every single Kind of deed that could ever exist: Any work in all three worlds, Be it under the earth, in higher realms, Or just so in the lands of men. This is the virtue that attains all things, Which grants each and every accomplishment. These are most high, and higher there's none, For they present the unsurpassed-- That method which is excellent. It's the home of every Holy Angel; I speak only briefly, and don't tell all.

gru.acip: ,ZHES 'JIG RTEN GSUM GYI DNGOS GRUB JI SNYED KUN KYANG RGYUD 'DI NAS GSUNGS PA'I SANGS RGYAS MKHA' 'GRO MA'I SNGAGS KYIS BDE BLAG TU 'GRUB PA'I PHYIR BLA NA MED PA STE GSANG SNGAGS THAMS CAD KYI NANG NAS 'GRAN ZLA MED PAR GSUNGS PAS NA,
gru.wylie: zhes 'jig rten gsum gyi dngos grub ji snyed kun kyang rgyud 'di nas gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyis bde blag tu 'grub pa'i phyir bla na med pa ste gsang sngags thams cad kyi nang nas 'gran zla med par gsungs pas na
gru.english: This verse relates how all the attainments, however many there may be in all the three worlds, can be accomplished easily by using the secret words of the Woman Angel Buddhas, spoken in this very text.  As such these words are unsurpassed: there is none among all the others which can rival them.

gru.acip: TSE DANG NOR SGRUB PAR 'DOD PA, 'GO NAD YAMS RIMS SOGS LUS KYI NA TSA DANG, SEMS KYI SDUG BSNGAL ZHI BA, SAD SER MU GE SOGS ZHI BA, CHAR 'BEBS GCOD SOGS SGRUB PA, GZA' KLU RGYAL PO LA SOGS PA'I SDE BRGYAD GDUG PA CAN GYI GNOD PA SEL BA, MI NOR 'GUGS PA SOGS DBANG SDUD KYI RIGS DANG, GSAD BSKRAD DBYE RMONGS SOGS LAS RAB 'BYAMS GANG BSGRUB PAR 'DOD KYANG SNGAGS 'DI NYID LA 'BAD PAS MCHOG TU 'GYUR ZHING,
gru.wylie: tshe dang nor sgrub par 'dod pa, 'go nad yams rims sogs lus kyi na tsha dang, sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba, sad ser mu ge sogs zhi ba, char 'bebs gcod sogs sgrub pa, gza' klu rgyal po la sogs pa'i sde brgyad gdug pa can gyi gnod pa sel ba, mi nor 'gugs pa sogs dbang sdud kyi rigs dang, gsad bskrad dbye rmongs sogs las rab 'byams gang bsgrub par 'dod kyang sngags 'di nyid la 'bad pas mchog tu 'gyur zhing
gru.english: Name any kind of ritual work there is: say you want to lengthen your life, or get rich; to put an end to some bodily illness, headaches or contagions, fevers or anything else; to stop some mental suffering; to make frost, and hail, and famines, and everything of the sort go away; to cause rain to fall, or commit termination, or the like; to clear away harm caused by any of the eight groups of evil, related to the planets, or to the serpentines, to the government of the land or the rest; to accomplish any of the acts that bring you power, bringing in worldly wealth and such; killing or frightening away or splitting or confusing, anything.  There are a countless myriad of such deeds, and the highest method for accomplishing whichever you may wish to do is to make strong effort in the secret words found right here.

gru.acip: ,LAG PA GA-YON PAS BZUNG NAS NI, ,RANG GI GNAS SU KHYER NAS SU, ,KHA' 'GRO MA NI DE DAG DANG, ,RTAG TU MNGON PAR RTZE BYED DE, ,BDE BA CAN GYI GNAS 'GROR 'GYUR, ,HE RU KA DPAL GUS 'DOD PAS, ,MKHA' LA 'GRO BA'I GNAS SU KHYER, ,SGRUB PA PO NI SNGAGS LUS CAN, ,'KHOR BAR 'CHI DANG RGA BA MED,
gru.wylie: lag pa ga-yon pas bzung nas ni, ,rang gi gnas su khyer nas su, ,kha' 'gro ma ni de dag dang, ,rtag tu mngon par rtse byed de, ,bde ba can gyi gnas 'gror 'gyur, ,he ru ka dpal gus 'dod pas, ,mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer, ,sgrub pa po ni sngags lus can, ,'khor bar 'chi dang rga ba med
gru.english: And also: Those who They take by their left hand And lead to where They live themselves, Will forever after laugh and play Together with these Angels holy, And pass to a Place of Happiness. Those whose joy is to revere Heruka Will go to where the Angels live; His disciple whose body becomes the words Never ages or dies in this suffering life.

gru.acip: ,SGRUB PO'I YON TAN RGYA CHEN PO, ,STONG PHRAG GCIG PA'I ZHAL MIN PAR, ,KHA GCIG GIS NI BRJOD MI NUS, ,STONG PHRAG BRGYA YI GDONG GYUR MIN, ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: sgrub po'i yon tan rgya chen po, ,stong phrag gcig pa'i zhal min par, ,kha gcig gis ni brjod mi nus, ,stong phrag brgya yi gdong gyur min, ,zhes dang
gru.english: The vast fine qualities of someone Keeping this practice could not be spoken By one with but a single mouth, nor one With a thousand, nor a hundred thousand.

gru.acip: 'DREN LUGS NI BDE MCHOG LA GA-YON PAS BZLA BAR GSUNGS PA LTAR LHA DBANG DU SDUD PA YIN PAS DBANG GI LAS LA SRIN LAG LA PHRENG BA 'GEL BAR GSUNGS PAS RGYUN DU GRUB NA DANG BSNYEN PA'I TSE THOG MAR SRIN LAG LA 'GEL ZHING, DE NAS MI BDE BA BYUNG NA RJES SU CI BDER BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: 'dren lugs ni bde mchog la ga-yon pas bzla bar gsungs pa ltar lha dbang du sdud pa yin pas dbang gi las la srin lag la phreng ba 'gel bar gsungs pas rgyun du grub na dang bsnyen pa'i tshe thog mar srin lag la 'gel zhing, de nas mi bde ba byung na rjes su ci bder byas la
gru.english: As for the actual way in which you count the beads with your fingers, the teachings of Highest Bliss say that we should "count them with the left."  And so in a case where we are trying to bring an Angel into our service we should, as it is stated, use our ring finger to count the beads--since this finger is the one used for the mode of power. If you are making the recitation of the mantra a constant practice, or in the case of a tantric retreat, then you can start off with your ring finger and then--when that becomes uncomfortable--switch to whichever finger is more comfortable.

gru.acip: RGYUN DU DAM BCA' JI TZAM YOD PA'I GRANGS LA NYUNG MTHAR BYAS TE BZLA ZHING, MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB SGRUB PA LA NGAG BZLAS GTZO BO YIN PAS CI NUS BZLA BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: rgyun du dam bca' ji tsam yod pa'i grangs la nyung mthar byas te bzla zhing, mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la ngag bzlas gtso bo yin pas ci nus bzla bar bya'o
gru.english: You should on a regular basis recite at least as many of the mantras as you have committed yourself to.  Since the verbal recitation of the mantra is the main practice for attaining the goals of the Heaven of the Angel, you should more generally recite Her mantra as many times as you possibly can.

gru.acip: BSNYEN TSAD NI, SA LUGS LA 'BUM PHRAG BZHI SOGS DANG, SINDHU RA'I SGRUB PA BYED NA 'BRU 'BUM TSAR NYER GSUM BYA BAR GSUNGS LA, RJE RIN PO CHE NI 'BUM PHRAG GIS TSOG PAS, RDZOGS LDAN LA NI BGRANG BYA GCIG ,CES SOGS GSUNGS PA LAS RAB 'BYAMS SGRUB PA LA DGONGS KYI,
gru.wylie: bsnyen tshad ni, sa lugs la 'bum phrag bzhi sogs dang, sindhu ra'i sgrub pa byed na 'bru 'bum tshar nyer gsum bya bar gsungs la, rje rin po che ni 'bum phrag gis tshog pas, rdzogs ldan la ni bgrang bya gcig ,ces sogs gsungs pa las rab 'byams sgrub pa la dgongs kyi
gru.english: As for how many times we repeat the mantra during our tantric retreats, the tradition of the Sakyas is that we do 400,000 repetitions, and such.  It's been stated that, if we are undertaking the Practice of Sindhura, then we do 23 sets of a hundred thousand of the syllables.  Je Rinpoche makes that statement that we should "Accumulate a hundred thousand, for one complete count," but all He means to say here is that we should repeat the mantra zillions and zillions of times.

gru.acip: DE DAG GI GSANG GSUM GYI BYIN RLABS DANG MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD SKU DANG BAm YIG PHYAG MTSAN GYI RNAM PAR SPYAN DRANGS PA 'OD ZER DE LAS TSUR DRANGS NAS THIM PAS BYIN RLABS ZHUGS SONG SNYAM PA DANG, 'KHOR LO LNGA DANG GSUM GYI LHA SPRO TSUL,
gru.wylie: de dag gi gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs dang mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad sku dang baM yig phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa 'od zer de las tshur drangs nas thim pas byin rlabs zhugs song snyam pa dang, 'khor lo lnga dang gsum gyi lha spro tshul
gru.english: All the blessings of Their three secrets, and each and every attainment of the Heaven of the Angel, are led back along the rays of light in the form of Her body, the vam letter, and Her various accoutrements.  See them come and dissolve into you, and at this point think to yourself that they have given blessing to your being.  Our Lama then spoke about sending forth Angels of the five and three groups.

gru.acip: RANG RES SNGAGS KLOG TSUL JI LTA BA BZHIN 'DON SHES PA DKA' YANG, SPYIR DKAR CHOS KUN GYI RTZA BA DANG BA DANG, LHAG PAR DU GSANG SNGAGS MOS PAS 'GRUB BYA BA YIN PAS DAD PA GAL CHE BA
gru.wylie: rang res sngags klog tshul ji lta ba bzhin 'don shes pa dka' yang, spyir dkar chos kun gyi rtsa ba dang ba dang, lhag par du gsang sngags mos pas 'grub bya ba yin pas dad pa gal che ba
