gru.english: It is difficult for people like you and I to know how to recite these secret words in the way they are really supposed to be spoken out.  In general though the very root of any practice of goodness is faith, and the secret teachings particularly are something where a person reaches his goals by power of his wishing purely.  So faith is of paramount importance here.

gru.acip: DE'I NANG NAS KYANG AOm GSUM MA'I RIG SNGAGS 'DI NI SNGAGS GZHAN BZLA BA LAS PHAN YON CHE, DE YANG MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB THABS KYI GTZO BO GCIG NGAG BZLAS YIN ZHING, BZLAS DMIGS SOGS CHER MA SHES KYANG SEMS RGYA YAN DU MI BTANG BAR BLA MA YI DAM LA KHYED SHES KYI BLO LINGS BSKYUR BYAS TE CHOS 'DI LA YID CHES KYI DAD PA BRTAN POS GSOL 'DEBS SHUGS DRAG BCAS BZLAS NA 'DI SNGAGS GZHAN DANG MI 'DRA BAR BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB PA'I RIG SNGAGS YIN PAS NGES PAR 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: de'i nang nas kyang aoM gsum ma'i rig sngags 'di ni sngags gzhan bzla ba las phan yon che, de yang mkha' spyod sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo gcig ngag bzlas yin zhing, bzlas dmigs sogs cher ma shes kyang sems rgya yan du mi btang bar bla ma yi dam la khyed shes kyi blo lings bskyur byas te chos 'di la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan pos gsol 'debs shugs drag bcas bzlas na 'di sngags gzhan dang mi 'dra bar bklags pas 'grub pa'i rig sngags yin pas nges par 'grub
gru.english: There are a lot of these secret words we could use, but reciting the formula of the triple om is of greater benefit than all the rest.  And one of the primary methods of reaching the Heaven of the Angel is the verbal recitation.  Even if you don't have any great understanding of how to do the visualizations as you recite the words, don't let your mind go all over--think of your Lama and Angel, surrender yourself to Her with your whole heart, make the most urgent and powerful supplication, keep unshakable faith and trust in the practice, and just recite.  Remember, these secret words are unlike any other--those will reach who only say them--and so with these you must surely reach your ultimate goal.

gru.acip: BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB CES PA LUS SEMS KYIS GANG BYUNG RGYA YAN BAG MED BYA CHOG GSUNG BA MIN PAR, 'DI GSANG SNGAGS KYI MTHAR THUG YIN PAS THUN MONG LAM SBYANGS LEGS PAR SNGON SONG DANG,
gru.wylie: bklags pas 'grub ces pa lus sems kyis gang byung rgya yan bag med bya chog gsung ba min par, 'di gsang sngags kyi mthar thug yin pas thun mong lam sbyangs legs par sngon song dang
gru.english: These holy words, "Those will reach who only say them," aren't meant to imply that it will work if you just do or think whatever you like, if you just fool around, all over the place.  This is the ultimate secret practice, and so you must first finish the prerequisite perfectly: you must train yourself in the path which is shared by both the open and secret teachings.

gru.acip: L'A LI TAS, YI GE 'BAR BA LA SEMS BZUNG NA DNGOS GRUB MYUR BAR GSUNGS PA 'JIGS BYED LA MTSON PA TZAM YIN PAS GZHAN LA'ANG DE DANG MTSUNGS PAS 'DI LA SEMS MA GA-YENG BAR GNAS NA MCHOG TU 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: lA li tas, yi ge 'bar ba la sems bzung na dngos grub myur bar gsungs pa 'jigs byed la mtshon pa tsam yin pas gzhan la'ang de dang mtshungs pas 'di la sems ma ga-yeng bar gnas na mchog tu 'gyur
gru.english: Lalita has said that if when you are focusing on syllables you make them very brilliant, you will be able to reach your spiritual goals faster.  Although he was referring to the practice of the Frightener, you can apply this advice to other practices as well.  If you are able to keep your mind on this visualization without getting distracted, it is the highest method.

gru.acip: SKABS 'GAR CHOS THAMS CAD RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA MED PA'I YUL STONG NYID RTOGS MKHAN GYI BLO DE DANG YUL CAN BDE BA CHEN PO'I YE SHES GNYIS DBYER MED RO GCIG GI NGO BOR GYUR PA DE LA SEMS BZUNG NAS BZLA STE DON GYI BZLAS PA YIN,
gru.wylie: skabs 'gar chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa'i yul stong nyid rtogs mkhan gyi blo de dang yul can bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis dbyer med ro gcig gi ngo bor gyur pa de la sems bzung nas bzla ste don gyi bzlas pa yin
gru.english: [8] Sometimes when you are reciting, you can focus your mind on the subject of emptiness, which is the fact that nothing in the world has any nature of its own.  This state of mind and the subject state of mind here--the wisdom of great bliss--are indivisible, a single song.  You keep your mind on this and do the recitation.  This is the meaning recitation.

gru.acip: RTOG MED CES PA'I DON NI, DA LTA RANG CAG GI SEMS NI RTOG PA MANG DU 'CHAR BA'I RTOG BCAS YIN LA, 'CHI BA 'OD GSAL GYI TSE RTOG PA THAMS CAD 'GAG CING DE YUN RING DU GNAS MI NUS PAR MYUR DU BAR DO'I LUS GRUB,
gru.wylie: rtog med ces pa'i don ni, da lta rang cag gi sems ni rtog pa mang du 'char ba'i rtog bcas yin la, 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi tshe rtog pa thams cad 'gag cing de yun ring du gnas mi nus par myur du bar do'i lus grub
gru.english: As for the meaning of "non-conceptual," right now all of our minds are filled with all different kinds of thoughts--we are conceptual.  During the clear light which occurs at death, all of ones conceptions stop.  But you are not able to stay in that state for long, and are quickly taken into the intermediate state's body.

gru.acip: 'DI'I LAM DUS SU'ANG SEMS DBEN DPE'I 'OD GSAL SHAR BA NA RTOG PA 'GAG KYANG 'OD GSAL DE LA GNAS MI NUS PAR ZAG BCAS KYI RLUNG LAS GRUB PA'I MA DAG PA'I SGYU LUS RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA DKAR MO'I RNAM PAR LDANG,
gru.wylie: 'di'i lam dus su'ang sems dben dpe'i 'od gsal shar ba na rtog pa 'gag kyang 'od gsal de la gnas mi nus par zag bcas kyi rlung las grub pa'i ma dag pa'i sgyu lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i rnam par ldang
gru.english: At the time of the path as well, all of your conceptual thinking stops when the approximate clear light of transcendent mind comes to you.  You are not however able to stay in that clear light, and because your winds are not yet pure, you arise in the form of a white Angel of Diamond, with an impure illusory body.

gru.acip: DE DAG GI TSE SEMS MA YENGS PAR GTZO BOR 'BAD DGOS TE, GZHAN DU MI 'GRO'I ZHES SOGS GSUNGS PA LTAR SEMS RGYA YAN LA BTANG NA YUN RING PO'I BZLAS PA LA BRTZON PAR BYAS KYANG MI 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS PAS GAL SHIN TU CHE BAS BLO NUS CI YOD KYIS NAN TAN BYA ZHING,
gru.wylie: de dag gi tshe sems ma yengs par gtso bor 'bad dgos te, gzhan du mi 'gro'i zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sems rgya yan la btang na yun ring po'i bzlas pa la brtson par byas kyang mi 'grub par gsungs pas gal shin tu che bas blo nus ci yod kyis nan tan bya zhing
gru.english: While you are doing your recitation, you should follow the lines which go, "Don't go somewhere else..."  You should stick to the main thing--that is, the visualization you are concentrating on--without getting distracted.  If you let your mind go all over the place, it's been said that you can make great efforts to recite for years without achieving any of your goals.  It is therefore very important that you concentrate to the very best of your mind's ability.

gru.acip: SNGAGS DON NI, RIN 'BYUNG SGRUB THABS KYI NANG DU PHAG MO DBU BCAD MA ZHES PA DER GTZO 'KHOR GSUM YOD PA'I DBUS MA SANGS RGYAS MKHA' 'GRO MA'I SNGAGS LA, AOm SARBA BUDDHA d'A KI N'I YE H'Um PHAt SV'A H'A, ZHES DANG, GA-YAS SU RDO RJE RAB BSNGAGS MA'I SNGAGS LA, AOm BADZRA WARnA N'I YE H'Um PHAt, CES DANG, GA-YON DU RDO RJE RNAM PAR SNANG MDZAD MA'I SNGAGS LA, AOm BADZRA BEE RO TZA N'I YE H'Um PHAt, CES 'BYUNG BAS,
gru.wylie: sngags don ni, rin 'byung sgrub thabs kyi nang du phag mo dbu bcad ma zhes pa der gtso 'khor gsum yod pa'i dbus ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags la, aoM sarba buddha DA ki nI ye hUM phaT svA hA, zhes dang, ga-yas su rdo rje rab bsngags ma'i sngags la, aoM badzra warNa nI ye hUM phaT, ces dang, ga-yon du rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma'i sngags la, aoM badzra bee ro tsa nI ye hUM phaT, ces 'byung bas
gru.english: Here I will explain the meaning of the secret words.  Within the ritual text for reaching the Angel which is entitled the Source of Jewels, there is a practice called the "Sow Who Cuts Their Heads Off"; and in this there are three Angels: a central one and two in attendance.  The central Angel is named the Woman Angel of All Buddhas, and Her secret words are Om sarva Buddha dakiniye hung phet svaha.  To Her right is the Diamond Lady of Proclamation, and Her secret words are Om vajra vananiye hung phet.  To Her left is the Diamond Lady of Appearance, whose secret words are Om vajra vairochaniye hung phet.

gru.acip: DANG PO'I SNGAGS DON, SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI MKHA' 'GRO MA ZHES PA LA SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD LA MKHA' 'GRO'I SGRA 'JUG NA YANG MA'I SGRA 'JUG PA'I RGYU MTSAN JI LTAR YIN ZHE NA THUGS BDE BA CHEN PO'I YE SHES CHOS NYID KYI MKHA' LA 'GRO BA'I MKHA' 'GRO MA ZER ZING, DE YANG BYINGS SGRUB KYI SKABS d'A KI NAM MKHA' LA'O ZHES PA'I BYINGS BZHAG ,CES 'BYUNG BAS, DES NA SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI CHOS NYID RANG BZHIN MED PAR MKHYEN MKHAN DE THUGS SHES RAB KYI NGO BO YIN PAS NA CHOS SKU'AM THUGS MTSON,
gru.wylie: dang po'i sngags don, sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa la sangs rgyas thams cad la mkha' 'gro'i sgra 'jug na yang ma'i sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar yin zhe na thugs bde ba chen po'i ye shes chos nyid kyi mkha' la 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ma zer zing, de yang byings sgrub kyi skabs DA ki nam mkha' la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag ,ces 'byung bas, des na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid rang bzhin med par mkhyen mkhan de thugs shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas na chos sku'am thugs mtshon
gru.english: First we will cover the meaning of the secret words of the Woman Angel of All Buddhas.  Now suppose someone were to pose the following question, "When we say the 'Woman Angel of All Buddhas,' I can understand how the word 'Angel' applies to 'all Buddhas,' but why is it that we say 'Woman Angel'?" The meaning of "Woman Angel" here is that the minds of Enlightened Beings--the wisdoms of great bliss--fly in the sky of emptiness.  When we deconstruct the secret words to their root we get, as they say, "daki--which comes down to in the sky."  We can thus say that the first Angel represents the Dharma Body or the enlightened mind, since Her very nature is that of the holy mind or wisdom of each and every Enlightened Being, which understands the true nature of things: the fact that they have no quality of Their own.

gru.acip: RIGS BSDU NA'ANG RIGS BRGYA RIGS LNGA RU 'DU BA DANG, DE RIGS GSUM DU BDU NA DON GRUB 'OD DPAG MED, RIN 'BYUNG RNAM SNANG LA 'DU BA YIN, DE YANG BSDU NA GSANG CHEN RIGS GCIG TU 'DU BA YIN TE, RIGS BRGYA RIGS LNGA RIGS GSUM RIGS GCIG TU, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA YANG GSANG CHEN RIGS GCIG GI BDAG NYID YIN NO, ,
gru.wylie: rigs bsdu na'ang rigs brgya rigs lnga ru 'du ba dang, de rigs gsum du bdu na don grub 'od dpag med, rin 'byung rnam snang la 'du ba yin, de yang bsdu na gsang chen rigs gcig tu 'du ba yin te, rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum rigs gcig tu, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yang gsang chen rigs gcig gi bdag nyid yin no,
gru.english: If you group the various Angels into families, the hundred families can be included into the five.  When you group the five families into three, you do so by combining the class of Attainment with that of Limitless Light, and that of the Source of Jewels with that of Appearances.  You can even combine these three families into the single family of the Great Secret.  This is just as it is said in the lines which go, "The hundred families into the five families into the three families into the one..."  And so the Angel of Diamond is the very embodiment of the single family of the Great Secret.

gru.acip: DE'I TSUL NI NGAG BZLAS ZIN NAS ZHAR BYUNG RDZOGS RIM DANG PO'I 'GOR LUS GNAD CHOS BDUN LDAN DU BYAS LA, RLUNG RO DGU PHRUGS SU BSAL TSUL N'A RO'I CHOS DRUG GI SKABS LTAR GYI RGYAS PAR MI DGOS PAR TSE SGRUB GYI SKABS BZHIN
gru.wylie: de'i tshul ni ngag bzlas zin nas zhar byung rdzogs rim dang po'i 'gor lus gnad chos bdun ldan du byas la, rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal tshul nA ro'i chos drug gi skabs ltar gyi rgyas par mi dgos par tshe sgrub gyi skabs bzhin
gru.english: This is how to proceed.  After you have finished your verbal recitation, then move on to the first of the incidental practices of the stage of completion.  As you begin this, put your body into the seven point posture.  Then clear the channels with the practice of the nine fold wind.  It's not necessary that you do this in the extensive version found in the Six Practices of Naropa; rather you can follow the method that we use in the ritual for attaining long life.

gru.acip: DE NAS ZHAR BYUNG RDZOGS RIM GNYIS PAS STENG MKHA' SPYOD KYI DGA' 'KHYIL DKAR PO LA BRTEN NAS BDE BA SGRUB, 'OG SA SPYOD KYI DGA' 'KHYIL DMAR PO LA BRTEN NAS STONG PA SGRUB,
gru.wylie: de nas zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis pas steng mkha' spyod kyi dga' 'khyil dkar po la brten nas bde ba sgrub, 'og sa spyod kyi dga' 'khyil dmar po la brten nas stong pa sgrub
gru.english: After this perform the second of the completion stage practices, using the white swirl of bliss--the one that acts in the heaven--to reach bliss, and using the red swirl of bliss--the one that acts on the ground below--to reach emptiness.

gru.acip: ,ZHES SOGS DE NYID BCU BZHI'I CHINGS GSUNGS PA'I KHONGS NAS BDE MCHOG YAB YUM GYI SGRUB THABS BSTAN PA RJE YAB SRAS DANG LCANG SKYA ROL RDOR SOGS KYIS RGYUD DON GDAMS PAR SHAR NAS MAN NGAG
gru.wylie: zhes sogs de nyid bcu bzhi'i chings gsungs pa'i khongs nas bde mchog yab yum gyi sgrub thabs bstan pa rje yab sras dang lcang skya rol rdor sogs kyis rgyud don gdams par shar nas man ngag
gru.english: These and the lines that accompany them are the original source for the fourteen essential practices.  It is from this body of the Word that the Lord, the spiritual Father, and his Sons--as well as Changkya Roldor and others--composed instructions on the ritual for reaching the Man and Wife of Highest Bliss.  These instructions were the result of the meaning of the secret teachings showing itself to each of these Lamas as private revelation.

gru.acip: DE NYID BCU BZHI TSANG BA'I YI DAM GYI SGRUB THABS LA RGYUN DU 'BAD NA, SGRUB PA PO DE TSE STOD LA MTSAMS MED LNGA BYAS PA'I SDIG PO CHE ZHIG YIN YANG TSE SMAD LA GRUB PA'I GO 'PHANG 'THOB PA DANG;
gru.wylie: de nyid bcu bzhi tshang ba'i yi dam gyi sgrub thabs la rgyun du 'bad na, sgrub pa po de tshe stod la mtshams med lnga byas pa'i sdig po che zhig yin yang tshe smad la grub pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa dang;
gru.english: Suppose a practitioner is able to make good and constant effort in a practice for reaching a Close Angel which has all these fourteen essential practices complete in it.  Even if they are a great sinner, and have committed one of the five immediate wrong deeds in the earlier part of their life, they can still then in the latter part achieve the state of the Angel they are trying to reach.

gru.acip: GAL TE GA-YENG BAS MA GRUB NA, BAR DO DANG PHYI MAR YI DAM GYI LHAS RJES SU 'DZIN CING, DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO'I TSOGS KYIS DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU 'KHRID PAR 'GYUR BA SOGS RTZA RGYUD NAS BSNGAGS BRJOD RGYA CHER MDZAD TSUL,
gru.wylie: gal te ga-yeng bas ma grub na, bar do dang phyi mar yi dam gyi lhas rjes su 'dzin cing, dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par 'gyur ba sogs rtsa rgyud nas bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad tshul
gru.english: Even if they go astray somehow and do not reach the Angel, they will still be cared for by the Angels during the time between their death and their rebirth, and in their next life as well.  And then they will be led to the Heaven of the Angel by a great crowd of Warriors and their Angels.  Our Lama spoke of how the praises of these and other such wonders were sung at length within the secret root text.

gru.acip: RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SGRUB THABS RGYAS 'BRING GNYIS LA RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG DANG, DE NYID BCU BZHI GNYIS KA TSANG LA, SGRUB THABS BSDUS PA SHOG GCIG MA LA RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG MA GTOGS DE NYID BCU BZHI MI TSANG BAS NGES PAR SGRUB THABS RGYAS TZAM ZHIG BTON THUB NA LEGS,
gru.wylie: rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gnyis la rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang, de nyid bcu bzhi gnyis ka tshang la, sgrub thabs bsdus pa shog gcig ma la rnal 'byor bcu gcig ma gtogs de nyid bcu bzhi mi tshang bas nges par sgrub thabs rgyas tsam zhig bton thub na legs
gru.english: The eleven practices here, as well as the fourteen essential practices, are both found in the two versions of the ritual for reaching the Holy Angel: in the longer and in the one of middle length.  The very brief ritual though, the one that fits on one page, only includes the eleven practices: it does not incorporate all of the fourteen.  This is why it is so good if you can be sure to recite any of the more extensive forms of this ritual.

gru.acip: GOS KYI SKAD DOD WA SA NA ZHES PA GOS DANG, GNAS GNYIS LA 'JUG CING GNAS LA SGRUB PA BYED PA'I GNAS DANG, LHA'I GNAS GNYIS YOD PA LAS,
gru.wylie: gos kyi skad dod wa sa na zhes pa gos dang, gnas gnyis la 'jug cing gnas la sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas dang, lha'i gnas gnyis yod pa las
gru.english: The original Sanskrit word for "vestment" is vasana, which can refer either to clothing or to a place.  When it means place, it can refer either to the place in which you practice or to the place where Angels reside.

gru.acip: RGYU SOGS STONG PA SNGON 'GRO BAS DE NYID GCIG STE, A'A LI K'A LI'I DE NYID KYI SNGON DU STONG NYID BSGOM PA 'GRO DGOS PAS, DAG PA GSUM GYI RNAL 'BYOR BYA BA CHOS RNAMS KYI NGO BO STONG PA NYID DANG, RGYU BDEN PAR GRUB PA MED PA'I MTSAN MA MED PA DANG, 'BRAS BU THOB BYA SMON PA'I YUL MED PA'I SMON PA MED PA STE RNAM THAR SGO GSUM GYI NGO BO 'CHI BA CHOS SKU'I STONG NYID BSGOM PA BSTAN NO, ,
gru.wylie: rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro bas de nyid gcig ste, a'a li kA li'i de nyid kyi sngon du stong nyid bsgom pa 'gro dgos pas, dag pa gsum gyi rnal 'byor bya ba chos rnams kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang, rgyu bden par grub pa med pa'i mtshan ma med pa dang, 'bras bu thob bya smon pa'i yul med pa'i smon pa med pa ste rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ngo bo 'chi ba chos sku'i stong nyid bsgom pa bstan no,
gru.english: The root-tantra words "The emptiness of causes / And such must come before" represent the next of the essential categories.  These are actually a reference to the practice of meditating upon emptiness in the form of the Dharma body during the stage of death.  The essence of the emptiness at that point is the three doors of liberation. The first of these three is the "door of liberation which is emptiness itself," and is represented by the essence of every existing thing as we experience it in the deep practice of the three purities. The second is the "door to liberation free of any signs," which is a reference to the fact that no cause ever has any true nature of its own. The third is the "door to liberation free of any hopes," which is a reference to the fact that the things we might hope for, the goals of our practice, are not things that exist either.

gru.acip: DE YANG GANG ZAG RAB 'BRING THA GSUM GYI LAM BGROD TSUL GSUNGS PA RNAMS KYANG DE LTA BU'I DE NYID BCU BZHI TSANG BA'I SGO NAS LAM NYAMS SU BLANGS NA NI 'GRUB LA GZHAN DU NI MA YIN NO, ,
gru.wylie: de yang gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul gsungs pa rnams kyang de lta bu'i de nyid bcu bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas lam nyams su blangs na ni 'grub la gzhan du ni ma yin no,
gru.english: People say many things about what practitioners of highest, medium, and lowest spiritual capacity need on their journey of the path.  If however one is able to practice the path with all of these fourteen essential categories complete, they will reach their goals; and if all fourteen are not complete, they will not.

gru.acip: RGYUD GZHAN 'JIGS BYED LTA BU LA MTSON NA, RANG DON SKU GSUM GYI GO 'PHANG SGRUB PA DANG PO SBYOR BA'I TING NGE 'DZIN DANG, GZHAN DON PHRIN LAS PHUN TSOGS KYI TING NGE 'DZIN DANG, LAS RGYAL MCHOG GI TING NGE 'DZIN TE, TING NGE 'DZIN GSUM GYI CHINGS ZHES BYA BA DANG,
gru.wylie: rgyud gzhan 'jigs byed lta bu la mtshon na, rang don sku gsum gyi go 'phang sgrub pa dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang, gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang, las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin te, ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings zhes bya ba dang
gru.english: The other secret teachings also have their ancient roots.  The secret teachings of the Frightener, for example, have what are called the three meditative concentrations.  The first of these, called the "meditative concentration of application," is to reach your own goals by achieving the state of the three bodies of an enlightened being.  The second is the "meditative concentration of excellence," which is to fulfill the goals of other beings by undertaking the holy activities of an enlightened being.  The third one is called the "meditative concentration of the Highest Victor of Activities."

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG RNAM PAR SNANG MDZAD KYI YAN LAG ,BSTOD PA RIN 'BYUNG, BDUD RTZI MYANG BA 'OD DPAG MED, MCHOD PA DON GRUB, DBANG BSKUR BA MI BSKYOD PA, RJES CHAGS RDO RJE SEMS DPA'I YAN LAG STE YAN LAG DRUG GI CHINGS ZHES PA RNAMS
gru.wylie: gzhan yang rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ,bstod pa rin 'byung, bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med, mchod pa don grub, dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa, rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ste yan lag drug gi chings zhes pa rnams
gru.english: There are also the ancient roots called the "six branches."  These are the branch of Appearances; the branch of Source of Jewels called "praising"; the branch of Limitless Light called "partaking of the nectar"; the branch of Accomplishment called "offering"; the branch of Unmoving called "granting the empowerment"; and the branch of the Diamond Warrior called "affection."

gru.acip: SPYI BOR THOD PA'I 'OG KLAD RGYA'I STENG DU DBU MA RA RO RKYANG GIS MDUD PA RE RE BCINGS PA'I MDUD MTSAMS NAS PHYOGS KYI RTZA BZHI THON, DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I BRGYAD, DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I BCU DRUG ,DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I SUM CU SO GNYIS, KHA DOG KHRA CHOL LE BA GDUGS KHA PHUB PA LTA BU DBYIBS GRU GSUM,
gru.wylie: spyi bor thod pa'i 'og klad rgya'i steng du dbu ma ra ro rkyang gis mdud pa re re bcings pa'i mdud mtshams nas phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi thon, de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i brgyad, de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i bcu drug ,de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i sum cu so gnyis, kha dog khra chol le ba gdugs kha phub pa lta bu dbyibs gru gsum
gru.english: The first chakra is located at the tip of your head, underneath the skull and above the brain.  At this point the central channel of taste and the solitary channel both twist around the central channel and form a knot.  From this knot come four major channels.  From the branches of each of those four channels come two more channels making a total of eight.  From each of these split off another two channels making sixteen, and then two more branch off from each of the sixteen making a total of thirty-two.  Its color is that of a multicolored pattern (although oral tradition says to visualize it as white), and its shape is triangular and slightly curved downward like an umbrella facing down.

whole_word_matches.context: ha dog khra chol le ba gdugs kha phub pa lta bu dbyibs gru gsum

gru.acip: LTE BA'I BUG PA'I THAD DU DBU MA LA RO RKYANG GIS MDUD PA RE RE BCINGS PA'I MDUD MTSAMS NAS PHYOGS KYI RTZA 'DAB BZHI, DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I BRGYAD, DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I BCU DRUG ,DE RE RE LAS BZHI BZHI GYES PA'I RE BZHI'AM YANG NA DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I SUM CU SO GNYIS, DE RE RE LAS GNYIS GNYIS GYES PA'I RE BZHI, GDUGS KHA BSLANGS PA LTA BU KHA DOG DMAR PO DBYIBS GRU GSUM RTZA 'DAB SBUBS STONG RTZE MO GRO SOG GRIS BCAD PA LTA BU SBOM PHRA 'JAG MA TZAM 'JAM ZHING MNYEN PA,
gru.wylie: lte ba'i bug pa'i thad du dbu ma la ro rkyang gis mdud pa re re bcings pa'i mdud mtshams nas phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi, de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i brgyad, de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i bcu drug ,de re re las bzhi bzhi gyes pa'i re bzhi'am yang na de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i sum cu so gnyis, de re re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i re bzhi, gdugs kha bslangs pa lta bu kha dog dmar po dbyibs gru gsum rtsa 'dab sbubs stong rtse mo gro sog gris bcad pa lta bu sbom phra 'jag ma tsam 'jam zhing mnyen pa
gru.english: The fourth chakra is located at the plane of the navel.  At this place both the channel of taste and the solitary channel wrap around the central channel forming a knot.  From this knot come out four major channels.  Each of these split into two making eight.  Then each of the eight split into sixteen.  Then you can either visualize that each of these sixteen branches off into four making a total of sixty-four channels, or alternatively the sixteen each split into two making thirty-two, and that that these thirty-two each split into two making sixty-four.  The chakra is colored red, has a triangular shape, and curves upward slightly like an umbrella turned upside-down.  The channels are hollow and about the width of a piece of wheat at their outer tips.  They are soft and flexible like the flesh of your tongue.

whole_word_matches.context: hi, gdugs kha bslangs pa lta bu kha dog dmar po dbyibs gru gsum rtsa 'dab sbubs stong rtse mo gro sog gris bcad p

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DBANG MO'I BSNYEN SGRUB LAS GSUM GYI LAG LEN NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA SKAL BZANG MKHA' SPYOD BGROD PA'I SKAS ZHES BYA BA BZHUGS SO,,
gru.wylie: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lag len nag 'gros su bkod pa skal bzang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so
gru.english: Herein contained is The Stairway to Heaven for Those of Goodness and Faith, practical instructions set in prose on how to perform the close retreat, the practice, and the sacred activity for reaching the Naropa's heavenly Queen, the Holy Angel of Diamond

gru.acip: ,DBANG PO RAB 'BRING LUS 'DIS MKHA' SPYOD BGROD, ,THA MA BAR DOR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GROS BSU, ,YANG THA SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS DNGOS GRUB THOB, ,CHES MYUR 'DA' KHA'I LAM GYIS SKAD CIG 'PHO,
gru.wylie: dbang po rab 'bring lus 'dis mkha' spyod bgrod, ,tha ma bar dor dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu, ,yang tha skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub thob, ,ches myur 'da' kha'i lam gyis skad cig 'pho
gru.english: Those of highest and medium power Travel to the Angel's Heaven Within this very life; Those of less are greeted By Warriors and their Angels In the state inbetween; And those of least power Reach their goal Within a series of lives. Those who use the quickest path, The path of the moment of death, Are transferred there in an instant.

gru.acip: ZHES JI SKAD DU GSUNGS PA LTAR SKAL LDAN GYI SKYE BO LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD PA'I GDAMS PA ZAB MO DPAL 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I RTZA RGYUD LE'U ZHE BRGYAD PA LAS RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I NYE BA'I SNYING PO BKLAGS PAS 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS PA'I MAN NGAG,
gru.wylie: zhes ji skad du gsungs pa ltar skal ldan gyi skye bo lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i gdams pa zab mo dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u zhe brgyad pa las rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po bklags pas 'grub par gsungs pa'i man ngag
gru.english: As is said in these lines, those people of highest goodness and faith can travel to the Angel's Heaven in this life without having to give up their present body.  The profound advices on how to do this are found within those lines of the 48th chapter of the Secret Book of the Glorious Union of Spheres which read: Those will reach Who only say The Words of Closest Essence, The Words of the Diamond Queen.

gru.acip: 'PHAGS YUL PAnA GRUB KUN GYI GTZUG NOR N'A RO TA PA'I ZHABS KYIS RDO RJE BTZUN MO NYID LAS DNGOS SU GSAN TE LEGS PAR SROL PHYE BA'I GDAMS PA ZAB MO RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DBANG MO'I SGO NAS MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB PA'I BSNYEN SGRUB LAS GSUM NYAMS SU LEN TSUL GYI MAN NGAG NAG 'GROS SU 'GOD PA LA,
gru.wylie: 'phags yul paNa grub kun gyi gtsug nor nA ro ta pa'i zhabs kyis rdo rje btsun mo nyid las dngos su gsan te legs par srol phye ba'i gdams pa zab mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sgo nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag nag 'gros su 'god pa la
gru.english: This very teaching began so well when the blessed Naropa, the crowning jewel of all the scholars and saints of the Land of the Realized, was granted instructions directly from the Diamond Queen Herself.  Here I will set down in prose those instructions on how to do the close retreat, the practice, and the sacred activity for reaching Heaven through the Queen of Naropa's Heaven, the Holy Angel of Diamond.

gru.acip: BSNYEN PA, SGRUB PA, LAS SBYOR DANG GSUM LAS, DANG PO BSNYEN PA LA THUN MONG BA'I BSNYEN PA DANG MCHOG GI BSNYEN PA SOGS MANG DU YOD PA LAS, 'DIR BZLAS BRJOD KYI SGO NAS LHA'I THUGS RGYUD BSKUL TE PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA'I GZHI BSNYEN CHEN MO 'DUG TSUL 'CHAD PAR BYA STE,
gru.wylie: bsnyen pa, sgrub pa, las sbyor dang gsum las, dang po bsnyen pa la thun mong ba'i bsnyen pa dang mchog gi bsnyen pa sogs mang du yod pa las, 'dir bzlas brjod kyi sgo nas lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa'i gzhi bsnyen chen mo 'dug tshul 'chad par bya ste
gru.english: Of these three--the close retreat, the practice, and the sacred activity--we will begin with how to do the close retreat.  Now, there are many different kinds of retreat which you can do--common retreats, supreme retreats, and all sorts of other retreats as well.  What I will explain here is how to do that retreat which serves as the foundation mainly for reaching the outer Heaven: the Great Retreat, in which you exhort the heart of the Angel by means of reciting Her secret words. Who Can Do This Practice

gru.acip: CHAG MED BZLAS SGOM DANG , YAR MAR GYI TSES BCU'I MCHOD PA LA BRTZON PAS RE ZHIG NA RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA THA MAL GYI BUD MED KYI RNAM PAS SGRUB PA PO DE'I LAG PA'I MKHRIG MA NAS BZUNG STE LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD KYI GNAS SU 'KHRID PAR BYED LA,
gru.wylie: chag med bzlas sgom dang , yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa la brtson pas re zhig na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam pas sgrub pa po de'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par byed la
gru.english: And then you would have to keep up, without ever breaking them, your practices of recitation and meditation in the form of the Angel; making great efforts as well in maintaining the practice of the Offering of the Tenth Day of the waxing and waning of the moon.  If you are able to do all this, then the Holy Angel of Diamond will come to you in the form of a normal human man or woman, take you by the hand, and lead you to Heaven in this very life.

gru.acip: GAL TE DE LTAR 'GRUB PA'I SKAL BA MED PA RNAL 'BYOR PA BSOD NAMS 'BRING PO ZHIG YIN KYANG SISINADH'U LANGAGA LA LI YA'I SGRUB PA LA BRTEN NAS LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD KYI GNAS SU BGROD PAR GSUNGS PAS,
gru.wylie: gal te de ltar 'grub pa'i skal ba med pa rnal 'byor pa bsod nams 'bring po zhig yin kyang sisinadhU langaga la li ya'i sgrub pa la brten nas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi gnas su bgrod par gsungs pas
gru.english: Now suppose that you don't have quite enough goodness and faith for all this to happen, but still you are a tantric practitioner of medium virtue.  Even so, it is stated in the scriptures, you will still be able to travel to Her Heaven in this very life, if you undertake the practice of Sindhur Langali.

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG BSNYEN PA'I SNGON DU GSUNG RAB SGROG PA, DGE 'DUN LA BSNYEN BKUR, GTOR MA BRGYA RTZA DANG CHA GSUM, DBUL PHONGS LA SBYIN GTONG SOGS RANG GI 'BYOR 'KHOS DANG BSTUN PA'I TSOGS GSOG RGYA GANG CHE BSGRUB,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i sngon du gsung rab sgrog pa, dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur, gtor ma brgya rtsa dang cha gsum, dbul phongs la sbyin gtong sogs rang gi 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i tshogs gsog rgya gang che bsgrub
gru.english: You can as well, prior to your retreat, exert yourself in accumulating great masses of good karma by presenting the holy teachings to others, or facilitating such teaching; serving the Community; performing the offering of a hundred torma cakes, or else the three-part offering of the torma; taking care of the poor and needy, and everything of the sort.  Do as much as you can, within your means. Where to Do Retreat

gru.acip: ,RI BO TSANG TSING SMAN LJONGS SAM, ,CHU BO CHEN PO'I NGOGS DAG DANG , ,GDOD NAS GRUB PA'I DUR KHROD DU, ,DER NI DKYIL 'KHOR BRI BAR BYA,
gru.wylie: ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs sam, ,chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang , ,gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du, ,der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya
gru.english: In the mountains or in wild forests, In secret hollows of magical plants, Upon the banks of a great river, Or in burial grounds used since all time-- In places such as these Should you draw your secret world.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB SEMS DPAS BRTEN PA YI, ,GNAS SU BZLAS NA YID 'ONG DNGOS GRUB THOB, CES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas brten pa yi, ,gnas su bzlas na yid 'ong dngos grub thob, ces gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: If you do your recitation in a place Which Buddhas and bodhisattvas have used before You will reach beautiful realizations.

gru.acip: SKYES CHEN DAM PA GONG MA RNAMS DANG , RANG GI RTZA BA'I BLA MA'I SGRUB GNAS LTA BUR BSGOM NA GNAS KYIS GANG ZAG BYIN GYIS RLOB PA'I DGOS PA KHYAD PAR CAN YOD PAS DE LTA BU RNYED NA LEGS LA,
gru.wylie: skyes chen dam pa gong ma rnams dang , rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sgrub gnas lta bur bsgom na gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlob pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pas de lta bu rnyed na legs la
gru.english: There is a special effect of doing retreat in places such as a house which has been used by holy beings of the past, or where your own Root Lama has done their practice; as they say, the place then blesses the person.  As such, it would be great if you could find a place like this.

gru.acip: GAL TE MA BYUNG YANG RANG GI KHYIM MAM RNAL 'BYOR DANG RJES SU MTHUN PA'I SGRUB KHANG MTSAMS KYI DBU TSUGS NAS MA GROL GYI BAR DU BAR CHAD MI 'BYUNG BA'I GNAS SU SGRUB PA LA 'JUG PAR BYA'O,
gru.wylie: gal te ma byung yang rang gi khyim mam rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa'i sgrub khang mtshams kyi dbu tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar du bar chad mi 'byung ba'i gnas su sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o
gru.english: In the case that you can't find a place like any of those mentioned here, you can do retreat inside your own house, in a retreat cabin which is conducive to deep practice, or some other place where you won't be interrupted at all from the moment you start up until you finally leave the retreat. When to Start Retreat

gru.acip: SGRUB KHANG GI PHYI NANG NYE 'KHOR THAMS CAD PHYAG BDAR LEGS PAR BYAS LA BSANG BDUG LEGS PAR GTONG , DRI ZHIM PO'I ME TOG BDUD RTZI LNGA DANG BA BYUNG GIS BYUGS LA CHAG CHAG GDAB, ME TOG GCAL DU BKRAM, BDUD RTZI RIL BU SOGS MED NA NANG MCHOD BYIN RLABS BYAS PA GTOR BAS 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: sgrub khang gi phyi nang nye 'khor thams cad phyag bdar legs par byas la bsang bdug legs par gtong , dri zhim po'i me tog bdud rtsi lnga dang ba byung gis byugs la chag chag gdab, me tog gcal du bkram, bdud rtsi ril bu sogs med na nang mchod byin rlabs byas pa gtor bas 'grub
gru.english: Now prepare your retreat hut.  Sweep and clean every part of your retreat house very thoroughly--inside, outside, as well as the surrounding area.  Then fill the house with the sweet smell of juniper incense.  Throw fragrant flowers everywhere, spray the five nectars around, spread cow dung on the walls [an ancient antiseptic], and sprinkle water on the ground to keep the dust down.  Make a carpet of flowers everywhere.  Then throw nectar pills all around or, if you don't have any, spray inner offering which you have blessed.

gru.acip: SGRUB KHANG GI NANG DU JI LTAR 'OS PA'I PHYOGS SU RJE BTZUN MA'I BRIS 'BUR GYI SKU DANG RGYUD KYI PO TI SOGS MCHOG GSUM GYI RTEN LEGS PAR DGRAM,
gru.wylie: sgrub khang gi nang du ji ltar 'os pa'i phyogs su rje btsun ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku dang rgyud kyi po ti sogs mchog gsum gyi rten legs par dgram
gru.english: In an appropriate place inside the retreat house set up a beautiful altar to the Three Supreme Ones with a painting or sculpture of the Blessed Angel, secret holy scriptures, and so on.

gru.acip: MTSAMS KYI RING GZHAN NAS DNGOS PO DANG YO BYAD CI BYUNG YANG MTSAMS THO'I NANG DU KHYER MI 'ONG ZHING NANG NAS KYANG PHYI LA MI 'BYIN, BSNYEN PA LEGS PAR TSUGS NAS MTSAMS GROL GROL GYI BAR DON GCOD DANG BKOD PA BYED DGOS PA RNAMS BYA, GZHAN BYED DGOS THAMS CAD MTSAMS LA 'JUG NYIN YAN LA GRUB PAR BYAS TE, PHYI NANG GI G-YENG BA CI YANG MED PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: mtshams kyi ring gzhan nas dngos po dang yo byad ci byung yang mtshams tho'i nang du khyer mi 'ong zhing nang nas kyang phyi la mi 'byin, bsnyen pa legs par tshugs nas mtshams grol grol gyi bar don gcod dang bkod pa byed dgos pa rnams bya, gzhan byed dgos thams cad mtshams la 'jug nyin yan la grub par byas te, phyi nang gi g-yeng ba ci yang med par bya'o
gru.english: For the length of your retreat don't allow anything, any stuff, to come in past your retreat marker which was not in your original plan; and don't send outside anything that you began the retreat with.  Wrap up all of your business and other affairs before you start your retreat, and don't return to them until the retreat is over.  Finish everything you have to do before the day that you go into retreat.  Don't have any external or internal distractions at all. Reading Two: How to Start the Retreat

gru.acip: DE NAS SNGON 'GRO'I THO YIG ZUR DU BKOD DE LTAR LAS BUM ZHIG TU DUM SKYES MA BSKYED DE, KHAndA RO HI BRGYA RTZA SOGS BZLAS LA MTHAR 'OD ZHU BYAS TE BSANG CHU SGRUB,
gru.wylie: de nas sngon 'gro'i tho yig zur du bkod de ltar las bum zhig tu dum skyes ma bskyed de, khaNDa ro hi brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la mthar 'od zhu byas te bsang chu sgrub
gru.english: Following my ritual on how to start a retreat, you should begin with the ritual vase.  Prepare the secret water by creating the Lady of Pieces within the vase.  This is done with the ritual that includes reciting Her secret words one hundred times, and melting Her into light at the end.

gru.acip: MKHA' 'GRO SPYI GTOR GZHI BDAG GTOR MA, BGEGS GTOR RNAMS BSHAM, RANG NYID RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I NGA RGYAL DANG LDAN PAS MKHA' 'GRO SPYI GTOR DANG GZHI BDAG GTOR MA BTANG LA BSNYEN SGRUB MTHAR PHYIN PA LA BAR CHAD BZLOG CING , MTHUN RKYEN SGRUB PA'I 'PHRIN LAS BCOL,
gru.wylie: mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma, bgegs gtor rnams bsham, rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma btang la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa la bar chad bzlog cing , mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i 'phrin las bcol
gru.english: Next prepare the torma Offering Cake for All Angels, the Offering Cake for the Spirit Lord, and the Offering Cake for the Obstructing Spirits.  Identifying strongly with the Holy Angel of Diamond, first offer the Offerings Cake for All Angels, and then present the Offering Cake for the Spirit Lord.  Entreat these holy beings to stop all obstacles for the duration of your retreat, and to perform Their sacred activity of granting you whatever assistance you might need.

gru.acip: BGEGS GTOR BTANG LA BSNYEN SGRUB BYED PA LA MI DGA' BA'I BGEGS KYI TSOGS THAMS CAD GNAS GZHAN DU BSKRAD PA'I DMIGS PA SHUGS DRAG BYA ZHING , DUM SKYES MA'I SNGAGS SOGS DRAG TU BZLA BA DANG , GU GUL GYIS BDUG PA DANG , YUNGS KAR GYIS BRAB PA DANG , ROL MO'I SGRA DRAG TU BYAS TE GTOR MA PHYIR BSKYEL ZHING BGEGS THAMS CAD BSKRAD PAS GZHAN DU SONG BA'I MOS PA BRTAN PO BYA,
gru.wylie: bgegs gtor btang la bsnyen sgrub byed pa la mi dga' ba'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gnas gzhan du bskrad pa'i dmigs pa shugs drag bya zhing , dum skyes ma'i sngags sogs drag tu bzla ba dang , gu gul gyis bdug pa dang , yungs kar gyis brab pa dang , rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas te gtor ma phyir bskyel zhing bgegs thams cad bskrad pas gzhan du song ba'i mos pa brtan po bya
gru.english: As you present the Offering Cake for the Obstructing Spirits, imagine vividly that the entire mass of obstructing spirits who are not happy about your retreat are being chased somewhere else far away.  Recite the secret words of the Lady of Pieces, and the rest, fiercely; burn lots of gugul incense; throw mustard seeds everywhere; and make a lot of noise with your bell.  Then take the offering cake outside and decide firmly in your heart that all of the spirits that might have caused you problems have been chased away.

gru.acip: DE NAS STAN BDE BA LA LUS RNAM SNANG GI CHOS BDUN LDAN GYIS KHA NUB TU PHYOGS PA'AM PHYOGS PAR MOS DGOS TE, 'DI'I RGYA GZHUNG RNAMS SU AOO d'I YA NA'I GNAS SU KHA BLTAS NAS BSGOM NA MKHA' SPYOD 'GRUB PA'I DGOS PA KHYAD PAR CAN YOD PAR GSUNGS PAS SO,,
gru.wylie: de nas stan bde ba la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan gyis kha nub tu phyogs pa'am phyogs par mos dgos te, 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams su aoo DI ya na'i gnas su kha bltas nas bsgom na mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod par gsungs pas so
gru.english: Then sit down on your comfortable meditation seat and assume the seven-point posture of the Buddha of Appearances.  Face towards the west, or imagine that whatever direction you happen to be facing is west.  The ancient Sanskrit scriptures say that there is a very special purpose served by doing so: if you meditate facing the holy Land of Uddiyana, then you will reach the Angel's Heaven faster.

gru.acip: BGEGS BSKRAD CING BSRUNG BA DANG , GNAS GSUM BYIN GYIS BRLAB PA DANG , GDAN BSRUNG BA 'DI RNAMS GRUB CHEN RNAMS KYI GZHUNG DU MAR 'BYUNG BAS GAL CHE'O,,
gru.wylie: bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba dang , gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang , gdan bsrung ba 'di rnams grub chen rnams kyi gzhung du mar 'byung bas gal che'o
gru.english: All of these practices--chasing away obstructing spirits, building-up protection, blessing the three places of your body, and protecting your meditation seat--are found in the ancient treatises written by great secret practitioners, and it is very important that you do them. How to Prepare Your Mind

gru.acip: DE NAS JI SKAD DU, SGRUB THABS KUN BZANG LAS,
gru.wylie: de nas ji skad du, sgrub thabs kun bzang las
gru.english: Je Tsongkapa's ritual for reaching Gentle Voice, entitled Every Good, says:

gru.acip: ,DAL 'BYOR 'DI NI SHIN TU G-YO BA DANG , ,'JIG RTEN SKYE BO DAM PA PHRAD RNYED DKA', ,DE BAS SHES RAB THABS LA GZHOL BA YI, ,YID LA BYED PA'I MCHOG DE BSGRUB PAR BYA, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g-yo ba dang , ,'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka', ,de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yi, ,yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: This life of leisure and fortune is fragile; Holy beings are hard to meet in this world; Thus should you start your practice With that highest state of mind Lost to wisdom and method.

gru.acip: DAL 'BYOR SHIN TU RNYED DKA' ZHING 'JIG SLA BA DANG , SKYES PU DAM PA DGE BA'I BSHES GNYEN DANG 'PHRAD PA DANG , DE'I GDAMS NGAG THOB NAS RNAM PAR DAG PA'I LAM SGRUB PA SHIN TU RNYED DKA' TSUL LA NGES PA DRANGS SHING ,
gru.wylie: dal 'byor shin tu rnyed dka' zhing 'jig sla ba dang , skyes pu dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa dang , de'i gdams ngag thob nas rnam par dag pa'i lam sgrub pa shin tu rnyed dka' tshul la nges pa drangs shing
gru.english: As these lines say, the body and mind of leisure and fortune which you now have are very difficult to find.  They can be destroyed very easily.  And to have met a holy being--your spiritual guide; for Him or Her to have granted you proper spiritual instructions; and to then have this opportunity to practice this pure and holy path is extremely rare.  Think about this over and over until it becomes a conviction deep within your heart.

gru.acip: GAL TE G-YENG BAS TSE 'DIR DE LTA BU MA 'GRUB KYANG 'CHI BA'I TSE DPA' PO RNAL 'BYOR MA'I TSOGS KYIS ROL MO'I SGRA DANG BCAS MKHA' SPYOD PU 'KHRID PAR BYED PA DANG
gru.wylie: gal te g-yeng bas tshe 'dir de lta bu ma 'grub kyang 'chi ba'i tshe dpa' po rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas mkha' spyod pu 'khrid par byed pa dang
gru.english: Even those practitioners who get distracted by this life, and who thus aren't able to reach the goal within their lifetime, will be greeted by a great gathering of man and woman Angels at the time of their death.  These Angels will lead them to Heaven, with a great symphony of music.

gru.acip: KHYAD PAR 'KHOR BSGYUR THOB PAR GSUNGS PA SOGS RGYUD DANG 'GREL PA DU MA NAS LAN CIG MA YIN PAR BSNGAGS PA'I LAM BZANG BO 'DI LTA BU LA ZHUGS NAS BSNYEN SGRUB BYED RGYU BYUNG BA SHIN TU SKAL BA BZANG NGO SNYAM PA'I BAR DU RANG GZHAN GYI BYA BA DANG SKYID SDUG CHE CHUNG CI BYUNG YANG , DE'I DBANG DU MA SONG BAR BYA SNYAM PA'I SNYING RUS DANG
gru.wylie: khyad par 'khor bsgyur thob par gsungs pa sogs rgyud dang 'grel pa du ma nas lan cig ma yin par bsngags pa'i lam bzang bo 'di lta bu la zhugs nas bsnyen sgrub byed rgyu byung ba shin tu skal ba bzang ngo snyam pa'i bar du rang gzhan gyi bya ba dang skyid sdug che chung ci byung yang , de'i dbang du ma song bar bya snyam pa'i snying rus dang
gru.english: This is simply how it is in general; more specifically, such people will be reborn as world-emperors: those empowered by the wheel.  The Enlightened Ones have praised this beautiful path as possessing all of these amazing qualities. Think to yourself how incredibly lucky you are just to be able to do retreat.  Make a resolve from your very core that regardless of what happens to you or to those who are helping you--be it good or bad, big or small--you will refuse to let it disturb your retreat.

gru.acip: DE YANG SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM LAS BYUNG BA LTAR BDUD RTZI MYANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR NAS BKRA SHIS KYI BAR DANG , TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO DANG BCAS PA BYA, GZHAN YANG BSNGO SMON SOGS NYAL KHA'I NYAMS LEN GYI RIM PA RNAMS LEGS BAR BYAS TE NYAL BA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA 'JUG,
gru.wylie: de yang sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam las byung ba ltar bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor nas bkra shis kyi bar dang , tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa bya, gzhan yang bsngo smon sogs nyal kha'i nyams len gyi rim pa rnams legs bar byas te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug
gru.english: On the first night of your retreat start with the Practice of Taking Nectar and continue all the way up to the final verses of joyful fortune, using the unique ritual text for reaching the Angel entitled the Short Path to Great Bliss.  You should also perform the Offering of the Gathering and the final dedications, prayers, and so on.  Having gone carefully through all the practices that take you up to bedtime, start off on the Practice of Sleeping.

gru.acip: NGAG BYIN RLABS DANG BLA MCHOD SOGS BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR, TSE SGRUB SOGS NYAMS SU LEN DGOS RNAMS SNGON DU BTANG , BDUD RTZI RIL BU'AM DE BTAB PA'I NANG MCHOD LCE THOG TU BZHAG LA BDUD RTZI MYANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR,
gru.wylie: ngag byin rlabs dang bla mchod sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor, tshe sgrub sogs nyams su len dgos rnams sngon du btang , bdud rtsi ril bu'am de btab pa'i nang mchod lce thog tu bzhag la bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor
gru.english: In the morning session first do any practices which you have committed to do; for example, the practice of blessing your speech, performing a Lama Practice such as the Offering to Lamas, long-life practices, or others of the like.  Then do the Practice of Taking Nectar by placing a nectar pill--or inner offering made with a nectar pill--upon your tongue.

gru.acip: THUN BAR PA GNYIS LA BDUD RTZI MYANG BA NAS BDAG BSKYED KYI MCHOD PA BYIN RLABS BAR SGRUB THABS BZHIN DANG , DE NAS BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR ZHES PA NAS SKYABS GNAS KUN 'DUS KYI NGO BOR GYUR, CES BLA MA BSKYED PA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI RJES,
gru.wylie: thun bar pa gnyis la bdud rtsi myang ba nas bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa byin rlabs bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang , de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdun gyi nam mkhar zhes pa nas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur, ces bla ma bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes
gru.english: In the second and third sessions follow the ritual from the Practice of Taking Nectar up to the place where you bless the offerings to the Angel created from yourself.  Then begin the Practice of the Lama with the section from "In the air in front of me�� up to ��each Lama becomes every place of refuge within a single being."

gru.acip: THUN THA MA LA TSAM RNGAM GYI SRUNG BA YAN GONG GI THUN BAR PA GNYIS LTAR LA GTOR 'BUL SMON LAM SHIS BRJOD RGYAS PA BCAS SGRUB THABS BDE CHEN NYE LAM LTAR BYA'O,
gru.wylie: thun tha ma la tsham rngam gyi srung ba yan gong gi thun bar pa gnyis ltar la gtor 'bul smon lam shis brjod rgyas pa bcas sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam ltar bya'o
gru.english: In the fourth session follow the same pattern as for the second and third sessions, adding the practice of the offering cakes, the longer concluding prayer, and the verses of joyful fortune as found in the Short Path to Great Bliss.

gru.acip: DE LTAR THOR THUN, SNGA THUN, DGONG THUN, SROD THUN TE THUN BZHIR NYAMS SU LEN CING , THUN GYI RING THUNG RANG GI KHAMS DANG MOS PA DANG BSTUN, MTSAMS KYI MGO MJUG GNYIS LHOD PA DANG DKYIL DU GRIM PA'I BSNYEN SGRUB NAS 'DRA BA BYA DGOS, NYI MA 'CHAR NUB KYI ZER KHA GNYIS DANG , NYIN GUNG MTSAN GUNG GNYIS TE TING NGE 'DZIN 'JIG PA'I DUS BZHI LA THUN MTSAMS KHEL BAR BYA,
gru.wylie: de ltar thor thun, snga thun, dgong thun, srod thun te thun bzhir nyams su len cing , thun gyi ring thung rang gi khams dang mos pa dang bstun, mtshams kyi mgo mjug gnyis lhod pa dang dkyil du grim pa'i bsnyen sgrub nas 'dra ba bya dgos, nyi ma 'char nub kyi zer kha gnyis dang , nyin gung mtshan gung gnyis te ting nge 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus bzhi la thun mtshams khel bar bya
gru.english: In this way you should follow the practice of the four sessions of pre-dawn, morning, evening, and night.  The length of each session should be in keeping with your own propensities and drive.  You have to make your retreat like a grain of barley--be more relaxed at the beginning and end, and work especially hard during the middle part.  Be sure that the four times when concentration is broken--when the sun breaks the horizon at dawn and dusk, and also the mid-points of day and night, meaning noon and midnight--fall inbetween your session times.

gru.acip: 'DI NYID RGYUN DU MA GRUB NA AOm GSUM MA NYID LAN GSUM BZLAS PAS KYANG RUNG GSUNG NGO,,
gru.wylie: 'di nyid rgyun du ma grub na aoM gsum ma nyid lan gsum bzlas pas kyang rung gsung ngo
gru.english: It has also been stated in scripture that--if you are not performing the practice this way on a regular basis--then you can simply recite three rounds of the secret words of the Triple Om over the rosary to bless it.

gru.acip: MTHE BONG LCAGS KYU'I TSUL GYIS DNGOS GRUB 'GUGS PA'I BSAM PAS BGRANG BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: mthe bong lcags kyu'i tshul gyis dngos grub 'gugs pa'i bsam pas bgrang bar bya'o
gru.english: As you count on the rosary imagine that each time you move your thumb you are reeling in realizations, the joint bent like a fishhook. How to do the Recitation

gru.acip: RJES SU BZUNG BA'I MTSAN MA BRTAN PO RNYED NA BZLAS GRANGS MA RDZOGS KYANG SGRUB PA DANG LAS SBYOR LA 'JUG TU RUNG BA 'DRA STE,
gru.wylie: rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma brtan po rnyed na bzlas grangs ma rdzogs kyang sgrub pa dang las sbyor la 'jug tu rung ba 'dra ste
gru.english: It appears to be the case that, if you get some strong signs that She has taken you into Her care, then even if you have yet to finish the customary total number of recitations you can proceed to higher practices and rites.

gru.acip: BEEd'URA ZHUN MA'I THEM SKAS LAS, AOm GSUM 'BUM PHRAG BRGYA TZAM GYI GRANGS KYI BSNYEN PA MTHAR PHYIN PA'AM, MTSAN MA BRTAN PO MA RNYED KYI BAR DU 'BAD NAS DE NAS SGRUB BSNYEN BYA DGOS PAS ZHES GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: beeDUra zhun ma'i them skas las, aoM gsum 'bum phrag brgya tsam gyi grangs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'am, mtshan ma brtan po ma rnyed kyi bar du 'bad nas de nas sgrub bsnyen bya dgos pas zhes gsungs
gru.english: And that's because the Staircase of Lapis Pure says-- You should continue your efforts either until you complete your retreat at the total of a hundred sets of a hundred thousand Mantras of the Triple Om,  or else until you receive some strong sign.  And then you must go on to get closer to Her with higher practices. Retreat Advice

gru.acip: DE LTAR BSNYEN PA TSAD LDAN BYA BA LA DAM TSIG DANG SPANG BLANG GI RIM PA NI, PHA DAM PA SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHAL NAS, BSNYEN PA YAL BA'I GNAD LNGA NGO MA SHES NA BSNYEN SGRUB BYAS PA DON MED DU 'GRO,
gru.wylie: de ltar bsnyen pa tshad ldan bya ba la dam tshig dang spang blang gi rim pa ni, pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas, bsnyen pa yal ba'i gnad lnga ngo ma shes na bsnyen sgrub byas pa don med du 'gro
gru.english: What sort of pledges should you keep while on retreat?  What things should you do and what shouldn't you do?  Pa Dampa Sangye has given the following advice: "If you don't know the five things which dissipate the energy of retreat, then your attempts to do retreat will be meaningless."

gru.acip: BRTUL ZHUGS GRUB PA'I BDAG NYID CHEN PO PAD+M'A KA RAS, DENG SANG SNGAGS PA RNAMS LA RGYUD NAS BSHAD PA'I RTAGS DANG NUS PA TSUL BZHIN MI 'BYUNG BA NI, MTSAMS GSUM RAL BA'I SKYON YIN,
gru.wylie: brtul zhugs grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po pad+mA ka ras, deng sang sngags pa rnams la rgyud nas bshad pa'i rtags dang nus pa tshul bzhin mi 'byung ba ni, mtshams gsum ral ba'i skyon yin
gru.english: The great being Padmakara, master of spiritual asceticism, has given these practical advices: The reason why secret practitioners of our time are not achieving spiritual powers or signs of successful practice is because they are breaking the three boundaries.

gru.acip: SGRUB PA MA THON BAR GNAS MI SPO, GDAN MI SPRUGS, MI DANG KHA 'PHRO MI BSRE, GTOR MA DUS LAS MA YOL BAR 'BUL, 'THAB 'KHON MI BYA, GTOR PHUD NYAMS SU MI 'JUG, SGRUB KHANG DU KHYI, YUGS SA, MDZE PHO DME CAN 'ONG MI 'JUG, DE DAG GI ZAS MI ZA, RANG GI NYAL MAL DU GZHAN MI GTONG , PHRENG BA MI LAG MI 'GRIM, GZHU MI 'THEN, MDA' MI BCAG ,MTSON RTZE KHAR MI 'JUG,
gru.wylie: sgrub pa ma thon bar gnas mi spo, gdan mi sprugs, mi dang kha 'phro mi bsre, gtor ma dus las ma yol bar 'bul, 'thab 'khon mi bya, gtor phud nyams su mi 'jug, sgrub khang du khyi, yugs sa, mdze pho dme can 'ong mi 'jug, de dag gi zas mi za, rang gi nyal mal du gzhan mi gtong , phreng ba mi lag mi 'grim, gzhu mi 'then, mda' mi bcag ,mtshon rtse khar mi 'jug
gru.english: Until you finish retreat: �	don't move to another place �	don't move your meditation seat �	don't have any social interaction with anyone �	offer your torma cakes on time �	don't hold bitterness towards anyone �	avoid all friction �	protect the torma cakes and offerings from harm �	don't allow dogs, widows, lepers, or defiled persons inside your retreat house �	be careful about who prepares your food �	don't let anyone else use your bed �	don't let anyone handle your rosary �	don't pull bows or break arrows �	protect your tongue from harm; don't put anything sharp in your mouth, etc.

gru.acip: DES NA BSNYEN SGRUB KYI SNGAGS BZLA BA'I TSE BZLAS PA'I 'PHRO LA GNYID BRO BA, GLAL BA, SBRID PA, LUD PA ,'OG RLUNG , BSHANG BA, GCI BA SOGS BYUNG NA DE MA THAG 'PHRENG BA BZHAG STE NYE REG BYA ZHING KHA BSHAL NAS DE 'DRA BYUNG SKABS KYI SNGAGS DE BZLAS PA'I GRANGS SU MI BRTZI BAS,
gru.wylie: des na bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe bzlas pa'i 'phro la gnyid bro ba, glal ba, sbrid pa, lud pa ,'og rlung , bshang ba, gci ba sogs byung na de ma thag 'phreng ba bzhag ste nye reg bya zhing kha bshal nas de 'dra byung skabs kyi sngags de bzlas pa'i grangs su mi brtsi bas
gru.english: Suppose then that you begin to fall asleep; or burp, cough, spit, pass gas, or need to defecate or urinate while you are reciting the secret words during retreat.  Right after that you should put down your rosary, do the ritual washing, and rinse out your mouth with water.  You should not count any recitation you did during your yawning attack or whatever other problem it was.

gru.acip: ,RGYAL KUN BDE CHEN BZHIN LAG SGYU MA'I GAR, ,BYU RU'I LANG TSOR MTSAN DPE'I NYAMS SGEG MA, ,RGYAL YUM KHYOD KYIS BDAG DANG SGRUB PA POR, ,GSANG GSUM RDO RJE'I BYIN BRGYA MYUR PHOBS SHIG
gru.wylie: rgyal kun bde chen bzhin lag sgyu ma'i gar, ,byu ru'i lang tshor mtshan dpe'i nyams sgeg ma, ,rgyal yum khyod kyis bdag dang sgrub pa por, ,gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin brgya myur phobs shig
gru.english: Dancing the dance of illusion You are the true image Of the great bliss Of every Enlightened Being; Luring with alluring poses In the marks and signs Of an Enlightened Being, A beautiful maiden Shining with crimson and coral; O sweet Angel, Woman of every Buddha, I beg You to shower Down upon me, And all those who seek to reach You, The three great secrets-- A million blessings of diamond.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS KYI MCHOG RNAMS LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG NI SKYABS SU MCHI, ,BDAG GIS SBYIN SOGS BGYIS PA'I BSOD NAMS KYIS, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la, ,byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi, ,bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: Until I reach enlightenment I go for refuge To the Buddha, the Dharma, And the highest Community. Through the merit of giving And the other good things I do May I become a Buddha To help all living beings. Transforming into Her

gru.acip: LAN GSUM BRJOD PAS SGRUB THABS LTAR BYIN GYIS BRLABS LA,
gru.wylie: lan gsum brjod pas sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la
gru.english: Lastly, repeat the following mantra three times: Om ah hung. Creating the Sacred Water

gru.acip: BSANG CHU SGRUB PA NI,
gru.wylie: bsang chu sgrub pa ni
gru.english: [Fill the vase with saffron water and a vase or nectar pill.  Place the small conch shell filled with a little bit of water atop the vase, and tie one end of the string to your ritual diamond.]  Now bring into being the sacred water that we will use to clear away obstacles:

gru.acip: CES BSANG CHU SGRUB,
gru.wylie: ces bsang chu sgrub
gru.english: Blessing the Offering Cake for All Angels

gru.acip: ,SDE BRGYAD BTZUN MO SRAS DANG G-YOG BCAS PAS, ,DNGOS GRUB KUN GYI BKA' DRIN BDAG LA STZOL, ,RNAL 'BYOR BDAG CAG 'KHOR BCAS LA, ,NAD MED TSE DANG DBANG PHYUG DANG ,
gru.wylie: sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g-yog bcas pas, ,dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol, ,rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la, ,nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang
gru.english: May each and every one of you In these eight great multitudes, With your queens and princes, Princesses and knights, Grant me the great kindness Of all my spiritual goals. May you grant every one of us Who try to keep this practice Freedom from all illness, Long and healthy lives, And authority in all we do.

gru.acip: ,DPAL DANG GRAGS DANG SKAL BA BZANG , ,LONGS SPYOD RGYA CHEN KUN THOB CING , ,ZHI DANG RGYAS LA SOGS PA YI, ,LAS KYI DNGOS GRUB BDAG LA STZOL,
gru.wylie: dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang , ,longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing , ,zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi, ,las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol
gru.english: Help us gain glory An good reputation, The fortune virtue brings. Help us gain abundantly Material things we need; Grant us the ability To act in the various ways Of peace, prosperity, And all the rest as well.

gru.acip: ,'JIG RTEN BDE ZHING LO LEGS DANG , ,'BRU RNAMS 'PHEL ZHING CHOS 'PHEL DANG , ,BDE LEGS THAMS CAD 'BYUNG BA DANG , ,YID LA 'DOD PA KUN 'GRUB SHOG
gru.wylie: 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang , ,'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang , ,bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang , ,yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog
gru.english: May the whole world be happy. May the crops grow high. May the harvests be plentiful. May the teachings spread. May every good And virtuous thing Come to pass. May every one Upon the earth Get all they wish for. Blessing and Presenting the Offering Cake for the Local Spirit Lord

gru.acip: ,BZHES NAS BDAG CAG YON MCHOD RNAMS, ,LAS DANG BYA BA CI BYED KYANG , ,KO LONG PHRAG DOG MA MDZAD PAR, ,MTHUN RKYEN YID BZHIN 'GRUB PAR MDZOD,
gru.wylie: bzhes nas bdag cag yon mchod rnams, ,las dang bya ba ci byed kyang , ,ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par, ,mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod
gru.english: Accept our offering, And bring to us-- Practitioners, sponsors, and revered ones-- All the things we need for our retreat, Exactly what we want for it, And feel no irritation or envy Regardless of what sacred rites And sacred work we do here.

gru.acip: ,CES BSNGO ZHING BSNYEN SGRUB MTHAR PHYIN PA DANG BAR CHAD BZLOG CING MTHUN RKYEN SGRUB PA'I 'PHRIN LAS BCOL,
gru.wylie: ces bsngo zhing bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa dang bar chad bzlog cing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i 'phrin las bcol
gru.english: In such words then do we dedicate the power of what we are to do; and exhort the spirit beings to their sacred work of helping us bring our retreat to a successful conclusion, prevent every obstacle, and aid us in acquiring all the things and conditions we require for this success. Presenting the Offering Cake for the Obstructing Spirits

gru.acip: ,H'Um, ,'JIGS PA'I H'Um SGRA NGES SGROG CING , ,BGEGS RNAMS MA LUS 'JOMS MDZAD PA, ,DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD STZAL PA'I LHA, ,BGEGS KYI DGRA LA PHYAG 'TSAL BSTOD,
gru.wylie: hUM, ,'jigs pa'i hUM sgra nges sgrog cing , ,bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa, ,dngos grub thams cad stsal pa'i lha, ,bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod
gru.english: Hung! Blast forth the terrifying sound of hung! Smash all those who would hinder us! I bow down to the Angel who grant to us Every attainment of the spirit; I bow down to that great foe Of all those who would hinder us.

gru.acip: RANG GI THUGS KA'I Bm YIG LAS 'OD ZER 'PHROS PAS BSNYEN SGRUB ZAB MO BYED PA LA BAR DU GCOD PA'I BGEGS KYI TSOGS RNAMS MCHOD SBYIN GYI GTOR MA 'DI'I MGRON DU
gru.wylie: rang gi thugs ka'i bM yig las 'od zer 'phros pas bsnyen sgrub zab mo byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di'i mgron du
gru.english: From the letter vam At my holy heart Fly out rays of light. They invite as guests To partake of the torma of offering Entire crowds of obstructing spirits Whose only aim is to disrupt This profound act that I'm about to do, This sacred act of retreat.

gru.acip: ,NGA NI GNAS 'DIR BSNYEN SGRUB ZAB MO BYED, ,KHYED RNAMS 'DI NAS GZHAN DU 'GRO BAR GYIS, I
gru.wylie: nga ni gnas 'dir bsnyen sgrub zab mo byed, ,khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis, i
gru.english: Am going to undertake A deep retreat Here in this place; You Are going to leave And find someplace else To stay.

gru.acip: BDAG GIS GNAS 'DIR BSNYEN SGRUB ZAB MO BYED PA LA
gru.wylie: bdag gis gnas 'dir bsnyen sgrub zab mo byed pa la
gru.english: I am going to accomplish, Here in this one place, A deep and holy retreat.

gru.acip: CES SNGAGS DRAG TU BZLA ZHING GU GUL GYIS BDUG, YUNGS KAR GYIS BRAB, ROL MO'I SGRA DRAG PO DANG BCAS GTOR MA RGYANG RING DU BSKYEL ZHING BSNYEN SGRUB BYED PA LA BAR DU GCOD PA'I BGEGS THAMS CAD RGYANG RING DU BSKRAD PA'I MOS PA SHUGS DRAG BYA,
gru.wylie: ces sngags drag tu bzla zhing gu gul gyis bdug, yungs kar gyis brab, rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas gtor ma rgyang ring du bskyel zhing bsnyen sgrub byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa shugs drag bya
gru.english: Recite these secret words in a ferocious tone as you ring your bell and carry a burning censer of gugul incense around your retreat house, throwing mustard seeds into every corner.  Then with a great clamor of bell and the like take the Offering Cake for the Obstructing Spirits outside, carry and place it away from the house, and believe with absolute conviction that all of the obstructing spirits have been chased far away. Reading 4-A Setting Up Our Retreat Boundary Markers

gru.acip: LAN GSUM BRJOD PAS SGRUB THABS LTAR BYIN GYIS BRLABS LA,
gru.wylie: lan gsum brjod pas sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la
gru.english: Lastly, repeat the following mantra three times to bless the torma: Om ah hung.

gru.acip: RNAL 'BYOR PA BDAG GI BSNYEN GRUB KYI BYA BA MTHAR MA PHYIN GYI BAR DU GNAS 'DIR BRTAN PAR BZHUGS NAS PHYI'I GDON BGEGS BAR GCOD NANG DU MI GTONG ZHING NANG GI DNGOS GRUB PHYIR MI G-YEL BA'I 'PHRIN LAS MDZOD CIG
gru.wylie: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bsnyen grub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas phyi'i gdon bgegs bar gcod nang du mi gtong zhing nang gi dngos grub phyir mi g-yel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig
gru.english: I who am trying to keep this practice Am going to do a retreat in this place, And ask You to remain here steadfast Until I come to this retreat's end. Stop all the outer spirits and obstacles Who might try to come inside, And don't allow a single one Of my inner attainments to get away.

gru.acip: CES BRJOD LA ME TOG 'THOR, ZHAL GYIS BZHES TE SGRUB PA MA THON GYI BAR DUM SKYES MA 'OD ZHU MI BYED PAR GNAS DER 'PHRIN LAS MDZAD CING BZHUGS PAR BSAMS NAS
gru.wylie: ces brjod la me tog 'thor, zhal gyis bzhes te sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar dum skyes ma 'od zhu mi byed par gnas der 'phrin las mdzad cing bzhugs par bsams nas
gru.english: Throw flower petals in the air in celebration, and believe that the Lady of Pieces has happily agreed not to disappear into light; that She will stay and protect you until the you complete  your retreat.

gru.acip: SNGAGS 'OD ZER DANG BCAS PA YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS SHAR NAG ,BYANG LJANG , NUB DMAR, LHO SER BA'I SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I RVA BA GRU BZHI PA TSANGS PA'I 'JIG RTEN NAS GSER GYI SA GZHI LA THUG GI BAR DU KHYAB PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las shar nag ,byang ljang , nub dmar, lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rva ba gru bzhi pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab par gyur
gru.english: Then the secret words and the light Transform into four walls Composed of crossed diamonds: Black to the east, Green to the north, Red to the west, And yellow to the south. The walls extend From the very top of the world Down to its innermost core.

whole_word_matches.context: g , nub dmar, lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rva ba gru bzhi pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la

gru.acip: RVA BA GRUB PA DANG DUS MNYAM DU H'Um LAS SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I LTE BA LA H'Um GIS MTSAN PA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER LAS GSER GYI SA GZHI LA THUG PA'I 'OG GI SA GZHI SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I RANG BZHIN DU GYUR,
gru.wylie: rva ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du hUM las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hUM gis mtshan pa'i hUM gi 'od zer las gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i 'og gi sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur
gru.english: As the walls are forming A letter hung appears And turns into a crossed diamond Marked at its center with hung. From the letter hung come rays of light Which become an entire ground Made itself of crossed diamonds And extending down to the very Core of the earth.

gru.acip: RANG NYID LHAR GSAL BA'I SKU LAS 'OD ZER DANG KHRO BO'I TSOGS DPAG TU MED PA SPROS TE THOS BSAM SGOM SGRUB BYED PA LA BAR DU GCOD PA'I BGEGS THAMS CAD BSKRAD PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer dang khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te thos bsam sgom sgrub byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur
gru.english: I see myself as an Angel, And from my holy body Fly forth rays of light And countless ferocious Angels. They go out and chase away All of the obstructing spirits That might cause an obstacle To my achieving the goals Of studying, contemplating, And carrying out this practice.

gru.acip: DES SNGON 'GRO'I SKOR RNAMS LEGS PAR GRUB PAS CUNG ZAD NGAL BSO ZHING , BZA' BTUNG DANG , KHAMS GSENG BA SOGS BYAS NAS SROD KYI DUS LA BAB PA NA THUN DNGOS GZHI'I 'GO 'DZUG PA YIN NO,
gru.wylie: des sngon 'gro'i skor rnams legs par grub pas cung zad ngal bso zhing , bza' btung dang , khams gseng ba sogs byas nas srod kyi dus la bab pa na thun dngos gzhi'i 'go 'dzug pa yin no
gru.english: With this you have completed, in an excellent way, everything having to do with the preliminaries to your retreat; and should take a nice break.  Relax, have something to eat and drink, stretch out, whatever.  Then, as dusk falls, you should start off on your practice of the four sessions.

gru.acip: 'DI YANG DGE BSNYEN RDO RJE RAB BRTAN DANG , SPAR GYI SBYIN BDAG SER BYES TSA BA DGE SLONG THUB BSTAN DNGOS GRUB BCAS NAS YANG YANG BSKUL NGOR 7 PHA BONG KHA'I SPRUL MING PA BYAMS PA BSTAN 'DZIN 'PHRIN LAS RGYA MTSOR 'BOD PAS BSGRIGS PA'I YI GE PA NI CHAB MDO BDAG LDAN DPON LHAS BGYIS PA DGE LEGS 'PHEL,,
gru.wylie: 'di yang dge bsnyen rdo rje rab brtan dang , spar gyi sbyin bdag ser byes tsha ba dge slong thub bstan dngos grub bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor 7 pha bong kha'i sprul ming pa byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtshor 'bod pas bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni chab mdo bdag ldan dpon lhas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel
gru.english: It was written at the repeated insistence of that layperson with lifetime vows, Dorje Rabten, and by the sponsor of the carving: the full monk Tupten Ngudrup, a member of the Tsawa College of Sera Je Monastery.  And it was composed by myself, Jampa Tendzin Trinle Gyatso--the one they call by the name of the Incarnation of Pabongka.  The scribe who first wrote it out was Dakden Punhla of Chamdo.  May goodness reign! *Translator's note: In the original Tibetan text, there is an additional section inserted at this point which repeats, almost word for word, sections of the Stairway to Heaven text by Dechen Nyingpo which forms the first reading for this twelfth course of the Tantric Series.  We have therefore not included that text here, but continue on to advices on coming out of retreat contained at the very end of the present work.  There are a very small number of points found in this middle piece that are not included in the Stairway, and these are specifically covered in the homework masters to the course. At The End of Your Retreat

gru.acip: ,BDAG GI SGRUB PA'I BYA BA LA, ,STONGS GROGS 'PHRIN LAS BSGRUBS PA LEGS, ,LUS DANG GRIB MA BZHIN 'GROGS NAS, ,BDE CHEN YE SHES BSKYED DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bdag gi sgrub pa'i bya ba la, ,stongs grogs 'phrin las bsgrubs pa legs, ,lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas, ,bde chen ye shes bskyed du gsol
gru.english: O sweet Angel, What You have done here In Your sacred deeds To assist me in This spiritual journey Has truly been An excellent thing. Stay now at my side Close as my very shadow; Ignite within me The wisdom of greatest bliss.

gru.acip: AOm, ,KHYED KYIS SEMS CAN DON KUN MDZAD, ,RJES SU MTHUN PA'I DNGOS GRUB BSTZAL, ,SANGS RGYAS YUL DU GSHEGS NAS KYANG, ,SLAR YANG 'BYON PAR MDZAD DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: aoM, ,khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad, ,rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bstsal, ,sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang, ,slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol
gru.english: Om! You have accomplished something Which is of benefit For every living being. You have granted them The attainments That are fitting for them. And even though You return now, To Your enlightened world, I pray that You Will come again When I call.

gru.acip: (DE NAS GTANG RAG GI MCHOD GTOR, TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO DANG, TIL GTZO BOR BYAS PA'I KHA SKONG ZHI BA'I SBYIN SREG SOGS GRUB RJES, DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD, BDAG 'JUG LEN PA SOGS BYED CING, MJUG TU DGE RTZA RNAMS BSNGO SMON GYI RGYAS 'DEBS BYA'O,)
gru.wylie: (de nas gtang rag gi mchod gtor, tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang, til gtso bor byas pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs grub rjes, dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod, bdag 'jug len pa sogs byed cing, mjug tu dge rtsa rnams bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bya'o,)
gru.english: Then set out an offering cake to express your thanks, and celebrate with a Circle of Gathering. Perform a fire offering of the peaceful type--emphasizing the offering of the sesame seeds--to make up for mistakes in your retreat.  After that you can engage in activities such a bringing into being the secret world and making its offerings, as well as taking yourself into it.  Seal the entire event by dedicating all the goodness you have done, and praying that it may help all beings.

gru.acip: , ,RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DBANG MO'I SGO NAS ZHI BA'I SBYIN SREG BYA TSUL DNGOS GRUB 'DOD 'JO ZHES BYA BA BZHUGS SO, ,
gru.wylie: ,rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya tshul dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so,
gru.english: Herein Contained is The Sacred Cow Who Grants Every Spiritual Goal Instructions on How to Perform the Peaceful Fire Offering In the Practice of the Queen of Naropa's Heaven The Holy Angel of Diamond

gru.acip: ,BLA MA MCHOG DANG DBYER MED HE RU KA:, ,RDO RJE BTZUN MOR BCAS LA GUS BTUD NAS, ,DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS SGRUB BYED THABS KYI MCHOG ,SBYIN SREG LAG LEN GSAL BAR BSHAD KYIS NYON,
gru.wylie: bla ma mchog dang dbyer med he ru ka:, ,rdo rje btsun mor bcas la gus btud nas, ,dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub byed thabs kyi mchog ,sbyin sreg lag len gsal bar bshad kyis nyon
gru.english: I bow down with deep devotion To Heruka and the Diamond Queen, Inseparable from my Teacher, supreme. Listen here, for I shall explain, Quite clearly, how to perform The offering of fire, highest method For reaching both the goals. Introduction

gru.acip: ZLUM THIG PHYI MA'I TSANGS THIG GI STENG DU SOR GNYIS DOR BAR MTSAN MA BYAS LA ZUR BZHIR BYA RJES BTZAL BA'I STENG DU THIG GRU BZHIR GDAB PA NI STEGS BU'O,,
gru.wylie: zlum thig phyi ma'i tshangs thig gi steng du sor gnyis dor bar mtshan ma byas la zur bzhir bya rjes btsal ba'i steng du thig gru bzhir gdab pa ni stegs bu'o
gru.english: 10) Next make marks on the Pure Line and the line running perpindicular to it two fingerwidths away from the outer circle.  Now make arcs at the four corners.  Connect these points to make a square, which will be the inner edge of the platform. a.	Start from the four points where the outer circle intersects the vertical and horizontal lines--points a, b, c, and d.  Then make four marks two fingerwidths away from these points upon the perpendicular lines--points e, f, g, and h. b.	Then place the steady end of your compass on point e, and the moving end on the center at point i.  Swing the compass to mark two arcs upon the diagnal lines. c.	Follow this same step placing the steady end of the compass at points f, g and h. d.	Use the chalkline to draw straight lines through the intersections of these arcs, making a square.

whole_word_matches.context: ma byas la zur bzhir bya rjes btsal ba'i steng du thig gru bzhir gdab pa ni stegs bu'o

gru.acip: ZHAR BYUNG RDZOGS RIM GYI RJES SU BAm YIG SNGAGS PHRENG BCAS GSAL BTAB NAS SDUD RIM BYED LUGS DNGUL CHU'I ZIN BRIS LTAR DANG, LUS DKYIL BSGOM MA BSGOMS KYI KHYAD PAR PHYE NAS SDUD RIM BYED TSUL SGRUB THABS GZHUNG DU GSAL BA LTAR LA,
gru.wylie: zhar byung rdzogs rim gyi rjes su baM yig sngags phreng bcas gsal btab nas sdud rim byed lugs dngul chu'i zin bris ltar dang, lus dkyil bsgom ma bsgoms kyi khyad par phye nas sdud rim byed tshul sgrub thabs gzhung du gsal ba ltar la
gru.english: Once you have completed the incidental practices of the stage of completion, then visualize the letter vam and the string of secret words.  Withdraw all of them in the process described in the Notes of Ngulchu.  There is a difference of how you do this depending on whether or not you have been meditating on the secret world of the body, and you should follow whichever lines of the ritual text that apply.

gru.acip: CHOS SKU'I KHYAD CHOS BZHI LAS, N'A DA TSUN CHAD BSDUS PA'I SNANG BA STONG SANG, NGES NGOR RANG BZHIN GYIS MA GRUB PA, YUL CAN BDE BA CHEN PO GSUM TSANG BA DGOS, CHOS SKU'I NGA RGYAL 'JOG PA MI DGOS,
gru.wylie: chos sku'i khyad chos bzhi las, nA da tshun chad bsdus pa'i snang ba stong sang, nges ngor rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa, yul can bde ba chen po gsum tshang ba dgos, chos sku'i nga rgyal 'jog pa mi dgos
gru.english: Here three of the four features of the Dharma Body must be complete.  When everything up through the crook is withdrawn, what appears to your perceptions is sheer emptiness.  The object that your perceptions grasp is the fact that nothing has any natural existence.  And the subject holding this object takes on the quality of great bliss.  You need not at this point apply the supreme confidence of the Dharma Body.

gru.acip: 'DIR STONG PA'I NGANG LAS LHAR YANG YANG BZHENGS PA NI SGYU LUS 'GRUB PA'I RGYUD SMIN BYED DANG, STONG PAR YANG YANG SBYANGS PA NI 'OD GSAL 'GRUB PA'I RGYUD SMIN BYED DU 'GRO,
gru.wylie: 'dir stong pa'i ngang las lhar yang yang bzhengs pa ni sgyu lus 'grub pa'i rgyud smin byed dang, stong par yang yang sbyangs pa ni 'od gsal 'grub pa'i rgyud smin byed du 'gro
gru.english: The reason why we keep coming forth here out of emptiness as the Angel, over and over, is that it acts to ripen the stream of our mind for achieving the body of illusion.  The reason we purify things into emptiness over and over is that it acts to ripen our mindstream for achieving the clear light.

gru.acip: 'DI'I SKABS KYI SRUNG 'KHOR BSGOM PA'ANG RDO RJE'I RVA GUR SOGS GRUB TSUL SNGAR LTAR YIN,
gru.wylie: 'di'i skabs kyi srung 'khor bsgom pa'ang rdo rje'i rva gur sogs grub tshul sngar ltar yin
gru.english: At this point you meditate as well on the circles of protection; the method for raising up the walls, the canopy of diamond, and so on is the same as described earlier.

gru.acip: BSGOM BYA'I LHA DANG SGOM PA PO'I GANG ZAG LA SOGS PA PHYI NANG GI CHOS THAMS CAD RANG GI SEMS KYIS BTAGS PA TZAM MA GTOGS RANG NGOS NAS TSUGS THUB TU GRUB PA RDUL TZAM YANG MED PAR NGES PA'I STONG NYID KYI LTA BA DANG,
gru.wylie: bsgom bya'i lha dang sgom pa po'i gang zag la sogs pa phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems kyis btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas tshugs thub tu grub pa rdul tsam yang med par nges pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba dang
gru.english: Every single inner and outer phenomenon in the universe--all these Angels we are meditating on, all of us who are meditating on them, everything at all--is simply what our mind labels it.  There does not exist the tiniest atom of any object which exists from its own side, which stands on its own in any way.  The state of mind which perceives this as true is what we call "correct view."

gru.acip: ,THAMS CAD BYAS SHING KUN ZOS KYANG, ,'GRUB 'GYUR NYES PAR MI 'GYUR NA, ,SNYING RJE LDAN PAS SMOS CI DGOS,
gru.wylie: thams cad byas shing kun zos kyang, ,'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur na, ,snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos
gru.english: So too we see the lines, You can do everything, You can eat anything, And it becomes a practice, And no bad deed. How much more still For someone who has love...

gru.acip: BLA MED LA NI GANG SNANG THAMS CAD LHA'I RNAM ROL TU 'CHAR DGOS PAS NA, GZUGS SGRA DRI RO REG BYA RNAMS KYANG RIM BZHIN, GZUGS THAMS CAD RNAM SNANG, SGRA THAMS CAD MI BSKYOD PA, DRI THAMS CAD RIN 'BYUNG, RO THAMS CAD 'OD DPAG MED, REG BYA THAMS CAD DON GRUB,
gru.wylie: bla med la ni gang snang thams cad lha'i rnam rol tu 'char dgos pas na, gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams kyang rim bzhin, gzugs thams cad rnam snang, sgra thams cad mi bskyod pa, dri thams cad rin 'byung, ro thams cad 'od dpag med, reg bya thams cad don grub
gru.english: Here in the Unsurpassed system though we are required to see everything around us as the dance of the Angels.  Everything we look on, everything we hear, every scent or taste or touch is in reality an Angel coming to us.  All that we see is in actuality the Angel named Appearances; all that we hear is Unshakable.  Everything we smell is Jewels; everything we taste Limitless Light; and everything we feel with our sense of touch is Attainment.
