gru.acip: 'GRUB SKABS TSES BCU MDOR BSDUS TZAM RE MA CHAG PA BYUNG NA LEGS, DNGUL CHUS GZHON NU MA GSUM GSUNGS KYANG BDUN YIN GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: 'grub skabs tshes bcu mdor bsdus tsam re ma chag pa byung na legs, dngul chus gzhon nu ma gsum gsungs kyang bdun yin gsungs
gru.english: During the time that you are trying to reach this Angel though it is best if you can never break performing at least a very abbreviated ceremony of the tenth.  Our Lama noted that seven maidens was the correct number, even though Ngulchu stated it was three.

gru.acip: TSOGS 'KHOR NI GSANG SNGAGS KYI DNGOS GRUB SPYI DANG, MKHA' SPYOD 'GRUB PA'I RGYU'I GTZO BO YIN PAS RAB LA NYIN STAR GYIS 'BUL BA DANG, DE MA BYUNG YANG BDE MCHOG RTZA RGYUD LAS,
gru.wylie: tshogs 'khor ni gsang sngags kyi dngos grub spyi dang, mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas rab la nyin star gyis 'bul ba dang, de ma byung yang bde mchog rtsa rgyud las
gru.english: This Circle of Gathering is one of the primary causes for the attainments of the secret teaching in general, and more specifically for reaching the Heaven of the Angel.  For this reason the best thing you can do is to make this offering on a daily basis.  If this is not happening though follow the words of the secret root text of Highest Bliss:

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB RJE LA HE RU KA'I GSUNG BYON TE, YAR NGO MAR NGO'I TSES BCU BZANG PO BYUNG NA DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD PA LA DKA' TSEGS MED PAR GSUNGS PA MKHAS GRUB KYI RNAM THAR DU YOD,
gru.wylie: mkhas grub rje la he ru ka'i gsung byon te, yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzang po byung na dag pa mkha' spyod du bgrod pa la dka' tshegs med par gsungs pa mkhas grub kyi rnam thar du yod
gru.english: In the biography of Lord Kedrup an incident is described where he received a revelation from Heruka, who said that if this Lord's observance of the ceremony of the tenth day of the waxing and waning of the moon were good, then he would have no difficulty in travelling to the Heaven of the Angel.

gru.acip: BYA BTANG RI KHROD PA SHIN TU 'KHOS DMAN LTA BUS ZLA RE BZHIN GYI YAR MAR GYI TSES BCU THAMS CAD CANG MI 'GRUB PA BYUNG NA, KUN SPYOD LAS,
gru.wylie: bya btang ri khrod pa shin tu 'khos dman lta bus zla re bzhin gyi yar mar gyi tshes bcu thams cad cang mi 'grub pa byung na, kun spyod las
gru.english: Suppose you are one of those hermits who have given up all the worldly life, or a meditator staying in retreat--suppose you have very little at your disposal with which to perform this practice, and so it happens that you are unable to keep the ceremony of the tenth as you should, twice per month, on the waxing and waning of the moon.  The text called Activities says,

gru.acip: ,GTOR MA MYOS BYED MED PAR LAS, ,MYUR DU 'GRUB PAR MI 'GYUR RO,
gru.wylie: gtor ma myos byed med par las, ,myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro
gru.english: Without the torma and intoxicant, This work will never succeed with speed.

gru.acip: RGYAS PAR 'GRUB SKABS TSOGS GTOR YANG BZHENGS THUB NA LEGS, DE MA GRUB KYANG TSOGS 'KHOR CHAD PA'I SKYON DU MI 'GYUR TE, RGYA GAR GYI GRUB CHEN TSOS KYANG SKYE BA BDUN PA'I MI RO SOGS SHA CHANG LA MDZAD PA LAS, TSOGS GTOR BSHAM SROL MED,
gru.wylie: rgyas par 'grub skabs tshogs gtor yang bzhengs thub na legs, de ma grub kyang tshogs 'khor chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur te, rgya gar gyi grub chen tshos kyang skye ba bdun pa'i mi ro sogs sha chang la mdzad pa las, tshogs gtor bsham srol med
gru.english: When you are performing the extended version of the ceremony, it is very good if you can prepare a torma cake for the Gathering.  But even if you do not, you do not incur the fault of having missed the Circle of Gathering.  This is because the great accomplished saints of India too would only use liquor, and flesh such as that which came from the body of a person who had only seven lives left to go.  They did not at that time have any tradition of preparing a torma cake for the Gathering.

gru.acip: YANG TSOGS GTOR RGYAS PAR 'GRUB NA, TSOGS GTOR GYI DBYIBS DPA' BO'I SNYING NGAM, DPA' MO'I NU MA LTA BUR SMUG RTZIS KHA BSGYUR BA, DKAR RGYAN LA MAR GYI KHRA TSAG BYA CHOG ,
gru.wylie: yang tshogs gtor rgyas par 'grub na, tshogs gtor gyi dbyibs dpa' bo'i snying ngam, dpa' mo'i nu ma lta bur smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba, dkar rgyan la mar gyi khra tshag bya chog
gru.english: If though you do decide to make an extensive offering of the torma cake for the Gathering, you should shape it like the heart of a man Warrior, or like the breast of a woman Warrior.  Then paint the outside with dyes mixed in a base of grease to get the right color.  For the white designs applied to the outside it is acceptable if you use the whey that comes from sieving.

gru.acip: NGED KYI SGRUB DKYIL DU, TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG ZHES SOGS NI GDANGS RGYUN YANG DBEN SA SNYAN BRGYUD THUN MONG MA YIN PA YOD PA DANG BCAS DE'I GNAD KYIS BLA MCHOD KYI TSOGS KYI CHO GA SOR BZHAG BYAS TE BKOD PA YIN,
gru.wylie: nged kyi sgrub dkyil du, ting 'dzin sngags dang zhes sogs ni gdangs rgyun yang dben sa snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa yod pa dang bcas de'i gnad kyis bla mchod kyi tshogs kyi cho ga sor bzhag byas te bkod pa yin
gru.english: Now the section--in my own version of the ritual for reaching Her secret world--which includes the refrain "Immaculate nectar blessed by our concentration, by our secret words" and so on comes with a unique melody that has been passed down through our oral tradition from Wensapa.  This is the special reason why I have added this part separately in my version of the Offering to Lamas.

gru.acip: SHIN TU BREL BA BYUNG SKABS DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD LA'ANG CUNG ZAD BSDUS PA 'BRING LTA BU BYED NA GSUNG DKYIL MI DGOS PAR SKU TSOM BU'I DKYIL 'KHOR DANG THUGS SINDH'U RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GNYIS KYIS CHOG ,
gru.wylie: shin tu brel ba byung skabs dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la'ang cung zad bsdus pa 'bring lta bu byed na gsung dkyil mi dgos par sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang thugs sindhU ra'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyis chog
gru.english: In the event that you have extremely limited time, it is permissible if you do a somewhat average kind of offering for the creation of the secret world, by abbreviating things a bit.  Here you leave out the secret world of holy Speech, and put forth only the secret world of the pile for holy Body and the secret world of sindhura, for holy Mind.

gru.acip: LAS RUNG MA SONG YANG DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD RGYAS PA BSTOD PA YAN BYAS TE, BDAG 'JUG BZHAG ,MJUG CHOG SOGS BYA CHOG ,
gru.wylie: las rung ma song yang dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rgyas pa bstod pa yan byas te, bdag 'jug bzhag ,mjug chog sogs bya chog
gru.english: Even if you haven't completed your readiness retreats it is still permissible if you recite the ritual of offering for the creation of the secret world, up through the words of praise.  Skip the part where you take yourself in.  Then complete the concluding parts of the ritual and so on.

gru.acip: RANG GI RGYUN GTAN YI DAM GYI GTOR MA SGRUB KHANG DU BZHAG NAS RANG NYID PHYOGS GZHAN DU 'GRO DGOS PA BYUNG NA, DE'I SKABS SU GTOR MA GSAR PA BSHAM PA MA 'GRUB KYANG SGRUB KHANG GI GTOR MA DE LA DMIGS PA BYAR RUNG ZHING,
gru.wylie: rang gi rgyun gtan yi dam gyi gtor ma sgrub khang du bzhag nas rang nyid phyogs gzhan du 'gro dgos pa byung na, de'i skabs su gtor ma gsar pa bsham pa ma 'grub kyang sgrub khang gi gtor ma de la dmigs pa byar rung zhing
gru.english: Suppose you are called upon to go somewhere else, and have to leave the torma for your usual Close Angel in your practice room.  Even in such a case it is permissible to focus your mind on the torma in your practice room and offer that one, assuming that you have not been able to make a new torma where you are.

gru.acip: DE YANG GTOR MA'I SGRUB GZHI YOD SA'I GTOR KHANG GNAS 'DI LTA BUR BYAS SHING, RJES SU GTOR MA 'BUL BA'I TSE RANG NYID LA PHAR RGYAB LTA BUR SLEB NA,
gru.wylie: de yang gtor ma'i sgrub gzhi yod sa'i gtor khang gnas 'di lta bur byas shing, rjes su gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe rang nyid la phar rgyab lta bur sleb na
gru.english: Let's say that this place here was the torma room--the place where the object you were going to use to be the torma was located.  And then let's say that later, when it came time to actually offer the torma, you had already left and reached the other side of some mountain pass.

gru.acip: BSANG SBYANG SKABS DMIGS SA RANG GIS BCOS PA'I SGRUB GZHI'I GTOR MA YOD SA DER DMIGS TE, BSKYED PA NI RANG GANG DU GNAS KYANG GSAR DU BSKYED DGOS PAS RANG GI MDUN DU BSKYED PA YIN,
gru.wylie: bsang sbyang skabs dmigs sa rang gis bcos pa'i sgrub gzhi'i gtor ma yod sa der dmigs te, bskyed pa ni rang gang du gnas kyang gsar du bskyed dgos pas rang gi mdun du bskyed pa yin
gru.english: The place towards which you would focus your mind as you performed the steps of clearing and purifying the offering would be the place where what you were going to use to be the torma, what you had physically mixed together to serve as the torma, was located.  When you reach the step of mentally producing the offering though you must start fresh, and make it appear wherever you happen to actually be.  Therefore you must produce the torma right in front of you.

gru.acip: CHOS THAMS CAD RANG BZHIN GYIS MA GRUB PA'AM RANG BZHIN GYIS STONG NA RTEN 'BYUNG RTOG BTAGS TZAM GYI RGYU 'BRAS BYA BYED THAMS CAD 'THAD PA YIN TE, SHES RAB SNYING PO LAS,
gru.wylie: chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'am rang bzhin gyis stong na rten 'byung rtog btags tsam gyi rgyu 'bras bya byed thams cad 'thad pa yin te, shes rab snying po las
gru.english: If it is true that no object in the universe exists naturally--if it is true that every single thing is empty of any nature of its own--then all the way things work, the relationship of cause and effect between things which exist merely in labels, interdependence itself, is all perfectly plausible.  As the Heart of Wisdom states,

gru.acip: RJE TZONG KHA PA'I SKU 'GA' RER NA BZA' SKU 'GAG GI GONG PA 'THU ZLOG MDZAD PA DANG, SGRUB KHANG RI KHROD DU LHO BRAG MAR PA'I PHYAG RJES YOD PA PHYAG GA-YON PA'I RJES YIN PA SOGS KYANG GA-YON PA'I KUN SPYOD GNANG PA YIN,
gru.wylie: rje tsong kha pa'i sku 'ga' rer na bza' sku 'gag gi gong pa 'thu zlog mdzad pa dang, sgrub khang ri khrod du lho brag mar pa'i phyag rjes yod pa phyag ga-yon pa'i rjes yin pa sogs kyang ga-yon pa'i kun spyod gnang pa yin
gru.english: Sometimes we see images of Lord Tsongkapa where the upper flap of His monk's shirt has been tucked in the wrong way, to the left.  And when we go to the mountain retreat of Drupkang to see the handprints left there by Hlodrak Marpa, they are always the print of the left hand.  These and the like are all signs of how They practiced acting to the left.

gru.acip: DE LA CHOS 'BYUNG MCHOD PA, GRU GSUM MCHOD PA, LAG MCHOD DE RGYAS 'BRING BSDUS GSUM YOD PA GSUM GA BDE MCHOG DANG SBYAR BA YOD TSUL,
gru.wylie: de la chos 'byung mchod pa, gru gsum mchod pa, lag mchod de rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa gsum ga bde mchog dang sbyar ba yod tshul
gru.english: Our Lama next described how this practice, as it applied to the secret teachings of Highest Bliss, had three versions: the more extensive, the medium, and the brief.  These are, respectively, the offering of the dharma star, the offering of the triangle, and the offering of the hand.

whole_word_matches.context: de la chos 'byung mchod pa, gru gsum mchod pa, lag mchod de rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yo

gru.acip: GA-YON PA'I KUN SPYOD KYI GTZO BO NI, LAG PA GA-YON PA LHAR BSKYED PA'I SGO NAS LAG MCHOD BYED PA STE, 'DI YANG MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB BYED GAL CHE BA GCIG YIN,
gru.wylie: ga-yon pa'i kun spyod kyi gtso bo ni, lag pa ga-yon pa lhar bskyed pa'i sgo nas lag mchod byed pa ste, 'di yang mkha' spyod sgrub byed gal che ba gcig yin
gru.english: The principal way of carrying out this practice of acting left-ways is to perform the offering of the hand, wherein you turn your left hand into an Angel.  This is also one of the most important ways of reaching the Heaven of the Angel.

gru.acip: LAG MCHOD MI 'GRUB PA'I SKABS KYANG BZA' BTUNG LA LONGS SPYOD TSE GONG GI LAG PA BYIN RLABS DANG, KHA ZAS BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA, RNAL 'BYOR MA'I LHA TSOGS RANG LUS LA SPYAN DRANGS TE BZHUGS PA'AM, LUS DKYIL GSAL BTAB PA LA PHUL BAS THUGS ZAG MED KYI BDE BAS TSIM PAR MOS PA SOGS
gru.wylie: lag mchod mi 'grub pa'i skabs kyang bza' btung la longs spyod tshe gong gi lag pa byin rlabs dang, kha zas bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa, rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rang lus la spyan drangs te bzhugs pa'am, lus dkyil gsal btab pa la phul bas thugs zag med kyi bde bas tshim par mos pa sogs
gru.english: Even on those occasions when you do not perform the offering of the hand, there are certain steps you should take whenever to partake of food or drink.  As mentioned above, bless your hand, and also bless the food so that it becomes sacred nectar.  Invite the entire Angelic assembly of the Holy Angel to come down and be in you, or else visualize the Angels of the secret world of your body, and offer the nectar to these Beings.  Believe then that Their holy minds have been filled with immaculate bliss.

gru.acip: ZAS KYI RNAL 'BYOR BYA TSUL NGED KYIS YUM BKA'I LAG MCHOD DANG, ZAS MCHOD ZUR DU BRIS PA SOGS LTAR TSUL BZHIN SPYAD NA RANG GZHAN GYI TSOGS GNYIS BDE BLAG TU RDZOGS PA'I THABS MKHAS KYI 'PHRUL CHEN PO YIN TE, ,GRUB CHEN GLING RAS PAS,
gru.wylie: zas kyi rnal 'byor bya tshul nged kyis yum bka'i lag mchod dang, zas mchod zur du bris pa sogs ltar tshul bzhin spyad na rang gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul chen po yin te, ,grub chen gling ras pas
gru.english: These and other details of how to perform the practice of eating may be found in works such as the separate texts I have composed for the offering of the hand and the offering of food, according to the secret teachings of the Husband.  If you are able to perform these practices properly, as outlined in the various texts, then it can be a very skilful method--something like a massive and efficient machine--for completing with ease the process of amassing the two great collections needed by yourself and others as well.  As the great and accomplished Lingrepa has said,

gru.acip: DKYIL 'KHOR BRI GZHI GRU BZHI PA'I STENG DU DKYIL 'KHOR RGYAS PAR NA DUR KHROD, RDO RVA, ME RIS DANG BCAS PA LHA SA'I SPAR MA LTAR DGOD CING,
gru.wylie: dkyil 'khor bri gzhi gru bzhi pa'i steng du dkyil 'khor rgyas par na dur khrod, rdo rva, me ris dang bcas pa lha sa'i spar ma ltar dgod cing
gru.english: First prepare a rectangular platform, upon which you will be making the secret world.  If you intend to depict this world in some detail, then follow the Lhasa carving, which includes the charnel grounds, the diamond wall, and the mountain of fire.

whole_word_matches.context: dkyil 'khor bri gzhi gru bzhi pa'i steng du dkyil 'khor rgyas par na dur khrod,

gru.acip: DE MA RNYED NA THOG MAR MTHO GANG ZLUM POR BSKOR, DE'I PHYIR SOR PHYED BSNAN PA'I ZLUM BSKOR SNGON PO, DE DAG GI NANG DU CHOS 'BYUNG GRU GSUM NYIS BRTZEGS NANG DMAR ZHING, RE KH'A DKAR PO,
gru.wylie: de ma rnyed na thog mar mtho gang zlum por bskor, de'i phyir sor phyed bsnan pa'i zlum bskor sngon po, de dag gi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs nang dmar zhing, re khA dkar po
gru.english: If you don't have access to this carving, then do the following.  First draw a circle with a radius equal to the length from the tip of your thumb to the tip of your middle finger stretched away from each other.  At a distance of half a fingerwidth outside that, add a circle that you color blue.  Inside of these draw a dharma star of two triangular sections stacked together.  The inner line is red, and the outer one is white.

whole_word_matches.context: a'i zlum bskor sngon po, de dag gi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs nang dmar zhing, re khA dkar po

gru.acip: CHOS 'BYUNG GI NANG DU ZLA DKYIL DKAR PO DANG, GRVA BZHIR DGA' 'KHYIL DMAR SKYA, PHYI'I GRU BCAD ZLA GAM LJANG GU RNAMS RAB RDUL TSON DANG, DE MIN SNGON TSUD NAS CHU TSON GYIS BRIS KYANG RUNG BAS, DE LTAR PHYAG BZHES LTAR 'DU BGYIS PA'I GDING DKYIL DGRAM,
gru.wylie: chos 'byung gi nang du zla dkyil dkar po dang, grva bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar skya, phyi'i gru bcad zla gam ljang gu rnams rab rdul tshon dang, de min sngon tshud nas chu tshon gyis bris kyang rung bas, de ltar phyag bzhes ltar 'du bgyis pa'i gding dkyil dgram
gru.english: Inside the dharma star draw a white moon disk, and at the four of the points pink-red bliss swirls.  At the outer corners draw half-moons in green.  All this is best done with colored powders, but it's also alright--if you don't have these--that you prepare the mandala in advance with paints.  Thus then do we by tradition set forth a supporting mandala.

whole_word_matches.context: dkar po dang, grva bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar skya, phyi'i gru bcad zla gam ljang gu rnams rab rdul tshon dang, de mi

gru.acip: DE DANG ZHAL SPROD KYIS AOm NAS BRTZAMS TE GA-YON SKOR DU AOm GSUM MA'I SNGAGS 'KHOR BRI BA'AM, DE LTAR MA 'GRUB NA PHYAG BZHES LTAR SIN DKYIL GYI SPAR TSAD LDAN LA SINDHU RA DANG LI KHRI BSRES PAS SPAR BTAB PA PO YIG MDUN RANG LA BSTAN TE ZHAL SPROD DU BZHUGS PA'I THUGS SINDHU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BCAS BSHAM,
gru.wylie: de dang zhal sprod kyis aoM nas brtsams te ga-yon skor du aoM gsum ma'i sngags 'khor bri ba'am, de ltar ma 'grub na phyag bzhes ltar sin dkyil gyi spar tshad ldan la sindhu ra dang li khri bsres pas spar btab pa po yig mdun rang la bstan te zhal sprod du bzhugs pa'i thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bcas bsham
gru.english: Facing across from this write the letter om, and then continue with the rest of the Mantra of the Triple Om, working around to the left.  If you're not able to do all this, there's an alternate tradition where you find a mold for a sindhura mandala which is authentically crafted.  Take again a mixture of li-tri and sindhura powders to press out the mandala.  The front of the mandala should be facing the person pressing it out: it should be across from them.  Thus then we have set forth what is known as the "sindhura of the secret world of Her holy thoughts."

gru.acip: DE TZAM MA LCOGS NA TZAN DAN DMAR PO'I PHYE MA DANG CHANG BSRES PAS CHOS 'BYUNG NYIS BRTZEGS BRIS PA'I KHAR GONG GSAL TSOM BU TZAM BYAS TE MANYDZI'I STENG DU THUGS SINDHU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BZHENGS SHING, GSUNG BDUD RTZI'I DKYIL 'KHOR MA 'GRUB KYANG RUNG BAR GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: de tsam ma lcogs na tsan dan dmar po'i phye ma dang chang bsres pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i khar gong gsal tshom bu tsam byas te manydzi'i steng du thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing, gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor ma 'grub kyang rung bar gsungs
gru.english: It's been stated that, if time doesn't allow even this, then you can take sandalwood powder and mix it with a little liquor and draw out a dharma star with its two triangular sections stacked together.  Atop this you place just the little heap of powder that we talked about before, and over that the small tripod with a sindhura secret world of Her holy thoughts; that is, it is considered acceptable if you are unable to prepare the nectar of the secret world of Her holy words.

gru.acip: GTZO MO'I G-YON DU ZHING SKYONG DUR KHROD BDAG POR DMAR GTOR STOD GRU GSUM, SMAD ZLUM PO LA CHANG BU GYEN BSLANG BDUN GYIS BSKOR BA BCAS GSUM KAR BRANG RGYAN LNGA TSOM SA LUGS LTAR DANG, RTZE RGYAN, RTZE MOR NYI ZLA N'A DA SOGS PHYAG BZHES LTAR BYAS PA,
gru.wylie: gtso mo'i g-yon du zhing skyong dur khrod bdag por dmar gtor stod gru gsum, smad zlum po la chang bu gyen bslang bdun gyis bskor ba bcas gsum kar brang rgyan lnga tshom sa lugs ltar dang, rtse rgyan, rtse mor nyi zla nA da sogs phyag bzhes ltar byas pa
gru.english: To the central torma's own left then goes the torma for the Protector of the Sacred Land: the Lord of the Burial Ground.  This one again is crimson, with a three-sided upper half and a cylindrical bottom half.  Around the base go seven pieces of dough shaped by pressing them in your fist; these are attached upright to the torma.  All three tormas have the five-part adornment of the Sakya tradition running up the top front, or else the top ornament and then at the very tip the moon disk, crescent, nada, and so on that we find in current usage.

gru.wylie: bca' sgrigs rgyas pa gong ltar la, bum bskyed mi dgos par bdag mdun bsgrubs te mchod bstod kyi mjug tu, gtor ma dang, tshogs 'khor 'bul ba man dkyil chog ltar bya gsungs
gru.english: Do an extensive form of the ceremony following the structure we've outlined above, but you need not perform the rite where you bring the sacred vase into being.  Raise the Angel who is separate from you and the one who is you.  After the offerings and words of praise, it is stated, you carry out the presentation of the torma cakes, offer the Circle of Gathering, and continue on with everything on past that, as we do in the ritual of the secret world. Instructions for a Tenth-Day Ceremony of Medium Length

gru.acip: TSES BCU 'BRING PO JI LTAR BYA BA'I TSUL NI, SGRUB THABS RGYAS PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM TSAM RNGAMS KYI BSRUNG BA'I BAR GRUB RJES, PHEEm, RANG GI THUGS KA'I BA YIG LAS 'OD ZER 'PHROS PAS 'OG MIN NAS ZHES PA NAS, MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR SPYAN DRANGS,
gru.wylie: tshes bcu 'bring po ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni, sgrub thabs rgyas pa bde chen nye lam tsham rngams kyi bsrung ba'i bar grub rjes, pheeM, rang gi thugs ka'i ba yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas zhes pa nas, mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs
gru.english: Here then is how we carry out an Offering of the Tenth which is of medium length.  Go through the extended ritual for reaching Her which is entitled the Short Path to Great Bliss.  Proceed up through the rite of protection where we use the Secret Words of Ferocity, and then after that recite the part that goes [in the English translation] from "Phem!  Light shines forth from the letter vam within my heart..." up to "... of both the Teachings and the world."

gru.acip: YIG BRGYA, MA RNYED YONGS SU SOGS MAN CHAD SGRUB THABS RGYAS PA LTAR BYA,

gru.english: Keep going then down through the Hundred-Syllable Mantra, the lines about "I don't have much to offer," and so on, just as we do in the extended form of the ritual for reaching Her.

gru.acip: TSES BCU BSDUS PA NI, BDAG BSKYED KYI, DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA STZAL DU GSOL, ZHES PA'I MJUG TU TSOGS 'KHOR BYA ZHING, TSOGS LHAG 'OG MIN MA'I MJUG TU BTON PA LAS GZHAN TSANG MA BDAG BSKYED GZHUNG LTAR BYED PA YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: tshes bcu bsdus pa ni, bdag bskyed kyi, dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol, zhes pa'i mjug tu tshogs 'khor bya zhing, tshogs lhag 'og min ma'i mjug tu bton pa las gzhan tshang ma bdag bskyed gzhung ltar byed pa yin no
gru.english: For an abbreviated version of the Offering of the Tenth, follow the text for turning yourself into Her, up to the point that includes the words, "Grant us every one of our goals."  The Circle of Gathering should come then right after that, and the offering of the remainders of the gathering should be read out after the section dedicated to the Lady of the Heaven Below No Other.  All the rest follows the normal order of the text of the ritual for becoming Her.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, GZHUNG DU RJE SANGS RGYAS DPAL BZANG GI BDAG 'JUG BZHIN DU NYAMS SU LEN PAR GSUNGS LA, YIG CHA DER TSOGS 'KHOR BYED TSUL ZUR TZAM LAS PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BYA TSUL MA GSUNGS SHING PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BDE MCHOG TU LAG MCHOD DANG, GRU GSUM MCHOD PA BYA BAR GSUNGS SHING, TSOGS 'KHOR NI DNGOS BSTAN BDAG 'JUG LEN PA YIN NA'ANG, DA LTA'I PHYAG BZHES 'DI 'PHRAL GYI NYAMS LEN LA GNAD 'GAG CHE BAS,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, gzhung du rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi bdag 'jug bzhin du nyams su len par gsungs la, yig cha der tshogs 'khor byed tshul zur tsam las phyi rol mchod pa bya tshul ma gsungs shing phyi rol mchod pa bde mchog tu lag mchod dang, gru gsum mchod pa bya bar gsungs shing, tshogs 'khor ni dngos bstan bdag 'jug len pa yin na'ang, da lta'i phyag bzhes 'di 'phral gyi nyams len la gnad 'gag che bas
gru.english: This brings us to the second of the secondary practices--the outside offering, or yoga of the gathering.  In the text it says that we should perform this practice as we find it in the ritual by Lord Sangye Pelsang for taking oneself into the secret world.  In that work though no instructions are given for performing the outer offering, aside from just a bit on how to do the Circle of Gathering.  What is stated is that in the teachings of Highest Bliss we perform the offering of the hand, and the offering of the three corners, for the outer offering.  The explicit form of Circle of Gathering is to take oneself into the secret world; but in current practice the immediate ritual is most critical.

gru.english: As for the base of the mandala, it should be a stand which is a square, with a circle drawn upon it which is a cubit across.  Outside this circle, half a fingerwidth from it, is another circle of white.  Outside that, another fingerwidth away, is a circle of blue; and outside it, to the same distance, is a white circle.

gru.english: Outside the circles is a square frame; we use yellow paint for this, and it represents the mode of prosperity.  The inner and outer circles represent the mode of peace.  The triangles express the mode of ferocity, and the half-moons the mode of power.

gru.english: The colors here also have their symbolism.  The white of the outside of the dharma star and the rest represents our attaining the mode of peace.  The green represents reaching both all the modes together, and the mode of prosperity.  The red represents achieving the powerful mode; and the blue the mode of ferocity.

gru.english: There's also a different way of abbreviating the ceremony; it follows the idea behind Je Rinpoche's offering of the three corners.  We take a flat piece of stone or wood or something of the like, and on the surface of it draw a dharma star with the ring finger of our left hand, using a liquid made of red sandalwood mixed with liquor.

gru.acip: BDAG BSKYED RGYAS BSDUS GANG RIGS BTANG, BUM SGRUB DBANG LEN NA MA GTOGS MI DGOS PAS, SGRUB BZHI BSANGS SBYANGS, STONG PA'I NGANG LAS AE AE LAS CHOS 'BYUNG SOGS BUM BSKYED LTAR DBANG BSKUR RGYAS 'DEBS KYI BAR BTANG NAS,

gru.english: Now go ahead and perform the ritual for turning yourself into the Angel, whether it be the extensive or briefer version.  You need not do the ritual for bringing the vase into being unless you are planning to take the empowerment.  Take the thing you're turning into the sacred object, clear it of obstacles, and then purify it into emptiness.  Then bring into being the dharma star from the two eh letters, and do the rest of the steps, as we normally do in the creation of the vase; then continue up to the point where we do the empowerment of marking.

gru.acip: DE TZAM YANG MA LCOGS NA RJE RIN PO CHES PHYI NANG BSAM GTAN GYI SGRUB MCHOD GSUM GSUNGS PA LTAR, RANG NYID LAM DU ZHUGS BZHIN DU BYED DGOS PA BYUNG NA DKYIL 'KHOR SOGS THAMS CAD YID KYI MOS PAS CHOG ,
gru.wylie: de tsam yang ma lcogs na rje rin po ches phyi nang bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod gsum gsungs pa ltar, rang nyid lam du zhugs bzhin du byed dgos pa byung na dkyil 'khor sogs thams cad yid kyi mos pas chog
gru.english: If you have no time even for this, you can follow the expression from Je Rinpoche where He speaks of "the three steps of practice and offering using outer and inner concentration."  This would be for example in a case where we were travelling that day but had to perform the ritual; and in this case it would be acceptable to simply imagine all the different elements of the ceremony--the secret world and the rest.

gru.acip: DE'I RGYU MTSAN YANG MKHAS GRUB RIN PO CHE'I RNAM THAR LAS, ZHAL GZIGS MANG DU BYUNG BA LAS, SKABS SHIG BDE MCHOG ZHAL GZIGS PAR GSOL BA RTZE GCIG TU BTAB NAS DAG PA MKHA' SPYOD DU SKYED PA'I RGYU GANG BSGRUB NA LEGS ZHUS PAS,

gru.english: The reason behind this is reflected in an incident recorded in the biography of Kedrup Je.  He had enjoyed many visions of divine beings, but one was most special.  Here he is having a vision of the Angel of Highest Bliss, and he makes the following supplication to the Angel, with complete single-pointed devotion: "Tell me, please, what is it that I have to do to be born into the Heaven of the Diamond Angel?"

gru.acip: DE 'DRA AE BDEN SNYAM PA BYUNG 'PHRAL 'KHOR LO BDE MCHOG DE RJE RIN PO CHER SONG BA YIN PAS DE BAS SGRUB BYED BZANG BA GZHAN MI DGOS SO,,
gru.wylie: de 'dra ae bden snyam pa byung 'phral 'khor lo bde mchog de rje rin po cher song ba yin pas de bas sgrub byed bzang ba gzhan mi dgos so
gru.english: Kedrup Je then immediately has the thought, "I'm not really sure about that last part," and in the same instant the Angel of Highest Bliss transforms into Je Rinpoche himself.  And so no better proof than that would ever be needed.

gru.acip: DUNG CHOS KYI CHU MA BSGRUB KYANG 'BRU GSUM BRJOD PA'I TSE BDUD RZIR GYUR PAR BSAM LA 'BUL,
gru.wylie: dung chos kyi chu ma bsgrub kyang 'bru gsum brjod pa'i tshe bdud rzir gyur par bsam la 'bul
gru.english: Even if you haven't been able to bring sacred water into being for the dharma conch, you can just go ahead and recite the three seed syllables and see it turned into nectar, then make the offering.

gru.acip: SINGHA ZHES PA SENGGE'I MING YIN PAS DE LTA BU'I YUL GRU RGYA GAR NA YOD, DAR LUNG ZHES PA MNGA' RIS SU YOD, BANG SO ZHES PA RO KHANG GI MING NGO,

gru.english: "Singha" is the Sanskrit word for a lion, and refers to a certain locality in the land of India.  "Darlung" is a place in the Tibetan province of Ngari; and the rare Tibetan word bangso here is a name for a tomb.

gru.acip: ZHI BA LA DKAR PO ZLUM PO, RGYAS PA LA SER PO GRU BZHI, DBANG LA DMAR PO ZLA GAM, DRAG PO LA NAG PO GRU GSUM BYAS NA LAS DANG MTHUN ZHES GSUNGS SHING,

gru.english: "Or else," he continues, "if the torma is for a work of peace you can make it white, and cylindrical; for a work of prosperity, yellow and four-sided; for a work of power, red and semi-circular; and for a work of ferocity three-sided, and black; that is, we fit the torma to the mode of the work we wish to accomplish."

gru.acip: DE NAS PHYI NANG GI MCHOD BSTOD 'DOD GSOL RGYAS BSDUS SOGS NGAG 'DON LTAR BYA LA 'JIG RTEN DANG, ZHES SOGS MGRON GZHAN RNAMS KYIS RANG RANG GI DNGOS GRUB STER NUS PA STZAL DU GSOL SNYAM PA'O,,
gru.wylie: de nas phyi nang gi mchod bstod 'dod gsol rgyas bsdus sogs ngag 'don ltar bya la 'jig rten dang, zhes sogs mgron gzhan rnams kyis rang rang gi dngos grub ster nus pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'o
gru.english: Then go ahead and present the outer and the inner offerings; and sing the song of praise; and make supplications both extensive and brief, and all the rest, as we find it in the text for recitation.  When we get to the part about "those of the world," think to yourself that you are requesting that it be possible for the other guests to each grant their respective attainments upon us.

gru.acip: SEMS CAN RANG RANG GI RJES SU STE BLO DANG 'TSAMS PA'I MCHOG DANG THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB MA LUS PA KUN STZAL NAS SANGS RGYAS KYI YUL TE ZHING DU DA LAM GSHEGS NAS KYANG, SLAR YANG BDAG SOGS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI BSOD NAMS KYI ZHING DU 'BYON PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, ZHES SNYAN GSAN PHUL,
gru.wylie: sems can rang rang gi rjes su ste blo dang 'tshams pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa kun stsal nas sangs rgyas kyi yul te zhing du da lam gshegs nas kyang, slar yang bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'byon par mdzad du gsol, zhes snyan gsan phul
gru.english: "Please grant us both the highest and the common attainments, each and every one of them, all of them, 'in accord' with every suffering being; meaning, in keeping with each one's own state of mind.  And even though You may now be returning to your Buddha lands--to Your enlightened paradises--I beg that You will return again in the future, to serve as the garden in which I and every other living being might plant our good karmas."  Thus do we send these Beings a message.

gru.acip: DGE BA 'DI YIS ZHES SOGS RANG GZHAN GYI 'DOD DON 'GRUB PA'I BSNGO SMON BYA ZHING,
gru.wylie: dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs rang gzhan gyi 'dod don 'grub pa'i bsngo smon bya zhing
gru.english: Next recite the words of dedication and prayer, "By this goodness," so that both yourself and every other living being might gain all the goals they hope for.

gru.acip: GAL TE TSE 'DIR MA 'GRUB NA 'CHI BA'I TSE MGON PO RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG DPA' BO DPA' MO'I TSOGS KYIS ME TOG SOGS MCHOD RDZAS SNA TSOGS DANG, SENGGE'I KHRI DANG 'JA' 'OD KYI GUR PHUB STE, MKHA' SPYOD KYI NAS SU 'KHRID PAR SHOG SNYAM DU BRJOD PAR BYA'O,,

gru.english: As you say these words, think in your mind: "Even if it happens that I fail to achieve my goals here in this life, may it come that--as I die--I am approached by my Protector, the Diamond Angel, together with great gatherings of man and woman Warriors.  May They come showering me with flowers and the like--a whole variety of different offerings.  May They raise a diamond throne, and above it a canopy of a rainbow.  And then may They lead me off to the Heaven of the Angel."

gru.acip: ,LUS 'BYUNG BZHI 'DUS PA'I RI BO NA, ,SEMS GNYUG MA'I BRAG PHUG BDE BA CAN, ,SGRUB GNAS NGO MTSAR CAN CIG DE NA GDA', ,BLA MA SGRUB PA ZHIG MDZAD NA DE RU MDZOD,

gru.english: On the mountain of the four elements, the body, Is the Heaven of Joy, the cave of primordial mind. If you need a wondrous place to practice, it is here: Oh Lamas, if you seek to perform a practice of attainment, then do it here.

gru.acip: ,CES GSUNGS PA LTAR MTSAMS SDOD PA DANG, SGRUB PA BRGYAG ZER BA LUS KYI SGRUB KHANG DU SEMS KYI SGRUB PA PO DRAN SHES KYI THUGS DAM LAS MI 'DA' BAR, GNYEN PO'I MTSAMS THO BTZUGS TE NYON MONGS PA'I MTSAMS BCAD NAS SDOD PA ZHIG DGOS KYI,
gru.wylie: ces gsungs pa ltar mtshams sdod pa dang, sgrub pa brgyag zer ba lus kyi sgrub khang du sems kyi sgrub pa po dran shes kyi thugs dam las mi 'da' bar, gnyen po'i mtshams tho btsugs te nyon mongs pa'i mtshams bcad nas sdod pa zhig dgos kyi
gru.english: The verses are saying that, if you claim you want to stay in retreat--if you say you want to practice and reach some attainment--then go to the meditation chamber of your own body.  And let the meditator, your mind, never waver from the heart practice, of recollection and awareness.  Go to the door and place there the signs that you are in retreat: the various antidotes for your mental afflictions.  And if there is anyone you go into retreat to keep out, let it be these afflictions themselves.  This is how you must do your retreat.

gru.acip: DBANG BZHI LAM BSGRIGS NAS, DNGUL CHU'I KHRID YIG TU GSUNGS PA NI SA LUGS YIN, DGE LDAN PA'I BKA' SROL LA BUM DBANG GIS BSKYED RIM DANG, GSANG DBANG GIS DBEN GSUM DANG SGYU LUS, SHER DBANG GIS 'OD GSAL, TSIG DBANG GIS ZUNG 'JUG 'GRUB PA'I SMIN BYED DU BYED PAR 'JOG TSUL,
gru.wylie: dbang bzhi lam bsgrigs nas, dngul chu'i khrid yig tu gsungs pa ni sa lugs yin, dge ldan pa'i bka' srol la bum dbang gis bskyed rim dang, gsang dbang gis dben gsum dang sgyu lus, sher dbang gis 'od gsal, tshig dbang gis zung 'jug 'grub pa'i smin byed du byed par 'jog tshul
gru.english: Ngulchu's treatise includes a line that says, "The four empowerments reflect the entire path..." but this is the Sakya system.  Our Lama went on to explain how, according to the tradition of the Virtuous Ones, the empowerment of the vase is explained as something that acts to ripen you for the stage of creation.  The empowerment of the secret ripens you for the three kinds of isolation, and for the body of illusion.  The empowerment of wisdom functions to ripen your mind for the clear light, and the empowerment of the word ripens you for the achievement of the Union of the Two.

gru.acip: DE LTAS MI 'GRUB PA NI DBANG PO 'BRING YIN PAS SINDH'U RA'I SGRUB PA LA BRTEN DGOS, DE LA BSNYEN SGRUB LAS GSUM LAS, BSNYEN PA'I SKABS SRUNG 'KHOR GYI NANG DU MTSAMS 'OG 'JUG DGOS JI YOD CHUD PA'I MOS PA BYA, DE'ANG MTSAMS 'OG TU MANG TZAM BZHAG STE DNGOS GZHIR MI 'PHRAD KA MED MA GTOGS MTSAMS KHANG DU MI 'JUG NA MTSAMS MI RAL BA LA PHAN,
gru.wylie: de ltas mi 'grub pa ni dbang po 'bring yin pas sindhU ra'i sgrub pa la brten dgos, de la bsnyen sgrub las gsum las, bsnyen pa'i skabs srung 'khor gyi nang du mtshams 'og 'jug dgos ji yod chud pa'i mos pa bya, de'ang mtshams 'og tu mang tsam bzhag ste dngos gzhir mi 'phrad ka med ma gtogs mtshams khang du mi 'jug na mtshams mi ral ba la phan
gru.english: Someone who does so and is unable to reach this goal is then a person of medium abilities, and must use the practice of sindura.  Here there are three steps: the close retreat, the practice to reach the Angel, and the sacred work.  Concerning the retreat, one has to try to imagine in advance all the persons they will consider to be within the bounds of the circles of protection during the length of time that they remain there.  As you contemplate this list, make it a rather long one and include anyone who may have to be there; but when you actually start the retreat, don't allow anyone to enter your retreat chamber except for those that you absolutely must meet.  This will help prevent the retreat from being broken.

gru.acip: RAB LA SINDH'U RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR BYED, BSNYEN SGRUB SBRAGS MA MDUN BSKYED KYIS BYA,
gru.wylie: rab la sindhU ra'i dkyil 'khor byed, bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma mdun bskyed kyis bya
gru.english: It is best if you can perform the practice of the secret world of sindhura.  The combination of the close retreat and the practice for reaching the Angel should be done with the Angel that appears before you.

gru.acip: BSNYEN PA ZIN PA NA ME LHA'I BSNYEN PA BYED PA DGE LDAN PA'I PHYAG SROL YIN, BSNYEN PA ZIN NAS SGRUB PA MA BYAS GONG LA RANG MI LCOGS PA BYUNG NA BAR STONG BYAS NAS MTSAMS BZHAG CHOG ,BSNYEN SGRUB ZIN RJES BCU CHA'I SBYIN SREG BYA,
gru.wylie: bsnyen pa zin pa na me lha'i bsnyen pa byed pa dge ldan pa'i phyag srol yin, bsnyen pa zin nas sgrub pa ma byas gong la rang mi lcogs pa byung na bar stong byas nas mtshams bzhag chog ,bsnyen sgrub zin rjes bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya
gru.english: Once this close retreat is finished, the custom of the Virtuous Ones is to do a close retreat for the Angel of Fire.  After the step of performing the close retreat is completed and before you do the practice for reaching the Angel, it is acceptable to leave your retreat and delay the latter practice for a space, if you don't have sufficient time.  Subsequent to completing both the close retreat and the practice for reaching the Angel, you should make the fire offering of ten parts.

gru.acip: SINDH'U RA'I SGRUB PA BYED PA'I TSE RANG SDOD PHYOGS KHA NUB TU BSTAN PA DBANG GI LAS 'GRUB CHED DANG, GSANG BA'I MKHA' 'GRO MA RNAMS BZHUGS PA'I GNAS AOO d'I YA NA DANG RGYA GAR SOGS PHAL CHER NUB PHYOGS SU YOD PAS DER KHA BLTAS TE BSGRUB NA MYUR DU BYIN GYIS RLOB PA'I RTEN 'BREL GYI GNAD KHYAD PAR CAN YOD,
gru.wylie: sindhU ra'i sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe rang sdod phyogs kha nub tu bstan pa dbang gi las 'grub ched dang, gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams bzhugs pa'i gnas aoo DI ya na dang rgya gar sogs phal cher nub phyogs su yod pas der kha bltas te bsgrub na myur du byin gyis rlob pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad khyad par can yod
gru.english: When you do the sindhura practice for reaching the Angel, you position yourself facing west; this is because you are performing an action of power.  Moreover, most of the locations where the secret woman Angels reside--places like Odiyana, India, and so on--are to the west, so when we face that direction it acts as a very special key to practice: it creates a kind of auspiciousness, one that lends us a blessing which helps us attain our goals with speed.

gru.acip: BSGRUB SKABS SHAR RTAGS DE MDUN DU BSTAN, SHAR RTAGS MED NA BSNYAL NAS BZHAG ,LANGGA LI YA'I SGRUB PA BYED SKABS SDUD RIM GYI DMIGS PA'I GTZO BO BSAM MI KHYAB THUN MONG MIN PA DE YIN,
gru.wylie: bsgrub skabs shar rtags de mdun du bstan, shar rtags med na bsnyal nas bzhag ,langga li ya'i sgrub pa byed skabs sdud rim gyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo bsam mi khyab thun mong min pa de yin
gru.english: When you perform the practice to reach the Angel, then place the east mark towards the front.  If there is no such mark, then lay the trunk down on its side.  Whenever you do this practice of the langaliya, the main visualization to use where you withdraw the entire scene in stages is the unique version of the practice of the inconceivable.

gru.acip: 'DI LA BRTEN NAS RNAL 'BYOR MAS RJES SU BZUNG BA DANG MKHA' SPYOD DU GSHEGS PA MANG BA SNGAR BSHAD ZIN PA LTAR YIN TSUL DANG, KHRI CHEN BSTAN PA RAB RGYAS GYIS BSNYEN PA 'BUM BZHI BTANG STE LHA SA BSAM 'GRUB PHO BRANG GI GZIM CHUNG SGE'U KHUNG NAS LHA SA'I KHROM DU GZIGS PAS DPRAL BA'I DGA' 'KHYIL BUD MED GCIG LA 'PHOS TSUL,
gru.wylie: 'di la brten nas rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba dang mkha' spyod du gshegs pa mang ba sngar bshad zin pa ltar yin tshul dang, khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas gyis bsnyen pa 'bum bzhi btang ste lha sa bsam 'grub pho brang gi gzim chung sge'u khung nas lha sa'i khrom du gzigs pas dpral ba'i dga' 'khyil bud med gcig la 'phos tshul
gru.english: Our Lama spoke further of how, as He had mentioned before, a great many persons who employed this practice were taken under the Holy Angel's care and passed on to Her Heaven.  He then related the story of the great throneholder, Tenpa Rabgye.  This master had completed the close retreat of 400,000 repetitions of the secret words and then had occasion to look out the window of His private quarters, located at the Samdrup Palace in Lhasa city.  Below in the marketplace He caught sight of a woman, and then saw a swirl of bliss move from His forehead to Hers.

gru.acip: PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR BSGRUB NA 'DI'I BSKYED RIM LA SBYANGS TE MYONG BA THON PAR BYED DGOS PA LAS, TSE 'DIR RDZOGS RIM LA SLOB MI DGOS, PHYI MAR MKHA' SPYOD KYI RTEN LA RDZOGS RIM GYI LAM NYAMS SU LON NUS PA BYA,
gru.wylie: phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor bsgrub na 'di'i bskyed rim la sbyangs te myong ba thon par byed dgos pa las, tshe 'dir rdzogs rim la slob mi dgos, phyi mar mkha' spyod kyi rten la rdzogs rim gyi lam nyams su lon nus pa bya
gru.english: If your practice is aimed primarily at reaching the outer Heaven of the Angel, then you must train yourself in these steps of the stage of creation, until you achieve a total mastery of them--but you need not in this life train in the stage of completion.  You will have achieved the ability to carry out the various paths of the completion stage in your next life, using the body and mind that you have then in the Angel's Heaven.

gru.acip: DE LTA'I 'CHI LTAS BZLOG MED BYUNG NA TSE SGRUB BYA, DE YANG RNAM RGYAL MA LA STONG MCHOD DANG, SGROL DKAR LA DU RBA'I SBYIN SREG ,TSE DPAG MED LA RLUNG SBYOR GTZO,
gru.wylie: de lta'i 'chi ltas bzlog med byung na tshe sgrub bya, de yang rnam rgyal ma la stong mchod dang, sgrol dkar la du rba'i sbyin sreg ,tshe dpag med la rlung sbyor gtso
gru.english: If a sign like this occurs which seems irreversible, you must carry out one of those practices for prolonging ones life.  The principal practices of this type are to make the offering of a thousand to the Lady of Victory Complete, to perform a durva grass fire offering to the White Lady of Freedom, or to do the practice of Limitless Life for sealing the inner winds.

gru.acip: DE DAG LAS RLUNG SBYOR GYI SGO NAS TSE SGRUB PA MCHOG YIN ZHING, DE YANG TSE NI RLUNG YIN LA, DE SPEL BA LA RLUNG BZUNG BA MCHOG YIN TSUL RLUNG STENG DU RLUNG BSNAN PAS 'PHEL BA YIN,
gru.wylie: de dag las rlung sbyor gyi sgo nas tshe sgrub pa mchog yin zhing, de yang tshe ni rlung yin la, de spel ba la rlung bzung ba mchog yin tshul rlung steng du rlung bsnan pas 'phel ba yin
gru.english: Of all these methods, the very highest for prolonging ones life is sealing the winds.  Life consists of wind, and there is a reason why holding the inner winds is the best method to promote more life: when you compress one wind on top of another, it causes the power of the wind to increase.

gru.acip: BUM CAN DANG, ZHAG BDUN MA'I TSE SGRUBS DGE THUN MONG BA DANG, DBEN SA LUGS RDOR BZLAS KYI SGO NAS BYA TSUL THUN MONG MIN PA STE, 'DI KHO BOS BDE MCHOG TSE LHA DKAR PO DANG SBYAR BA'ANG YOD GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: bum can dang, zhag bdun ma'i tshe sgrubs dge thun mong ba dang, dben sa lugs rdor bzlas kyi sgo nas bya tshul thun mong min pa ste, 'di kho bos bde mchog tshe lha dkar po dang sbyar ba'ang yod gsungs
gru.english: Two methods of prolonging ones life--using the capsule which is like a pitcher, and the seven-day practice--are common to all parts of the Virtuous tradition.  There is another method, the one of Wensapa, which utilizes the recitation of the Warrior of Diamond and is unique.  Our Lama told us that the explanation for this came with Wensapa's work on the White Angel of Life in the secret teachings of Highest Bliss.

gru.acip: RTEN DER SNGAR GYI SDIG PA RNAMS SBYANG, DGE BA SGRUB PAS BRGYUD JE BZANG DU SONG STE 'TSANG RGYA BA LA BYA, 'DI'I BSHAD PA DA DUNG 'OG TU 'PHO KHRID DNGOS GZHI'I SKABS KYANG 'BYUNG GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: rten der sngar gyi sdig pa rnams sbyang, dge ba sgrub pas brgyud je bzang du song ste 'tshang rgya ba la bya, 'di'i bshad pa da dung 'og tu 'pho khrid dngos gzhi'i skabs kyang 'byung gsungs
gru.english: He can then use this new type of life to purify himself of the bad deeds he committed earlier, and he can accomplish new good as well.  The stream of his mind becomes progressively more pure until at last he even reaches enlightenment.  I will expand on this subject, said our Lama, below when we reach the part of the teaching devoted entirely to the practice of transfer.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NANG GI MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA RDZOGS RIM RTZA DBU MA LA BSLAB PA LA,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa nang gi mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma la bslab pa la
gru.english: This brings us to the second major section of our presentation: the instructions for the practice of the central channel--the stage of completion--which is primarily for the purpose of reaching the inner Heaven of the Angel.

gru.acip: 'DI RNAMS SA LUGS KYI YIG CHA RNAMS SU MI GSAL YANG, GRUB MCHOG BSTAN PA'I RGYAL MTSAN, THU'U BKVAN DHARMA BADZRA, AA MCHOG BLO BZANG LUNG RIGS RGYA MTSO RNAMS KYI GSUNG LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR DGA' LDAN SNYAN RGYUD KYI MAN NGAG DANG GUNG BSGRIG STE 'CHAD NA,
gru.wylie: 'di rnams sa lugs kyi yig cha rnams su mi gsal yang, grub mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan, thu'u bkvan dharma badzra, aa mchog blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar dga' ldan snyan rgyud kyi man ngag dang gung bsgrig ste 'chad na
gru.english: The instructions for these practices are not clearly presented in the texts of the Sakya tradition.  I will nonetheless present for you here a description of them according to the advices and authoritative sources of the oral tradition of the Gelukpas.  This description derives from the teachings of that highest of accomplished saints, Tenpay Gyeltsen; Tuken Rinpoche Dharma Vajra; and Achok Lobsang Lungrik Gyatso.

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN MA'I BDAG BSKYED BZLAS PA GTOR 'BUL BCAS LEGS PAR GRUB RJES MDUN BYIN BRIS SKU DANG ME LHA DBYER MED KYI TSUL DU BSKYED,
gru.wylie: rje btsun ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul bcas legs par grub rjes mdun byin bris sku dang me lha dbyer med kyi tshul du bskyed
gru.english: Recite the ritual for turning yourself into the Angel, in the system of the Holy Angel herself.  Take your time and do it well, remembering to offer a torma cake at the appropriate point.  Now bring the God of Fire up within the image of Him, in such a way that the representation and the actual Angel are one and the same.

gru.acip: MDUN BSKYED GSHEGS GSOL NYER BSDU SOGS GANG YANG MI BYED PAR THUN RJES MA RNAMS LA'ANG BDAG BSKYED BZLAS PA GRUB RJES ME LHA SDAD YOD GSAL 'DEBS KYI TSUL DANG MNGON RTOGS NAS BZOD GSOL KYI BAR SNGAR BZHIN BYA,
gru.wylie: mdun bskyed gshegs gsol nyer bsdu sogs gang yang mi byed par thun rjes ma rnams la'ang bdag bskyed bzlas pa grub rjes me lha sdad yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul dang mngon rtogs nas bzod gsol kyi bar sngar bzhin bya
gru.english: As you approach the conclusion of the ritual, leave off doing any of the normal steps where you request the deity that you have brought into being before you to return to Their own place, or go through some practice of dissolution.  Rather, in this and the succeeding sessions, complete the recitation of the ritual for turning yourself into the God, and then after that picture that this God of Fire is still there in the room with you.  Repeat everything as you did before from the ritual for bringing Him to you, up to the part where you beg His forgiveness for any mistakes in the practice you have done.

gru.acip: DE'I PHYI ROL TU SOR BZHI BSNAN PAS BSKOR BA MU RAN, DE'I PHYIR SOR BZHI BSNAN PAS BSKOR PA KHA KHYER, DE'I PHYIR SOR DOS STEGS BU GRU BZHI PA BYA,
gru.wylie: de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bsnan pas bskor ba mu ran, de'i phyir sor bzhi bsnan pas bskor pa kha khyer, de'i phyir sor dos stegs bu gru bzhi pa bya
gru.english: Work out now from this circle, adding four more fingerwidths to get the radius of the middle circle, and then draw it.  Add another four fingerwidths beyond this then to inscribe the outer circle.  Add a pair of fingerwidths beyond this to establish the edge of the inner platform, which is a square.

whole_word_matches.context: an pas bskor pa kha khyer, de'i phyir sor dos stegs bu gru bzhi pa bya

gru.acip: PHYI DRO GLING LA GRIB MA BABS PA'I DUS SU SGRUB PA PO STAN DMAR PO DRI BZANG GI CHUS GSHER BAR BYAS PA'I STENG DU RDO RJE SKYIL KRUNG GI KHA NUB TU PHYOGS PAR 'DUG STE, DAR DMAR POS THOD BCING, SMRA BA BCAD,
gru.wylie: phyi dro gling la grib ma babs pa'i dus su sgrub pa po stan dmar po dri bzang gi chus gsher bar byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung gi kha nub tu phyogs par 'dug ste, dar dmar pos thod bcing, smra ba bcad
gru.english: Begin in the evening, at dusk, when the world is cloaked in shadows.  The yogi should seat themselves on a red cushion which has been sprinkled with fragrant water.  Place your legs in a full lotus position, and face to the west.  Tie a red headband around your head, and go into strict silence.

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN MA'I BDAG BSKYED BZLAS PA GTOR 'BUL DANG BCAS PA SONG RJES, BSANG CHU CHU BZHI GZHUNG LTAR BSGRUB,
gru.wylie: rje btsun ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa song rjes, bsang chu chu bzhi gzhung ltar bsgrub
gru.english: First recite the entire ritual for turning yourself into the Diamond Angel, including the offering of a torma cake.  Then bring into being the water for clearing away obstacles, as well as the four waters of offering, as this is done in the relevant ritual text.

gru.acip: DE LTAR BYAS NA ME LHA THAB TU 'GUGS NUS SHING DES DNGOS GRUB KYI SGO MANG DU 'BYED TSUL RIG PA MCHOG DANG DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSO NAS GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: de ltar byas na me lha thab tu 'gugs nus shing des dngos grub kyi sgo mang du 'byed tshul rig pa mchog dang dngos grub rgya mtsho nas gsungs so
gru.english: If you do all these as I've described it, you will find that you are indeed able to induce the God of Fire to come and enter the fire on the platform.  Texts like the Height of Knowledge and the Ocean of Attainments describe how this then opens up a thousand new doors to your spiritual goals.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA SINDHU RA'I SGRUB PA'AM, BSNYEN SGRUB SBRAGS MA JI LTAR BYA TSUL NI,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa sindhu ra'i sgrub pa'am, bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma ji ltar bya tshul ni
gru.english: This brings us to the second part of this section: instructions on how to do the Practice of Sindhura, otherwise known as the Combination of Retreat and Practice.

gru.acip: YUL NYI SHU RTZA BZHI'I YA GYAL LA SOGS PA MKHA' 'GRO 'DU BA'I GNAS MTSAN NYID DANG LDAN PA DUR KHROD DANG KHAD NYE BA'I SGRUB KHANG DU BYI DOR LEGS PAR BYIS,
gru.wylie: yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal la sogs pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dur khrod dang khad nye ba'i sgrub khang du byi dor legs par byis
gru.english: First find a retreat cabin which is on the edge of a burial ground--a spot like one of the 24 holy places, with all the requisite characteristics of a truly sacred site: a place where the Angel ladies gather.  Clean and tidy the cabin well.

gru.acip: SGRUB PA LA 'JUG PA'I DANG PO NI ME RLUNG RGYU BA'I DUS SU BRTZAM PAR BYA STE, SGRUB BSNYEN GYI SKABS 'DIR GNAS DUS KHANG PA LTA PHYOGS SOGS BSHAD TSOD LTAR BYA DGOS SHING, DE YANG SA GSUM GYI PHO NYA MO RNAMS DBANG DU BYA BA'I DBANG GI LAS DANG MTHUN PAR BYA GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dang po ni me rlung rgyu ba'i dus su brtsam par bya ste, sgrub bsnyen gyi skabs 'dir gnas dus khang pa lta phyogs sogs bshad tshod ltar bya dgos shing, de yang sa gsum gyi pho nya mo rnams dbang du bya ba'i dbang gi las dang mthun par bya gsungs
gru.english: The time that you choose to begin the practice should be a period of the day when the inner wind of fire normally flows.  We need to remember, as far as our retreats, to keep in mind criteria that are covered in the texts: the general place, the time, the type of retreat hut, which direction it faces, and other such issues.  It is also said that all these factors, if observed carefully, are conducive to the sacred work of bringing the Messenger women of all three worlds to do our bidding. Translator's note: We've corrected some of this paragraph in the Tibetan where it seemed to be miscarved.

gru.acip: DE NAS SKYABS SEMS NAS BSAM MI KHYAB KYI BAR GYI BDAG BSKYED BZLAS PA DANG BCAS PA RDZOGS PA'I MJUG TU MDUN BSKYED KYI DKYIL 'KHOR YAN LAG BZHI RDZOGS SU BSGRUB STE PHYI NANG GI MCHOD PA BSTOD PA DANG BCAS PA YIG CHA LOGS SU 'BYUNG BA LTAR RGYAS PAR BYAS,
gru.wylie: de nas skyabs sems nas bsam mi khyab kyi bar gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub ste phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa dang bcas pa yig cha logs su 'byung ba ltar rgyas par byas
gru.english: Next recite the ritual for turning yourself into Her, all the way from the section on refuge and the Wish up to the Yoga of the Inconceivable.  Once you have completed this, then bring a secret world of the type that is before you into being--one that is complete with all four of its components.  After that, do the steps of the outer and inner offerings, and the words of praise; perform these in an extensive manner, as they appear in our separate texts.

gru.acip: DPRAL BAR SINDHU RA'I THIG LE BKOD, DAR DMAR POS THOD BCINGS, CHAS GOS DMAR PO GYON TE, THAB RTZAR BDAG BSKYED BZLAS PA GTOR 'BUL DANG BCAS PA CHO GA LTAR SGRUB RJES,
gru.wylie: dpral bar sindhu ra'i thig le bkod, dar dmar pos thod bcings, chas gos dmar po gyon te, thab rtsar bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa cho ga ltar sgrub rjes
gru.english: Place a dot of sindhura powder in the middle of your forehead, and wrap a red headband around your head.  The outfit you wear, and the accessories attached to it, should all be crimson.  Sitting there now at the platform, recite the ritual for becoming Her, along with the offering of the torma cake, all in accordance with the usual text.

gru.acip: DKAR GTOR BTANG BSANG CHU DANG CHU BZHI SGRUB PA, RDOR DRIL PHYIN RLABS NAS BZUNG CHO GA'I NGAG 'DON RNAMS BCU CHA'I SBYIN SREG GI CHO GA ZUR DU BKOD PA LTAR BYA,
gru.wylie: dkar gtor btang bsang chu dang chu bzhi sgrub pa, rdor dril phyin rlabs nas bzung cho ga'i ngag 'don rnams bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zur du bkod pa ltar bya
gru.english: Go through the steps of the ritual then where you offer forth a torma cake of "white" substances, and bring into being the water for clearing away obstacles, as well as the four waters of offering.  Then recite everything from the part where you bless your diamond and bell on up, just as we see it in the separate ritual texts on making a tenth-part offering of fire.

gru.acip: DE NAS NYIN RE BZHIN BAR MA CHAD PAR THUN GNYIS RE'AM RE RE TZAM RANG GI KHAMS KYI LCOGS TSOD DANG BSTUN NAS RIM GYIS BCU CHA'I GRANGS 'GRO NGES BYA, MJUG TU 'O THUG GI STON MO DANG TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO BCAS RGYAS PAR BYA'O,, DE DAG NI SGRUB PA JI LTAR BYA BA'I TSUL GSAL BAR BKOD PA'O,,
gru.wylie: de nas nyin re bzhin bar ma chad par thun gnyis re'am re re tsam rang gi khams kyi lcogs tshod dang bstun nas rim gyis bcu cha'i grangs 'gro nges bya, mjug tu 'o thug gi ston mo dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas rgyas par bya'o,, de dag ni sgrub pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa'o
gru.english: Continue the fire offering each day then, without missing a day.  This can be done in two sessions a day, or just one--all according to your personal capacity and how much time you have at your disposal.  Gradually though you must be sure to complete the required number of offerings into the fire: one tenth the number of your mantras.  On the day that you finish, hold a rice-pudding party and do an extensive Circle of Offering.  With this then we have given a clear account of how one should do the "practice" part of the sindhura practice. The Application of Sindhura to our Life

gru.acip: GSUM PA LAS LA SBYOR BA NI, DE LTAR SGRUB PA LEGS PAR THON NAS SHING LANG+GA LI YA ZHES PA BDE MCHOG RTZA RGYUD NAS ZUR TZAM GSUNGS PA BAL YUL RGYA GAR SOGS NAS THON PA KHRA RIS LTA BU YOD PA DE MA RNYED NA BOD DU DO RGOD PAS BYA BAR GSUNGS LA,
gru.wylie: gsum pa las la sbyor ba ni, de ltar sgrub pa legs par thon nas shing lang+ga li ya zhes pa bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas zur tsam gsungs pa bal yul rgya gar sogs nas thon pa khra ris lta bu yod pa de ma rnyed na bod du do rgod pas bya bar gsungs la
gru.english: This brings us to the third part of this section, which is actually applying the Practice of Sindhura to holy actions in our life.  Once you have finished the practices of sindhura as we have described them above, you must seek out the trunk of a tree known as a "Langaliya." This particular kind of tree is mentioned only very briefly in the root secret text for teachings of Highest Bliss.  It comes from countries like Nepal and India, and has a certain distinctive checkered pattern to the wood.  It is taught though that if one is unable to find this particular tree, then here in Tibet one may "use a dogupa."

gru.acip: SLAR YANG DKYIL 'KHOR SNGAR LTAR BZHENGS TE SINDH'U RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU SNGAR GYI SHING DE RTZA RTZE MA NOR ZHING, MA BCAD GONG SHAR LA BSTAN PA DE MDUN LA PHYOGS PAR BZHAG LA SGRUB MCHOD BDAG 'JUG TSOGS GTOR GSOL 'DEBS SOGS NAN TAN BYA,
gru.wylie: slar yang dkyil 'khor sngar ltar bzhengs te sindhU ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sngar gyi shing de rtsa rtse ma nor zhing, ma bcad gong shar la bstan pa de mdun la phyogs par bzhag la sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshogs gtor gsol 'debs sogs nan tan bya
gru.english: Now set up another mandala table as we did before; in the center of the secret world of sindhura powder then set the wood container, being careful not to mix up the top and the bottom.  Orient it so that the side with the original mark for the eastern direction is now facing to the front.  Now throw yourself into a intense practice of the ritual for reaching Her; the offerings; taking yourself in; a Circle of Gathering; presenting the torma cake; and supplications for the blessing of this Holy Being.

gru.acip: SENG LDENG LA SOGS PA'I SHING GANG YANG RUNG BA LAS BYAS PA'I DBYUG PA LAG PA GNYIS SNYING GAR RTZA SPRAD PA'I GRU MO PHAN TSUN GYI SNE DANG MNYAM PA ZHIG HE RU KA'AM, DUM SKYES MAR BSKYED DGOS PAS,
gru.wylie: seng ldeng la sogs pa'i shing gang yang rung ba las byas pa'i dbyug pa lag pa gnyis snying gar rtsa sprad pa'i gru mo phan tshun gyi sne dang mnyam pa zhig he ru ka'am, dum skyes mar bskyed dgos pas
gru.english: You two go together into the forest and prepare a special staff from whatever tree you feel is appropriate--it could for example be the sandalwood.  The length of the staff should be equal to the distance from your one elbow to the other, when you touch your fingertips at your chest with your elbows splayed out to either side--which would be a pair of cubits.  Now we're going to have to raise either Heruka or the Lady of Pieces within the staff.

whole_word_matches.context: pa'i dbyug pa lag pa gnyis snying gar rtsa sprad pa'i gru mo phan tshun gyi sne dang mnyam pa zhig he ru ka'am,

gru.acip: YIG BRGYA BZLA, DUM SKYES MA ZHU BA LAS BYUNG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR DBYUG PAR GYUR PAR BSAMS LA SGRUB GROGS LA GTAD, DES KYANG ZHAL BZHI PA'I SNGAGS BZLA ZHING DBYUG PA LAG TU BZUNG,
gru.wylie: yig brgya bzla, dum skyes ma zhu ba las byung ba'i rnal 'byor dbyug par gyur par bsams la sgrub grogs la gtad, des kyang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzla zhing dbyug pa lag tu bzung
gru.english: (After that, recite the Mantra of a Hundred Syllables, and see the following:) The Lady of Pieces Melts down And flows into This sacred yogi's staff. (Now hand the staff over to your assistant.  They hold the staff in their hands and recite the Mantra of the Four-Faced One.)

gru.acip: DER YID DU 'BAB PA'I SAR DONG GRU GSUM ZUR GCIG MDUN DU BSTAN PA KHRU GANG TZAM BRUS PA'I NANG DU GA-YAM SGROM SOGS BTZUGS PAR
gru.wylie: der yid du 'bab pa'i sar dong gru gsum zur gcig mdun du bstan pa khru gang tsam brus pa'i nang du ga-yam sgrom sogs btsugs par
gru.english: Pick a spot that appeals to you and dig out a triangle-shaped pit.  One point of the triangle should be facing to the front.  Dig down about a cubit, and then line the pit with shale or something of the like to create a little chamber.

whole_word_matches.context: der yid du 'bab pa'i sar dong gru gsum zur gcig mdun du bstan pa khru gang tsam brus pa'

gru.acip: SNGAGS 'OD ZER DANG BCAS PA YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS SHAR NAG, BYANG LJANG, NUB DMAR, LHO SER BA'I SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I RVA BA GRU BZHI PA TSANGS PA'I 'JIG RTEN NAS GSER GYI SA GZHI LA THUG GI BAR DU KHYAB PAR GYUR,
gru.wylie: sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las shar nag, byang ljang, nub dmar, lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rva ba gru bzhi pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab par gyur
gru.english: The secret words And the beams of light Transform now Into a crossed diamond, A fortress of four walls, Black to the east Green to the north Red to the west And yellow to the south. This too stretches From the Pure One's world Down to the golden core Of the earth itself.

whole_word_matches.context: ng, nub dmar, lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rva ba gru bzhi pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la

gru.acip: RVA BA GRUB PA DANG DUS MNYAM DU H'Um LAS SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I LTE BAL H'Um GIS MTSAN PA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER LAS GSER GYI SA GZHI LA THUG PA'I 'OG GI SA GZHI SNA TSOGS RDO RJE'I RANG BZHIN DU GYUR,
gru.wylie: rva ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du hUM las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bal hUM gis mtshan pa'i hUM gi 'od zer las gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i 'og gi sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur
gru.english: In the very moment That the walls are complete, A letter hung appears, And from it a crossed diamond Marked at its center With hung. Light shines forth From the hung, And pierces To the earth's gold core, Transforming it In its essence To another diamond, crossed.

gru.acip: THUN GROL NAS SINDH'U RA BZHAG ,RANG GROGS DANG BCAS NANG DU LOG, TSES BCU GCIG NYIN SNGA DRO NAS SINDH'U RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR GSAR PA BSHAMS TE, SGRUB MCHOD DANG BDAG 'JUG TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO SOGS RGYAS PAR BYA,
gru.wylie: thun grol nas sindhU ra bzhag ,rang grogs dang bcas nang du log, tshes bcu gcig nyin snga dro nas sindhU ra'i dkyil 'khor gsar pa bshams te, sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyas par bya
gru.english: Once the session is finished, leave the container of sindhura powder where it is.  Return home, together with your assistant.  On the morning of the eleventh then set forth a new mandala of sindhura.  Take yourself through extensive forms of the various steps of reaching Her; offering to Her; bringing yourself in to the secret world; a Circle of Gathering, and all the rest.

gru.acip: NYIN MO SNGAR BZHIN SGRUB MCHOD DANG BDAG 'JUG LA BRTZON, NYER LNGA'I NUB MO MTSAN THOG THAG BZLAS PA BYAS LA NAM LANGS MA THAG SINDH'U RA PHYUNG NAS KHYIM DU KHYER LA,
gru.wylie: nyin mo sngar bzhin sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug la brtson, nyer lnga'i nub mo mtshan thog thag bzlas pa byas la nam langs ma thag sindhU ra phyung nas khyim du khyer la
gru.english: During the days, continue as we did before really working at the ritual for reaching Her; making Her offerings; and bringing yourself into Her secret world.  On the evening of the 25th of the month, recite Her secret words all night long.  Just after the day breaks, dig up the container of sindhura and carry it home.

gru.acip: DE NYID DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU BZHAG NAS PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BDAG 'JUG TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO DANG BCAS RGYAS PAR BYAS NAS MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA'I GSOL BA SHUGS DRAG 'DEBS,
gru.wylie: de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas phyi rol mchod pa bdag 'jug tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas rgyas par byas nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i gsol ba shugs drag 'debs
gru.english: Take the container and set it in the center of the mandala you've got set up.  Again do extensive versions of the presentation of the water offerings; bringing yourself into the mandala; and celebrating the Circle of Gathering.  Then make fierce supplication that She grant you the attainment of Her heaven.

gru.acip: TSES BCU'I MCHOD PA LA SOGS PA'I YO BYAD MED KYANG SNGAR GYI SINDH'U RA MDUN DU BZHAG NAS BSAM GTAN GYI SGRUB MCHOD BYA LA,
gru.wylie: tshes bcu'i mchod pa la sogs pa'i yo byad med kyang sngar gyi sindhU ra mdun du bzhag nas bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod bya la
gru.english: Now since you're just a simple wanderer now, you're not going to have with you all the equipment that it takes to do your Offering of the Tenth and other such rituals.  So what you do is simply place that same container of sindhura in front of you and do the entire ritual for reaching Her, and all the offerings, in your mind.

gru.acip: DE LTA BU'I TSUL GYIS MKHA' SPYOD 'GRUB PA NI DBANG PO 'BRING ZHES BYA STE, SINDH'UR LANG+GA LI YI SDONG BUR BCAS, ,ZHES PA NAS, MKHA' SPYOD 'KHRID PAR SHOG ,CES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: de lta bu'i tshul gyis mkha' spyod 'grub pa ni dbang po 'bring zhes bya ste, sindhUr lang+ga li yi sdong bur bcas, ,zhes pa nas, mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog ,ces gsungs so
gru.english: Working to reach the Heaven of the Angel with this kind of practice, the Sindhura, is considered to be the method used by those of medium spiritual capacity, given the context of its mention in the Prayer with the lines that go from "May I use the sindhura and the trunk of langali..." up to "... May the Lovely One lead me off to the Heaven of the Angel."

gru.acip: DE LTAR 'BAD KYANG MA 'GRUB NA TSE 'DIR LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU BGROD PA'I NUS PA MED PAS DBANG PO THA MA ZHES BYA STE,
gru.wylie: de ltar 'bad kyang ma 'grub na tshe 'dir lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i nus pa med pas dbang po tha ma zhes bya ste
gru.english: Now suppose that you do make every effort in this particular practice, but you do not reach the goal.  In this case, you do not have the ability to travel to the Heaven of the Angel before giving up this body--and you would be considered a person of least capacity.

gru.acip: DE LTAR MKHA' SPYOD KYI ZHING DER SLEBS TZAM NYID NAS GRUB PAS BCUD LEN GRUB PA BZHIN DU RANG LO BRGYAD CU LON PA'I RGAN PO YIN YANG LO BCU DRUG LON PA'I NA TSOD DU 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: de ltar mkha' spyod kyi zhing der slebs tsam nyid nas grub pas bcud len grub pa bzhin du rang lo brgyad cu lon pa'i rgan po yin yang lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod du 'gyur
gru.english: The very moment that you arrive and start your practice in this Heaven, something wonderful happens, as though you had suddenly gained mastery over that practice of living off of nothing but tiny pills of flower essence.  That is, you may have up to this moment been a decrepit octogenarian, but now you look as though you were a youth of 16 years once more.

gru.acip: 'DI LTA BU'I MYUR LAM BLA NA MED PA LA NYAMS LEN BYAR YOD PA'I SKAL BA BZANG PO 'DI LTA BU RNYED PA'I DUS 'DIR MNOG CHUNG SNYING PO MED PA'I TSE 'DI'I BYA BA LA MI GA-YENG BAR GTAN 'DUN DNGOS GRUB MCHOG GI DGA' STON BSGRUB PA LA RTZE GCIG TU 'BAD PAR 'TSAL LO,, ZHES KHO BOS SNYING THAG PA NAS GDAMS SO,,
gru.wylie: 'di lta bu'i myur lam bla na med pa la nyams len byar yod pa'i skal ba bzang po 'di lta bu rnyed pa'i dus 'dir mnog chung snying po med pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba la mi ga-yeng bar gtan 'dun dngos grub mchog gi dga' ston bsgrub pa la rtse gcig tu 'bad par 'tshal lo,, zhes kho bos snying thag pa nas gdams so
gru.english: You are a person who possesses the extraordinary good karma to have access to the fast path we've described in these pages: you have here in your own hands this one unsurpassed path, ready for you to practice.  Don't get distracted now by the meaningless trifles that this life around you seems to offer.  Come seat yourself at the feast that awaits you: focus on the highest spiritual goal of all, the one thing you always wished for.  Come, throw yourself into Her practice, and have your fill.  These parting words of advice do I offer you, straight from the core of my heart.

gru.acip: 'DIR SMRAS PA, GANG ZHIG BRDOS BCAS LUS 'DI MA DOR BZHIN, ,DNGOS SU RIG 'DZIN GRONG DU BGROD BYED CING, ,NYE BA'I SNYING PO BKLAGS TZAM GYIS 'GRUB PA'I, ,KHYAD CHOS 'DI 'DRA GDAMS ZAB 'DI KHO NA,
gru.wylie: 'dir smras pa, gang zhig brdos bcas lus 'di ma dor bzhin, ,dngos su rig 'dzin grong du bgrod byed cing, ,nye ba'i snying po bklags tsam gyis 'grub pa'i, ,khyad chos 'di 'dra gdams zab 'di kho na
gru.english: And so it is done. These are the only words of instruction Which possess this extraordinary quality: They can take you direct to the city Of the Keepers of Sacred Knowledge Now, before your body's bubble bursts-- And all you need to do Is recite Her words of closest essence.

gru.acip: ,BDAG 'DRA GTAN 'DUN BSGRUB PA'I LONG TZAM MED, ,BSGRUB KYANG TSIG TZAM GSOG LAS BSGOM MI SHES, ,YANG DAG LAM BZANG THOB PA'I SKAL DMAN LA, ,GDAMS ZAB 'DI LAS BYA SLA KHE CHE GANG,
gru.wylie: bdag 'dra gtan 'dun bsgrub pa'i long tsam med, ,bsgrub kyang tshig tsam gsog las bsgom mi shes, ,yang dag lam bzang thob pa'i skal dman la, ,gdams zab 'di las bya sla khe che gang
gru.english: What teaching could be more easily followed, And still be the most important of all? Perfect for those of you like me, Who have but hours to try to reach The ultimate destination we dream-- Who practice and practice but only seem To pile up words with recitation, Who know nothing of actual practice, Who have only barely enough karma To have met with this pure perfect path.

gru.acip: (,CES RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DBANG MO'I BSNYEN SGRUB LAS GSUM GYI LAG LEN NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA SKAL BZANG MKHA' SPYOD BGROD PA'I THEM SKAS ZHES BYA BA 'DI YANG,)
gru.wylie: (,ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lag len nag 'gros su bkod pa skal bzang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di yang,)
gru.english: This then has been the Stairway to Heaven for Those of Good Fortune, a text in simple prose on how to carry out the retreat, the sacred practice, and the holy activity--these three steps--in the teachings of the Queen of the Heaven that Naropa was shown: the Heaven of the Holy One, the Angel of Diamond.

gru.acip: (LAM 'DI LA GCIG TU MOS PA LHUR LEN PA, TSA BA RONG NAS DGE BSNYEN RDO RJE RAB BRTAN GYIS RAB DKAR LHA REG ,RTEN GSUM, MDUN LCOG RGYA RTZI MA BKOD LEGS SOGS BDOG PA'I SKYES BZANG DANG BCAS LO NAS LOR BSTUD NAN DU BSKUL BA LA BRTEN NAS, LAM 'DIR MOS PA YID BYED KYI RNAL 'BYOR LHUR LEN PA'I BTZUN GZUGS BDE CHEN SNYING POS PHYOGS GCIG TU BSGRIGS PA'I YI GE PA NI, GCIG TU SGRUB PA'I RGYAL MTSAN 'DZIN PA ZHVA SGAB CHOS MDZAD THUB BSTAN DBANG RGYAL GYIS BGYIS PA 'GRO DON 'PHEL,,) ` ,,
gru.wylie: (lam 'di la gcig tu mos pa lhur len pa, tsha ba rong nas dge bsnyen rdo rje rab brtan gyis rab dkar lha reg ,rten gsum, mdun lcog rgya rtsi ma bkod legs sogs bdog pa'i skyes bzang dang bcas lo nas lor bstud nan du bskul ba la brten nas, lam 'dir mos pa yid byed kyi rnal 'byor lhur len pa'i btsun gzugs bde chen snying pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni, gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa zhva sgab chos mdzad thub bstan dbang rgyal gyis bgyis pa 'gro don 'phel,,) `
gru.english: I was begged to compose this work by a layperson with lifetime vows from Tsawa Rung who name is Dorje Rabten, a practitioner who is single-mindedly devoted to this one particular path.  He presented to me many fine gifts: offering scarves of silk, raiment of the gods, white as snow; the traditional offering of the three representations of enlightened body, speech, and mind; and an exquisite table on which to set them, finished in Chinese lacquer.  For year after year he chased me to finish putting it all together, and thus I have.  I am Dechen Nyingpo, only a shadow of a real monk, but I am someone who is trying to practice this particular yoga, and who has utter devotion for it.  The scribe for the text was the dharma man of Shagab, Tupten Wangyal, who is a true upholder of the banner of deep and constant practice.  We pray that this will be of benefit for every living being.

gru.acip: ,GANG GI BSNYEN SGRUB LAS SBYOR ZAB DGU'I GNAD, ,MKHA' 'GRO'I SNYING BCUD SNYAN BRGYUD NOR BU'I PHRENG, ,KHRIGS CHAGS GSER GYI SRAD BU LA BRGYUS NAS, ,SKAL BZANG DGA' STON SNYING PO MCHOG SBYIN BYAS,
gru.wylie: gang gi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor zab dgu'i gnad, ,mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud snyan brgyud nor bu'i phreng, ,khrigs chags gser gyi srad bu la brgyus nas, ,skal bzang dga' ston snying po mchog sbyin byas
gru.english: Here then are a Thousand Subtle secret keys For applying ourselves to Your Retreat, practice, and sacred work. It is the heart essence Of the Angels, a string Of precious jewels from The oral lineage, Strung so perfectly For us now, Lined up one by one On a string of purest gold. And it will bring to those Who have the goodness The highest gift of all, The feast of the very essence.

gru.acip: ,GANG 'DI GCIG LAS DU MAR 'CHAR BA'I 'PHRUL, ,MI 'DZAD DNGOS POR SPEL BA'I RGYU SBYOR BA, ,DGE SLONG THUB BSTAN DNGOS GRUB PHA BLO LDAN, ,AA MA TSE BRTAN SGROL MA DANG BCAS GSUM,
gru.wylie: gang 'di gcig las du mar 'char ba'i 'phrul, ,mi 'dzad dngos por spel ba'i rgyu sbyor ba, ,dge slong thub bstan dngos grub pha blo ldan, ,aa ma tshe brtan sgrol ma dang bcas gsum
gru.english: And someone has worked The miracle, of turning This single copy Into myriad ones-- Someone supplied the means To turn what we have now Into an inexhaustible rain Of all we could ever need. That someone was three: the monk By the name of Tupten Ngudrup, Along with his father Londen, And mother Tseten Drolma.

gru.acip: ,MCHOG GSUM BDEN BYIN BDAG GI LHAG BSAM DANG, ,STONG PA'I GSHIS LUGS CHOS CAN SNA TSOGS SU, ,'CHAR BA'I RTEN 'BYUNG 'GOG PA MED PA'I MTHUS, ,SMON PA'I DON KUN BDE BLAG 'GRUB GYUR CIG
gru.wylie: mchog gsum bden byin bdag gi lhag bsam dang, ,stong pa'i gshis lugs chos can sna tshogs su, ,'char ba'i rten 'byung 'gog pa med pa'i mthus, ,smon pa'i don kun bde blag 'grub gyur cig
gru.english: By the power of the blessing Of the truth of the Highest Three; By the power of my willingness To free all beings myself; By the power of the Way Things are, Emptiness itself, Displayed never-ending In the thousand forms of the things around us, Dependent origination, Then may all that we have prayed for here Come to be, with perfect ease.

gru.acip: BLA MA'I KHRID RGYUN SKABS 'DI YIN GYI ZHAL GSAL MA BYUNG, BSKYED RIM RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG 'DIS NI RAB BZLAS SGOM GYIS GROL BA, 'BRING SINDHU RA'I SGRUB PAS GROL BA, THA MA 'CHI KHAR RNAL 'BYOR MAS RJES SU 'ZIN PA 'PHO BAS BGROD PA, YANG MTHA' SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS MKHA' SPYOD SOGS 'GRUB PA'I GANG ZAG THAMS CAD KYIS NYAMS SU LEN PA GAL CHE,
gru.wylie: bla ma'i khrid rgyun skabs 'di yin gyi zhal gsal ma byung, bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig 'dis ni rab bzlas sgom gyis grol ba, 'bring sindhu ra'i sgrub pas grol ba, tha ma 'chi khar rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'zin pa 'pho bas bgrod pa, yang mtha' skye ba brgyud nas mkha' spyod sogs 'grub pa'i gang zag thams cad kyis nyams su len pa gal che
gru.english: This is the section as it is normally given according to the teaching tradition of our Lamas; but I haven't received clarifications on it.  If people apply themselves to these eleven yogas of the stage of creation, then those of highest capacity will reach liberation through the practices of recitation and meditation.  Those of medium capacity will be freed through the practice of sindhura.  Those of least capacity are taken into the care of the Diamond Angel at the moment of death, travelling the path through the practice of sending on their consciousness.  And those who are lower than low in their capacity attain the Heaven of the Angel and other goals over a series of future lives.  As such, it's important for people of all capacities to exert themselves in the practice of these eleven yogas.

gru.acip: DE YANG, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI MA SKYES DANG, ,THE TSOM LDAN PA NYID DANG NI, ,BKA' BZHIN DU NI MI SPYOD DANG, ,DAD PA MED NYID 'GRUB MI 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: de yang, ,byang chub sems ni ma skyes dang, ,the tshom ldan pa nyid dang ni, ,bka' bzhin du ni mi spyod dang, ,dad pa med nyid 'grub mi 'gyur
gru.english: As the text says, Those who fail to develop The Wish for enlightenment; Those whose minds Are plagued by doubts; Those who fail To follow the directions; And those who have no faith Will never achieve their goals.

gru.acip: ,ZHES LAM THUN MONG BAS RGYUD SBYANGS TE BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS KYIS RTZIS MA ZIN PA DANG, LAM NYAMS SU LEN TSUL THE TSOM GYI SGRO 'DOGS MA CHOD PA DANG, BKA' BZHIN DU NI MI SPYOD PA DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA MI BSRUNG PA DANG, LHA DANG BLA MA'I GDAMS NGAG SOGS LA DAD PA MA THOB NA DNGOS GRUB MI 'GRUB PAS DE DAG LA 'BAD PA GAL CHE BA YIN TE,
gru.wylie: zhes lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs te byang chub kyi sems kyis rtsis ma zin pa dang, lam nyams su len tshul the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs ma chod pa dang, bka' bzhin du ni mi spyod pa dam tshig dang sdom pa mi bsrung pa dang, lha dang bla ma'i gdams ngag sogs la dad pa ma thob na dngos grub mi 'grub pas de dag la 'bad pa gal che ba yin te
gru.english: These lines are describing, first, practitioners who have failed to prepare their minds with the path which is shared, and whose hearts are not imbued then by the Wish for enlightenment.  Then it speaks of those who have failed to resolve their doubts about how the path should be put into practice.  Next it describes those who fail to follow the directions they've been given: who fail to honor their pledges and vows.  And then finally it mentions those who have no faith in things like the advices they receive from the Angels and Lamas.  People like this, the verse is saying, will never achieve their spiritual goals; and as such it is crucial for us to put forth great efforts in doing the opposite in each case.

gru.acip: SLOB DPON ZHI BA'I YE SHES KYIS, DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA'I RGYU BZHI NI, DAD PAS MI LDOG PA DANG, SHES RAB KYIS THE TSOM MI ZA BA DANG, TING NGE 'DZIN RTZE GCIG PA DANG SHIN TU GSANG BA RNAMS SO, ,ZHES GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: slob dpon zhi ba'i ye shes kyis, dngos grub 'grub pa'i rgyu bzhi ni, dad pas mi ldog pa dang, shes rab kyis the tshom mi za ba dang, ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pa dang shin tu gsang ba rnams so, ,zhes gsungs
gru.english: Master Shantijnana too has said, There are four things that act to bring you your spiritual attainments: refusing, because your faith is strong, to give up; refusing, because your wisdom is strong, to doubt any longer; maintaining single-pointed concentration; and keeping your practice perfectly secret.

gru.acip: RDO RJE PHAG MO'I BSKYED RIM 'DI MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB PA LA MCHOG YIN PAS NA BSKYED RIM PHAG MO MKHA' SPYOD CES GSUNGS SO,,
