gru.wylie: rdo rje phag mo'i bskyed rim 'di mkha' spyod sgrub pa la mchog yin pas na bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ces gsungs so
gru.english: This creation-stage practice of the Diamond Sow is the very best practice for reaching the Heaven of the Angel; as such, it's been given the name "The Creation-Stage Practice of the Heaven of the Sow."

gru.acip: SNYING GA'I CHOS 'BYUNG PHYI MAS GSANG GNAS KYI RTZA 'KHOR AE YIG GRU GSUM GYI DBYIBS CAN GYI RTZA 'DAB SUM CU SO GNYIS,
gru.wylie: snying ga'i chos 'byung phyi mas gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor ae yig gru gsum gyi dbyibs can gyi rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis
gru.english: The outside of the dharma star at our heart represents the chakra in the channels of our secret place, which has the triangular shape of the [Sanskrit] eh letter, and comes with 32 channel petals.

whole_word_matches.context: chos 'byung phyi mas gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor ae yig gru gsum gyi dbyibs can gyi rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis

gru.acip: CHOS 'BYUNG NANG MAS LTE BA'I RTZA MDUD GRU GSUM AA THUNG DANG BCAS PA RTZA 'DAB RE BZHI,
gru.wylie: chos 'byung nang mas lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum aa thung dang bcas pa rtsa 'dab re bzhi
gru.english: The inside of the star represents the triangular knot in the channels of the navel, along with its short ah letter.  It comes with 64 channel petals.

whole_word_matches.context: chos 'byung nang mas lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum aa thung dang bcas pa rtsa 'dab re bzhi

gru.acip: STENG MKHA' SPYOD KYI DKYIL 'KHOR DGA' 'KHYIL DKAR PO LA BRTEN NAS STONG PA MI RTOG PA DANG, 'OG RLUNG GI DKYIL 'KHOR DGA' 'KHYIL DMAR PO LA BRTEN NAS, BDE BA SGRUB PA,
gru.wylie: steng mkha' spyod kyi dkyil 'khor dga' 'khyil dkar po la brten nas stong pa mi rtog pa dang, 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor dga' 'khyil dmar po la brten nas, bde ba sgrub pa
gru.english: By relying on the "secret world of Her Heaven" in the upper location--meaning the white swirl of bliss--we attain a state beyond the conceptual.  And by relying on the "secret world of the inner winds" in the lower location--meaning the red swirl of bliss--we attain ecstasy.

gru.acip: BAR SNGAGS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR SNYING KHA'I CHOS 'BYUNG SNGAGS PHRENG BAm YIG N'A DA ME 'BAR LA KHAD PA BCAS LA BRTEN NAS DROD SGRUB PA STE DGA' 'KHYIL DE DAG SNYING GAR 'DUS PA STONG YAL DU SONG BA'I TSE BDE STONG DBYER MED DE NYID SHES RAB KYI YE SHES KYI LAM,
gru.wylie: bar sngags kyi dkyil 'khor snying kha'i chos 'byung sngags phreng baM yig nA da me 'bar la khad pa bcas la brten nas drod sgrub pa ste dga' 'khyil de dag snying gar 'dus pa stong yal du song ba'i tshe bde stong dbyer med de nyid shes rab kyi ye shes kyi lam
gru.english: By relying on the "secret world of the mantra" inbetween these two locations--a reference to the dharma star, the string of secret words, the vam letter, and its nada, just about to break out into flame; all at the heart--we attain inner heat.  The indivisible bliss and void that we experience when the two bliss swirls then gather at the heart and vanish into emptiness is the path of the empowerment of knowledge of the Lady of Wisdom.

gru.acip: DER SLEB PA TZAM NAS GRUB PA'I BCUD LEN GRUB PA BZHIN DU RGAN PO LO BRGYAD CU LON PA TZAM YANG LO BCU DRUG GI NA TSOD DU 'GYUR ZHING, NAM MKHA' MDZOD LA MNGA' BRNYES TE YO BYAD THAMS CAD NAM MKHA' LAS BAB CING,
gru.wylie: der sleb pa tsam nas grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du rgan po lo brgyad cu lon pa tsam yang lo bcu drug gi na tshod du 'gyur zhing, nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes te yo byad thams cad nam mkha' las bab cing
gru.english: The moment you arrive there, it's already as if you had mastered that practice of living off of tiny bits of flower essence: you might have been a doddering octogenarian, but now you look like you're 16.  You have power over the Treasure of the Sky, and so whatever physical needs you have simply drop into your hands from the sky above.

gru.acip: ' ,NUB BCO BRGYAD PAR, GANG ZAG DBANG PO 'BRING SINDHU RA'I SGRUB PAR SGRO 'DOGS BCAD NAS SPYAN GNYIS NAS ZHABS KYI BAR GYI SEMS 'DZIN GTONG BA LA,
gru.wylie: ' ,nub bco brgyad par, gang zag dbang po 'bring sindhu ra'i sgrub par sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong ba la
gru.english: On the evening of the eighteenth day, we do an analytical presentation of how a practitioner of medium capacity uses the practice of sindhura to attain their goals.  And then for the visualization focus of the day we do everything from Her two eyes down to Her feet.

gru.acip: 'DI LA BSNYEN PA DANG, SGRUB PA DANG, LAS SBYOR GSUM LAS, DANG PO NI,
gru.wylie: 'di la bsnyen pa dang, sgrub pa dang, las sbyor gsum las, dang po ni
gru.english: The practice of sindhura involves three steps: the retreat, the practice, and the sacred work.  Here is the first.

gru.acip: GROGS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I GZHI BSNYEN SONG BA LA SBA'I DBYUG PA LAG GNYIS SNYING KHAR RTZE SPRAD PAS GRU MO PHAN TSUN GYI TSAD DANG 'DOM PHYED DON GCIG PAS DE LTA BU'I DBYUG PA GROGS KYI LAG TU GTAD NAS SUMBHA NI BZLA, SBOM PHRA DANG DBYIBS BSHAD KHUNGS MA MTHONG,
gru.wylie: grogs 'khor lo sdom pa'i gzhi bsnyen song ba la sba'i dbyug pa lag gnyis snying khar rtse sprad pas gru mo phan tshun gyi tshad dang 'dom phyed don gcig pas de lta bu'i dbyug pa grogs kyi lag tu gtad nas sumbha ni bzla, sbom phra dang dbyibs bshad khungs ma mthong
gru.english: Now you will need to find a companion--a person who has completed the foundational retreat for the Angel known as Union of the Spheres--and invest her or him with a staff made of wood from a ba tree.  The staff should be half an armspan in length; which is the same as saying the length from one elbow to the other when you spread out your arms to the side and then bend them in, fingertips touching at your chest.  The assistant then recites the Sumbhani Mantra.  (I have yet to come across a scriptural reference for the exact width and shape of this staff.)

whole_word_matches.context: la sba'i dbyug pa lag gnyis snying khar rtse sprad pas gru mo phan tshun gyi tshad dang 'dom phyed don gcig pas d

gru.acip: SGRUB MCHOD, BDAG 'JUG LEN PA RNAMS RGYAS PAR BYAS NAS GROGS DANG LHAN CIG TU DUR KHROD DU SONG LA DER CHOS 'BYUNG GRU GSUM GYI ZUR GCIG NUB TU BSTAN PA KHRU GANG TZAM BRUS PA'I NANG DU SINDHU RA'I SHING BCUG LA G-YAM PA SOGS KYIS BCAD DE MIS MI SHES SHING RANG GIS MI NOR BA'I RTAGS BYAS PA'I STENG DU,
gru.wylie: sgrub mchod, bdag 'jug len pa rnams rgyas par byas nas grogs dang lhan cig tu dur khrod du song la der chos 'byung gru gsum gyi zur gcig nub tu bstan pa khru gang tsam brus pa'i nang du sindhu ra'i shing bcug la g-yam pa sogs kyis bcad de mis mi shes shing rang gis mi nor ba'i rtags byas pa'i steng du
gru.english: Go through an extended version of the ritual for reaching Her, along with the offerings, and taking yourself into Her secret world.  Now go with your companion to the charnel ground.  Dig out a hole shaped like a dharma star--about a cubit across, with one point facing to the west.  Place the container of wood down into the hole and line it around and on top with something to protect it--sheets of rock shale or the like.  No one who passes by the place later should be able to tell that anything's down there; but you should for yourself leave some kind of marker so you can find it.

whole_word_matches.context: dang lhan cig tu dur khrod du song la der chos 'byung gru gsum gyi zur gcig nub tu bstan pa khru gang tsam brus

gru.acip: RANG NYID KHA NUB TU PHYOGS NAS 'DUG LA RANG DANG 'OG GI SINDHU RA DBYER MED DU BYAS TE BDAG BSKYED BZHIN SGRUB NAS AOm GSUM MA'I BZLAS PA BYA ZHING,
gru.wylie: rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs nas 'dug la rang dang 'og gi sindhu ra dbyer med du byas te bdag bskyed bzhin sgrub nas aoM gsum ma'i bzlas pa bya zhing
gru.english: Seat yourself now atop the hole, facing to the west.  See yourself and the sindhura powder below you as being completely one.  Practicing as you've learned from the sadhana for reaching Her, start repeating the Mantra of the Triple Om.

gru.acip: SNGAR LTAR DKYIL 'KHOR GYI DBUS SU BZHAG NAS SGRUB MCHOD BDAG 'JUG DANG BCAS PA RGYAS PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: sngar ltar dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa rgyas par bya'o
gru.english: As before then you set the container in the center of the powder mandala, then undertake an extensive version of the ritual for reaching and offering to Her, along with the practice of taking yourself into the mandala.

gru.acip: DE LTA BU DANG MA 'PHRAD KYI BAR LA NANG RE BZHIN BSGOM BZLAS LA BRTZON PAR BYA ZHING, TSES BCU MCHOD PA LA YO BYAD MED KYANG MDUN DU RDO STEGS LTA BU'I STENG DU SINDHU RA BZHAG NAS BSAM GTAN GYI SGRUB MCHOD BYA,
gru.wylie: de lta bu dang ma 'phrad kyi bar la nang re bzhin bsgom bzlas la brtson par bya zhing, tshes bcu mchod pa la yo byad med kyang mdun du rdo stegs lta bu'i steng du sindhu ra bzhag nas bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod bya
gru.english: Until such time as you do meet such a Lady, you should continue to exert yourself daily in your usual practice of meditation and recitation.  Keep up your Offering of the Tenth; if because you are now a simple wanderer you have nothing at all to make the offering with, then just set a flat piece of rock in front of you.  Set the sindhura container atop it and do the ritual for reaching Her, and all the offerings, simply with the power of your concentration.

gru.acip: DE LTA BU'I TSUL GYIS MKHA' SPYOD SGRUB PA NI GANG ZAG 'BRING PO YIN LA, TSAR CHEN GYIS, SINDHU LANGGA LI YA'I SDONG BUR BCAS, ,ZHES SOGS GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: de lta bu'i tshul gyis mkha' spyod sgrub pa ni gang zag 'bring po yin la, tshar chen gyis, sindhu langga li ya'i sdong bur bcas, ,zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: A person who works to reach the Heaven of the Angel using this method is considered one of medium capacity; Master Tsarchen describes them in the lines of His prayer that include, "May I use the sindhura / And the trunk of langali."

gru.acip: SINDHU RA NI RGYA SKAD YIN LA BOD SKAD DU LI KHRI, LANGGA NI GONG BZHIN, RO LDAN NI DUR KHROD YIN PAS DER SGRUB PA BYAS NAS PHYOGS MED KYI YUL KUN TU MNYUL BA STE, 'KHYAMS PAS GANG ZAG GI MDZOD SPUR STE,
gru.wylie: sindhu ra ni rgya skad yin la bod skad du li khri, langga ni gong bzhin, ro ldan ni dur khrod yin pas der sgrub pa byas nas phyogs med kyi yul kun tu mnyul ba ste, 'khyams pas gang zag gi mdzod spur ste
gru.english: The word "sindhura" as He uses it here in His verse is the Sanskrit, which corresponds in Tibetan to what we call li-tri, or an orange-colored powder.  When He mentions langali, it has the same meaning as we discussed above.  The "home of the dead" that Master Tsarchen speaks of is the charnel ground which we've been talking about.  First you "practice" there, and "then go wandering off,"--moving randomly--to wherever your quest may take you: to "places far and near."  And then, as He mentions, something happens between the brows of "the one."

gru.acip: GONG DU BSHAD PA'I SGRUB PA SOGS TSUL BZHIN BYA GSUNGS, MA 'GRUB NA TSE 'DIR LUS MA SPANGS PAR MKHA' SPYOD DU 'GRO MA NUS PAS DBANG PO THA MA YIN LA,
gru.wylie: gong du bshad pa'i sgrub pa sogs tshul bzhin bya gsungs, ma 'grub na tshe 'dir lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro ma nus pas dbang po tha ma yin la
gru.english: It is stated that, first of all, we should undertake a correct practice of the various methods for reaching Her which are described above.  If we are not thus able to reach Her, then we are not someone who will be able to reach the Heaven of the Angel in this life, before we relinquish our body.  That is to say, we would be classified as a practitioner of lesser capacity.

gru.acip: PHYIS YAB RKYANG LA BRTEN PA YAB BKA', YUM RKYANG LA BRTEN PA YUM BKA', YAB YUM ZHAL SBYOR LA BRTEN PA LHAN SKYES KYI 'PHO BA GSUM DU BZHED PA GANG MOS GCIG ZHAG BDUN LA SOGS PA SGRUB KHANG DANG LUS LA 'JA' ZUG PA DANG DRI ZHIM PO LANG BA DANG, SPYI BO ZA BA DANG, SNAG KHRAG 'DZAG PA LA SOGS PA'I MKHA' SPYOD GRUB PA'I RTAGS MA BYUNG GI BAR DU SBYANG ZHING DE NAS MA BRJED TZAM BYA,
gru.wylie: phyis yab rkyang la brten pa yab bka', yum rkyang la brten pa yum bka', yab yum zhal sbyor la brten pa lhan skyes kyi 'pho ba gsum du bzhed pa gang mos gcig zhag bdun la sogs pa sgrub khang dang lus la 'ja' zug pa dang dri zhim po lang ba dang, spyi bo za ba dang, snag khrag 'dzag pa la sogs pa'i mkha' spyod grub pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du sbyang zhing de nas ma brjed tsam bya
gru.english: Later on, three methods of the transfer of consciousness were recognized.  The first is the "Transfer of the Word of the Man," which is done only with the Man.  The second is the "Transfer of the Word of the Wife," done only with the Wife.  And the third is the "Transfer of the Simultaneous," performed through the kiss of the Man and the Wife together.  You can perform whichever of these that attracts you. This could involve for example a practice of seven days.  You work at it until you get signs that you are reaching the Angel's Heaven: rainbows form, with one end striking your meditation hut and your body; a special fragrance arises; you start to feel a tingling at the very tip of your head; pus and blood drip from your body, and so on.  Then stop the practice and repeat it in the future only for very brief periods so that you don't forget the various steps, and not more than that.

gru.acip: LAS LA SBYOR BA NI THOG MAR 'CHI LTAS BRTAG DGOS PAS, DE YANG 'CHI DUS RNAM SHES THON PA'I BU GA DGU YOD PA LAS, BSHANG LAM NAS THON NA DMYAL BA, DE BZHIN DU CHU LAM DUD 'GRO, KHA YI DVAGS, LTE BA 'DOD KHAMS KYI LHA, MDZOD SPU GZUGS MED KHAMS, SPYI BO GZUGS KHAMS, SNA GNOD SBYIN, RNA BA GRUB PA'I LHA, MIG MI'I RGYAL POR SKYE BAR GSUNGS PA MTSON PA TZAM YIN LA,
gru.wylie: las la sbyor ba ni thog mar 'chi ltas brtag dgos pas, de yang 'chi dus rnam shes thon pa'i bu ga dgu yod pa las, bshang lam nas thon na dmyal ba, de bzhin du chu lam dud 'gro, kha yi dvags, lte ba 'dod khams kyi lha, mdzod spu gzugs med khams, spyi bo gzugs khams, sna gnod sbyin, rna ba grub pa'i lha, mig mi'i rgyal por skye bar gsungs pa mtshon pa tsam yin la
gru.english: As for the actual sacred work here, you must first check for omens of an imminent death.  Generally speaking, there are nine different apertures of the body from which a person's consciousness may make its exit when it comes time to die.  It is said that if consciousness exits from the anus, this means that the person is going to take rebirth as a hell being.  If it exits from the orifice of urination, they are reborn as an animal; from the mouth, as a craving spirit; from the navel, as a pleasure being in the desire realm; from the spot between the eyebrows, as one in the formless realm; from the tip of the head, as one in the form realm; from the nose, as a harmful spirit; from the ears as a pleasure being of attainment; and from the eyes as a king of humankind.  These are just some of the possibilities that are mentioned.

gru.acip: DE'I NANG NAS SGO BRGYAD BKAG NAS SGO GCIG DBYE GSUNGS PA LTAR, TSANGS BUG MA GTOGS SGO BRGYAD YI GES BKAG NAS TSANGS BUG NAS THON PA 'PHO BA DANG 'BREL NA NGES PAR SNGAGS SGRUB PA'I RTEN MKHA' SPYOD DU SKYE BAR GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: de'i nang nas sgo brgyad bkag nas sgo gcig dbye gsungs pa ltar, tshangs bug ma gtogs sgo brgyad yi ges bkag nas tshangs bug nas thon pa 'pho ba dang 'brel na nges par sngags sgrub pa'i rten mkha' spyod du skye bar gsungs te
gru.english: Regarding these, the scripture says that we should "block eight of the doors and open one of them."  That is, we use sacred letters to block the eight exits other than the Opening of the Pure One at the tip of our head.  If we are able to carry out then a practice of sending our mind on where it exits from this Opening of the Pure One, then--it is stated--we will with certainty be born into the Heaven of the Angel, complete with a body and mind properly equipped for the practice of the way of the secret word.  As one text for example says:

gru.acip: ,ZHES SOGS GSUNGS PA LTAR MI DGE BA SHIN TU GSOG TSABS CHE BA'I SDIG CAN (MI PHAL PA STONG DANG 'DRA,) YANG 'PHO BA BYAS PAS MKHA' SPYOD SOGS SNGAGS SGRUB PA'I RTEN KHYAD PAR CAN THOB PAR GSUNGS PA NYAMS LEN GNAD LA 'KHEL ZHING, 'PHO BA'I DUS ZIN NA PHAN YON SHIN TU CHE BAR GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar mi dge ba shin tu gsog tshabs che ba'i sdig can (mi phal pa stong dang 'dra,) yang 'pho ba byas pas mkha' spyod sogs sngags sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can thob par gsungs pa nyams len gnad la 'khel zhing, 'pho ba'i dus zin na phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs
gru.english: The point here is that--even if you've been a particularly evil person, amassing piles of negative karma with bad deeds (such as the killing mentioned, which is like murdering a thousand regular people)--then still, it has been stated, you can attain a birth in a place such as the Angel's Heaven, and the extraordinary type of body and mind that you need to practice the way of the secret word, if you undertake the practice of sending your mind on purposely.  It is a way of focusing your practice at the most crucial points of all, and said to be of extremely great benefit should the circumstances demand such drastic action.

gru.acip: GZHUNG DU GSAL BA NI MKHA' 'GRO'I SGRA YAL BA ZHES RNA BA GNYIS BKAG PA NA 'UR SGRA MED PA DANG, NYI MA RTZE SHAR LA RGYAB BSTAN PA'I GRIB MA'I MGO BOR RLANGS PA MED PA DANG, MIG 'TSIR BAS 'OD SGOR MED PA DANG, LAG G-YAS GYI KHU TSUR DPRAL BAR BZHAG GRU MO PUS MOR BTZUGS TE MKHRIG MAR BLTAS PAS RBAD KYIS CHAD PA RNAMS GSUNGS KYANG MA NGES PA DANG,
gru.wylie: gzhung du gsal ba ni mkha' 'gro'i sgra yal ba zhes rna ba gnyis bkag pa na 'ur sgra med pa dang, nyi ma rtse shar la rgyab bstan pa'i grib ma'i mgo bor rlangs pa med pa dang, mig 'tshir bas 'od sgor med pa dang, lag g-yas gyi khu tshur dpral bar bzhag gru mo pus mor btsugs te mkhrig mar bltas pas rbad kyis chad pa rnams gsungs kyang ma nges pa dang
gru.english: Some other methods for scrying signs of death which we see descried in various texts include: �	"Loss of the sound of those who travel the sky, "which means that when we block both our ears we no longer hear any whooshing sound. �	Waiting until the tip of the sun has risen, then standing with our back to it and observing our shadow--and seeing that where the shadow of our head should be, there is none. �	Closing our eyes and pressing down on the eyelids, and observing that there are none of those little round patches of light that used to come then. �	Making our right hand into a fist, setting it against our forehead, and then propping our elbow up on our knee--next staring at our wrist and seeing if anything suddenly blacks out. None of these techniques though gives definite results.

whole_word_matches.context: r med pa dang, lag g-yas gyi khu tshur dpral bar bzhag gru mo pus mor btsugs te mkhrig mar bltas pas rbad kyis ch

gru.acip: TSE NYAMS PA GSO BA TSE DBANG TSE SGRUB SOGS BYED PA, BSOD NAMS NYAMS PA GSO BA DKON MCHOG LA MCHOD PA, NGAN SLONG LA SBYIN GTONG, LAS NYAMS PA GSO BA STONG NYID SGOM PA DANG SROG BLU SOGS LA 'BAD CING, DES KYANG MA BZLOG NA NAD LA SOGS PA MA PHOG GONG DU 'PHO BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: tshe nyams pa gso ba tshe dbang tshe sgrub sogs byed pa, bsod nams nyams pa gso ba dkon mchog la mchod pa, ngan slong la sbyin gtong, las nyams pa gso ba stong nyid sgom pa dang srog blu sogs la 'bad cing, des kyang ma bzlog na nad la sogs pa ma phog gong du 'pho bar bya'o
gru.english: In a case where your life force has declined and you seek to restore it, then you can do practices such as taking a long-life empowerment, or undertaking rituals which extend one's life.  Where your merit has declined, restore it by devoting yourself to practices such as making offerings to the Three Jewels, and making donations to the poor and needy.  If it's that your karma has declined, throw yourself into practices such as meditating on emptiness and rituals of ransoming to avert death.  If these don't work to stop the omens, then you should send your consciousness on before the sickness or whatever it will be strikes you and prevents you from doing so.

gru.acip: 'DIR 'PHO BA YOD TSUL DANG LUGS GZHAN LA MED PA'I KHYAD CHOS SHIN TU ZAB CING GSANG BAR BYA BA YIN TSUL SOGS LAS DMIGS RIM MANG PO LA MI STON PAR DON GNYER CAN MANG MTHA' GSUM LA SOGS PAR RDZOGS RIM GYI 'JA' LUS SGRUB PA'I MJUG TU GNANG ZHING MTHONG GROL DU BSDUS PAR ZHAG BCU GSUM TZAM DU GRUB PAR BYED NA SGRO 'DOGS GCOD PA'ANG DKYUS BZHIN BYAS NA MI 'GRIGS PAS BSDU LUGS SHES DGOS PA DANG,
gru.wylie: 'dir 'pho ba yod tshul dang lugs gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos shin tu zab cing gsang bar bya ba yin tshul sogs las dmigs rim mang po la mi ston par don gnyer can mang mtha' gsum la sogs par rdzogs rim gyi 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i mjug tu gnang zhing mthong grol du bsdus par zhag bcu gsum tsam du grub par byed na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'ang dkyus bzhin byas na mi 'grigs pas bsdu lugs shes dgos pa dang
gru.english: The very fact that in this tradition we do have a practice of sending the mind on is something extremely profound and secretly kept, as are the extraordinary features that distinguish it from the way the same practice is performed in other traditions.  The instructions for it are revealed without a great many complicated visualizations, and are granted for example at the very most to three sincere aspirants at a time--and at that only after they have been practicing the section of the stage of completion concerning the rainbow body.  In Freedom on Sight it states that for the abbreviated form of the practice one should only work on it for about 13 days; and that it is improper even to continue any further review of its details.  As such, one must understand how this abbreviated practice is undertaken.

gru.acip: ,LUNG RTOGS SNANG BAS MTHO BA'I GZI BYIN GYIS, ,'PHAGS YUL MKHAS GRUB MI LTUNG 'PHRENG BA'I DBUS, ,SNGON MED NYE LAM GSAL MDZAD GRUB PA'I DBANG, ,PAN CHEN N'A RO TA PAR GUS PHYAG 'TSAL,,
gru.wylie: lung rtogs snang bas mtho ba'i gzi byin gyis, ,'phags yul mkhas grub mi ltung 'phreng ba'i dbus, ,sngon med nye lam gsal mdzad grub pa'i dbang, ,pan chen nA ro ta par gus phyag 'tshal
gru.english: Ode to Naropa You are the high King of accomplished yogis You stand in the center of the great Scholars and sages from Mother India, land of the Realized Ones You elucidate this quick path as none before With a clear light raised high-- your teaching and realizations O Great Sage Narotapa I humbly bow down to You.

gru.acip: ,SKAL BZANG GDUL BYA'I GDUNG SEL TSAR PA RJE, ,GDAMS PA RGYA MTSO'I SNYING PO MA nI KAS, ,GRUB DBANG THUGS BCUD RDO RJE BTZUN MO YI, ,BLO GSAL RGYA MTSO'I ZHABS LA MGOS PHYAG 'TSAL,
gru.wylie: skal bzang gdul bya'i gdung sel tshar pa rje, ,gdams pa rgya mtsho'i snying po ma Ni kas, ,grub dbang thugs bcud rdo rje btsun mo yi, ,blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal
gru.english: Ode to Tsarchen Lord Tsarpa you clear away the torment of fortunate disciples With that precious jewel at the heart of the ocean: the advices of the Diamond Queen She who holds within Her heart the knowledge of that Lord of all yogis, Lord Buddha O Losel Gyatso I touch my head to Your holy feet

gru.acip: ,GANG DES LEGS LDAN BUNG BA'I DGA' STON DU, ,GSOL 'DEBS PADMO BZHAD MDZAD SMON LAM CHA, ,YONGS RDZOGS LAM GYI LO 'BRAS G-YUR ZA BAR, ,BSGRUBS PA'I SMON LAM TSIG DON BSHAD PAR BYA,
gru.wylie: gang des legs ldan bung ba'i dga' ston du, ,gsol 'debs padmo bzhad mdzad smon lam cha, ,yongs rdzogs lam gyi lo 'bras g-yur za bar, ,bsgrubs pa'i smon lam tshig don bshad par bya
gru.english: My Pledge to Compose the Work Lord Tsarpa's prayer, a plea for blessings, coaxes open the petals of Her lotus flower so fortunate bees can feast His prayer leads us to a tree laden with the weight of the entire path, both the leaves and the fruit And so I will undertake a word-by-word analysis of this prayer of Tsarchen

gru.acip: ,DE YANG RGYAL MCHOG LNGA PA CHEN POS, ,AA HO MA DANG MKHA' 'GRO'I ZHAL GYI RLANGS, ,MNGAR POR 'THUL 'DI N'A RO TA PA NAS, ,SNYAN BRGYUD TSAD MA BZHI LDAN 'DZIN NUS PA'I, ,MKHAS GRUB RIM PAR BRGYUD KYI GZHAN DU MIN, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: de yang rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos, ,aa ho ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi rlangs, ,mngar por 'thul 'di nA ro ta pa nas, ,snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan 'dzin nus pa'i, ,mkhas grub rim par brgyud kyi gzhan du min, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: So too, that  highest of Victors the Great Fifth Dalai Lama has stated: This sweet-smelling breath from the lips of the Angel, that Lady of Wonder, Was passed down to us through the famed lineage of Narotapa Each generation receiving the lineage from great masters Who maintained it with the four types of authority For otherwise it could never truly be passed on

gru.acip: 'PHAGS YUL GYI PAN GRUB KUN GYI NANG NAS MKHAS PA DANG GRUB PA'I YON TAN GYIS RGYAL MTSAN GYI TOG GI NOR BU RIN PO CHE LTAR MCHOG TU GYUR PA JO BO CHEN PO N'A RO TA PA'I ZHABS KYIS RJE BTZUN MA NYID LAS DNGOS SU BSAN PA'I MAN NGAG LA BRTEN NAS,
gru.wylie: 'phags yul gyi pan grub kun gyi nang nas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan gyis rgyal mtshan gyi tog gi nor bu rin po che ltar mchog tu gyur pa jo bo chen po nA ro ta pa'i zhabs kyis rje btsun ma nyid las dngos su bsan pa'i man ngag la brten nas
gru.english: Of all the great sages in ancient India, Land of the Realized Ones that high Lord Narotapa is the greatest He is the precious wish-fulfilling jewel atop a victory banner with his excellent knowledge of scripture and his high realizations Which he achieved by relying upon personal instructions from the Holy Lady Herself

gru.acip: MCHOG GTZO BOR BSGRUBS PAS MTHUN MONG ZHAR LA 'GRUB PA DMAR MO SKOR GSUM MAM MKHA' SPYOD SKOR GSUM DU GRAGS PA'I NANG TSAN,
gru.wylie: mchog gtso bor bsgrubs pas mthun mong zhar la 'grub pa dmar mo skor gsum mam mkha' spyod skor gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan
gru.english: And a section in there known as "The Three Teachings on the Crimson Lady" (also called "The Three Teachings on the Heaven of the Angel") is considered the very essence of them all By devoting yourself mainly to practicing these highest of teachings you will also along the way reach all your worldly goals.

gru.acip: LNGA PA CHEN POS, ,DBANG PO RAB 'BRING LUS 'DIS MKHA' SPYOD BGROD, ,THA MA BAR DOR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GROS BSU, ,CHES MYUR 'DA' KHA'I LAM GYIS SKAD CIG 'PHO, ,YANG THA SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS DNGOS GRUB THOB,
gru.wylie: lnga pa chen pos, ,dbang po rab 'bring lus 'dis mkha' spyod bgrod, ,tha ma bar dor dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu, ,ches myur 'da' kha'i lam gyis skad cig 'pho, ,yang tha skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub thob
gru.english: The Great Fifth also said: Those of highest and medium capacities travel to the heaven of the Angel in this very body Those of lowest capacity are embraced by Warriors and their Lady Angels in the state between their death and rebirth Or else, most quickly, they transfer their consciousness in a single instant by using the path of the hour of death And even those lower than lowest will, in a short string of rebirths reach all their goals.

gru.acip: ,CES GSUNGS PA LTAR, ZAB PA LAS KYANG CHES CHER ZAB PA'I GDAMS PA, NGES PA'I DON DU DPAL HE RU KA DANG DBYER MED CING, DRANGS DON GDUL BYA'I SNANG NGOR YANG MKHAS GRUB GNYIS LDAN GYI SKYES BU,
gru.wylie: ces gsungs pa ltar, zab pa las kyang ches cher zab pa'i gdams pa, nges pa'i don du dpal he ru ka dang dbyer med cing, drangs don gdul bya'i snang ngor yang mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu
gru.english: And verily He spoke, for These advices, which are ever so much deeper than deep came down in a pure stream of holiest Lamas Every one of Them was, in truth inseparable from the glorious Heruka But for the sake of us disciples they donned the guise of mere human masters of books and deep practice

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN YAB YUM GYIS RJES SU BZUNGS TE GRUB PA'I GO 'PHANG MTHON POR GSHEGS PA'I BLA MA DAM PA SHA STAG LAS BRGYUD PA,
gru.wylie: rje btsun yab yum gyis rjes su bzungs te grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i bla ma dam pa sha stag las brgyud pa
gru.english: Who were received by the Angel Man and Wife and thus reached exalted states of spiritual attainment

gru.acip: DE YANG BSNGO BYA'I DGE BA GANG YANG RUNG BA DMIGS YUL DU BYAS TE DE 'DI'I RGYUR 'GYUR BAR SHOG CIG SNYAM DU SMON PA NI BSNGO SMON GNYIS KA DANG, ,BSNGO BYA'I DGE BA DA MIGS YUL DU MA BYAS PAR 'DI 'GRUB PAR SHOG CIG SNYAM DU SMON PA NI, SMON LAM YIN LA BSNGO BA MIN PAR GSUNGS SO, ,DES NA BSNGO BA DANG SMON LAM GNYIS KA YIN PA DANG, SMON LAM YIN LA BSNGO BA MIN PA GNYIS YOD PA LAS 'DIR NI SNGA MA YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: de yang bsngo bya'i dge ba gang yang rung ba dmigs yul du byas te de 'di'i rgyur 'gyur bar shog cig snyam du smon pa ni bsngo smon gnyis ka dang, ,bsngo bya'i dge ba da migs yul du ma byas par 'di 'grub par shog cig snyam du smon pa ni, smon lam yin la bsngo ba min par gsungs so, ,des na bsngo ba dang smon lam gnyis ka yin pa dang, smon lam yin la bsngo ba min pa gnyis yod pa las 'dir ni snga ma yin no
gru.english: Now it has been spoken that when you bring to mind any particular good deed which you have done, and you pray by thinking to yourself, "May it act as a cause for such and such a desired result," this is both a dedication and a prayer.  But when you don't bring to mind any of your past good deeds, and you simply pray by thinking to yourself, "may such and such happen," this is a prayer but not a dedication.  So there are two kinds of prayer: the kind that is both a dedication and a prayer, and the kind that is a prayer but not a dedication, and our prayer here is the former.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NGOS BZUNG BA'I DGE BA JI LTAR BSNGO BA'I TSUL LA BZHI, LAM GYI RTZA BA BSHES GNYEN DAM PAS RJES SU 'DZIN PAR SMON PA, LAM DNGOS KYI RTOGS PA RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA, SMON LAM YONGS RDZOGS KYI DON BSDU BA, SMON LAM 'GRUB PA'I CHED BDEN TSIG BRJOD PA'O,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ngos bzung ba'i dge ba ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul la bzhi, lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin par smon pa, lam dngos kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar smon pa, smon lam yongs rdzogs kyi don bsdu ba, smon lam 'grub pa'i ched bden tshig brjod pa'o
gru.english: Now here is the actual body of the prayer, which is how to dedicate that holy deed we've just identified.  It can be divided into four sections: praying to be taken into the care of a holy spiritual guide, which is the root of the path; praying that realizations of the actual path will ripen in your mindstream; a summary of the entire prayer; and finally an act of truth so that everything we've prayed for will come about. The True Source

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, DNGOS GRUB 'BYUNG GNAS MTSAN LDAN BLA MA YIS, ,DGYES BZHIN 'BRAL MED RJES SU 'DZIN PAR SHOG, CES PAS BSTAN TE,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, dngos grub 'byung gnas mtshan ldan bla ma yis, ,dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog, ces pas bstan te
gru.english: The first of these sections, praying to be taken into the care of a holy spiritual guide, is expressed in the following lines: And I pray that by The power of this deed I may be taken Under the care Of a Lama who possesses Every qualification, for these Are the true source Of every spiritual goal And may I always please My Lama, And never be apart From Him or Her

gru.acip: MDO RGYUD DGONGS 'GREL DANG BCAS PA THAMS CAD NAS MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB SANGS RGYAS KYI GO 'PHANG DANG, MTHUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB GRUB PA CHEN PO BRGYAD DANG LAS BZHI LA SOGS PA THAMS CAD GANG LAS 'BYUNG PA'I GNAS DANG RTZA BA LTA BU NI,
gru.wylie: mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad nas mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dang, mthun mong gi dngos grub grub pa chen po brgyad dang las bzhi la sogs pa thams cad gang las 'byung pa'i gnas dang rtsa ba lta bu ni
gru.english: The teachings of the Victor, both open and secret, along with the commentaries which explain their intent, all state that there is one true source, one veritable root from which every attainment stems:  We must rely properly on a holy Lama, both in our thoughts and in our daily life activities.  This is the only way to reach both the highest type of spiritual goal--reaching the state of a Buddha, and the other, worldly type of spiritual goals--the eight great yogic powers,1 the four modes,2 and the rest.

gru.acip: DAD CING GUS PA'I SGO NAS MNYES PA SGRUB PA'I SGO GSUM DANG, KHYAD PAR BKA' BZHIN SGRUB PAR BYED PA'I SGO NAS THUGS MI DGYES PA MED PAR DGYES BZHIN DU BYANG CHEN MA THOB KYI BAR SKAD CIG KYANG 'BRAL PA MED PAR RJES SU 'DZIN PAR SHOG CIG, CES SMON PA'O,,
gru.wylie: dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas mnyes pa sgrub pa'i sgo gsum dang, khyad par bka' bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i sgo nas thugs mi dgyes pa med par dgyes bzhin du byang chen ma thob kyi bar skad cig kyang 'bral pa med par rjes su 'dzin par shog cig, ces smon pa'o
gru.english: We must come to realize the truth of this, and with faith and devotion endeavor to make our Lama happy with us, using all three doors of our body, speech, and mind.  We will especially please our Lama and never sadden Their heart if we can always do as the Lama has requested of us.  And so we are praying, "May I be able to do so."  And until we reach the exalted state of Buddhahood, we need to be taken under the care of this holiest of beings, and we must seek never to be apart from Them, even for an instant.  And so we pray, "May I make this happen." The Path

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, ,DAL 'BYOR GRU CHEN MI RTAG DRAN PA YI, ,BA DAN DKAR PO BSKYOD PA LAS 'BRAS KYI, ,BLANG DOR MTHUN PA'I RLUNG GIS RAB BSKUL NAS, ,'JIGS RUNG 'KHOR BA'I MTSO LAS SGROL BAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, ,dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las 'bras kyi, ,blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas, ,'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog
gru.english: The first step is found in these lines of prayer: And by the power Of this deed May I board the great ship Of spiritual leisure and fortune; May I set the white sails Of constantly remembering My own impermanence, And thus see the ship stir forth; May the fair winds Of my careful observance Of the laws of karma And its consequences Then fill the sails And drive us all Across the terror of this sea, The cycle of pain we live in.

whole_word_matches.context: dang po ni, ,dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi, ,ba dan dkar po bskyod pa las

gru.acip: CES PA STE, CHOS BYED PA'I LONG MED PA'I 'GAL RKYEN DMYAL SOGS MI KHOM PA'I GNAS BRGYAD DANG BRAL ZHING, MTHUN RKYEN RANG 'BYOR LNGA DANG GZHAN 'BYOR LNGA DNGOS DANG CHA 'DRA CI RIGS PA'I SGO NAS TSANG BA'I RANG CAG RNAMS KYIS THOB PA'I DAL 'BYOR GYI RTEN, RNYED PAR DKA' ZHING RNYED NA GNAS SKABS DANG MTHAR THUG GI 'DOD DON THAMS CAD SGRUB NUS PA RGYA MTSOR 'JUG PA'I GRU GZINGS CHEN PO DANG 'DRA BA 'DI NYID,
gru.wylie: ces pa ste, chos byed pa'i long med pa'i 'gal rkyen dmyal sogs mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral zhing, mthun rkyen rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga dngos dang cha 'dra ci rigs pa'i sgo nas tshang ba'i rang cag rnams kyis thob pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten, rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub nus pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings chen po dang 'dra ba 'di nyid
gru.english: In order to attain a body and mind of spiritual leisure and fortune, first of all we must be free of the eight states of having no opportunity for spiritual practice,5 which would be for instance taking a birth in one of the hells.  After that, we need to acquire the ten conducive conditions--those five which relate to ourselves,6 and those five which relate to the world around us7--either in their exact forms or some close approximation.  Then we have a great ship to take us across the sea; for when we are able to find these rare conditions, we gain the power to actualize our every wish, from the smallest up to the ultimate.

whole_word_matches.context: 'dod don thams cad sgrub nus pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings chen po dang 'dra ba 'di nyid

gru.acip: LAS DGE BA BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS 'BRAS BU BDE BA KHO NA DANG, MI DGE BA BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS 'BRAS BU SDUG BSNGAL KHO NA 'BYUNG BA SOGS LA NGES SHES SGO DU MA NAS DRANGS TE SDIG PA PHRA MO NAS SPONG BA DANG, DGE BA PHRA MA NAS SGRUB PA'I BLANG DOR MA 'CHOL BA'I MTHUN PA'I RLUNG GIS RAB TU BSKUL BA LA BRTEN NAS,
gru.wylie: las dge ba byas pa la brten nas 'bras bu bde ba kho na dang, mi dge ba byas pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na 'byung ba sogs la nges shes sgo du ma nas drangs te sdig pa phra mo nas spong ba dang, dge ba phra ma nas sgrub pa'i blang dor ma 'chol ba'i mthun pa'i rlung gis rab tu bskul ba la brten nas
gru.english: Next we must come to understand the laws of karma from both perspectives:  if you do good things, the consequences of those actions can only bring you happiness; if you do harmful things, the consequences of those actions will only bring you pain.  With the fair winds of our clear and careful observance of these laws, we will stop even the subtlest of negative actions and we we'll carry out even the smallest of virtues, and thus fill the sails.

gru.acip: SEMS CAN DE RNAMS KYI BDE SDUG BSGRUB SEL BYA BA'I DON DU BDAG GIS SANGS RGYAS KYI GO 'PHANG THOB PAR BYA'O SNYAM DU SMON PA DANG 'JUG PA'I BDAG NYID CAN GYI BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS KYI GO CHA BTZAN PO BGOS TE,
gru.wylie: sems can de rnams kyi bde sdug bsgrub sel bya ba'i don du bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems kyi go cha btsan po bgos te
gru.english: This decision to reach the matchless state of Buddhahood in order to destroy the sufferings of these other beings, and to bring them to happiness, is how we don the sturdy armor of the Wish for enlightenment, both as a sincere intention and in our everyday actions.

gru.acip: DANG PO LA GNYIS, BSKYED RIM GYI LAM RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA DANG, BSKYED RIM GYI 'BRAS BU 'GRUB PAR SMON PA'O,,
gru.wylie: dang po la gnyis, bskyed rim gyi lam rgyud la skye bar smon pa dang, bskyed rim gyi 'bras bu 'grub par smon pa'o
gru.english: The first of these divisions again has two steps: praying that the path of the stage of creation develops in our minds, and then praying that we achieve the goals of the stage of creation.

gru.acip: CES PA STE, DE YANG, RJE BDAG NYID CHEN POS, DE TSE DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS 'GRUB PA'I GZHI, ,RNAM DAG DAM TSIG SDOM PAR GSUNGS PA LA, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR, DBANG THOB PA'I RJES SU LAM RIM PA GNYIS LA NYAMS LEN CHER MA BYUNG YANG, DAM SDOM SPYI DANG KHYAD PAR RTZA LTUNG GIS MA GOS NA NGAN SONG DU RDOG PAS PHUL YANG MI 'GRO ZHING MA THA SKYE BA BCU DRUG TSUN LA MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB THOB PA YIN TE,
gru.wylie: ces pa ste, de yang, rje bdag nyid chen pos, de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi, ,rnam dag dam tshig sdom par gsungs pa la, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar, dbang thob pa'i rjes su lam rim pa gnyis la nyams len cher ma byung yang, dam sdom spyi dang khyad par rtsa ltung gis ma gos na ngan song du rdog pas phul yang mi 'gro zhing ma tha skye ba bcu drug tshun la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin te
gru.english: Now as that highest Lord himself told us:  "It has been spoken that at this point (after receiving the empowerment) the cause of reaching both types of spiritual goals is keeping your pledges and vows pure."  And it is just as Je Tsongkapa has said.  Even if we find ourselves unable to put the path--the two stages--into practice very well, we still must keep all our pledges and vows, especially the root vows. If we do keep our vows, then even if we have done the best things we could do to send ourselves to one of the lower realms, we won't end up there.  The very worst that could happen is that within sixteen lives we reach the highest goal.  This is just as Master Vibhuti Chandra has stated:

gru.acip: BI BHU TIS, ,MA BSGOMS GYUR KYANG LTUNG MED NA, ,SKYE BA BCU DRUG DAG NA 'GRUB, ,CES GSUNGS LA,
gru.wylie: bi bhu tis, ,ma bsgoms gyur kyang ltung med na, ,skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub, ,ces gsungs la
gru.english: Even should they fail to meditate, A person will reach the goal Within the length of sixteen lives, So long as a downfall has not occurred.

gru.acip: DES NA DBANG RNAM PAR DAG PA THOB PA DE'I TSE BLA MA LHA'I SPYAN SNGAR KHAS BLANGS SHING MNOS PA'I DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA TSUL BZHIN DU SRUNG BA MCHOG DANG MTHUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS 'GRUB PA'I GZHI YIN PAR RGYUD DANG GRUB CHEN GYI GZHUNG LAS GSUNGS PA LA, BCOS MIN GYI NGES SHES RNYED NAS DRAN SHES BAG DANG LDAN PAS MIG GI 'BRAS BU BZHIN DU BSRUNG BA DANG,
gru.wylie: des na dbang rnam par dag pa thob pa de'i tshe bla ma lha'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing mnos pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du srung ba mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi yin par rgyud dang grub chen gyi gzhung las gsungs pa la, bcos min gyi nges shes rnyed nas dran shes bag dang ldan pas mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba dang
gru.english: Now it was then--at that time when we received our pure empowerment--that we stood in the presence of our Lama, the Holy Angel, and promised Her, swore to Her, to protect our pledges and our vows properly.  For it has been stated in both the root tantras and in the great works of the Accomplished Ones that this is the basis of achieving the two type of spiritual goals--those worldly goals, and the highest goal.  We must come to understand in our hearts that this is true.  Then we will be able to protect our vows as well as we would shield our eyes from something that would harm them, by maintaining our recollection and awareness, and by acting with care. Sleeping

gru.acip: DE'I SGO NAS LAM NYAMS SU LEN PA LA YANG, PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA BSKYED RIM GYI RNAL 'BYOR DANG, NANG GI MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA RDZOGS RIM GYI RNAL 'BYOR GNYIS LAS 'PHAGS PA KLUS,
gru.wylie: de'i sgo nas lam nyams su len pa la yang, phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor dang, nang gi mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gnyis las 'phags pa klus
gru.english: As for actually putting the path into practice, the deep practices of the stage of creation are primarily for reaching Her outer heaven, whereas the deep practices of the stage of completion are mainly for reaching Her inner heaven,  As the Realized One, Nagarjuna, has stated:

gru.acip: DANG PO NYAL BA'I RNAL 'BYOR NI, 'DI NYID SPYOD LAM GYI RNAL 'BYOR GYI NANG TSAN YIN KYANG, 'DIR THOG MAR 'BYUNG BA NI GONG MA RNAMS RNAL 'BYOR SGOM PA LA LDANG DGOS SHING, DE'I SNGON DU NYAL DGOS PAS THOG MAR BYUNG BAR GSUNGS LA, GZHAN YANG GRUB CHEN L'U AI PAS,
gru.wylie: dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni, 'di nyid spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi nang tshan yin kyang, 'dir thog mar 'byung ba ni gong ma rnams rnal 'byor sgom pa la ldang dgos shing, de'i sngon du nyal dgos pas thog mar byung bar gsungs la, gzhan yang grub chen lU ai pas
gru.english: We see here that the deep practice of sleeping comes first.  In actuality, this practice is part of the deep practice of everyday life, so why is it mentioned at the very beginning?  It has been spoken by the sages of old that it should be so.  This is because in order to engage in any deep practice at all, you must first wake up--and to wake up, you must first be asleep!  Moreover, the Accomplished Luyipa has stated:

gru.acip: DUS DE SNANG STONG GNYIS LAS STONG PA DANG, THABS SHES GNYIS LAS SHES RAB KYI DUS YIN CING, STONG PHYOGS SHES RAB KYI CHA 'OD GSAL BSGRUB TSUL MA RGYUD SPYI'I BSTAN BYA'I GTZO BO YIN PAS, THOG MA'I DUS DE NAS BRTZAM NA YE SHES DE MYUR DU RGYUD LA SKYE BA'I RTEN 'BREL GYI GNAD YOD PA DANG, RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO LAS,
gru.wylie: dus de snang stong gnyis las stong pa dang, thabs shes gnyis las shes rab kyi dus yin cing, stong phyogs shes rab kyi cha 'od gsal bsgrub tshul ma rgyud spyi'i bstan bya'i gtso bo yin pas, thog ma'i dus de nas brtsam na ye shes de myur du rgyud la skye ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yod pa dang, rdo rje mkha' 'gro las
gru.english: Now when we speak of the pair of appearances and emptiness, night is the time of emptiness.  When we talk of the pair of method and wisdom, night is the time of wisdom.  And the main teaching of all the Mother Tantras is this wisdom half of things, the side of emptiness--how to achieve the clear light.  So if we want to develop wisdom quickly in our minds, the key is getting off to a good start, by making this time the first deep practice.  As it says in the Diamond Sky Dancer:

gru.acip: ,YUL 'DI RNAMS KYI BU MO GANG, ,SGRUB PA PO LA DNGOS GRUB STER, ,RTAG TU MTSAN MO 'PHYAN PA DANG, ,RTAG TU MTSAN MO 'DU BAR BYED, ,MKHA' SPYOD SHIN TU RNYED DKA' BA'I, ,DNGOS GRUB CHEN PO STER BAR 'GYUR, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang, ,sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster, ,rtag tu mtshan mo 'phyan pa dang, ,rtag tu mtshan mo 'du bar byed, ,mkha' spyod shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i, ,dngos grub chen po ster bar 'gyur, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar
gru.english: The women of these lands Grant the seekers their attainments. Always do They roam at night, Always do They meet at night; They bestow the highest goal Of reaching Her sweet heaven-- So difficult to find.

gru.acip: PHYI ROL GYI MKHA' 'GRO MA RNAMS MTSAN MO'I DUS SU LHAG PAR RGYU PA'I GNAD KYIS DUS DER THOG MA BRTZAM NA MKHA' SPYOD KYI DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB SLA BA'I DGOS PA YOD PAR YANG GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: phyi rol gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams mtshan mo'i dus su lhag par rgyu pa'i gnad kyis dus der thog ma brtsam na mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub 'grub sla ba'i dgos pa yod par yang gsungs so
gru.english: The fact that these Lady Angels, these outer Vajra Yoginis, are much more inclined to do their holy activities at night is a crucial point for us.  For it means that if we wish to accomplish all our goals easily, then we must begin our practice at Her time.  Thus it has been spoken.

gru.acip: SBYANG GZHI SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN 'JIG PA DANG GCUD KYI SEMS CAN 'CHI BA DANG CHOS MTHUN ZHING, THA MAL BA'I GNYID RANG DGA' BA SBYONG BYED NYAL BA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYIS BDE STONG DU BSGYUR BAS LAM DUS SU GNYID CHOS SKUR BSRE BA LA PHAN CHE ZHING, DPE DON GYI 'OD GSAL 'GRUB PA'I DGE RTZA SMIN BYED DANG, SBYANGS 'BRAS CHOS SKU 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang gcud kyi sems can 'chi ba dang chos mthun zhing, tha mal ba'i gnyid rang dga' ba sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bde stong du bsgyur bas lam dus su gnyid chos skur bsre ba la phan che zhing, dpe don gyi 'od gsal 'grub pa'i dge rtsa smin byed dang, sbyangs 'bras chos sku 'grub par gsungs so
gru.english: When we fall asleep, it is akin to the experience of death (for the beings who inhabit the world), or to the destruction of the world (the things which they inhabit)--those two things we need to purify.  And in the deep practice of sleep at this stage, on the path, we start by purifying the habit of just unthinkingly falling asleep, and also our tendency to think of sleep as something ordinary.  Sleep, and its two sisters, are transformed into bliss and emptiness. This method is also very helpful in the practice of mixing sleep with the emptiness body of a Buddha.  For it is said that this practice acts to ripen the virtue at the very core of our being, thus enabling us to achieve both the approximate and the actual clear light.  And the end result of all this purifying is that we actually attain the emptiness body of a Buddha.

gru.acip: AOm A'A: H'Um BRJOD BZHIN DU G-YON PA'I MTHEB SRIN GYIS LAG MTHIL G-YAS PAR CHOS 'BYUNG GRU GSUM RTZE MO RANG LA BSTAN PA MDUN NAS G-YON SKOR DU BRIS PA'I DBUS NAS BDE STONG GI RANG BZHIN GYI BDUD RTZI'I SNYING PO BLANGS TE LCE STENG DU MYANGS PAS BDUD RTZIS LUS GANG, SDIG LTUNG DAG,
gru.wylie: aoM a'a: hUM brjod bzhin du g-yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lag mthil g-yas par chos 'byung gru gsum rtse mo rang la bstan pa mdun nas g-yon skor du bris pa'i dbus nas bde stong gi rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i snying po blangs te lce steng du myangs pas bdud rtsis lus gang, sdig ltung dag
gru.english: Then with the ring finger and thumb of your left hand, draw a dharma-star triangle on the palm of your right hand while saying Om Ah Huung.  The point of the triangle should face you, and you should draw it in a counter-clockwise direction. Now from the center of this triangle take the essence of the nectar--that which has the nature of bliss and emptiness, and place it on the tip of your tongue.  By thus enjoying the nectar, the nectar fills your whole body, and all your bad deeds and moral downfalls are purified.

The Refuge That Cannot Fail

gru.acip: DE YANG, MAR GYUR 'GRO BA'I ZHES SOGS KYIS THOG MA MED PA NAS DRIN GYIS BSKYANGS PA'I MAR GYUR PA'I 'GRO BA THAMS CAD KYI GTAN GYI BDE BA SGRUB PA DANG SDUG BSNGAL SEL BA'I DON CHEN PO BDAG KHO NAS BYA SNYAM PA SNYING LA ZHUGS PA GZHAN DON DON GNYER DANG,
gru.wylie: de yang, mar gyur 'gro ba'i zhes sogs kyis thog ma med pa nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi gtan gyi bde ba sgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i don chen po bdag kho nas bya snyam pa snying la zhugs pa gzhan don don gnyer dang
gru.english: Now for the line of prayer which includes "all mother beings."  When this thought enters into our hearts: I myself will undertake the purpose of greatest good; I will bestow ultimate happiness upon all living beings and cast away their every pain, for these are the kind mothers who have nurtured and protected me--this is the desire to live for the sake of others.

gru.acip: RDOR SEMS SGOM BZLAS NI, LCANG SKYA'I DGONGS PA BZHIN GZHUNG DU BDE MCHOG LTAR BYA'O GSUNGS KYANG, SGRUB THABS DNGOS GZHI NYUNG NGU LA YAN LAG RGYAS PA SKABS SU MI BABS PAR DGONGS NAS PHYAG BZHES LA T'A RA N'A THA'I GSUNG RJE NYID KYI TSEMS BU DMAR KHRID DU GSAL BA LTAR MDZAD LA,
gru.wylie: rdor sems sgom bzlas ni, lcang skya'i dgongs pa bzhin gzhung du bde mchog ltar bya'o gsungs kyang, sgrub thabs dngos gzhi nyung ngu la yan lag rgyas pa skabs su mi babs par dgongs nas phyag bzhes la tA ra nA tha'i gsung rje nyid kyi tshems bu dmar khrid du gsal ba ltar mdzad la
gru.english: Now here is the meditation and recitation of the Warrior of Diamond.  As it is stated in the text, Changkya Rinpoche intended that we follow the version of Highest Bliss.  However, since there is little description of this in the actual ritual text (because it is not the right place for a lengthy descriptions), we do our actual practice as it was described by Taranatha, and made clear in the instruction manual of the Tailor24 by Lord Tsongkapa himself.

gru.acip: DE GNYIS LA BRTEN PA'I DNGOS GRUB BSGRUB TSUL LA MI 'DRA BA'I ZAB KHYAD GSUNGS PA YANG GTAN NAS MED PAR MA ZAD, RDO RJE CHOS KYI RNAM PAR BSGOM NA DE NYID GSUNG RDO RJE'I RANG BZHIN YIN PAS GDUL BYA'I RGYUD LA BLA MA'I GSUNG GIS PHAN THOGS CHE BA'I RTEN 'BREL YOD PAR GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: de gnyis la brten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub tshul la mi 'dra ba'i zab khyad gsungs pa yang gtan nas med par ma zad, rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bsgom na de nyid gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pas gdul bya'i rgyud la bla ma'i gsung gis phan thogs che ba'i rten 'brel yod par gsungs te
gru.english: Now some people have said that the method of reaching our goals by relying on these two is not similar--that there is a distinction in the depth of the practices; however, this is totally untrue.  In fact, it has been stated that any form of Dharma of Diamond that we meditate on is of the nature of diamond speech,26 which plants a very strong seed for getting the holy speech of the Lama to enter into a student's mind.

gru.acip: BYAMS PA CHOS LEGS KYI SGRUB THABS LAS KYANG, RTZA BA'I BLA MA DE NYID RJE BTZUN RDO RJE CHOS KYI RNAM PA CAN DU BSGOM PA DE LA'O,,
gru.wylie: byams pa chos legs kyi sgrub thabs las kyang, rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bsgom pa de la'o
gru.english: So too, in his ritual text for reaching the Angel, Jampa Chulek states: "For this practice, meditate on your one and only Root Lama, in the form of the holy Dharma of Diamond.

gru.acip: KHA CIG 'DIR RDO RJE CHOS RDO RJE DANG DRIL BU 'DZIN PA DE BSGOM PAR BSHAD YOD KYANG, DE MTHUN MONG BA'I SKABS YIN PAS PHYAG LEN MTHUN MONG MA YIN BA BZHIN BSGOM GSUNGS, RNAM PA RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM PA NI GSUNG GI DNGOS GRUB STZOL BA'I RTEN 'BREL LO, ,ZHES GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: kha cig 'dir rdo rje chos rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa de bsgom par bshad yod kyang, de mthun mong ba'i skabs yin pas phyag len mthun mong ma yin ba bzhin bsgom gsungs, rnam pa rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ni gsung gi dngos grub stsol ba'i rten 'brel lo, ,zhes gsungs
gru.english: "Some have said of this Dharma of Diamond that we should see Him holding a diamond and bell; however, this is the custom in the treatises of the shared method, and it has been stated that we should meditate in the unique way.  But if we meditate on any form of Dharma of Diamond, it is a cause for receiving the attainments of enlightened speech."

gru.acip: DE SKABS ZHAL SHES GSUM GA NYAMS SU LEN PA'I DON MIN NAM SNYAM STE, DE LTAR BYAS NA RDZOGS RIM GYI SKABS SU NYAMS SU BLANG BYA NI BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG BAR GRAGS PA 'DI YIN LA, BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG MA YIN PAR GRAGS PA NI PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA LANGGA LI YA'I SGRUB PA SOGS BSKYED RIM DANG 'GREL BA'I NYAMS SU BLANG BYA YIN PAS BLO RMONGS BDAG LTA BUR CUNG ZAD GO MI BDE BA MCHIS SO,,
gru.wylie: de skabs zhal shes gsum ga nyams su len pa'i don min nam snyam ste, de ltar byas na rdzogs rim gyi skabs su nyams su blang bya ni bsam mi khyab mthun mong bar grags pa 'di yin la, bsam mi khyab mthun mong ma yin par grags pa ni phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa langga li ya'i sgrub pa sogs bskyed rim dang 'grel ba'i nyams su blang bya yin pas blo rmongs bdag lta bur cung zad go mi bde ba mchis so
gru.english: However, it doesn't seem to me that all three of these instructions were meant to be put into practice at that time.  If that were the case, then instead of putting into practice that which is carried out during the stage of completion--the practice called the shared inconceivable--we would be doing the practice known as the unique inconceivable, which is connected with the stage of creation, and used mainly for reaching outer heaven, like those practices such as Langali.  And to a mind as dull as mine, this wouldn't make much sense. _______________

gru.acip: 'DU SHES GSUM PA ZHES PA BZA' BTUNG BYED PA, NYAL BA, BSHANG LCI 'DOR BA GSUM LAS GZHAN GANG YANG MI BYED PA NGAN PA'I TSAD LTA BU LA ZER BAS, 'DIR YANG PHYI'I SNANG TSUL MKHAS PA DANG GRUB PA'I TSUL YANG MI BYED, KHA 'DON PHYAG MCHOD SOGS KYANG MI BYED PAR NYIN MTSAN KHOR MAR NYAL NAS SDOD PA LTA BU LA,
gru.wylie: 'du shes gsum pa zhes pa bza' btung byed pa, nyal ba, bshang lci 'dor ba gsum las gzhan gang yang mi byed pa ngan pa'i tshad lta bu la zer bas, 'dir yang phyi'i snang tshul mkhas pa dang grub pa'i tshul yang mi byed, kha 'don phyag mchod sogs kyang mi byed par nyin mtshan khor mar nyal nas sdod pa lta bu la
gru.english: That saying "Mr. Three Thoughts" refers to eating & drinking, sleeping, and relieving one's bowels.  It is like the measure of a sloth--anyone who does nothing other than those three things.  And here too, the way it appears on the outside, the person is not acting like a great scholar or meditator, and they are not engaging in the practices of recitation, prostrations, or making offerings; instead, day and night around the clock they are just lazing around.

gru.acip: MAndAL GANG 'GRUB 'BUL GSUNGS PA, GRANGS GSOG BYED NA THOG MAR TSOM BU SO BDUN MA TSAR GCIG DANG, DE NAS TSOM BU BDUN MA LA GRANGS BSAGS NAS MJUG TU TSOM BU NYER GSUM MA TSAR GCIG 'BUL,
gru.wylie: maNDal gang 'grub 'bul gsungs pa, grangs gsog byed na thog mar tshom bu so bdun ma tshar gcig dang, de nas tshom bu bdun ma la grangs bsags nas mjug tu tshom bu nyer gsum ma tshar gcig 'bul
gru.english: It has been said, "Perform as many secret world offerings as you are able."  If you are aiming for a certain number of them, first do one round of the offering in 37 piles, then while you are repeating them to reach a certain number, perform the offering in seven piles, and then at the end do one round of the offering in 23 piles.

gru.acip: DE LAS KYANG RNAL 'BYOR MA RGYUD KYI SKABS SU PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO LHAN CIG SKYES PA'I YE SHES DANG, STONG PA NYID DBYER MI PHYED PA'I SGO NAS DE KHO NA NYID LA 'JUG PA RGYAL BA'I THUGS CHOS SKU 'GRUB PA'I RIGS 'DRA'I RGYU STONG PHYOGS SHES RAB 'OD GSAL BSGRUB TSUL RTZAL DU BTON NAS 'CHAD PA LAS,
gru.wylie: de las kyang rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi skabs su phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang, stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i sgo nas de kho na nyid la 'jug pa rgyal ba'i thugs chos sku 'grub pa'i rigs 'dra'i rgyu stong phyogs shes rab 'od gsal bsgrub tshul rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa las
gru.english: When speaking of this pair of winds and mind in the context of the secret teaching of the Angel of Diamond, we explain it by emphasizing the emptiness side of things--the side of wisdom, the way to attain the clear light.  And that wisdom is the cause which creates the concordant result of attaining the dharma body--the holy heart of the Victorious Ones--by entering into a state of thusness, the Great Seal, through the inseparable pair of spontaneous wisdom and emptiness.

gru.acip: SNANG PHYOGS THABS KYI CHA SGYU MA'I SKU BSGRUB TSUL RTZAL DU BTON NAS MI 'CHAD PA'I GNAD KYIS SBYANG GZHI'I RLUNG GI LDOG CHA NAS MI 'CHAD PAR SEMS KYI LDOG CHA NAS 'CHAD PA YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: snang phyogs thabs kyi cha sgyu ma'i sku bsgrub tshul rtsal du bton nas mi 'chad pa'i gnad kyis sbyang gzhi'i rlung gi ldog cha nas mi 'chad par sems kyi ldog cha nas 'chad pa yin no
gru.english: The point is, we don't explain the ultimate basis by emphasizing the appearance side of things--the side of method, the way to attain the holy body of illusion--which would be isolating the wind half of the basis to be transformed; we explain it by isolating the half of mind.

gru.acip: RANG SEMS LHAN CIG SKYES PA GSAL ZHING STONG PA DE GSANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG, DE'I RTEN 'BREL GYIS LTE BA'I DBU MAR RO RKYANG GIS 'KHYUD PA'I NANG GI DBYIBS GRU GSUM AE YIG DANG, DE'I NANG DU KHAMS DMAR PO NYIS DVANGS KYI GSUM DVANGS AA THUNG SHAD KYI RNAM PA TZAN NAM, LUGS 'DIR PHAG MO TI LA KA ZHES PA BAm YIG ZLUM PO'I RNAM PAR YOD PA NI NANG GI RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG,
gru.wylie: rang sems lhan cig skyes pa gsal zhing stong pa de gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma dang, de'i rten 'brel gyis lte ba'i dbu mar ro rkyang gis 'khyud pa'i nang gi dbyibs gru gsum ae yig dang, de'i nang du khams dmar po nyis dvangs kyi gsum dvangs aa thung shad kyi rnam pa tsan nam, lugs 'dir phag mo ti la ka zhes pa baM yig zlum po'i rnam par yod pa ni nang gi rnal 'byor ma dang
gru.english: With the blessing of its presence, then inside the central channel at the navel, where the taste and solitary channels are entwined around it, is an eh letter29 in the shape of a triangle.  Inside of this triangle is the essence of the essence of the red element, refined yet again into pure essence.  It is in the shape of a short ah, which looks like a Tibetan punctuation mark at the end of a line of verse: k30.  In this system it is called the "drop of the Sow," and it takes the form of a rounded v letter31--this is the inner Angel.

gru.acip: 'ON KYANG 'OD GSAL LHAN CIG SKYES PA DE NYID 'KHOR BA'I RTZA BA BDAG 'DZIN DANG 'DZIN STANGS DNGOS 'GAL DU BZHUGS PA MIN PAS DE TZAM GYIS 'KHOR BA LAS MI GROL TE, MGON PO KLU SGRUB KYIS,
gru.wylie: 'on kyang 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa de nyid 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du bzhugs pa min pas de tsam gyis 'khor ba las mi grol te, mgon po klu sgrub kyis
gru.english: However, this inborn clear light by itself does not stand in direct opposition to the root of the cycle of suffering--our tendency to hold to a self-nature of objects we perceive.  And thus with only this we will not be freed from the cycle of suffering.  As the master Arya Nagarjuna has stated:

gru.acip: DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI BAm YIG DE NYID JE JER SONG STE ZHES PA NAS YE SHES KYI ME 'BAR BA'I DBUS NA BZHUGS PA'O ZHES PA'I BAR TE,

gru.english: This is the part in the ritual text starting from the line "This very letter vam grows larger and larger," up to "and I stand in the midst of a blazing fire of knowledge."

gru.acip: SNGAGS BLA MED KYI GDUL BYA'I GTZO BO TSE GCIG LA SANGS RGYAS SGRUB PA'I RTEN LA NI 'DZAM BU GLING PA'I MI MNGAL SKYES KHAMS DRUG LDAN PA DBANG PO GNYIS SBYOR GYI BDE BA LAM DU BYED NUS PA'I DBANG RNON ZHIG DGOS PA LAS,
gru.wylie: sngags bla med kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo tshe gcig la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rten la ni 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan pa dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed nus pa'i dbang rnon zhig dgos pa las
gru.english: And why is this the case?  Well, primary aspirants for the unsurpassed secret teaching have the foundation they need to achieve enlightenment in a single lifetime: they are human beings living on the Jambu continent; they have been born from a womb; their bodies possess the six elements; they can experience the bliss of joining together the two sexual organs; and they have an intellect sharp enough to be able to use this bliss as a path.

gru.acip: DES NA 'DZAM BU GLING PA'I MI MNGAL SKYES KHAMS DRUG LDAN PA SGRUB PA PO RANG NYID LA MA 'ONGS PA NA 'BYUNG RGYU'I 'CHI BA BAR DO SKYE BA GSUM SKABS 'DI'I SBYANG GZHI YIN LA,
gru.wylie: des na 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan pa sgrub pa po rang nyid la ma 'ongs pa na 'byung rgyu'i 'chi ba bar do skye ba gsum skabs 'di'i sbyang gzhi yin la
gru.english: And this aspirant who is human, living on the Jambu continent, born from a womb, and possessing the six elements is our own self, whose imminent death, in-between state, and rebirth are the three original states to be transformed at this point in time. ...oooOOOooo...

gru.acip: 'DZIN STANGS CHOS THAMS CAD RANG GI BLOS BTAGS PA TZAM LAS RANG NGOS NAS BDEN PAR GRUB PA RDUL TZAM YANG MED PAR NGES PA'I YUL CAN BDE BA CHEN PO DANG YUL STONG PA NYID GNYIS GNYIS SNANG PHRA MOS KYANG BAR MA CHOD PAR CHU LA CHU BZHAG PA BZHIN DU GYUR PA DANG,
gru.wylie: 'dzin stangs chos thams cad rang gi blos btags pa tsam las rang ngos nas bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med par nges pa'i yul can bde ba chen po dang yul stong pa nyid gnyis gnyis snang phra mos kyang bar ma chod par chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du gyur pa dang
gru.english: Third, how we interpret the object is that every existing thing is nothing more than a label created by our own mind--there is not even an atom's worth of ultimate existence from its own side. The greatest bliss is our subject state of mind, and emptiness is its object.  And this pair of subject and object become like water poured into water--they are unable to be divided, even in a subtle form, into an appearance as two.

gru.acip: DE BZHIN DU TSAR CHEN GYI MKHA' SPYOD BSGRUB PA'I NYE LAM LAS, BAm YIG BRIS PA'I MTHAR MDUN NAS G-YON SKOR GYIS AOm GSUM MA'I SNGAGS 'PHRENG MGO PHYIR BSTAN KHOR YUG TU BRIS, DE YANG AOm GSUM, DE'I RJES SU SARBA, ZHES PA NAS, SV'A H'A RNAMS RIM PA BZHIN DU BRI BA MA RTOGS 'BRU RE RE NAS LDOG BAR MI MDZAD, CES PA'I BAR DANG, 'DI LA SHAR DRANG POR AOm DANG, ZHES PA NAS, LHOR N'I BRIS NA CHA SNYOM PAR 'GYUR RO, ,ZHES PA'I BAR SNGA MA DANG KHYAD PAR GTAN NAS MED PAR GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: de bzhin du tshar chen gyi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nye lam las, baM yig bris pa'i mthar mdun nas g-yon skor gyis aoM gsum ma'i sngags 'phreng mgo phyir bstan khor yug tu bris, de yang aoM gsum, de'i rjes su sarba, zhes pa nas, svA hA rnams rim pa bzhin du bri ba ma rtogs 'bru re re nas ldog bar mi mdzad, ces pa'i bar dang, 'di la shar drang por aoM dang, zhes pa nas, lhor nI bris na cha snyom par 'gyur ro, ,zhes pa'i bar snga ma dang khyad par gtan nas med par gsungs
gru.english: In the same way, he says, Lord Tsarchen in his Quick Path for Reaching Heaven states: After drawing the vam letter, draw the string of secret words of the Triple Om in a counter-clockwise way, starting in front with the letters facing outside and circling around the edge.  So first come the three Oms.  After this comes the Sarva... And he continues up to: Sva Ha, drawing them in groups like this, but without turning each separate letter around backwards. Then he goes on to say: And if the Om is drawn straight to the East, and... And he continues this up to: ...and the Ni drawn straight to the South, it will come out in equally-divided segments. And these statements by Lord Tsarchen, he concludes, are not in any way different from the previous quotation.

gru.acip: GONG DU CHA SNYOM TSUL GSUNGS PA YANG CHA SHIN TU MI SNYOM PAR 'GYUR TE ,BYANG SHAR LA, 7 NUB BYANG LA, 4 LHO NUB LA, 8 SHAR LHOR SROG LDAN, 9 DANG, PHAt BKRAL NA, 12 'BYUNG BA MNGON SUM GYIS GRUB PAS,
gru.wylie: gong du cha snyom tshul gsungs pa yang cha shin tu mi snyom par 'gyur te ,byang shar la, 7 nub byang la, 4 lho nub la, 8 shar lhor srog ldan, 9 dang, phaT bkral na, 12 'byung ba mngon sum gyis grub pas
gru.english: Also when you apply to this pair system the method which we stated above for making equal-proportioned segments, it comes out in extremely unequal segments: we can see with direct and valid perception that, counting all the components with their own vowels, you'd have seven to the northeast, four to the northwest, eight to the southwest, and nine (or if you separate the Phet then twelve) to the southeast.

gru.acip: BZHI DANG DGU SOGS MANG NYUNG CHA MI SNYOM PA MNAG RDZI RGAN POS KYANG RTOGS NA, MKHAS SHING GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG TSAR CHEN YAB SRAS LA LONG BA'I 'KHAR BA LTAR GAR 'DZUGS MED PA'I 'KHRUL PA DE 'DRA RMI LAM DU YANG 'BYUNG BA MI SRID, DES NA DE DAG LA GZU BO'I BLOS LEGS PAR BRTAGS SHING DPYAD NA YI GE GNYIS RE MA LDOG PAR 'DRI BA TSAR CHEN YAB SRAS SOGS KYI DGONGS PA MIN PAR 'GRUB BO,,
gru.wylie: bzhi dang dgu sogs mang nyung cha mi snyom pa mnag rdzi rgan pos kyang rtogs na, mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug tshar chen yab sras la long ba'i 'khar ba ltar gar 'dzugs med pa'i 'khrul pa de 'dra rmi lam du yang 'byung ba mi srid, des na de dag la gzu bo'i blos legs par brtags shing dpyad na yi ge gnyis re ma ldog par 'dri ba tshar chen yab sras sogs kyi dgongs pa min par 'grub bo
gru.english: Even a senile old yak herder can figure out that four and nine and the rest are unequal.  And it is impossible, even in your dreams, for these crowning lords and sages--Tsarchen and his spiritual sons--to make an error like this, as if they were blind men with a cane who could not tell where they were going.  And so, when we thoroughly examine and investigate these theories with an unbiased mind, we can establish that it was not the intention of Tsarchen and his close followers to place the letters in un-reversed pairs.

gru.acip: RGYUD DANG GRUB CHEN SA CHEN SOGS KYI BZHED PA DANG MI MTHUN ZHING SNGAGS BTU DANG RGYAB 'GAL DU 'GRO BA DANG,
gru.wylie: rgyud dang grub chen sa chen sogs kyi bzhed pa dang mi mthun zhing sngags btu dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro ba dang
gru.english: It is not in accordance with the position of the secret teachings, or of the great ancient Indian masters, or of those such as Sachen, and it runs in direct contradiction to what is found in the ritual collection for these secret words.

gru.acip: ZHES GSUNGS PA'I BLA MA NI GRUB MCHOG 'JAM DBYANGS BDE BA'I RDO RJE DANG, RJE BLO BZANG CHOS KYI NYI MA'I DKYIL CHOG LAS KYANG, THUGS SIN DKYIL SKABS 'BRU RE RE NAS LDOG PAR MI MDZAD GSUNGS YANG G-YON SKOR SPYI 'GRO LTAR 'BRU RE RE NAS LDOG KYANG LEGS ZHES BLA MAS GSUNGS, ZHES LNGA MA'I ZER TSUL DANG BSTUN NAS GSUNGS PA'I BLA MA NI RJE STAG PHU BA DANG RJE LCANG SKYA ROL PA'I RDO RJE GNYIS KA STE,
gru.wylie: zhes gsungs pa'i bla ma ni grub mchog 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje dang, rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i dkyil chog las kyang, thugs sin dkyil skabs 'bru re re nas ldog par mi mdzad gsungs yang g-yon skor spyi 'gro ltar 'bru re re nas ldog kyang legs zhes bla mas gsungs, zhes lnga ma'i zer tshul dang bstun nas gsungs pa'i bla ma ni rje stag phu ba dang rje lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje gnyis ka ste
gru.english: The Lama who is quoted here is that highly realized one, Jamyang Deway Dorje.  And then, in his Ritual for a Secret World, Lord Lobsang Chukyi Nyima states: It has been stated that, at the point in the ritual of the secret world where we make one of sindhura powder to represent Her holy heart, we should not turn each separate letter around backwards.  But my Lamas have stated that it is good though if each separate letter were turned around backwards in the usual counter-clockwise way. And this statement is in keeping with the feeling of the previous one.  The Lamas quoted here are Lord Takpuwa and Lord Changkya Rolpay Dorje.

gru.acip: DES NA YAB SRAS DE RNAMS NI NGES PA'I DON DU DPAL HE RU KA DANG GNYIS SU MED CING, DRANG DON GDUL BYA'I SNANG NGO LA YANG MTSAN LDAN GYI BLA MA MTHA' YAS PA'I ZHABS PAD BSNYEN NAS MDO RGYUD MAN NGAG RGYA MTSO LTA BU LA THOS BSAM SGOM GSUM MTHAR PHYIN PAR MDZAD PAS, MDO RGYUD KYI DON LA RIGS PA'I LAM NAS DRANGS PA'I NGES PA RNYED CING MI 'JIGS PA'I GZER THEBS PA'I MKHAS GRUB GNYIS LDAN GYI SKYES CHEN 'GRAN ZLA MED PA SHA STAG YIN PAS,
gru.wylie: des na yab sras de rnams ni nges pa'i don du dpal he ru ka dang gnyis su med cing, drang don gdul bya'i snang ngo la yang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mtha' yas pa'i zhabs pad bsnyen nas mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin par mdzad pas, mdo rgyud kyi don la rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i nges pa rnyed cing mi 'jigs pa'i gzer thebs pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen 'gran zla med pa sha stag yin pas
gru.english: In actuality, these Lamas and their spiritual descendants are inseparable from the glorious Heruka.  And the guise they take on for their students is that of ones who have reached the final end of the three trainings of listening, contemplation, and meditation on a veritable ocean of advices in both the open and secret ways, which they achieved by sitting at the holy lotus feet of an infinite number of highly qualified Lamas.  Thus each and every one of them is an unrivaled great being who has mastered both scriptures and deep practice, who has driven in the dagger of fearlessness and has truly perceived how to extract through the process of logic the actual meaning of the open and secret teachings.

gru.acip: 'OD GSAL DE LAS LANGS MA THAG TU PHUNG PO RNYING PA LAS GO SA LOGS SU BZHIN LAG GI RNAM PA CAN GYI DAG MA DAG GI SGYU LUS GNYIS KYI LAM DNGOS GNAS LA 'GRUB PA'I DGE RTZA SMIN BYED DANG, DE'I MTHAR THUG GI 'BRAS BU LONGS SPYOD RDZOGS PA'I SKU MNGON DU BYED PA'I RTOGS PA DANG,
gru.wylie: 'od gsal de las langs ma thag tu phung po rnying pa las go sa logs su bzhin lag gi rnam pa can gyi dag ma dag gi sgyu lus gnyis kyi lam dngos gnas la 'grub pa'i dge rtsa smin byed dang, de'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i rtogs pa dang
gru.english: The method also acts to ripen the store of virtue within us so that, just after we rise up from this clear light, we are in a form with a face and hands in all the right places, but in a physical space separate from that of our old body.  That is, we attain the actual path of both the pure and the impure illusory bodies.  And the end result or goal of this is the realization where we bring about the full body of enjoyment.

gru.acip: DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI RANG GI SNYING GAR ZHES PA NAS RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SKUR GYUR CES PA'I BAR TE, 'DI LA GZHAN GYI GZHI SBYANG, SGYUR GNYIS LAS DANG PO SBYANG BA NI,
gru.wylie: de ni sgrub thabs kyi rang gi snying gar zhes pa nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur ces pa'i bar te, 'di la gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang, sgyur gnyis las dang po sbyang ba ni
gru.english: This section is reflected in the ritual for reaching her from the words "In my heart..." up to "...They all turn into the Angel of the Diamond."  In this practice, first we purify the original state of others, and then we transform them.  Here is the first of these two.

gru.acip: 'DIR SGRUB THABS SU SKABS 'DIR LUS DKYIL BSGOM PAR 'DOD NA ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR BSGOM PAR MI 'DOD NA MA BSGOM KYANG CHOG CHOD PAR MI 'GRO ZHING,
gru.wylie: 'dir sgrub thabs su skabs 'dir lus dkyil bsgom par 'dod na zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgom par mi 'dod na ma bsgom kyang chog chod par mi 'gro zhing
gru.english: For this practice, it is stated in the ritual text, "At this point you can meditate on the secret world of your body if you wish."  What this means is that if you don't wish to meditate on this step and so don't, you need not be concerned that you have somehow broken the ritual.

gru.acip: DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI RANG GI SNYING GAR NANG GI DMAR CHA ZHES PA NAS 'JIGS DUS KYI GDAN LA G-YAS BRKYANGS KYIS BZHUGS PA'O ZHES PA'I ?,
gru.wylie: de ni sgrub thabs kyi rang gi snying gar nang gi dmar cha zhes pa nas 'jigs dus kyi gdan la g-yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i ?
gru.english: This practice can be found in the ritual text* starting from "At my heart is the red inner part..." up to "Standing with Her right leg extended, on a dais of the demons Frightener and Time." *Translator's note: Referring to an older ritual text than the one we use at present.

gru.acip: DE RNAMS GNAS NYER BZHI DANG DUR KHROD BRGYAD GLING BZHI RI RAB BCAS SO BDUN DU BZHUGS PA'I DPA' BO DANG RNAL 'BYOR MA DNGOS YIN SNYAM PA DANG, DE YANG RANG GI LUS KYI CHA SHAS LAS GRUB PAR BSAM PA'O,,
gru.wylie: de rnams gnas nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad gling bzhi ri rab bcas so bdun du bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa dang, de yang rang gi lus kyi cha shas las grub par bsam pa'o
gru.english: We need to think to ourselves that these are the actual Angels of Diamond and Warriors who live in the 37 places: the 24 sacred sites, the eight burial grounds, the four continents, and the great mountain.  Then we must believe that they all come from the parts of our own body. ...oooOOOooo...

gru.acip: DPA' BO DPA' MOS BYIN GYIS BRLABS PA DNGOS NI, SGRUB THABS KYI PHEEm RANG GI THUGS KA'I BAm YIG LAS ZHES PA NAS RNAL 'BYOR GYI BDAG NYID DE NGA'O ZHES PA'I BAR TE,
gru.wylie: dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa dngos ni, sgrub thabs kyi pheeM rang gi thugs ka'i baM yig las zhes pa nas rnal 'byor gyi bdag nyid de nga'o zhes pa'i bar te
gru.english: Now here is the actual blessing by the Warrior men and women.  In the ritual text this begins at the phrase "Phem!  From the letter vam at my heart..." and goes up to "...joined in one.  I am their absolute purity."

gru.acip: PHO NYA DANG BANG CHEN PA ZHES PA 'DOD DON MYUR DU SGRUB PA'I MI LA ZER BA BZHIN, RANG LAM MYUR DU BGROD PAR BYED PAS NA PHO NYA ZHES GSUNGS LA,
gru.wylie: pho nya dang bang chen pa zhes pa 'dod don myur du sgrub pa'i mi la zer ba bzhin, rang lam myur du bgrod par byed pas na pho nya zhes gsungs la
gru.english: The word for those who quickly perform a desired task is "messenger" or "emissary."  And so too are those who help us progress quickly on our individual path called "messengers."

gru.acip: DE NAS GO CHA BGO BA NI, DPA' BO DPA' MOS BYIN GYIS BRLABS PA'I GONG DU BYED PA DANG 'DIR BYED PA'I LUGS GNYIS LAS PHYI MA LEGS PAR GSUNGS LA, DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI RANG GI GNAS RNAMS SU ZHES PA NAS TZAndI KA'I NGO PO RNAMS SU GYUR CES PA'I BAR TE,
gru.wylie: de nas go cha bgo ba ni, dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gong du byed pa dang 'dir byed pa'i lugs gnyis las phyi ma legs par gsungs la, de ni sgrub thabs kyi rang gi gnas rnams su zhes pa nas tsaNDi ka'i ngo po rnams su gyur ces pa'i bar te
gru.english: Here is how we don the armor.  There are two ways of performing the practice--either doing it before being blessed by the man and woman warriors, or doing it here; and it has been stated that the latter of these two is better.  This can be found in the ritual text starting from, "At the points of my..." and continuing up to "In nature they are Chandika."

gru.acip: DE YANG RNAM 'JOMS KYI SRUNG BA'I GO CHA LTAR 'OD ZER LA ZHIB PAR BLTAS NA YI GE DE DANG DE'I RNAM PA 'BA' ZHIG TU BSAM PA NI GRUB CHEN LVA BA PA'I MAN NGAG ZAB CING GSANG BA'I GNAS YIN PAS DE BZHIN BYA BAR GSUNGS SO, ,
gru.wylie: de yang rnam 'joms kyi srung ba'i go cha ltar 'od zer la zhib par bltas na yi ge de dang de'i rnam pa 'ba' zhig tu bsam pa ni grub chen lva ba pa'i man ngag zab cing gsang ba'i gnas yin pas de bzhin bya bar gsungs so,
gru.english: Now this armor of the Destroyer which protects us is like a network of light, but when we look closely we see only a latticework of such and such letters.  This is the crucial point in the profound and secret advices of the great yogi Lawapa, and so my Lama has stated that we should do it this way.

gru.acip: DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI RANG GI SNYING GAR ZHES PA NAS BDE STONG LA MNYAM PAR 'JOG GO ZHES PA'I BAR TE,
gru.wylie: de ni sgrub thabs kyi rang gi snying gar zhes pa nas bde stong la mnyam par 'jog go zhes pa'i bar te
gru.english: This practice can be found in the ritual text starting from "At my heart..." and continuing up to "Stay in meditation now, on the bliss and emptiness."

gru.acip: RTOG MED CES PA DA LTA RANG CAG RNAMS RTOG PA MANG PO 'CHAR BA'I RTOG BCAS SHA STAG DANG, 'CHI BA 'OD GSAL GYI TSE RTOG PA THAMS CAD 'GAG KYANG YUN RING GNAS MI NUS PAR BAR DO 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: rtog med ces pa da lta rang cag rnams rtog pa mang po 'char ba'i rtog bcas sha stag dang, 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi tshe rtog pa thams cad 'gag kyang yun ring gnas mi nus par bar do 'grub
gru.english: And "devoid of conceptual thought" is the following.  At present, each of us is constantly full of conceptual thought, which means many conceptual thoughts are arising.  At the point of our death all conceptual thought is stopped, but we are unable to remain there for a long time, because the in-between state then occurs.

gru.acip: LAm DUS SU YANG SEMS DBEN DPE'I 'OD GSAL SHAR BA NA RTOG PA 'GAG KYANG 'OD GSAL DE LA GNAS MI NUS PAR ZAG BCAS KYI RLUNG LAS GRUB PA'I MA DAG PA'I SGYU LUS SU LDANG,
gru.wylie: laM dus su yang sems dben dpe'i 'od gsal shar ba na rtog pa 'gag kyang 'od gsal de la gnas mi nus par zag bcas kyi rlung las grub pa'i ma dag pa'i sgyu lus su ldang
gru.english: At the time of the path as well, when isolation of mind or approximate clear light arises, conceptual thought is stopped.  But we are unable to remain in this clear light, and we rise up into the impure illusory body which is produced by winds which are tarnished by imperfections.

gru.acip: BSKYED RIM GYI ZHAR DU BYUNG BA'I RDZOGS RIM ZUNG 'DOD DON SGRUB PA'I PHO NYA LTA BUS LHAN SKYES BDE STONG GI YE SHES BDE BLAG TU 'DREN NUS PAR SHOG CIG ,CES SMON PA'O,
gru.wylie: bskyed rim gyi zhar du byung ba'i rdzogs rim zung 'dod don sgrub pa'i pho nya lta bus lhan skyes bde stong gi ye shes bde blag tu 'dren nus par shog cig ,ces smon pa'o
gru.english: And we are praying here that this pair of completion stage practices, which are incidental to the stage of creation, may act like a messenger to attain our desired goal: the ability to easily bring on the wisdom of simultaneous bliss and emptiness.

gru.acip: DE NI SGRUB THABS KYI RANG GI SNYING GA'I ZHES PA NAS STONG PA NYID DU THIM PAR BSAM MO ZHES PA'I BAR TE,
gru.wylie: de ni sgrub thabs kyi rang gi snying ga'i zhes pa nas stong pa nyid du thim par bsam mo zhes pa'i bar te
gru.english: This practice can be found in the ritual text starting from the phrase, "Light shines forth..." and continuing up to "...until it melts into Clear Light, Emptiness."

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, SGRUB THABS KYI STONG PA'I NGANG LAS ZHES PA NAS TSAM RNGAMS KYIS BSRUNG BA'I BAR TE,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, sgrub thabs kyi stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas tsham rngams kyis bsrung ba'i bar te
gru.english: The first of these can be found in the ritual text starting from the phrase "from this state of emptiness..." and continuing up to the point where we protect ourselves with the secret words of ferocity.
