gru.english: Now urge Them to their sacred task: And now may You, O Glorious Goddess, Fulfill Your sacred task of seeing That all the things which are needed By masters and their disciples, All those who live in spiritual centers, Come to them effortlessly, Come to them automatically.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,KHYOD KYI RANG BZHIN CIR YANG MA GRUB KYANG, ,'DI LTAR MTSAN NYID CIR YANG SNANG BA YIS, ,'PHRIN LAS RNAM BZHI 'GRO DON MDZAD PA LA, ,BDAG GIS BSGRIMS TE RAB TU BSTOD BGYID NA, ,BDAG KYANG LAS BZHI'I RANG BZHIN LHUN GRUB STE, ,KHYOD LTAR 'GRO BA'I DON LA BRTZON PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,khyod kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub kyang, ,'di ltar mtshan nyid cir yang snang ba yis, ,'phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro don mdzad pa la, ,bdag gis bsgrims te rab tu bstod bgyid na, ,bdag kyang las bzhi'i rang bzhin lhun grub ste, ,khyod ltar 'gro ba'i don la brtson par shog
gru.english: Bhyoh! There is nothing about You That comes about through any nature Of its own; And yet this quality allows You To appear in any way at all-- Using the four modes of sacred work To accomplish the needs of living kind. And now I focus my mind perfectly And sing Your praises to the sky; By this act, may I as well Automatically master these four same modes, And like You labor as hard as I can For the sake of living beings.

gru.acip: ,BDAG CAG DUS 'DIR TSE RING ZHING, ,'KHOR DANG BSTAN PA RGYAS PA DANG, ,KHAMS GSUM DBANG DU 'DU BA DANG, ,BSHAD SGRUB LONGS SPYOD 'PHEL BAR MDZOD, (,CES GTOR RDZONGS SPRO BA LA DGA' NA BYA'O,,)
gru.wylie: bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing, ,'khor dang bstan pa rgyas pa dang, ,khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang, ,bshad sgrub longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod, (,ces gtor rdzongs spro ba la dga' na bya'o,,)
gru.english: Bring us all then in this time Lifetimes that are long; See that the disciples And the teachings grow-- Help us bring all three the realms Under our command, Increase the amount of teachings given, Increase the study of these teachings, Increase too all the resources Required by these activities. Singing Her Praises

gru.acip: ,DENG 'DIR RNAL 'BYOR BDAG CAG DPON SLOB KYI, ,RIGS DANG BRGYUD PAR BCAS RNAMS GNYER DU GTAD, ,BCOL LO LTOS SO BSRUNG GNYER RTAG MDZOD NAS, ,'JIGS CHEN BRGYAD DANG DUS MIN 'CHI BA SOGS, ,NYER 'TSE ZHI ZHING 'BYOR DRUG 'PHEL PA DANG, ,MOS BZHIS DBANG SDUD DGRA BGEGS TSAR GCOD PA'I, ,RNAM BZHI 'PHRIN LAS LHUN GYIS 'GRUB PAR MDZOD, (,CES PA 'DIS BSTOD CING 'PHRIN LAS BCOL LO,,)
gru.wylie: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob kyi, ,rigs dang brgyud par bcas rnams gnyer du gtad, ,bcol lo ltos so bsrung gnyer rtag mdzod nas, ,'jigs chen brgyad dang dus min 'chi ba sogs, ,nyer 'tshe zhi zhing 'byor drug 'phel pa dang, ,mos bzhis dbang sdud dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i, ,rnam bzhi 'phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod, (,ces pa 'dis bstod cing 'phrin las bcol lo,,)
gru.english: In present times as well, We yogis and yoginis here, Descendants as we are In the family of that Master, Exact of You this very pledge. We place in You this trust, We trust ourselves to You; Be now that one guardian Who lives forever close to us-- Put a stop to anything That would ever bring us harm: Things like the eight great fears, And death that comes before its time. Shower on us all six riches, And help us master with perfect ease All four forms of sacred work, Where with the four forms of wishes We gather in all power, And chop down every obstacle And enemy of our practice. With these verses then we have both praised Her and invoked Her to Her sacred deeds. Begging Permission to Perform the Empowerment

gru.acip: (BUM PA'I GZUNGS THAG NAS BZUNGS TE LHA BSRUNG GI SNGAGS BSDUS STE BSGRUB CING,)
gru.wylie: (bum pa'i gzungs thag nas bzungs te lha bsrung gi sngags bsdus ste bsgrub cing,)
gru.english: Grasp now the string atop the sacred vase and do a brief practice of the mantra which urges the Goddess to guard us:

gru.acip: DE'I CHED DU LAM GYI BAR CHAD SEL ZHING 'PHRIN LAS SGRUB PA'I SRUNG MA KHYAD PAR CAN DMAG ZOR LHA MO LA LAS BZHI LHA MOS BSKOR BA DANG, LHA MO GSANG SGRUB DANG BCAS PA'I RJES GNANG ZHU (SNYAM PA'I KUN SLONG KHYAD PAR CAN GYI SGO NAS NYAN PAR 'TSAL,)
gru.wylie: de'i ched du lam gyi bar chad sel zhing 'phrin las sgrub pa'i srung ma khyad par can dmag zor lha mo la las bzhi lha mos bskor ba dang, lha mo gsang sgrub dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang zhu (snyam pa'i kun slong khyad par can gyi sgo nas nyan par 'tshal,)
gru.english: To reach this goal, I now request permission To engage in the practice Of the Queen of the End of War-- Accompanied as She is By the Goddesses of the Four Modes, Along with the Lady of Secret Practice-- For She is that special protector Who can clear away every obstacle, And accomplish every holy deed.

gru.acip: DE YANG GANG GSAN PAR BYA BA NI, SNYIGS MA'I DUS 'DIR THUGS RJE DANG 'PHRIN LAS SHIN TU MYUR BA'I DMAG ZOR LHA MO LAS BZHI DANG GSANG SGRUB LHA MO'I DBANG DANG RIGS GTAD DE DAG NYE RGYUD DU BYUNG TSUL NI,
gru.wylie: de yang gang gsan par bya ba ni, snyigs ma'i dus 'dir thugs rje dang 'phrin las shin tu myur ba'i dmag zor lha mo las bzhi dang gsang sgrub lha mo'i dbang dang rigs gtad de dag nye rgyud du byung tshul ni
gru.english: Let us first speak though Of what it is here You will hear-- How it was that in these days of dark A lineage first sprang up For granting this empowerment And entrance to the families Of the Queen of the End of War, And the Goddesses of Four Modes, And the Goddess Practiced in Secret: Those holy beings whose compassion And sacred acts do move with such swift speed.

gru.acip: DE NAS RIM PAR BRGYUD DE BDAG GI DRIN CAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG CHEN PO GANG DE'I BAR DU BYON PA LAS KHO BO CAG GIS LEGS PAR MNOS PA'I NYE RGYUD KHYAD PAR CAN DPAL LDAN DMAG ZOR LHA MO LA LAS BZHI LHA MOS BSKOR BA DANG GSANG SGRUB DANG BCAS PA'I SROG DBANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA GSANG BA LAS KYANG CHES GSANG BA 'DI NYID 'BUL BAR BYED PA LA,
gru.wylie: de nas rim par brgyud de bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gang de'i bar du byon pa las kho bo cag gis legs par mnos pa'i nye rgyud khyad par can dpal ldan dmag zor lha mo la las bzhi lha mos bskor ba dang gsang sgrub dang bcas pa'i srog dbang thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba 'di nyid 'bul bar byed pa la
gru.english: From Him the teaching came down From generation to generation, Until it reached our own Root Lama, The great Lord of Sages, Who granted it to us. And now we impart this same to you, Secret beyond all secrets, A private and wondrous lineage, The unique empowerment of life Belonging to the glorious one, The Queen of the End of War, In the company of the Goddesses Of the Four Modes, along with The Lady of Secret Practice. The Mandala of Recompense

gru.acip: SLOB DPON GYIS BGYI 'OS PA RNAMS LEGS PAR 'GRUB, DA KHYED RANG SLOB MA RNAMS KYIS 'OS PA BLA MA DANG YI DAM GYI LHA DBYER MA MCHIS PA LA SROG DBANG ZAB MO ZHU BA'I YON DU MAndAL 'BUL BAR ZHU, (ZHES BRDA SBYAR TE MAndAL 'BUL DU GZHUG,)
gru.wylie: slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os pa rnams legs par 'grub, da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis 'os pa bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dbyer ma mchis pa la srog dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maNDal 'bul bar zhu, (zhes brda sbyar te maNDal 'bul du gzhug,)
gru.english: The Master has fully completed All that is worthy to be done To grant now the empowerment; And the time has come For you the disciples To do what is worthy for you to: That is, the time has come For you to make the presentation Of an offering of the mandala To your Lama and Close Angel, Two beings who are One, In recompense for Their granting you This profound empowerment of life. Indicate thus to the disciples that they should now offer the mandala.

gru.acip: ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG, (,ZHES RGYUN BSHAGS LAN GSUM GYIS RJES BZLOS BYA,)
gru.wylie: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog, (,zhes rgyun bshags lan gsum gyis rjes bzlos bya,)
gru.english: I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind in my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha. The Examination of the Disciples

gru.acip: (SLOB MAS,) HO: ,BDAG NI SNOD LDAN RIG PA 'DZIN, ,BLA MAS JI LTAR BSGO BA RNAMS, ,SROG LA BABS KYANG MI GTONG BAR, ,BKA' BZHIN BSGRUB PAR BGYID 'TSAL LO, (,ZHES LAN BTAB,)
gru.wylie: (slob mas,) ho: ,bdag ni snod ldan rig pa 'dzin, ,bla mas ji ltar bsgo ba rnams, ,srog la babs kyang mi gtong bar, ,bka' bzhin bsgrub par bgyid 'tshal lo, (,zhes lan btab,)
gru.english: And the disciples in turn reply, Ho! I am a proper vessel, I am a Keeper of Knowledge; And I will do my utmost To do as my Lama has commanded, To follow Your wishes And never abandon them, Even at the cost of my life.

gru.acip: (,BDUD RTZI LAS SLOB MA'I KHAR BLANG NAS,) ,'DI NI KHYOD KYI DMYAL BA'I CHU, ,DAM TSIG 'DAS NA BSREG PAR BYED, ,DAM TSIG BSRUNG NA DNGOS GRUB STER, ,RDO RJE BDUD RTZI'I CHU 'THUNG SHIG ,
gru.wylie: (,bdud rtsi las slob ma'i khar blang nas,) ,'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu, ,dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed, ,dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster, ,rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig
gru.english: The Diamond Master then takes up a quantity of nectar from its vessel, and touches it to the tongue of each disciple with the words, Drink now of this sacred water, Drink of deathless diamond nectar. It is a drink from the realms of hell That will burn you should you Transgress your pledges, And bring you every attainment Should you honor them.

gru.acip: (,THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GSOL GDAB NI,) HO: ,DKYIL 'KHOR GTZO MCHOG KHRAG 'THUNG DPAL, ,DPA' BO CHEN PO BDAG LA DGONGS, ,SANGS RGYAS BSTAN PA BSRUNG BA DANG, ,ZHI RGYAS DBANG DRAG LAS GRUB PHYIR, ,SRID GSUM DBANG BSGYUR RE MA TI, ,MA MO DRAG MO MTHU RTZAL CAN, ,'JAM RGYAS DBANG GI LHAG PA'I LHA, ,DAM TSIG CAN GYI SROG DBANG STZOL, (,ZHES LAN GSUM GYIS GSOL BA 'DAB,)
gru.wylie: (,thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab ni,) ho: ,dkyil 'khor gtso mchog khrag 'thung dpal, ,dpa' bo chen po bdag la dgongs, ,sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang, ,zhi rgyas dbang drag las grub phyir, ,srid gsum dbang bsgyur re ma ti, ,ma mo drag mo mthu rtsal can, ,'jam rgyas dbang gi lhag pa'i lha, ,dam tshig can gyi srog dbang stsol, (,zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'dab,)
gru.english: We come now to the unique supplication: Ho! Hear my plea, Lord of the Mandala, Eminent One, shining Drinker of the Blood, Warrior most mighty. I seek to protect the teachings, And to attain the skills Of peace, prosperity, power, and ferocity. And so I beg that You grant me The empowerment of life Into those who possess the pledges-- Into the secret teachings of Remati, Empress of All Three Realms, The Witch, the Angry One, Mistress of Mystic Powers; And into those of the Goddesses Beyond all other goddesses: Those gentle, generous, powerful.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,DPAL LDAN GNYAN GYI RE MA TI, ,LAS BZHI LHA MO GSANG SGRUB SOGS, ,'KHOR DANG BCAS PA MA LUS PA, ,SNGON GYI DAM TSIG GNYER DGONGS NAS, ,GNAS 'DIR MYUR DU GSHEGS SU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti, ,las bzhi lha mo gsang sgrub sogs, ,'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa, ,sngon gyi dam tshig gnyer dgongs nas, ,gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol
gru.english: Bhyoh! O Glorious Remati, Woman of Wrath; O Goddesses of the Four Modes, The Lady of Secret Practice, and such; Along with each and every Angel Counted in your retinue; Think back now to The pledge You took In the days of old, And come we beg You To this place with speed.

gru.acip: (DE NAS GTZO MO'I SKU SPYI BOR BZHAG STE,) ,BHYO: ,SRID PA KUN GYI DBANG PHYUG RGYAL, ,DMAG DANG ZOR GYI LHA MO YI, ,SKU YI SGO NAS DBANG BSKUR BAS, ,RDO RJE'I SKU RU 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: (de nas gtso mo'i sku spyi bor bzhag ste,) ,bhyo: ,srid pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal, ,dmag dang zor gyi lha mo yi, ,sku yi sgo nas dbang bskur bas, ,rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog
gru.english: Now place the image of the central Angel upon the disciple's head: Bhyoh! She is the victorious Queen Of all of existence-- The Goddess of Curses and War. I empower you here By using Her holy form; And so may you take on too Her precious diamond body.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,SRID PA KUN GYI DBANG PHYUG RGYAL, ,DUNG SKYONG ZHI BA'I LHA MO YI, ,SKU YI SGO NAS DBANG BSKUR BAS, ,RDO RJE'I SKU RU 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,srid pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal, ,dung skyong zhi ba'i lha mo yi, ,sku yi sgo nas dbang bskur bas, ,rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog
gru.english: Bhyoh! She is the victorious Queen Of all of existence-- The Goddess of Peace, Who protects with an ivory conch. I empower you here By using Her holy form; And so may you take on too Her precious diamond body.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,SRID PA KUN GYI DBANG PHYUG RGYAL, ,KHAMS GSUM DBANG DU BSDU MDZAD PA'I, ,SKU YI SGO NAS DBANG BSKUR NAS, ,RDO RJE'I SKU RU 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,srid pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal, ,khams gsum dbang du bsdu mdzad pa'i, ,sku yi sgo nas dbang bskur nas, ,rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog
gru.english: Bhyoh! She is the victorious Queen Of all of existence-- She places all three realms Within Her own dominion. I empower you here By using Her holy form; And so may you take on too Her precious diamond body.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,SRID PA KUN GYI DBANG PHYUG RGYAL, ,DGRA BGEGS MA LUS SGROL MDZAD MA'I, ,SKU YI SGO NAS DBANG BSKUR BAS, ,RDO RJE'I SKU RU 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,srid pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal, ,dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol mdzad ma'i, ,sku yi sgo nas dbang bskur bas, ,rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog
gru.english: Bhyoh! She is the victorious Queen Of all of existence-- She releases from their lives All enemies and obstructing spirits. I empower you here By using Her holy form; And so may you take on too Her precious diamond body.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,SRID PA KUN GYI DBANG PHYUG RGYAL, ,CHOS SRID YON TAN SPEL MDZAD MA, ,SKU YI SGO NAS DBANG BSKUR BAS, ,RDO RJE'I SKU DU 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,srid pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal, ,chos srid yon tan spel mdzad ma, ,sku yi sgo nas dbang bskur bas, ,rdo rje'i sku du 'grub par shog
gru.english: Bhyoh! She is the victorious Queen Of all of existence-- She brings all high qualities, The worldly and the spiritual, To flower ever higher. I empower you here By using Her holy form; And so may you take on too Her precious diamond body.

gru.acip: SNGAGS PHRENG SA BON DANG BCAS PAR THIM PAS, MCHOG THUN GYI DNGOS GRUB SGRUB PA'I MOS PA DANG BCAS 'DI'I RJES BZLOS MDZOD BYAS LA, (BHYO: BDUN MA LAN GSUM RJES ZLOS BYED DU BCUG STE,)
gru.wylie: sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas par thim pas, mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la, (bhyo: bdun ma lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug ste,)
gru.english: They come and sink into The string of secret words, Along with the seed syllable; Think, as you recite after me here, How you will now be able to reach All of your spiritual goals, Both the ultimate ones, And those ones which are shared. Have the disciples repeat after you, three times, the Mantra of the Seven Bhyoh:

gru.acip: THUGS SROG SA BON DANG BCAS PAR THIM PAS, ZHI BA'I LAS RAB 'BYAMS 'GRUB PA'I MOS PA DANG BCAS 'DI'I RJES ZLOS MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: thugs srog sa bon dang bcas par thim pas, zhi ba'i las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la
gru.english: These come and melt down Into Her own heart's life, And sacred syllable; Think, as you recite after me here, How you will now be able to perform Billions upon billions of acts In the sacred mode of peace.

gru.acip: THUGS SROG SA BON DANG BCAS PAR THIM PAS, ZHI BA'I LAS RAB 'BYAMS 'GRUB PA'I MOS PA DANG BCAS 'DI'I RJES ZLOS MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: thugs srog sa bon dang bcas par thim pas, zhi ba'i las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la
gru.english: These come and melt down Into Her own heart's life, And sacred syllable; Think, as you recite after me here, How you will now be able to perform Billions upon billions of acts In the sacred mode of prosperity.

gru.acip: THUGS SROG SA BON DANG BCAS PAR THIM PAS, DBANG GI LAS RAB 'BYAMS 'GRUB PA'I MOS PA DANG BCAS 'DI'I RJES ZLOS MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: thugs srog sa bon dang bcas par thim pas, dbang gi las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la
gru.english: These come and melt down Into Her own heart's life, And sacred syllable; Think, as you recite after me here, How you will now be able to perform Billions upon billions of acts In the sacred mode of power.

gru.acip: THUGS SROG SA BON DANG BCAS PAR THIM PAS, DRAG PO'I LAS RAB 'BYAMS 'GRUB PA'I MOS PA DANG BCAS 'DI'I RJES ZLOS MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: thugs srog sa bon dang bcas par thim pas, drag po'i las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la
gru.english: These come and melt down Into Her own heart's life, And sacred syllable; Think, as you recite after me here, How you will now be able to perform Billions upon billions of acts In the sacred mode of ferocity.

gru.acip: (SLOB DPON GYIS,) ,BCOM LDAN 'DI LA STZAL LAGS KYI, ,BCOM LDAN 'DI LA 'GO BAR MDZOD, ,SNGAGS KYI DNGOS GRUB SBYIN PA DANG, ,BRTUL ZHUGS BRTAN PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, (,ZHES BRJOD CING SLOB MA'I MGOR ME TOG BZHAG STE BYIN GYIS RLABS PA NI, GSUNG GI DBANG PO,,)
gru.wylie: (slob dpon gyis,) ,bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi, ,bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod, ,sngags kyi dngos grub sbyin pa dang, ,brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol, (,zhes brjod cing slob ma'i mgor me tog bzhag ste byin gyis rlabs pa ni, gsung gi dbang po,,)
gru.english: And the Master says, O Conqueror, grant this one the boon; O Conqueror, guide this one as well. I beg You to give them The attainments of the secret teachings; And I beg You to make Their determination to practice strong. With these words, the Master places a flower petal upon the disciple's head, which grants them blessing.  This then concludes the empowerment into Her precious speech. Empowerment into Her Precious Mind

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,SNA TSOGS PHYAG MTSAN GNYER GTAD PAS, ,ZHI RGYAS DBANG DANG DRAG MO YI, ,'PHRIN LAS SGRUB LA THOGS MED PA, ,THUGS KYI BYIN GYIS BRLAB TU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,sna tshogs phyag mtshan gnyer gtad pas, ,zhi rgyas dbang dang drag mo yi, ,'phrin las sgrub la thogs med pa, ,thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol
gru.english: Bhyoh! By handing into your care, My disciple, These many different Sacred instruments, I pray that She then grant you The blessing of Her holy mind: The ability to engage, With perfect ease, In holy deeds of peace And prosperity, power And ferocity.

gru.acip: NA MO: RIG 'DZIN RTZA BRGYUD KYI DPAL LDAN BLA MA DAM PA RNAMS KYI BKA' DANG DAM LAS MA 'DA' BAR RDO RJE SLOB MA 'DI RNAMS PHYI BZHIN RJES SU 'BRANGS LA, LUS DANG GRIB MA BZHIN DU 'GROGS TE, MTHUN RKYEN SGRUBS, GANG LTAR BCOL BA'I LAS THAMS CAD SGRUB PAR MDZOD CIG (,CES BKA' BSGO,)
gru.wylie: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams phyi bzhin rjes su 'brangs la, lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te, mthun rkyen sgrubs, gang ltar bcol ba'i las thams cad sgrub par mdzod cig (,ces bka' bsgo,)
gru.english: Namo! Never break now The commitment You have made; Never break now The commandment given You By the Holy Ones, The Keepers of Knowledge, Our glorious Root and Lineage Lamas: Take now these disciples of diamond Into Your care, and guide them; Stay close to them as their very shadows, Procure for them all that they need for their practice; Accomplish every sacred task That we have entrusted to You.

gru.acip: ,DAM RDZAS 'CHI MED BDUD RTZI'I ZAS, ,ZO ZHIG BU KHYOD RIGS SU SKYES, ,NGA YIS BSGO BA'I BKA' MA CAG , ,SGRUB LA NAN TAN GCES PAR GYIS, (,ZHES BRJOD LA GTOR ZAN DNGOS GRUB KYI TSUL DU BYIN,)
gru.wylie: dam rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zas, ,zo zhig bu khyod rigs su skyes, ,nga yis bsgo ba'i bka' ma cag , ,sgrub la nan tan gces par gyis, (,zhes brjod la gtor zan dngos grub kyi tshul du byin,)
gru.english: Say the following words, as you offer the disciple a small piece of the torma cake, as though you were actually handing them their spiritual goals. My disciple, This is the substance of pledge; A feast of the nectar of deathlessness. Never now break the command I have given you-- Devote yourself to your practice, Cherish this precious practice. Entrance into the Family of the Queen of the End of War

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS MDUN DU SMAN GYI LJON SHING ME TOG GI TSAL DANG RDZING BU SOGS MDZES SHING YID DU 'ONG BA'I DBUS SU RIN PO CHE LAS GRUB PA'I KHANG BZANG RGYA PHIBS LCOGS DANG BCAS PA 'OD DU 'BAR BA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las mdun du sman gyi ljon shing me tog gi tshal dang rdzing bu sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang rgya phibs lcogs dang bcas pa 'od du 'bar ba
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes, before me, a garden Of fragrant trees and flowers, Adorned with lovely ponds, Filled with beauty. In the center of the garden Is a palace carved of precious gem, Blazing in light, With spires and minarets.

gru.acip: DE'I 'KHOR DU ZHI BA'I LAS SGRUB PA'I 'KHOR GYIS BSKOR BA'I DPRAL BAR AOm, MGRIN PAR A'A: THUGS KAR H'Um, THUGS KA'I 'OD ZER GYIS BYANG SHAR MU LI TING NAS ZHI BA'I LHA MO 'KHOR BCAS PA BADZRA SA M'A DZA:(S SPYAN DRANGS BAR BSAM LA,)
gru.wylie: de'i 'khor du zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpral bar aoM, mgrin par a'a: thugs kar hUM, thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis byang shar mu li ting nas zhi ba'i lha mo 'khor bcas pa badzra sa mA dza:(s spyan drangs bar bsam la,)
gru.english: There in the retinue Surrounding Her Are the Angels who accomplish The works of peace; At Their forehead stands om; At Their throat stands ah; At Their heart stands hung. Rays of light race From those precious hearts, Traveling north and east To Mu-Li-Ting, calling forth The Goddess of Peace And all those in Her circle-- Vajra Samajah! See that, with this, the Goddess is beckoned.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,ZHI BA'I 'PHRIN LAS BSGRUB MDZAD DUNG SKYONG MA, ,'DOD PA KHAMS KYI DBANG PHYUG DPAL LHA MO, ,'KHOR BCAS MI MTHUN NYER 'TSE ZHI BA'I CHED, ,THOGS PA MED PAR GNAS 'DIR GSHEGS SU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad dung skyong ma, ,'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal lha mo, ,'khor bcas mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i ched, ,thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol
gru.english: Bhyoh! Lady who protects with an ivory conch, Who accomplishes sacred deeds of peace; Empress of the desire realm, Goddess shining, Come I beg You to this place, effortless, instantly, Come with Your circle, come to put a stop To things that work against us, things that harm us.

gru.acip: NAD DANG GDON DANG BGEGS DANG BAR DU GCOD PA SOGS MI MTHUN PA'I PHYOGS THAMS CAD DANG, KHYAD PAR RANG DANG SLOB MA'I THOS BSAM SGOM GSUM SOGS BSHAD SGRUB KYI BYA BA LA BAR DU GCOD PA THAMS CAD ZHI (BAR BSAMS LA,)
gru.wylie: nad dang gdon dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang, khyad par rang dang slob ma'i thos bsam sgom gsum sogs bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi (bar bsams la,)
gru.english: In your heart, think-- The light puts a stop To everything That could ever work against The spiritual side of things: Sickness, demons, obstacles, And every sort of problem. Most especially it puts an end To anything that would hinder The activities of teaching and practice-- Those like the three of learning, And contemplation, and meditation-- Carried out both by myself And by the disciples assembled here.

gru.acip: ,SNGON TSE BCOM LDAN 'DAS KYI SPYAN SNGA RU, ,CHOS BZHIN SGRUB PAR BYED PA'I GANG ZAG LA, ,BU BZHIN SKYONG BAR ZHAL GYIS BZHES PA YI, ,CHOS SKYONG SRUNGS MA RNAMS LA BDAG BSTOD DO,
gru.wylie: sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru, ,chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la, ,bu bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yi, ,chos skyong srungs ma rnams la bdag bstod do
gru.english: In days long past You stood before the Conqueror And promised to protect Anyone who was properly Trying to practice the Dharma, As if they were Your child. I sing then Your praises, Guardians of the Teaching.

gru.acip: (DE NAS, RIGS GTAD KYI GNANG BA ZHU BA NI,) ,KYEE RGYAL BA KUN YUM RDO RJE DBYINGS PHYUG MA, ,ZHI BA'I SKUR STON LHA MO DUNG SKYONG MA, ,ZHI BA'I LAS SGRUB RIGS GTAD SLOB BU LA, ,STER BA'I SKABS DBYE GNANG BA STZAL DU GSOL, (,CES LAN GSUM BRJOD NAS ME TOG 'THOR RO,,
gru.wylie: (de nas, rigs gtad kyi gnang ba zhu ba ni,) ,kyee rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma, ,zhi ba'i skur ston lha mo dung skyong ma, ,zhi ba'i las sgrub rigs gtad slob bu la, ,ster ba'i skabs dbye gnang ba stsal du gsol, (,ces lan gsum brjod nas me tog 'thor ro
gru.english: We next request permission to bring the disciple into Her family, by repeating the following three times: See!  You are the Woman of all the Victors, The Empress of the Diamond Realm: The Goddess who protects with an ivory conch, Showing Herself in peaceful form. I beg that You grant me permission To engage in this opportunity To grant this disciple entrance Into the family that accomplishes All the acts of peace. Throw petals of flowers into the air in celebration.

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,'GRO BA'I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS GZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: I go for refuge to the Three Jewels, And confess one by one all the wrong I have done. I rejoice in the good of every being. I hold the enlightenment Of the Buddha in my mind. I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind in my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS SMAN GYI LJON SHING ME TOG GI TSAL DANG, RDZING BU SOGS MDZES SHING YID DU 'ONG BA'I DBUS SU RIN PO CHE LAS GRUB PA'I KHANG BZANG RGYA PHIBS LCOGS DANG BCAS PA 'OD DU 'BAR BA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las sman gyi ljon shing me tog gi tshal dang, rdzing bu sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang rgya phibs lcogs dang bcas pa 'od du 'bar ba
gru.english: Out of a state of emptiness Comes a garden Of fragrant trees and flowers, Adorned with lovely ponds, Filled with beauty. In the center of the garden Is a palace carved of precious gem, Blazing in light, With spires and minarets.

gru.acip: ZHI BA'I LAS SGRUB PA'I 'KHOR GYIS BSKOR BA'I SPYI BOR AOm, MGRIN PAR A'A: THUGS KAR BHYO: YIG H'Um SNGON POS MTSAN PA,
gru.wylie: zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i spyi bor aoM, mgrin par a'a: thugs kar bhyo: yig hUM sngon pos mtshan pa
gru.english: She is surrounded By Her retinue Of the Angels who accomplish The works of peace; At the top of Their heads Stands a letter om, At Their throats an ah, And at Their precious hearts A letter bhyoh, Marked with a blue hung.

gru.acip: (RGYAS PA'I LHA MO'I RIGS GTAD NI,) DKYIL 'KHOR GYI LTE BA GRU BZHI DANG MTHA' RIN PO CHES BSKOR BA'I DBUS SU BHYO: YIG SER POR MTSON SPUNGS BKOD,)
gru.wylie: (rgyas pa'i lha mo'i rigs gtad ni,) dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba gru bzhi dang mtha' rin po ches bskor ba'i dbus su bhyo: yig ser por mtshon spungs bkod,)
gru.english: For the ritual of entrance into the family of the Goddess of Prosperity, begin with a square center to the mandala, circled by a string of jewels.  In the middle, place a pile of yellow powder in the shape of a bhyoh letter.

whole_word_matches.context: as pa'i lha mo'i rigs gtad ni,) dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba gru bzhi dang mtha' rin po ches bskor ba'i dbus su bhyo: y

gru.acip: DBU RGYAN, SNYAN CHA, MGUL RGYAN, SE MO DO, DO SHAL, 'OG PAGS, PHYAG ZHABS KYI GDU BU RNAMS, RIN PO CHE LAS GRUB PA, DAR SER PO'I NA BZA' 'JAG SNGON PO SHA DAR RGYA KHAS RGYAS PA LHAB LHUB TU GSOL BA DANG SNGON PO'I SKE RAGS BCINGS PA, PHYED SKYIL GYI TSUL DU BZHUGS PA,
gru.wylie: dbu rgyan, snyan cha, mgul rgyan, se mo do, do shal, 'og pags, phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu rnams, rin po che las grub pa, dar ser po'i na bza' 'jag sngon po sha dar rgya khas rgyas pa lhab lhub tu gsol ba dang sngon po'i ske rags bcings pa, phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa
gru.english: She wears a headdress, and earrings, A necklace, a breast ornament, A garland, a skirt, bracelets, and anklets All crafted of precious gems. Her rainment is sewn From pure yellow silk, With a border of soft blue cotton And honey-colored silk. It flaps in the air behind Her, Bound at Her waist With a silken sky-blue belt. She sits astride Her mount With half a lotus posture.

gru.acip: DE'I 'KHOR DU RGYAS PA'I LAS BSGRUB PA'I 'KHOR GYIS SKOR BA'I SPYI BOR AOm, MGRIN PAR A'A: THUGS KAR H'Um, THUGS KA'I 'OD ZER GYIS BYANG SHAR MU LI TING NAS RGYAS PA'I LHA MO 'KHOR BCAS BADZRA SA M'A DZA:(S SPYAN DRANGS PAR BSAM LA,)
gru.wylie: de'i 'khor du rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa'i 'khor gyis skor ba'i spyi bor aoM, mgrin par a'a: thugs kar hUM, thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis byang shar mu li ting nas rgyas pa'i lha mo 'khor bcas badzra sa mA dza:(s spyan drangs par bsam la,)
gru.english: There in the retinue Surrounding Her Are the Angels who accomplish The works of prosperity; At Their forehead stands om; At Their throat stands ah; At Their heart stands hung. Rays of light race From those precious hearts, Traveling north and east To Mu-Li-Ting, calling forth The Goddess of Prosperity And all those in Her circle-- Vajra Samajah! See that, with this, the Goddess is beckoned.

gru.acip: ,BHYO: ,RGYAS PA'I 'PHRIN LAS BSGRUB MDZAD 'DOD KHAMS MA, ,'KHOR BCAS BSTAN 'GRO'I PHAN BDE BDAG SOGS KYI, ,CHOS SRID LEGS TSOGS YAR NGO'I ZLA BA LTAR, ,SPEL PHYIR GNAS 'DIR THOGS MED DA TSUR BYON,
gru.wylie: bhyo: ,rgyas pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad 'dod khams ma, ,'khor bcas bstan 'gro'i phan bde bdag sogs kyi, ,chos srid legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ba ltar, ,spel phyir gnas 'dir thogs med da tshur byon
gru.english: Bhyoh! You are the Queen of the Desire Realm, Who accomplishes holy deeds of prosperity; Come now to this place, effortless, instantly, Along with the Angels in Your retinue, To accomplish help and happiness For the teachings and all living beings; To increase all the good things Of the Dharma and of the world For myself and all others, Brought flowering like the waxing moon.

gru.acip: SRID PA GSUM GYI BKRAG MDANGS DANG GZI BRJID, TSE DANG BSOD NAMS THAMS CAD BSDUS TE RANG DANG SLOB MA LA THIM PAS, TSE DANG BSOD NAMS THOS BSAM SGOM GSUM SOGS BSHAD SGRUB KYI BYA BA THAMS CAD RGYAS (PAR BSAMS PA,)
gru.wylie: srid pa gsum gyi bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid, tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus te rang dang slob ma la thim pas, tshe dang bsod nams thos bsam sgom gsum sogs bshad sgrub kyi bya ba thams cad rgyas (par bsams pa,)
gru.english: Watch now as-- All of the brilliance and authority Of all the three realms, All of their lifeforce, all of their merit, Come gathering to this place, Melting into myself and my disciples; Bringing our own lifeforce, Our own merit, and every activity Of teaching and practice-- Things like the three of learning, And contemplation, and meditation-- Flowering ever further.

gru.acip: ,SNGON TSE BCOM LDAN 'DAS KYI SPYAN SNGA RU, ,CHOS BZHIN SGRUB PAR BYED PA'I GANG ZAG LA, ,BU BZHIN SKYONG BAR ZHAL GYIS BZHES PA YI, ,CHOS SKYONG SRUNGS MA RNAMS LA BDAG BSTOD DO,
gru.wylie: sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru, ,chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la, ,bu bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yi, ,chos skyong srungs ma rnams la bdag bstod do
gru.english: In days long past You stood before the Conqueror And promised to protect Anyone who was properly Trying to practice the Dharma, As if they were Your child. I sing then Your praises, Guardians of the Teaching.

gru.acip: (GNANG BA ZHU BA NI,) ,KYEE RGYAL BA KUN YUM RDO RJE DBYINGS PHYUG MA, ,DPAL LDAN 'DOD KHAMS DBANG PHYUG GSER MDOG MAS, ,RGYAS PA'I LAS SGRUB RIGS GTAD SLOB BU LA, ,STER BA'I SKABS DBYE GNANG BSTZAL DU GSOL, (,CES LAN GSUM BRJOD NAS ME TOG MTHOR RO,,)

gru.english: Next we request permission, by repeating the following three times: See! I beg that You grant me permission To engage in this opportunity To grant this disciple entrance Into the family that accomplishes All the acts of prosperity. Throw petals of flowers into the air in celebration.

gru.english: I go for refuge to the Three Jewels, And confess one by one all the wrong I have done. I rejoice in the good of every being. I hold the enlightenment Of the Buddha in my mind. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.wylie: dbu rgyan, snyan cha, mgul rgyan, se mo do, do shal, 'og pags, phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu rnams, rin po che las grub pa, dar ser po'i na bza' 'jag sngon po sha dar rgya khas rgyas pa lhab lhub tu gsol ba dang sngon po'i ske rags bcings pa, phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa
gru.english: She wears a headdress, and earrings, A necklace, a breast ornament, A garland, a skirt, bracelets, and anklets All crafted of precious gems. Her rainment is sewn From pure yellow silk, With a border of soft blue cotton And honey-colored silk. It flaps in the air behind Her, Bound at Her waist With a silken sky-blue belt. She sits astride Her mount With half a lotus posture.

gru.english: Bhyoh! You send out and then withdraw The light of the ruby, and in its wake Bestow every wondrous thing there is In the realms of the world and of peace. You are a wishing tree that brings to us Every wish our hearts desire; I sing Your praises then, my Goddess, Who deigns to grant me power.

gru.wylie: gtso mo'i mdun gyi drag po lha mo'i mdun du bam ro gan rgyal bskyel ba'i steng du bhyo: mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las, lha mo re ma ti gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma shin tu khro shin tu khro shing gtum pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing, smin ma dang sma ra 'bad pa ral pa kham nag thur du nyil ba rting bar 'phyang ba
gru.english: There on the ground In front of the Goddess of Ferocity Who rides behind the central Angel Is a human corpse, lying face up. Above it appears a bhyoh of midnight blue, Which turns into the goddess Named Remati--the one Who is practiced in secret. She has one head, And two arms; She rages, She rages, With a temper of fire. She has three eyes, Bloodshot and bulging, With bushy eyebrows And hair on Her face; Her dusty yellow hair Is tied up in locks That stretch down to Her heels.

gru.wylie: (yang gsang drag mo 'di'i srog dbang ni, chos byung gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer dang me ris bskor ba'i dbus su sa bon nam tshom bu gang rigs bris pa'i steng manydzi'i khar gsang sgrub kyi gtor nag gdan thabs kyi zan gru gsum dang gtor nag gru gsum bsnol thabs su brtsegs par rgyan spras byed,)
gru.english: Here then is the empowerment of life for this ferocious Woman of the Ultimate Secret.  Draw a dharma star of a simple triangle of blue-black, within a circle, and surrounded by a mountain of fire.  In the center, either write a sacred syllable or simply place a small pile of powder--and above this place a small manji tripod.  On a little platform atop this tripod, place a black torma cake of flour, a triangular pill shape, laid down flat.  Atop this stack another black torma cake, also triangular, so that they form a star--and then add torma ornaments to this.

Around the outside place pinch-pieces.

She has three eyes, Bloodshot and bulging, With bushy eyebrows And hair on Her face; Her dusty yellow hair Is tied up in locks That stretch down to Her heels.

gru.acip: GTZO 'KHOR THAMS CAD KYI SPYI BOR AOm DKAR PO, MGRIN PAR A'A: DMAR PO, THUGS KAR H'Um SNGON POS MTSAN PA, BDAG NYID KYI THUGS KA'I H'Um GI 'OD ZER LCAGS KYU'I RNAM PA CAN GYIS, BYANG SHAR MU LI TING GI KHRAG MTSO NAS GSANG SGRUB LHA MO RE MA TI 'KHOR DANG BCAS PA SPYAN DRANGS,
gru.wylie: gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor aoM dkar po, mgrin par a'a: dmar po, thugs kar hUM sngon pos mtshan pa, bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hUM gi 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis, byang shar mu li ting gi khrag mtsho nas gsang sgrub lha mo re ma ti 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs
gru.english: The central Angel And all Her circle Are marked On the tip of Their head With a white letter om, At Their throat With a red letter ah, And at Their holy heart With a blue letter hung. From the hung At my own holy heart Come rays of light In the form of hooks-- They pass to the north and east, To the bloody seas of Mu-Li-ting, And beckon back The Goddess of Secret Practice, Remati, Together with Her circle.

gru.acip: ,KYEE DPAL CHEN KHRAG 'THUNG DPA' BO CHE, ,MA MO'I GSANG SGRUB SROG DBANG 'DIS, ,SANGS RGYAS BSTAN PA BSRUNG DON DU, ,BDAG LA BKA' DRIN STZAL DU GSOL, (,LAN GSUM,)
gru.wylie: kyee dpal chen khrag 'thung dpa' bo che, ,ma mo'i gsang sgrub srog dbang 'dis, ,sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung don du, ,bdag la bka' drin stsal du gsol, (,lan gsum,)
gru.english: See!  You blaze in glory, Warrior mighty, Drinker of blood; Grant me I beg You The infinite kindness Of this empowerment of life Into the Witch of Secret Practice, So that I may protect The teachings of the Buddhas.

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,'GRO BA'I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS GZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG LA, ,BYANG CHUB BAR DU BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI BSKYED PAR BGYI, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la, ,byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: I go for refuge to the Three Jewels, And confess one by one all the wrong I have done. I rejoice in the good of every being. I hold the enlightenment Of the Buddha in my mind. I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community, Until I am enlightened. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind in my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: STONG PA'I NGANG LAS BAM RO GAN RGYAL BSKYEL BA'I STENG DU BHYO: MTHING NAG YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS, KHYED RANG RNAMS LHA MO RE MA TI GSANG SGRUB ZHAL GCIG PHYAG GNYIS MA SHIN TU KHRO SHIN TU KHRO SHING GTUM PA SPYAN GSUM DMAR LA ZLUM ZHING, SMIN MA DANG SMA RA 'BAD PA RAL PA KHAM NAG THUR DU NYIL BA RTING BAR 'PHYANG BA,
gru.wylie: stong pa'i ngang las bam ro gan rgyal bskyel ba'i steng du bhyo: mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las, khyed rang rnams lha mo re ma ti gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma shin tu khro shin tu khro shing gtum pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing, smin ma dang sma ra 'bad pa ral pa kham nag thur du nyil ba rting bar 'phyang ba
gru.english: Out of the emptiness Appears a human corpse, lying face up. Above it comes a bhyoh of midnight blue-- It is all of you here. And now you turn into the goddess Named Remati--the one Who is practiced in secret. She has one head, And two arms; She rages, She rages, With a temper of fire. She has three eyes, Bloodshot and bulging, With bushy eyebrows And hair on Her face; Her dusty yellow hair Is tied up in locks That stretch down to Her heels.

gru.acip: (DE NAS TZAK LI SLOB MA'I SPYI BOR BZHAG NAS,) MDUN GYI GSANG SGRUB LHA MO RE MA TI'I SPYI BO NAS RANG 'DRA DPAG TU MED PA BYON, SLOB MA'I SPYI BO NAS THIM PAS, GSANG SGRUB LHA MO'I SKU'I SROG DBANG LUS LA ZHUGS PA'I MOS PA MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: (de nas tsak li slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas,) mdun gyi gsang sgrub lha mo re ma ti'i spyi bo nas rang 'dra dpag tu med pa byon, slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas, gsang sgrub lha mo'i sku'i srog dbang lus la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la
gru.english: Touch now the chakli image to the top of the disciple's head-- See now, my disciple, How from the tip of the head Of Remati, the Goddess Of secret practice, before you, Come immeasurable numbers Of copies of Herself. They sink into the top Of your own head, Bringing into your body The empowerment of life Of the holy body Of the Goddess Of secret practice.

gru.acip: (PHYAG MTSAN SLOB MA'I SNYING KAR GTUGS TE,) MDUN GYI GSANG SGRUB LHA MO'I THUGS KA NAS BDE STONG GNYIS MED KYI YE SHES RAL GRI MGO RLON SOGS PHYAG MTSAN GYI RNAM PAR DPAG TU MED PA BYON, SLOB MA RNAMS KYI SNYING KHAR THIM PAS, THUGS KYI SROG DBANG ZAB MO THOB PA'I MOS PA MDZOD BYAS LA,
gru.wylie: (phyag mtshan slob ma'i snying kar gtugs te,) mdun gyi gsang sgrub lha mo'i thugs ka nas bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes ral gri mgo rlon sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par dpag tu med pa byon, slob ma rnams kyi snying khar thim pas, thugs kyi srog dbang zab mo thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la
gru.english: Touch the various sacred instruments to the disciple's heart. See, my disciple, How from the sacred heart Of the Goddess of secret practice In front of you Comes the wisdom Of undivided bliss and emptiness, In the form of an infinite number Of sacred instruments, including A sword, and a freshly severed head. They sink into your heart, And grant you the profound Empowerment of life Of the holy mind.

gru.acip: MDOR NA GNAS SKABS DANG MTHAR THUG GI DON THAMS CAD YID LA JI LTAR RE BA'I 'BRAS BU RING POR MI THOGS PAR MYUR DU 'GRUB PA'I 'PHRIN LAS 'GRUB PAR MDZAD DU GSOL, (ZHES BRJOD LA BKA' BSGO ZHING DAM BSGRAGS BYA,)
gru.wylie: mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad yid la ji ltar re ba'i 'bras bu ring por mi thogs par myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzad du gsol, (zhes brjod la bka' bsgo zhing dam bsgrags bya,)
gru.english: In brief then may these disciples Achieve with perfect ease, And incredible speed, Soon, soon, All the goals That they hope for, Every wish of their heart-- Goals of the everyday, Goals of the ultimate. And we beg You now To undertake those sacred deeds That will bring this to reality. With this we give the Angels Their orders, and proclaim the pledge They have committed Themselves to.

gru.acip: ,'DI NI KHYOD KYI DMYAL BA'I CHU, ,DAM TSIG 'DAS NA BSREG PAR BYED, ,DAM TSIG BSRUNG NA DNGOS GRUB STER, ,RDO RJE BDUD RTZI'I CHU 'THUNG SHIG ,
gru.wylie: 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu, ,dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed, ,dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster, ,rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig
gru.english: The Diamond Master then takes up a quantity of nectar from its vessel, and touches it to the tongue of each disciple with the words, Drink now of this sacred water, Drink of deathless diamond nectar. It is a drink from the realms of hell That will burn you should you Transgress your pledges, And bring you every attainment Should you honor them.

gru.acip: DE NAS PHUR BU STOD GSANG SGRUB LA SMAD PHUR BU'I DPAL CAN DU BSAM LA, RBOD RBAD BSAD GSUM GYI SNGAGS BZLA BZHIN PAS LINGGA BSGRAL,
gru.wylie: de nas phur bu stod gsang sgrub la smad phur bu'i dpal can du bsam la, rbod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags bzla bzhin pas lingga bsgral
gru.english: See the upper half Of the ritual dagger As the Lady of Secret Practice; See the lower half As Glorious One of the Dagger; Recite the mantra Of the triple deed-- Invoking, cursing, and killing-- And as you do, Liberate the linga:

gru.acip: (BSGRAL RO LAG TU BTEGS NAS,) ,AOm CHOS KYI DBYINGS GNAS GNAM SA LTA BU'I ZHAL, ,A'A: DGRA BGEGS DPUNG TSOGS ZA BAR CHES RNGAMS PAS, ,H'Um GTUM CHEN DPA' BO BKA' SDOD DREGS PA'I TSOGS, ,HR'I: GNYER GTAD LAS RNAMS THOGS MED LHUN 'GRUB MDZOD,
gru.wylie: (bsgral ro lag tu btegs nas,) ,aoM chos kyi dbyings gnas gnam sa lta bu'i zhal, ,a'a: dgra bgegs dpung tshogs za bar ches rngams pas, ,hUM gtum chen dpa' bo bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs, ,hrI: gnyer gtad las rnams thogs med lhun 'grub mdzod
gru.english: Raise up in your hands the corpse that is left after the liberation-- Om! You live in the Realm of Is, With jaws that stretch From earth to sky; Ah! You thrill to devour The vast armies Of our foes--our obstacles; Hung! Assemblies of vicious Warriors, Of arrogant Keepers of the Dharma; Hrih! Undertake, with perfect ease And spontaneity The holy deeds Of Your guardianship.

gru.acip: ,RDO RJE SLOB DPON DGONGS SU GSOL, ,BDAG NI 'GRO BA'I DON CHED DU, ,BLA MED BYANG CHUB BSGRUB PA LA, ,BAR DU GCOD PA'I 'CHI BDAG GI , ,BDUD LAS RNAM PAR RGYAL BA'I PHYIR, ,'CHI MED RIG 'DZIN STZAL DU GSOL, (LAN GSUM GYIS GSOL BA BTAB PA,)
gru.wylie: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol, ,bdag ni 'gro ba'i don ched du, ,bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la, ,bar du gcod pa'i 'chi bdag gi , ,bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyir, ,'chi med rig 'dzin stsal du gsol, (lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa,)
gru.english: Repeat this supplication then, thrice: O Diamond Master, I ask You to hear me. I swear to reach matchless enlightenment, For the sake of every living being. And so that I may achieve total victory Over that demon, the Lord of Death-- One who would prevent me from this goal-- I beg that You make me now Someone who possesses the knowledge Of deathlessness itself.

gru.acip: (SKYABS 'GRO NI, TSIG RKANG LNGA PO 'DRA BA LA, DRUG PA RTZA BA GSUM LA SKYABS SU MCHI, ,ZHES DANG, SEMS BSKYED KYI SKABS 'CHI MED RIG 'DZIN BSGRUB PAR BYA, ZHES 'DON PA BSGYUR,)
gru.wylie: (skyabs 'gro ni, tshig rkang lnga po 'dra ba la, drug pa rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi, ,zhes dang, sems bskyed kyi skabs 'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrub par bya, zhes 'don pa bsgyur,)
gru.english: Go for refuge now, by changing parts of the previous wording for the recitation.  The first five lines in the Tibetan are the same, but the sixth is changed as indicated.  For the part on raising the Wish for enlightenment, change the one line as seen here.

gru.acip: ,DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,SDIG PA THAMS CAD SO SOR BSHAGS, ,'GRO BA'I DGE LA RJES YI RANG, ,SANGS RGYAS BYANG CHUB YID KYIS GZUNG, ,SANGS RGYAS CHOS DANG TSOGS MCHOG RNAMS, ,RTZA BA GSUM LA SKYABS SU MCHI, ,RANG GZHAN DON NI RAB BSGRUB PHYIR, ,'CHI MED RIG 'DZIN BSGRUB PAR BYA, ,BYANGS CHUB MCHOG GI SEMS NI BSKYED BGYID NAS, ,SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BDAG GI MGRON DU GNYER, ,BYANG CHUB SPYOD MCHOG YID 'ONG SPYAD PAR BGYI, ,'GRO LA PHAN PHYIR SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR SHOG,
gru.wylie: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags, ,'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang, ,sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung, ,sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog rnams, ,rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi, ,rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir, ,'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrub par bya, ,byangs chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas, ,sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer, ,byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi, ,'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
gru.english: The disciples repeat, after the Master, the following Daily Rite of Confession, three times: I go for refuge to the Three Jewels, And confess one by one all the wrong I have done. I rejoice in the good of every being. I hold the enlightenment Of the Buddha in my mind. I take my refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the Community-- In the three of the foundation. To fill all the needs Of myself and others, I swear to become one who holds The knowledge of deathlessness-- I will gain the Wish for Buddhahood, And take all living kind into my care; I swear I will sweetly do All those highest deeds That Bodhisattvas do. For the sake of all, let me be the Buddha.

gru.acip: ,'CHI MED ZHI BA'I LHA MO YI, ,SKU YI TSE DBANG LUS LA ZHUGS, ,LUS NI GZHOM MED RDO RJE'I SKU, ,MTSAN DANG DPE BYAD 'GRUB PAR SHOG ,
gru.wylie: 'chi med zhi ba'i lha mo yi, ,sku yi tshe dbang lus la zhugs, ,lus ni gzhom med rdo rje'i sku, ,mtshan dang dpe byad 'grub par shog
gru.english: The empowerment of life Into the blessed body Of the peaceful goddess Of deathless life Enters into your bodies. May thus your bodies Attain the marks and signs Of an enlightened being, And the indestructible Form of diamond Upon which they are found.

gru.acip: ,BCOM LDAN 'DI LA STZAL LAGS KYI, ,BCOM LDAN 'DI LA 'GO BAR MDZOD, ,SNGAGS KYI DNGOS GRUB SBYIN PA DANG, ,BRTUL ZHUGS BRTAN PAR MDZAD DU GSOL,
gru.wylie: bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi, ,bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod, ,sngags kyi dngos grub sbyin pa dang, ,brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol
gru.english: O Conqueror, grant this one the boon; O Conqueror, guide this one as well. I beg You to give them The attainments of the secret teachings; And I beg You to make Their determination to practice strong.

gru.acip: ,BCOM LDAN DON GRUB TSE DPAG MED MGON GYI, ,PHYAG MTSAN SNA TSOGS RDO RJE RGYA GRAM 'DI, ,LAS 'PHRO LNGA LDAN KHYOD LA SBYIN PA YIS, ,DON GRUB RIGS KYI TSE LA DBANG THOB SHOG ,
gru.wylie: bcom ldan don grub tshe dpag med mgon gyi, ,phyag mtshan sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram 'di, ,las 'phro lnga ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis, ,don grub rigs kyi tshe la dbang thob shog
gru.english: This is the crossed diamond Which is the sacred instrument Of the Conqueror, the Savior, The Angel of Accomplishment, The Angel of Limitless Life. It sends forth sacred deeds Of five different kinds, And I present it now To you-- And so shall you now attain The power of life In the Family of Accomplishment.

gru.acip: (,G-YUNG DRUG GTAD DE,) ,NAM YANG MI G-YO RTAG BRTAN RDO RJE'I KHAMS, ,TSE YI DNGOS GRUB G-YUNG DRUNG GZUGS SHAR 'DI, ,LAS 'PHRO LNGA LDAN KHYOD LA SBYIN PA YIS, ,'CHI MED RIG PA 'DZIN PA THOB PAR SHOG , (CES BRJOD,)
gru.wylie: (,g-yung drug gtad de,) ,nam yang mi g-yo rtag brtan rdo rje'i khams, ,tshe yi dngos grub g-yung drung gzugs shar 'di, ,las 'phro lnga ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis, ,'chi med rig pa 'dzin pa thob par shog , (ces brjod,)
gru.english: Give the swastika into their hands and say, Here is the attainment of life, A state of diamond solid and firm, Something that will never move, Showing itself in a swastika's form. It sends forth sacred deeds Of five different kinds, And I present it now To you-- And so shall you now become Someone who possesses the knowledge Of deathlessness itself.

gru.acip: ,DAM RDZAS 'CHI MED BDUD RTZI'I ZAS, ,ZO ZHIG BU KHYOD RIGS SU SKYES, ,NGA YIS BSGO BA'I BKA' MA CAN, ,SGRUB LA NAN TAN GCES PAR GYIS, (,ZHES BRJOD LA GTOR ZAN DNGOS GRUB KYI TSUL DU BYIN,)
gru.wylie: dam rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zas, ,zo zhig bu khyod rigs su skyes, ,nga yis bsgo ba'i bka' ma can, ,sgrub la nan tan gces par gyis, (,zhes brjod la gtor zan dngos grub kyi tshul du byin,)
gru.english: Say now the following, as you grant the disciple a small piece of the torma cake to partake of, as though you were actually handing them their spiritual goals-- This is a feast Of the substances of pledge; This is the nectar Of deathless life. Partake of it, my child, And be born into our family. Cherish now this practice Of constantly reaching to be with This Goddess to whom I now Have granted Her command.

gru.acip: TSE GCIG LUS GCIG LA SANGS RGYAS KYI GO 'PHANG BSGRUB NA N'A RO CHOS DRUG GI GTUM MO DANG , GSANG 'DUS KYI BSRE BA SKOR DGU, RDOR BZLAS, BDE MCHOG GI 'OD GSAL RNAMS MED MI RUNG YIN PAS NGES PAR SBYAR DGOS,
gru.wylie: tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub na nA ro chos drug gi gtum mo dang , gsang 'dus kyi bsre ba skor dgu, rdor bzlas, bde mchog gi 'od gsal rnams med mi rung yin pas nges par sbyar dgos
gru.english: Anyone who is working to achieve the state of enlightenment in one life, in this one body, has no option but to follow the practice of inner heat from the Six Practices of Naropa; the nine-fold practice of blending from the teachings of the Secret Collection; the recitation of the Warrior of Diamond; and the practice of clear light from the teachings of Highest Bliss.  As such we must absolutely combine all of these with our present practice.

gru.acip: SNGON CHAD ZHI GNAS SGRUB MA MYONG BAS 'DI'I AA SHAD LA DMIGS RTEN BYAS NAS ZHI GNAS SGRUB PA'I MAN NGAG RNAMS LAM RIM NAS TSUR SBYAR TE BSGRUB,
gru.wylie: sngon chad zhi gnas sgrub ma myong bas 'di'i aa shad la dmigs rten byas nas zhi gnas sgrub pa'i man ngag rnams lam rim nas tshur sbyar te bsgrub
gru.english: Those who have never achieved the state of meditative quietude before this point can do so by using the ah dagger in this practice as their object of meditation, and by applying to this practice the instructions, found in the texts on the steps of the path to Buddhahood, for developing this kind of quietude.

gru.acip: RLUNG DBU MAR 'DU BA'I DMIGS PA LEGS PO BYUNG NA RLUNG SBYOR DNGOS SU MA BYAS KYANG GEGS MI 'BYUNG BA DANG , RLUNG 'DU BA'I DGOS PA 'GRUB PA SOGS LA GNAD CHE, RGYUD DANG RJE BLA MA'I DGONGS PA'ANG 'DI YIN,
gru.wylie: rlung dbu mar 'du ba'i dmigs pa legs po byung na rlung sbyor dngos su ma byas kyang gegs mi 'byung ba dang , rlung 'du ba'i dgos pa 'grub pa sogs la gnad che, rgyud dang rje bla ma'i dgongs pa'ang 'di yin
gru.english: If your visualization of gathering the winds into the central channel is done carefully, then even if you don't actually seal the winds physically you will have no obstacles occur, and you will still have achieved your goal of bringing in the winds and such.  This is an important key to the practice, and reflects as well the true thought of both the secret texts and our Lord Lama.

gru.acip: YANG SNANG MCHED THOB GSUM RIM GYIS BYUNG BA MIN PAR RTAS BRDAB PA DANG G-YANG DU LHUNG BA LTA BUS GLO BUR DU 'CHI DGOS PA BYUNG NA, BAR DO GRUB TSE BSRE TSUL GONG LTAR BYED,
gru.wylie: yang snang mched thob gsum rim gyis byung ba min par rtas brdab pa dang g-yang du lhung ba lta bus glo bur du 'chi dgos pa byung na, bar do grub tshe bsre tshul gong ltar byed
gru.english: Now suppose it happens that you must die suddenly: you are thrown from a horse or fall off a cliff or something like that, and there is no process where the three of appearance, spread, and attainment occur in their gradual progression.  When you come out as one of those beings between death and rebirth, then do the different blendings as described above.

gru.acip: RDZOGS RIM GYI RTOGS PA MA THOB PA TSOS KYANG RDZOGS RIM GYI DMIGS RNAM DANG , BSRE SKOR GYI GDAMS NGAG RNAMS LA GOMS PAR BYAS NAS, 'DUN STOBS KYI BSRE TSUL SNGAR BSHAD PA LTAR BYAS NA, SNGAGS SGRUB PA'I RTEN KHYAD PAR CAN DU SKYE BAR NUS SHING ,
gru.wylie: rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa ma thob pa tshos kyang rdzogs rim gyi dmigs rnam dang , bsre skor gyi gdams ngag rnams la goms par byas nas, 'dun stobs kyi bsre tshul sngar bshad pa ltar byas na, sngags sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can du skye bar nus shing
gru.english: Even those who have not managed to attain the realizations of the stage of completion should acquaint themselves with the different visualizations of this stage, and with the instructions for the practice of blending.  If they do then they can perform, by force of will alone, the various steps of the blending process described above.  And then they will be able to find a birth in the extraordinary kind of body and life where they can practice the secret word.

gru.acip: BSRE BA SKOR DGU LA GO BA TZAM CHAGS NA'ANG NGAN SONG GI SKYE SGO NGES PAR KHEGS PA MKHAS GRUB RJES, 'DI NI RNAL 'BYOR PA'I BLO GDENG 'CHA' SA ZHES SOGS KYI BSNGAGS BRJOD GNANG TSUL BCAS GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: bsre ba skor dgu la go ba tsam chags na'ang ngan song gi skye sgo nges par khegs pa mkhas grub rjes, 'di ni rnal 'byor pa'i blo gdeng 'cha' sa zhes sogs kyi bsngags brjod gnang tshul bcas gsungs
gru.english: Even if all you do is get a basic understanding of this nine-fold practice of blending, the door for you to take a birth in the lower realms will absolutely be shut closed.  Our Lama went on to describe how this was the reason that Kedrup Je praised this practice in lines like, "Here is one thing that practitioners can feel an absolute sense of certainty about."

gru.acip: ,NUB NYER GCIG PAR, GZHI CHOS CAN 'KHOR BA'I GNAS KYI SKYE 'CHI BAR DO GSUM LA SGRO 'DOGS BCAD NAS, RLUNG LUS LA GNAS PAS BDE BA SGRUB PA'I DMIGS PA GTONG BA LA, DE YANG SKYE 'CHI BAR DO GSUM DANG CHOS MTHUN SBYOR TSUL GONG BZHIN GNANG ,
gru.wylie: nub nyer gcig par, gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnas kyi skye 'chi bar do gsum la sgro 'dogs bcad nas, rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa gtong ba la, de yang skye 'chi bar do gsum dang chos mthun sbyor tshul gong bzhin gnang
gru.english: On the evening of the 21st day, do a review of our original condition here in the cycle of pain: the three stages of our birth, our death, and the period inbetween.  So here we are carrying out a visualization of how we achieve bliss due to the way that the winds stay within the body.  We can relate the steps here to the parallel events in our birth, our death, and the inbetween state--as you did this above.

gru.acip: RANG BZHIN BRGYAD CU NI, MGON PO KLU SGRUB KYI RIM LNGA DANG , SPYOD BSDUS SOGS LA DE DAG SO SOR GSUNGS SHING , RAGS RTZIS BYAS NA SNANG MCHED THOB GSUM GYI SKABS SU 'DU STE, SNANG BA'I SKABS KUN RTOG SUM CU SO GSUM, MCHED PA'I SKABS KUN RTOG BZHI BCU, NYER THOB KYI SKABS SU KUN RTOG BDUN THIM PA STE KUN RTOG RGYAD CU DBYINGS SU THIM NAS 'CHI BA 'OD GSAL MNGON DU BYED PA YIN LA,
gru.wylie: rang bzhin brgyad cu ni, mgon po klu sgrub kyi rim lnga dang , spyod bsdus sogs la de dag so sor gsungs shing , rags rtsis byas na snang mched thob gsum gyi skabs su 'du ste, snang ba'i skabs kun rtog sum cu so gsum, mched pa'i skabs kun rtog bzhi bcu, nyer thob kyi skabs su kun rtog bdun thim pa ste kun rtog rgyad cu dbyings su thim nas 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byed pa yin la
gru.english: Which brings us to the 80 misperceptions of reality.  These are described individually in Master Nagarjuna's teachings upon the five stages, and in texts such as the Abbreviated Activity.  To give a grossly brief summary, these can all be included into the three stages of illumination, blossoming, and attainment.  During the stage of illumination, 33 of these misperceptions dissolve into nothingness.  At the stage of blossoming, another 40 dissolve.  And then during the stage of attainment, another 7 dissolve, which makes 80.  After this then the clear light of death makes its appearance.

gru.acip: DE NAS BAR DO GRUB PA'I DOD LA MA DAG PA'I SGYU LUS SU LANG YANG DE NGO MA SHES PAS BAR DO GRUB, DE NI RLUNG SEMS LAS GRUB PA'I LUS MA GTOGS RAGS PA MED LA, DE'I PHYIR GNAS PA RTZA MED PA'I RLUNG RANG KHA RGYAL NAS SEMS LA RANG DBANG MI THOB PAR MING GZHI 'KHYAMS PO PHYOGS KUN TU YUD YUD 'GRO ZHING , 'KHRUL SNANG GI SDUG BSNGAL DRAG PO 'BYUNG ,
gru.wylie: de nas bar do grub pa'i dod la ma dag pa'i sgyu lus su lang yang de ngo ma shes pas bar do grub, de ni rlung sems las grub pa'i lus ma gtogs rags pa med la, de'i phyir gnas pa rtsa med pa'i rlung rang kha rgyal nas sems la rang dbang mi thob par ming gzhi 'khyams po phyogs kun tu yud yud 'gro zhing , 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal drag po 'byung
gru.english: At this juncture we can rise up in the impure form of the illusory body, in place of going into the intermediate being--which is what happens if we fail to recognize the clear light here.  With this illusory body, there is no gross aspect at all--nothing other than a body made of wind and thought itself.  So what happens is that the inner winds--freed from their normal habitat, the channels--suddenly obtain their freedom, and unless we have attained control of our mind then we become one of those "wanderers of the basis of the name"--we set off on our aimless wandering here and there.  Then too we undergo intense suffering of mistaken perceptions.

gru.acip: DE'I RKYEN GYIS BAR DO BA DE LUGS 'BYUNG GI SNANG MCHED THOB GSUM GYI RTAGS SHAR NAS 'CHI BA 'OD GSAL MNGON DU GYUR NAS KHAMS DKAR DMAR GYI DBUS SU SKYE BA LEN ZHING , LUGS LDOG GI THOB MCHED SNANG GSUM BYUNG NAS NYER THOB ZIN PA NA SKYE SRID GRUB BO,,
gru.wylie: de'i rkyen gyis bar do ba de lugs 'byung gi snang mched thob gsum gyi rtags shar nas 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du gyur nas khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su skye ba len zhing , lugs ldog gi thob mched snang gsum byung nas nyer thob zin pa na skye srid grub bo
gru.english: This then triggers a series of the three stages of illumination, blossoming, and attainment, where the relevant signs appear to the person in their forward order, followed by the rising of the clear light.  And then they take their rebirth into the center of the combined white and red elements.  The same three stages of illumination, blossoming, and attainment then come to the person in their reverse order.  Once the stage of attainment draws to a close, the being at birth appears.

gru.acip: BZHI PA LNGA PA GNYIS NI YAN LAG GI RNAM PAR GSAL BA LTA BU RA MA GNYIS DANG , DRUG PA LA YAN LAG LNGA GRUB PA NAG PA LTA BU, BDUN PAR MGO RDZOGS PAR GRUB CING YAN LAG GZHAN RDZOGS PAR MA GRUB PA SENG+GE LTA BU, BRGYAD PAR YAN LAG THUNG NGU GRUB PA MI'U THUNG LTA BU,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis ni yan lag gi rnam par gsal ba lta bu ra ma gnyis dang , drug pa la yan lag lnga grub pa nag pa lta bu, bdun par mgo rdzogs par grub cing yan lag gzhan rdzogs par ma grub pa seng+ge lta bu, brgyad par yan lag thung ngu grub pa mi'u thung lta bu
gru.english: In the fourth and fifth months, the limbs are completely distinct, like the two different Ramas.  In the sixth month, all four limbs and the head are formed in a way that recalls the Black One, Krishna.  In the seventh, the head is completely formed, but the four limbs are not quite finished; and so the fetus looks like lion.  In the eighth month, the four limbs extend out like miniatures, so that the fetus resembles a dwarf.

gru.acip: DGU PAR MNGAL NANG DU DRI NGA BA SOGS KYI PHYIR 'BYUNG BAR SKE RING BA BYA NGANG PA LTA BU, PHYI ROL TU BTZAS PA SANGS RGYAS BLTAMS PA LTA BU STE GNAS SKABS BCUR 'GYUR TSUL SA LUGS BZHED KYANG MKHAS GRUB RIN PO CHE'I BRTAG GNYIS 'GREL CHEN DU DGAG PA MTHA' YAS PA YOD,
gru.wylie: dgu par mngal nang du dri nga ba sogs kyi phyir 'byung bar ske ring ba bya ngang pa lta bu, phyi rol tu btsas pa sangs rgyas bltams pa lta bu ste gnas skabs bcur 'gyur tshul sa lugs bzhed kyang mkhas grub rin po che'i brtag gnyis 'grel chen du dgag pa mtha' yas pa yod
gru.english: In the ninth month, the exit from the womb begins with foul smells and the like oozing out, and then a long neck, like that of a certain bird: the goose.  And then when the child is actually born, it recalls the holy birth of a Buddha.  This then is how the ten represent the ten stages in the womb; they are accepted by the Sakya tradition, but Kedrup Rinpoche, in his great commentary to the Tantra in Two Sections, presents countless points which refute this position.

gru.acip: 'DI LA 'CHI BA'I 'OD GSAL ZIN NA DUS DER 'TSANG RGYA BAR 'DOD CING, DE YANG BAR DO DANG POR SANGS RGYAS PA ZHES ZER BA NI, SHIN TU MI RIGS TE, 'CHI SRID MA 'GAGS PAR BAR DO GRUB PA GZHUNG TSAD LDAN RNAMS DANG 'GAL BA'I PHYIR DANG, 'CHI SRID TSE 'DI DANG BAR DO GNYIS KYI NANG NAS, TSE 'DI NYID DU GZHAG DGOS PA'I PHYIR DANG, DER 'CHI BA'I 'OD GSAL ZIN NA SKABS DER SANGS RGYAS PA GZHUNG TSAD LDAN GANG NAS KYANG MA BSHAD CING, MI 'THAD PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: 'di la 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zin na dus der 'tshang rgya bar 'dod cing, de yang bar do dang por sangs rgyas pa zhes zer ba ni, shin tu mi rigs te, 'chi srid ma 'gags par bar do grub pa gzhung tshad ldan rnams dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang, 'chi srid tshe 'di dang bar do gnyis kyi nang nas, tshe 'di nyid du gzhag dgos pa'i phyir dang, der 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zin na skabs der sangs rgyas pa gzhung tshad ldan gang nas kyang ma bshad cing, mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: What we say is that this person then goes on to achieve recognition of the clear light of death, and becomes enlightened at that point.  The claim that, rather, this individual could reach enlightenment at the point where they have first entered the intermediate state is completely incorrect.  This is because saying that one could enter the intermediate state prior to such time as the being of death had come to an end would contradict authoritative scriptures--and if you had to position the being of death either in this life or in the intermediate state, you'd have to say it belonged to this life.  And there is not a single authoritative scripture at all which says that the person reaches enlightenment at that point, as they maintain recognition of the clear light of death--and it would be incorrect to say so.

gru.acip: DE BZHIN DU SHI BA'I 'OD GSAL GYI MTHAR BAR DO MTSAN NYID PA'I LUS LEN DGOS NA, BAR DO ZIN NAS LAM SBYANGS KYANG RTEN DE NYID LA MCHOG MI 'GRUB PAS,
gru.wylie: de bzhin du shi ba'i 'od gsal gyi mthar bar do mtshan nyid pa'i lus len dgos na, bar do zin nas lam sbyangs kyang rten de nyid la mchog mi 'grub pas
gru.english: The case is the same at the end of the clear light of death: if one at that point had to take on the body of an actual inbetween being, then even if one were to reach recognition during this intermediate state and undertake some practice of the path, they would still never reach the highest goal in such a body and mind.

gru.acip: GANG ZAG DANG PO LA GZHAN LA BAR DO 'ONG BA'I DOD LA, ,KHONG LA RLUNG SEMS LAS LAM GYI LONGS SKU 'GRUB PA CIG DGOS PA YIN TE, 'DI DAG GI SGRUB BYED RNAMS KYANG GZHAN DU BSHAD ZIN TO,,
gru.wylie: gang zag dang po la gzhan la bar do 'ong ba'i dod la, ,khong la rlung sems las lam gyi longs sku 'grub pa cig dgos pa yin te, 'di dag gi sgrub byed rnams kyang gzhan du bshad zin to
gru.english: And so the simple fact is that the first of the three individuals must necessarily be someone who achieves--in the face of what comes to other people as turning into an intermediate being--a paradise body of the path stage, produced by his or her winds and thoughts.  I have, further, set forth all the evidence of these points at great length, in other writings.

gru.acip: LTAR BAR DO NGOS ZIN NAS BAR DO'I LUS MTSAN NYID PA LEN DGOS PAR BYUNG BA 'DIS, RTEN DE LA MCHOG MI 'GRUB KYANG, RANG NYID YI DAM GYI LHAR SGOM PA DANG, DE KHO NA NYID KYI LTA BA SKYONG BA DANG, GANG SNANG GI SNOD BCUD THAMS CAD LA SNGAR SNANG BA SGYU MA DANG, RMI LAM SGYU MAR BSHAD PA BZHIN DU BSGOMS NA KHYAD PAR CHE BAS DE RNAMS KYI GDAMS NGAG NAS BAR DO'I SKABS YIN PAR BSAMS KYIN BSGOM PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: ltar bar do ngos zin nas bar do'i lus mtshan nyid pa len dgos par byung ba 'dis, rten de la mchog mi 'grub kyang, rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar sgom pa dang, de kho na nyid kyi lta ba skyong ba dang, gang snang gi snod bcud thams cad la sngar snang ba sgyu ma dang, rmi lam sgyu mar bshad pa bzhin du bsgoms na khyad par che bas de rnams kyi gdams ngag nas bar do'i skabs yin par bsams kyin bsgom par bya'o
gru.english: And so thus you can recognize the intermediate state for what it is; and while a person who has had to take on the actual body of an intermediate being cannot achieve the highest goal with that configuration of body and mind, it can make an immense difference if you can undertake to see yourself as a close Angel; try to maintain the correct view of suchness; and meditate on how what appears to you is illusory, and illusory as a dream is--all in the sense that we explained before.  As such you will have to be practicing at this point, constantly reminding yourself how what is now coming to you is the period of the intermediate state, as it was described in the instructions received.

gru.acip: DE LA GOMS PA MANG DU BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS, SGYU MA'I SKU SGRUB DGOS PAS, 'DIR 'OD GSAL SNGA MA DE LAS KHYAD PAR DU GYUR PA CIG SPYOD DGOS SO, ,DE YANG SGYU MA'I LUS DNGOS SAM RJES MTHUN PA'I RTEN CIG LA BRTEN NAS 'OD GSAL DU 'JUG PA CIG YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: de la goms pa mang du byas pa la brten nas, sgyu ma'i sku sgrub dgos pas, 'dir 'od gsal snga ma de las khyad par du gyur pa cig spyod dgos so, ,de yang sgyu ma'i lus dngos sam rjes mthun pa'i rten cig la brten nas 'od gsal du 'jug pa cig yin no
gru.english: And since it is the case that one must master this kind of clear light through constant practice if one hopes to attain the illusory body, then one must obviously be practicing a clear light which is far more extraordinary than the kinds we've just described.  There is moreover a practice where one enters into clear light based on a mental and physical configuration involving either an actual or an approximate illusory body.

gru.acip: ZHES GSUNGS PA 'DIR SNANG LA, GRUB CHEN GYI GZHUNG KHUNGS THUB NAS GNYID KYI STONG PA BZHI BSHAD NAS 'OD GSAL 'DZIN TSUL 'DI 'DRA BA GZHAN GANG NAS KYANG MI 'BYUNG BAS, 'DI NAS BSHAD PA BZHIN SHES DGOS SO,,
gru.wylie: zhes gsungs pa 'dir snang la, grub chen gyi gzhung khungs thub nas gnyid kyi stong pa bzhi bshad nas 'od gsal 'dzin tshul 'di 'dra ba gzhan gang nas kyang mi 'byung bas, 'di nas bshad pa bzhin shes dgos so
gru.english: So we do see this reference; and we would have to say that there appears no comparable explanation at all, in any authoritative treatise by the great masters, of the four types of emptiness of sleep, and how to achieve recognition of the clear light of sleep.  And so you should understand these points as we have explained them here.

gru.acip: ,ZHES BDE SDUG GI GNAS LUS KYI MTHA' STE, SNGAR GTUM MO BSGOMS PAS DAG PAR MA BYAS PAR 'PHOS NA, NGAL BA DON MED DU BH'A BA BHA DRAS BSHAD PAS, SNGAR GYI GTUM MO SGOM PA 'PHO BA KHYAD PAR CAN SGRUB PA'I RGYU CIG YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: zhes bde sdug gi gnas lus kyi mtha' ste, sngar gtum mo bsgoms pas dag par ma byas par 'phos na, ngal ba don med du bhA ba bha dras bshad pas, sngar gyi gtum mo sgom pa 'pho ba khyad par can sgrub pa'i rgyu cig yin no
gru.english: The "place" for pleasure and pain is the "end" of the body.  Suppose we undertake to send on our consciousness without having first undertaken the practice of inner fire, and thus purified this body.  Master Bhavabhadra has described this as nothing more than meaningless trouble for ourselves.  And so we can say that one of the causes for accomplishing a truly amazing practice of sending our mind on is to meditate first upon the inner fire.

gru.acip: 'DIR 'PHO BA SBYONG BA'I RTEN DU LHA GANG SGOM SNYAM NA, BLA MA RNAMS RANG GI YI DAM GANG YIN SGOM PAR BZHED, KHA SBYOR DANG GDAN BZHI LAS 'DI LA SGOS KYI LHA SGOM TSUL CIG GSUNGS PAS GRUB NA DE BZHIN DU BYED RGYU YIN YANG, 'DIR TSIG MANGS SU DOGS NAS MA BRIS SO,,
gru.wylie: 'dir 'pho ba sbyong ba'i rten du lha gang sgom snyam na, bla ma rnams rang gi yi dam gang yin sgom par bzhed, kha sbyor dang gdan bzhi las 'di la sgos kyi lha sgom tshul cig gsungs pas grub na de bzhin du byed rgyu yin yang, 'dir tshig mangs su dogs nas ma bris so
gru.english: To begin with, you might wonder to yourself which Angel we should use as the foundation for our practice of sending on the mind.  The Lamas have said that we should do the practice using our own Close Angel.  The Kiss and the Four Seats talk about a specific way of doing this practice with our personal Angel guide; and it is certainly true that this is the way we should do it as we proceed.  Fearing though that this presentation would go on too long if I included those particular instructions here, I will leave it at that.

gru.acip: DE NAS LTE BA'I AA DANG, SNYING KHA'I H'Um DANG, SPYI GTZUG GI KshA GSAL BTAB NAS, 'OG RLUNG DRAG TU THEN PAS AA DE NYID, RTZA DBU MA'I NANG NAS YAR LA KHYU RU RU BYUNG NAS, SNYING KHA'I H'Um LA THIM PAR BSAM ZHING, AA HI KA CI TZAM GRUB PA CIG BZLOS SO,,
gru.wylie: de nas lte ba'i aa dang, snying kha'i hUM dang, spyi gtsug gi kSha gsal btab nas, 'og rlung drag tu then pas aa de nyid, rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar la khyu ru ru byung nas, snying kha'i hUM la thim par bsam zhing, aa hi ka ci tsam grub pa cig bzlos so
gru.english: Focus now upon the ah at the navel, the hung at the heart, and the ksha at the tip of the head.  Draw the lower wind up forcefully and see that this same ah letter wends its way up inside the central channel, melting then into the hung at the heart.  Now repeat the expression ah hi ka as many times as you can.

gru.acip: GRONG 'JUG BYED PA'I DGOS PA NI, RIGS DMA' BAS GZHAN DON CHEN PO MI 'GRUB PAS RIGS MTHO BA'I RTEN 'DZIN PA DANG, NAD BU CAN GYIS RANG GZHAN GYI DON MI 'GRUB PAR MTHONG NAS, NAD MED PA'I LUS RTEN 'DZIN PA DANG, NA SO RGAS PAS GZHON PA'I LUS RTEN 'DZIN PA SOGS KYI DON DU GRONG 'JUG BYED DO,,
gru.wylie: grong 'jug byed pa'i dgos pa ni, rigs dma' bas gzhan don chen po mi 'grub pas rigs mtho ba'i rten 'dzin pa dang, nad bu can gyis rang gzhan gyi don mi 'grub par mthong nas, nad med pa'i lus rten 'dzin pa dang, na so rgas pas gzhon pa'i lus rten 'dzin pa sogs kyi don du grong 'jug byed do
gru.english: Just why do we undertake the practice of entering the city"  Perhaps we were born into a very low social status--one with which [in ancient India] it would be difficult to accomplish any great good for others.  And so we take possession of the body of someone of a higher station.  Or else we have contracted some very serious illness, and we see that it would be difficult for us then to be of help either to ourselves or to others--and then we take on a body free of any illness.  Perhaps too we have simply gotten too old, and we seek a younger body.  It is for these and similar purposes that we enter the city.

gru.acip: JI LTAR BYED PA'I TSUL LA 'DI PA'I BLA MA RNAMS GSUM DU BYED PA'I DANG PO SKYANG BA NI, RLUNG SEMS GNYIS LA DBANG THOB, TSE 'DIR GZHAN DON 'GRUB PAR MTHONG ZHING, SEMS CAN LA SNYING RJE TSAD MED DANG LDAN PA'I GANG ZAG GIS GRONG DU 'JUG PA'I MAN NGAG NYAMS SU BLANG BAR BYA STE,
gru.wylie: ji ltar byed pa'i tshul la 'di pa'i bla ma rnams gsum du byed pa'i dang po skyang ba ni, rlung sems gnyis la dbang thob, tshe 'dir gzhan don 'grub par mthong zhing, sems can la snying rje tshad med dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis grong du 'jug pa'i man ngag nyams su blang bar bya ste
gru.english: As for the method that we use to carry out this practice, the Lamas have outlined three different steps.  The first of these is called "extending."  For this, we must first of all be someone who has attained mastery over their winds and mind.  We must as well perceive that if we do undertake the practice in this present life then it will be of benefit to others.  And finally we must be possessed of limitless compassion for all living beings.  This is the kind of person who can carry out the instructions for entering the city.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA LAM LA BOGS 'BYIN PA'I THABS SPYOD PA NI, TSE 'DIR MCHOG 'GRUB PA LA SPYOD PA DGOS LA, 'DI LA YANG BSKYED RIM PA'I SPYOD PA DANG, RDZOGS RIM PA'I SPYOD PA GNYIS DANG, DE RE RE LA YANG SPROS BCAS DANG, SPROS MED DANG, SHIN TU SPROS MED KYI SPYOD PA GSUM BYED PAR SGRON GSAL LAS GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa lam la bogs 'byin pa'i thabs spyod pa ni, tshe 'dir mchog 'grub pa la spyod pa dgos la, 'di la yang bskyed rim pa'i spyod pa dang, rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa gnyis dang, de re re la yang spros bcas dang, spros med dang, shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum byed par sgron gsal las gsungs so
gru.english: Here now is our second major section, on "enjoyment" as a method for advancing your practice drastically. There are two types of this enjoyment: that for a person following the stage of creation, and that for one who is following the stage of completion. The Lamp of Illumination further states that each of these may be divided into enjoyment with elaboration; without elaboration; and completely free of elaboration.

gru.acip: BYED PA'I DUS NI SGYU LUS SGRUB PA'I MGO RTZOM PA'I DUS DANG, SGYU LUS GRUB NAS 'OD GSAL SBYONG BA'I DUS DANG, SLOB PA'I ZUNG 'JUG THOB NAS, MI SLOB PA'I ZUNG 'JUG THOB PA'I PHYIR DU BYED PA'I DUS GSUM MO, ,'DI RNAMS 'DIR SMOS PA NI MAN NGAG GI GNAD TSANG BA LA 'DI RNAMS KYANG DGOS SO,, ZHES KHA BSKANG PA DANG, DE DAG GI BAG CHAGS BZHAG PA'I PHYIR BYAS KYI, RGYA CHER NI TSIG MANGS SU DOGS PAS MA BRIS TE, SHES PAR 'DOD NA 'DUS PA'I MAN NGAG LAS BTZAL BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: byed pa'i dus ni sgyu lus sgrub pa'i mgo rtsom pa'i dus dang, sgyu lus grub nas 'od gsal sbyong ba'i dus dang, slob pa'i zung 'jug thob nas, mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob pa'i phyir du byed pa'i dus gsum mo, ,'di rnams 'dir smos pa ni man ngag gi gnad tshang ba la 'di rnams kyang dgos so,, zhes kha bskang pa dang, de dag gi bag chags bzhag pa'i phyir byas kyi, rgya cher ni tshig mangs su dogs pas ma bris te, shes par 'dod na 'dus pa'i man ngag las btsal bar bya'o
gru.english: When does one partake of these enjoyments? There are three different periods: 1) when one has just got to the point of producing one's illusory body; 2) when one has already produced their illusory body, and is practicing to reach proficiency in clear light; and 3) as a means for attaining the union of the two beyond all further learning. The reason I have mentioned these practices here is as a sort of addendum, to tell you that "if you really want all the crucial points of these advices in a comprehensive way, you're going to need these as well." I also wanted to plant a seed in you to practice them in the future. I have not written any very detailed description of them here because of a concern that this treatise would become too lengthy. If you would like to know more on this subject, you can seek it in the advices on the Secret Collection. Bringing about the Final Result

gru.acip: DE'I RTEN GZUGS KYI SKU RLUNG SEMS TZAM LAS GRUB PA NI LONGS SKU YIN LA, SKU DE GNYIS NGO BO GCIG LA LDOG PA THA DAD TZAM YIN ZHING, GZUGS SKU DE LA GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES KYI SKU ZHES LAN DU MAR GSUNGS PAS, GZUGS SKU SANGS RGYAS KYI SAS MA BSDUS PAR GDUL BYA'I RGYUD KYIS BSDUS PA DANG, SHES PA LAS NGO BO THA DAD PA'I BEMS POR 'DOD PA DANG, 'BRAS BU'I SKABS SU YE SHES MED PA SOGS SU SMRAS PA NI, LEGS PAR SMRAS PA MIN PAR SHES PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: de'i rten gzugs kyi sku rlung sems tsam las grub pa ni longs sku yin la, sku de gnyis ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad tsam yin zhing, gzugs sku de la gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes lan du mar gsungs pas, gzugs sku sangs rgyas kyi sas ma bsdus par gdul bya'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang, shes pa las ngo bo tha dad pa'i bems por 'dod pa dang, 'bras bu'i skabs su ye shes med pa sogs su smras pa ni, legs par smras pa min par shes par bya'o
gru.english: The physical body which serves as the basis of this last body is the enjoyment body, and it is made of nothing but the winds and mind.
