And so these two bodies are merely separate expressions of a single essence; because of this and the fact that this physical body is on a multitude of occasions spoken of as the "body of indivisible wisdom," one should be aware that statements such as the following are not ones which are good: --that the physical body of an enlightened being is not subsumed by the level of a Buddha, but rather something subsumed within the being of the disciple; --the belief that this same body consists of particles of matter which are not types of mental stuff; and --that at the point of the final result one no longer has any wisdom.

gru.acip: ,GRUB CHEN TE LO N'A RO'I GDAMS PA MCHOG , ,DPAL LDAN N'A RO CHOS DRUG CES GRAGS PA, ,GANGS RI'I KHROD 'DIR SKAL LDAN MTHA' YAS LA, ,ZAB MO RDO RJE THEG PA'I DGA' STON MCHOG ,
gru.wylie: grub chen te lo nA ro'i gdams pa mchog , ,dpal ldan nA ro chos drug ces grags pa, ,gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skal ldan mtha' yas la, ,zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dga' ston mchog
gru.english: This then has been The Six Yogas of the glorious Naropa, Those highest advices Of those accomplished masters, Telopa and Naropa. It is the highest feast Of the profound way of the diamond For infinite numbers Of fortunate ones, here in the Land of Snow.

gru.acip: SPYIR STON PA THUGS RJE CAN DES 'GRO BA RNAMS LA PHAN BDE BSGRUB PA'I SLAD DU, CHOS KYI RNAM GRANGS JI SNYED CIG GSUNGS PA THAMS CAD THEG PA CHE CHUNG GI SDE SNOD GNYIS SU 'DU ZHING,
gru.wylie: spyir ston pa thugs rje can des 'gro ba rnams la phan bde bsgrub pa'i slad du, chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis su 'du zhing
gru.english: Most generally, our Teacher--Lord Buddha, the Compassionate One--has presented us with a wide variety of spiritual teachings, all spoken for the purpose of bringing help and happiness to all living beings.  This entire body of teachings is subsumed by two groups: the teachings of the greater way, and those of the lesser way.

gru.acip: RNAL 'BYOR GYI RGYUD DE NYID BSDUS PA DANG, SGYU MA BDE MCHOG DANG, GSANG BA MDZOD KYI RGYUD DANG, RNAL 'BYOR GYI RGYUD DPAL MCHOG DANG PO DANG, RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED KYI RGYUD DANG, BZLAS PA DANG BRTUL ZHUGS DANG, SOGS KYIS SBYIN SREG DANG 'KHRUL 'KHOR SOGS KYIS DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA DE,
gru.wylie: rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang, sgyu ma bde mchog dang, gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud dang, rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po dang, rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang, bzlas pa dang brtul zhugs dang, sogs kyis sbyin sreg dang 'khrul 'khor sogs kyis dngos grub 'grub pa de
gru.english: Oh you can try to reach your spiritual attainments by studying the secret teachings of deep practice--the Summary of Suchness; the Highest Bliss of Illusion; the Hidden Book of the Treasure of Secrets; the secret text of deep practice known as The First of Highest Glory; the Secret Book of the Lord of Terror--or through the recitation of mantas, or spiritual austerities, or what our root text here calls "other means," referring to practices such as fire offerings or the physical poses of yoga.

gru.acip: GTZANG SBRA GSUM BYED PA 'DIR PHO NYA MO LA BRTEN PA'I BSAM GTAN TZAM GYIS NI, SNGAGS PAS SKAD CIG GIS TE MYUR DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR ZHES PA NI, PHO NYA LA BRTEN PA'I CHE BA STON NO,,
gru.wylie: gtsang sbra gsum byed pa 'dir pho nya mo la brten pa'i bsam gtan tsam gyis ni, sngags pas skad cig gis te myur du 'grub par 'gyur zhes pa ni, pho nya la brten pa'i che ba ston no
gru.english: But all you really need to do is use what they speak of here as the "three forms of purity": that is, the meditative practice where you utilize a Messenger.  With this alone a practitioner of the way of the secret word can, as the root text puts it, "reach their goals" in "a single instant," meaning with great speed.  This section of the text then is meant to convey to us the superiority of practice with a Messenger. * * * The great Pabongka Rinpoche Dechen Nyingpo (1878-1941) was the Root Lama of Kyabje Trijang Rinpoche, who in turn was the Root Lama of our own Root Lama, Khen Rinpoche Geshe Lobsang Tharchin, and of His Holiness the present Dalai Lama.  Pabongka Rinpoche is also of course the author of the famed lam-rim text, A Gift of Liberation, Thrust into Our Hands, as well as of most of the materials that we use in our principal tantric practice, the Angel of Diamond (Vajra Yogini).  In the selection here He gives an exquisite, concise connection of partner practice to our immediate and ultimate spiritual goals, from a work called Notes taken on the Occasion of an Oral Teaching for "The Ocean of Attainments," on the Stage of Creation in the Teachings of the Glorious Secret Collection (Guhya Samaja); and for "The Lamp that Illuminates the Five Stages," on the Stage of Completion (ACIP digital text S00326, f. 40b; the book is a transcript of one of the Rinpoche's oral teachings):

gru.acip: GSANG BA GRUB PA LAS, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA MNYAM LDAN PAS, ,RDO RJE PADMA MNYAM SBYOR BAS, ,BDEN PA GSUNG BAS MNGON SUM DU, ,'DI 'DRA'I SGOM PA GANG GSUNGS PA, ,DANG PO'I LAS CAN SEMS CAN LA, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA GANG SPANGS NAS, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI RAB STON PA, ,GZHAN GYI MTSON PAS MI MTHONG STE, ,DANG PO'I LAS PAS RIG PAR BYA, ,THOG MA BAR MTHA' DRI MED PA, ,RIG STE GZHAN DU NUS MA YIN, ,ZHES GSUNGS PAS SO,,
gru.wylie: gsang ba grub pa las, ,las kyi phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas, ,rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor bas, ,bden pa gsung bas mngon sum du, ,'di 'dra'i sgom pa gang gsungs pa, ,dang po'i las can sems can la, ,las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas, ,byang chub sems ni rab ston pa, ,gzhan gyi mtshon pas mi mthong ste, ,dang po'i las pas rig par bya, ,thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa, ,rig ste gzhan du nus ma yin, ,zhes gsungs pas so
gru.english: This fact is expressed in the text called Practicing in Secret: Have an actual partner And stay with them; Let the diamond rod And the lotus join; Come to the truth. Thus it is said, But suppose a person Who is just a beginner Gives up the practice Of an actual partner And fails to meditate As it's described here. They will never be able To see that element Of enlightenment as It's taught so well, Trying to bring A replication Through some other way. Those who are new To the practice should come To understand this fact, And come to knowledge In this way instead, With an immaculate Beginning, and middle, And end; there is No other way.

gru.acip: DE 'DRA BA'I RTEN 'BREL KHYAD PAR CAN SGRIG PA LA YANG G-YON PA'I KUN SPYOD KYI DAM TSIG RNAMS GAL CHE BA LA DGONGS NAS RTZA RGYUD LAS, ,PHYAG RGYA DANG BRAL GSANG SNGAGS NI, ,LUS CAN RNAMS LA 'GRUB MI 'GYUR, ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: de 'dra ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can sgrig pa la yang g-yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig rnams gal che ba la dgongs nas rtsa rgyud las, ,phyag rgya dang bral gsang sngags ni, ,lus can rnams la 'grub mi 'gyur, ,zhes dang
gru.english: The various pledges about acting to the left are of particular importance in setting up the causes for this sort of thing to happen; and that's why the secret root rext says, Anyone here in a body who tries To practice the secret word Without a partner can never Achieve the goals they seek.

gru.acip: ,DE BZHIN PHO NYA LEGS 'GROGS PAS, ,SGRUB PA PO YIS DNGOS GRUB 'THOB, ,BZLAS BRJOD BSAM GTAN MCHOD MED PAR, ,MYUR BA NYID DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ,SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS SGRUB PA POS, ,MCHOD PA NYID LA RAB TU 'JUG ,'DI LAS GZHAN PA'I MCHOD MED DE, ,DE LTAR BSTAN BCOS NGES PA YIN, ,PHO NYA'I LAM LA DGA' RNAMS KYI, ,SGRUB PA PO NI DNGOS GRUB 'GYUR, ,ZHES GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: de bzhin pho nya legs 'grogs pas, ,sgrub pa po yis dngos grub 'thob, ,bzlas brjod bsam gtan mchod med par, ,myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur, ,sngags dang phyag rgyas sgrub pa pos, ,mchod pa nyid la rab tu 'jug ,'di las gzhan pa'i mchod med de, ,de ltar bstan bcos nges pa yin, ,pho nya'i lam la dga' rnams kyi, ,sgrub pa po ni dngos grub 'gyur, ,zhes gsungs te
gru.english: It further says that, And just so a practitioner reaches their goals By finding a Messenger to be their companion. When you do, then you will reach your attainments With ultimate speed, even without Following any of the practices Of reciting, meditation, or offering. It's with the secret words and their partner That a practitioner engages in The very highest of offerings. There is no other offering, And on this the classical commentaries Are completely definite. And so it is those practitioners Who are attracted to the path Of the Messenger who reach their goals.

gru.acip: HE RU KA MNGON 'BYUNG LAS KYANG, ,DPA' BO GANG ZHIG PHYAG RGYA DMAN, ,SGRUB BO MCHOD PAR BYED PA NI, ,PHUB MA RDUNG DANG MTSUNGS PA STE, ZHES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: he ru ka mngon 'byung las kyang, ,dpa' bo gang zhig phyag rgya dman, ,sgrub bo mchod par byed pa ni, ,phub ma rdung dang mtshungs pa ste, zhes gsungs so
gru.english: The The Source of Realizations for the Practice of Heruka also says, Any warrior who attempts to practice And to make the offering With a lesser kind of partner Is like someone thrashing chaff. * * * The lead-in to the preceding section is also quoted directly from the same text by Je Tsongkapa.  In essence it is saying that the partner practice described next is the quickest way to enlightenment; if we love others, if we want to help stop the suffering of countless living beings on countless planets, then we owe it to them to learn and undertake this practice:

gru.acip: DE LTAR BYAS NA G-YON PAS MTSON PA'I SHES RAB NI DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD KYI SGRUB BYED YIN PAS, LAM 'DI'I RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN SKYE BA'I RTEN 'BREL DA LTA NAS SGRIG PA'I PHYIR DU G-YON PA'I KUN SPYOD RNAMS BYED DO,,
gru.wylie: de ltar byas na g-yon pas mtshon pa'i shes rab ni dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub byed yin pas, lam 'di'i rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba'i rten 'brel da lta nas sgrig pa'i phyir du g-yon pa'i kun spyod rnams byed do
gru.english: And so the left stands for wisdom, and wisdom is that thing which brings about each and every attainment.  This then leads to why we act to the left: we are--from the present moment--setting up all the conditions which will bring us extraordinary realizations of this path.

gru.acip: YID SKYOB PA'I SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAR YANG DAG PAR LDAN PA'I SGRUB PA PO NYID NI DNGOS GRUB MCHOG SGRUB PA LA BRTZON PA YIN PAS, PHYAG RGYA LA SBYOR BA DANG BRAL BA'I GSANG SNGAGS NI, LUS CAN TE SGRUB PA PO RNAMS LA 'GRUB MI 'GYUR BA STE 'GRUB PAR SHIN TU DKA'O,,
gru.wylie: yid skyob pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyar yang dag par ldan pa'i sgrub pa po nyid ni dngos grub mchog sgrub pa la brtson pa yin pas, phyag rgya la sbyor ba dang bral ba'i gsang sngags ni, lus can te sgrub pa po rnams la 'grub mi 'gyur ba ste 'grub par shin tu dka'o
gru.english: The point is that only a practitioner who truly possesses the way of the secret word--a way which protects our minds*--as well as a spiritual partner is someone who is making true efforts in reaching the highest goal.  Thus a practitioner of the way of the secret word who is without this kind of union with a partner--anybody "here in a body," meaning in this context a person who is engaged in spiritual practice, but who lacks the partner--will "never achieve the goals they seek," which is to say that they will find it extremely difficult to achieve these goals. *Translator's note: This is an allusion to the literal explanation of the word "mantra": that which protects (tra) the mind (man). * * * Je Tsongkapa repeats his thoughts on the speed of the path of the partner, and the need for us to engage in it, in his Illumination of Every Secret Point (ACIP digital text S05316, f. 18a)--

gru.acip: SPYIR GSANG SNGAGS BLA MED PA'I SGRUB PA PO THAMS CAD LA PHO NYA MO MTSAN NYID TSANG BAS GROGS BYAS NA LAM MYUR BA YIN PA LA, KHYAD PAR DU BDE MCHOG GI LAM LEGS PAR SHES NAS SGRUB PA BYED PA RNAMS LA, MKHA' 'GRO MA'I PHO NYA MO KHYAD PAR CAN RNAMS KYIS BYIN GYIS RLOB PA DANG, LAM GYI GROGS MDZAD PA CHES MYUR BA YIN PAS
gru.wylie: spyir gsang sngags bla med pa'i sgrub pa po thams cad la pho nya mo mtshan nyid tshang bas grogs byas na lam myur ba yin pa la, khyad par du bde mchog gi lam legs par shes nas sgrub pa byed pa rnams la, mkha' 'gro ma'i pho nya mo khyad par can rnams kyis byin gyis rlob pa dang, lam gyi grogs mdzad pa ches myur ba yin pas
gru.english: Looking at it in a general way, we can say that each and every person who ever practices the secret teachings of the unsurpassed group travels their path with greater speed if they have, as their companion, a Messenger lady who possesses the requisite qualifications. More particularly, those who educate themselves well in the path of Sanvara, the Angel of Highest Bliss, travel the path with infinitely greater speed if they are granted the blessings of special Messengers, Ladies of the Sky, and if these Ladies become their companions.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NI, GTZANG SBRA GSUM BYAS PA LAS BYUNG BA'I BSOD NAMS SU GANG GYUR BA, SGRUB PA PO'I YON TAN RGYA CHEN PO NI SMRA BAR NUS PAR 'OS PA MA YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa ni, gtsang sbra gsum byas pa las byung ba'i bsod nams su gang gyur ba, sgrub pa po'i yon tan rgya chen po ni smra bar nus par 'os pa ma yin no
gru.english: Here is our second point from above.  The amount of merit produced by performing the practice of the three purities--the vast good qualities of a person who undertakes such a practice--are not something that could ever properly be expressed.

gru.acip: LO CHEN GYI 'GYUR LAS, SGRUB PA PO'I YON TAN RGYA CHEN PO, ,STONG PHRAG GCIG PA'I ZHAL MIN PAR, ,KHA CIG GIS NI BRJOD MI NUS, ,ZHES 'BYUNG NGO,,
gru.wylie: lo chen gyi 'gyur las, sgrub pa po'i yon tan rgya chen po, ,stong phrag gcig pa'i zhal min par, ,kha cig gis ni brjod mi nus, ,zhes 'byung ngo
gru.english: The translation from Sanskrit into the Tibetan executed by Lochen reads the lines here as-- If the vast good qualities Of such a practitioner Could never be expressed By a thousand sets of lips, How then could they be By one?

gru.acip: CI'I PHYIR SGRUB PA PO PHAN YON DE LTA BU DANG LDAN PAR 'BYUNG ZHE NA, DPAL HE RU KA NYID YE SHES CHEN PO YIN LA, NYON MONGS PAS RNAM PAR DAG PA'I YON TAN GYI MTSAN NYID STOBS BCU LA SOGS PA KUN TSANG BA DE LTA BUR RNAL 'BYOR PA YANG 'GYUR BAS PHAN YON CHE'O,,
gru.wylie: ci'i phyir sgrub pa po phan yon de lta bu dang ldan par 'byung zhe na, dpal he ru ka nyid ye shes chen po yin la, nyon mongs pas rnam par dag pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid stobs bcu la sogs pa kun tshang ba de lta bur rnal 'byor pa yang 'gyur bas phan yon che'o
gru.english: You may well ask then why such extraordinary benefits would accrue to such a practitioner.  The "One of Great Wisdom" mentioned here in the root text is none other than the glorious Heruka himself; and He possesses, in their entirety, attributes such as the ten powers--examples of high qualities where one is completely free of the mental afflictions.  The benefits then are great because a person who engages in these deep practices becomes the same.

gru.acip: SGRUB PA PO PHO NYA MO DANG GNYIS SU MED PAR SBYOR BA LAS BYUNG BA YI BDE BA'I CHU STE BDE STONG GNYIS SU MED PA NYID GNYIS SU MED PAR SBYOR BA'I SGRUB PA PO YIS, REG PA STE BSTEN PAS GZHAN GYI LUS LA REG PA DANG NI GTAM SMRAS PAS KYANG DAG PAR BYED CING, SDIG PA 'JOMS PAR BYED PAS, SDIG PA KUN LAS GROL BAR 'GYUR NA RNAL 'BYOR PA LTA CI SMOS,
gru.wylie: sgrub pa po pho nya mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba las byung ba yi bde ba'i chu ste bde stong gnyis su med pa nyid gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i sgrub pa po yis, reg pa ste bsten pas gzhan gyi lus la reg pa dang ni gtam smras pas kyang dag par byed cing, sdig pa 'joms par byed pas, sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur na rnal 'byor pa lta ci smos
gru.english: Consider then the liquid of bliss that is produced when the practitioner and the Messenger lady go into indivisible union.  Suppose that the practitioner who has engaged in this indivisible union takes this very same liquid, which is itself none other than indivisible bliss and emptiness, and touches--which is to say uses--it. They can then go on and touch other people, or engage them in conversation, and with no more than this the other person is made pure: their bad deeds are destroyed, they are freed from all bad deeds.  What need then is there to mention what it does to the practitioner themselves?

gru.acip: PHYAG RGYA MTSAN NYID PA LA BRTEN TSUL RGYUD NAS BSHAD PA BZHIN BYAS NA LAM 'GRUB PA TZAM DU MA ZAD, MYUR BA YANG YIN TE,
gru.wylie: phyag rgya mtshan nyid pa la brten tshul rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin byas na lam 'grub pa tsam du ma zad, myur ba yang yin te
gru.english: It's not just that one reaches the goals of the path if they practice, as the secret teachings describe it, properly with a qualified spiritual partner.  This method is also faster.

gru.acip: DE NYID LAS, ,DE BZHIN PHO NYA LEGS 'GROGS PAS, ,SGRUB PA PO YIS DNGOS GRUB THOB, ,BZLAS BRJOD BSAM GTAN MCHOD MED PAR, ,MYUR BA NYID DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR DANG,
gru.wylie: de nyid las, ,de bzhin pho nya legs 'grogs pas, ,sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob, ,bzlas brjod bsam gtan mchod med par, ,myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur, ,zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang
gru.english: As the very same work [the Shorter Root Tantra of Highest Bliss] puts it, Any practitioner who takes on well A Messenger as we've described it Will reach their spiritual goals. In fact they will do so with perfect speed, Even without performing practices Such as reciting mantras, Or meditation, or making offerings.

gru.acip: 'DI'I BSHAD RGYUD DU MA LAS KYANG GSUNGS TE, HE RU KA MNGON 'BYUNG DANG ,SAM BHU tI DANG, RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO DANG, MKHA' 'GRO RGYA MTSO SOGS NAS BSHAD CING ,DNGOS GRUB SNYE MA LAS KYANG DE LTAR BYA NUS PA NAS PHYI'I RKYEN PHO NYA MO MTSAN NYID TSANG BA LA BRTEN NAS LAM CHES MYUR BAR 'GYUR GYI, GZHAN DU MIN PAS THABS DE GTZO BO YIN TE, ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: 'di'i bshad rgyud du ma las kyang gsungs te, he ru ka mngon 'byung dang ,sam bhu Ti dang, rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang, mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs nas bshad cing ,dngos grub snye ma las kyang de ltar bya nus pa nas phyi'i rkyen pho nya mo mtshan nyid tshang ba la brten nas lam ches myur bar 'gyur gyi, gzhan du min pas thabs de gtso bo yin te, zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: This is also stated in a great many of the explanatory tantras upon this same root tantra--in works including the Source of Realizations for Heruka; The Kiss; The Diamond Angel; and The Ocean of the Angels.  The Golden Harvest of Attainments also states that "Once you are able to do so, then you practice with the outer aid of a Messenger lady who possesses all the required qualifications--and your journey along the path becomes infinitely more quick.  There is in fact no other way for this to happen, and so we say that this is the main method of all." * * * Again in His Lamp that Illuminates the Essence (ACIP digital text S00299), Choney Lama clarifies why Lord Buddha taught both the "path which uses desire" (practice with a partner) and the "path free of desire" (ff. 41b-42a):

gru.acip: DKA' THUB BSTEN NA BYANG SEMS NYAMS PA'I RGYU BYAS NAS BDE CHEN GYI YE SHES BSKYED MI NUS PAS MCHOG MYUR DU 'GRUB PA LA GEGS BYED PA'I PHYIR TE,
gru.wylie: dka' thub bsten na byang sems nyams pa'i rgyu byas nas bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed mi nus pas mchog myur du 'grub pa la gegs byed pa'i phyir te
gru.english: If then we instead deprive ourselves of these pleasures, it causes the depletion of our element of enlightenment.  We are then unable to produce the wisdom of great bliss, which in turn acts as an obstacle to our achieving the highest goal swiftly.

gru.acip: 'DUS PA'I RTZA RGYUD LAS, ,DKA' THUB SDOM PA MI BZAD PAS, ,BSTEN KYANG 'GRUB PAR MI 'GYUR GYI, ,'DOD PA'I LONGS SPYOD THAMS CAD LA, ,BSTEN NA MYUR DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las, ,dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas, ,bsten kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi, ,'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la, ,bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur, ,zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: As the root tantra of the Secret Collection (Guhya Samaja) puts it, We can rely on strict and tortuous Practices where we deny ourselves, But they will not bring us attainments. If instead we utilize each and every Enjoyment of the senses, We reach our goals with speed. * * * We are all familiar with Je Tsongkapa's Great Book on the Steps of the Path to Enlightenment, called in Tibetan the Lam-Rim Chenmo--perhaps the greatest spiritual classic ever written in the Tibetan language.  The Master wrote a parallel work for the secret teachings called The Great Book on the Stages of the Way of the Secret Word, with the longer name of The Revelation of Vital Points of All the Secrets: A Book on the Stages of the Path in the Practice of the Lord over the Secret World of All the Victors, the Great Keeper of the Diamond (Vajradhara), which is ACIP digital text S05281.  At one point in this text (f. 434a) Je Rinpoche describes how Tibet's master meditator, the holy Milarepa, felt about practice with a partner--

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB RJE'I GSUNG ZIN BRIS LAS, SROG RTZOL GSUM DANG KHYAD PAR DU RDOR BZLAS TE NANG GI RKYEN GSUM DANG, PHYI'I RKYEN NI RIM LNGA LAS, SGYU MA DAG NI THAMS CAD LAS, ,ZHES PA NAS, GSAL BAR 'DI LAS MTSON PAR NUS, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR, PHYAG RGYA SROG RTZOL DU SONG BA STE PHYI NANG GI RKYEN DE DAG LA BRTEN NAS SEMS DBEN GYI YE SHES BSKYED NUS KYI, ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: mkhas grub rje'i gsung zin bris las, srog rtsol gsum dang khyad par du rdor bzlas te nang gi rkyen gsum dang, phyi'i rkyen ni rim lnga las, sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las, ,zhes pa nas, gsal bar 'di las mtshon par nus, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar, phyag rgya srog rtsol du song ba ste phyi nang gi rkyen de dag la brten nas sems dben gyi ye shes bskyed nus kyi, zhes dang
gru.english: This is true because Kedrup Je's Notes further say, One is capable of giving rise to the wisdom of transcendent mind by relying upon the outer and inner factors.  The inner factors are three, with the three different practices for mastering the life-wind, and most especially the recitation of the diamonds.  The outer factor is using practice with a partner as a method of  mastering the life-wind, as expressed in the lines from The Five Stages which begin with "Of all the different illusions before us..." and continue up to "...Are clearly replicated with one of these."

gru.acip: 'DI LA MKHAS PA KHA CIG NA RE, SEMS DBEN MTHAR THUG GI YE SHES GSUM SKYED PA LA LAS RGYA BRTEN DGOS PA NI RIM LNGA'I GZHUNG 'DI'I DGONGS PA YIN GYI SEMS DBEN TZAM LA MIN TE, GSAL SGRON LAS, SGYU LUS KYI SGRUB GZHI'I SEMS DBEN GYI YE SHES GSUM RDZOGS PAR SKYED PA LA PHYI'I PHYAG RGYA DGOS SO, ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: 'di la mkhas pa kha cig na re, sems dben mthar thug gi ye shes gsum skyed pa la las rgya brten dgos pa ni rim lnga'i gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa yin gyi sems dben tsam la min te, gsal sgron las, sgyu lus kyi sgrub gzhi'i sems dben gyi ye shes gsum rdzogs par skyed pa la phyi'i phyag rgya dgos so, ,zhes dang
gru.english: On this, some sages express the following opinion-- The actual intent of these lines from the Five Stages is to say that we need to practice with an actual partner in order to give birth to the three wisdoms of the ultimate form of transcendent mind.  The text is not though saying this about reaching the stage of transcendent mind as a whole.  This is reflected in the following statement from The Lamp which Illuminates: In order to give rise, completely, to the three different forms of the wisdom of transcendent mind which act as the material from which the body of illusion is made, one needs an outer partner.

gru.acip: 'DI LA KHA CIG NA RE, TSE 'DIR 'TSANG RGYA BA LA LAS RGYA NGES PAR BSTEN DGOS PA'I MA MTHA' SA MTSAMS NI SEMS DBEN THOB PA NAS YIN TE, YE SHES RDO RJE KUN LAS BTUS PA'I t'I KA LAS, 'DIR PHYAG RGYA DANG STONG PA GSUM RJES SU 'GRO LDOG NGES PAR GSUNGS PA NI, SGYU MA'I SKU SGRUB NUS PA'I SEMS DBEN GYI STONG PA GSUM RDZOGS PAR SKYE BA PHYAG RGYA LA NGES PAR LTOS PA LA DGONGS PA YIN TE,
gru.wylie: 'di la kha cig na re, tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba la las rgya nges par bsten dgos pa'i ma mtha' sa mtshams ni sems dben thob pa nas yin te, ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i TI ka las, 'dir phyag rgya dang stong pa gsum rjes su 'gro ldog nges par gsungs pa ni, sgyu ma'i sku sgrub nus pa'i sems dben gyi stong pa gsum rdzogs par skye ba phyag rgya la nges par ltos pa la dgongs pa yin te
gru.english: On this, others express the following opinion: The point at which it does finally become absolutely necessary to practice with an actual partner is once one has attained transcendent mind.  This is true because the commentary entitled The Complete Compendium of the Diamond of Wisdom states: The statement here that a partner and the three forms of emptiness are such that where one is there, the other comes; and where one is missing, the other cannot come; is made with the intention of saying that--if we hope to see the three forms of emptiness within transcendent mind arise, the form of transcendent mind that has the power to bring about the body of illusion--then we must necessarily practice with a partner.

gru.acip: YANG KHA CIG NA RE, LAS RGYA BSTEN DGOS PA'I MTSAMS SEMS DBEN THOB PA NAS YIN ZER BA MI 'THAD DE, GANG ZAG MTSAN NYID TSANG BA LA RIM GNYIS SGOM PA'I SNGON DU DBANG GSUM PA DNGOS DBANG DU BSKUR BA YOD PA GANG ZHIG ,GSANG BA GRUB PA LAS, LAS DANG PO BAS PHYI'I PHYAG RGYA'I THABS SPANGS NA THABS GZHAN GYIS DGA' BZHI'I LHAN SKYES MTSON DU MED PAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR NA MA KHYAB STE,
gru.wylie: yang kha cig na re, las rgya bsten dgos pa'i mtshams sems dben thob pa nas yin zer ba mi 'thad de, gang zag mtshan nyid tshang ba la rim gnyis sgom pa'i sngon du dbang gsum pa dngos dbang du bskur ba yod pa gang zhig ,gsang ba grub pa las, las dang po bas phyi'i phyag rgya'i thabs spangs na thabs gzhan gyis dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes mtshon du med par gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste
gru.english: Someone might come and make yet another argument: It's incorrect to say that the point at which one must practice with an actual partner begins from when one has attained transcendent mind.  This is true because (1) there do exist cases where one can impart the third empowerment in its actual form to persons who possess the necessary qualities, even before they begin their practice of the two stages of the secret teachings; and (2) the text of Practicing in Secret says that beginners who give up on the method of practicing with an outer partner cannot bring about the simultaneous wisdom of the four forms of bliss with any other method. Our reply to this is that--although the latter two points are true--they don't necessarily imply the former.

gru.acip: MTSAN LDAN MA DANG SBYOR PA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYIS RDO RJE 'CHANG GIS TSE 'DIR MNGON DU BYED MI NUS PA'I RNAL 'BYOR PAS KYANG BAR DOR NGES PAR 'GRUB BO ZHES GSUNGS,
gru.wylie: mtshan ldan ma dang sbyor pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdo rje 'chang gis tshe 'dir mngon du byed mi nus pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang bar dor nges par 'grub bo zhes gsungs
gru.english: The Keeper of the Diamond [Vajradhara, the form that Lord Buddha took to grant the secret teachings] himself has stated that even a deep practitioner who lacks the capacity to reach enlightenment in the present life will, without fail, reach it in the intermediate state--if they engage in the deep practice of union with a "woman of the mark" [which is a poeticism for all human women, since during most of their lives they are "marked" each month with their menstrual period].

gru.acip: DE LA'ANG RTZA 'TSOL BA SOGS PHYAG RGYA SROG RTZOL GYI GNAD SHES DGOS PAS DE DAG NI 'DIR PHYOGS TZAM YANG 'DRIR MI LANG GIS, ,'JAM MGON TZONG KHA PA CHEN PO YAB SRAS DANG, RJES 'BRANG, MKHAS GRUB CHEN PO DAG GI GSUNG LAS RTOGS PAR BYA,
gru.wylie: de la'ang rtsa 'tshol ba sogs phyag rgya srog rtsol gyi gnad shes dgos pas de dag ni 'dir phyogs tsam yang 'drir mi lang gis, ,'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po yab sras dang, rjes 'brang, mkhas grub chen po dag gi gsung las rtogs par bya
gru.english: To carry out this practice, you're going to have to know all the crucial points of working with your partner's life-winds: how to find where their channel comes down to their sexual organ, and so on.  I don't have space in this particular text to write even a rough description of these subjects, and so you should learn them by referring to the writings of our Gentle Protector, the great Tsongakapa, and those of later followers of His tradition, and other great wise and accomplished beings. * * * And the Rinpoche concludes in the same text again with the following (ff. 68b-69a):

gru.acip: BDE STONG SBYOR 'DOD NAS BYED PA GTAN MIN PA DANG DBANG DANG DAM TSIG THUN MONG MA YIN PAS SNOD RUNG DU BSGRUB PA DANG, YUL RTEN GNYIS SNGAGS DANG LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA SOGS PAS SBYANGS PA'I THABS MKHAS KYANG MED PAS, LAM DER PHYAG RGYA'I SBYOR BAS SA GSUM BZA' BAR BYA ZHES MI GSUNG NGO,,
gru.wylie: bde stong sbyor 'dod nas byed pa gtan min pa dang dbang dang dam tshig thun mong ma yin pas snod rung du bsgrub pa dang, yul rten gnyis sngags dang lha'i rnal 'byor la sogs pas sbyangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyang med pas, lam der phyag rgya'i sbyor bas sa gsum bza' bar bya zhes mi gsung ngo
gru.english: That though is not in any way done out of a desire to combine bliss and emptiness; and in that path, there is no custom of making the disciple a proper vessel by granting them empowerment, and unique commitments.  Nor in that path do there exist unexpected spiritual means such as where the person seeking union and the person they seek to perform union with engage in practices of mantra, and in turning themselves into Angels.  We could not say then that in the open path of the greater way the three realms had been "devoured" through union with a partner.

gru.acip: DE BSGOMS PAS NYON SGRIB TU MA ZAD SHES SGRIB SPANGS PA'I MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB KYANG TSE 'DIR 'GRUB PAR GO NUS PAS LAM GYI GNAD RNAMS LA RKANG TSUGS PA'I NGES PA RNYED PAR 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: de bsgoms pas nyon sgrib tu ma zad shes sgrib spangs pa'i mchog gi dngos grub kyang tshe 'dir 'grub par go nus pas lam gyi gnad rnams la rkang tshugs pa'i nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ro
gru.english: And then finally they comprehend that--if they do their meditations this way--then they will not only finish off the obstacles to nirvana that exist within their minds, but also be able to eliminate the obstacles to omniscience.  Which is to say, they will reach the highest spiritual achievement of all, here in this current life.  In short, they reach an incontrovertible mastery of the crucial points of the path. * * * Je Tsongkapa continues, in the same text--the Golden Harvest of Attainments--with some material on partner practice that we've seen influenced later writers on the subject (ff. 24a-25a):

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, NYUNG NGU'I RTZA RGYUD LAS, ,PHYAG RGYA DANG BRAL GSANG SNGAGS NI, ,LUS CAN RNAMS LA 'GRUB MI 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, nyung ngu'i rtsa rgyud las, ,phyag rgya dang bral gsang sngags ni, ,lus can rnams la 'grub mi 'gyur
gru.english: Here is the first.  As the Briefer Root Tantra puts it, Anyone here in a body who tries To practice the secret word Without a partner can never Achieve the goals they seek.

gru.acip: ,ZHES SHES RAB MA'I PHYAG RGYA LA BRTEN PA DANG BRAL NA LAM GZHAN GYIS MI 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS SHING,
gru.wylie: zhes shes rab ma'i phyag rgya la brten pa dang bral na lam gzhan gyis mi 'grub par gsungs shing
gru.english: What this is saying is that if we fail to practice with a spiritual partner, a Woman of Wisdom, and try to use some other path, we will not reach our spiritual goals.

gru.acip: YANG DE NYID LAS, ,DE BZHIN PHO NYA LEGS 'GROGS PAS, ,SGRUB PA PO YIS DNGOS GRUB 'THOB, ,BZLAS BRJOD BSAM GTAN MCHOD MED PAR, ,MYUR BA NYID DU 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: yang de nyid las, ,de bzhin pho nya legs 'grogs pas, ,sgrub pa po yis dngos grub 'thob, ,bzlas brjod bsam gtan mchod med par, ,myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur
gru.english: And just so a practitioner reaches their goals By finding a Messenger to be their companion. When you do, then you will reach your attainments With ultimate speed, even without Following any of the practices Of reciting, meditation, or offering.

gru.acip: ,SNGAGS DANG PHYAG RGYAS SGRUB PA POS, ,MCHOD PA NYID LA RAB TU 'JUG ,'DI LAS GZHAN PA'I MCHOD MED DE, ,DE LTAR BSTAN BCOS NGES PA YIN,
gru.wylie: sngags dang phyag rgyas sgrub pa pos, ,mchod pa nyid la rab tu 'jug ,'di las gzhan pa'i mchod med de, ,de ltar bstan bcos nges pa yin
gru.english: It's with the secret words and their partner That a practitioner engages in The very highest of offerings. There is no other offering, And on this the classical commentaries Are completely definite.

gru.acip: ,PHO NYA'I LAM LA DGA' RNAMS KYI, ,SGRUB PA PO NI DNGOS GRUB 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: pho nya'i lam la dga' rnams kyi, ,sgrub pa po ni dngos grub 'gyur
gru.english: And so it is those practitioners Who are attracted to the path Of the Messenger who reach their goals.

gru.acip: ZHES RKANG PA DANG PO GNYIS DANG GSUM PAS PHO NYA'I LAM GYIS PHYI'I BZLAS BRJOD SOGS DANG BRAL YANG 'GRUB PA DANG, MYUR BAR 'GRUB PA YANG DE'I MTHUS YIN PAR GSUNGS TE, RIM PA DANG PO'I SKABS SU BZLAS BRJOD SOGS BYED PA SNGON DU GTONG BA 'GOG PA MIN NO,,
gru.wylie: zhes rkang pa dang po gnyis dang gsum pas pho nya'i lam gyis phyi'i bzlas brjod sogs dang bral yang 'grub pa dang, myur bar 'grub pa yang de'i mthus yin par gsungs te, rim pa dang po'i skabs su bzlas brjod sogs byed pa sngon du gtong ba 'gog pa min no
gru.english: The part above that starts with "And just so..." and goes to "...and reach your attainments," along with the part from "even without..." up to "...offering," are saying that--if one practices the path of the Messenger--then they will reach their spiritual goals, even if they aren't following any outer practice of reciting the mantra, and so on.  And it's the power of this same partner practice, says this text, which enables us to reach these goals with great speed.  This of course is not to preclude engaging in practices such as the recitation of mantras earlier on, at the point when we are working on the first of the two stages of the secret path.

gru.acip: GSANG BA GRUB PA LAS, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA MNYAM LDAN PAS, ,RDO RJE PADMA MNYAM SBYOR BAS, ,BDEN PA GSUNG PAS MNGON SUM DU, ,'DI 'DRA'I BSGOM PA GANG GSUNGS PA, ,DANG PO'I LAS CAN SEMS CAN LA, ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA GANG SPANGS NAS, ,BYANG CHUB SEMS NI RAB STON PA, ,GZHAN GYIS MTSON PAS MI MTHONG STE, ,DANG PO'I LAS PAS RIG PAR BYA, ,THOG MA BAR MTHA' DRI MED PA, ,RIG STE GZHAN DU NUS MA YIN, ,ZHES GSUNGS PAS SO,,
gru.wylie: gsang ba grub pa las, ,las kyi phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas, ,rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor bas, ,bden pa gsung pas mngon sum du, ,'di 'dra'i bsgom pa gang gsungs pa, ,dang po'i las can sems can la, ,las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas, ,byang chub sems ni rab ston pa, ,gzhan gyis mtshon pas mi mthong ste, ,dang po'i las pas rig par bya, ,thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa, ,rig ste gzhan du nus ma yin, ,zhes gsungs pas so
gru.english: This fact is expressed in the text called Practicing in Secret: Have an actual partner And stay with them; Let the diamond rod And the lotus join; Come to the truth. Thus it is said, But suppose a person Who is just a beginner Gives up the practice Of an actual partner And fails to meditate As it's described here. They will never be able To see that element Of enlightenment as It's taught so well, Trying to bring A replication Through some other way. Those who are new To the practice should come To understand this fact, And come to knowledge In this way instead, With an immaculate Beginning, and middle, And end; there is No other way.

gru.acip: HE RU KA MNGON 'BYUNG LAS KYANG, ,DPA' BO GANG ZHIG PHYAG RGYA DMAN, ,SGRUB PO MCHOD PAR BYED PA NI, ,PHUB MA BRDUNG DANG MTSUNGS PA STE, ,ZHES GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: he ru ka mngon 'byung las kyang, ,dpa' bo gang zhig phyag rgya dman, ,sgrub po mchod par byed pa ni, ,phub ma brdung dang mtshungs pa ste, ,zhes gsungs so
gru.english: The The Source of Realizations for the Practice of Heruka also says, Any warrior who attempts to practice And to make the offering With a lesser kind of partner Is like someone thrashing chaff. * * * Pabongka Rinpoche Dechen Nyingpo was a reincarnation of the Lamas of the Changkya line, eminent sages and secret practitioners.  The second Changkya Rinpoche was Changkya Ngawang Lobsang Chunden (1642-1714); his Ritual for Imparting an Empowerment into the Forty-Five Secret Worlds combining the String and Kriya (ACIP digital text S00153) includes the following section on the need for partner practice (ff. 194b-195a):

gru.acip: ,'DI DE SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI, ,RIG MA'I BRTUL ZHUGS BLA NA MED, ,RMONGS PA GANG GIS 'DA' BYED PA, ,DE LA MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB MED,
gru.wylie: 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi, ,rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med, ,rmongs pa gang gis 'da' byed pa, ,de la mchog gi dngos grub med
gru.english: This is unsurpassed austerity Of the Woman of Knowledge, Followed by every single Buddha that there is. Any ignorant fool Who leaves this path behind Can never reach the highest Of all spiritual attainments.

gru.acip: DE'I PHYIR RIG MA BRTEN PA'I THABS 'DI DANG BRAL PAR NI KHYOD KYIS NAM YANG MA BYED CIG RIG MA MTSAN NYID TSANG BA LA BRTEN NAS BDE BA CHEN PO'I TING NGE 'DZIN SGRUB PA 'DI SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI RIG MA'I BRTUL ZHUGS BLA NA MED PA DE YIN PAS,
gru.wylie: de'i phyir rig ma brten pa'i thabs 'di dang bral par ni khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig rig ma mtshan nyid tshang ba la brten nas bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med pa de yin pas
gru.english: "Therefore you must never allow yourself to be separated from "this very one," meaning this particular method, of practicing with a Woman of Knowledge.  By practicing with a Woman of Knowledge who possesses each and every one of the requisite qualifications, you will reach the meditative state of great bliss.  This then is the unsurpassed austerity of the Woman of Knowledge, and it is followed by every single Buddha that there is.

gru.acip: DE 'DRA BA'I 'DOD YON LAM BYED LA RMONGS PA GANG GIS 'DA' BAR BYED PA DE LA TSE 'DIR NI MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA MED DE, DE 'DRA'I 'DOD YON LAM BYED DE NI MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB 'GRUB PA'I NYE RGYU'I GTZO BO MED MI RUNG YIN PA'I PHYIR RO, ,ZHES PA STE DE LTA BU GO BAR BYAS LA RIG MA'I BRTUL ZHUGS SBYIN,
gru.wylie: de 'dra ba'i 'dod yon lam byed la rmongs pa gang gis 'da' bar byed pa de la tshe 'dir ni mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa med de, de 'dra'i 'dod yon lam byed de ni mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa'i nye rgyu'i gtso bo med mi rung yin pa'i phyir ro, ,zhes pa ste de lta bu go bar byas la rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin
gru.english: "Any ignorant fool who leaves behind this practice of taking objects of desire as their path can never reach the highest of all spiritual attainments here in this life.  And this is because turning objects of desire into a path in this way is the primary immediate cause for reaching this highest of attainments--it is an absolute necessity." Speak thus, for granting your disciple an understanding of these things is in itself to grant them the empowerment of the Austerity of the Woman of Knowledge. * * * His Holiness the First Panchen Lama, Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen (1565-1662), has an interesting answer to the question of the need for an actual partner at a specific point in the five traditional stages of secret practice in His Treasure House of Jewels: An Explanation of the "Five Stages" written by the Protector, Nagarjuna (ACIP digital text S00264; note that this text is one of those by His Holiness which was apparently missed by the authors of the standard Tohoku catalog, thus the low ACIP number, ff. 40a-40b).

gru.acip: MI DGOS TE, SEMS DBEN MTHAR THUG BSKYED PA'I SGRUB PA PO GANG ZHIG ,KUN RDZOB KYI CHU SKYES DANG RDO RJE SBYOR BA RGYUN DU MED PAR GYUR NA YANG, SNGAR DBANG DUS SOGS SU LAN CIG TZAM ZHIG LAS RGYA LAS MYONG ZHING MTSON PA'I DON DE NYID RGYUN LDAN DU BSGOM PA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI STOBS KYIS TE YE SHES KYI PHYAG RGYA LA BRTEN NAS KYANG 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR BA'I PHYIR TE,
gru.wylie: mi dgos te, sems dben mthar thug bskyed pa'i sgrub pa po gang zhig ,kun rdzob kyi chu skyes dang rdo rje sbyor ba rgyun du med par gyur na yang, sngar dbang dus sogs su lan cig tsam zhig las rgya las myong zhing mtshon pa'i don de nyid rgyun ldan du bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis te ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir te
gru.english: It is not.  There could exist a practitioner who had been able to produce the ultimate form of transcendent mind within them, but without a continual practice of the union of the deceptive form of a child of the lake [meaning a lotus, or the woman's vagina] joined to the diamond [the man's penis]. We are assuming here that earlier on, during their tantric empowerment or on some other occasion, they had already enjoyed--just one single time--an experience with an actual partner, and at that point reached a replication of higher wisdom.  They then took that understanding and meditated upon it on a continual basis.  Due to the power of this deep practice, they were able as well to utilize an imaginary partner, and thus achieve this goal.

gru.acip: 'O NA GANG YIN SNYAM NA, SANGS RGYAS SGRUB BYED KYI LAM GYI GTZO BO NI RDZOGS RIM YIN LA, DE LA'ANG THABS DANG THABS BYUNG GNYIS KYI PHYI MA GTZO BO YIN NO,,
gru.wylie: 'o na gang yin snyam na, sangs rgyas sgrub byed kyi lam gyi gtso bo ni rdzogs rim yin la, de la'ang thabs dang thabs byung gnyis kyi phyi ma gtso bo yin no
gru.english: "How does all this work?" you may ask.  The primary path that brings us to the attainment of Buddhahood is the stage of completion; here there are methods, and the things that the methods produce--and of these, the latter are primary.

gru.acip: CHAGS LAM GYIS CHAGS PA LAM DU BYA BA'I PHYIR DU GSUNGS PA'I LAM NI, GNYIS KA LA 'DRA MOD KYANG CHAGS PA LAM DU BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS BDE BA CHEN PO SKYE LUGS DANG, DE NYID KYIS MCHOG 'GRUB LUGS GTZO BOR BSHAD PA NA,
gru.wylie: chags lam gyis chags pa lam du bya ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i lam ni, gnyis ka la 'dra mod kyang chags pa lam du byas pa la brten nas bde ba chen po skye lugs dang, de nyid kyis mchog 'grub lugs gtso bor bshad pa na
gru.english: The two are admittedly similar in how they describe a special path that was taught so that people could use the path of desire as a way of turning desire into a path.  One of them though is primarily devoted to describing  how--by turning desire into a path--we give rise to great bliss; and then how we use this same bliss to achieve our highest goals.

gru.acip: TSUL DE THEG PA GZHAN DANG RGYUD SDE 'OG MA LA MED PA'I KHYAD CHOS SU MTHONG ZHING, DE'ANG LAM SHIN TU 'JUG PA BDE LA MYUR BAR MTHONG NAS LAM 'DI LA MCHOG TU GUS PA SKYE ZHING BRTZON 'GRUS KYANG 'BAR BAR 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: tshul de theg pa gzhan dang rgyud sde 'og ma la med pa'i khyad chos su mthong zhing, de'ang lam shin tu 'jug pa bde la myur bar mthong nas lam 'di la mchog tu gus pa skye zhing brtson 'grus kyang 'bar bar 'gyur ro
gru.english: See this way of doing it as a special feature which is lacking in the other ways of the teaching, and in the lower groups of the secret word.  And see it as well as a path which is extremely easy to engage in, and much more fast.  Because then you will feel the highest regard for it, and you will be set on fire to throw yourself into it. * * * Here is a further and very sophisticated opinion on the need for an actual partner at certain parts of the five stages, this time from His Holiness the First Panchen Lama's Sun which Illuminates Every Profound Point: A Collection of All the Essential and Crucial Sections of "The Lamp that Illuminates, Totally, the Teaching on the Five Stages; a Book of Advices on the King of All Secret Teachings, the Glorious Secret Collection (Guhya Samaja)" (ACIP digital text S00266--another text apparently missed by the Tohoku Catalog, selection from ff. 49b-51a).

gru.acip: RIM LNGA LAS, ,GANG ZHIG CHU SKYES RDO RJE SBYOR, ,KUN RDZOB TU YANG MED GYUR NA, ,LAN CIG TZAM ZHIG MYONG NAS KYANG, ,RNAL 'BYOR STOBS KYIS 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR, ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
gru.wylie: rim lnga las, ,gang zhig chu skyes rdo rje sbyor, ,kun rdzob tu yang med gyur na, ,lan cig tsam zhig myong nas kyang, ,rnal 'byor stobs kyis 'grub par 'gyur, zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
gru.english: As the Secret Book of the Five Stages puts it, Suppose a person never joins The flower born of the lake And the diamond bolt, Even on the deceptive level. They can still use their practice To reach their spiritual goals, Assuming they've had that experience At least a single time.

gru.acip: KHO NA RE, SKABS 'DIR SEMS DBEN 'DREN PA'I PHYIR LAS RGYA BSTEN PAR GSUNGS PA DANG, GSANG BA GRUB PAR, DANG PO'I LAS RGYAS RIG PAR BYA, ZHES LAS DANG PO'I RDZOGS RIM PA DANG BSKYED RIM PAS LAS RGYA BSTEN PAR GSUNGS PA GNYIS 'GAL LO ZHE NA,
gru.wylie: kho na re, skabs 'dir sems dben 'dren pa'i phyir las rgya bsten par gsungs pa dang, gsang ba grub par, dang po'i las rgyas rig par bya, zhes las dang po'i rdzogs rim pa dang bskyed rim pas las rgya bsten par gsungs pa gnyis 'gal lo zhe na
gru.english: Suppose one asks then the following question-- In the present context, scripture tells us that we must practice with an actual partner in order to bring on the stage of transcendent mind.  The text called Practicing in Secret though states that we should "be known by the first of the actual partners," meaning that beginners on the stage of completion--and followers of the stage of creation--should practice with an actual partner.  Don't these two statements contradict each other?

gru.acip: DANG PO GRUB STE, RDOR BZLAS KYIS LAS RLUNG GI RGYU BA BKAG NAS STONG PA RNAMS 'DREN PA'I PHYIR TE, RDO RJE 'PHRENG BA LAS,
gru.wylie: dang po grub ste, rdor bzlas kyis las rlung gi rgyu ba bkag nas stong pa rnams 'dren pa'i phyir te, rdo rje 'phreng ba las
gru.english: The first statement above is true because the Recitation of Diamond functions to stop the flow of the wind of action, and this brings on the various forms of emptiness.  As the String of Diamonds puts it,

gru.acip: PHYI MA GRUB STE, LAS RGYA LA MA BRTEN NA SEMS DBEN MTHAR THUG BSKYED MI NUS PA'I PHYIR TE, YE SHES RDO RJE KUN LAS GTUS LAS,
gru.wylie: phyi ma grub ste, las rgya la ma brten na sems dben mthar thug bskyed mi nus pa'i phyir te, ye shes rdo rje kun las gtus las
gru.english: The latter statement above is true because, unless we do practice with an actual partner, we will find ourselves unable to give rise to the ultimate form of transcendent mind.  As Compendium of the Diamond of Wisdom states,

gru.acip: ,LAN GCIG TZAM ZHIG MYONG NAS KYANG, ,RNAL 'BYOR STOBS KYIS 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: lan gcig tsam zhig myong nas kyang, ,rnal 'byor stobs kyis 'grub par 'gyur
gru.english: They can still use their practice To reach their spiritual goals, Assuming they've had that experience At least a single time.

gru.acip: ,ZHES PA LTAR LAN GCIG MTSON PA SNGON DU SONG NAS SHIN TU SPROS MED KYI SPYOD PA LA BRTEN NAS SEMS DBEN MTHAR THUG GI RNAL 'BYOR BSKYED NUS PA'I PHYIR, 'ON KYANG MKHAS GRUB NOR BZANG RGYA MTSO NI LAS RGYA LA RAGS MA LAS PAR TSE GCIG LA 'TSANG RGYA NUS PA ZHIG BZHED PAR SNANG NGO,,
gru.wylie: zhes pa ltar lan gcig mtshon pa sngon du song nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa la brten nas sems dben mthar thug gi rnal 'byor bskyed nus pa'i phyir, 'on kyang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho ni las rgya la rags ma las par tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya nus pa zhig bzhed par snang ngo
gru.english: What this is saying is that it is possible to replicate the experience a single time with an actual partner, and then later on utilize the practice free of elaboration to reach the deep state of the ultimate form of transcendent mind.  We should add though that it appears that the wise and accomplished Norsang Gyatso has taken the position that it is possible to reach enlightenment in a single lifetime without relying upon practice with an actual partner. * * * As almost a closing remark on the matter, Je Tsongkapa clarifies the need for an actual partner in a piece called Advices Deeply Cherished: A Very Detailed Explanation of a Number of Profound, Personal Philosophical Positions (ACIP digital text S05301-21, ff. 34b-35a):

gru.acip: ,LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA'I SBYOR BA YIS, ,PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO BSGRUB PAR BYA, ,BCU GNYIS LO LON DPE MED MA, ,SHES RAB CHEN PO BSTEN PAR BYA,
gru.wylie: las kyi phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis, ,phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya, ,bcu gnyis lo lon dpe med ma, ,shes rab chen po bsten par bya
gru.english: Union with an actual physical partner Brings you to attain the Great Seal. Practice with a maiden of great wisdom, One who has reached at least twelve years, One who's beyond compare.

gru.acip: CHO GA BZHIN DU PHYAG RGYA 'DUS BYAS PA'I CHO GA SNGON DU 'GRO BAS, SGRUB PA PO GANG GIS GNYIS KA LHAR BSGOMS SHING NYE BAR SPYAD NA DE SANGS RGYAS NYID 'THOB PAR 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: cho ga bzhin du phyag rgya 'dus byas pa'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas, sgrub pa po gang gis gnyis ka lhar bsgoms shing nye bar spyad na de sangs rgyas nyid 'thob par 'gyur ro
gru.english: Suppose that first we engage in the rite of going into union with a partner, following the proper way of ritual; and that then both the partners continue this practice together, seeing each other as real Angels. It brings us nothing less than the state of perfect Buddhahood.

gru.acip: PHO NYA MO LA GSANG MCHOD BYAS PA DE NAS TE DE LA BRTEN NAS YID SKYOB PAS SNGAGS TE GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: pho nya mo la gsang mchod byas pa de nas te de la brten nas yid skyob pas sngags te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'grub par 'gyur ro
gru.english: We first make the secret offering to our Messenger lady, and then we practice with Her; this is the real way of the secret word, or mantra, because it protects [tra] our mind [man], by enabling us to achieve the indivisible form of wisdom.

gru.acip: MNGON SUM DU MA BYAS PA'I RDO RJE 'DZIN JI LTAR 'GRUB CE NA, RDO RJE 'CHANG BDAG GI SLOB DPON GYI LUS SU LEGS PAR GNAS PA STE, SLOB DPON GYI RNAM PA CAN DU BYAS NAS SGRUB PA PO RNAMS LAS PHYI DANG NANG GI MCHOD PA LEN PAS RDO RJE 'DZIN MNGON SUM DU GYUR PA DANG 'DRA'O,,
gru.wylie: mngon sum du ma byas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin ji ltar 'grub ce na, rdo rje 'chang bdag gi slob dpon gyi lus su legs par gnas pa ste, slob dpon gyi rnam pa can du byas nas sgrub pa po rnams las phyi dang nang gi mchod pa len pas rdo rje 'dzin mngon sum du gyur pa dang 'dra'o
gru.english: "How do we establish," one may ask, "that there exists a Keeper of the Diamond that we cannot see?"  The Keeper of the Diamond "lives His life within the body of our own spiritual Master," meaning that He assumes the form of our Master.  And since this Master accepts from us the outer and inner offerings, it is as if the Keeper of the Diamond has become someone we can see.

gru.acip: ZHAL LUNG LAS KYANG, ,'DI YI DON LDAN 'GA' ZHIG LA, ,NGA NI DE YI LUS GNAS TE, ,SGRUB PO GZHAN LA MCHOD PA LEN, ,DE YIS DE MNYES RANG GI RGYUD, ,LAS KYI SGRIB PA DAG BYED DO,
gru.wylie: zhal lung las kyang, ,'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la, ,nga ni de yi lus gnas te, ,sgrub po gzhan la mchod pa len, ,de yis de mnyes rang gi rgyud, ,las kyi sgrib pa dag byed do
gru.english: The Word from the Lips says as well, I live my life inside the bodies Of those few who hold this meaning; With other practitioners, The offering is only accepted-- But with this one, we are pleased, And then the karmic obstacles In this practitioner's being Are completely cleaned away.

gru.acip: 'DI'I SGRUB PA PO RNAMS LA BCOM LDAN 'DAS 'DI RTAG TU MA BRAL BA KHO NA YIN NO, ,ZHES BSTAN PA'I PHYIR DPA' BO ZHES GSUNGS TE,
gru.wylie: 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams la bcom ldan 'das 'di rtag tu ma bral ba kho na yin no, ,zhes bstan pa'i phyir dpa' bo zhes gsungs te
gru.english: The lines of the root text that mention a "warrior" are meant to convey that for all of time the Conquerors will never leave the side of a practitioner of this path.

gru.acip: DE'I PHYIR SGRUB PA POS THA MAL GYI SNANG ZHEN SPANGS PA'I MCHOG GI SNANG BA DANG NGA RGYAL LA SHIN TU MNYAM PAR BZHAG PAS, GLU DANG GAR LA SOGS PA'I MCHOD PAS RANG DANG PHYAG RGYA LA MCHOD PAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: de'i phyir sgrub pa pos tha mal gyi snang zhen spangs pa'i mchog gi snang ba dang nga rgyal la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas, glu dang gar la sogs pa'i mchod pas rang dang phyag rgya la mchod par bya'o
gru.english: As such, a secret practitioner must relinquish all belief that the things around them are normal; they must join in intense union with their partner, maintaining the highest vision of each other, and the highest sense that both are already divine.  Watch then as Holy Beings make offerings to both you and your partner, with gifts such as song, and sacred dance.

gru.acip: ZHES PA 'KHOR BA DANG DE'I BAG CHAGS LAS LAM GZHAN GYIS GROL BA CHES RING NGO ZHES PA'I DON NO, ,DE NAS TE RGYU MTSAN DE'I PHYIR SGRUB PA POS PHYI NANG SOGS KYI MCHOD PA'I DNGOS PO KUN GYIS RANG DANG PHYAG RGYA MCHOD PAR BYAS PA LAS MYUR DU GROL BAR BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: zhes pa 'khor ba dang de'i bag chags las lam gzhan gyis grol ba ches ring ngo zhes pa'i don no, ,de nas te rgyu mtshan de'i phyir sgrub pa pos phyi nang sogs kyi mchod pa'i dngos po kun gyis rang dang phyag rgya mchod par byas pa las myur du grol bar bya'o
gru.english: What the text is saying here is that--if we try to use any other path--then our liberation from both the circle of pain and the subtle seeds behind it will be delayed for a very, very long time.  As such, a secret practitioner should see that both their spiritual partner, and they themselves, are presented with every kind of offering--whether outer, inner, or any of the rest.  And they must be sure as well to make offerings to their partner themselves.  If they do, then they will quickly be liberated. * * * This prayer to our Heart Lama says it all.  From Fulfilling the Hopes of Those Who Possess Great Goodness: Notes upon the Practice of Transfer, and a General Confession, relating to the "Lama Practice of Indivisible Bliss and Voidness" (ACIP digital text S06411, f. 31a), written by the great master of the teachings of Vajra Yogini, Lama Quicksilver, Ngulchu Dharma Bhadra (1772-1851).

gru.acip: YI DAM KUN 'DUS KYI NGO BO KHYOD KYIS MCHOG DANG THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD STZOL CIG ,
gru.wylie: yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bo khyod kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsol cig
gru.english: You are the combination Of every Close Angel In the universe. Grant me every attainment-- Those that are highest, And those that are shared With lower ways.

gru.acip: MKHA' 'GRO KUN 'DUS KHYOD KYIS LAM DUS SU'ANG LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA LA SOGS PA GTAN GYI BDE BA BYANG CHUB SGRUB PA'I GROGS MDZOD CIG ,
gru.wylie: mkha' 'gro kun 'dus khyod kyis lam dus su'ang las kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa gtan gyi bde ba byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig
gru.english: You are the combination Of every Angel woman In the universe. Here as I travel the path as well May you come to me in forms Like that of my spiritual partner, And be my companion in my quest For the eternal bliss Of Buddhahood.

gru.acip: CHOS SKYONG KUN 'DUS KHYOD KYIS BYANG CHUB SGRUB PA LA GDON BGEGS DANG SA CHU ME RLUNG LA SOGS PA'I GNOD PA PHYI'I BAR CHAD DANG,
gru.wylie: chos skyong kun 'dus khyod kyis byang chub sgrub pa la gdon bgegs dang sa chu me rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa phyi'i bar chad dang
gru.english: You are the combination Of every Guardian of the Dharma In the universe. Shield me from the demons Who would block me From reaching enlightenment; Protect me from outer harms That would block my path-- Like trouble from earth, Or water, or fire, or wind.

gru.acip: DRI BA GNYIS PA'I LAN NI, BDAG GI SGRUB DKYIL DU YOD PA'I, NOR 'DZIN KHYAB PA'I KARMA MU DRA MA, ,ZHES PA DE RJE TSAR CHEN BLO GSAL RGYA MTSO'I GSUNG NGO MA YIN ZHING,
gru.wylie: dri ba gnyis pa'i lan ni, bdag gi sgrub dkyil du yod pa'i, nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu dra ma, ,zhes pa de rje tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung ngo ma yin zhing
gru.english: Here is the answer our Lama gave to the second of the questions in this section: "In my daily sadhana text for the practice of the Angel of Diamond, Vajra Yogini, you can see a line that mentions 'Women Karma Mudra who cover every place of where all wealth comes from.'*  This is a direct quotation from the Lord, Tsarchen Losel Gyatso. *Translator's note: Twilight language is being used here to conceal secret stuff.  "Karma Mudra" is the Sanskrit original for the Tibetan Lekyi Chakgya, which means "partner of deeds," which in turn (as we will see) refers to an actual, physical spiritual partner.  The "place where all wealth comes from" means "the entire face of the planet," since gold and coal and so on are dug up from the earth.  Master Tsarchen then is saying that you can find emanations of Her in every corner of the entire planet.

gru.acip: DE DANG RJE MI LAS, LAS RGYA DKON PAR GSUNGS PA'I 'GAL SPONG NI, SANGS RGYAS RNAMS SANGS RGYAS MA THAG TU GDUL BYA'I DON DU SPRUL SKU BYA BA THER 'BUM 'GYED PAR GSUNGS KYANG, DA LTA RANG RE RNAMS BLA MA MTSAN LDAN DANG MJAL DKA' BA MNGON SUM DU GRUB PA BZHIN,
gru.wylie: de dang rje mi las, las rgya dkon par gsungs pa'i 'gal spong ni, sangs rgyas rnams sangs rgyas ma thag tu gdul bya'i don du sprul sku bya ba ther 'bum 'gyed par gsungs kyang, da lta rang re rnams bla ma mtshan ldan dang mjal dka' ba mngon sum du grub pa bzhin
gru.english: "This would seem though to contradict Lord Milarepa's statement that 'Actual, physical spiritual partners are hard to find.'  It's all the same though as that statement in scripture, where they say that enlightened beings, in the instant after Their enlightenment, send out billions upon billions of clones of themselves, to work for the good of disciples everywhere.  And yet we can see with our own eyes that it's quite difficult for all of us here right now to meet a truly qualified Lama.

gru.acip: (DE'I DON NI SGRUB PA PO'I BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS KUN DA LTA BU 'PHEL BA'I RTZA BA NI PADMA CAN LA SOGS PA'I LUS YIN LA, DE'I LUS KYI RTZA BA YANG PHYAG RGYA MA DE'I SEMS YIN PAS SMOD TSIG GIS DE'I SEMS SUN MI DBYUNG ZHES PA'O,,)
gru.wylie: (de'i don ni sgrub pa po'i byang chub kyi sems kun da lta bu 'phel ba'i rtsa ba ni padma can la sogs pa'i lus yin la, de'i lus kyi rtsa ba yang phyag rgya ma de'i sems yin pas smod tshig gis de'i sems sun mi dbyung zhes pa'o,,)
gru.english: What this means is that the very root for strengthening the element of enlightenment--that element which is reflected in the secret practitioner's kunda [semen or ovarian fluid]--happens to be the body of the Lady of the Lotus, or any other type of partner it may be.  And the very root of our partner's body is Her mind; as such, we should never upset Her mind by using disparaging words.

gru.acip: (KHA CIG SUN DBYUNG BAR MI BYA BA'I SKAD DOD LA 'DOD CHAGS DANG BRAL BAR MI BYA ZHES PAR YOD PAS, THIG LE NYAMS PAS 'DOD CHAGS DANG BRAL BAR MI BYA BA LA 'CHAD PA NI SKABS DON MA RTOGS PAR SNANG STE, THUGS KYI RDO RJE MI SMAD PA NI SMOD TSIG GIS BUD MED KYI SEMS MA DGA' BAR MI BYA BA'I DON YIN GYI, SGRUB PA PO RANG GI SEMS LA BYED PA MIN PA'I PHYIR RO,,)
gru.wylie: (kha cig sun dbyung bar mi bya ba'i skad dod la 'dod chags dang bral bar mi bya zhes par yod pas, thig le nyams pas 'dod chags dang bral bar mi bya ba la 'chad pa ni skabs don ma rtogs par snang ste, thugs kyi rdo rje mi smad pa ni smod tshig gis bud med kyi sems ma dga' bar mi bya ba'i don yin gyi, sgrub pa po rang gi sems la byed pa min pa'i phyir ro,,)
gru.english: Now some commentators have pointed out that the original Sanskrit for "don't upset the mind" can also mean "never lose your passion."  And so they explain this section as meaning that we should never lose our sexual passion, since this would then hurt the essential drops within our body. This interpretation though misses the context of the current line.  When it says that we should "never disparage the diamond of enlightened mind," what it's talking about is never displeasing the heart of our Lady.  It's not however a reference to the mind of the practitioner themselves.

gru.acip: DES NA RNAL 'BYOR MA'I MCHOG MNYES PAR 'GYUR TE, DE'I TSE SGRUB PA PO RNAMS KYI 'DOD PA'I 'BRAS BU 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: des na rnal 'byor ma'i mchog mnyes par 'gyur te, de'i tshe sgrub pa po rnams kyi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'gyur ro
gru.english: What the text is telling us to do then is to work hard to please our partner, this highest of all the Angels.  When a secret practitioner follows this advice, then they gain all the results they desire. * The Question of Desire One of the first and most important questions that arises with the idea of engaging in an intimate partnership in order to reach enlightenment is: We thought desire was bad! Why would anyone come teaching desire as a path to perfection? We begin our answer with a selection found in an original sutra, and quoted in a biography of Pabongka Rinpoche himself entitled The Lovely and Very Meaningful Song of the Pure One: A Biography of the Good and Glorious Pabongka Dechen Nyingpo; Absolute Lord over the Families of Enlightened Beings, and a Veritable Sea of Secret Worlds; Glorious Heruka Himself, Masquerading in the Golden Robes; and our One and Only Protector (ACIP digital text S00992, which is Part One--this selection is found at ff. 89a-90b). The biography was composed by a close student of the Rinpoche named Denma Lobsang Dorje (1908-1975), who also transcribed and edited a number of the Lama's teachings, and made them into books for us to enjoy.  The original sutra is ACIP digital text KD00047, from the Kangyur collection, and the citation is found there at ff. 89a-90b.  The "bodhisattva" described here is obviously one who is also enlightened, and already appearing in countless emanations.

gru.acip: GSANG BA BSAM GYIS MI KHYAB PA BSTAN PA'I MDO LAS, ZHI BA'I BLO GROS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI LUS KYI SPYOD LAM JI SNYED PA BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA'I LUS KYI SPYOD LAM YANG DE SNYED DU LHUN GYIS GRUB CING SGRIM PA MED PAR GNAS SO,,
gru.wylie: gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo las, zhi ba'i blo gros sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi spyod lam ji snyed pa byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi spyod lam yang de snyed du lhun gyis grub cing sgrim pa med par gnas so
gru.english: The Sutra that Reveals the Inconceivable Secret puts it this way: O Shantimati, One of the Peaceful Mind, the bodhisattva takes on all the different roles that any suffering being might take on themselves; and they do so spontaneously, without any conscious thought.

gru.acip: ZHI BA'I BLO GROS DE LTAR SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI GZUGS DANG, KHA DOG DANG, SPYOD LAM JI SNYED PA BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA'I GZUGS DANG, KHA DOG DANG, SPYOD LAM YANG DE SNYED DU LHUN GYIS GRUB CING YONGS SU MI RTOG PAR KUN TU GNAS SO,,
gru.wylie: zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar sems can thams cad kyi gzugs dang, kha dog dang, spyod lam ji snyed pa byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang, kha dog dang, spyod lam yang de snyed du lhun gyis grub cing yongs su mi rtog par kun tu gnas so
gru.english: And so we can say, o One of the Peaceful Mind, that the bodhisattva takes on whatever outer form, or skin color, or behavior that we find among any of the suffering beings in the entire universe.  And they live in each role spontaneously, without any conscious thought at all.

gru.acip: 'GRO BA CHAGS PAS MYOS SHING, DE LA ZHEN PA RNAMS 'DUL BA'I SLAD DU RNAL 'BYOR MA MI MO'I RNAM PAS BUD MED KYI KHROD DU BYON TE RGYUD BYIN GYIS RLOB PA SOGS KYIS DNGOS GRUB LHAG PAR MYUR BA'I KHYAD CHOS TE KHYAD CHOS GSUM
gru.wylie: 'gro ba chags pas myos shing, de la zhen pa rnams 'dul ba'i slad du rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pas bud med kyi khrod du byon te rgyud byin gyis rlob pa sogs kyis dngos grub lhag par myur ba'i khyad chos te khyad chos gsum
gru.english: Finally, these are times when beings are crazed with desire; and because She also wants to help those who have a craving for that sort of thing, the Angel comes to us in the form of a human female, mixing with the women of the world, so She can give Her blessings to our being.  Things like this give our path its third unique quality: that it brings the attainments with incredible speed. * * * Choney Lama asks some extraordinary questions on the use of desire as a path, and as always answers them masterfully, in His Lamp that Illuminates the Essence: An Explanation of Critical Points in the "Harvest of Attainments" [of Je Tsongkapa], itself a Treatise on the Great, Deep Practice of the Stage of Completion, according to the System of that Great and Accomplished Saint, Luhipa (ACIP digital text S00299, ff. 42a-42b):

gru.acip: GAL TE DE NYON MONGS YIN NA, SGRIB PA YIN DGOS PAS, DE YIN NA RANG GI NGO BO'I SGO NAS BYANG CHUB SGRUB PA LA BAR DU GCOD BYED YIN PA'I PHYIR DE'I RGYUR 'GYUR BA 'GAL LO ZHE NA,
gru.wylie: gal te de nyon mongs yin na, sgrib pa yin dgos pas, de yin na rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod byed yin pa'i phyir de'i rgyur 'gyur ba 'gal lo zhe na
gru.english: One may continue with the following objection: "If something is a mental affliction, then it's necessarily an obstacle to spiritual progress.  And if it's an obstacle like this, then it must be something that, by its very nature, hinders our quest for enlightenment.  And in this case it would be a contradiction to say it were a cause for this enlightenment."

gru.acip: DBANG PO SPONG BAR GDAMS PA NI PHYAG CHEN LA BRTEN NAS MI 'GYUR BA'I BDE CHEN BSGRUB PA'I LAM DE BOR BA STE DE LA MI 'JUG PAR NOR LA CHAGS SHING 'KHYOG PO'I SNYING LDAN LAS KYI PHYAG RGYA DANG, YID KYIS BRTAGS PA TZAM GYI SHES RAB MA YE SHES KYI PHYAG RGYA DAG KHO NA SANGS RGYAS NYID KYI SLAD DU GANG GIS BSTEN PAR BYED PA DE NI RNAM PAR BRTAGS PA'I BLO CAN LAS DANG YE SHES KYI PHYAG RGYA DE YIS BSGRUB PA DE'ANG KHAMS PHYIR 'PHO BA THOB PAR BYED KYI BDE BA CHEN PO'I GO 'PHANG 'THOB PAR MI 'GYUR RO,,
gru.wylie: dbang po spong bar gdams pa ni phyag chen la brten nas mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen bsgrub pa'i lam de bor ba ste de la mi 'jug par nor la chags shing 'khyog po'i snying ldan las kyi phyag rgya dang, yid kyis brtags pa tsam gyi shes rab ma ye shes kyi phyag rgya dag kho na sangs rgyas nyid kyi slad du gang gis bsten par byed pa de ni rnam par brtags pa'i blo can las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya de yis bsgrub pa de'ang khams phyir 'pho ba thob par byed kyi bde ba chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par mi 'gyur ro
gru.english: When the text speaks of "advices that we give up the power," it means to reject the path where we try to bring on immutable ecstasy by practicing with a partner.  It means that someone refuses to engage in this practice; rather, they are attracted to physical possessions, and have a crooked heart.  There are indeed actual partners, and there are "partners of wisdom," meaning those that are simply imagined; and they could practice only with these proper partners, and only for the sake of their enlightenment.  These people though, deluded people, try to practice with either an actual or an imaginary partner and all they achieve is the element moving out of the body--they never achieve the state of great bliss.

gru.acip: DE MI 'THOB PA TZAM DU ZAD DAM SNYAM NA, BLA NA MED PA'I SNGAGS KYI SGRUB PA POS KHAMS PHYIR 'DZAG PA'I BDE BA LA CHAGS PA LAS NI BDE CHEN MI 'THOB PA TZAM DU MA ZAD SDIG PAR 'GYUR TE GANG GI PHYIR NA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TSAD MED PA BZHI ZAD PAR BYED PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: de mi 'thob pa tsam du zad dam snyam na, bla na med pa'i sngags kyi sgrub pa pos khams phyir 'dzag pa'i bde ba la chags pa las ni bde chen mi 'thob pa tsam du ma zad sdig par 'gyur te gang gi phyir na, thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med pa bzhi zad par byed pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: One may ask, "Is that all? Is it only that they fail to reach this ecstasy?"  No--it's not just that a practitioner of the unsurpassed form of the way of the secret word who is attracted to the pleasure of having their element pour out of the body only loses an opportunity to reach great bliss.  Because they also collect a serious bad karma.  Why is this?  Because there is a very special form of the Four Infinite Thoughts; and by engaging in the practice this way, they kill these four.

gru.acip: DANG PO NI, GAL TE 'DOD YON LNGA LA JI LTAR 'DOD PAR BSTEN PAS SANGS RGYAS 'GRUB PAR GSUNGS NA, 'DOD CHAGS ZHE SDANG GTI MUG GSUM, ,'DI DAG 'JIG RTEN DUG GSUM MO, ,ZHES 'DOD YON LNGA LA CHAGS PA SPANG BYA'I DUG TU GSUNGS PA DANG,
gru.wylie: dang po ni, gal te 'dod yon lnga la ji ltar 'dod par bsten pas sangs rgyas 'grub par gsungs na, 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum, ,'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum mo, ,zhes 'dod yon lnga la chags pa spang bya'i dug tu gsungs pa dang
gru.english: One may pose the following question: You have put forth statements from scripture said to show that one can attain enlightenment by indulging to our heart's content in objects of pleasure, in the five objects of the senses.  How though can you assert that this doesn't contradict the statement from scripture where an attraction the five objects of the senses is described as being a poison that we must seek to abandon?

gru.acip: 'DUL BA DON YOD PAR GRUB PA'I RGYUD LAS KYANG, ,GANG GIS BLUN PO 'CHING 'GYUR BA, ,DE YIS MKHAS PA YONGS GROL ZHES, ,BYANG CHUB RNAM PAR BSGOMS NA NI, ,'DI DAG THAMS CAD PHYIN CI LOG
gru.wylie: 'dul ba don yod par grub pa'i rgyud las kyang, ,gang gis blun po 'ching 'gyur ba, ,de yis mkhas pa yongs grol zhes, ,byang chub rnam par bsgoms na ni, ,'di dag thams cad phyin ci log
gru.english: The Secret Book of Discipline, on the Practice of Attainment, also includes the following lines: It's been stated that the very thing Which enslaves fools Is something that the wise can use To gain their liberation. If you use them to reach liberation, They all turn completely around.

gru.acip: RIGS PA 'DIS NA KHYAD PAR CAN BSKUL BAR 'GYUR BA DANG, KHYAD PAR CAN GYI YONGS SU 'GYUR BAS KHYAD PAR CAN GYI 'BRAS BU YID DU 'ONG BA SKYED PA'I RGYUR ZHUGS PA'I BLA NA MED PA'I BDE BA CHEN PO'I 'BRAS BU THOB PAR BYA BA LA BSGRUB PA GZHAN MED DE,
gru.wylie: rigs pa 'dis na khyad par can bskul bar 'gyur ba dang, khyad par can gyi yongs su 'gyur bas khyad par can gyi 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba skyed pa'i rgyur zhugs pa'i bla na med pa'i bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba la bsgrub pa gzhan med de
gru.english: What this kind of thinking is showing us is that we need something extraordinary to drive us on--to bring us an extraordinary transformation, which brings us to an extraordinarily beautiful goal.  The thing that does act as the cause for this result is unsurpassed ecstasy, and there is nothing else that can act as it does to bring us our goal.

gru.acip: PHA RGYUD MA RGYUD GNYIS KA'I DBANG DU BYAS NAS 'CHAD NA, BLA MED KYI SGO NAS MCHOG SGRUB PA'I RTEN GYI GTZO BO RIN PO CHE LTA BU'I GANG ZAG LA PHO MO GNYIS YOD KYANG,
gru.wylie: pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i dbang du byas nas 'chad na, bla med kyi sgo nas mchog sgrub pa'i rten gyi gtso bo rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la pho mo gnyis yod kyang
gru.english: Looking at it from the point of view of both the Secret Teachings of the Father and the Secret Teachings of the Mother, those people who are so much like a precious jewel--that is, the primary form of life that can achieve the ultimate goal by following the unsurpassed group of secret teachings--include both men and women.

gru.acip: RGYUD DANG BSTAN BCOS RNAMS LAS PHAL CHER SGRUB PA PO SKYES PA DANG, DE'I PHYAG RGYA LA BUD MED RIGS BZHI BSHAD PA MANG NGO,,
gru.wylie: rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams las phal cher sgrub pa po skyes pa dang, de'i phyag rgya la bud med rigs bzhi bshad pa mang ngo
gru.english: The original tantras though, and the classical commentaries written upon them, make reference for the most part to practitioners who are male; and we see a great many descriptions of what kind of partner they should have--that is, the four different types of women they should look for.

gru.acip: DE'I TSE SKYES PAR MA ZAD RIG MA YANG LAM SGRUB PA POR SHES PAR BYA STE, SHES RAB KYI RKYEN GYIS THABS GROL BA LTAR THABS KYI RKYEN GYIS SHES RAB MA GROL BAR YANG LAN MANG DU GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: de'i tshe skyes par ma zad rig ma yang lam sgrub pa por shes par bya ste, shes rab kyi rkyen gyis thabs grol ba ltar thabs kyi rkyen gyis shes rab ma grol bar yang lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: When you come across descriptions like this, you should be aware that it's not just men who can follow this path; Women of Knowledge too are included here.  "Wisdom," meaning the female partner, assists "method" (the male partner) in reaching liberation; but the male partner also liberates the female one.  This has been stated in scripture many times over.

gru.acip: YANG DE NYID LAS, DRUG PO DE DAG NI SKAL BZANG MA STE SU BHA GA YIN LA, DE DAG NI SGRUB PA PO LA MCHOG STER BA YIN NO, ,ZHES RUS SBAL GYI RGYAB LTAR MTHO BA SOGS KYI MTSAN NYID DRUG TSANG BA'I BHA GA DANG LDAN PA NI SKAL BZANG MA STE, DE DANG 'DUS PAS SGRUB PA PO LA MCHOG STER BAS, SU BHA GA ZHES PA SKAL BZANG MA'AM BHA GA BZANG PO MA ZHES PA'I DON NO,,
gru.wylie: yang de nyid las, drug po de dag ni skal bzang ma ste su bha ga yin la, de dag ni sgrub pa po la mchog ster ba yin no, ,zhes rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba sogs kyi mtshan nyid drug tshang ba'i bha ga dang ldan pa ni skal bzang ma ste, de dang 'dus pas sgrub pa po la mchog ster bas, su bha ga zhes pa skal bzang ma'am bha ga bzang po ma zhes pa'i don no
gru.english: The same work also says that "Women of the six different types are subhaga, or women with an excellent share of goodness.  They grant the secret practitioner the highest of attainments."  The point here is that a woman with an excellent share of goodness is a woman who possesses a bhaga, or sexual organ, which is complete with the six desirable characteristics: ones such as their organ being raised up like the back of a turtle.  If we practice union with a woman such as these, then it imparts to us the highest of attainments; this then is the real meaning of the word subhaga, which translates as one with an excellent share of goodness, or one with an excellent bhaga.

gru.acip: RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO LAS KYANG, ,BUD MED KUN GYI SGYU MA'I RGYA, ,'DI NI GNYIS MED YE SHES MCHOG ,RNYED DANG BDE BA KUN MOS PAS, ,NGAN PAR SPYOD PA'ANG 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang, ,bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya, ,'di ni gnyis med ye shes mchog ,rnyed dang bde ba kun mos pas, ,ngan par spyod pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur
gru.english: As The Diamond Angel puts it, This snare of illusion-- Every single woman there is-- Is the highest of indivisible wisdom; If they seek after this possession, If they thirst for every pleasure, Then even those whose actions are bad Reach their spiritual goals.

gru.acip: ,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I 'GREL PA LAS, NGAN PAR SPYOD PA STE SGRUB PA PO GANG GI RANG BZHIN NYON MONGS PA BDO BA YIN YANG DE DAG LA RNAL 'BYOR MA RNAMS KYIS, DON DAM PA'I YE SHES KYI DNGOS GRUB STER BAR 'GYUR BA'O,,
gru.wylie: zhes gsungs pa'i 'grel pa las, ngan par spyod pa ste sgrub pa po gang gi rang bzhin nyon mongs pa bdo ba yin yang de dag la rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis, don dam pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub ster bar 'gyur ba'o
gru.english: The commentary to this section makes the following very clear statement on it-- You can even be a practitioner "whose actions are bad," meaning whose very nature is that their mind is overrun with mental afflictions.  The Angels though will come and grant you the ultimate attainment of wisdom.

gru.acip: 'DI ZHES BYA BA'I SGRAS NI RNAL 'BYOR MA RNAMS LA YANG DE DAG GIS DON DAM PA'I YE SHES STER BAR 'GYUR RO ZHES BLTA BAR BYA STE, DE LTAR NA LAM 'DIS SKYES PA DANG BUD MED DAG KYANG TSEGS MED PAR 'GRUB PAR 'GYUR RO ZHES BYA BAR DGONGS SO, ,ZHES GSAL BAR GSUNGS SO,,
gru.wylie: 'di zhes bya ba'i sgras ni rnal 'byor ma rnams la yang de dag gis don dam pa'i ye shes ster bar 'gyur ro zhes blta bar bya ste, de ltar na lam 'dis skyes pa dang bud med dag kyang tshegs med par 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bya bar dgongs so, ,zhes gsal bar gsungs so
gru.english: The word this in the verse should be thought of as conveying the idea that "the male partners will in turn grant the Angels their own ultimate wisdom."  What it means to say then is that both male and female practitioners can, in this way, achieve their spiritual goals without any trouble at all. * * * Lama Quicksilver, Ngulchu Dharma Bhadra (1772-1851) shows sensitivity to how partner practice in the teachings of the Angel of Diamond, Vajra Yogini, goes both ways; the following is an excerpt from His Secret Treasure of the Angels (ACIP digital text S0202 f. 86a):

gru.acip: DE LA PHO NYA ZHES PA NI BANG CHEN LTA BU 'DOD DON SGRUB MI LA ZER BA BZHIN, RANG GI LAM MYUR DU BGROD PAR BYED PAS NA, RANG PHO YIN NA DPA' BO DANG MO YIN NA DPA' MO RNAMS PHO NYA YIN,
gru.wylie: de la pho nya zhes pa ni bang chen lta bu 'dod don sgrub mi la zer ba bzhin, rang gi lam myur du bgrod par byed pas na, rang pho yin na dpa' bo dang mo yin na dpa' mo rnams pho nya yin
gru.english: Now the word "Messenger" here is meant in the sense of an emissary: someone who goes and gets something done that you wish accomplished.  And since They help you complete your journey of the path with speed, then the male Warriors (if you are yourself a female) or female Warriors (if you are a male) are in this case your Messengers. * * * Master Quicksilver shows the same sensitivity in His description of a very unique partner practice that we'll be exploring towards the end of the class (ff. 124a-124b)--

gru.acip: BSHAD TSUL 'DI NI DBYANGS CAN DGA' BLO'I SA LAM RNAM GZHAG LAS GSUNGS TE, SHES BYED NI GSAL SGRON LAS, MTSAN PHYED NA BLA MAS LAS RGYA LA BRTEN PA'I DNGOS DBANG BSKUR TE 'OD GSAL MTSON PAR BYED PA'O, ,DE NAS THO RANGS 'OD GSAL SGOM TSUL DANG, DE'I 'OG TU ZUNG 'JUG SGRUB LUGS KYI GDAMS NGAG PHOG PAS DON GYI 'OD GSAL 'THOB CING, DE'I 'OG TU ZUNG 'JUG 'GRUB BO, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA 'DI YIN NO, ,'ON KYANG GZHUNG 'DI NI DANG PO NAS BLA MED KYI LAM DU RIGS NGES PA'I LAM BGROD TSUL BSHAD PA'I GZHUNG YIN PAS DPYAD BYA'O,,
gru.wylie: bshad tshul 'di ni dbyangs can dga' blo'i sa lam rnam gzhag las gsungs te, shes byed ni gsal sgron las, mtshan phyed na bla mas las rgya la brten pa'i dngos dbang bskur te 'od gsal mtshon par byed pa'o, ,de nas tho rangs 'od gsal sgom tshul dang, de'i 'og tu zung 'jug sgrub lugs kyi gdams ngag phog pas don gyi 'od gsal 'thob cing, de'i 'og tu zung 'jug 'grub bo, ,zhes gsungs pa 'di yin no, ,'on kyang gzhung 'di ni dang po nas bla med kyi lam du rigs nges pa'i lam bgrod tshul bshad pa'i gzhung yin pas dpyad bya'o
gru.english: This way of explaining comes from Yangchen Gaway Lodru's presentation on the levels and paths, where the following section from the Lantern is quoted as authority-- In the midnight hour, the Lama grants the actual form of the empowerment where one practices with a physical partner; this brings on an experience of the clear light.  The Lama then grants instructions on how to meditate upon the clear light of daybreak, and after that the instructions on how the Combination of the Two is achieved. These points though bear some further examination, since the section of text quoted here is one which is describing how a person who always has and always will be on the path of the unsurpassed teachings travels the path.

gru.acip: BSHAD TSUL 'DI DANG MI MTHUN PAR MKHAS GRUB RJE'I BRTAG GNYIS RNAM BSHAD LAS, BYANG SEMS SRID PA THA MA PA DE LA DBANG GSUM PA DNGOS DBANG DU BSKUR BA'I TSE, PHYAG RGYA LA BRTEN NAS BDE CHEN MTSAN NYID TSANG BA BSKYED PAR NUS LA, STONG NYID MNGON SUM DU RTOGS ZIN MA NYAMS PA SNGAR NAS YOD PAS,
