It sparkles, light flashes from it, and it is filled with the nectar of the four waters of deathlessness, to make the world pure of all the problems that come with every kind of illness.  These four waters are water offered to drink; water to wash the feet; water to clean the mouth; and water sprayed to clear away obstacles.

gru.acip: SPYIR MCHOD PA LA LNGA YOD DE, RDZAS KYI MCHOD PA, SNGAGS KYI MCHOD PA, PHYAG RGYA'I MCHOD PA, TING NGE 'DZIN GYI MCHOD PA, SGRUB PA'I MCHOD PA DANG LNGA YOD PA'I PHYIR RO,,
gru.wylie: spyir mchod pa la lnga yod de, rdzas kyi mchod pa, sngags kyi mchod pa, phyag rgya'i mchod pa, ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa, sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang lnga yod pa'i phyir ro
gru.english: Generally speaking, there are five different forms of offering: the offering of substances; the offering of secret words; the offering of a sacred gesture; the offering of meditative concentration, and the offering of our practice.

gru.acip: LNGA PA SGRUB PA MCHOD PA ZHAR BYUNG DANG BCAS PA LA GNYIS, NANG NGAM SGRUB PA'I MCHOD PA DNGOS DANG, ZHAR BYUNG RGYA JA'I MCHOD PA BSHAD PA'O,,
gru.wylie: lnga pa sgrub pa mchod pa zhar byung dang bcas pa la gnyis, nang ngam sgrub pa'i mchod pa dngos dang, zhar byung rgya ja'i mchod pa bshad pa'o
gru.english: Here is the fifth section from above, on the offering of our practice, and an incidental section.  This itself comes in two parts: the actual offering of our practice--also called the "inner" offering; and then an explanation of an incidental offering: that of fine Chinese tea.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA NANG MCHOD NI, LCAGS KYU LNGA DANG SOGS RKANG PA GNYIS TE, DNGOS GRUB 'GUGS PAR BYED PAS (LCAGS KYU LNGA) STE SHA LNGA DANG, DNGOS GRUB GSAL BAR BYED PAS (SGRON MA LNGA) STE BDUD RTZI LNGA DANG,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa nang mchod ni, lcags kyu lnga dang sogs rkang pa gnyis te, dngos grub 'gugs par byed pas (lcags kyu lnga) ste sha lnga dang, dngos grub gsal bar byed pas (sgron ma lnga) ste bdud rtsi lnga dang
gru.english: [48 continued...] Having covered the outer offering, we move on now to our second major section here, on the inner offering.  This is presented in five lines: the two which begin with "I offer too an endless ocean," and the three which start with "burning and pure..."  The inner offering is made of different substances, including first of all the five fleshes, which are here referred to as the "five hooks," since they function to hook and draw into us our spiritual goals.  Within this offering as well are the five nectars, here called the "five lights" because they illuminate these goals.

gru.acip: SPYIR SHA LNGA LA DNGOS GRUB 'GUGS PAR BYED PAS LCAGS KYU DANG GSAL BAR BYED PAS SGRON MA ZHES BSHAD PA MANG YANG, SGRA DON DE NI BDUD RTZI LNGA LA'ANG SBYAR RUNG BAR SEMS SO,,
gru.wylie: spyir sha lnga la dngos grub 'gugs par byed pas lcags kyu dang gsal bar byed pas sgron ma zhes bshad pa mang yang, sgra don de ni bdud rtsi lnga la'ang sbyar rung bar sems so
gru.english: Generally speaking, there are many references in scripture which state that the five fleshes are referred to as "hooks" because they act to hook and draw in to us our spiritual goals; and that the "lamps" are so called because they illuminate these goals.  It seems to me though that the literal description of hooking in goals could just as well be applied to the five nectars too. The Secret Offering

gru.acip: BZHI PA DE KHO NA NYID KYI MCHOD PA NI SGRIB BRAL LHAN SKYES SOGS TSIGS SU BCAD PA GCIG STE, GNYIS SNANG GI RTOG PA'I (SGRIB) PA KUN DANG (BRAL) BA YUL CAN (LHAN) CIG (SKYES) PA'I (BDE BA'I YE SHES) CHEN PO DANG, YUL GZUGS SOGS (CHOS KUN RANG BZHIN) GYIS GRUB PA'I (SPROS) PA (DANG BRAL BA'I DBYINGS) TE STONG PA NYID GNYIS PO NGO BO (DBYER MED) PAR (LHUN) GYIS (GRUB) PA STE 'BAD RTZOL MED PAR CHU DANG CHU 'DRES PA LTAR RO GCIG TU ZHUGS PA'I BDE STONG DBYER MED KYI YE SHES KYI GZIGS NGOR,
gru.wylie: bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni sgrib bral lhan skyes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste, gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i (sgrib) pa kun dang (bral) ba yul can (lhan) cig (skyes) pa'i (bde ba'i ye shes) chen po dang, yul gzugs sogs (chos kun rang bzhin) gyis grub pa'i (spros) pa (dang bral ba'i dbyings) te stong pa nyid gnyis po ngo bo (dbyer med) par (lhun) gyis (grub) pa ste 'bad rtsol med par chu dang chu 'dres pa ltar ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes kyi gzigs ngor
gru.english: Next is the offering of suchness--our fourth major offering.  This is presented in the 15 brief lines that begin with "I offer to You the highest form of mind..."  What we are offering here first is the state of mind which is free of each and every obstacle where what we think we see and what is really there are two different things: that state of mind which is the great wisdom of simultaneous bliss. And we offer as well the object which this state of mind is focused upon: emptiness, or the Sphere where every single thing--everything from physical forms on up--is free of any projection that they could exist in truth.  And so really what we are offering is the wisdom of indivisible bliss and voidness, which engages in a single song: this subject state of mind and its object, indivisible and spontaneous--meaning that they are to us like water poured into water, effortlessly.

gru.acip: GNYIS PA YI RANG NI, CHOS RNAMS RANG BZHIN SOGS RKANG PA BZHI STE, KUN RDZOB PA'I (CHOS RNAMS) KYI (RANG BZHIN) TE GNAS LUGS STONG PA NYID KYI DBANG DU BYAS NA, BDEN PAR GRUB PA'I (MTSAN MA DANG BRAL YANG) MA BRTAGS MA DPYAD PAR MING RKYANG BTAGS YOD KYI THA SNYAD TZAM DU LAS 'BRAS KYI RNAM GZHAG 'THAD PA NI,
gru.wylie: gnyis pa yi rang ni, chos rnams rang bzhin sogs rkang pa bzhi ste, kun rdzob pa'i (chos rnams) kyi (rang bzhin) te gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi dbang du byas na, bden par grub pa'i (mtshan ma dang bral yang) ma brtags ma dpyad par ming rkyang btags yod kyi tha snyad tsam du las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad pa ni
gru.english: This brings us to the second of the additional steps, which is rejoicing in goodness.  This is presented in the root text with the ten lines which begin with "Nothing in the universe..."  Now nothing in the universe--meaning none of the deceptive reality around us--possesses, as far as its nature, or its reality of emptiness, the slightest sign of anything that could exist in truth.  If though we don't look too closely--just in terms of things existing only in name, as no more than what we call them--we can say that all the workings of these things, the laws of actions and their consequences, are all perfectly reasonable.

gru.acip: (,SLOB DPON KYI NI YON TAN BZUNG, ,SKYON NI NAM YANG BZUNG MI BYA, ,YON TAN BZUNG NA DNGOS GRUB THOB, ,SKYON RNAMS BZUNG NA DNGOS MI 'GRUB, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR,)
gru.wylie: (,slob dpon kyi ni yon tan bzung, ,skyon ni nam yang bzung mi bya, ,yon tan bzung na dngos grub thob, ,skyon rnams bzung na dngos mi 'grub, ,zhes gsungs pa ltar,)
gru.english: Spend your time thinking about The fine qualities that your Master possesses, And never consider any of the faults Which you imagine that you see. By considering Their qualities, You reach your attainments; By imagining Their faults, You deny yourself attainments.

gru.acip: SNGAGS DANG RDZAS SBYOR GYIS BGEGS SOGS BZLOG NUS PA'AM, ZHI SOGS SGRUB PA SHES PA NI, (SNGAGS DANG RGYUD SHES SHING) ZHES PA'I DON DU KHA CIG BZHED DO,,
gru.wylie: sngags dang rdzas sbyor gyis bgegs sogs bzlog nus pa'am, zhi sogs sgrub pa shes pa ni, (sngags dang rgyud shes shing) zhes pa'i don du kha cig bzhed do
gru.english: Some explain the lines "You are versed in the secret word, and all the secret books" as meaning that our Lama has the ability to repel obstructing spirits with secret spells and substances; or else that They know how to bring about peace and the rest.

gru.acip: ,PHYIR ZLOG GNYIS KYI CHO GA DANG, ,GSANG DANG SHES RAB YE SHES DANG, ,KHA SBYOR 'BYED PA'I CHO GA DANG, ,GTOR MA DANG RDO RJE'I BZLAS PA DANG, ,DRAG SHUL SGRUB PA'I CHO GA DANG, ,RAB TU GNAS DANG DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB, ,GSANG BA'I DE NYID BCU YIN NO, ,ZHES PA LTAR,
gru.wylie: phyir zlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang, ,gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang, ,kha sbyor 'byed pa'i cho ga dang, ,gtor ma dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang, ,drag shul sgrub pa'i cho ga dang, ,rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub, ,gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no, ,zhes pa ltar
gru.english: These are the ten subjects Of secret practice: The two rituals For forcing obstacles away; The secret; the Woman of Wisdom; The rite for splitting the capsule; Torma cakes; diamond recitation; The forceful rite for reaching Them; Consecration; and bringing into being The world of the secrets.

gru.acip: GTOR MA'I RIGS 6 DANG, YID DANG NGAG BZLAS KYI RDO RJE'I BZLAS PA 7 DANG, LHA LO DANG ZLA BAR TSUL BZHIN BSGRUBS KYANG MA 'GRUB NA LHA LA DRAG PO'I SBYOR BA BYED PA 8 DANG, RAB GNAS 9 DANG, MDUN BSKYED KYI DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB TSUL BCAS SHES 10 PA'O,,
gru.wylie: gtor ma'i rigs 6 dang, yid dang ngag bzlas kyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa 7 dang, lha lo dang zla bar tshul bzhin bsgrubs kyang ma 'grub na lha la drag po'i sbyor ba byed pa 8 dang, rab gnas 9 dang, mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul bcas shes 10 pa'o
gru.english: (6) They know the art of making and presenting torma cakes; (7) They know the Recitation of Diamond--reciting in both mind and speech; (8) They know how bring an Angel to them forcefully, in a case where They have tried to reach this Angel in the proper way, for month after month, year after year, but found Themselves unable to do so; (9) They know how to do the rites of consecration; and (10) They know how to bring into being the secret world that comes before Them.

gru.acip: ZHES PA LTAR MDUN BSKYED KYI DKYIL 'KHOR BRI SGRUB SHES PA 1 DANG, BDAG BSKYED KYI DANG PO SBYOR BA SOGS SHES PA 2 DANG, PHYAG RGYA BZHIS RGYAS 'DEBS LTA BU 3 DANG, G-YAS BRKYANG BA SOGS RKANG STABS 4 DANG, RDO RJE SKYIL KRUNG SOGS 'DUG STANGS 5 DANG,
gru.wylie: zhes pa ltar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bri sgrub shes pa 1 dang, bdag bskyed kyi dang po sbyor ba sogs shes pa 2 dang, phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs lta bu 3 dang, g-yas brkyang ba sogs rkang stabs 4 dang, rdo rje skyil krung sogs 'dug stangs 5 dang
gru.english: And here is how these ten are explained-- (1) They know how to draw, and then reach, the secret world that is brought into being before us; (2) They know the "first practice" and so forth in the rite for turning oneself into an Angel; (3) They know how to apply, for example, the four different kinds of seals; (4) They know how to take the stance, with the right leg extended and such; and (5) They know how take the seated posture--the diamond posture, and all the others.

gru.acip: DE LTA BU('I NYI MA) DE, (DUS) NGAN KYI DBANG GIS (NUB) PA STE, MYA NGAN LAS 'DAS PA'I TSUL BSTAN PAR ('GYUR TE,) DE'I RJES SU (MGON) DANG (SKYABS MED PA'I) BDAG SOGS SNYIGS MA'I ('GRO BA MANG PO LA) BLANG DOR KYI GNAS STON PA SOGS (RGYAL BA'I MDZAD PA) 'PHRIN LAS NYE BAR (SGRUB BAR MDZAD PA'I SKYABS MGON THUGS) RJE (CAN LA) ZHES PA'O,,
gru.wylie: de lta bu('i nyi ma) de, (dus) ngan kyi dbang gis (nub) pa ste, mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan par ('gyur te,) de'i rjes su (mgon) dang (skyabs med pa'i) bdag sogs snyigs ma'i ('gro ba mang po la) blang dor kyi gnas ston pa sogs (rgyal ba'i mdzad pa) 'phrin las nye bar (sgrub bar mdzad pa'i skyabs mgon thugs) rje (can la) zhes pa'o
gru.english: Due to the fact that these are degenerate times, the sun that this Teacher represents has sunk below the horizon--which is to say, Lord Buddha has pretended to pass into His final enlightenment.  And now here in the days of darkness which have followed Him, there are many living creatures--both myself and others--who have no one to turn to, no one who can protect them.  And so I make this supplication to my Shelter and Savior of compassion, to the One who comes and takes up the enlightened deeds of the Buddhas--deeds such as teaching all of us what it is we should take up, and what give up.

gru.acip: MGON PO KLU SGRUB KYIS ,SANGS RGYAS BRGYA MCHOD STONG MCHOD LAS, ,BLA MA'I BA SPU GCIG MCHOD LHAG ,ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: mgon po klu sgrub kyis ,sangs rgyas brgya mchod stong mchod las, ,bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod lhag ,zhes dang
gru.english: And our Savior, Nagarjuna, has said: Making an offering To a single pore of our Lama's body Is more powerful than Making an offering To a hundred Buddhas, To a thousand Buddhas.

gru.acip: RIGS BRGYA NI, RNAM SNANG GI RIGS KYI RNAM SNANG, RIN 'BYUNG, 'OD DPAG MED, DON GRUB, MI BSKYOD PA LNGA YOD PA DE BZHIN DU, LHAG MA BZHI LA'ANG SBYAR BAS NYER LNGA,
gru.wylie: rigs brgya ni, rnam snang gi rigs kyi rnam snang, rin 'byung, 'od dpag med, don grub, mi bskyod pa lnga yod pa de bzhin du, lhag ma bzhi la'ang sbyar bas nyer lnga
gru.english: Here is how we identify the Hundred Families.  There are five different families inside of the Family of the Angel of Appearances: those of the Angel of Appearances himself; and then those of Jewels, Limitless Light, Attainment, and Unshakable.  The same applies to the remaining four families, which makes a total of 25.

gru.acip: YI DAM KUN 'DUS YIN PAS MCHOG DANG THUN MONG GI (DNGOS GRUB KUN STZOL) BA DANG, MKHA' 'GRO KUN 'DUS YIN PAS (GTAN GYI) BDE BA SANGS RGYAS 'THOB PA LA 'GAL RKYEN SEL ZHING, MTHUN RKYEN SGRUB PA'I (GROGS MDZOD) LA,
gru.wylie: yi dam kun 'dus yin pas mchog dang thun mong gi (dngos grub kun stsol) ba dang, mkha' 'gro kun 'dus yin pas (gtan gyi) bde ba sangs rgyas 'thob pa la 'gal rkyen sel zhing, mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i (grogs mdzod) la
gru.english: And since You are the embodiment of every Close Angel that there is, I ask You to grant me all attainments--both those which are supreme, and those which are shared.  Given too that You are the embodiment of every Angel of the Sky, then I ask that You clear away anything at all that would work against my attaining Buddhahood--the happiness that is forever--and stay at my side to help me reach everything that would serve me in my quest.

gru.acip: DE NAS (CIG CHAR) DU (BYUNG NAS) DE RNAMS RIM PA BZHIN DU SGRUB PA PO (BDAG NYID KYI) SPYI BO MGRIN PA SNYING GA'I (GNAS GSUM) DU SNGA PHYI (RIM) CHAR (DANG,) DE NAS (CIG CHAR) DU (THIM PA) NAS THUN MONG BA LTAR NA SROG GCOD SOGS LUS KYI SGRIB PA DANG, RDZUN DU SMRA BA SOGS NGAG GI SGRIB PA DANG, BRNAB SEMS SOGS YID KYI SGRIB PA DANG, SGO GSUM THUN MONG GI SGRIB PA STE (SGRIB) PA (BZHI DAG CING,)
gru.wylie: de nas (cig char) du (byung nas) de rnams rim pa bzhin du sgrub pa po (bdag nyid kyi) spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga'i (gnas gsum) du snga phyi (rim) char (dang,) de nas (cig char) du (thim pa) nas thun mong ba ltar na srog gcod sogs lus kyi sgrib pa dang, rdzun du smra ba sogs ngag gi sgrib pa dang, brnab sems sogs yid kyi sgrib pa dang, sgo gsum thun mong gi sgrib pa ste (sgrib) pa (bzhi dag cing,)
gru.english: And then they come as one, sinking into my body; into the same three places on me, the practitioner; that is, into the tip of the head, the throat, and the heart.  First they come one after the other, and then they come as one.  Relative to the shared teachings, these rays of light clean us of the four kinds of obstacles: obstacles relating to our actions (deeds such as the taking of life); obstacles relating to our speech (things like telling lies); and obstacles relating to our thoughts (such as being unhappy when others get something)--along with obstacles that involve all three of these doors of expression.

gru.acip: DE LTAR RNYED DKA' YANG (MYUR DU 'JIG PAR) 'GYUR BA'I 'CHI BA NI NGES PAR 'ONG LA NAM 'CHI CHA MED PA SOGS YIN PA'I (TSUL) LEGS PAR (RTOGS NAS DON) CI YANG (MED) PA (TSE 'DI'I) ZAS NOR GSOG PA SOGS KYI (BYA BA LA MI G-YENG BAR) GTAN GYI BDE BA BYANG CHUB SGRUB PA'I (DON) CHEN PO DANG (LDAN) PAS LUS 'DI LA (SNYING PO) DE LTA BU (LEN PAR) RO,,
gru.wylie: de ltar rnyed dka' yang (myur du 'jig par) 'gyur ba'i 'chi ba ni nges par 'ong la nam 'chi cha med pa sogs yin pa'i (tshul) legs par (rtogs nas don) ci yang (med) pa (tshe 'di'i) zas nor gsog pa sogs kyi (bya ba la mi g-yeng bar) gtan gyi bde ba byang chub sgrub pa'i (don) chen po dang (ldan) pas lus 'di la (snying po) de lta bu (len par) ro
gru.english: All of these qualities that have been so difficult to obtain are, moreover, quickly destroyed--in the form of death, which is something that will without question come to us.  And there is no telling just when it will come.  We must see clearly how this and other such facts are true, and avoid becoming distracted by the completely meaningless business of this life: activities such as accumulating food and money.  We must then learn to take some great essence of life, by attaining the ultimate happiness of enlightenment itself, and in such a way give some meaning to having attained the body we now possess.  Bless me then to do these things.

gru.acip: SKYABS 'GRO'I BSLAB BYA LAM RIM NAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR (SDIG) PA RNAMS (SPONG) ZHING (DGE) BA'I (TSOGS MTHA' DAG SGRUB) PAR BYED (PA LA, BRTZON PA) DRAG PO (LHUR LEN) PA STE CHED DU (BYED PAR) RO,,
gru.wylie: skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya lam rim nas 'byung ba ltar (sdig) pa rnams (spong) zhing (dge) ba'i (tshogs mtha' dag sgrub) par byed (pa la, brtson pa) drag po (lhur len) pa ste ched du (byed par) ro
gru.english: And so I throw myself into--dedicate myself to--fierce efforts to give up each and every negative deed, and to accomplish every good; that is, I work to follow the advices on taking shelter, as they are found in the teachings on the steps of the path.  I beg Your blessing for this as well.

gru.acip: ,GANG LA BRTEN NA SKU GSUM BDE BA CHE, ,THUN MONG DNGOS GRUB DANG BCAS SKAD CIG LA, ,STZOL MDZAD 'DOD DGU'I MCHOG STZOL YID BZHIN NOR, ,RDO RJE CAN ZHABS PADMOR GUS BTUD NAS,
gru.wylie: gang la brten na sku gsum bde ba che, ,thun mong dngos grub dang bcas skad cig la, ,stsol mdzad 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol yid bzhin nor, ,rdo rje can zhabs padmor gus btud nas
gru.english: I bow in devotion to the lotus feet Of the One Who Has the Diamond: A wish-fulfilling gem who grants The highest of all my many dreams. If I surrender myself to You Then I know I shall be granted In but a single moment of time The ecstasy of the three holy forms, And all the goals that are shared.

gru.acip: ,SKAL BZANG SLOB MA'I PHAN BDE MA LUS PA, ,SGRUB PA'I THABS MCHOG GNYIS PA DANG BRAL BA, ,MDO RGYUD DAM PA'I MAN NGAG PAD TSAL LAS, ,'ONGS PA'I ME TOG PHRENG MDZES MGUL RGYAN SPEL,
gru.wylie: skal bzang slob ma'i phan bde ma lus pa, ,sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gnyis pa dang bral ba, ,mdo rgyud dam pa'i man ngag pad tshal las, ,'ongs pa'i me tog phreng mdzes mgul rgyan spel
gru.english: This is the highest means of all For disciples of good fortune To reach all that is good, To reach all happiness; Nothing can compare to it. This is a string of lovely blooms That I carry to you from the lotus garden Of the open and secret teachings, And the highest of advices-- Come don this jeweled necklace.

gru.acip: DE YANG THAR 'DOD RNAMS KYI PHUN SUM TSOGS PA THAMS CAD KYI GZHI RTEN, LEGS TSOGS MA LUS PA'I 'BYUNG GNAS, MCHOG DANG THUN MONG GI DNGOS GRUB MTHA' YAS PA KUN GYI RTZA BA, THEG PA MCHOG GI RNAL 'BYOR PA RNAMS KYIS NYAMS SU BLANG BAR BYA BA'I MAN NGAG MTHA' DAG GI GNAD BSDUS PA NI,
gru.wylie: de yang thar 'dod rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi gzhi rten, legs tshogs ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas, mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' yas pa kun gyi rtsa ba, theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i man ngag mtha' dag gi gnad bsdus pa ni
gru.english: There is but one thing which is the very foundation for all the wondrous things that will ever come to those who seek for freedom.  It is the very source from which each and every good thing springs forth.  It is the very root of infinite attainments--both those which are supreme, and those which are held in common.  It is an instruction which combines every crucial point found in all the spiritual advices put into practice by deep practitioners of the ultimate path.

gru.acip: RJE THAMS CAD MKHYEN PAS KYANG, ,DE NAS 'DI PHYI'I LEGS TSOGS JI SNYED PA'I, ,RTEN 'BREL LEGS PAR 'GRIG PA'I RTZA BA NI, ,LAM STON BSHES GNYEN DAM PA 'BAD PA YIS, ,BSAM DANG SBYOR BAS TSUL BZHIN BSTEN PA RU, ,MTHONG NAS SROG GI PHYIR YANG MI GTONG BAR, ,BKA' BZHIN BSGRUB PA'I MCHOD PAS MNYES PAR BYED, ,RNAL 'BYOR NGAS KYANG NYAMS LEN DE LTAR BYAS, ,THAR 'DOD KHYED KYANG DE BZHIN BSKYANG 'TSAL LO, ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang, ,de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i, ,rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni, ,lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis, ,bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru, ,mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar, ,bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed, ,rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas, ,thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo, zhes dang
gru.english: The all-knowing Lord has said as well, See that the very root For setting in motion the forces That will bring to you every good thing In this life and those beyond it Is to take yourself, and properly, To a supreme spiritual guide, Striving to serve Them in both Your thoughts and actions too. Never give Them up then, Even if it should cost you your life; Please Them with the offering Of carrying out Their every instruction. This is what I, in my deep practice, Have carried out myself; Those of you who hope for freedom Should seek to do the same.

gru.acip: BLA MA LNGA BCU PA LAS KYANG, ,DNGOS GRUB SLOB DPON RJES 'BRANG ZHES, ,RDO RJE 'DZIN PA NYID GSUNG BAR, ,SHES NAS DNGOS PO THAMS CAD KYIS, ,BLA MA YONGS SU MNYES PAR BYA, ZHES DANG,
gru.wylie: bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang, ,dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes, ,rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsung bar, ,shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis, ,bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya, zhes dang
gru.english: The Fifty Verses on Lamas says as well, Grasp the fact that the Keeper Of the Diamond himself has said That every attainment flows From your spiritual Master. Please Them completely then With everything you possess.

gru.acip: DE NAS MGON PO KLU SGRUB KYIS RIM LNGAR, ,MCHOD PA THAMS CAD YONGS SPANGS NAS, ,BLA MA MCHOD PA YANG DAG BRTZAM, ,DE MNYES PAS NI KUN MKHYEN GYI, ,YE SHES MCHOG NI THOB PAR 'GYUR,
gru.wylie: de nas mgon po klu sgrub kyis rim lngar, ,mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas, ,bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam, ,de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi, ,ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur
gru.english: Think now upon the words of our protector, Nagarjuna, who in His book on the five stages has said, Abandon every other kind of offering, And devote yourself completely To making offerings to your Lama. The act of pleasing your Lama Brings you to the attainment Of the highest form of wisdom.

gru.acip: ,SGRIB BRAL LHAN SKYES BDE BA'I YE SHES CHE, ,CHOS KUN RANG BZHIN SPROS DANG BRAL BA'I DBYINGS, ,DBYER MED LHUN GRUB SMRA BSAM BRJOD LAS 'DAS, ,DON DAM BYANG CHUB SEMS MCHOG KHYOD LA 'BUL,
gru.wylie: sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes che, ,chos kun rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i dbyings, ,dbyer med lhun grub smra bsam brjod las 'das, ,don dam byang chub sems mchog khyod la 'bul
gru.english: I offer to You The highest form of mind, The ultimate Wish for enlightenment: Great wisdom Of simultaneous bliss, Free of every obstacle; The Sphere Of every single thing Free of any Projection of truth; The Indivisible, The Spontaneous, That which is Beyond All thoughts to imagine, All words to describe.

gru.acip: DE NAS LAG NA RDO RJE DBANG BSKUR BA'I RGYUD LAS, ,SLOB DPON GYI NI YON TAN BZUNG, ,SKYON NI NAM YANG GZUNG MI BYA, ,YON TAN BZUNG NA DNGOS GRUB 'THOB, ,SKYON RNAMS BZUNG NA DNGOS MI 'GRUB,
gru.wylie: de nas lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las, ,slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung, ,skyon ni nam yang gzung mi bya, ,yon tan bzung na dngos grub 'thob, ,skyon rnams bzung na dngos mi 'grub
gru.english: Bring to mind next the following lines, from the Secret Book of Empowerment into the Teachings of the Angel who Wields the Diamond: Spend your time thinking about The fine qualities that your Master possesses, And never consider any of the faults Which you imagine that you see. By considering Their qualities, You reach your attainments; By imagining Their faults, You deny yourself attainments.

gru.acip: KHYAD PAR DU, RTZA BA'I BLA MA DE NYID MTSAN THOS PA TZAM GYIS NGAN 'GRO'I 'JIGS PA 'PHROG CING, DRAN PA TZAM GYIS 'KHOR BA'I SDUG BSNGAL SEL BA, GSOL BA BTAB NA DNGOS GRUB THAMS CAD BDE BLAG TU STZOL BAR MDZAD PA'I SKYABS GNAS BSLU BA MED PA DKON MCHOG GSUM PO 'DUS PA'I BDAG NYID DU BSAMS LA,
gru.wylie: khyad par du, rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing, dran pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba, gsol ba btab na dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa'i skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum po 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsams la
gru.english: More especially, the simple act of hearing our Heart Teacher's name spoken out loud is enough to rip away from us any need to fear a birth in one of the realms of misery.  Just thinking of Them is enough to dispel the sufferings of the cycle of pain; and if we only beg Them to do so, They can grant us all our spiritual goals, with perfect ease.  See your Heart Teacher then as They really are: the single embodiment of all three of the Jewels--a place of refuge which can never fail us.

gru.acip: ,THUB PA'I NYI MA DUS KYIS NUB GYUR TE, ,MGON SKYABS MED PA'I 'GRO BA MANG PO LA, ,RGYAL BA'I MDZAD PA NYE BAR SGRUB MDZAD PA'I, ,SKYABS MGON THUGS RJE CAN LA GSOL BA 'DEBS,
gru.wylie: thub pa'i nyi ma dus kyis nub gyur te, ,mgon skyabs med pa'i 'gro ba mang po la, ,rgyal ba'i mdzad pa nye bar sgrub mdzad pa'i, ,skyabs mgon thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs
gru.english: The time has come for the sun Of the teachings of the Able One To sink below the horizon; And there are many living creatures Who have no one to turn to, No one who can protect them. And so I make this supplication To my compassionate Shelter and Savior, To the one who takes up The deeds of the Buddhas.

gru.acip: ,KHYOD NI BLA MA KHYOD NI YI DAM KHYOD NI MKHA' 'GRO CHOS SKYONG STE, ,DENG NAS BZUNG STE BYANG CHUB BAR DU KHYOD MIN SKYABS GZHAN MI 'TSOL BAS, ,'DI DANG BAR DO PHYI MA'I MTHAR YANG THUGS RJE'I LCAGS KYUS GZUNG MDZOD LA, ,SRID ZHI'I 'JIGS SGROL DNGOS GRUB KUN STZOL GTAN GYI GROGS MDZOD BAR GCOD SRUNGS,
gru.wylie: khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam khyod ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste, ,deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar du khyod min skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas, ,'di dang bar do phyi ma'i mthar yang thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung mdzod la, ,srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol dngos grub kun stsol gtan gyi grogs mdzod bar gcod srungs
gru.english: You are my Lama You are my Close Angel You are my Angel of the Sky You are my Dharma Protector; I seek no other shelter at all From this moment on to the day That I reach my final enlightenment; Reach out, snare me with the hook Of Your heart's compassion, However far away I am, In this life or the next, Or in the time between. Save me from the terror Of this suffering life; Save me from the terror Of a lower peace; Grant me all attainments, Stay forever at my side, Protect me from every obstacle.

gru.acip: ,NGAN SONG SDUG BSNGAL 'BAR BA'I MES 'JIGS NAS, ,SNYING NAS DKON MCHOG GSUM LA SKYABS 'GRO ZHING, ,SDIG SPONG DGE TSOGS MTHA' DAG BSGRUB PA LA, ,BRTZON PA LHUR LEN BYED PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: ngan song sdug bsngal 'bar ba'i mes 'jigs nas, ,snying nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing, ,sdig spong dge tshogs mtha' dag bsgrub pa la, ,brtson pa lhur len byed par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me to take heartfelt refuge In the Three both rare and supreme For the fear I feel for the fire Of the pain of the lower realms. Bless me to throw myself Into giving up every negative deed, And accomplishing every good.

gru.acip: ,SO THAR BYANG SEMS GSANG SNGAGS SDOM PA YI, ,BCAS MTSAMS SROG GI PHYIR YANG MI GTANG ZHING, ,DGE CHOS SDUD DANG SEMS CAN DON SGRUB PA'I, ,TSUL KHRIMS PHAR PHYIN RDZOGS PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa yi, ,bcas mtshams srog gi phyir yang mi gtang zhing, ,dge chos sdud dang sems can don sgrub pa'i, ,tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me to master The perfection of an ethical life, Where even at the cost of my life I never cross the line Of a vow, whether it be One of those of individual freedom, Or of the bodhisattva, Or of the secret word; And where I gather within me virtue, Where I accomplish the goals of beings.

gru.acip: ,KHAMS GSUM SKYE DGU MA LUS KHROS GYUR TE, ,GSHE ZHING MTSANG 'BRU BSDIGS SHING SROG GCOD KYANG, ,MI 'KHRUGS GNOD LAN PHAN PA SGRUB BYED PA'I, ,BZOD PA'I PHAR PHYIN RDZOGS PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: khams gsum skye dgu ma lus khros gyur te, ,gshe zhing mtshang 'bru bsdigs shing srog gcod kyang, ,mi 'khrugs gnod lan phan pa sgrub byed pa'i, ,bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me to master The perfection of avoiding anger, To the point where I would never Feel upset at all if every living being In all the three realms of being Became angered at me, And spoke harshly to me, And criticized me, and threatened me, Or even took my life; Bless me to reach the point Where my reaction to them Would be to want to help them.

gru.acip: ,SEMS CAN RE RE'I PHYIR YANG MNAR MED PA'I, ,ME NANG BSKAL PA RGYA MTSOR GNAS DGOS KYANG, ,SNYING RJES MI SKYO BYANG CHUB MCHOG BRTZON PA'I, ,BRTZON 'GRUS PHAR PHYIN RDZOGS PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med pa'i, ,me nang bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos kyang, ,snying rjes mi skyo byang chub mchog brtson pa'i, ,brtson 'grus phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me to master The perfection of joyful effort, Where I would strive For supreme enlightenment And out of compassion Never become discouraged, Even if I had to remain For infinite eons in the flames Of the lowest realms of hell For each of the infinite beings there are.

gru.acip: ,'KHOR 'DAS RANG BZHIN RDUL TZAM MED PA DANG, ,RGYU 'BRAS RTEN 'BREL BSLU BA MED PA GNYIS, ,PHAN TSUN 'GAL MED GROGS SU 'CHAR BA YI, ,KLU SGRUB DGONGS DON RTOGS PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: 'khor 'das rang bzhin rdul tsam med pa dang, ,rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa gnyis, ,phan tshun 'gal med grogs su 'char ba yi, ,klu sgrub dgongs don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me to come To a realization Of what Arya Nagarjuna really meant: Of how all the things In both the cycle and beyond it Could possess not even an atom Of something which was their own, And yet still exhibit without fail A dependence of cause and effect, Each of these two qualities Dependent upon the other, In perfect harmony, Without the slightest contradiction.

gru.acip: ,DE NAS RDO RJE 'DZIN PA'I DED DPON GYI, ,DRIN LAS RGYUD SDE RGYA MTSO'I MJINGS BRGAL TE, ,DNGOS GRUB RTZA BA DAM TSIG SDOM PA RNAMS, ,SROG LAS GCES PAR 'DZIN PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
gru.wylie: de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ded dpon gyi, ,drin las rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mjings brgal te, ,dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa rnams, ,srog las gces par 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs
gru.english: Bless me that after all this I travel--by the kindness Of the captain of the ship, Of my Holder of the Diamond-- Across the ocean of endless depths, The teachings of the secret way. Bless me that I come to cherish, Even more than my life, The secret pledges and vows, The root of every attainment.

gru.acip: ,MGON KHYOD GANG DU MNGON PAR SANGS RGYAS PA'I, ,'KHOR GYI THOG MA NYID DU BDAG GYUR TE, ,GNAS SKABS MTHAR THUG DGOS 'DOD MA LUS PA, ,'BAD MED LHUN GYIS GRUB PA'I BKRA SHIS STZOL,
gru.wylie: mgon khyod gang du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i, ,'khor gyi thog ma nyid du bdag gyur te, ,gnas skabs mthar thug dgos 'dod ma lus pa, ,'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis stsol
gru.english: Wherever it is, my Savior, That You might decide to manifest Yourself becoming enlightened, I ask that You allow me To be there in the very front Of all who there surround You; May I win the joyful fortune Of seeing each and every dream I have, Each and every thing I need-- Both here and now and ultimately, Come true without the slightest effort, Simply on its own.

gru.acip: ,MDOR BSDU NA, ,'DI LTAR BGYIS PA'I RNAM DKAR DGE BA YANG, ,DUS GSUM BDE GSHEGS SRAS BCAS THAMS CAD KYI, ,MDZAD PA SMON LAM MA LUS BSGRUB PA DANG, ,LUNG RTOGS DAM CHOS 'DZIN PA'I RGYU RU BSNGO,
gru.wylie: mdor bsdu na, ,'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba yang, ,dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi, ,mdzad pa smon lam ma lus bsgrub pa dang, ,lung rtogs dam chos 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo
gru.english: To do this in a summary way, recite then the following: I take all the pure white virtue That I've created through this practice And dedicate it to serve as a cause For all the holy deeds and prayers Of each and every Buddha Gone to Bliss, And every one of Their sons and daughters, In the past, or now, or the future, To come true as They do wish it. I dedicate this virtue also as a cause That the holy Dharma, Both in its physical form and as realizations, Remains always in this world.

gru.acip: SMRAS PA, ,MDO RGYUD DAM PA'I MAN NGAG 'O MA'I MTSO, ,RNAM DPYOD SA 'DZIN DBANG POS BSRUBS PA LAS, ,SNGON MED LEGS BSHAD BDUD RTZI'I KE LA SHA, SKAL BZANG LEGS BRIS TSOGS KYI NYER 'TSOR GRUB,
gru.wylie: smras pa, ,mdo rgyud dam pa'i man ngag 'o ma'i mtsho, ,rnam dpyod sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa las, ,sngon med legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ke la sha, skal bzang legs bris tshogs kyi nyer 'tshor grub
gru.english: And thus it is done. I took an ocean of milk-- The highest spiritual advices From both the open and secret teachings-- And stirred it with powerful Thoughts of analysis, Equal to the Lord of Mountains. I thus produced A true Lake Kailash Of the nectar of deathlessness: Words of fine explanation Of the like never seen before; And I pray it should serve As sustenance for masses Of those exquisitely rendered Beings of highest fortune.

gru.acip: SH'AKYA'I DGE SLONG BLO BZANG CHOS KYI RGYAL MTSAN GYIS GRUB CHEN GLING GIS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA DANG, DPANG LO CHEN POS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA DANG, SA SKYA BA'I DGE BA'I BSHES GNYEN CHEN PO DU MAS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA DANG, THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA DGE 'DUN RGYA MTSOS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA DANG, MKHAS GRUB CHEN PO MKHAN PO RIN PO CHE SANGS RGYAS YE SHES KYIS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA DANG,
gru.wylie: shAkya'i dge slong blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis grub chen gling gis mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa dang, dpang lo chen pos mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa dang, sa skya ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du mas mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa dang, thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa dang, mkhas grub chen po mkhan po rin po che sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa dang
gru.english: And so I--the Shakya monk named Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen [His Holiness the First Panchen Lama]--have composed the rite, basing it upon earlier pieces: the Offering to Lamas by Drupchen Ling; the Offering to Lamas by Panglo Chenpo; the works on offering to Lamas written by a great many eminent spiritual guides of the Sakya tradition; the Offering to Lamas by His Holiness the Second Dalai Lama, the omniscient Gendun Gyatso; and the Offering to Lamas by the wise and accomplished Khen Rinpoche, Sangye Yeshe.

gru.acip: GZHAN YANG GRUB MTHA' SO SO'I BLA MA MCHOG DMAN DU MAS MDZAD PA'I BLA MA MCHOD PA MANG PO ZHIG MTHONG ZHING, BRJOD BYA'I DON RNAMS KHONG DU CHUD PAR BYAS TE LEGS PA'I CHA THAMS CAD LEGS PAR BSDUS NAS,
gru.wylie: gzhan yang grub mtha' so so'i bla ma mchog dman du mas mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa mang po zhig mthong zhing, brjod bya'i don rnams khong du chud par byas te legs pa'i cha thams cad legs par bsdus nas
gru.english: I have in addition studied a great number of other works on offering to Lamas composed by teachers--both greater and lesser--of a variety of traditions.  I have come to a complete grasp of all of these writings, and incorporated all of the best parts of them carefully into the present ritual.

gru.acip: ,,'DI DANG PHYAG CHEN 'GREL PA YANG, RAB 'BYAMS SMRA BA CHOS GRAGS KYIS BSGRUBS PA'I DGE BAS PHA MA GNYIS MYUR DU SANGS RGYAS THOB PAR SHOG ,,
gru.wylie: 'di dang phyag chen 'grel pa yang, rab 'byams smra ba chos grags kyis bsgrubs pa'i dge bas pha ma gnyis myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog
gru.english: That teacher of myriad scriptures, Chudrak, helped me make this work--and also my commentary upon the Great Seal of the Mahamudra--available to others.  I pray that, by this goodness, his father and mother may quickly come to attain the state of enlightenment.

gru.acip: 'JIG RTEN GYI KHAMS RGYA MTSO SHIN TU BSTAN PA'I PHYOGS GSAL BAR BYA BA YANG DAG PAR BSGRUBS PA
gru.wylie: 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa'i phyogs gsal bar bya ba yang dag par bsgrubs pa
gru.english: An Elucidation of Issues Concerning the Veritable Ocean of the Worlds of the Universe

gru.acip: 'PHAGS PA SGO MTHA' YAS PA SGRUB PA ZHES BYA BA'I GZUNGS
gru.wylie: 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs
gru.english: An Exalted Secret Formula entitled, The Accomplishment of Infinite Goals" (Arya Ananta Mukha Sadhaka Nama Dharani).txt"

gru.acip: BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA'I SO SOR THAR PA CHOS BZHI SGRUB PA ZHES BYA BA THEG PA CHEN PO'I MDO
gru.wylie: byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa chos bzhi sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo
gru.english: An Exalted Sutra of the Greater Way entitled Accomplishing the Four Points of the Individual Freedom for Bodhisattvas" (Bodhisattva Pratimoksha +).txt"

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA DGE LEGS DPAL BZANG PO'I GSUNG 'BUM KA BA'I DKAR CHAG
gru.wylie: mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dge legs dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum ka ba'i dkar chag
gru.english: Table of Contents to Volume 1 (KA) of the Collected Works of the Omniscient Kedrup Je Gelek Pel Sangpo

gru.acip: BOD GANGS CAN GYI GRUB MTHA' RIS MED KYI MKHAS DBANG BRGYA DANG BRGYAD CU LHAG GI GSUNG 'BUM SO SO'I DKAR CHAG PHYOGS GCIG TU BSGRIGS PA SHES BYA'I GTER MDZOD, STOD CHA
gru.wylie: bod gangs can gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas dbang brgya dang brgyad cu lhag gi gsung 'bum so so'i dkar chag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa shes bya'i gter mdzod, stod cha
gru.english: Volume 1 of the "Treasure of Knowable Things," being a Compendium of Catalogs to the Individual Collected Works of More than 180 Different Masters from All the Traditions of Tibetan Buddhism

gru.acip: BOD GANGS CAN GYI GRUB MTHA' RIS MED KYI MKHAS DBANG BRGYA DANG BRGYAD CU LHAG GI GSUNG 'BUM SO SO'I DKAR CHAG PHYOGS GCIG TU BSGRIGS PA SHES BYA'I GTER MDZOD, BAR CHA
gru.wylie: bod gangs can gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas dbang brgya dang brgyad cu lhag gi gsung 'bum so so'i dkar chag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa shes bya'i gter mdzod, bar cha
gru.english: Volume 2 of the "Treasure of Knowable Things," being a Compendium of Catalogs to the Individual Collected Works of More than 180 Different Masters from All the Traditions of Tibetan Buddhism

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN GRAGS PA BSHAD SGRUB KYI GSUNG 'BUM DKAR CHAG GSAR BSGRIGS DVANGS GSAL ME LONG
gru.wylie: rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag gsar bsgrigs dvangs gsal me long
gru.english: The "Crystal-Clear Mirror," being a New Version of the Catalog to the Collected Works of the Holy Drakpa Shedrup

gru.acip: KHRI BYANG BLA BRANG PHUN TSOGS RAB BRTAN GYI GTZUG LAG KHANG DU RGYAL BA'I BKA' 'GYUR DANG, BSTAN 'GYUR RIN PO CHES DBUS 'PHAGS BOD GRUB MTHA' RIS MED KYI MKHAS GRUB DU MA'I GLEGS BAM KHAG MANG PHYOGS BSDUS BGYIS PA JI BZHUGS BCAS KYI DKAR CHAG...
gru.wylie: khri byang bla brang phun tshogs rab brtan gyi gtsug lag khang du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang, bstan 'gyur rin po ches dbus 'phags bod grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub du ma'i glegs bam khag mang phyogs bsdus bgyis pa ji bzhugs bcas kyi dkar chag...
gru.english: A Catalog to a Great Many Works of Numerous Masters of All the Traditions of Indian and Tibetan Buddhism, starting with the Precious Kangyur and Tengyur, found in Puntsok Rabten Temple at the Religious Estate of Kyabje Trijang Rinpoche...

gru.acip: SGRUB THABS DKAR CHAG
gru.wylie: sgrub thabs dkar chag
gru.english: Catalog of Rituals in this Volume for Reaching Various Angels

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA DGE LEGS DPAL BZANG PO'I GSUNG 'BUM KHA PA'I DKAR CHAG
gru.wylie: mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dge legs dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum kha pa'i dkar chag
gru.english: Catalog to Volume Kha of the Collected Works of the Omniscient Kedrup Je, the Good and Glorious Gelek

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN 'JAM DPAL DBYANGS CHOS KYI RGYAL MTSAN GYIS MDZAD PA'I GRUB MTHA'I RNAM GZHAG
gru.wylie: rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag
gru.english: A Presentation of the Schools of Philosophy by Jetsun Jampel Yang, Chukyi Gyeltsen

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I MTHA'I RNAM PAR BZHAG PA GSAL BAR BSHAD PA THUB BSTAN LHUN PO'I MDZES RGYAN ZHES BYA BA LAS SDE TSAN DANG PO
gru.wylie: grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba las sde tshan dang po
gru.english: Part One of "The Lovely Jewel for the Mountain Peak of the Teachings of the Able One," being a Survey of the Schools of Philosophy

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I MTHA'I RNAM PAR BZHAG PA GSAL BAR BSHAD PA THUB BSTAN LHUN PO'I MDZES RGYAN ZHES BYA BA LAS SDE TSAN GNYIS PA
gru.wylie: grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba las sde tshan gnyis pa
gru.english: Part Two of "The Lovely Jewel for the Mountain Peak of the Teachings of the Able One," being a Survey of the Schools of Philosophy

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I MTHA'I RNAM PAR BZHAG PA GSAL BAR BSHAD PA THUB BSTAN LHUN PO'I MDZES RGYAN ZHES BYA BA LAS SDE TSAN GSUM PA
gru.wylie: grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba las sde tshan gsum pa
gru.english: Part Three of "The Lovely Jewel for the Mountain Peak of the Teachings of the Able One," being a Survey of the Schools of Philosophy

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I MTHA'I RNAM PAR BZHAG PA GSAL BAR BSHAD PA THUB BSTAN LHUN PO'I MDZES RGYAN ZHES BYA BA LAS SDE TSAN BZHI PA
gru.wylie: grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba las sde tshan bzhi pa
gru.english: Part Four of "The Lovely Jewel for the Mountain Peak of the Teachings of the Able One," being a Survey of the Schools of Philosophy

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN DRUL BU ZHABS LUGS KYI 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I RDZOGS RIM RIM PA LNGA'I DMAR KHRID
gru.wylie: grub chen drul bu zhabs lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i dmar khrid
gru.english: A "Dissection" Instruction on the Five Parts to the Stage of Completion in the Practice of the Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], according to the System of the Realized Saint, Ghantapada

gru.acip: DUS DGRA'I DBANG PO'I SGRUB THABS KYI ZHAL SHES ZIN THO
gru.wylie: dus dgra'i dbang po'i sgrub thabs kyi zhal shes zin tho
gru.english: Notes to a Private Instruction on How to Reach the Lord of the Enemy of Time

gru.acip: TSE BSGRUB BDUD RTZI'I ZIL MNGAR
gru.wylie: tshe bsgrub bdud rtsi'i zil mngar
gru.english: The "Sweet Rain of Nectar," being a Practice for Extending One's Lifetime

gru.acip: BSNYEN YIG DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSO
gru.wylie: bsnyen yig dngos grub rgya mtsho
gru.english: The "Ocean of Attainments," Instructions for Performing Close Retreats

gru.acip: MGON PO'I SNYEN BSGRUB KYI YIG CHUNG
gru.wylie: mgon po'i snyen bsgrub kyi yig chung
gru.english: Instructions for Performing a Retreat to Reach the Protector [Mahakala]

gru.acip: RJE BDAG NYID CHEN POS SRAS KYI THU PO MKHAS GRUB SMRA BA'I NYI MA LA CHIG BRGYUD DU STZAL PA'I BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI BRJED BYANG GRUB GNYIS DGA' STON
gru.wylie: rje bdag nyid chen pos sras kyi thu po mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma la chig brgyud du stsal pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brjed byang grub gnyis dga' ston
gru.english: A Party for the Two Attainments: Notes on a Lama Practice Granted Verbally by the Lord, the Great One, to the First and Foremost of His Spiritual Sons: Kedrup Maway Nyima

gru.acip: MA nI RIL BSGRUB KYI CHO GA 'KHYER BDE
gru.wylie: ma Ni ril bsgrub kyi cho ga 'khyer bde
gru.english: Convenient Ritual for Blessing Mani Pills

gru.acip: DGE 'DUN DBYEN ZLUM GYI 'KHOR LO SGRUB TSUL
gru.wylie: dge 'dun dbyen zlum gyi 'khor lo sgrub tshul
gru.english: A Method for Bringing about a Reunification of the Community after a Schism

gru.acip: BSNYEN RDZOGS SOGS BSGRUB TSUL GYI CHO GA 'KHYER BDE KUN PHAN
gru.wylie: bsnyen rdzogs sogs bsgrub tshul gyi cho ga 'khyer bde kun phan
gru.english: "Easy to Use and a Benefit to All," being a Ritual for Conferring the Ordinations of a Full Monk and the Like

gru.acip: DPAL GSANG BA 'DUS PA'I SGRUB THABS RNAL 'BYOR NGAG RIM NGAG 'DON DU BSGRIGS PA BLO GSAL DGA' SKYED
gru.wylie: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor ngag rim ngag 'don du bsgrigs pa blo gsal dga' skyed
gru.english: The "Bringer of Bliss to the Wise," being "The Steps of the Word of the Master Practitioners," a Ritual for Reaching the Glorious Secret Collection [Guhyasamaja], arranged for Recitation

gru.acip: DPAL GSANG BA 'DUS PA'I RAS BRIS DANG BSAM GTAN GYI DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD BYA TSUL GYI CHOG SGRIG DNGOS GRUB CHAR 'BEBS
gru.wylie: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul gyi chog sgrig dngos grub char 'bebs
gru.english: The "Shower of Attainments," a Method of Making Offering for Attainments in the Teachings of the Glorious Secret Collection [Guhyasamaja], through the Practice of a Secret World, either Drawn or Visualized

gru.acip: DPAL 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I SGRUB THABS BDE CHEN GSAL BA NGAG 'DON DU BSGRIGS PA BDE CHEN RAB RGYAS
gru.wylie: dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen gsal ba ngag 'don du bsgrigs pa bde chen rab rgyas
gru.english: The "Spread of Great Bliss," being a Ritual for Recitation of "The Light of Great Bliss," a Ritual for Reaching the Glorious Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara]

gru.acip: DPAL 'KHOR LO SDOM PA L'U AI PA'I MDUN SKYED SGRUB MCHOD PHYI ROL MCHOD PA LAG MCHOD DANG BCAS PA'I NGAG 'DON BDE CHEN CHAR 'BEBS...
gru.wylie: dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lU ai pa'i mdun skyed sgrub mchod phyi rol mchod pa lag mchod dang bcas pa'i ngag 'don bde chen char 'bebs...
gru.english: The "Shower of Great Bliss," a Ritual of Recitation for the Creation Before, the Offering for Attainment, the Outer Offering, and the Offering of the Hand in the Glorious Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], in the Tradition of Luyipa...

gru.acip: GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG DRIL BU ZHABS LUGS KYI BCOM LDAN 'DAS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I LUS DKYIL GYI MNGON PAR RTOGS PA BDE CHEN RAB 'PHEL
gru.wylie: grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu zhabs lugs kyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon par rtogs pa bde chen rab 'phel
gru.english: The "Flood of Great Bliss," being a "Realization" Practice into the Secret World of the Body in the Teaching of the Victorious Buddha, the Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], according to the Tradition of the Lord of Accomplished Masters, Ghantapada

gru.acip: DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED KYI SGRUB THABS ZA MA TOG NGAG 'DON BYA TSUL GO BDE BAR BSGRIGS PA 'JAM DPAL DGONGS RGYAN
gru.wylie: dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs za ma tog ngag 'don bya tshul go bde bar bsgrigs pa 'jam dpal dgongs rgyan
gru.english: "Jewel of the True Thought of Gentle Voice [Manjushri]," being a Convenient Method for Reciting "The Chest of Riches," a Method for Reaching the Glorious Diamond Frightener [Bhairava]

gru.acip: DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED CHEN PO'I SGRUB THABS NGAG 'DON GYI CHOG BSGRIGS 'KHRUL SPONG MKHAS PA DGYES BYED
gru.wylie: dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don gyi chog bsgrigs 'khrul spong mkhas pa dgyes byed
gru.english: "Pleasure for the Wise, and Unerring Exposition," being a Ritual for Reaching the Great and Glorious Diamond Frightener [Bhairava], arranged for Recitation

gru.acip: DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED DPA' BO GCIG PA'I SGRUB THABS BDUD LAS RNAM RGYAL GYI NGAG 'DON KHRIGS CHAGS SU BSDEBS PA BDUD LAS RNAM PAR RGYAL BA'I RGYAL MTSAN
gru.wylie: dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam rgyal gyi ngag 'don khrigs chags su bsdebs pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan
gru.english: "Banner declaring Victory over the Demons," a Version of the "Victory over the Demons," a Ritual for Reaching the Glorious Diamond Frightener [Bhairava] in His Solitary Warrior [Eka Vira] Form, Prepared for Convenient Recitation

gru.acip: CHOS RGYAL GSANG SGRUB LA MCHOD GTOR 'BUL TSUL LAG TU BLANG BDE BAR BKOD PA
gru.wylie: chos rgyal gsang sgrub la mchod gtor 'bul tshul lag tu blang bde bar bkod pa
gru.english: A Convenient Ritual for the Presentation of Offerings and Torma Cakes to the King of the Dharma, the Attainment of the Secret [Dharmaraja]

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB SBYIN PA DAR RGYAS KYIS MDZAD PA'I CHOS 'KHOR GYI SPYI DON BLO GSAL GZHON NU'I MGRIN RGYAN
gru.wylie: mkhas grub sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'khor gyi spyi don blo gsal gzhon nu'i mgrin rgyan
gru.english: The "Jewel Necklace for Intelligent Young Minds," being an Overview of the Subject of the Turning of the Wheel of the Dharma Written by the Accomplished Master Jinpa Dargye

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB SBYIN PA DAR RGYAS KYIS MDZAD PA'I RGYU 'BRAS 'KHOR LO
gru.wylie: mkhas grub sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i rgyu 'bras 'khor lo
gru.english: A Presentation on the Subject of Cause and Effect, Written by the Accomplished Master Jinpa Dargye

gru.acip: MKHAS GRUB SBYIN PA DAR RGYAS KYIS MDZAD PA'I YUL YUL CAN GYI RNAM GZHAG GSAL BA'I ME LONG
gru.wylie: mkhas grub sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i yul yul can gyi rnam gzhag gsal ba'i me long
gru.english: The "Clear Mirror," being a Treatise on Subjects and Objects Composed by the Accomplished Master Jinpa Dargye

gru.acip: 'JAM MGON RGYAL BA'I BSTAN SRUNG RGYAL CHEN RDO RJE SHUGS LDAN RTZAL GYI SKU GSUNG THUG YON TAN 'PHRIN LAS KYI RTEN DANG, PHYI NANG GSANG PA'I RTEN BCA' BA'I LAG LEN GYI RIM PA GSAL BAR BKOD PA DNGOS GRUB GTER BRGYA DBYE BA'I GSER GYI LDE MIG
gru.wylie: 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan srung rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan rtsal gyi sku gsung thug yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten dang, phyi nang gsang pa'i rten bca' ba'i lag len gyi rim pa gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub gter brgya dbye ba'i gser gyi lde mig
gru.english: "A Golden Key for Opening a Million Treasure Chests Filled with Attainments," being a Presentation on the Preparation of Various Altars Dedicated to the Dharma Protector "Diamond Angel of Power" [Vajravega]

gru.acip: 'JAM MGON RGYAL BA'I BSTAN SRUNG RGYAL CHEN RDO RJE SHUGS LDAN RTZAL LA BRTEN NAS ZHI RGYAS DBANG GSUM GYI SBYIN SREG JI LTAR BYA TSUL GSAL BAR NAG 'GROS SU BKOD PA DNGOS GRUB SNANG BA STONG 'BAR 'OD KYI RTZE DGA'
gru.wylie: 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan srung rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan rtsal la brten nas zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg ji ltar bya tshul gsal bar nag 'gros su bkod pa dngos grub snang ba stong 'bar 'od kyi rtse dga'
gru.english: "The Playground that Shines with the Light of a Thousand Lamps of Attainments," being a Recitation Text of Instructions for the Performance of Three Different Kinds of Fire Offerings in the Practice of the Diamond Angel of Power [Vajravega]

gru.acip: 'JAM MGON RGYAL BA'I BSTAN SRUNG RGYAL CHEN RDO RJE SHUGS LDAN RTZAL GYI RGYAS PA'I 'PHRIN LAS LA BRTEN NAS GTER BUM SGRUB CING PHYVA G-YANG 'GRUGS PA'I CHO GA 'DOD DGU'I DGA' BA 'KHYIL BA
gru.wylie: 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan srung rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan rtsal gyi rgyas pa'i 'phrin las la brten nas gter bum sgrub cing phyva g-yang 'grugs pa'i cho ga 'dod dgu'i dga' ba 'khyil ba
gru.english: "The Crowd of Happiness from the Things We Hope For," being a Ritual for the Practice of a Vase of Riches, and for Accomplishing Prosperity, through the Mighty Deeds of the Diamond Angel of Power [Vajravega]

gru.acip: DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED KYI RIM PA GNYIS PA'I RNAM BSHAD DNGOS GRUB SNYE MA
gru.wylie: dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa gnyis pa'i rnam bshad dngos grub snye ma
gru.english: "The Golden Harvest of Attainments," being an Explication of the Two Stages in the Practice of the Glorious Diamond Frightener [Vajra Bhairava]

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN L'U HI PA'I LUGS KYI RDZOGS RIM RNAL 'BYOR CHEN PO'I RNAM BSHAD DNGOS GRUB SNYE MA'I GNAD DON SNYING PO GSAL BAR BYED PA'I SGRON ME
gru.wylie: grub chen lU hi pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po'i rnam bshad dngos grub snye ma'i gnad don snying po gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me
gru.english: "A Lamp which Illuminates the Very Heart of All the Essential Points in the 'Harvest of Attainments'," being an Explanation of that Great and Deep Practice, the Stage of Completion according to the System of the Great Adept, Luipa

gru.acip: MGON PO KLU GRUB KYIS MDZAD PA'I RIM PA LNGA'I RNAM PAR BSHAD PA ZUNG 'JUG NOR BU'I BANG MDZOD
gru.wylie: mgon po klu grub kyis mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga'i rnam par bshad pa zung 'jug nor bu'i bang mdzod
gru.english: "The Treasure House of Jewels," being an Explanation of the "Five Stages" Written by the Protector, Nagarjuna

gru.acip: RGYUD THAMS CAD KYI RGYAL PO DPAL GSANG BA 'DUS PA'I BSKYED RIM GYI RNAM BSHAD DNGOS GRUB KYI RGYA MTSO'I SNYING PO
gru.wylie: rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho'i snying po
gru.english: "The Essence of the Ocean of Attainments," being an Explanation of the Creation Stage of the glorious Secret Collection [Guhyasamaja], King of All the Secret Teachings

gru.acip: SGROL DKAR YID BZHIN 'KHOR LO'I SGRUB THABS
gru.wylie: sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs
gru.english: Method for Reaching the Wish-Giving Wheel [Chintamani Chakra], the White Lady of Liberation [Tara]

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN MA 'PHAGS MA SGROL DKAR YID BZHIN 'KHOR LO'I BSNYEN PA BYA TSUL GYI RIM PA GSAL BAR BKOD PA DNGOS GRUB 'DOD PA 'JO BA'I 'CHI MED BDUD RTZI'I BUM BZANG...
gru.wylie: rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi rim pa gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang...
gru.english: "An Excellent Vase Filled with the Nectar of Immortality, a Wishing-Giving Cow that Grants all Attainments," being Instructions for a Retreat in the Teachings of the Wish-Giving Wheel [Chintamani Chakra], the White Lady of Liberation [Tara]...

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN SGROL LJANG BLA MED LUGS NYE BRGYUD 'PHAGS MA'I ZHAL LUNG TZITTA MA nI LAS SGRUB THABS RKYANG PA'I 'DON SGRIGS ZUR DU BKOL BA...
gru.wylie: rje btsun sgrol ljang bla med lugs nye brgyud 'phags ma'i zhal lung tsitta ma Ni las sgrub thabs rkyang pa'i 'don sgrigs zur du bkol ba...
gru.english: The Section on the Ritual for Reaching the Holy Angel, the Lady of Liberation [Tara], in Her Emerald Form, Arranged for Easy Recitation and Excerpted from "The Wishing Jewel, Word of the Realized Woman,"...

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN MA 'PHAGS MA SGROL MA'I MAndAL BZHI PA'I CHO GA BYA TSUL GSAL BAR BKOD PA DNGOS GRUB 'DAB RGYA GROL BA'I AUTPAL CHUN PO...
gru.wylie: rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i maNDal bzhi pa'i cho ga bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub 'dab rgya grol ba'i autpal chun po...
gru.english: "The Book of a Vast Bouquet of Indigo Lotus Flowers that Open Into a Million Blooms of Spiritual Attainment," being a Clear Presentation of How to Perform the Practice of the Four Mandalas of the Holy and Realized Lady of Liberation [Tara]...

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN MA 'PHAGS MA SGROL MA'I SGRUB THABS TZITTA MA nI DANG 'BREL BA'I BDAG 'JUG LEN TSUL NYES LTUNG MUN PA 'JOMS PA'I ZLA BA GSAR PA
gru.wylie: rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs tsitta ma Ni dang 'brel ba'i bdag 'jug len tshul nyes ltung mun pa 'joms pa'i zla ba gsar pa
gru.english: "A Brand New Moon that Destroys the Darkness of Wrong Deeds and Broken Vows," being Instructions for Bringing Oneself into a Secret World, and Connected with "The Wish-Giving Jewel," a Method for Reaching the Holy and Realized Lady of Liberation [Tara]

gru.acip: RJE BTZUN SGROL MA TZITTA MA nI'I BSNYEN SGRUB SBRAGS MA'I 'DON CHOG DNGOS GRUB BUNG BA 'GUGS PA'I YID 'PHROG AUTPAL GSAR PA'I SKYED TSAL
gru.wylie: rje btsun sgrol ma tsitta ma Ni'i bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i 'don chog dngos grub bung ba 'gugs pa'i yid 'phrog autpal gsar pa'i skyed tshal
gru.english: "The Garden of Fresh Blue Lotus Blooms that Steal Your Heart Away, and Entice the Bees of Spiritual Attainments," being a Ritual for Recitation in Conjunction with a Retreat on the Practice of the Wish-Giving Jewel, the Holy Lady of Liberation [Tara]

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN DRIL BU PA'I LUGS KYI 'KHOR LO BDE MCHOG LUS DKYIL GYI BDAG BSKYED MDOR BSDUS
gru.wylie: grub chen dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bdag bskyed mdor bsdus
gru.english: A Brief Practice for Making Oneself the Deity in the Secret World of the Body according to the Teachings of the Sphere of Highest Bliss [Chakrasamvara], in keeping with the Tradition of the Great and Accomplished Saint, Ghantapada

gru.acip: DAM CAN CHOS KYI RGYAL PO PHYI SGRUB LA BRTEN NAS GTOR CHEN DRUG CU PA'I RNAM BZHAG RDO RJE GNAM LCAGS 'BAR BA'I PHRENG BA
gru.wylie: dam can chos kyi rgyal po phyi sgrub la brten nas gtor chen drug cu pa'i rnam bzhag rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phreng ba
gru.english: "The String of Blazing Diamond Steel from the Sky," being an Explanation of the Practice of the Sixty-Fold Torma Cake, in the Outer Practice for Reaching the King of the Dharma [Dharmaraja], a Protector Acting under Pledge

gru.acip: BDE MCHOG LHA LNGA'I BSKYED RDZOGS GNYIS KYI 'KHRID DMIGS BDE CHEN MYUR 'GRUB...
gru.wylie: bde mchog lha lnga'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi 'khrid dmigs bde chen myur 'grub...
gru.english: "A Quick Method for Achieving Great Bliss," consisting of the Various Points Raised in a Teaching on both the Stage of Creation and the Stage of Completion in the Practice of the Five Angels of Highest Bliss [Sambara]...

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN L'U HI PA'I LUGS KYI RDZOGS RIM RNAL 'BYOR CHEN PO'I RNAM BSHAD DNGOS GRUB SNYE MA'I GNAD DON SNYING PO GSAL BAR BYED PA'I SGRON ME
gru.wylie: grub chen lU hi pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po'i rnam bshad dngos grub snye ma'i gnad don snying po gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me
gru.english: "A Lamp that Illuminates the Essence," an Explanation of Critical Points in "The Harvest of Attainments," Itself a Treatise on the Great, Deep Practice of the Stage of Completion, according to the System of that Great and Accomplished Saint, Luipa

gru.acip: ZAB LAM BLA MA MCHOD PA BDE STONG DBYER MED MA DANG GRUB RGYAL LUGS KYI TSE SGRUB SBRAGS MA'I SGO NAS ZHING KHYAD PAR CAN LA BRTAN BZHUGS 'BUL TSUL...
gru.wylie: zab lam bla ma mchod pa bde stong dbyer med ma dang grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe sgrub sbrags ma'i sgo nas zhing khyad par can la brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul...
gru.english: A Ritual for Requesting the Long Life of an Extraordinary Being through a Practice Combining the Profound Path of "The Offering to Lamas, Indivisible Bliss and Voidness," and a Longevity Practice in the Tradition of Drupgyal...

gru.acip: SGRUB SDE DGE RGYAS THEG MCHOG GLING GI SPONG BA PA RNAMS KYI NYAMS BZHES KHRIMS SU BCA' BA'I YI GE NGO MTSAR BDUD RTZI'I DGA' STON
gru.wylie: sgrub sde dge rgyas theg mchog gling gi spong ba pa rnams kyi nyams bzhes khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i dga' ston
gru.english: "An Amazing Feast of Nectar," being a Book of Rules to be Used as a Guide for Daily Life by the Mendicants of the Monastery known as Drupde Gegye Tekchok Ling

gru.acip: DPAL GSANG BA 'DUS PA'I BSKYED RIM DNGOS GRUB RGYA MTSO DANG, RDZOGS RIM RIM LNGA GSAL SGRON GNYIS KYI GSUNG BSHAD NOS PA'I ZIN THO 'GA' ZHIG...
gru.wylie: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang, rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gnyis kyi gsung bshad nos pa'i zin tho 'ga' zhig...
gru.english: Notes taken on the Occasion of an Oral Teaching on "The Ocean of Attainments," on the Stage of Creation in the Teachings of the Glorious Secret Collection [Guhyasamaja]; and "The Lamp that Illuminates the Five Stages," on the Stage of Completion...

gru.acip: 'DUS PA 'PHAGS LUGS KYI SGRUB THABS MDOR BSDUS MCHOG GI DGA' STON
gru.wylie: 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus mchog gi dga' ston
gru.english: "The Ultimate Entertainment," being a Brief Ritual for Reaching the Secret Collection, according to the Tradition of the Realized Being

gru.acip: BCOM LDAN 'DAS DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED DPA' BO GCIG PA'I SGRUB THABS BDUD LAS RNAM RGYAL...
gru.wylie: bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam rgyal...
gru.english: "Total Victory over the Demons," being a Ritual for Reaching the Conqueror, the Glorious Diamond Frightener [Vajra Bhairava], in His Form as a Solitary Warrior [Eka Vira]...

gru.acip: BCOM LDAN 'DAS DPAL RDO RJE 'JIGS BYED DPA' BO GCIG PA'I SGRUB THABS SHIN TU MDOR BSDUS DANG, BDAG 'JUG SHIN TU BSDUS PA BCAS
gru.wylie: bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs shin tu mdor bsdus dang, bdag 'jug shin tu bsdus pa bcas
gru.english: An Extremely Brief Ritual for Reaching the Conqueror, the Glorious Diamond Frightener [Vajra Bhairava], in His Form as a Solitary Warrior [Eka Vira], and including the Instructions for Entering into His Secret World by Oneself

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN DRIL BU ZHABS LUGS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA LUS DKYIL GYI BUM BSKYED DANG BDAG 'JUG MDOR BSDUS...
gru.wylie: grub chen dril bu zhabs lugs 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil gyi bum bskyed dang bdag 'jug mdor bsdus...
gru.english: A Ritual for Creating the Sacred Vase of the Secret World of the Body in the Teachings of the Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], according to the Tradition of Ghantapada; along with a Brief Practice for Bringing Oneself into this Secret World...

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN DRIL BU ZHABS LUGS BCOM LDAN 'DAS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA LUS DKYIL GYI GZHI BSNYEN CHEN MO'I BSNYEN SGRUBS BKLAGS CHOG TU BKOD PA...
gru.wylie: grub chen dril bu zhabs lugs bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil gyi gzhi bsnyen chen mo'i bsnyen sgrubs bklags chog tu bkod pa...
gru.english: A Ritual Arranged for Recitation, in the Practice of a Great Foundation Retreat focusing on the Secret World of the Body in the Teachings of the Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], in the System of that Great Accomplished Master, Ghantapada...

gru.acip: GRUB CHEN DRIL BU ZHABS LUGS BCOM LDAN 'DAS 'KHOR LO SDOM PA LUS DKYIL LA BRTEN PA'I PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BYA TSUL GYI 'DON CHOG...
gru.wylie: grub chen dril bu zhabs lugs bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil la brten pa'i phyi rol mchod pa bya tshul gyi 'don chog...
gru.english: A Ritual, Meant to Be Recited, for the Practice of the Outer Offerings in the Secret World of the Body, within the Secret Teachings of the Conqueror, the Union of the Spheres [Chakrasamvara], according to the Tradition of Ghantapada...

gru.acip: 'CHI MED RDO RJE'I SROG TU SGRUB PA'I MAN NGAG KUN GYI PHUL GYUR RDO RJE BZLAS PA'I RLUNG SBYOR BDE MCHOG TSE LHA DKAR PO DANG SBRAGS TE NYAMS SU LEN TSUL GYI MAN NGAG...
gru.wylie: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog tu sgrub pa'i man ngag kun gyi phul gyur rdo rje bzlas pa'i rlung sbyor bde mchog tshe lha dkar po dang sbrags te nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag...
gru.english: Advices on the Capsule of Wind in the Diamond Recitation, the Absolute Ultimate among All Advices for Attaining the Adamantine State of Deathlessness, Combined with Practices of the White Angel of Life, in the Teachings of Highest Bliss [Sambara]...

gru.acip: BCOM LDAN 'DAS BDE MCHOG TSE LHA DKAR PO'I TSOGS MCHOD BYA TSUL DNGOS GRUB 'GUG PA'I LCAGS KYU
gru.wylie: bcom ldan 'das bde mchog tshe lha dkar po'i tshogs mchod bya tshul dngos grub 'gug pa'i lcags kyu

mang ba.english: In response, Subhuti replies: It would be many great mountains of merit--and these great mountains of merit are mountains of merit that we could establish as existing only in name, only in the way that a dream or an illusion exists: these same great mountains of merit though could never exist as mountains that existed ultimately. The Ones Thus Gone as well speak in a nominal sense of "great mountains of merit, great mountains of merit"--applying the name to them. This section is meant to demonstrate a number of different points. Black and white deeds that you have committed before now, and which you are going to commit later, are such that the ones in the past have stopped, and the ones in the future are yet to come. Therefore they are non-existent, but we have to agree that, generally speaking, they exist. We also have to agree that they are connected to the mind stream of the person who committed them, and that they produce their appropriate consequences for this person. mang ba.english: What this verse is saying is that it is possible for the person who was your father in your last life to turn into your son in this life. Your mother in your last life then can turn to your wife in this one. Your worst enemy can turn into your dearest relative, and the complete reverse of all these can happen as well: your son in your past life turns into your father in this one, and all the rest--there is no absolutely no certainty who is who. And that's not all. Even in this present life, we can see with our own two eyes how uncertain life can be: a person who was ready to murder someone the year before becomes in the following year their bosom friend, and so on. People though grasp to the occasional appearance that these relationships are something that are certain, and then begin to feel strong emotions of attachment, or anger. These lead them to spend their lives helping some people, and hurting others. They act like some kind of animal, dazed and confused, wandering aimlessly across some great wasteland. The animal runs, with no idea what it does, exhausting itself in the pursuit of what seems to be some great goal. And then some man appears and shouts at it, "What are you doing!" And then the animal reverses direction, and runs just as purposefully the opposite way. mang ba.english: The point of the verse is as follows. Suppose that you could manage to bring back, and collect together all the mothers' milk that you had ever fed upon in all the different bodies you have taken upon yourself. The massive amount of this milk would exceed the water in all four seas. The "four seas" here are different parts of the greater outer ocean, named from the four different hues of its four quarters as the colors of Mount Supreme reflect upon them. Even the deepest parts of these seas, and their other distances, are something that it is possible to measure; yet the number of births that you and I have taken are limitless in number. As such we have already drunk more milk of our mothers than the water these seas hold in them. And if we continue the way we are, if we go on following the life of ordinary beings, failing to practice the path, then we can still expect to drink a measure of milk which is infinitely more.

mang ba.english: The next suffering is [3] the fact that we have to shed our bodies, over and over. This is indicated in the lines that include, "It doesn't matter what wonderful kind of body I may be able to attain..." The point here is that, regardless of all the bad deeds we might accumulate in order to maintain this body we have now, it is an absolute certainty that--in the end--we will be forced to shed it. The power of the wrong deeds we did for the sake of the body though we carry along in our mind, and they bring to us the eventual result of unbearable pain. Beyond this are the lines that say, The size of the stack of rotting corpses belonging to each of us Would exceed an equivalent to the height of Mount Supreme itself. Suppose that you could put together a huge stack of all the skeletons left from the bodies that any particular person had ever taken on, and then left behind. This stack would be more immense than Summit, the great mountain at the middle of the world. The difficult expression nyechik here is meant to indicate "a quantity equivalent to the height," which is then exceeded.

Moreover, in no sutra or classical commentary at all do we see bodhisattvas who have reached the state conducive to their certain separation from suffering referred to as bodhisattvas residing in the dzambu-tree grove. Therefore the being in question is a bodhisattva who has managed to develop the first concentration level sitting at the base of a dzambu tree, and who has gained his every goal. From the point of view of his having overcome any desire for the objects of the desire realm, the bodhisattva is in no way distinguished from the non-Buddhists mentioned. mang ba.english: The Six Preliminaries and the Seven Ingredients The seventh ingredient is dedication, which is found in the verse with the words "prostrations and..." [The full verse reads: I dedicate To my future enlightenment All my merit, Whatever little goodness I may have gathered here By bowing myself and offering, By confessing and rejoicing, By urging and supplication.] Here we are taking all the virtuous seeds within us, represented by the goodness we have accomplished in practicing the six ingredients that have already come, and dedicating them as a cause for the full enlightenment of ourselves and every living being, together. Make this dedication with tremendous will, and the power of your good will flow forever, and never Read this prayer as I have taught you to here; understand what each verse means, and say it out slowly, without letting your mind wander to something else. If you can do this, then you will gain a great mountain of good deeds, beyond any kind of measuring. Five of the ingredients we have listed here—prostrating, offering, urging, supplicating, and rejoicing—help you to gather together the different factors that are conducive to the path. One of them, confessing, helps you clean yourself of the factors that are obstacles, ones that oppose the path. One part of rejoicing—dwelling in a sense of gladness over the good you have done yourself—also functions to multiply your virtue. Dedication works to multiply, fantastically, even the minor good deeds you have done in the acts of gathering, and cleaning, and multiplying. It also takes good deeds that are short-term, those that are going to give a good result and then disappear, and changes them so that they will never be exhausted. In brief, it functions in all three ways: to gather, to clean, and to multiply such that goodness never ends.

phra ma.english: Some of the humans Are too busy Thinking things are there; And some of the humans Are too busy Thinking that nothing is there. Some of them too Are too busy With killing; Some are too busy With robbing, and stealing; Some are too busy Trying to say things That will split up others. We either believe that things exist in a way that they can't possibly exist; or our minds have this habit of swinging to the opposite extreme, where we say that “nothingness” means that nothing exists, or nothing really matters—misperceptions of emptiness that have gone on for as long as the emptiness teachings themselves, thousands of years. And the very nature of these mistaken ideas about emptiness is that they make it easier not to be kind to everyone around us.

phra ma.english: Divisive speech, the words of a mentally Afflicted state meant to split up others. Harsh speech is that which is unpleasant; Meaningless, really every afflicted. Others, every other afflicted type like Flattery for gain, a song, a show. Like too wrong commentaries. (5) Divisive speech consists of words which are spoken purposely, without any mistake, and in a mentally afflicted state; they are meant to split up others who are friends, and their meaning should be understood by the other person. (6) Harsh speech consists of unpleasant words which are spoken purposely, and without any mistake; their meaning to should be understood by the other person. (7) "Meaningless speech" really refers to every case of words spoken in an afflicted state of mind.  Other groups say that what "meaningless speech" actually refers to is every afflicted type of the spoken word other than those three already mentioned.  They say cases would be like a monk's engaging in the improper livelihood of flattering someone for the purpose of some gain, or else singing a song out of desire. Still other cases would be where the monk told stories to entertain others at a show put on by some performer, or too where he began reciting some wrong commentary written by a non-Buddhist.
